description: The fuel volume regulator (also called metering unit or suction control valve) is a solenoid valve on the inlet side of the high-pressure pump, used mainly on common-rail diesel engines. The engine control module pulses it to set how much fuel the pump draws in and delivers to the rail, and in this way controls rail pressure. P0001 is set when the control module detects that the control circuit of this valve is open, i.e. no plausible current flows when the valve is driven. Rail pressure can then no longer be controlled as intended. Whether the valve is open or closed without current depends on the design, so the same fault can cause excess pressure in one system and no pressure in another.
possible_causes: Connector at the regulator loose, corroded or unplugged [HIGH]
Solenoid coil of the regulator open [MEDIUM]
Broken wire in the harness, e.g. chafing or rodent damage [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Der Kraftstoffmengenregler (auch Zumesseinheit oder Saugdrossel) ist ein Magnetventil auf der Saugseite der Hochdruckpumpe, vor allem bei Common-Rail-Dieselmotoren. Das Motorsteuergerät taktet ihn und legt so fest, wie viel Kraftstoff die Pumpe ansaugt und ins Rail fördert; damit regelt es den Raildruck. P0001 wird gesetzt, wenn das Steuergerät eine Unterbrechung im Steuerkreis des Ventils erkennt, also beim Ansteuern kein plausibler Strom fließt. Der Raildruck lässt sich dann nicht mehr wie vorgesehen regeln. Ob das Ventil stromlos offen oder geschlossen ist, hängt von der Bauart ab; derselbe Fehler kann deshalb in einem System Überdruck, in einem anderen gar keinen Druck bewirken.

symptoms: Engine cranks but does not start, or stalls (normally closed valve)
Loss of power or limp mode (normally open valve)

description: The fuel volume regulator (also called metering unit or suction control valve) is a solenoid valve on the inlet side of the high-pressure pump, used mainly on common-rail diesel engines. The engine control module pulses it to set how much fuel the pump draws in and delivers to the rail, and in this way controls rail pressure. With P0002 the circuit is electrically intact, but command and effect do not match: the measured current does not fit the duty cycle, or rail pressure does not follow the regulator position plausibly. The cause is often mechanical, for example a sticking valve, rather than the wiring.

High resistance at connector or wiring causing wrong current [MEDIUM]
Low-pressure supply problem: clogged filter or air in the fuel [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure sensor reading wrong values [LOW]

description: The fuel shutoff valve is a solenoid valve that opens or blocks the fuel supply. On diesel engines it is usually closed without current, so that the engine stops reliably when switched off. The engine control module energises it to let fuel flow and monitors its control circuit continuously. P0005 is set when this control circuit is open. A normally closed valve then cannot open, so the engine does not start or cuts out while driving. Which vehicles use this valve and code varies by manufacturer.
possible_causes: Wire or connector interrupted or corroded [HIGH]
Valve coil open [MEDIUM]
Fuse or relay in the valve supply faulty [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The engine control module learns how far each camshaft of bank 1 is offset from the crankshaft and compares this with a reference. P0008 is set when both camshafts of this bank are shifted in the same direction beyond a threshold. That points to the drive shared by the bank: a stretched primary timing chain, a worn tensioner, an idler gear or a crankshaft reluctor wheel that has slipped. A single faulty camshaft phaser does not set this code, because it affects only one camshaft.
possible_causes: Primary or timing chain stretched [HIGH]
Chain tensioner worn or loose [MEDIUM]
Timing drive fitted incorrectly after an engine repair [MEDIUM]
Crankshaft reluctor wheel slipped [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 1500€ - 4000€ (8h - 20h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: The engine control module learns how far each camshaft of bank 1 is offset from the crankshaft and compares this with a reference. That points to the drive shared by the bank: a stretched primary timing chain, a worn tensioner, an idler gear or a crankshaft reluctor wheel that has slipped. A single faulty camshaft phaser does not set this code, because it affects only one camshaft.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät lernt, wie weit jede Nockenwelle der Bank 1 gegenüber der Kurbelwelle versetzt ist, und vergleicht das mit einem Referenzwert. P0008 wird gesetzt, wenn beide Nockenwellen dieser Bank gleichsinnig über eine Schwelle hinaus verschoben sind. Das deutet auf den gemeinsamen Antrieb der Bank: eine gelängte Primär-Steuerkette, einen verschlissenen Spanner, ein Zwischenrad oder ein verrutschtes Geberrad an der Kurbelwelle. Ein einzelner defekter Nockenwellenversteller löst diesen Code nicht aus, weil er nur eine Nockenwelle betrifft.

symptoms: Timing chain rattle, especially at cold start
Loss of power or rough running
Often stored together with P0016 to P0019

description: This monitor does not judge the end position of the intake camshaft on bank 1 but how fast it follows a change of the commanded angle. The code is set when the actual angle lags behind the target for too long during several adjustments. The adjustment speed depends directly on oil flow, so worn or wrong oil and a partly clogged screen are the usual causes. Drivability is often hardly affected; the fault is an early warning before the camshaft misses its target position altogether. Bank 1 is the cylinder bank that contains cylinder 1.
possible_causes: Oil too thick or too thin, sludged, or oil level low [HIGH]
Screen at the oil control valve partly clogged [HIGH]
Oil control valve sluggish [MEDIUM]
Cam phaser leaking internally or worn [MEDIUM]
Generally weak oil pressure, e.g. worn oil pump or bearings [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 8h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The fuel volume regulator (also called metering unit or suction control valve) is a solenoid valve on the inlet side of the high-pressure pump, used mainly on common-rail diesel engines. The engine control module pulses it to set how much fuel the pump draws in and delivers to the rail, and in this way controls rail pressure. To compensate for tolerances and wear, the control module learns a long-term correction of the regulator control. P000E is set when this correction leaves its calibrated range. The regulator is electrically fine, but the system needs an unusually large correction all the time, which points to wear or contamination of regulator or pump, a weak low-pressure supply, or a missing calibration after a pump replacement.
possible_causes: Fuel volume regulator worn or contaminated [HIGH]
High-pressure pump worn, delivering less [MEDIUM]
Low-pressure side: clogged filter, weak lift pump or air in the fuel [MEDIUM]
Not calibrated after pump or regulator replacement [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure sensor drifting [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Der Kraftstoffmengenregler (auch Zumesseinheit oder Saugdrossel) ist ein Magnetventil auf der Saugseite der Hochdruckpumpe, vor allem bei Common-Rail-Dieselmotoren. Das Motorsteuergerät taktet ihn und legt so fest, wie viel Kraftstoff die Pumpe ansaugt und ins Rail fördert; damit regelt es den Raildruck. Um Toleranzen und Verschleiß auszugleichen, lernt das Steuergerät eine langfristige Korrektur der Regleransteuerung. P000E wird gesetzt, wenn diese Korrektur ihren festgelegten Bereich verlässt. Der Regler ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber das System braucht dauernd eine ungewöhnlich große Korrektur. Das deutet auf Verschleiß oder Verschmutzung von Regler oder Pumpe, eine schwache Niederdruckversorgung oder ein fehlendes Anlernen nach einem Pumpentausch.

symptoms: Often hardly noticeable at first, later loss of power
Hard starting if rail pressure is wrong

description: On common-rail diesel and some gasoline direct-injection systems a spring-loaded pressure relief valve protects the rail and injectors: if pressure rises too far, it opens and returns fuel to the tank, often holding a reduced pressure for limp-home operation. The control module recognises the opening from the rail pressure signal and stores P000F. The code reports an event, not a defect of the relief valve itself; the actual cause usually lies in pressure control, for example a regulator that delivers too much fuel.
possible_causes: Fuel volume regulator stuck open or without current, pump over-delivers [HIGH]
Rail pressure sensor reading wrong, control runs into overpressure [MEDIUM]
Pressure control valve faulty, where fitted [MEDIUM]
Fuel return line blocked or kinked [LOW]
Relief valve itself leaking or fatigued [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Bei Common-Rail-Dieseln und manchen Benzin-Direkteinspritzern schützt ein federbelastetes Druckbegrenzungsventil Rail und Injektoren: Steigt der Druck zu weit, öffnet es und leitet Kraftstoff zum Tank zurück, oft unter Beibehaltung eines verringerten Drucks für den Notlauf. Das Steuergerät erkennt das Öffnen am Raildrucksignal und speichert P000F. Der Code meldet ein Ereignis, keinen Defekt des Ventils selbst; die eigentliche Ursache liegt meist in der Druckregelung, etwa bei einem Regler, der zu viel Kraftstoff fördert.

symptoms: Sudden loss of power or limp mode

description: The engine control module drives the oil control valve (a pulse-width modulated solenoid) of the variable valve timing on the intake camshaft on bank 1. It checks the electrical state of this output and sets the code when the circuit is open, or when the measured state does not match the command, for example because of a short. Camshaft adjustment is then disabled and the phaser stays in its locked rest position: the engine keeps running, but with less torque and higher consumption. Bank 1 is the cylinder bank that contains cylinder 1.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Variable valve timing actuator failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Solenoid coil of the oil control valve open or shorted [HIGH]
Connector corroded, loose or soaked with engine oil wicking through the valve [HIGH]
Wiring harness chafed through or broken [MEDIUM]
Supply voltage missing, e.g. blown fuse [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Camshaft adjustment is then disabled and the phaser stays in its locked rest position: the engine keeps running, but with less torque and higher consumption. bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät steuert das Ölsteuerventil (ein pulsweitenmoduliertes Magnetventil) der Nockenwellenverstellung an der Einlassnockenwelle auf Bank 1 an. Es überwacht den elektrischen Zustand dieses Ausgangs und setzt den Code, wenn der Stromkreis unterbrochen ist oder der gemessene Zustand nicht zum Befehl passt, etwa durch einen Kurzschluss. Die Verstellung wird dann abgeschaltet, der Versteller bleibt in seiner verriegelten Grundstellung: Der Motor läuft weiter, aber mit weniger Drehmoment und höherem Verbrauch. Bank 1 ist die Zylinderreihe mit Zylinder 1.

symptoms: Less pulling power at low and medium engine speed

description: The engine control module compares the commanded position of the intake camshaft on bank 1 with the actual position it calculates from the camshaft and crankshaft sensors. This code is set when the camshaft sits further advanced than commanded for longer than a calibrated time, or, depending on the manufacturer, when the target is missed in either direction ("system performance"). Typical cause is a phaser that does not return to its rest position, for example because the oil control valve sticks open or its screen is clogged. Bank 1 is the cylinder bank that contains cylinder 1.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Camshaft variable timing solenoid failure, Engine oil level is too low, The engine is not timed correctly, The engine oil does not meet the manufacturer's requirements, Variable valve timing actuator failure, Worn timing chain

possible_causes: Oil level too low, oil sludged or wrong viscosity [HIGH]
Screen at the oil control valve clogged with debris [HIGH]
Oil control valve mechanically sticking [HIGH]
Cam phaser worn or its locking pin sticking [MEDIUM]
Timing chain worn or fitted incorrectly after a repair [LOW]

description: A camshaft profile actuator switches the intake camshaft (camshaft A) on bank 1 between two or more fixed cam profiles with different valve lift and duration, for example by shifting a cam piece axially or by locking rocker arms or tappets with oil pressure. Unlike a camshaft phaser it does not shift the timing continuously. The second letter "A" in the title numbers the actuator on this camshaft. This code is set when the control circuit of the actuator is open: no current flows when it is driven, because of a broken wire, an unplugged connector or an open coil. bilingual_description.en: A camshaft profile actuator switches the intake camshaft (camshaft A) on bank 2 between two or more fixed cam profiles with different valve lift and duration, for example by shifting a cam piece axially or by locking rocker arms or tappets with oil pressure. Unlike a camshaft phaser it does not shift the timing continuously. The second letter "A" in the title numbers the actuator on this camshaft. This code is set when the control circuit reads too high, typically because of a short to battery voltage or overcurrent in the output stage. The engine usually stays on one profile, typically the base profile with low lift. Some manufacturers report these faults with their own codes instead. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines.
bilingual_description.de: Ein Nockenprofil-Aktuator schaltet die Einlassnockenwelle (Nockenwelle A) auf Bank 2 zwischen zwei oder mehr festen Nockenprofilen mit unterschiedlichem Ventilhub und unterschiedlicher Öffnungsdauer um, etwa indem er ein Nockenstück axial verschiebt oder Kipphebel bzw. Stößel per Öldruck koppelt. Anders als ein Nockenwellenversteller verschiebt er die Steuerzeit nicht stufenlos. Das zweite „A“ im Titel nummeriert den Aktuator an dieser Welle. Dieser Code wird gesetzt, wenn der Steuerkreis zu hoch misst, typisch durch einen Kurzschluss nach Plus oder Überstrom in der Endstufe. Der Motor bleibt dann meist auf einem Profil, typisch dem Grundprofil mit kleinem Hub. Manche Hersteller melden solche Fehler stattdessen mit eigenen Codes. Bank 2 gibt es nur bei V- und Boxermotoren.

symptoms: Less power at high engine speed because the profile does not switch
Higher consumption or uneven part-load running, depending on the profile

description: The engine control module drives the oil control valve (a pulse-width modulated solenoid) of the variable valve timing on the intake camshaft on bank 2. It checks the electrical state of this output and sets the code when the circuit is open, or when the measured state does not match the command, for example because of a short. Camshaft adjustment is then disabled and the phaser stays in its locked rest position: the engine keeps running, but with less torque and higher consumption. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines; it is the cylinder bank without cylinder 1.
possible_causes: Solenoid coil of the oil control valve open or shorted [HIGH]
Connector corroded, loose or soaked with engine oil wicking through the valve [HIGH]
Wiring harness chafed through or broken [MEDIUM]
Supply voltage missing, e.g. blown fuse [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: "A" Camshaft Position Actuator Circuit (Bank 2)

bilingual_description.en: The engine control module drives the oil control valve (a pulse-width modulated solenoid) of the variable valve timing on the intake camshaft on bank 2. It checks the electrical state of this output and sets the code when the circuit is open, or when the measured state does not match the command, for example because of a short. Camshaft adjustment is then disabled and the phaser stays in its locked rest position: the engine keeps running, but with less torque and higher consumption. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines; it is the cylinder bank without cylinder 1.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät steuert das Ölsteuerventil (ein pulsweitenmoduliertes Magnetventil) der Nockenwellenverstellung an der Einlassnockenwelle auf Bank 2 an. Es überwacht den elektrischen Zustand dieses Ausgangs und setzt den Code, wenn der Stromkreis unterbrochen ist oder der gemessene Zustand nicht zum Befehl passt, etwa durch einen Kurzschluss. Die Verstellung wird dann abgeschaltet, der Versteller bleibt in seiner verriegelten Grundstellung: Der Motor läuft weiter, aber mit weniger Drehmoment und höherem Verbrauch. Bank 2 gibt es nur bei V- und Boxermotoren; gemeint ist die Zylinderreihe ohne Zylinder 1.

symptoms: Less pulling power at low and medium engine speed

description: The engine control module compares the commanded position of the intake camshaft on bank 2 with the actual position it calculates from the camshaft and crankshaft sensors. This code is set when the camshaft sits further advanced than commanded for longer than a calibrated time, or, depending on the manufacturer, when the target is missed in either direction ("system performance"). Typical cause is a phaser that does not return to its rest position, for example because the oil control valve sticks open or its screen is clogged. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines; it is the cylinder bank without cylinder 1.
possible_causes: Oil level too low, oil sludged or wrong viscosity [HIGH]
Screen at the oil control valve clogged with debris [HIGH]
Oil control valve mechanically sticking [HIGH]
Cam phaser worn or its locking pin sticking [MEDIUM]
Timing chain worn or fitted incorrectly after a repair [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 1800€ (0.5h - 8h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.de: Nockenwellenposition "A" (Einlass) – Steuerzeit zu früh oder Systemleistung (Bank 2)

bilingual_description.en: The engine control module compares the commanded position of the intake camshaft on bank 2 with the actual position it calculates from the camshaft and crankshaft sensors. This code is set when the camshaft sits further advanced than commanded for longer than a calibrated time, or, depending on the manufacturer, when the target is missed in either direction ("system performance"). Typical cause is a phaser that does not return to its rest position, for example because the oil control valve sticks open or its screen is clogged. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines; it is the cylinder bank without cylinder 1.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät vergleicht die angeforderte Stellung der Einlassnockenwelle auf Bank 2 mit der tatsächlichen, die es aus Nockenwellen- und Kurbelwellensensor berechnet. Der Code wird gesetzt, wenn die Nockenwelle länger als eine festgelegte Zeit weiter in Richtung früh steht als befohlen, oder je nach Hersteller, wenn der Sollwert in beide Richtungen verfehlt wird („Systemleistung“). Typisch ist ein Versteller, der nicht in seine Grundstellung zurückkehrt, etwa weil das Ölsteuerventil offen klemmt oder sein Sieb zugesetzt ist. Bank 2 gibt es nur bei V- und Boxermotoren; gemeint ist die Zylinderreihe ohne Zylinder 1.

symptoms: Rough or unstable idle, as valve overlap is too large
Rattling from the timing drive at cold start

description: The engine control module compares the commanded position of the intake camshaft on bank 2 with the actual position from the camshaft and crankshaft sensors. This code is set when the camshaft stays further retarded than commanded for longer than a calibrated time. Usually the phaser does not move far enough out of its rest position, because oil pressure is too low to release the locking pin, the oil control valve does not open, or the oil screen is blocked. A stretched timing chain also shifts the camshaft towards retarded. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines; it is the cylinder bank without cylinder 1.
possible_causes: Oil pressure or oil level too low, oil worn out [HIGH]
Oil control valve sticking closed or its screen blocked [HIGH]
Cam phaser defective or seized in its rest position [MEDIUM]
Timing chain stretched or jumped a tooth [MEDIUM]
Wear debris in the oil circuit, e.g. from a thrust bearing [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 10h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: A solenoid valve routes engine oil to a valve control element on the intake side of bank 1. Depending on the manufacturer this is a valve lift changeover or a camshaft phaser. P0026 is a plausibility fault: the electrical control is in order, but the expected effect does not occur or comes too late. The control module recognises this from feedback such as an oil pressure switch or the camshaft sensor. Pure circuit faults of the same solenoid have their own codes. The engine usually remains drivable, but with less power and higher consumption.
possible_causes: Oil level too low, wrong viscosity or sludged oil [HIGH]
Feedback oil pressure switch faulty or leaking (systems with switch) [HIGH]
Screen in front of the solenoid clogged, or solenoid sticking [MEDIUM]
Mechanical fault in the valve train, e.g. locking pin or phaser sticking [MEDIUM]
Contact resistance in wiring or connector [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Ein Magnetventil leitet Motoröl zu einem Ventilsteuerungs-Element auf der Einlassseite von Bank 1. Je nach Hersteller ist das eine Ventilhub-Umschaltung oder ein Nockenwellenversteller. P0026 ist ein Plausibilitätsfehler: Die elektrische Ansteuerung ist in Ordnung, aber die erwartete Wirkung bleibt aus oder kommt zu spät. Das Steuergerät erkennt das an einer Rückmeldung, etwa einem Öldruckschalter oder dem Nockenwellensensor. Reine Stromkreisfehler desselben Magnetventils haben eigene Codes. Der Motor bleibt meist fahrbar, aber mit weniger Leistung und höherem Verbrauch.

symptoms: Loss of power, no extra pull at higher engine speed
Rough idle possible if a phaser is affected

description: The upstream oxygen sensor on bank 1 (sensor 1, before the catalytic converter) only delivers a usable signal once its ceramic element is hot. A heating element inside the sensor gets it there quickly after a cold start. Typically the heater receives battery voltage via a fuse or relay, and the engine control module switches the ground side with a pulsed signal while comparing the commanded state with the measured voltage or current. P0030 is the general circuit fault: the measured state does not fit the command, most often because the circuit is interrupted. Which physical fault sets P0030, P0031 or P0032 is defined by each manufacturer. Without heating, closed-loop mixture control starts late and cold-start emissions rise.
possible_causes: Heater circuit interrupted, e.g. broken or chafed wire near the exhaust [HIGH]
Heating element inside the sensor burnt out [HIGH]
Connector corroded or terminal pushed back [MEDIUM]
Heater supply fuse or relay faulty [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]

description: The turbocharger bypass valve A is the compressor recirculation (diverter) valve: it connects the pressure side of the compressor with the intake side upstream of the turbocharger. description: The electric boost actuator A positions the variable turbine vanes or the wastegate and reports its position through a sensor. In a learning run, for example with the engine warm at idle or after switching off, the control module drives the actuator to its mechanical end stops and stores the sensor values as reference. P003A is set when a learned end position or the total travel lies outside the permitted limits. Typical reasons are worn or sticking vanes or linkage, a faulty actuator, a broken actuator lever, or a replacement actuator that has not been learned in. A usually denotes the first turbocharger in the exhaust flow.
possible_causes: Electronic actuator or its control module faulty [HIGH]
Vane mechanism, sector gear or linkage worn or sticking [MEDIUM]
Replacement not learned in, or learning run aborted (e.g. low voltage) [MEDIUM]
Actuator lever broken [LOW]
Position sensor or its wiring faulty [LOW]

description: The camshaft profile actuator A switches the intake camshaft (camshaft A) on bank 1 between fixed cam profiles, usually a low-lift base profile and a high-lift profile. In most designs the unactuated state ("off") is the base profile; which profile counts as "on" is defined by the manufacturer. The control module does not need a position sensor to check the switchover: it detects the actual profile indirectly, for example from oil pressure in the switching gallery, intake pressure per cylinder or crankshaft speed fluctuations. This code is set when the switchover is commanded but the camshaft stays on the base profile, or switches too slowly or incompletely. The engine then lacks power at higher engine speed.
possible_causes: Oil level too low, wrong viscosity or sludged oil, so switching pressure is missing [HIGH]
Profile switching solenoid sticking or its screen clogged [HIGH]
Oil supply to the switching elements leaking or restricted, e.g. worn seals [MEDIUM]
Locking pin in tappet or rocker arm, or sliding cam piece, sticking [MEDIUM]
Consequence of a circuit fault of the same actuator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 3500€ (0.5h - 10h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Der Nockenprofil-Aktuator A schaltet die Einlassnockenwelle (Nockenwelle A) auf Bank 1 zwischen festen Nockenprofilen um, meist zwischen einem Grundprofil mit kleinem Hub und einem Profil mit großem Hub. Bei den meisten Bauarten ist der unbetätigte Zustand („aus“) das Grundprofil; welches Profil als „an“ gilt, legt der Hersteller fest. Einen Positionsgeber braucht das Steuergerät für die Prüfung nicht: Es erkennt das tatsächliche Profil indirekt, etwa am Öldruck in der Schaltgalerie, am Saugrohrdruck je Zylinder oder an Drehzahlschwankungen der Kurbelwelle. Dieser Code wird gesetzt, wenn die Umschaltung befohlen ist, die Nockenwelle aber im Grundprofil bleibt oder zu langsam bzw. unvollständig umschaltet. Dem Motor fehlt dann Leistung bei höherer Drehzahl.

description: On engines with two exhaust banks, the control module checks whether the upstream oxygen sensors are assigned to the right bank. description: "Boost control A" is the electrically driven actuator the engine control module uses to set boost pressure: depending on the engine a pulse-width modulated solenoid or vacuum converter at the wastegate, the control valve of variable turbine vanes, or an electric actuator with position feedback. The letters A and B denote two separate actuators, for example on the low- and high-pressure turbocharger of a two-stage system, not the cylinder banks. This code is set when the control circuit is open: with the driver switched off no load can be measured, or the measured state does not match the command. Without control the actuator usually falls back to its rest position, which on most engines means low boost; depending on the design too much boost is also possible.

bilingual_description.de: „Ladedruckregelung A“ ist das elektrisch angesteuerte Stellglied, mit dem das Motorsteuergerät den Ladedruck einstellt: je nach Motor ein pulsweitenmoduliertes Magnetventil oder ein Unterdruckwandler am Wastegate, das Steuerventil der verstellbaren Turbinenschaufeln oder ein elektrischer Steller mit Positionsrückmeldung. Die Buchstaben A und B bezeichnen zwei getrennte Stellglieder, etwa am Nieder- und am Hochdrucklader einer zweistufigen Aufladung, nicht die Zylinderbänke. Dieser Code wird gesetzt, wenn der Steuerkreis unterbrochen ist: Bei abgeschalteter Endstufe ist keine Last messbar, oder der gemessene Zustand passt nicht zum Befehl. Ohne Ansteuerung fällt das Stellglied meist in seine Ruhestellung, was bei den meisten Motoren wenig Ladedruck bedeutet; je nach Auslegung ist auch zu viel Ladedruck möglich.

B is the second actuator, for example on the high-pressure turbocharger of a two-stage system or on the second turbocharger; it does not denote cylinder bank 2. With this code the circuit is electrically intact, but the actuator does not follow the command plausibly: its actual position deviates too far or too long from the target, or its learned values do not fit. Boost is then too low or too high depending on where it sticks, often with reduced power.
bilingual_description.de: „Ladedruckregelung B“ ist das elektrisch angesteuerte Stellglied, mit dem das Motorsteuergerät den Ladedruck einstellt: je nach Motor ein pulsweitenmoduliertes Magnetventil oder ein Unterdruckwandler am Wastegate, das Steuerventil der verstellbaren Turbinenschaufeln oder ein elektrischer Steller mit Positionsrückmeldung. B ist das zweite Stellglied, etwa am Hochdrucklader einer zweistufigen Aufladung oder am zweiten Lader; es bezeichnet nicht Zylinderbank 2. Bei diesem Code ist der Kreis elektrisch in Ordnung, aber das Stellglied folgt dem Befehl nicht plausibel: Seine Ist-Position weicht zu weit oder zu lange vom Sollwert ab, oder seine Lernwerte passen nicht. Der Ladedruck ist dann je nach Klemmstellung zu niedrig oder zu hoch, oft mit reduzierter Leistung.

symptoms: Loss of power or reduced power mode

description: "Boost control B" is the electrically driven actuator the engine control module uses to set boost pressure: depending on the engine a pulse-width modulated solenoid or vacuum converter at the wastegate, the control valve of variable turbine vanes, or an electric actuator with position feedback. B is the second actuator, for example on the high-pressure turbocharger of a two-stage system or on the second turbocharger; it does not denote cylinder bank 2. This code is set when the voltage at the control output is too low, typically because of a short to ground; some manufacturers also report a missing supply this way. Without control the actuator usually falls back to its rest position, which on most engines means low boost; depending on the design too much boost is also possible.
possible_causes: Harness chafed, short to ground [HIGH]
Actuator coil shorted [MEDIUM]
Water in the connector [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 900€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: "Boost control A" is the electrically driven actuator the engine control module uses to set boost pressure: depending on the engine a pulse-width modulated solenoid or vacuum converter at the wastegate, the control valve of variable turbine vanes, or an electric actuator with position feedback. The letters A and B denote two separate actuators, for example on the low- and high-pressure turbocharger of a two-stage system, not the cylinder banks. This code is set when the circuit signal drops out briefly or jumps, as with a loose contact. Boost then fluctuates and reduced power may occur only now and then. Wire broken internally by engine movement [HIGH]
Corroded terminals [MEDIUM]
Actuator itself faulty [LOW]

description: The heated oxygen sensor on bank 2 is the upstream sensor (sensor 1, before the catalytic converter), used for mixture control. Its heating element brings it quickly to operating temperature. Typically the heater receives battery voltage via a fuse, and the engine control module switches the ground side with a pulsed signal while checking that the circuit state matches the command. P0050 is the general circuit fault: the measured state of the heater circuit does not fit the command, most often because the circuit is interrupted. Which physical fault sets the general, low or high code is defined by each manufacturer. Without heating, closed-loop mixture control starts late and cold-start emissions rise. Bank 2 codes occur only on engines with two exhaust banks (V or boxer engines).
possible_causes: Heating element inside the sensor burnt out [HIGH]
Wire or connector damaged by heat or road spray [HIGH]
Heater fuse blown; a shared fuse can set several heater codes [MEDIUM]
Output driver or software of the engine control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: HO2S Heater Control Circuit (Bank 2 Sensor 1)

bilingual_description.en: The heated oxygen sensor on bank 2 is the upstream sensor (sensor 1, before the catalytic converter), used for mixture control. Its heating element brings it quickly to operating temperature. Typically the heater receives battery voltage via a fuse, and the engine control module switches the ground side with a pulsed signal while checking that the circuit state matches the command. P0050 is the general circuit fault: the measured state of the heater circuit does not fit the command, most often because the circuit is interrupted. Which physical fault sets the general, low or high code is defined by each manufacturer. Without heating, closed-loop mixture control starts late and cold-start emissions rise. Bank 2 codes occur only on engines with two exhaust banks (V or boxer engines).
bilingual_description.de: Die beheizte Lambdasonde auf Bank 2 ist die vorgeschaltete Sonde (Sonde 1, vor dem Katalysator), die der Gemischregelung dient. Ihr Heizelement bringt sie schnell auf Betriebstemperatur. Meist bekommt die Heizung Bordspannung über eine Sicherung, und das Motorsteuergerät schaltet die Masseseite getaktet, wobei es prüft, ob der Zustand des Kreises zum Befehl passt. P0050 ist der allgemeine Stromkreisfehler: Der gemessene Zustand des Heizkreises passt nicht zum Befehl, meist weil der Kreis unterbrochen ist. Welcher elektrische Fehler den allgemeinen, den niedrigen oder den hohen Code auslöst, legt jeder Hersteller selbst fest. Ohne Heizung beginnt die Gemischregelung verspätet, und die Kaltstartemissionen steigen. Codes für Bank 2 gibt es nur bei Motoren mit zwei Abgassträngen (V- oder Boxermotoren).

description: On bank 1, this monitor checks the heating element of the upstream sensor (sensor 1, before the catalytic converter) not for an open or short circuit, but for its resistance. Many systems measure it once after a genuine cold start, when coolant and intake air temperatures show that the sensor is at ambient temperature, and correct the value for temperature; some manufacturers evaluate the heater current instead. The code is set when the value lies outside the limits for this sensor type, typically because the element has aged. Since the test often runs only after a long standstill, the code may take a night to confirm or clear.
possible_causes: Heating element aged or partly damaged [HIGH]
Contact resistance or corrosion at connector or pins [MEDIUM]
Replacement sensor with a different heater type fitted [MEDIUM]
Engine control module faulty [LOW]

Typically the heater receives battery voltage via a fuse, and the engine control module switches the ground side with a pulsed signal while checking that the circuit state matches the command. P0056 is the general circuit fault: the measured state of the heater circuit does not fit the command, most often because the circuit is interrupted. Which physical fault sets the general, low or high code is defined by each manufacturer. Without heating, the sensor becomes ready late and catalyst monitoring may not complete. Bank 2 codes occur only on engines with two exhaust banks (V or boxer engines).
bilingual_description.de: Die beheizte Lambdasonde auf Bank 2 ist die Sonde 2 hinter dem (ersten) Katalysator, die vor allem den Katalysator überwacht. Ihr Heizelement bringt sie schnell auf Betriebstemperatur. Meist bekommt die Heizung Bordspannung über eine Sicherung, und das Motorsteuergerät schaltet die Masseseite getaktet, wobei es prüft, ob der Zustand des Kreises zum Befehl passt. P0056 ist der allgemeine Stromkreisfehler: Der gemessene Zustand des Heizkreises passt nicht zum Befehl, meist weil der Kreis unterbrochen ist. Ohne Heizung wird die Sonde verspätet betriebsbereit, und die Katalysatorüberwachung läuft womöglich nicht durch. Codes für Bank 2 gibt es nur bei Motoren mit zwei Abgassträngen (V- oder Boxermotoren).

description: On bank 2, this monitor checks the heating element of the upstream sensor (sensor 1, before the catalytic converter) not for an open or short circuit, but for its resistance. Many systems measure it once after a genuine cold start, when coolant and intake air temperatures show that the sensor is at ambient temperature, and correct the value for temperature; some manufacturers evaluate the heater current instead. The code is set when the value lies outside the limits for this sensor type, typically because the element has aged. Since the test often runs only after a long standstill, the code may take a night to confirm or clear. Bank 2 codes occur only on engines with two exhaust banks (V or boxer engines).

description: The camshaft profile actuator A switches the exhaust camshaft (camshaft B) on bank 1 between fixed cam profiles, usually a low-lift base profile and a high-lift profile. In most designs the unactuated state ("off") is the base profile; which profile counts as "on" is defined by the manufacturer. The control module does not need a position sensor to check the switchover: it detects the actual profile indirectly, for example from oil pressure in the switching gallery, intake pressure per cylinder or crankshaft speed fluctuations. This code is set when the switchover is commanded but the camshaft stays on the base profile, or switches too slowly or incompletely. The engine then lacks power at higher engine speed.
possible_causes: Oil level too low, wrong viscosity or sludged oil, so switching pressure is missing [HIGH]
Profile switching solenoid sticking or its screen clogged [HIGH]
Oil supply to the switching elements leaking or restricted, e.g. worn seals [MEDIUM]
Locking pin in tappet or rocker arm, or sliding cam piece, sticking [MEDIUM]
Consequence of a circuit fault of the same actuator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 3500€ (0.5h - 10h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.en: The camshaft profile actuator A switches the exhaust camshaft (camshaft B) on bank 1 between fixed cam profiles, usually a low-lift base profile and a high-lift profile. In most designs the unactuated state ("off") is the base profile; which profile counts as "on" is defined by the manufacturer. The control module does not need a position sensor to check the switchover: it detects the actual profile indirectly, for example from oil pressure in the switching gallery, intake pressure per cylinder or crankshaft speed fluctuations. This code is set when the switchover is commanded but the camshaft stays on the base profile, or switches too slowly or incompletely. The engine then lacks power at higher engine speed.
bilingual_description.de: Der Nockenprofil-Aktuator A schaltet die Auslassnockenwelle (Nockenwelle B) auf Bank 1 zwischen festen Nockenprofilen um, meist zwischen einem Grundprofil mit kleinem Hub und einem Profil mit großem Hub. Bei den meisten Bauarten ist der unbetätigte Zustand („aus“) das Grundprofil; welches Profil als „an“ gilt, legt der Hersteller fest. Einen Positionsgeber braucht das Steuergerät für die Prüfung nicht: Es erkennt das tatsächliche Profil indirekt, etwa am Öldruck in der Schaltgalerie, am Saugrohrdruck je Zylinder oder an Drehzahlschwankungen der Kurbelwelle. Dieser Code wird gesetzt, wenn die Umschaltung befohlen ist, die Nockenwelle aber im Grundprofil bleibt oder zu langsam bzw. unvollständig umschaltet. Dem Motor fehlt dann Leistung bei höherer Drehzahl.

description: "Boost control B" is the electrically driven actuator the engine control module uses to set boost pressure: depending on the engine a pulse-width modulated solenoid or vacuum converter at the wastegate, the control valve of variable turbine vanes, or an electric actuator with position feedback. B is the second actuator, for example on the high-pressure turbocharger of a two-stage system or on the second turbocharger; it does not denote cylinder bank 2. This code concerns the supply voltage that the control module switches to the actuator (high side): it is too low, for example because of a short to ground or an open circuit. Without control the actuator usually falls back to its rest position, which on most engines means low boost; depending on the design too much boost is also possible.
possible_causes: Supply wire shorted to ground or interrupted [HIGH]
Fuse or relay of the supply faulty [MEDIUM]
Internal short in the actuator [MEDIUM]
High-side driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 900€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: „Ladedruckregelung B“ ist das elektrisch angesteuerte Stellglied, mit dem das Motorsteuergerät den Ladedruck einstellt: je nach Motor ein pulsweitenmoduliertes Magnetventil oder ein Unterdruckwandler am Wastegate, das Steuerventil der verstellbaren Turbinenschaufeln oder ein elektrischer Steller mit Positionsrückmeldung. B ist das zweite Stellglied, etwa am Hochdrucklader einer zweistufigen Aufladung oder am zweiten Lader; es bezeichnet nicht Zylinderbank 2. Dieser Code betrifft die Versorgungsspannung, die das Steuergerät dem Stellglied zuschaltet (Plusseite): Sie ist zu niedrig, etwa durch einen Masseschluss oder eine Unterbrechung. Ohne Ansteuerung fällt das Stellglied meist in seine Ruhestellung, was bei den meisten Motoren wenig Ladedruck bedeutet; je nach Auslegung ist auch zu viel Ladedruck möglich.

Its heating element brings it quickly to operating temperature. Typically the heater receives battery voltage via a fuse, and the engine control module switches the ground side with a pulsed signal while checking that the circuit state matches the command. description: Air-assisted injectors have an air sleeve around the nozzle tip: air flowing past at high speed breaks the fuel spray into finer droplets, which improves combustion and cold starts and lowers hydrocarbon emissions. On port-injected engines this air is taken upstream of the throttle and dosed by a pulse-width modulated bypass solenoid; because it bypasses the throttle, it is part of the idle air. The system is rare and mainly found on older engines. P0065 means the control is electrically in order, but the effect is implausible. One documented method compares the idle speed controller correction with the air assistance switched on and off during stable idle; if the difference is too large, the code is set.
possible_causes: Air-assist solenoid sticking or dirty [HIGH]
Air hoses to the injectors leaking, disconnected or blocked [HIGH]
Air passages at the injectors coked [MEDIUM]
Air leak distorting idle control [MEDIUM]

bilingual_description.de: Luftunterstützte Einspritzventile haben eine Luftumfassung um die Düsenspitze: Mit hoher Geschwindigkeit vorbeiströmende Luft zerreißt den Kraftstoffstrahl in feinere Tröpfchen, was Verbrennung und Kaltstart verbessert und die Kohlenwasserstoff-Emissionen senkt. Bei Saugrohreinspritzung wird diese Luft vor der Drosselklappe abgezweigt und über ein pulsweitenmoduliertes Bypass-Magnetventil dosiert; da sie an der Drosselklappe vorbeiströmt, gehört sie zur Leerlaufluft. Das System ist selten und vor allem bei älteren Motoren zu finden. P0065 bedeutet: Die Ansteuerung ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber die Wirkung ist unplausibel. Ein dokumentiertes Verfahren vergleicht im stabilen Leerlauf die Korrektur der Leerlaufregelung mit ein- und ausgeschalteter Luftunterstützung; ist der Unterschied zu groß, wird der Code gesetzt.

description: The engine control module compares the air quantity measured by the manifold pressure and/or mass air flow sensor with the quantity the throttle position leads it to expect. P0068 is set when they do not match, typically because more air arrives than the nearly closed throttle allows, i.e. an air leak behind the throttle, or because the throttle body is dirty or a sensor reads wrong. On engines with electronic throttle this check protects throttle control, so the engine often goes into reduced power. Each sensor can be electrically fine on its own; regulations require such plausibility checks for input sensors with a code of their own.
possible_causes: Air leak behind the throttle: intake manifold, vacuum or MAP hoses [HIGH]
Throttle body dirty [HIGH]
Mass air flow or manifold pressure sensor faulty [MEDIUM]
Engine control software (manufacturer updates exist) [MEDIUM]
Camshaft timing out of position [LOW]

description: With the ignition on and the engine stopped, the intake manifold is at ambient pressure, so the manifold pressure sensor and the barometric pressure sensor (often inside the control module) must read almost the same. P0069 is set when they differ by more than a threshold. Some systems also compare the barometric reading with a value estimated from manifold pressure at wide-open throttle while driving. Altitude and weather shift both values equally and do not cause the code. Each sensor can be electrically fine on its own; regulations require such plausibility checks for input sensors with a code of their own.
possible_causes: Manifold pressure sensor drifting [HIGH]
MAP sensor hose blocked, kinked or leaking [HIGH]
Barometric pressure sensor (often inside the control module) faulty [MEDIUM]
5 V reference or connector faulty [MEDIUM]

description: The engine control module compares the air quantity measured by the mass air flow sensor with the quantity it calculates from manifold pressure, engine speed and temperature. P006A is set when the two deviate too far. A typical cause is an exhaust gas recirculation valve that does not close: recirculated exhaust raises manifold pressure without passing the air flow sensor. Air leaks, a leaking crankcase ventilation hose or a dirty sensor have the same effect. Each sensor can be electrically fine on its own; regulations require such plausibility checks for input sensors with a code of their own.

bilingual_title.en: MAP - Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Correlation

bilingual_description.en: On turbocharged or supercharged engines the control module compares manifold pressure with the pressure measured upstream of the throttle, for example at idle or with the throttle wide open, where the two must lie close together. P006C is set when the difference exceeds a threshold. Manufacturers interpret "inlet pressure" differently: some mean boost pressure upstream of the throttle, others the pressure at the compressor inlet. Typical causes are a leak in the charge-air path or a faulty pressure sensor. Each sensor can be electrically fine on its own; regulations require such plausibility checks for input sensors with a code of their own.
bilingual_description.de: Bei aufgeladenen Motoren vergleicht das Steuergerät den Saugrohrdruck mit dem vor der Drosselklappe gemessenen Druck, etwa im Leerlauf oder bei weit offener Drosselklappe, wo beide nah beieinander liegen müssen. P006C wird gesetzt, wenn die Differenz eine Schwelle überschreitet. Hersteller verstehen unter „Eingangsdruck“ Verschiedenes: manche den Ladedruck vor der Drosselklappe, andere den Druck am Verdichtereintritt. Typische Ursachen sind ein Leck im Ladeluftweg oder ein defekter Drucksensor. Jeder Sensor kann für sich elektrisch in Ordnung sein; Vorschriften verlangen solche Plausibilitätsprüfungen für Eingangssensoren mit eigenem Code.

description: Without boost, for example with the engine stopped or at low load, the pressure sensor ahead of the turbocharger or supercharger must read about the same as the barometric pressure sensor. P006D is set when the difference is too large; some manufacturers compare against an estimated barometric value instead and run the check once per ignition cycle. Typical causes are a faulty inlet pressure sensor, a faulty barometric sensor (often inside the control module) or a wiring or reference-voltage fault. Each sensor can be electrically fine on its own; regulations require such plausibility checks for input sensors with a code of their own.
possible_causes: Inlet pressure sensor faulty [HIGH]
Barometric pressure sensor or control module faulty [MEDIUM]
Wiring, connector or 5 V reference faulty [MEDIUM]
Clogged air filter lowering pressure ahead of the compressor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 250€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: "Boost control A" is the electrically driven actuator the engine control module uses to set boost pressure, for example a wastegate solenoid, the control valve of variable turbine vanes or an electric actuator. Some engines supply it through two driver stages in the control module: a high side that switches the supply voltage and a low side that switches ground. The low side is covered by P0045 to P0048; this code concerns the high side. P006E is set when the switched supply voltage is too low, typically because the supply wire is shorted to ground or interrupted. Without supply the actuator stays in its rest position, which on most engines means low boost and reduced power.
possible_causes: Supply wire shorted to ground or interrupted [HIGH]

description: The ambient air temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor whose resistance falls as temperature rises. Its value is used by the climate control, the outside temperature display and the engine control module, which needs it to enable other diagnostics and to correct its maps. bilingual_description.de: Der Außenlufttemperatursensor A ist ein NTC-Thermistor, dessen Widerstand mit steigender Temperatur sinkt. description: The ambient air temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor whose resistance falls as temperature rises. description: A solenoid valve on the cylinder head controls oil flow for the variable valve control on the intake side of bank 1. Depending on the manufacturer it drives a camshaft phaser (for example on Nissan engines) or a valve lift changeover (for example on Subaru engines). This code family reports electrical faults in its control circuit; P0075 is the general circuit fault: open circuit or short, without distinguishing between them. Some manufacturers use only this code for all electrical faults of the valve. Other manufacturers report the same valve under the "camshaft position actuator" codes instead. Valve control is then switched off or stays in its base position.

Diese Codegruppe meldet elektrische Fehler im Steuerkreis; P0084 ist der allgemeine Stromkreisfehler: Unterbrechung oder Kurzschluss, ohne Unterscheidung. Manche Hersteller nutzen für alle elektrischen Fehler des Ventils nur diesen Code. Andere Hersteller melden dasselbe Ventil stattdessen unter den Codes für den Nockenwellenversteller. Die Ventilsteuerung wird dann abgeschaltet oder bleibt in ihrer Grundstellung. Bank 2 gibt es nur bei V- und Boxermotoren.

description: A solenoid valve on the cylinder head controls oil flow for the variable valve control on the exhaust side of bank 2. Depending on the manufacturer it drives a camshaft phaser (for example on Nissan engines) or a valve lift changeover (for example on Subaru engines). This code family reports electrical faults in its control circuit; P0085 means the voltage in the control circuit is too low, typically a short to ground; depending on the driver stage an open solenoid winding can also set this code. Other manufacturers report the same valve under the "camshaft position actuator" codes instead. Valve control is then switched off or stays in its base position. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground, or solenoid winding open (driver-dependent) [HIGH]
Shorted turns in the solenoid coil [MEDIUM]
Corroded or oil-soaked connector [MEDIUM]
Output driver or supply in the engine control module faulty [LOW]

description: On common-rail diesel and gasoline direct-injection engines, a high-pressure pump feeds the fuel rail, a sensor measures rail pressure, and the engine control module regulates it towards a target from its maps. P0087 is set when the actual pressure stays below the target by more than a threshold for some time. It is a system code: it does not say which component is at fault. Typical causes are a weak low-pressure supply, a worn high-pressure pump, a sticking control valve, a leak or a drifting pressure sensor; the engine usually goes into reduced power.
possible_causes: Low-pressure supply too weak: lift pump, clogged filter, low tank level or waxing [HIGH]
High-pressure pump worn [HIGH]
Pressure control or metering valve sticking [MEDIUM]
High-pressure leak or excessive injector return flow [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure sensor drifting [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Bei Common-Rail-Dieseln und Benzin-Direkteinspritzern speist eine Hochdruckpumpe das Rail, ein Sensor misst den Raildruck, und das Motorsteuergerät regelt ihn auf einen Sollwert aus seinen Kennfeldern. P0087 wird gesetzt, wenn der Istdruck eine Zeit lang um mehr als eine Schwelle unter dem Sollwert bleibt. Es ist ein Systemcode: Er sagt nicht, welches Bauteil schuld ist. Typische Ursachen sind eine schwache Niederdruckversorgung, eine verschlissene Hochdruckpumpe, ein klemmendes Regelventil, ein Leck oder ein driftender Drucksensor; der Motor geht meist in einen Notlauf mit reduzierter Leistung.

symptoms: Loss of power or reduced power mode

description: On common-rail diesel and gasoline direct-injection engines, a high-pressure pump feeds the fuel rail, a sensor measures rail pressure, and the engine control module regulates it towards a target from its maps. P0088 is set when the actual pressure stays above the target by more than a threshold for some time. On many gasoline systems the pump can only raise pressure, which is then reduced only by injecting. Typical causes are a sticking pressure control or metering valve, a drifting pressure sensor or, on diesels with a pressure control valve, a blocked return. Real overpressure can cause harsh combustion noise and smoke.
possible_causes: Pressure control or metering valve sticking [HIGH]
Rail pressure sensor drifting [MEDIUM]
Fuel return blocked (diesel with pressure control valve) [MEDIUM]
Engine control software [LOW]

description: On common-rail diesel and gasoline direct-injection engines, a high-pressure pump feeds the fuel rail, a sensor measures rail pressure, and the engine control module regulates it towards a target from its maps. The fuel pressure regulator A is the actuator the manufacturer designates for this: depending on the system a pressure control valve that releases fuel from the rail, or the control valve on the high-pressure pump. Some manufacturers report the pump valve under the "fuel volume regulator" codes instead. P0089 is a function check: pressure may still be plausible, but the regulator works at its limit, needs too much correction, or pressure does not follow its control signal. Typical causes are a sticking or worn regulator, a weak pump or a faulty pressure sensor.

High-pressure pump weak [MEDIUM]

Engine control software [LOW]

description: Some engines, mainly gasoline direct injection with a demand-controlled in-tank pump, have their own pressure sensor in the low-pressure line between the tank pump and the high-pressure pump. Besides a weak tank pump or its control unit, a clogged filter or a faulty sensor, simply running the tank empty can set this code.

description: On some common-rail diesels, fuel returning from the injection system is cooled in a heat exchanger connected to a low-temperature coolant circuit. An electric coolant pump, switched by the engine control module depending on fuel temperature, drives this circuit. P008C reports an open control circuit of this pump or its relay. If the pump fails for long, the fuel runs hotter; some systems then limit power to protect components.

description: After the engine has been switched off long enough, coolant and fuel should have approached the same temperature. The engine control module compares the coolant temperature sensor with the fuel temperature sensor at the next cold start and sets P008F if they differ too much. From this alone it cannot tell which sensor is wrong, so both have to be checked. Regulations require such plausibility checks for input sensors; the exact conditions are manufacturer-specific.
possible_causes: Coolant temperature sensor drifting [HIGH]
Fuel temperature sensor drifting [HIGH]
Contact resistance at a connector [MEDIUM]
Values distorted, e.g. by an auxiliary heater [LOW]

Das Motorsteuergerät vergleicht beim nächsten Kaltstart den Kühlmitteltemperatursensor mit dem Kraftstofftemperatursensor und setzt P008F, wenn sie zu weit auseinanderliegen. Allein daraus kann es nicht erkennen, welcher Sensor falsch misst; beide müssen geprüft werden. Vorschriften verlangen solche Plausibilitätsprüfungen für Eingangssensoren; die genauen Bedingungen legt der Hersteller fest.

Some manufacturers report the pump valve under the "fuel volume regulator" codes instead. P0092 means the voltage in the control circuit is too high, typically a short to battery voltage. Rail pressure can then no longer be controlled as intended, and the engine usually runs in reduced power.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to battery voltage, or connector corroded [HIGH]
Regulator coil faulty [HIGH]
Fuse or supply voltage faulty [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Bei Common-Rail-Dieseln und Benzin-Direkteinspritzern speist eine Hochdruckpumpe das Rail, ein Sensor misst den Raildruck, und das Motorsteuergerät regelt ihn auf einen Sollwert aus seinen Kennfeldern. Der Kraftstoffdruckregler A ist das Stellglied, das der Hersteller dafür vorsieht: je nach System ein Druckregelventil, das Kraftstoff aus dem Rail ablässt, oder das Steuerventil an der Hochdruckpumpe. Manche Hersteller melden das Pumpenventil stattdessen unter den Codes für den Kraftstoffmengenregler. P0092 bedeutet: Die Spannung im Steuerkreis ist zu hoch, typisch durch einen Kurzschluss nach Plus. Der Raildruck lässt sich dann nicht mehr wie vorgesehen regeln, und der Motor läuft meist mit reduzierter Leistung.

description: A leak in the high-pressure fuel system is not measured directly but inferred from a pressure and volume balance. P0093 means the pump is already delivering at its limit and rail pressure still stays well below target. The leak can be external (line, rail) or internal (injector return, relief valve). An external leak is a fire hazard: stop the engine and inspect it.
possible_causes: High-pressure line or rail fitting leaking [HIGH]
Injector with excessive leak-off [HIGH]
Pressure relief or control valve leaking [MEDIUM]
Weak pump or low-pressure supply mistaken for a leak [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0093 bedeutet: Die Pumpe fördert schon an ihrer Grenze, und der Raildruck bleibt trotzdem deutlich unter dem Sollwert. Das Leck kann außen sitzen (Leitung, Rail) oder innen (Injektor-Rücklauf, Druckbegrenzungsventil). Ein äußeres Leck ist eine Brandgefahr: Motor abstellen und nachsehen.

symptoms: Loss of power or reduced power mode

description: A leak in the high-pressure fuel system is not measured directly but inferred from a pressure and volume balance. P0094 is typically detected when rail pressure drops too fast during overrun with injection cut off, or when more pump delivery than expected is needed at idle. Possible leaks are injectors with too much leak-off, fittings or relief valves; internal leakage can dilute the engine oil with fuel, so a rising oil level is a warning sign.
possible_causes: Injector with excessive leak-off [HIGH]
High-pressure fitting slightly leaking [HIGH]
Pressure relief valve leaking [MEDIUM]
Engine control software (manufacturer updates exist) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: After a long standstill with the engine cold, intake air temperature and ambient air temperature should be about the same. P009A is set when the two sensors disagree by more than a threshold at the next start. A detected engine block heater usually suspends the test. Several manufacturers perform this comparison under other codes; no manufacturer description naming P009A itself was found. Suspects are both sensors, an ambient sensor in a heat-affected position and contact resistance at a connector.
possible_causes: Intake air temperature sensor drifting or contaminated [HIGH]
Ambient temperature sensor faulty or in a heat-affected position [MEDIUM]
Contact resistance at a connector [MEDIUM]
Engine block heater or auxiliary heater distorting the comparison [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 200€ (0.5h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

P009A wird gesetzt, wenn die beiden Sensoren beim nächsten Start um mehr als eine Schwelle voneinander abweichen. Eine erkannte Motorvorwärmung setzt die Prüfung meist aus. Mehrere Hersteller führen diesen Vergleich unter anderen Codes durch; eine Herstellerbeschreibung, die P009A selbst nennt, wurde nicht gefunden. Verdächtig sind beide Sensoren, ein Außentemperatursensor an einer wärmebeeinflussten Stelle und Übergangswiderstände an Steckern.

description: The fuel pressure relief control is an electrically controlled valve on the fuel rail that the engine control module opens to reduce rail pressure deliberately, for example on overrun, on load drops or when the engine is switched off. It differs from the purely mechanical pressure relief valve, which opens passively at overpressure, and from the pressure regulator, which controls pressure continuously. Manufacturer documents show this code mainly on heavy-duty diesel engines. P009B reports an open control circuit of this valve. Rail pressure can then not be reduced as intended, and the engine may be derated.
possible_causes: Wire broken or connector corroded [HIGH]
Valve coil faulty [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Die Druckabbau-Steuerung ist ein elektrisch angesteuertes Ventil am Rail, das das Motorsteuergerät öffnet, um den Raildruck gezielt abzubauen, etwa im Schubbetrieb, bei Lastabwurf oder beim Abstellen. Es unterscheidet sich vom rein mechanischen Druckbegrenzungsventil, das bei Überdruck selbsttätig öffnet, und vom Druckregler, der den Druck dauernd regelt. Herstellerunterlagen zeigen diesen Code vor allem bei Nutzfahrzeug-Dieselmotoren. P009B meldet eine Unterbrechung im Steuerkreis dieses Ventils. Der Raildruck lässt sich dann nicht wie vorgesehen abbauen, und die Motorleistung kann begrenzt werden.

description: When the engine is hot, the thermostat should be open and coolant should flow through the radiator. P00B7 is set when the engine coolant temperature is very high (above about 117 to 119 °C in documented cases) while the radiator side stays much colder, so too little coolant flows through the radiator. The usual cause is a thermostat stuck closed; low coolant, air in the system, a pump that delivers too little or a blocked radiator have the same effect. If the temperature keeps rising, stop driving to avoid engine damage.

description: Direct-injection engines release injection only once the rail has reached a minimum pressure. Cranking then takes longer or the engine does not start. The check runs once per start; some manufacturers only enable it above a minimum tank level.
possible_causes: High-pressure pump weak, or its drive cam or follower worn [HIGH]
Lift pump or low-pressure supply too weak [MEDIUM]
Control valve on the pump faulty [MEDIUM]
Leak or check valve fault letting pressure bleed off after shutdown [MEDIUM]
Very low fuel level [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: With the engine stopped, all pressure sensors in the intake system (manifold pressure, boost pressure, barometric pressure) should read ambient pressure; some diesels also compare them at idle. Two sensors drifting at the same time (contamination, oil mist, ageing) [MEDIUM]
Pressure hose to a sensor leaking or blocked [MEDIUM]
Engine control module or software [LOW]

description: Some engine control modules switch the solenoid of fuel pressure regulator A on both sides: the ground side is monitored by P0090 to P0092, the supply side (high-side driver) by P00C8 to P00CA. description: The fuel volume regulator is the solenoid valve that meters how much fuel the high-pressure pump delivers (metering unit on diesels, pump control valve on some gasoline direct-injection engines). Many control modules switch such solenoids on both sides; P0001 to P0004 cover the control side, while these codes cover the supply side (high-side driver). P00CB reports an open circuit on the supply side. Rail pressure may then deviate, with reduced power or hard starting. None of the published manufacturer documents searched uses this code; the explanation follows regulations and comparable manufacturer monitors.
possible_causes: Supply wire broken or connector corroded [HIGH]
Regulator coil open or shorted (often built into the pump) [MEDIUM]
High-side driver in the engine control module faulty [LOW]

description: After a long standstill (six hours in a documented case) all intake air temperature sensors, for example intake air, charge air cooler and manifold temperature, should read about the same. The control module compares them in pairs: if one sensor stands out, it sets that sensor's own plausibility code. This code is set when no pair agrees, so no single sensor can be identified as faulty. A detected engine preheater suspends the test. Since it runs only after a long standstill, the code may take a night to return after being cleared. Some vehicles also disable start-stop while this code is stored.
possible_causes: One temperature sensor drifting without setting its own code [MEDIUM]
Uneven cooling, undetected preheater or strong sunshine [MEDIUM]
Shared ground or reference line disturbed, falsifying several sensors [MEDIUM]
Engine control module or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Manche Fahrzeuge schalten die Start-Stopp-Automatik ab, solange dieser Code gespeichert ist.

description: This code concerns the heated oxygen sensor upstream of the catalytic converter (sensor 1) on bank 1. Unlike the heater circuit codes, which report an open or short circuit, this code means the heater is driven but does not bring the oxygen sensor to the expected temperature. One documented method, used where no current-measuring shunt is fitted, measures the internal impedance of the sensor element: a hot element has a low impedance. If the impedance stays above a limit that depends on the calculated element temperature and the voltage at the sensor connector, the heating is judged insufficient. The test runs once per trip. Typical causes are an aged heating element or added resistance from corrosion in the heater circuit. For this sensor position no manufacturer description of the test was found; the code appears in a manufacturer's code list, and the explanation follows the documented counterpart for sensor 2.
possible_causes: Heating element aged, resistance increased [HIGH]
Corrosion or contact resistance at connector or harness of the heater circuit [HIGH]
Too low supply voltage at the sensor connector, e.g. poor ground [MEDIUM]
Diagnostic software (manufacturer updates exist for some vehicles) [MEDIUM]
Replacement sensor with a different heater [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Dieser Code betrifft die beheizte Lambdasonde vor dem Katalysator (Sonde 1) auf Bank 1. Anders als die Heizkreis-Codes, die eine Unterbrechung oder einen Kurzschluss melden, bedeutet dieser Code: Die Heizung wird angesteuert, bringt die Lambdasonde aber nicht auf die erwartete Temperatur. Ein dokumentiertes Verfahren, genutzt wo kein Strommess-Shunt verbaut ist, misst die Innenimpedanz des Sondenelements: Ein heißes Element hat eine niedrige Impedanz. Bleibt die Impedanz über einer Grenze, die von der errechneten Elementtemperatur und der Spannung am Sondenstecker abhängt, gilt die Heizleistung als unzureichend. Die Prüfung läuft einmal je Fahrt. Typische Ursachen sind ein gealtertes Heizelement oder zusätzlicher Widerstand durch Korrosion im Heizkreis. Für diese Sondenposition wurde keine Herstellerbeschreibung der Prüfung gefunden; der Code steht in einer Hersteller-Codeliste, die Erklärung folgt dem dokumentierten Gegenstück für Sonde 2.

description: This code concerns the heated oxygen sensor upstream of the catalytic converter (sensor 1) on bank 2. Unlike the heater circuit codes, which report an open or short circuit, this code means the heater is driven but does not bring the oxygen sensor to the expected temperature. One documented method, used where no current-measuring shunt is fitted, measures the internal impedance of the sensor element: a hot element has a low impedance. If the impedance stays above a limit that depends on the calculated element temperature and the voltage at the sensor connector, the heating is judged insufficient. The test runs once per trip. Typical causes are an aged heating element or added resistance from corrosion in the heater circuit. For this sensor position no manufacturer description of the test was found; the code appears in a manufacturer's code list, and the explanation follows the documented counterpart for sensor 2. Bank 2 exists only on V and boxer engines.

description: During fuel cut-off on overrun the exhaust gas is pure air, so the oxygen sensors before and behind the catalytic converter must both report the same lean value. A documented method averages and normalises the signals of both sensors during fuel cut-off and sets the code when they differ by more than a limit; it runs once per drive cycle and needs several overrun phases. The code points to one of the sensors having drifted, not to the catalytic converter. The manufacturer documenting it uses wide-band sensors in both positions.
possible_causes: Upstream sensor aged or shifted [HIGH]
Downstream sensor aged or shifted [HIGH]
Air or exhaust leak between the sensors falsifying the lean signal [MEDIUM]
Retrofitted sensor with wrong characteristic, or software [LOW]

description: Bypass valve A is the electric compressor recirculation valve, mounted close to the hot compressor and turbine housing. This code reports that its temperature is too high. How the temperature is detected is not described in published manufacturer documents; a documented principle for comparable turbocharger solenoids estimates the coil temperature from current, supply voltage and duty cycle and protects the coil by limiting or switching it off. With the valve switched off, the compressor may surge when lifting off the throttle. None of the published manufacturer documents searched uses this code; the explanation follows regulations and comparable manufacturer monitors.
possible_causes: Valve energised for unusually long periods, e.g. due to boost control problems [MEDIUM]

Heat shield missing or exhaust leak near the turbocharger [MEDIUM]
Contact resistance or supply fault distorting the estimate [LOW]

description: Some engines, mainly hybrids and fuel-saving designs, have an exhaust heat exchanger behind the catalytic converter that transfers exhaust heat into the coolant for faster warm-up of engine and cabin. A bypass valve sends the exhaust either through the heat exchanger or around it. Documented diagnostics compare the coolant temperature rise at the heat exchanger with the commanded mode: if it behaves like bypass while recovery is commanded, or the other way round, the valve is considered stuck. P00E3 reports the valve stuck open. How "open" and "closed" map to bypass and recovery is not publicly documented, so both possible effects should be considered: slow warm-up and weak heating, or excessive coolant heat. None of the published manufacturer documents searched uses this code; the explanation follows regulations and comparable manufacturer monitors.
possible_causes: Valve flap coked or corroded and sticking [HIGH]
Actuator faulty (electric or vacuum) [MEDIUM]
Linkage or return spring broken [MEDIUM]
Heat exchanger temperature sensor faulty, simulating a stuck valve [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: After a long standstill (six hours in a documented case) all intake air temperature sensors, for example intake air, charge air cooler and manifold temperature, should read about the same. The control module compares them in pairs: if one sensor stands out, it sets that sensor's own plausibility code. This code is set when no pair agrees, so no single sensor can be identified as faulty. A detected engine preheater suspends the test. Since it runs only after a long standstill, the code may take a night to return after being cleared. No manufacturer description naming this exact code was found; bank 2 codes are intended for engines with two separate intake paths.

description: This is the bank 2 counterpart of the comparison between barometric pressure and the pressure ahead of the turbocharger or supercharger. At low air flow the inlet pressure sensor reads close to ambient pressure, minus the small loss across the air filter, so it must match the barometric reading. The code is set when the difference is too large; a clogged air filter or a leaking intake hose on bank 2 can cause it as well as a drifting sensor. None of the published manufacturer documents searched uses this code; the explanation follows regulations and comparable manufacturer monitors.
possible_causes: Inlet pressure sensor of bank 2 drifting or dirty [HIGH]
Air filter or intake of bank 2 clogged [MEDIUM]
Intake hose between air flow meter and turbocharger leaking or slipped off [MEDIUM]
Barometric sensor faulty [LOW]

description: 'Battery B' here is not a hybrid high-voltage battery (those have codes from P0B27) but, in the only documented use by FCA/Stellantis, the 12 V auxiliary battery of the start-stop system. When the engine restarts automatically, a relay separates main and auxiliary battery so that the auxiliary one keeps the control units stable while the main battery cranks. The engine module sets P00FD if the auxiliary battery is disconnected on the first start, drops below about 8 V during an auto-start, or repeatedly falls below 10.3 V (counter reaches ten). Start-stop is then disabled; often it follows a jump start or many short trips. Whether the MIL comes on is not stated in the sources.

description: The evaporative emission system stores fuel vapour from the tank in a charcoal canister and later purges it into the engine. P00FE means the vapour path between tank and canister is restricted or blocked. That matters because a blocked line can hide the tank side from the leak test and disturb tank venting and refuelling. Ford, where P00FE replaces its own code P144A, checks this once per drive cycle during the cruise leak test, while purging with the vent valve closed, and confirms suspicious pressure responses with an intrusive test. VW used the same code on the 2013–2019 Golf, where the diagnosis covers the purge valve and the leak detection module. Typical causes are kinked or pinched lines and charcoal grains from a broken canister.
possible_causes: Kinked, pinched or misrouted vapour line between tank and canister [HIGH]
Charcoal canister broken down, grains blocking lines or valves [MEDIUM]
Rollover or fill-limit valve at the tank stuck closed (e.g. after overfilling) [MEDIUM]
Purge valve or leak detection module faulty [LOW]
Tank pressure sensor reading wrong [LOW]

description: P00FF is an information code in the engine control module: the body control module has detected an emissions-relevant fault of its own and asks over the data bus for the check engine light. The engine module stores P00FF so that a generic OBD scanner can see why the MIL is on; the actual fault is stored in the body control module as B or U codes and must be read there. GM documents two cases – a 2020 Cadillac CT5 with climate flap actuator codes and 2025 full-size SUVs with U1962 – both cured by reprogramming the body control module, not by replacing parts. The mechanism matches other 'module requested MIL' codes such as P069E. P00FF itself causes no limp mode.

description: The mass air flow sensor (MAF) sits between the air filter and the throttle or compressor and measures how much air the engine draws in; fuel quantity, load and ignition are calculated from it. Most are hot-film or hot-wire sensors that output either a voltage or, on GM, Saab and newer Ford systems, a frequency. P0100 means the control module gets no usable signal at all. Ford uses it for a broken sensing element on digital sensors (period longer than 1.3 ms, i.e. below about 0.78 kHz, for half a second); on GM's 3.0 V6 in the Saab 9-4X it is set at 0 Hz. Many systems with voltage sensors skip P0100 and report low or high directly. The engine then runs on air mass calculated from manifold pressure, throttle angle and speed; Ford also disables start-stop.

description: The mass air flow sensor (MAF) sits between the air filter and the throttle or compressor and measures how much air the engine draws in; fuel quantity, load and ignition are calculated from it. Most are hot-film or hot-wire sensors that output either a voltage or, on GM, Saab and newer Ford systems, a frequency. P0101 is a plausibility fault: the signal is electrically fine but does not match the engine's state. GM petrol engines model the expected air flow from manifold pressure, throttle, speed and boost and blame the MAF if it is off by more than 20 g/s; GM diesels check the measured-to-estimated ratio (0.8–1.2) with EGR closed; Bosch ME9 compares it with the throttle angle. Common causes are air leaks after the sensor, a soiled element (oiled sport filters) or a disconnected crankcase vent; GM also documents a bad crimp in the fuse box. Ford uses P0068 instead. Two trips are needed.

bilingual_title.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor A Circuit Low
