description: The fuel composition sensor is fitted only to flex-fuel vehicles that can run on petrol or ethanol up to E85. GM uses a capacitive sensor in the fuel line whose square-wave output frequency gives the ethanol content – 50 Hz for E0 up to 150 Hz for E100 – while the pulse width carries the fuel temperature. Ford has calculated the ethanol content from the oxygen sensor feedback after refuelling since model year 2000 and has no such sensor. P0176 is the general circuit fault of this sensor without telling low from high. GM's current documents use P0178/P0179 instead, so P0176 is mainly to be expected on older flex-fuel vehicles or other makes. GM issued a special coverage for 2013–2014 flex-fuel models (10 years/150,000 miles) because road salt could make the sensor fail electrically, turning on the MIL and disabling remote start. No manufacturer document using exactly this code was found; the description rests on CARB's circuit monitoring requirement and component information.
possible_causes: Flex-fuel sensor electrically failed (corrosion from road salt) [HIGH]
Connector or wire corroded, open or shorted [HIGH]
Supply (relay, fuse) missing [MEDIUM]
Engine control module [LOW]

bilingual_description.en: The fuel composition sensor is fitted only to flex-fuel vehicles that can run on petrol or ethanol up to E85. GM uses a capacitive sensor in the fuel line whose square-wave output frequency gives the ethanol content – 50 Hz for E0 up to 150 Hz for E100 – while the pulse width carries the fuel temperature. description: Leak detection pump modules in the evaporative emission system (for example Bosch's DM-TL, used by VW, BMW, Porsche, Volvo, Mini, Land Rover and Kia/Hyundai) draw fresh air through their own filter, often mounted separately via a hose; at rest the charcoal canister is also vented through it. P017F means this filter is restricted – by dust, mud or water when fitted near a wheel arch. The reference measurement of the pump and the venting are then distorted, and the tank can pull a vacuum. A GM patent describes detection via the pressure difference across the filter during purge (above about 8 inH2O for 10–20 s). No manufacturer document using exactly this code was found; the description rests on CARB's requirement to monitor evaporative system components and these component sources.
possible_causes: Leak detection pump filter dirty or blocked [HIGH]
Moisture or ice in filter or hose [MEDIUM]
Hose between filter and pump kinked or blocked [MEDIUM]
Pump module faulty (wrong reference) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 20€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: Fuel pressure sensor B is a second fuel pressure sensor; which one is up to the manufacturer. On GM it is the low-pressure sensor in the supply line of direct-injection engines (0–743 kPa), read by the engine module or the fuel pump control module; on Ford engines with dual injection it is the sensor on the port-injection rail (0.5–4.5 V for about 0–70 psi). Sensor A is the high-pressure rail sensor (P0190–P0194). P018A is the general circuit fault for when a manufacturer does not distinguish low from high. GM and Ford, whose sensor B functions are documented, use P018C/P018D instead, so no manufacturer document using exactly this code was found; the description rests on CARB's circuit monitoring requirement and the component information. When the sensor fails, the control module uses a pre-set value and usually runs the supply pump with fixed control.

description: Fuel pressure sensor B is a second fuel pressure sensor; which one is up to the manufacturer. On GM it is the low-pressure sensor in the supply line of direct-injection engines (0–743 kPa), read by the engine module or the fuel pump control module; on Ford engines with dual injection it is the sensor on the port-injection rail (0.5–4.5 V for about 0–70 psi). Sensor A is the high-pressure rail sensor (P0190–P0194). P018B is the plausibility fault. GM checks actively whether the sensor responds: if the pump duty sits at its limit for 5 s or the pressure error varies too little, the module changes pump output and fails the sensor if pressure moves 30 kPa or less – a 'frozen' sensor; two trips. Ford checks the deviation from target instead: more than 20 psi (about 1.4 bar) for 8 s with a plausible target of 35–60 psi, which can also be a genuine pressure problem. A fault-free P018B is a precondition for GM's pump output check (P2635) and Ford's supply checks (P008A/P008B).

description: Common-rail diesels have a pressure relief valve in the rail – usually a spring-loaded valve, on some truck engines electronically controlled. It opens on overpressure and then holds a low limp-home pressure; every opening wears the seat, and after many openings it may no longer close tightly. P018F means the valve has opened too often: the control module recognises openings from the rail pressure trace (overshoot, then a steep drop to the limp-home level) and counts them. The code therefore usually points to an underlying problem – the pressure control repeatedly lets overpressure build up. No manufacturer document describing P018F was found; the function and counting logic come from patents on large engines (example: opening at about 1950 bar, then about 800 bar).
possible_causes: Volume control valve sticking – repeated overpressure [HIGH]
Rail pressure sensor reading wrong (controller targets too high) [MEDIUM]
Relief valve fatigued, opening too early [MEDIUM]
Return blocked or pressure control valve faulty [LOW]
Load changes or overrun steps with software faults [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2000€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Sudden loss of power (limp mode with low rail pressure)
Starting problems once the valve no longer seals
Smoke or harsh combustion noise beforehand

description: The rail pressure sensor A measures the pressure in the high-pressure fuel rail of common-rail diesels and petrol direct-injection engines – a three-wire sensor with 5 V reference. P0190 is the general circuit code used when a manufacturer does not split low and high; GM and Ford use P0192/P0193 instead. Bosch EDC16 diesels (Saab/Opel 1.9) report P0190 with a fault type byte, and a Saab bulletin traces it to corrosion in the sensor connector, sometimes with no restart for up to 15 minutes. On a sensor fault the engine runs on a calculated pressure in limp mode – on Saab's 3.0 V6 diesel with at most 40 MPa rail pressure and 20 % pedal.
possible_causes: Connector corroded or water ingress at the rail pressure sensor [HIGH]
Rail pressure sensor faulty [MEDIUM]
Harness damaged (heat, chafing) [MEDIUM]
5 V reference disturbed [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

symptoms: Stalling or no start (sometimes only after a waiting time)

description: The rail pressure sensor A measures the pressure in the high-pressure fuel rail of common-rail diesels and petrol direct-injection engines; it is either a three-wire sensor (5 V reference, ground, signal rising with pressure, about 0.5 V at 0 bar) or a digital SENT sensor with two measuring channels. The engine module uses it as the feedback signal for rail pressure control. P0191 means the signal is electrically valid but not believable – stuck, offset or drifting. Manufacturers check it differently: Ford's 2023 diesels and GM's diesels test the offset with the system depressurised (Ford before starting after 10 min and 12 s after switch-off, window about 0.25–0.38 V; GM 6.5–14 % of supply); GM petrol direct injection compares the two SENT channels (limit 1.0 MPa); Saab's V6 diesel flags a large target deviation while the signal barely moves. GM treats it as a one-trip fault. Ford petrol direct injection uses P0087/P0088 instead. On a fault the module uses a substitute value and usually limits power.
possible_causes: Rail pressure sensor drifting or stuck (wrong offset at 0 bar) [HIGH]
Genuine pressure fault: high-pressure pump, pressure or volume control valve, tank pump [MEDIUM]
Connector corroded, contact resistance in signal or ground [MEDIUM]
Fuel shortage or clogged filter [LOW]
Control module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

GMs Diesel von 2016 setzen ihn, wenn zwei aufeinanderfolgende Proben im Abstand von 6,25 ms um mehr als 15 MPa auseinanderliegen (80 von 115 Proben), und speichern ihn ohne Motorkontrollleuchte; Saab nutzt zwei Fahrzyklen, Volvo und Mack schalten die Leuchte ein. Bulletins von Volvo/Mack führen ihn auf korrodierte oder verschlissene Kontakte an Sensor und Kabelbaum zurück, oft zusammen mit P016E, weil die Druckregelung auf das springende Signal reagiert; Abhilfe waren neuer Sensor und Kabelbaumabschnitt.

description: The engine oil temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor fed with 5 V through a resistor: the hotter the oil, the lower the signal voltage. The engine module uses the oil temperature for variable cam timing (Ford disables it with cold oil or a sensor fault), engine protection and the oil life monitor; many engines have no such sensor and use a calculated oil temperature instead. P0195 is the general circuit fault without telling low from high. With analogue sensors most manufacturers use P0197/P0198 instead. The documented use is Ford's 2023 diesels with a digital SENT oil temperature sensor: P0195 is set when the sensor reports a status or data fault for 5 s, while a complete loss of communication is U0667. The module then uses a substitute value (Saab: 100 °C), and functions relying on oil temperature are restricted.
possible_causes: Connector or harness damaged, corroded or oil-soaked [HIGH]
Sensor faulty internally (electronics fault on SENT sensors) [MEDIUM]
5 V reference or ground problem in the sensor circuit [MEDIUM]
Control module or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 250€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Der Motoröltemperatursensor A ist ein NTC-Thermistor, der über einen Vorwiderstand mit 5 V versorgt wird: Je heißer das Öl, desto niedriger die Signalspannung. Das Motorsteuergerät nutzt die Öltemperatur für die Nockenwellenverstellung (Ford sperrt sie bei kaltem Öl oder Sensorfehler), den Motorschutz und die Ölwechselanzeige; viele Motoren haben keinen solchen Sensor und rechnen mit einer berechneten Öltemperatur. P0195 ist der allgemeine Stromkreisfehler, ohne zwischen zu niedrig und zu hoch zu unterscheiden. Bei analogen Sensoren nutzen die meisten Hersteller stattdessen P0197/P0198. Belegt ist der Einsatz bei Fords Dieseln von 2023 mit digitalem SENT-Öltemperatursensor: P0195 wird gesetzt, wenn der Sensor 5 s lang einen Status- oder Datenfehler meldet, ein vollständiger Kommunikationsausfall ist U0667. Das Steuergerät nutzt dann einen Ersatzwert (Saab: 100 °C), und Funktionen, die auf die Öltemperatur angewiesen sind, werden eingeschränkt.

description: The engine oil temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor fed with 5 V through a resistor: the hotter the oil, the lower the signal voltage. The engine module uses the oil temperature for variable cam timing (Ford disables it with cold oil or a sensor fault), engine protection and the oil life monitor; many engines have no such sensor and use a calculated oil temperature instead. P0196 means the signal is electrically valid but implausible – stuck, offset or rising wrongly. GM's LT4 runs three tests: after a cold soak oil, coolant and intake air must agree within 16 °C; during warm-up the oil must reach 90 °C after enough air mass; and continuously it is compared with a model (fault above 30 °C); two trips. Saab expects at least 50 °C once coolant has held 80 °C for 3 min. Caution: on Ford's 2023 diesels P0196 actually checks the coolant sensor against oil temperature (35 °C after 6 h), and Nissan traced it on the Rogue to a faulty coolant control valve.
possible_causes: Oil temperature sensor drifting or stuck (offset) [HIGH]
Comparison sensor (coolant, intake air) or its wiring wrong [MEDIUM]
Thermal management or coolant control valve, or thermostat faulty (oil genuinely too hot or cold) [MEDIUM]
Contact resistance in the connector [MEDIUM]
Control module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 450€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

symptoms: Check engine light on (usually after two drives)

description: The engine oil temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor fed with 5 V through a resistor: the hotter the oil, the lower the signal voltage. The engine module uses the oil temperature for variable cam timing (Ford disables it with cold oil or a sensor fault), engine protection and the oil life monitor; many engines have no such sensor and use a calculated oil temperature instead. P0197 means the signal voltage is below its lower limit, so the module would read implausibly hot oil (around 145–150 °C) – practically always a signal wire shorted to ground or an internally shorted sensor. Ford sets it below 0.16–0.20 V for 5 s; GM below 25 Ω in 20 of 50 samples – without a warning light on the 2018 LT4, with two trips on the 2019 version, so MIL behaviour depends on the manufacturer and model year. A substitute value is used.
possible_causes: Signal wire chafed against ground or the engine block [HIGH]
Sensor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Oil or water in the connector (leakage current) [MEDIUM]
Control module input faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 200€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The engine oil temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor fed with 5 V through a resistor: the hotter the oil, the lower the signal voltage. The engine module uses the oil temperature for variable cam timing (Ford disables it with cold oil or a sensor fault), engine protection and the oil life monitor; many engines have no such sensor and use a calculated oil temperature instead. Sensor element open [MEDIUM]
Signal wire shorted to 5 V or battery voltage [LOW]
Control module pull-up or input faulty [LOW]

description: The engine oil temperature sensor A is an NTC thermistor fed with 5 V through a resistor: the hotter the oil, the lower the signal voltage. description: Sensor 3 on bank 1 is a switching oxygen sensor behind a second converter or converter brick; it exists on Jaguar Land Rover's supercharged V6 and V8 (on both banks) and on Ford systems that monitor part of the converter volume. 'Delayed response' means the sensor starts reacting too late after a mixture change – unlike 'slow response' (P0145/P0165), where the transition itself is too flat. This code covers the rich-to-lean direction, tested during forced fuel cut-off. For sensor 2, GM checks whether the signal falls below 450 mV before a calibrated air mass has passed; behind two converters their oxygen storage buffers the change, so limits are wide. No manufacturer document using exactly this code was found – the Jaguar Land Rover bulletins list only P0142ff/P0162ff for sensor 3 – so the description rests on CARB's response requirement and the sensor 2 logic. There is no limp mode; the converter monitor cannot complete.
possible_causes: Sensor 3 aged, sooted or oil-poisoned [HIGH]
Exhaust leak ahead of sensor 3 [MEDIUM]
Converter with strongly differing oxygen storage (aftermarket or new) [LOW]
Sensor 3 heater weak [LOW]
Control module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 250€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Sensor 3 auf Bank 1 ist eine Sprungsonde hinter einem zweiten Katalysator bzw. Katalysatorblock; es gibt ihn bei den Kompressor-V6 und -V8 von Jaguar Land Rover (auf beiden Bänken) und bei Ford-Systemen, die nur einen Teil des Katalysatorvolumens überwachen. „Verzögerte Reaktion“ heißt, die Sonde beginnt nach einem Gemischwechsel zu spät zu reagieren – anders als bei „langsamer Reaktion“ (P0145/P0165), wo der Übergang selbst zu flach ist. Dieser Code betrifft die Richtung fett nach mager, geprüft bei erzwungener Schubabschaltung. Für Sensor 2 prüft GM, ob das Signal unter 450 mV fällt, bevor eine kalibrierte Luftmasse durchgesetzt ist; hinter zwei Katalysatoren puffert deren Sauerstoffspeicher den Wechsel, die Grenzen sind daher weit. Eine Herstellerunterlage mit genau diesem Code wurde nicht gefunden – die Bulletins von Jaguar Land Rover führen für Sensor 3 nur P0142ff/P0162ff –, die Beschreibung stützt sich daher auf die CARB-Vorgabe zur Ansprechrate und die Logik für Sensor 2. Einen Notlauf gibt es nicht; die Katalysatorprüfung kann nicht abschließen.

bilingual_title.en: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Lean to Rich Bank 2 Sensor 3

bilingual_description.en: Sensor 3 on bank 2 is a switching oxygen sensor behind a second converter or converter brick; it exists on Jaguar Land Rover's supercharged V6 and V8 (on both banks) and on Ford systems that monitor part of the converter volume. 'Delayed response' means the sensor starts reacting too late after a mixture change – unlike 'slow response' (P0145/P0165), where the transition itself is too flat. This code covers the lean-to-rich direction, tested when the module enriches the mixture after overrun. For sensor 2, GM checks whether the signal rises above 350 mV before a calibrated air mass has passed; behind two converters their oxygen storage buffers the change, so limits are wide. No manufacturer document using exactly this code was found – the Jaguar Land Rover bulletins list only P0142ff/P0162ff for sensor 3 – so the description rests on CARB's response requirement and the sensor 2 logic. There is no limp mode; the converter monitor cannot complete.
bilingual_description.de: Sensor 3 auf Bank 2 ist eine Sprungsonde hinter einem zweiten Katalysator bzw. Katalysatorblock; es gibt ihn bei den Kompressor-V6 und -V8 von Jaguar Land Rover (auf beiden Bänken) und bei Ford-Systemen, die nur einen Teil des Katalysatorvolumens überwachen. „Verzögerte Reaktion“ heißt, die Sonde beginnt nach einem Gemischwechsel zu spät zu reagieren – anders als bei „langsamer Reaktion“ (P0145/P0165), wo der Übergang selbst zu flach ist. Dieser Code betrifft die Richtung mager nach fett, geprüft, wenn das Steuergerät nach dem Schub anfettet. Für Sensor 2 prüft GM, ob das Signal über 350 mV steigt, bevor eine kalibrierte Luftmasse durchgesetzt ist; hinter zwei Katalysatoren puffert deren Sauerstoffspeicher den Wechsel, die Grenzen sind daher weit. Eine Herstellerunterlage mit genau diesem Code wurde nicht gefunden – die Bulletins von Jaguar Land Rover führen für Sensor 3 nur P0142ff/P0162ff –, die Beschreibung stützt sich daher auf die CARB-Vorgabe zur Ansprechrate und die Logik für Sensor 2. Einen Notlauf gibt es nicht; die Katalysatorprüfung kann nicht abschließen.

description: These codes only apply to vehicles with a gaseous alternative fuel – compressed natural gas (CNG) or LPG – as bi-fuel models alongside petrol or as dedicated gas engines; on bi-fuel vehicles a fault usually blocks gas operation and the vehicle runs on petrol. The gas rail temperature sensor, often combined with the rail pressure sensor, measures the gas temperature at the injectors: gas cools strongly when it expands in the regulator, and the injected mass depends on density, i.e. on rail pressure and temperature, so the module corrects injection time with it. A Ford patent describes plausibility checks against engine bay temperature at idle and an expected cold rail at full load with a full tank. description: The engine oil temperature sensor B is an NTC thermistor fed with 5 V through a resistor: the hotter the oil, the lower the signal voltage. The engine module uses the oil temperature for variable cam timing (Ford disables it with cold oil or a sensor fault), engine protection and the oil life monitor; many engines have no such sensor and use a calculated oil temperature instead. Sensor B is a second oil temperature sensor whose position is defined by the manufacturer. P01B9 is the general circuit fault of sensor B, the counterpart of P0195. No manufacturer document using the B-sensor codes was found, so it is unclear who fits a sensor B; the description follows sensor A and CARB's circuit monitoring requirement.

description: Some V engines have a separate high-pressure fuel circuit per bank, each with its own pump or rail – for example Audi's 4.0 TFSI V8 with a second high-pressure pump for bank 2. These codes are the bank 2 counterparts of the system pressure codes for bank 1. P01C8 is the bank 2 counterpart of P0087: the actual pressure stays below target over time. Typical causes are a weak high-pressure pump on bank 2, a faulty volume control valve, low supply pressure or a leak. No manufacturer using exactly this code was found; the logic follows P0087 and CARB's requirement for pressure control. Not every two-rail engine uses them: GM's LT6 reports bank 2 pressure problems under other codes.

Volume control valve faulty or its control disturbed [MEDIUM]
Supply pressure too low (lift pump, filter) [MEDIUM]
Leak in the bank 2 high-pressure circuit [LOW]

description: Some V engines have a separate high-pressure fuel circuit per bank, each with its own pump or rail – for example Audi's 4.0 TFSI V8 with a second high-pressure pump for bank 2. description: Diesel engines must detect when fuel can no longer be injected at the correct crank angle – CARB requires this for every injector individually, hence one code per cylinder. The start of injection is not measured directly: during overrun with fuel cut-off the control module fires a tiny test injection into one cylinder (GM: about 1.5 mm³) and evaluates the resulting speed change at the crankshaft sensor. From this it learns how much extra energizing time the injector needs (Bosch calls this zero fuel calibration). This code means injector 1 needs clearly more energizing time than intended, i.e. it opens too late – GM sets it above 80 µs of extra time, after two trips. Documented users are GM's 6.6 litre Duramax (LML, L5P) and FCA's 3.0 litre EcoDiesel; Ford reports the same function under P2B11ff. Bulletins often point away from the injector: GM fixed false settings on 2020–2021 L5P trucks with new software and warns that vibration, for example from off-road tyres, disturbs the evaluation; FCA lists wrong injector correction codes, boost leaks and loose injector clamps.
possible_causes: Injector worn, coked or sticking (opens late, delivers too little) [HIGH]
False setting from software or vehicle vibration (e.g. off-road tyres) [MEDIUM]
Wrong injector correction code stored after an injector replacement [MEDIUM]
Boost leak or loose injector clamp [LOW]
Contaminated fuel [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Dieselmotoren müssen erkennen, wenn Kraftstoff nicht mehr im richtigen Kurbelwinkel eingespritzt werden kann – CARB verlangt das für jeden Injektor einzeln, daher ein Code je Zylinder. Der Spritzbeginn wird nicht direkt gemessen: Im Schubbetrieb mit Schubabschaltung gibt das Steuergerät eine winzige Testeinspritzung in einen Zylinder (GM: etwa 1,5 mm³) und wertet die Drehzahländerung am Kurbelwellensensor aus. Belegte Nutzer sind GMs 6,6-Liter-Duramax (LML, L5P) und FCAs 3,0-Liter-EcoDiesel; Ford meldet dieselbe Funktion unter P2B11ff. Bulletins weisen oft weg vom Injektor: GM behob Fehlauslösungen bei L5P-Pickups von 2020–2021 per Software und warnt, dass Vibrationen, etwa durch Geländereifen, die Auswertung stören; FCA nennt falsche Injektor-Korrekturcodes, Ladeluftlecks und lockere Spannpratzen.

From this it learns how much extra energizing time the injector needs (Bosch calls this zero fuel calibration). This code means injector 7 needs clearly more energizing time than intended, i.e. it opens too late – GM sets it above 80 µs of extra time, after two trips. The documented user for this cylinder is GM's 6.6 litre Duramax V8 (LML, L5P); Ford reports the same function under P2B11ff. GM fixed false settings on 2020–2021 L5P trucks with new software and warns that vibration, for example from off-road tyres, disturbs the evaluation, so injectors should not be replaced before that is ruled out.
possible_causes: Injector worn, coked or sticking (opens late, delivers too little) [HIGH]
False setting from software or vehicle vibration (e.g. off-road tyres) [MEDIUM]
Wrong injector correction code stored after an injector replacement [MEDIUM]
Boost leak or loose injector clamp [LOW]
Contaminated fuel [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Coolant temperature sensor 3 is a third NTC coolant sensor on engines with thermal management or split cooling circuits; its position is defined by the manufacturer – on Jaguar Land Rover's 2018–2019 Ingenium petrol engines it sits in the engine block water jacket, on Audi's 3.0 TFSI V6 it is part of the thermal management. As with every NTC sensor, a low signal voltage means hot and a high one cold. CARB requires such additional sensors to be monitored from model year 2019 onwards. P01E3 is the general circuit fault of this sensor without telling low from high. No manufacturer document using exactly this code was found; it is described by analogy with its documented sibling codes and the NTC principle.
possible_causes: Open circuit or loose contact at connector or wiring of sensor 3 [HIGH]

Control module [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Der Kühlmitteltemperatursensor 3 ist ein dritter NTC-Kühlmittelfühler bei Motoren mit Thermomanagement oder getrennten Kühlkreisen; seinen Einbauort legt der Hersteller fest – bei den Ingenium-Benzinern von Jaguar Land Rover (2018–2019) sitzt er im Kühlmantel des Motorblocks, beim 3.0 TFSI V6 von Audi gehört er zum Thermomanagement. Wie bei jedem NTC-Sensor heißt niedrige Signalspannung heiß und hohe kalt. CARB verlangt, solche zusätzlichen Sensoren ab Modelljahr 2019 zu überwachen. Eine Herstellerunterlage mit genau diesem Code wurde nicht gefunden; beschrieben ist er in Anlehnung an die belegten Geschwistercodes und das NTC-Prinzip.

description: Engine coolant heater A is an electric coolant heater switched by the engine module, directly or via a relay or power stage, to shorten warm-up – less cold-start emissions and faster cabin heat; A and B denote two separately switched heaters or stages. It is not the same as a mains-powered block heater (which the vehicle does not control) or the electrically heated thermostat (P0597–P0599). CARB requires output components to be checked for correct response or at least for circuit faults. This code reports an open control circuit – the module detects missing continuity, typically with the driver switched off. No manufacturer using these codes was found in the GM, Ford or NHTSA documents checked; the typical driver diagnosis (open circuit detected with the driver switched off, as GM does for other outputs) is an analogy, and thresholds are unknown.
possible_causes: Control wire or connector to the heater or relay open [HIGH]
Heater element burnt out or relay coil open [HIGH]
Fuse in the load circuit blown [MEDIUM]
Control module output stage faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: Engine coolant heater A is an electric coolant heater switched by the engine module, directly or via a relay or power stage, to shorten warm-up – less cold-start emissions and faster cabin heat; A and B denote two separately switched heaters or stages. It is not the same as a mains-powered block heater (which the vehicle does not control) or the electrically heated thermostat (P0597–P0599). CARB requires output components to be checked for correct response or at least for circuit faults. This code reports an open control circuit – the module detects missing continuity, typically with the driver switched off. No manufacturer using these codes was found in the GM, Ford or NHTSA documents checked; the typical driver diagnosis (open circuit detected with the driver switched off, as GM does for other outputs) is an analogy, and thresholds are unknown.
bilingual_description.de: Der Kühlmittelheizer A ist eine elektrische Kühlmittelheizung, die das Motorsteuergerät direkt oder über Relais bzw. Leistungsendstufe schaltet, um den Warmlauf zu verkürzen – weniger Kaltstartemissionen und schneller warmer Innenraum; A und B bezeichnen zwei getrennt geschaltete Heizer oder Stufen. Er ist nicht dasselbe wie eine Netz-Standheizung (die das Fahrzeug nicht steuert) oder der elektrisch beheizte Thermostat (P0597–P0599). CARB verlangt, Ausgangsbauteile auf richtige Reaktion oder zumindest auf Stromkreisfehler zu prüfen. Dieser Code meldet einen unterbrochenen Steuerkreis – das Steuergerät erkennt fehlenden Durchgang, typisch bei abgeschaltetem Treiber. In den geprüften Unterlagen von GM, Ford und NHTSA wurde kein Hersteller gefunden, der diese Codes nutzt; die typische Treiberdiagnose (Unterbrechung bei abgeschaltetem Treiber erkannt, wie GM es bei anderen Ausgängen macht) ist eine Analogie, Schwellen sind unbekannt.

symptoms: Longer warm-up, cabin heat slower in winter

description: Engine coolant heater A is an electric coolant heater switched by the engine module, directly or via a relay or power stage, to shorten warm-up – less cold-start emissions and faster cabin heat; A and B denote two separately switched heaters or stages. It is not the same as a mains-powered block heater (which the vehicle does not control) or the electrically heated thermostat (P0597–P0599). CARB requires output components to be checked for correct response or at least for circuit faults. This code reports a control circuit voltage that is too low – typically a short to ground in the control line or the heater/relay. Heater element or relay coil shorted to ground [MEDIUM]
Moisture or corrosion in the connector [MEDIUM]
Control module output stage [LOW]

description: Since model years 2019–2021 CARB requires petrol engines to detect a thermostat fault not only during warm-up but also when the coolant, after reaching operating temperature, drops back below the temperature needed for other diagnostics. P01F0 is this check. GM sets it when coolant falls below 64 °C with a conventional thermostat or 70.5 °C with an electrically heated one (2019 Corvette: 65/78.5 °C) after having been above it, with at least 0.8 km driven, ambient above −7 °C, enough heat input and no long overrun downhill; two trips. GM also uses it on the 6.6 litre Duramax diesel as a 'stuck open thermostat' check. Ford does not use the code in the documents checked. Usual cause is a thermostat stuck open.
possible_causes: Thermostat stuck open or not sealing [HIGH]
Heated map thermostat, thermal management valve or switchable water pump faulty [MEDIUM]
Radiator fan running constantly (relay stuck) [MEDIUM]
Coolant sensor drifting cold [MEDIUM]
Low coolant or air in the system [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 400€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Seit den Modelljahren 2019–2021 verlangt CARB bei Benzinern, einen Thermostatfehler nicht nur im Warmlauf zu erkennen, sondern auch, wenn das Kühlmittel nach Erreichen der Betriebstemperatur wieder unter die für andere Diagnosen nötige Temperatur fällt. P01F0 ist diese Prüfung. GM setzt ihn, wenn das Kühlmittel nach Überschreiten unter 64 °C bei normalem bzw. 70,5 °C bei elektrisch beheiztem Thermostat fällt (Corvette 2019: 65/78,5 °C), bei mindestens 0,8 km Fahrt, Umgebung über −7 °C, genügend Wärmeeintrag und ohne lange Schubphasen bergab; zwei Fahrzyklen. GM nutzt ihn auch beim 6,6-Liter-Duramax-Diesel als Prüfung auf offen hängenden Thermostat. Ford nutzt den Code in den geprüften Unterlagen nicht. Übliche Ursache ist ein offen hängender Thermostat.

symptoms: Check engine light on (after two drive cycles)

description: Sensor 4 on bank 1 is a fourth oxygen sensor, behind a third converter or converter brick. The OBD standard provides for up to four sensors per bank, and the code standard defines sensor 4 for bank 1 only. No manufacturer or vehicle using these codes could be identified; the description rests on CARB's requirements for downstream oxygen sensors and the logic of sensors 2 and 3. A switching sensor delivers about 0.1–0.9 V. P01F1 is the general circuit code of this sensor, the counterpart of P0136/P0142 for sensors 2 and 3. Typical causes are an aged sensor, open or high-resistance wiring and a failed heater.
possible_causes: Sensor 4 aged or poisoned [HIGH]
Wiring or connector open, high-resistance or corroded [MEDIUM]
Sensor heater failed [MEDIUM]
Control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Bank 1 Sensor 4

bilingual_description.en: Sensor 4 on bank 1 is a fourth oxygen sensor, behind a third converter or converter brick. The OBD standard provides for up to four sensors per bank, and the code standard defines sensor 4 for bank 1 only. No manufacturer or vehicle using these codes could be identified; the description rests on CARB's requirements for downstream oxygen sensors and the logic of sensors 2 and 3. A switching sensor delivers about 0.1–0.9 V. P01F1 is the general circuit code of this sensor, the counterpart of P0136/P0142 for sensors 2 and 3. Typical causes are an aged sensor, open or high-resistance wiring and a failed heater.
bilingual_description.de: Sensor 4 auf Bank 1 ist eine vierte Lambdasonde hinter einem dritten Katalysator bzw. Katalysatorblock. Der OBD-Standard sieht bis zu vier Sonden je Bank vor, und die Code-Norm kennt Sensor 4 nur für Bank 1. Ein Hersteller oder Fahrzeug, das diese Codes nutzt, ließ sich nicht ermitteln; die Beschreibung stützt sich auf die CARB-Vorgaben für Nachkatsonden und die Logik der Sensoren 2 und 3. Eine Sprungsonde liefert etwa 0,1–0,9 V. P01F1 ist der allgemeine Stromkreiscode dieser Sonde, das Gegenstück zu P0136/P0142 bei den Sensoren 2 und 3. Typische Ursachen sind eine gealterte Sonde, unterbrochene oder hochohmige Leitungen und eine ausgefallene Heizung.

description: The engine module switches an electric coolant heater A through a power stage (driver). This code means the driver itself has reported excessive current or overheating and has shut down to protect itself – it concerns the control circuit, not the coolant temperature. Such heaters warm the coolant around a cold start, shortening warm-up and providing cabin heat sooner; a GM patent describes how the module recognises a pre-heated engine so other temperature diagnostics do not misfire. No manufacturer using this code family was found in GM, Ford or FCA documents; the description rests on CARB's requirements for output components. Siblings for heater A are P01E8–P01EB.
possible_causes: Short or partial short in heater element A [HIGH]
Wiring or connector chafed to ground, moisture in connector [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the module or relay faulty or overheated [LOW]
Heater running without coolant (low level, air pocket) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Die Geschwistercodes für Heizer A sind P01E8–P01EB.

description: Turbocharger outlet pressure sensor B is a second pressure sensor at a compressor outlet – for example one per turbo on twin-turbo engines or a second measuring point; sensor A has the codes P00F8–P00FC. It is a separate family from the boost pressure sensor: GM and Ford report the pressure ahead of the throttle under the boost sensor codes P0236–P0238. description: Turbocharger outlet pressure sensor B is a second pressure sensor at a compressor outlet – for example one per turbo on twin-turbo engines or a second measuring point; sensor A has the codes P00F8–P00FC. Uneven turbo output (twin-turbo, wastegate or vanes on one side) [LOW]

description: P0200 is the injector circuit fault without a cylinder assignment. The large US manufacturers do not use it – GM and Ford report injector faults per cylinder (P0201 ff) or as faults of the shared injector supply (P062D/P062E, P2146 ff). Saab documents it on the 3.0 V6 diesel of the 9-5, whose injectors are driven by a separate power stage behind the glovebox: there P0200 means an electrical fault in that power stage or its wiring, and the engine is shut down. Generally the cause lies in something all injectors share – supply, fuse, relay, ground or driver stage – so several cylinders are affected at once. CARB does not require separate codes for each kind of circuit fault.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Defective Fuel Injector, Faulty or corroded Fuel Injector, wiring, and or connections, Plugged Fuel Injector, Dirt in the Fuel Injector

possible_causes: Shared injector supply open (fuse, relay, harness connector) [HIGH]
Separate injector power stage or its wiring faulty (diesel) [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
Ground fault of the module or power stage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 900€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: P0200 ist der Einspritzventil-Stromkreisfehler ohne Zuordnung zu einem Zylinder. Die großen US-Hersteller nutzen ihn nicht – GM und Ford melden Injektorfehler je Zylinder (P0201 ff) oder als Fehler der gemeinsamen Injektorversorgung (P062D/P062E, P2146 ff). Saab dokumentiert ihn beim 3,0-V6-Diesel des 9-5, dessen Injektoren eine eigene Endstufe hinter dem Handschuhfach ansteuert: Dort heißt P0200 elektrischer Fehler dieser Endstufe oder ihres Kabelbaums, und der Motor wird abgestellt. Allgemein liegt die Ursache in etwas, das alle Injektoren teilen – Versorgung, Sicherung, Relais, Masse oder Endstufe –, deshalb sind mehrere Zylinder zugleich betroffen. CARB verlangt keine getrennten Codes je Art des Stromkreisfehlers.

symptoms: Engine does not start or shuts down

description: P0201 reports an electrical fault, mainly an open circuit, in the injector circuit of cylinder 1. The engine module watches each injector output: GM flags an open circuit at an impedance of 200 kΩ or more – on direct injection and diesel engines in 10 of 20 or 5 of 10 samples and with the warning light in the first trip, on some port-injected engines only after two trips. Ford's port injection reads a fault bit from the driver chip that covers open, short to ground and short to voltage alike; Ford diesels report only the open circuit here and shorts as P0261/P0262. On direct injection the affected injector is switched off; the cylinder misfires.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Defective Fuel Injector, Faulty or corroded Fuel Injector, wiring, and or connections, Plugged Fuel Injector, Dirt in the Fuel Injector

possible_causes: Connector at the cylinder 1 injector loose, corroded or with a broken or pushed-back pin [HIGH]
Injector coil open [MEDIUM]
Wire between module and injector open or chafed (heat, rodents) [MEDIUM]
Injector supply missing (fuse, relay) – then usually several cylinders at once [LOW]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 700€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: P0201 meldet einen elektrischen Fehler, vor allem eine Unterbrechung, im Einspritzventil-Stromkreis von Zylinder 1. Das Motorsteuergerät überwacht jeden Injektorausgang: GM erkennt eine Unterbrechung ab 200 kΩ – bei Direkteinspritzern und Dieseln in 10 von 20 bzw. 5 von 10 Messungen und mit Warnleuchte schon im ersten Fahrzyklus, bei manchen Saugrohreinspritzern erst nach zwei Fahrzyklen. Bei Direkteinspritzung wird der betroffene Injektor abgeschaltet; der Zylinder setzt aus.

description: P020A reports a fault in the injection timing of cylinder 1 on a diesel engine. Unlike P01CB/P01CC ('over retarded/advanced', the result of the injector learning routine in overrun), this code has no direction, and what it checks is up to the manufacturer. GM uses it as an electrical check on a four-cylinder diesel and on the 6.6 litre L5P Duramax V8: at every injection the engine module measures how long the injector current takes to reach its pull-in level of 13 A. If on the V8 that time is outside 60–150 µs in 10 of 20 samples, the code sets and the warning light comes on in the first trip. FCA lists it for the 3.0 litre EcoDiesel V6 together with the learning codes: check injector coding, charge air leaks and the injector clamp, reset the zero fuel calibration and repeat the learning drive; if the code returns, the injector is replaced.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 1 faulty (coil, armature, wear, deposits) [HIGH]
Injector wiring or connector: contact resistance, corrosion, chafing [MEDIUM]
Engine software sets the code falsely (update available for some models) [MEDIUM]
Injector driver stage or boost voltage in the engine module [LOW]
Wrong injector code, contaminated fuel or loose injector clamp [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P020A meldet einen Fehler im Einspritzzeitpunkt von Zylinder 1 bei einem Dieselmotor. Anders als P01CB/P01CC („zu spät/zu früh“, das Ergebnis des Injektor-Lernens im Schubbetrieb) trägt dieser Code keine Richtung; was genau geprüft wird, legt der Hersteller fest. GM nutzt ihn als elektrische Prüfung bei einem Vierzylinder-Diesel und beim 6,6-Liter-V8 L5P Duramax: Bei jeder Einspritzung misst das Motorsteuergerät, wie lange der Injektorstrom bis zum Anzugsstrom braucht (13 A). Liegt diese Zeit beim V8 in 10 von 20 Messungen außerhalb von 60–150 µs, wird der Code gesetzt und die Warnleuchte geht schon im ersten Fahrzyklus an. FCA führt ihn beim 3,0-Liter-EcoDiesel V6 zusammen mit den Lerncodes: Injektorcodierung, Ladeluft-Undichtigkeit und Spannpratze prüfen, Nullmengenkalibrierung zurücksetzen und die Lernfahrt wiederholen; kommt der Code wieder, wird der Injektor getauscht.

description: A cold start injector is an additional injector in the intake manifold that sprays extra fuel for a few seconds while a cold engine is cranked. In classic Bosch systems a thermo-time switch on the block powers it directly, without the engine module – such systems cannot set a code at all. A code is only possible where the engine module drives the valve and monitors its circuit, as CARB requires for output components. From the 1990s the main injectors took over cold-start enrichment, so the code only fits early OBD II engines. P0213 concerns cold start injector 1. No manufacturer using it was found in GM, Ford or Saab documents.
possible_causes: Connector or wire corroded or open [HIGH]
Valve coil open or valve stuck [MEDIUM]
Thermo-time switch or control relay faulty [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 300€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Ein Kaltstartventil ist ein zusätzliches Einspritzventil im Saugrohr, das beim Anlassen eines kalten Motors einige Sekunden lang zusätzlich Kraftstoff einspritzt. In klassischen Bosch-Anlagen schaltet es ein Thermozeitschalter am Motorblock direkt, ohne Motorsteuergerät – solche Anlagen können gar keinen Code setzen. Ein Code ist nur möglich, wo das Steuergerät das Ventil ansteuert und seinen Stromkreis überwacht, wie es CARB für Ausgangskomponenten verlangt. Ab den 1990er-Jahren übernahmen die Hauptinjektoren die Kaltstartanreicherung, der Code passt also nur zu frühen OBD-II-Motoren. P0213 betrifft Kaltstartventil 1. In Unterlagen von GM, Ford und Saab wurde kein Hersteller gefunden, der ihn nutzt.

description: The engine shutoff solenoid is the electric stop valve on older diesel injection pumps, mainly distributor pumps. It is energised with the ignition on and lets fuel into the pump; with no current a spring closes it, the pump runs dry and the engine stops – also as a safety backup if the governor fails. P0215 reports a fault in this solenoid or its supply, typically a broken coil, a sticking plunger, a blown fuse or relay, or a wiring fault. The result is either an engine that will not start or dies, or one that keeps running after switch-off. Newer diesels stop through the injectors or a fuel shutoff valve with its own codes P0005–P0007. No manufacturer document describing P0215 was found; the description rests on CARB's requirements for output components and a Bosch patent on the valve.
possible_causes: Shutoff solenoid faulty (open coil, sticking plunger) [HIGH]
Relay or fuse in the supply circuit faulty [HIGH]
Broken wire, corrosion or ground fault at the pump connector [MEDIUM]
Pump control module faulty [LOW]
Engine module driver faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Der Motorabstellmagnet ist das elektrische Abstellventil an älteren Diesel-Einspritzpumpen, vor allem Verteilerpumpen. Bei eingeschalteter Zündung wird er bestromt und gibt den Kraftstoffzulauf frei; ohne Strom schließt ihn eine Feder, die Pumpe läuft leer und der Motor geht aus – auch als Sicherung, falls der Regler versagt. P0215 meldet einen Fehler am Magneten oder an seiner Versorgung, typisch eine unterbrochene Spule, ein klemmender Kolben, eine defekte Sicherung oder ein Relais oder ein Leitungsfehler. Die Folge ist entweder ein Motor, der nicht anspringt oder ausgeht, oder einer, der nach dem Abschalten weiterläuft. Neuere Diesel stellen über die Injektoren oder ein Kraftstoffabsperrventil mit eigenen Codes P0005–P0007 ab. Eine Herstellerunterlage zu P0215 wurde nicht gefunden; die Beschreibung stützt sich auf die CARB-Vorgaben für Ausgangskomponenten und ein Bosch-Patent zum Ventil.

symptoms: Engine does not start or stalls while driving
Engine keeps running after ignition off (solenoid stuck open)

description: P0216 is a diesel code for the control of injection timing. On 1990s distributor pumps with an electronic timing advance it meant that actual injection timing missed its target; today manufacturers use it for the electronic injector control, with different meanings. GM's Duramax diesels compare, inside the engine module, the summed injection pulse widths from the hardware driver with those calculated by the software; a mismatch in 30 of 124 or 60 consecutive checks sets the code with the warning light in the first trip. On GM's 3.0 litre LM2 it appeared together with P0202 from a broken pin in the injector 2 connector. Saab's 3.0 V6 diesel uses it for a fault in the separate injector power stage. The result can be loss of power, rough running, smoke and limp mode.
possible_causes: Injector harness or connector (broken pin) – common rail [MEDIUM]
Engine module or injector power stage faulty internally [MEDIUM]
Distributor pump electronics or timing advance faulty [MEDIUM]
Low supply pressure on distributor pumps (lift pump, filter) [MEDIUM]
Pump installed incorrectly, drive gear misaligned [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0216 ist ein Diesel-Code für die Steuerung des Einspritzzeitpunkts. Bei Verteilerpumpen der 1990er mit elektronischem Spritzversteller hieß er, dass der Ist-Spritzbeginn den Sollwert verfehlt; heute nutzen Hersteller ihn für die elektronische Injektoransteuerung, mit unterschiedlicher Bedeutung. GMs Duramax-Diesel vergleichen im Motorsteuergerät die aufsummierten Einspritzimpulse des Hardware-Treibers mit den von der Software berechneten; eine Abweichung in 30 von 124 oder 60 aufeinanderfolgenden Prüfungen setzt den Code mit Warnleuchte im ersten Fahrzyklus. Beim 3,0-Liter-LM2 von GM trat er zusammen mit P0202 durch einen gebrochenen Kontaktstift am Stecker von Injektor 2 auf. Saabs 3,0-V6-Diesel nutzt ihn für einen Fehler der eigenen Injektor-Endstufe. Folgen können Leistungsverlust, unrunder Lauf, Rauch und Notlauf sein.

symptoms: Hard starting or stalling (distributor pump), smoke

description: P0217 is a condition code: the engine module reports that coolant temperature has passed a protection threshold. The limit and the reaction depend on the manufacturer – Saab's 2.2 diesel sets it at 120 °C for over 10 s, limits fuel quantity and suspends EGR and boost diagnostics until the temperature drops; heavy-duty diesels cut power sharply and may shut down; Ford petrol engines use their own code P1299 and cut fuel to individual cylinders. Whether the warning light comes on varies, because CARB exempts overheat protection that only engages once the gauge reads red. Usual causes are low coolant, a thermostat stuck closed, a failed fan or water pump – but Ford traced some cases to a faulty coolant sensor or harness.
possible_causes: Low coolant (leak, head gasket) [HIGH]
Thermostat stuck closed [HIGH]
Radiator fan, fan clutch or water pump faulty, radiator clogged [MEDIUM]
Coolant temperature sensor or harness faulty (false reading) [MEDIUM]
Extreme load (towing, gradient, heat) with an intact cooling system [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 900€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Coolant Over Temperature Condition

bilingual_description.en: P0217 is a condition code: the engine module reports that coolant temperature has passed a protection threshold. The limit and the reaction depend on the manufacturer – Saab's 2.2 diesel sets it at 120 °C for over 10 s, limits fuel quantity and suspends EGR and boost diagnostics until the temperature drops; heavy-duty diesels cut power sharply and may shut down; Ford petrol engines use their own code P1299 and cut fuel to individual cylinders. Whether the warning light comes on varies, because CARB exempts overheat protection that only engages once the gauge reads red. Usual causes are low coolant, a thermostat stuck closed, a failed fan or water pump – but Ford traced some cases to a faulty coolant sensor or harness.
bilingual_description.de: P0217 ist ein Zustandscode: Das Motorsteuergerät meldet, dass die Kühlmitteltemperatur eine Schutzschwelle überschritten hat. Grenze und Reaktion hängen vom Hersteller ab – Saabs 2,2-Liter-Diesel setzt ihn bei 120 °C für mehr als 10 s, begrenzt die Einspritzmenge und setzt AGR- und Ladedruckdiagnose aus, bis die Temperatur sinkt; schwere Nutzfahrzeugdiesel nehmen stark Leistung zurück und können abschalten; Ford-Benziner nutzen den eigenen Code P1299 und schalten einzelnen Zylindern den Kraftstoff ab. Ob die Warnleuchte angeht, ist unterschiedlich, weil CARB Überhitzungsschutz ausnimmt, der erst bei rot stehender Anzeige eingreift. Übliche Ursachen sind Kühlmittelmangel, ein geschlossen klemmender Thermostat, ein ausgefallener Lüfter oder eine defekte Wasserpumpe – Ford fand aber auch Fälle mit defektem Kühlmittelsensor oder Kabelbaum.

symptoms: Temperature gauge in the red, overheat warning
Loss of power, limp mode, cylinders possibly shut off
Steam or coolant smell, coolant loss

description: P0218 is a condition code: the transmission or engine module reports that transmission fluid temperature sensor A reads above an overheat limit. Saab's Aisin automatic sets it above 170 °C for more than 10 s, or above 140 °C for two minutes at high speed, shows a 'transmission overheating' warning and shifts less smoothly; afterwards a fluid change is advised because the additives are spent. Ford uses its own code on diesels and lists P0218 without the warning light on other models. Reactions include earlier torque converter lock-up, a modified shift pattern and sometimes reduced power. Causes are real overheating – towing, hills, low or old fluid, a clogged cooler – or a sensor reading wrongly.
possible_causes: High load (towing, hills, sustained full throttle, stop-and-go in heat) [HIGH]
Transmission fluid low or aged [MEDIUM]
Fluid cooler, thermostat or lines clogged, weak cooling system [MEDIUM]
Torque converter clutch slipping or internal damage [LOW]
Temperature sensor or wiring reading wrongly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Causes are real overheating – towing, hills, low or old fluid, a clogged cooler – or a sensor reading wrongly.
bilingual_description.de: P0218 ist ein Zustandscode: Das Getriebe- oder Motorsteuergerät meldet, dass der Getriebeöltemperatursensor A über einer Überhitzungsgrenze liegt. Saabs Aisin-Automatik setzt ihn über 170 °C für mehr als 10 s oder über 140 °C für zwei Minuten bei hoher Geschwindigkeit, zeigt eine Warnung zur Getriebeüberhitzung und schaltet weniger weich; danach wird ein Ölwechsel empfohlen, weil die Zusätze verbraucht sind. Ford nutzt bei Dieseln einen eigenen Code und führt P0218 bei anderen Modellen ohne Warnleuchte. Reaktionen sind frühere Wandlerüberbrückung, ein geändertes Schaltprogramm und teils reduzierte Leistung. Ursachen sind echte Überhitzung – Anhänger, Steigungen, zu wenig oder altes Öl, ein zugesetzter Kühler – oder ein falsch messender Sensor.

symptoms: Limp mode or reduced power possible

description: P0219 is a condition code: engine speed has exceeded the overspeed limit even though the rev limiter already cuts fuel – so the engine was driven from outside, usually by downshifting at too high a road speed or descending in too low a gear, or the speed signal was wrong. Limits: Ford 6.7 litre diesel above 4,200 rpm, 3.0 litre above 4,800 rpm, after 0.1 s; GM/Saab 2.8 V6 petrol with manual gearbox above 7,000 rpm for 1 s; Saab 2.2 diesel above 6,200 rpm, although fuel is cut from 5,000 rpm. Many manufacturers store it without the warning light. Saab advises: together with a camshaft sensor code it was real overspeed, alone check the speed signal; after real overspeed inspect the engine for valve train damage.
possible_causes: Downshift at too high a road speed (manual gearbox) [HIGH]
Descending in too low a gear [MEDIUM]
Fault in the speed signal (crankshaft sensor, wiring) [LOW]
Diesel runaway (oil drawn into the intake) or sticking injection [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 150€ (0.2h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Overspeed Condition

bilingual_description.en: P0219 is a condition code: engine speed has exceeded the overspeed limit even though the rev limiter already cuts fuel – so the engine was driven from outside, usually by downshifting at too high a road speed or descending in too low a gear, or the speed signal was wrong. Limits: Ford 6.7 litre diesel above 4,200 rpm, 3.0 litre above 4,800 rpm, after 0.1 s; GM/Saab 2.8 V6 petrol with manual gearbox above 7,000 rpm for 1 s; Saab 2.2 diesel above 6,200 rpm, although fuel is cut from 5,000 rpm. Many manufacturers store it without the warning light. Saab advises: together with a camshaft sensor code it was real overspeed, alone check the speed signal; after real overspeed inspect the engine for valve train damage.
bilingual_description.de: P0219 ist ein Zustandscode: Die Motordrehzahl hat die Überdrehzahlgrenze überschritten, obwohl der Drehzahlbegrenzer schon den Kraftstoff abschaltet – der Motor wurde also von außen angetrieben, meist durch Herunterschalten bei zu hoher Geschwindigkeit oder Bergabfahrt im zu kleinen Gang, oder das Drehzahlsignal war falsch. Grenzen: Ford-6,7-Liter-Diesel über 4.200/min, 3,0-Liter über 4.800/min, nach 0,1 s; GM/Saab 2,8-V6-Benziner mit Schaltgetriebe über 7.000/min für 1 s; Saab-2,2-Diesel über 6.200/min, obwohl ab 5.000/min abgeregelt wird. Viele Hersteller speichern ihn ohne Warnleuchte. Saab rät: Zusammen mit einem Nockenwellensensor-Code war es echtes Überdrehen, allein das Drehzahlsignal prüfen; nach echtem Überdrehen den Motor auf Ventiltriebschäden untersuchen.

symptoms: Usually no lasting symptoms, only a stored code
Briefly very high revs, limiter intervening
After real overspeed: rattling, loss of power

description: P021A reports a fault in the injection timing of cylinder 7 on a diesel engine. Unlike P01D7/P01D8 ('over retarded/advanced', the result of the injector learning routine in overrun), this code has no direction, and what it checks is up to the manufacturer. GM uses it as an electrical check on the 6.6 litre L5P Duramax V8: at every injection the engine module measures how long the injector current takes to reach its pull-in level of 13 A. If on the V8 that time is outside 60–150 µs in 10 of 20 samples, the code sets and the warning light comes on in the first trip. For 2020–2021 Silverado/Sierra HD, GM issued a software update against false setting. FCA's V6 and Ford do not use it.

Injector wiring or connector: contact resistance, corrosion, chafing [MEDIUM]

Wrong injector code, contaminated fuel or loose injector clamp [LOW]

description: With electronic throttle control the throttle body carries two position sensors, A and B, usually with opposite or offset signals, and the engine module compares them (correlation code P2135). GM and Ford give the pedal sensors their own codes (P2120 ff), so B is in practice the second throttle sensor. P0220 is the general circuit fault of sensor B without telling low from high. GM uses it in a special sense on 2015–2016 V8 engines: the signal lies outside 0.25–4.59 V only in the monitoring processor while the main processor sees it as valid; this sets immediately with the warning light. Newer GM and Ford engines report sensor B faults as P0222/P0223. The module carries on with sensor A, limits throttle opening and power and switches off cruise control.
possible_causes: Throttle body or sensor B faulty (worn track) [HIGH]
Wiring or connector at the throttle body (corrosion, break) [HIGH]
5 V reference disturbed (short in another sensor on the same reference) [MEDIUM]
Engine module input or monitoring processor faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit

bilingual_description.en: With electronic throttle control the throttle body carries two position sensors, A and B, usually with opposite or offset signals, and the engine module compares them (correlation code P2135). GM and Ford give the pedal sensors their own codes (P2120 ff), so B is in practice the second throttle sensor. P0220 is the general circuit fault of sensor B without telling low from high. GM uses it in a special sense on 2015–2016 V8 engines: the signal lies outside 0.25–4.59 V only in the monitoring processor while the main processor sees it as valid; this sets immediately with the warning light. Newer GM and Ford engines report sensor B faults as P0222/P0223. The module carries on with sensor A, limits throttle opening and power and switches off cruise control.
bilingual_description.de: Bei elektronischer Drosselklappensteuerung sitzen im Drosselklappensteller zwei Stellungssensoren, A und B, meist mit gegenläufigem oder versetztem Signal, und das Motorsteuergerät vergleicht beide (Korrelationscode P2135). GM und Ford geben den Pedalwertgebern eigene Codes (P2120 ff), B ist dort also praktisch der zweite Drosselklappensensor. P0220 ist der allgemeine Stromkreisfehler von Sensor B, ohne zwischen zu niedrig und zu hoch zu unterscheiden. GM nutzt ihn bei V8-Motoren von 2015–2016 in einer Sonderbedeutung: Das Signal liegt nur im Überwachungsprozessor außerhalb von 0,25–4,59 V, während der Hauptprozessor es als gültig sieht; das wird sofort mit Warnleuchte gemeldet. Neuere GM- und Ford-Motoren melden Fehler an Sensor B als P0222/P0223. Das Steuergerät arbeitet mit Sensor A weiter, begrenzt Drosselklappenöffnung und Leistung und schaltet den Tempomat ab.

symptoms: Check engine light and throttle warning light

description: With electronic throttle control the throttle body carries two position sensors, A and B, usually with opposite or offset signals, and the engine module compares them (correlation code P2135). GM and Ford give the pedal sensors their own codes (P2120 ff), so B is in practice the second throttle sensor. P0221 is the plausibility fault: the signal of sensor B is electrically valid but does not match sensor A or the throttle position expected from airflow. Bosch ME9 engines (Saab) set it at a deviation of more than 9 %, older Ford systems at more than 7 degrees between the sensors without the warning light; many newer engines report this only as P2135. The module carries on with sensor A, limits throttle opening and power and switches off cruise control.

Contact resistance at connector or wiring [MEDIUM]
Throttle dirty or sticking [MEDIUM]
Mass airflow sensor fault or false air [LOW]

description: With electronic throttle control the throttle body carries two position sensors, A and B, usually with opposite or offset signals, and the engine module compares them (correlation code P2135). GM and Ford give the pedal sensors their own codes (P2120 ff), so B is in practice the second throttle sensor. description: The charge air cooler bypass is a flap or valve that routes compressed air around the charge air cooler, so the engine and exhaust warm up faster after a cold start; when warm it closes or opens partly to control intake air temperature. It is driven by an electric motor with a built-in position sensor or by a solenoid and vacuum can. description: The fuel pump circuit has two sides: the primary circuit is the engine module's output to the fuel pump relay coil (or to a pump control module), the secondary circuit is the power circuit from relay contact or module to the pump itself. description: P0234 is a function code, not a sensor fault: the engine module compares target and actual boost, and actual boost stays above target although the control is already lowering it (wastegate opened, variable vanes opened). GM petrol engines set it at 20–35 kPa over target with the warning light in the first trip; GM diesels with variable vanes at 7–10 kPa, after two trips; Ford EcoBoost at about 28 kPa (4 psi) over 5 s while the wastegate is already commanded fully open. Ford diesels instead use P0234 for exhaust back pressure above 4.0–4.5 bar. The engine limits boost or enters limp mode. Typical causes are a wastegate stuck closed, sooted variable vanes or a faulty control valve; Audi traced cases on the Q7 TDI to cracked exhaust parts jamming the turbo vanes. Check the boost sensor against barometric pressure first.

description: Boost sensor A measures the absolute pressure between charge air cooler and throttle – GM calls it TIAP, Ford TIP – usually combined with an intake air temperature sensor; its voltage rises with pressure. With the ignition on and the engine stopped it must read the same as manifold and barometric pressure. P0235 is the general fault of sensor A's circuit or signal, for modules that do not split low, high and range. GM, Ford and Saab do not use it; Audi documents it on the Q7 TDI together with over- and underboost, so there it also marks an implausible boost value, for example from a charge air leak or jammed turbo vanes. bilingual_description.en: Boost sensor A measures the absolute pressure between charge air cooler and throttle – GM calls it TIAP, Ford TIP – usually combined with an intake air temperature sensor; its voltage rises with pressure. description: The fuel pump circuit has two sides: the primary circuit is the engine module's output to the fuel pump relay coil (or to a pump control module), the secondary circuit is the power circuit from relay contact or module to the pump itself. P023F means the power circuit to the pump is open. GM pumps with their own power module, whose speed is controlled by rail pressure, measure the pump current: if it stays below 1 A (older modules 0.5 A) although the pump is commanded, the code sets with the warning light in the first trip, and fuel pressure diagnostics are suspended. The cause lies in the wire from module to pump or its return, the pump connector or the pump motor itself. The pump stops, so the engine will not start or dies – there is no limp mode.

Fuel pump open internally (brushes, winding) [HIGH]
Wire from module to pump or return wire open [MEDIUM]
Pump control module faulty [LOW]

description: The wastegate lets exhaust bypass the turbine to limit boost; actuator B is either a pulse-width-modulated solenoid on a pneumatic wastegate can or an electric actuator with a position sensor. B is the second turbo or actuator, so B codes only exist on engines with two. P0250 means the control circuit of actuator B reads high: the control wire is shorted to voltage, checked with the driver on. GM's LGW twin-turbo sets it at less than 0.5 Ω to battery voltage in 10 of 20 samples with the warning light in the first trip; older GM modules need two trips. Ford reports it on pneumatic wastegates after 2–3 s. Valve B can no longer be controlled, so that side runs on base boost.
possible_causes: Control wire of wastegate B shorted to voltage [HIGH]
Winding shorted internally (overcurrent) [MEDIUM]
Connector corroded or damp [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Der LGW-Biturbo von GM setzt ihn bei weniger als 0,5 Ω gegen Batteriespannung in 10 von 20 Messungen mit Warnleuchte im ersten Fahrzyklus; ältere GM-Steuergeräte brauchen zwei Fahrzyklen. Ford meldet ihn bei pneumatischen Wastegates nach 2–3 s. Ventil B ist nicht mehr ansteuerbar, diese Seite läuft mit Grundladedruck.

symptoms: Clearly less power, boost only at base level

description: These codes cover the electrically controlled fuel metering actuator on a diesel injection pump. On older distributor pumps it was a solenoid that set the injected quantity; on common rail it is usually an inlet metering valve on the high-pressure pump that lets only as much fuel into the pumping elements as the rail needs, instead of spilling the excess through a pressure valve. Manufacturers use different codes for this part: Ford P0001–P0004, GM Duramax P0090–P0092. P0251 is the general circuit fault of actuator A. Saab's 2011 9-5 diesel uses it for an open circuit of the pressure regulator on the high-pressure pump: if the control wire does not show the expected voltage with the driver off for more than 1 s, the code sets with the warning light at once. Depending on the system, rail pressure and power are then limited.
possible_causes: Metering actuator coil open [HIGH]
Connector at the actuator corroded or loose, broken wire [HIGH]
Supply voltage to the actuator missing [MEDIUM]
Distributor pump: internal electronics or quantity valve faulty [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Diese Codes betreffen das elektrisch angesteuerte Mengenstellglied an einer Diesel-Einspritzpumpe. Bei älteren Verteilerpumpen war es ein Magnetventil, das die Einspritzmenge festlegte; bei Common Rail ist es meist eine Zumesseinheit auf der Saugseite der Hochdruckpumpe, die nur so viel Kraftstoff in die Pumpenelemente lässt, wie das Rail braucht, statt den Überschuss über ein Druckventil abzusteuern. Die Hersteller nutzen für dieses Bauteil unterschiedliche Codes: Ford P0001–P0004, GM Duramax P0090–P0092. P0251 ist der allgemeine Stromkreisfehler von Stellglied A. Saabs 9-5-Diesel von 2011 nutzt ihn für eine Unterbrechung des Druckreglers an der Hochdruckpumpe: Zeigt die Steuerleitung bei abgeschaltetem Treiber länger als 1 s nicht die erwartete Spannung, wird der Code mit sofortiger Warnleuchte gesetzt. Je nach System werden Raildruck und Leistung dann begrenzt.

description: These codes cover the electrically controlled fuel metering actuator on a diesel injection pump. On older distributor pumps it was a solenoid that set the injected quantity; on common rail it is usually an inlet metering valve on the high-pressure pump that lets only as much fuel into the pumping elements as the rail needs, instead of spilling the excess through a pressure valve. Manufacturers use different codes for this part: Ford P0001–P0004, GM Duramax P0090–P0092. P0252 is the range or performance fault of actuator A, and the meaning depends on the maker. Saab's 2011 9-5 diesel sets it when the driver stage of the pump pressure regulator overheats – a sign of a shorted turn or excessive current – with the warning light at once; Ford checks the same under P0002 at a driver temperature above 170 °C. Generally the code can also mean the actuator does not achieve the expected effect.

Actuator mechanically sticking or dirty (fuel quality, wear debris) [MEDIUM]
Wiring with contact resistance [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]

description: These codes cover the electrically controlled fuel metering actuator on a diesel injection pump – on common rail usually an inlet metering valve on the high-pressure pump that sets how much fuel is compressed. description: These codes cover the electrically controlled fuel metering actuator on a diesel injection pump – on common rail usually an inlet metering valve on the high-pressure pump that sets how much fuel is compressed. P0257 is the functional fault of actuator B: the metering does not achieve its target. It is documented on Mack and Volvo heavy-duty common-rail diesels of 2018–2020 together with rail pressure codes (P0087, P016F, P228F) and P2A17/P2A1F; the cause can lie outside the actuator, for example an electronic pressure relief valve stuck open, a leak or poor low-pressure supply, so those faults are fixed first. Engine power may be derated.

description: These codes cover the electrically controlled fuel metering actuator on a diesel injection pump – on common rail usually an inlet metering valve on the high-pressure pump that sets how much fuel is compressed. possible_causes: Supply wire, fuse or relay of the metering valves open or shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector at the pump corroded or loose [MEDIUM]
Metering valve shorted to ground internally [MEDIUM]
Engine module [LOW]

symptoms: Limp mode with limited power and speed

description: On demand-controlled fuel systems the engine module does not drive the pump itself but sends a pump control module the desired pump output on a separate control line, usually as a duty cycle; the module reports back on a monitor line or via CAN. P025A means the control line from the engine module to pump module A is open or faulty. On Ford systems the pump module itself detects the bad command signal and reports it on the monitor line (11–16 V, 2–5 s); Ford uses P025A for the shared line to modules A and B. GM's pump module compares the enable line with the request on the data bus and sets P025A after about 1 s, with the warning light in the first trip; on some Ford vehicles the code does not light it.
possible_causes: Control line to the pump module open or shorted, often along the frame [HIGH]
Connector at the pump module corroded or wet (module often mounted on the frame) [HIGH]
Pump control module faulty (input) [MEDIUM]
Module ground or supply poor [MEDIUM]
Engine module output faulty [LOW]

description: On demand-controlled fuel systems the engine module does not drive the pump itself but sends a pump control module the desired pump output on a separate control line, usually as a duty cycle; the module reports back on a monitor line or via CAN. P025B means pump module A receives a signal, but an invalid command – the duty cycle is outside the valid window or implausible. Ford's module signals this with a 20 % (±4 %) duty cycle on its monitor line; the check runs continuously at 11–16 V over 2–5 s. Whether the warning light comes on depends on the vehicle. Typical causes are contact resistance in the control line or connector that distorts the duty cycle, a poor ground or a faulty module.

Pump control module faulty [MEDIUM]

Engine module software or output [LOW]

description: Boost sensor A measures the pressure between charge air cooler and throttle (Ford TIP, GM TIAP). P025E counts brief excursions outside its valid voltage range that are each too short for the low or high code P0237/P0238 – Ford's limits are below 0.19 V and above 4.88 V. Ford counts these events continuously and sets P025E after 10 in one drive cycle. Boost control then runs on a substitute value or is switched off, leaving only base boost. Typical causes are a loose or corroded connector or a wire breaking under vibration and heat.
possible_causes: Loose contact or corrosion at the sensor connector [HIGH]
Wire or 5 V reference breaking from vibration or heat [MEDIUM]
Sensor faulty internally (erratic signal) [MEDIUM]
Shared 5 V reference disturbed by another sensor [LOW]

description: P0261 means the control wire of the cylinder 1 injector – the side the engine module switches to ground – is shorted to ground. GM detects this with the driver off: on direct injection at 1 V or less, on port injection and Duramax diesels at 0.5 Ω or less to ground. Ford's 6.7 diesel has its driver chip report the short within 0.3 s. Most systems switch the warning light on in the first trip (some GM port-injection engines and Saab's 2.0 turbo after two) and shut the affected injector off, so the cylinder misfires. description: P0263 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. The code sets when the correction for cylinder 1 reaches its limit and the cylinder still does not keep up – GM at 95 % of a limit of about ±12–17 mm³ for 30 s, Ford above 90 % of the allowed 3.5–15 mg per stroke for 7.5 s; GM needs two trips. The code does not say whether there is too much or too little fuel – the correction value for cylinder 1 shows the direction: strongly negative means a leaking injector, strongly positive a weak injector or low compression. VW and Ram traced some cases to over-sensitive software, so check for updates before replacing injectors.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 1 worn, coked or leaking [HIGH]
Engine software outdated or diagnosis too sensitive [MEDIUM]
Injector correction codes not or wrongly programmed after replacement [MEDIUM]

description: P026A means the charge air cooler is not cooling enough. The module compares the temperature drop across the cooler with the maximum possible (inlet minus ambient) or with a model: GM's 6.6 litre LML diesel sets it below 25 % efficiency, later GM diesels below 50 %, both after two trips; Ford's 6.7 and 3.0 diesels when the measured temperature is 18–35 °C (3.0: 35–65 °C) off the model over about 10 s. GM's 3.0 twin-turbo petrol with a coolant-cooled charge air cooler sets it in the first trip when manifold air exceeds 110 °C or boost has been limited for a long time. Hot intake air costs power and raises NOx and soot.
possible_causes: Charge air cooler clogged on the outside (insects, leaves, dirt) or fins damaged [HIGH]
Coolant-cooled cooler: pump faulty, air in the low-temperature circuit, low coolant [HIGH]
Charge air or ambient temperature sensor inaccurate [MEDIUM]
Charge air cooler bypass stuck open [LOW]
Software or calibration [LOW]

GM und Ford regeln den Zeitpunkt stattdessen mit zylinderweisen Codes (P01CB ff, P2B11 ff).

symptoms: Possibly knocking, rough running or more smoke

description: From 2010, CARB requires diesel engines to detect when the commanded injection quantity is not delivered. The module estimates the fuel actually burned from airflow and the measured lambda (from the NOx or oxygen sensor) and corrects the quantity; if that correction passes a limit, the code sets. P026C means the engine gets less fuel than commanded. GM's 6.6 litre LML diesel checks it at idle with the vehicle stationary and the engine warm, setting it at a correction of −20 to −35 mm³ per stroke for 12 s; later GM diesels use the learned correction value (10 of 20 samples); both need two trips. FCA lists it with an injector cleaning procedure for deposits. Ford diesels do not use it. Typical causes are coked injectors, wrong airflow or lambda measurement and weak fuel supply.
possible_causes: Injectors coked or clogged (too little flow) [HIGH]
Airflow or boost measurement wrong, NOx sensor lambda inaccurate [MEDIUM]
Weak low- or high-pressure supply (filter, pump, rail pressure) [MEDIUM]
Fuel quality or contamination [LOW]
Software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 4000€ (0.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: From 2010, CARB requires diesel engines to detect when the commanded injection quantity is not delivered. On GM's 2.8 litre diesel vans of 2020–2022 it could also be a software anomaly without driving problems. Symptoms are black smoke and more frequent filter regeneration.
bilingual_description.de: Seit 2010 verlangt CARB bei Dieselmotoren, zu erkennen, wenn die befohlene Einspritzmenge nicht ankommt. Das Steuergerät schätzt die tatsächlich verbrannte Kraftstoffmenge aus Luftmasse und gemessenem Lambda (von NOx- oder Lambdasonde) und korrigiert die Menge; überschreitet diese Korrektur eine Grenze, wird der Code gesetzt. P026D heißt, der Motor bekommt mehr Kraftstoff als befohlen. GMs LML-Diesel setzt ihn im Leerlauf bei einer Korrektur von +16 bis +35 mm³ je Hub über 12 s, nach zwei Fahrzyklen. Volvo-Lkw erkennen ihn als zu wenig Sauerstoff an den NOx-Sonden für den Kraftstoffdurchsatz und verweisen auf Ladedrucksensor, AGR-Ventil und -Sensor, falsche Injektoren, Laderschaufeln und Ansauglecks. Bei GMs 2,8-Liter-Diesel-Transportern von 2020–2022 konnte es auch eine Software-Anomalie ohne Fahrprobleme sein. Symptome sind Schwarzrauch und häufigere Filterregeneration.

symptoms: Black smoke, higher soot load, more frequent filter regeneration

description: Some engines cool the charge air with a coolant-to-air cooler in its own low-temperature circuit with an electric pump. P026E means that pump is electrically sound but does not deliver as commanded – judged from feedback by the pump electronics or from the missing temperature drop. FCA documents it on the 2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia and 2018 Stelvio with the 2.0 turbo, together with P024A, and fixed it with a software update; thresholds are not published. Air in the circuit or low coolant lets the pump run dry; hot charge air then costs power.
possible_causes: Air in the low-temperature circuit or low coolant (pump runs dry) [HIGH]
Pump faulty internally (bearing, impeller, electronics) [HIGH]
Software or calibration [MEDIUM]
Weak supply or ground, corroded connector [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.
