description: P026F is a general functional code for the coolant thermostat. CARB requires that the coolant reaches the temperature needed for other diagnostics in the approved time and comes within 11 °C of the thermostat's regulating temperature; from model years 2019–2021 petrol engines must also detect it dropping back below that temperature, and electric pumps or valves controlling coolant flow are monitored like a thermostat. The module follows coolant temperature against a heat model. No manufacturer using P026F was found – GM and Ford report thermostat faults as P0128, P01F0 or P2181 – so the description rests on CARB and the thermostat's function.
possible_causes: Thermostat stuck open or opening too early [HIGH]
Thermostat stuck closed or opening too late [MEDIUM]
Map-controlled thermostat: heating element or control faulty [MEDIUM]
Coolant temperature sensor inaccurate [LOW]
Low coolant or air in the system [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 400€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: P0270 means the control wire of the cylinder 4 injector – the side the engine module switches to ground – is shorted to ground. GM detects this with the driver off: on direct injection at 1 V or less, on port injection and Duramax diesels at 0.5 Ω or less to ground. Ford's 6.7 diesel has its driver chip report the short within 0.3 s. Most systems switch the warning light on in the first trip (some GM port-injection engines and Saab's 2.0 turbo after two) and shut the affected injector off, so the cylinder misfires. Ford petrol engines report all injector circuit faults as P0201 ff instead.
possible_causes: Control wire of the cylinder 4 injector chafed to ground in the harness [HIGH]
Injector connector damp or corroded, leakage to ground [MEDIUM]
Injector shorted to its housing internally [MEDIUM]
Open control wire (on some GM port-injection drivers this also reads low; P020x sets too) [LOW]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: P0270 heißt, die Steuerleitung des Injektors von Zylinder 4 – die Seite, die das Motorsteuergerät nach Masse schaltet – hat Masseschluss. GM erkennt das bei abgeschaltetem Treiber: bei Direkteinspritzung ab 1 V oder weniger, bei Saugrohreinspritzung und Duramax-Diesel ab 0,5 Ω oder weniger gegen Masse. Beim 6,7-Liter-Diesel von Ford meldet der Treiberbaustein den Kurzschluss binnen 0,3 s. Ford-Benziner melden alle Injektorkreisfehler stattdessen unter P0201 ff.

symptoms: Misfire and rough running, misfire code P0304
Injector shut off, limp mode possible on diesels

description: P0271 means the control wire of the cylinder 4 injector is shorted to voltage. Ford petrol engines report all injector circuit faults as P0201 ff instead.

Injector coil shorted internally (too low resistance, overcurrent) [MEDIUM]
Short between supply and control wire in harness or connector [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]

description: P0272 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. The code sets when the correction for cylinder 4 reaches its limit and the cylinder still does not keep up – GM at 95 % of a limit of about ±12–17 mm³ for 30 s, Ford above 90 % of the allowed 3.5–15 mg per stroke for 7.5 s; GM needs two trips. The code does not say whether there is too much or too little fuel – the correction value for cylinder 4 shows the direction: strongly negative means a leaking injector, strongly positive a weak injector or low compression. VW and Ram traced some cases to over-sensitive software, so check for updates before replacing injectors.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 4 worn, coked or leaking [HIGH]
Engine software outdated or diagnosis too sensitive [MEDIUM]
Injector correction codes not or wrongly programmed after replacement [MEDIUM]
Low compression on cylinder 4 (valve, rings, injector seal) [MEDIUM]
Crankshaft sensor or tone wheel learning faulty, dual-mass flywheel [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P0278 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. The code sets when the correction for cylinder 6 reaches its limit and the cylinder still does not keep up – GM at 95 % of a limit of about ±12–17 mm³ for 30 s, Ford above 90 % of the allowed 3.5–15 mg per stroke for 7.5 s; GM needs two trips. The code does not say whether there is too much or too little fuel – the correction value for cylinder 6 shows the direction: strongly negative means a leaking injector, strongly positive a weak injector or low compression. VW and Ram traced some cases to over-sensitive software, so check for updates before replacing injectors.

Engine software outdated or diagnosis too sensitive [MEDIUM]
Injector correction codes not or wrongly programmed after replacement [MEDIUM]
Low compression on cylinder 6 (valve, rings, injector seal) [MEDIUM]
Crankshaft sensor or tone wheel learning faulty, dual-mass flywheel [LOW]

description: On demand-controlled fuel systems the engine module does not drive the pump itself but sends a pump control module the desired pump output on a separate control line, usually as a duty cycle; the module reports back on a monitor line or via CAN. Module B is a second pump module, for example on dual-tank commercial vehicles. P027A is the counterpart of P025A: the control line from the engine module to pump module B is open or faulty. No manufacturer using P027A was found – Ford reports line faults of both modules together under P025A, GM only uses P025A; the description follows CARB's circuit monitoring requirement and Ford's module B check. If the second tank's pump gets no valid command, fuel may run short when running from that tank.
possible_causes: Control line to the pump module open or shorted, often along the frame [HIGH]
Connector at the pump module corroded or wet (module often mounted on the frame) [HIGH]
Pump control module faulty (input) [MEDIUM]
Module ground or supply poor [MEDIUM]

description: P0284 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. description: Some vehicles – mainly commercial and off-road machines, or cars with a separate cooler for a coolant-cooled charge air cooler – have their own fan for the charge air cooler; a Deere patent describes such a fan that the module switches and reverses to blow out dirt. P028A heißt, der Steuerkreis des Lüfters ist unterbrochen oder allgemein gestört, erkannt von der Endstufe. description: Some vehicles – mainly commercial and off-road machines, or cars with a separate cooler for a coolant-cooled charge air cooler – have their own fan for the charge air cooler, switched by the engine module; a Deere patent describes such a fan that is also reversed to blow out dirt. The charge air then gets hotter, which can limit boost and power. No manufacturer document using this code was found; the description rests on CARB's output component requirement.

description: Some vehicles – mainly commercial and off-road machines, or cars with a separate cooler for a coolant-cooled charge air cooler – have their own fan for the charge air cooler, switched by the engine module; a Deere patent describes such a fan that is also reversed to blow out dirt. bilingual_title.en: Charge Air Cooler Cooling Fan Stuck On

bilingual_description.en: Some vehicles – mainly commercial and off-road machines, or cars with a separate cooler for a coolant-cooled charge air cooler – have their own fan for the charge air cooler, switched by the engine module; a Deere patent describes such a fan that is also reversed to blow out dirt. P028C means the fan runs although the module has switched it off – speed or current feedback, or the voltage at the output, does not match the off command. Typical causes are a welded relay contact or a shorted driver stage. The fan runs continuously and can drain the battery; the charge air tends to be too cold, which favours condensate. No manufacturer document using this code was found; the description rests on CARB's output component requirement.
bilingual_description.de: Manche Fahrzeuge – vor allem Nutz- und Arbeitsmaschinen oder Pkw mit eigenem Kühler für einen Luft-Wasser-Ladeluftkühler – haben einen eigenen Lüfter für den Ladeluftkühler, den das Motorsteuergerät schaltet; ein Deere-Patent beschreibt einen solchen Lüfter, der zum Ausblasen von Schmutz auch umgekehrt wird. P028C heißt, der Lüfter läuft, obwohl das Steuergerät ihn abgeschaltet hat – Drehzahl- oder Stromrückmeldung bzw. die Spannung am Ausgang passen nicht zum Aus-Befehl. Typische Ursachen sind ein verschweißter Relaiskontakt oder eine durchlegierte Endstufe. Der Lüfter läuft dauernd und kann die Batterie entladen; die Ladeluft wird eher zu kalt, was Kondensat begünstigt. Eine Herstellerunterlage mit diesem Code wurde nicht gefunden; die Beschreibung stützt sich auf die CARB-Vorgabe für Ausgangskomponenten.

symptoms: Fan runs all the time, even after switch-off

description: Some vehicles – mainly commercial and off-road machines, or cars with a separate cooler for a coolant-cooled charge air cooler – have their own fan for the charge air cooler, switched by the engine module; a Deere patent describes such a fan that is also reversed to blow out dirt. P028D means the fan's control circuit reads low – typically the control wire shorted to ground, detected by the driver stage. Depending on whether the module switches the low or the high side, the fan then runs permanently or not at all. No manufacturer document using this code was found; the description rests on CARB's output component requirement.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground (chafing) [HIGH]
Relay coil or fan module input shorted [MEDIUM]
Moisture or corrosion in the connector [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 300€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

symptoms: Loss of power in heat or at low speed
High charge air temperature, possibly P026A

description: P0290 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. The code sets when the correction for cylinder 10 reaches its limit and the cylinder still does not keep up – GM at 95 % of a limit of about ±12–17 mm³ for 30 s, Ford above 90 % of the allowed 3.5–15 mg per stroke for 7.5 s; GM needs two trips. The code does not say whether there is too much or too little fuel – the correction value for cylinder 10 shows the direction: strongly negative means a leaking injector, strongly positive a weak injector or low compression. Cylinder 10 only exists on diesels with ten cylinders; GM and Ford documents stop at cylinder 8, so the description follows CARB and the siblings.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 10 worn, coked or leaking [HIGH]
Engine software outdated or diagnosis too sensitive [MEDIUM]
Injector correction codes not or wrongly programmed after replacement [MEDIUM]
Low compression on cylinder 10 (valve, rings, injector seal) [MEDIUM]
Crankshaft sensor or tone wheel learning faulty, dual-mass flywheel [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Cylinder 10 Contribution/Balance

bilingual_description.en: P0290 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. The code sets when the correction for cylinder 10 reaches its limit and the cylinder still does not keep up – GM at 95 % of a limit of about ±12–17 mm³ for 30 s, Ford above 90 % of the allowed 3.5–15 mg per stroke for 7.5 s; GM needs two trips. The code does not say whether there is too much or too little fuel – the correction value for cylinder 10 shows the direction: strongly negative means a leaking injector, strongly positive a weak injector or low compression. Cylinder 10 only exists on diesels with ten cylinders; GM and Ford documents stop at cylinder 8, so the description follows CARB and the siblings.
bilingual_description.de: P0290 stammt aus der Zylindergleichstellung von Common-Rail-Dieseln: Das Motorsteuergerät misst die Kurbelwellenbeschleunigung im Arbeitstakt jedes Zylinders, vergleicht sie mit dem Mittelwert und gibt einem abweichenden Zylinder mehr oder weniger Kraftstoff. Der Code wird gesetzt, wenn die Korrektur für Zylinder 10 an ihre Grenze stößt und der Zylinder trotzdem nicht gleichzieht – GM bei 95 % einer Grenze von etwa ±12–17 mm³ über 30 s, Ford über 90 % der erlaubten 3,5–15 mg je Hub über 7,5 s; GM braucht zwei Fahrzyklen. Der Code sagt nicht, ob zu viel oder zu wenig Kraftstoff kommt – der Korrekturwert für Zylinder 10 zeigt die Richtung: stark negativ heißt undichter Injektor, stark positiv schwacher Injektor oder geringe Kompression. Zylinder 10 gibt es nur bei Dieseln mit zehn Zylindern; die Unterlagen von GM und Ford enden bei Zylinder 8, die Beschreibung folgt deshalb CARB und den Geschwistercodes.

description: P0291 means the control wire of the cylinder 11 injector – the side the engine module switches to ground – is shorted to ground. GM detects this with the driver off: on direct injection at 1 V or less, on port injection and Duramax diesels at 0.5 Ω or less to ground. Ford's 6.7 diesel has its driver chip report the short within 0.3 s. Most systems switch the warning light on in the first trip (some GM port-injection engines and Saab's 2.0 turbo after two) and shut the affected injector off, so the cylinder misfires. Ford petrol engines report all injector circuit faults as P0201 ff instead. Cylinder 11 exists only on twelve-cylinder engines; no manufacturer document using this code was found – GM and Ford documents stop at cylinder 8 – so the description follows CARB and the codes for cylinders 1–8.
possible_causes: Control wire of the cylinder 11 injector chafed to ground in the harness [HIGH]
Injector connector damp or corroded, leakage to ground [MEDIUM]
Injector shorted to its housing internally [MEDIUM]
Open control wire (on some GM port-injection drivers this also reads low; P020x sets too) [LOW]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Ford's 6.7 diesel has its driver chip report the short within 0.3 s. Most systems switch the warning light on in the first trip (some GM port-injection engines and Saab's 2.0 turbo after two) and shut the affected injector off, so the cylinder misfires. Ford petrol engines report all injector circuit faults as P0201 ff instead. Cylinder 11 exists only on twelve-cylinder engines; no manufacturer document using this code was found – GM and Ford documents stop at cylinder 8 – so the description follows CARB and the codes for cylinders 1–8.
bilingual_description.de: P0291 heißt, die Steuerleitung des Injektors von Zylinder 11 – die Seite, die das Motorsteuergerät nach Masse schaltet – hat Masseschluss. GM erkennt das bei abgeschaltetem Treiber: bei Direkteinspritzung ab 1 V oder weniger, bei Saugrohreinspritzung und Duramax-Diesel ab 0,5 Ω oder weniger gegen Masse. Beim 6,7-Liter-Diesel von Ford meldet der Treiberbaustein den Kurzschluss binnen 0,3 s. Die meisten Systeme schalten die Warnleuchte im ersten Fahrzyklus ein (manche GM-Saugrohreinspritzer und Saabs 2,0-Liter-Turbo nach zwei) und den betroffenen Injektor ab, sodass der Zylinder aussetzt. Ford-Benziner melden alle Injektorkreisfehler stattdessen unter P0201 ff. Zylinder 11 gibt es nur bei Zwölfzylindern; eine Herstellerunterlage mit diesem Code wurde nicht gefunden – die Unterlagen von GM und Ford enden bei Zylinder 8 –, die Beschreibung folgt deshalb CARB und den Codes der Zylinder 1–8.

description: P0292 means the control wire of the cylinder 11 injector is shorted to voltage. On Ford's 6.7 diesel it means the injector's high side is shorted to its low side, reported within 0.3 s. Most systems switch the warning light on in the first trip (some GM port-injection engines and Saab's 2.0 turbo after two) and shut the affected injector off, so the cylinder misfires. Ford petrol engines report all injector circuit faults as P0201 ff instead. Cylinder 11 exists only on twelve-cylinder engines; no manufacturer document using this code was found – GM and Ford documents stop at cylinder 8 – so the description follows CARB and the codes for cylinders 1–8.
possible_causes: Control wire of the cylinder 11 injector touching battery voltage or another supply wire [HIGH]
Injector coil shorted internally (too low resistance, overcurrent) [MEDIUM]
Short between supply and control wire in harness or connector [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: P0296 comes from the cylinder balance control of common-rail diesels: the engine module measures the crankshaft acceleration of each cylinder's power stroke, compares it with the average and gives a deviating cylinder more or less fuel. The code sets when the correction for cylinder 12 reaches its limit and the cylinder still does not keep up – GM at 95 % of a limit of about ±12–17 mm³ for 30 s, Ford above 90 % of the allowed 3.5–15 mg per stroke for 7.5 s; GM needs two trips. The code does not say whether there is too much or too little fuel – the correction value for cylinder 12 shows the direction: strongly negative means a leaking injector, strongly positive a weak injector or low compression. Cylinder 12 only exists on diesels with twelve cylinders; GM and Ford documents stop at cylinder 8, so the description follows CARB and the siblings.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 12 worn, coked or leaking [HIGH]
Engine software outdated or diagnosis too sensitive [MEDIUM]
Injector correction codes not or wrongly programmed after replacement [MEDIUM]
Low compression on cylinder 12 (valve, rings, injector seal) [MEDIUM]
Crankshaft sensor or tone wheel learning faulty, dual-mass flywheel [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P0297 is a condition code: the engine module detects that road speed – from the vehicle speed sensor or wheel and output shaft speed – exceeded the calibrated maximum. Electronic speed limiters cut fuel or throttle at that limit, and the event is stored. Ford uses the code on its petrol trucks and stores it without the warning light; no manufacturer publishes a threshold. Common triggers are descending with a trailer beyond the limiter speed, wheelspin on the driven axle, a wrongly programmed tyre size or axle ratio, or spikes in the speed signal. Unlike P0219 it concerns road speed, not engine speed.
possible_causes: Limiter speed genuinely exceeded (downhill, trailer) [HIGH]
Wrong tyre size or axle ratio programmed, larger wheels fitted [MEDIUM]
Wheelspin on the driven axle [MEDIUM]
Speed signal disturbed (loose contact, interference, tone wheel) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 150€ (0.2h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: P0297 ist ein Zustandscode: Das Motorsteuergerät erkennt, dass die Fahrgeschwindigkeit – vom Geschwindigkeitssensor oder aus Rad- und Getriebeausgangsdrehzahl – das eingestellte Maximum überschritten hat. Elektronische Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzer nehmen an dieser Grenze Kraftstoff oder Drosselklappe zurück, und das Ereignis wird gespeichert. Ford nutzt den Code bei seinen Benzin-Lkw und speichert ihn ohne Warnleuchte; eine Schwelle veröffentlicht kein Hersteller. Häufige Auslöser sind Bergabfahrten mit Anhänger über die Begrenzergeschwindigkeit, durchdrehende Antriebsräder, eine falsch programmierte Reifengröße oder Achsübersetzung oder Spitzen im Geschwindigkeitssignal. Anders als P0219 betrifft er die Fahrgeschwindigkeit, nicht die Motordrehzahl.

symptoms: Usually no warning light, code only stored
Vehicle limits speed at its maximum
With a disturbed signal: jumping speedometer, odd shifting

description: P0298 is a protection code: engine oil temperature – from its own sensor, often combined with the oil level sensor, or modelled – has exceeded the protection limit. Saab's 3.0 diesel limits injection quantity when the oil stays at 135 °C or more for over 10 s, until it cools down; a heavy-duty bus engine warns in two stages and then derates. Ford stores the code without the warning light, in line with CARB's exemption for overheat protection. Usual causes are high load in heat, cooling problems, a clogged oil cooler or stuck oil thermostat, and occasionally a sensor reading too high.
possible_causes: High load in heat (trailer, mountain pass, stop-and-go) [HIGH]
Cooling or fan problem (clogged radiator, fan, thermostat, low coolant) [MEDIUM]
Oil cooler clogged or oil thermostat stuck [MEDIUM]
Oil temperature or level sensor reading too high [MEDIUM]
Low oil level or wrong oil [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P0299 means actual boost stays below target for a period although the control already demands more. Thresholds: GM petrol 30–55 kPa below target with the warning light in the first trip; GM diesels 10–50 kPa, two trips; Ford EcoBoost more than 4 psi (about 28 kPa) for 5 s with the wastegate already commanded fully closed; Ford diesels 30–40 kPa for 10–15 s, with a further underboost code P2263. Typical causes from manufacturer bulletins: a charge air leak, a wastegate that lost its preload or whose rod came off, a leaking bypass valve, sticking turbo vanes on diesels, and ice in the charge air cooler in winter. A faulty boost sensor can also fake underboost. Many engines then limit power.
possible_causes: Leak in the charge air path (hose off or torn, cooler leaking, clamps) [HIGH]
Wastegate faulty (rod off, preload lost, vacuum or solenoid, diaphragm) [HIGH]
Turbo vanes sticking or turbo worn (diesel) [MEDIUM]
Bypass valve leaking (torn diaphragm) or its control [MEDIUM]
Ice in the charge air cooler, boost sensor or connector, or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 6h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: These codes belong to an individual-cylinder fuel correction: a diesel's cylinder balance control measures each cylinder's crankshaft acceleration and adjusts its injection quantity; on petrol engines a cylinder-selective mixture control does the same. CARB requires the system to report when such a correction has used up its range or one cylinder causes an imbalance. P029A means the correction for cylinder 1 is at its upper limit: the module keeps giving this cylinder more fuel and still cannot even it out – a sign that the cylinder receives too little fuel or builds too little pressure. GM and Ford use other codes for this (P0263 ff, P219A ff); no manufacturer document describing this code with thresholds was found, so the description follows CARB and published patents.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 1 coked or partly clogged [HIGH]
Compression loss in this cylinder (valve, rings, leak at injector or glow plug) [MEDIUM]
Injector circuit high-resistance or connector [MEDIUM]
Petrol: false air at this cylinder's intake (manifold gasket) [MEDIUM]
Injector correction code missing or wrong after replacement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

CARB requires the system to report when such a correction has used up its range or one cylinder causes an imbalance. P02B4 means the module attributes the deviation of cylinder 7 to an injector delivering too little – deposits or a sticking nozzle needle. GM and Ford use other codes for this (P0263 ff, P219A ff); no manufacturer document describing this code with thresholds was found, so the description follows CARB and published patents.
bilingual_description.de: Diese Codes gehören zu einer zylinderindividuellen Kraftstoffkorrektur: Die Zylindergleichstellung eines Diesels misst die Kurbelwellenbeschleunigung jedes Zylinders und passt seine Einspritzmenge an; bei Benzinern tut das eine zylinderselektive Gemischregelung. CARB verlangt eine Meldung, wenn eine solche Korrektur ihren Stellbereich aufgebraucht hat oder ein einzelner Zylinder eine Ungleichverteilung verursacht. P02B4 heißt, das Steuergerät ordnet die Abweichung von Zylinder 7 einem Injektor zu, der zu wenig liefert – Ablagerungen oder eine hängende Düsennadel. GM und Ford nutzen dafür andere Codes (P0263 ff, P219A ff); eine Herstellerunterlage, die diesen Code mit Schwellen beschreibt, wurde nicht gefunden, die Beschreibung folgt deshalb CARB und veröffentlichten Patenten.

symptoms: Lack of power, higher consumption or smoke

description: These codes belong to an individual-cylinder fuel correction: a diesel's cylinder balance control measures each cylinder's crankshaft acceleration and adjusts its injection quantity; on petrol engines a cylinder-selective mixture control does the same. CARB requires the system to report when such a correction has used up its range or one cylinder causes an imbalance. P02B5 means the module detects fuel entering cylinder 7 outside the injection pulse – the injector is leaking or dripping. A BMW patent identifies such a leak by the fact that it persists with the injector switched off. A leaking diesel injector can dilute the oil or damage the piston, so act promptly. GM and Ford use other codes for this (P0263 ff, P219A ff); no manufacturer document describing this code with thresholds was found, so the description follows CARB and published patents.
possible_causes: Nozzle seat or needle of the cylinder 7 injector leaking [HIGH]
Deposits keeping the needle from closing fully [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure too high [LOW]
Wrong or wrongly coded injector [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: These codes belong to an individual-cylinder fuel correction: a diesel's cylinder balance control measures each cylinder's crankshaft acceleration and adjusts its injection quantity; on petrol engines a cylinder-selective mixture control does the same. CARB requires the system to report when such a correction has used up its range or one cylinder causes an imbalance. P02B6 means the correction for cylinder 8 is at its upper limit: the module keeps giving this cylinder more fuel and still cannot even it out – a sign that the cylinder receives too little fuel or builds too little pressure. GM and Ford use other codes for this (P0263 ff, P219A ff); no manufacturer document describing this code with thresholds was found, so the description follows CARB and published patents.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 8 coked or partly clogged [HIGH]
Compression loss in this cylinder (valve, rings, leak at injector or glow plug) [MEDIUM]
Injector circuit high-resistance or connector [MEDIUM]
Petrol: false air at this cylinder's intake (manifold gasket) [MEDIUM]
Injector correction code missing or wrong after replacement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: These codes belong to an individual-cylinder fuel correction: a diesel's cylinder balance control measures each cylinder's crankshaft acceleration and adjusts its injection quantity; on petrol engines a cylinder-selective mixture control does the same. description: Turbocharger B is a second, separately controlled turbo – on twin-turbo or two-stage systems, or one per bank. description: The engine module learns a small-quantity correction for each injector: on overrun it gives one injector a tiny test injection (GM about 1.5 mm³), measures the resulting crankshaft acceleration and corrects the injector's activation time per rail pressure step. P02CC means the learned correction for cylinder 1 has reached its lower limit at at least one pressure step: the injector needs much less activation time than nominal – it delivers too much at small quantities or opens early. GM diesels set it at limits of roughly ±66–182 µs after two trips. It is documented on GM's 6.6 litre L5P and 2.8 litre diesels – on the 2.8 a worn drive belt caused it to return after injector replacement – and on Land Rover's 5.0 V8 petrol, where a software update is the first step. It differs from P01CC (over advanced), which some systems derive from the same learning.
possible_causes: Injector of cylinder 1 leaking or over-delivering at small quantities [HIGH]
Engine software (update available for some models) [MEDIUM]
Injector correction code not or wrongly programmed after replacement [MEDIUM]
Disturbed crankshaft signal (worn drive belt, tone wheel, dual-mass flywheel) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät lernt für jeden Injektor eine Kleinmengenkorrektur: Im Schub gibt es einem Injektor eine winzige Testeinspritzung (GM etwa 1,5 mm³), misst die entstehende Kurbelwellenbeschleunigung und korrigiert die Ansteuerdauer des Injektors je Raildruckstufe. P02CC heißt, die gelernte Korrektur für Zylinder 1 hat an mindestens einer Druckstufe ihre Untergrenze erreicht: Der Injektor braucht deutlich weniger Ansteuerzeit als nominal – er liefert bei Kleinmengen zu viel oder öffnet früh. GM-Diesel setzen ihn bei Grenzen von etwa ±66–182 µs nach zwei Fahrzyklen. Belegt ist er bei GMs 6,6-Liter-L5P und 2,8-Liter-Diesel – beim 2,8er kam er nach einem Injektortausch durch einen verschlissenen Antriebsriemen wieder – und bei Land Rovers 5,0-V8-Benziner, wo ein Software-Update der erste Schritt ist. Er unterscheidet sich von P01CC („zu früh“), den manche Systeme aus derselben Lernung ableiten.

P02D9 means the learned correction for cylinder 7 has reached its upper limit at at least one pressure step: the injector needs much more activation time than nominal – it delivers too little or opens late, for example from coking. GM diesels set it at limits of roughly ±66–182 µs after two trips. Older GM calibrations (LML) use only this code of the pair, for both directions. It is documented on GM's 6.6 litre L5P diesel and on Land Rover's 5.0 V8 petrol, where a software update is the first step. It differs from P01D7 (over retarded), which some systems derive from the same learning.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät lernt für jeden Injektor eine Kleinmengenkorrektur: Im Schub gibt es einem Injektor eine winzige Testeinspritzung (GM etwa 1,5 mm³), misst die entstehende Kurbelwellenbeschleunigung und korrigiert die Ansteuerdauer des Injektors je Raildruckstufe. P02D9 heißt, die gelernte Korrektur für Zylinder 7 hat an mindestens einer Druckstufe ihre Obergrenze erreicht: Der Injektor braucht deutlich mehr Ansteuerzeit als nominal – er liefert zu wenig oder öffnet spät, etwa durch Verkokung. GM-Diesel setzen ihn bei Grenzen von etwa ±66–182 µs nach zwei Fahrzyklen. Ältere GM-Kalibrierungen (LML) nutzen von dem Paar nur diesen Code, für beide Richtungen. Belegt ist er bei GMs 6,6-Liter-L5P-Diesel und bei Land Rovers 5,0-V8-Benziner, wo ein Software-Update der erste Schritt ist. Er unterscheidet sich von P01D7 („zu spät“), den manche Systeme aus derselben Lernung ableiten.

description: The diesel intake air flow valve A is the throttle flap ahead of the intake manifold of a diesel engine: it creates the vacuum needed for high EGR rates, lowers airflow to heat the particulate filter and catalyst during regeneration and closes at switch-off against run-on shaking. A spring holds it open when unpowered; an electric motor positions it, with a position sensor reporting back. P02E0 means the motor circuit is open – cable, connector or motor winding. GM diesels detect more than 200 kΩ with the driver off, after about 1.5 s (6.6 litre LML: 7 s), two trips. On a fault the valve is switched off and the spring opens it: driving is usually little affected, but EGR control is restricted and filter regeneration may be blocked.
possible_causes: Connector at the throttle corroded or loose [HIGH]
Broken motor wire [MEDIUM]
Motor winding of the valve open [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Control Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The diesel intake air flow valve A is the throttle flap ahead of the intake manifold of a diesel engine: it creates the vacuum needed for high EGR rates, lowers airflow to heat the particulate filter and catalyst during regeneration and closes at switch-off against run-on shaking. A spring holds it open when unpowered; an electric motor positions it, with a position sensor reporting back. P02E0 means the motor circuit is open – cable, connector or motor winding. GM diesels detect more than 200 kΩ with the driver off, after about 1.5 s (6.6 litre LML: 7 s), two trips. On a fault the valve is switched off and the spring opens it: driving is usually little affected, but EGR control is restricted and filter regeneration may be blocked.
bilingual_description.de: Das Diesel-Ansaugluftventil A ist die Drosselklappe vor dem Saugrohr eines Dieselmotors: Es erzeugt den Unterdruck für hohe AGR-Raten, senkt die Luftmasse, um Partikelfilter und Katalysator bei der Regeneration zu heizen, und schließt beim Abstellen gegen Nachschütteln. Stromlos hält es eine Feder offen; ein Elektromotor stellt es, ein Positionssensor meldet die Stellung zurück. P02E0 heißt, der Motorstromkreis ist unterbrochen – Kabel, Stecker oder Motorwicklung. GM-Diesel erkennen mehr als 200 kΩ bei abgeschaltetem Treiber, nach etwa 1,5 s (6,6-Liter-LML: 7 s), zwei Fahrzyklen. Bei einem Fehler wird das Ventil abgeschaltet und die Feder öffnet es: Das Fahren ist meist kaum betroffen, aber die AGR-Regelung ist eingeschränkt und die Filterregeneration kann gesperrt sein.

symptoms: Filter regeneration does not run, soot load rises

description: The diesel intake air flow valve A is the throttle flap ahead of the intake manifold of a diesel engine: it creates the vacuum needed for high EGR rates, lowers airflow to heat the particulate filter and catalyst during regeneration and closes at switch-off against run-on shaking. Typical causes are an EGR valve stuck open, a clogged air filter, a sooted throttle or a dirty mass airflow sensor. The engine lacks air: loss of power, smoke and high soot load. Other manufacturers using this code were not found.
possible_causes: EGR valve stuck open [HIGH]
Air filter or intake clogged [MEDIUM]
Intake throttle stuck closed or coked [MEDIUM]
Mass airflow sensor reading too low (dirty) [MEDIUM]
Underboost or turbo fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Fords 6,7- und 3,0-Liter-Diesel regeln die Luftmasse über AGR-Ventil und Ansaugdrossel. P02ED heißt, die gemessene Luftmasse bleibt bei Regelung am Anschlag unter dem Soll – zu viel AGR, eine geschlossen klemmende Drossel oder ein verstopfter Ansaugweg –, über 10 s (6,7) bzw. 5 s (3,0). Typische Ursachen sind ein offen klemmendes AGR-Ventil, ein verstopfter Luftfilter, eine verrußte Drossel oder ein verschmutzter Luftmassenmesser. Dem Motor fehlt Luft: Leistungsverlust, Rauch und hohe Rußbeladung. Andere Hersteller mit diesem Code wurden nicht gefunden.

symptoms: Smoke, high soot load in the filter

description: P02EE reports an electrically implausible response of the cylinder 1 injector – not an open or short circuit (those are P0201, P0261, P0262), but a current or voltage pattern outside the expected range. GM's 8-cylinder diesel checks the time the current takes to fall from hold to zero (outside 20–50 µs in 10 of 20 samples, two trips); GM's petrol direct injection evaluates the voltage feedback of the opening and closing; Ford's diesels flag the injector's voltage or charge regulator at its limit (90 s), Ford's petrol direct injection its controlled-valve-operation adaptation at its limit. The injector may be shut off, causing misfire.
possible_causes: Injector electrically aged (piezo capacitance, coil resistance) [HIGH]
Contact resistance in the injector 1 connector or wiring [MEDIUM]
Injector mechanically sticking (valve lift) [MEDIUM]
Injector driver stage in the engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

The injector may be shut off, causing misfire.
possible_causes: Injector electrically aged (piezo capacitance, coil resistance) [HIGH]
Contact resistance in the injector 12 connector or wiring [MEDIUM]
Injector mechanically sticking (valve lift) [MEDIUM]
Injector driver stage in the engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The diesel intake throttle learns the position sensor values of its end stops, as a Toyota patent describes for the closed stop at engine stop. P02FA means a learned end-stop value is implausible. Ford's 6.7 and 3.0 diesels check it once after each learning run and set the code when the learned minimum offset is outside ±10 (6.7) or ±6.7 (3.0) – Ford only evaluates the minimum stop. Typical causes are soot and oil deposits at the flap and stop, a worn or shifted sensor, mechanical damage or a replacement part that has not been learned. EGR control may be restricted.
possible_causes: Soot and oil deposits at flap and stop (EGR, crankcase ventilation) [HIGH]
Position sensor in the throttle unit worn or shifted [MEDIUM]
Flap or shaft bent, stop worn, gear worn [MEDIUM]
Wrong or not learned replacement part [LOW]
Engine software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: Cold start fuel injection is an extra injection system for cold starts – for example on flex-fuel engines running on high ethanol blends, where a Hyundai patent describes a small auxiliary tank, a cold-start injector and a heater. CARB lists such heated fuel preparation systems among the monitored output components. P02FB means the control circuit of the cold-start injection is open or has a general fault – a broken coil, a loose or corroded connector or a broken wire. The engine then starts poorly or not at all in the cold; once warm it runs normally. No manufacturer document using this code was found; unlike the older P0213/P0214, these codes separate the fault types.
possible_causes: Coil of the cold-start injector or valve open [HIGH]
Connector loose, corroded or pin pushed back [MEDIUM]
Broken wire in the harness [MEDIUM]
Fuse or relay of the cold-start system [LOW]
Driver stage in the engine module [LOW]

description: Many diagnostics need to know how long the engine – or, on hybrids, the whole propulsion system – has been off: thermostat and evaporative checks and the cold-start strategy, for which CARB requires at least 6 hours of standstill. A timer measures this time, and the engine module checks its plausibility, for example against coolant cooling – a GM patent describes such a check. P02FF means that timer is implausible. Mercedes documents it on M256, M260, M264 and M274 engines of around 2020: after an internal reset the instrument cluster clock ran wrong; the fix is a software update for engine, transmission and instrument cluster modules. Readiness of standstill-dependent monitors may stay incomplete.
possible_causes: Time source in another module (instrument cluster, body module) gives an implausible time after a reset or voltage loss [HIGH]
Software level of engine, transmission or instrument cluster module [HIGH]
Battery discharged or disconnected, voltage dips [MEDIUM]
Instrument cluster or timer in the engine module faulty [LOW]
Coolant temperature sensor distorting the cooling check [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 900€ (0.3h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The engine module detects misfire from crankshaft speed: a cylinder that does not fire gives no acceleration impulse. At a catalyst-damaging rate (CARB: at least 5 % per 200 revolutions) the warning light flashes; at an emissions-relevant rate (at least 1 % per 1,000 revolutions – GM about 2–5 %, Ford 0.9–1.5 %) it comes on after two trips. Ford and GM may shut off a misfiring cylinder's injector to protect the catalyst. P0300 sets when the misfire cannot be assigned to one cylinder: several cylinders each account for more than 10 %, the cylinder changes randomly, or – at Ford – the cylinder cannot be identified at high speed. It often appears together with cylinder codes. Causes are usually systemic: false air, worn plugs on several cylinders, fuel pressure or fuel quality, valve timing – and false detection from a damaged tone wheel, rough roads or vibration. Bulletins name coils, cracked plug insulators and wrong plug gaps.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Worn out spark plugs, ignition wires, coil(s), distributor cap and rotor (when applicable), Incorrect ignition timing, Vacuum leak(s), Low or weak fuel pressure, Improperly functioning EGR system, Defective Mass Air Flow Sensor, Defective Crankshaft and or Camshaft Sensor, Defective Throttle Position Sensor, Mechanical engine problems (i.e.—low compression, leaking head gasket(s), or valve problems)

possible_causes: False air (vacuum leak, crankcase ventilation, intake gasket) [HIGH]
Worn or wrong spark plugs on several cylinders, faulty ignition coils [HIGH]
Fuel pressure too low or high, contaminated fuel [MEDIUM]
Valve timing (stretched chain), valves, compression on several cylinders [LOW]
False detection: tone wheel or pulley, rough road, vibration, software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 6h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Bei einer katalysatorschädigenden Rate (CARB: mindestens 5 % je 200 Umdrehungen) blinkt die Warnleuchte; bei einer emissionsrelevanten Rate (mindestens 1 % je 1.000 Umdrehungen – GM etwa 2–5 %, Ford 0,9–1,5 %) geht sie nach zwei Fahrzyklen an. P0300 wird gesetzt, wenn sich die Aussetzer keinem Zylinder zuordnen lassen: Mehrere Zylinder haben je mehr als 10 % Anteil, der Zylinder wechselt zufällig, oder – bei Ford – der Zylinder ist bei hoher Drehzahl nicht bestimmbar. Bulletins nennen Zündspulen, gerissene Kerzenisolatoren und falsche Elektrodenabstände.

description: The engine module detects misfire from crankshaft speed: a cylinder that does not fire gives no acceleration impulse. description: Ignition A is one of the control signal lines from the engine module to an ignition module, ignition output stage or group of coils; which cylinders it serves is defined by the manufacturer, not by the code standard. The code concerns the logic-level control signal, not the coil's primary current (that has its own codes, P0351 ff and P2300 ff). P030A means the control line is open – the module sees a voltage with its driver off that indicates high resistance. No manufacturer using these codes was found; GM reports coil control faults as P0351 ff (open above 30 kΩ, first trip), so the description follows CARB and that analogy. The affected coils fire wrongly or not at all, causing misfire; many modules then shut off injection to those cylinders to protect the catalyst.
possible_causes: Control line or connector pin open (corrosion, pushed-back pin) [HIGH]
Ignition module or coil with integrated driver of this group faulty [MEDIUM]
Supply or ground of the ignition module faulty [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Zündung A ist eine der Steuersignalleitungen vom Motorsteuergerät zu einem Zündmodul, einer Zündendstufe oder einer Spulengruppe; welche Zylinder sie bedient, legt der Hersteller fest, nicht die Code-Norm. Der Code betrifft das Steuersignal, nicht den Primärstrom der Spule (dafür gibt es eigene Codes, P0351 ff und P2300 ff). P030A heißt, die Steuerleitung ist unterbrochen – das Steuergerät sieht bei abgeschaltetem Treiber eine Spannung, die auf hohen Widerstand hindeutet. Ein Hersteller, der diese Codes nutzt, wurde nicht gefunden; GM meldet Fehler der Spulenansteuerung als P0351 ff (Unterbrechung über 30 kΩ, erster Fahrzyklus), die Beschreibung folgt deshalb CARB und dieser Analogie. Die betroffenen Spulen zünden falsch oder gar nicht, was Aussetzer verursacht; viele Steuergeräte schalten dann die Einspritzung dieser Zylinder zum Schutz des Katalysators ab.

No manufacturer using these codes was found; GM reports coil control faults as P0351 ff (open above 30 kΩ, first trip), so the description follows CARB and that analogy. The affected coils fire wrongly or not at all, causing misfire; many modules then shut off injection to those cylinders to protect the catalyst.
bilingual_description.de: Zündung A ist eine der Steuersignalleitungen vom Motorsteuergerät zu einem Zündmodul, einer Zündendstufe oder einer Spulengruppe; welche Zylinder sie bedient, legt der Hersteller fest, nicht die Code-Norm. Der Code betrifft das Steuersignal, nicht den Primärstrom der Spule (dafür gibt es eigene Codes, P0351 ff und P2300 ff). P030B heißt, die Steuerleitung ist zu niedrig – typisch ein Masseschluss. Ein Hersteller, der diese Codes nutzt, wurde nicht gefunden; GM meldet Fehler der Spulenansteuerung als P0351 ff (Unterbrechung über 30 kΩ, erster Fahrzyklus), die Beschreibung folgt deshalb CARB und dieser Analogie. Die betroffenen Spulen zünden falsch oder gar nicht, was Aussetzer verursacht; viele Steuergeräte schalten dann die Einspritzung dieser Zylinder zum Schutz des Katalysators ab.

symptoms: Loss of power, possibly cylinders shut off

description: The engine module detects misfire from crankshaft speed: a cylinder that does not fire gives no acceleration impulse. At a catalyst-damaging rate (CARB: at least 5 % per 200 revolutions) the warning light flashes; at an emissions-relevant rate (at least 1 % per 1,000 revolutions – GM about 2–5 %, Ford 0.9–1.5 %) it comes on after two trips. Ford and GM may shut off a misfiring cylinder's injector to protect the catalyst. P0310 means more than 90 % of the detected misfires fall on cylinder 10. Usual causes are the ignition coil or spark plug of that cylinder, its injector, or low compression; a quick test is to swap coil or plug with a neighbouring cylinder and see whether the misfire moves. Cylinder 10 exists on ten-cylinder engines such as Ford's 6.8 litre V10; there an under-torqued crankshaft pulley bolt and engine software caused false misfire codes on all cylinders.
possible_causes: Ignition coil of cylinder 10 faulty (coil, connector, ground) [HIGH]
Spark plug of cylinder 10 worn, sooted, cracked or wrongly gapped [HIGH]
Injector of cylinder 10 clogged or leaking, or its control [MEDIUM]
Low compression on cylinder 10 (valve, rings, head gasket) or local false air [LOW]
Water or oil in the plug well [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 800€ (0.3h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: When the tank is nearly empty the fuel pump can draw air in corners or on gradients, which causes misfires. CARB allows misfire detection to be switched off at 15 % fuel or less; some manufacturers instead report misfires detected in this state under P0313 rather than P030x. Ford's normal misfire monitor runs from 15 % fuel, Saab's ME9 from 12 %; Saab's T8 sets P0313 below 5 litres with the same tests as P0300 (3 % per 1,000 revolutions, flashing light at a catalyst-damaging rate). GM petrol engines simply suspend the monitor without their own code. After refuelling the symptoms usually disappear – if not, look for a real misfire cause.
possible_causes: Tank nearly empty – the fuel pump draws air (corners, gradients, braking) [HIGH]
Actual misfire cause (ignition, injector, false air) that happened at low fuel [MEDIUM]
Weak fuel pump, clogged strainer or filter, faulty swirl pot [MEDIUM]
Fuel level sender reading too low [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 600€ (0.1h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Bei fast leerem Tank kann die Kraftstoffpumpe in Kurven oder an Steigungen Luft ansaugen, was Aussetzer verursacht. CARB erlaubt, die Aussetzererkennung bei 15 % Tankinhalt oder weniger abzuschalten; manche Hersteller melden in diesem Zustand erkannte Aussetzer stattdessen als P0313 statt P030x. Fords normale Aussetzerüberwachung läuft ab 15 % Tankinhalt, Saabs ME9 ab 12 %; Saabs T8 setzt P0313 unter 5 Litern mit denselben Prüfungen wie P0300 (3 % je 1.000 Umdrehungen, blinkende Leuchte bei katalysatorschädigender Rate). GM-Benziner setzen die Überwachung einfach ohne eigenen Code aus. Nach dem Tanken verschwinden die Symptome meist – sonst nach einer echten Aussetzerursache suchen.

symptoms: Check engine light on (flashing at a catalyst-damaging rate)
Jerking or power loss with an almost empty tank, especially in corners or uphill

description: P0314 means the misfire is attributable to a single cylinder, but the module does not say which one. CARB generally requires cylinder-specific codes and allows a general code only with approval where the cylinder cannot be identified reliably; for diesels identification is required only where possible without extra hardware. GM and Ford do not use P0314. It is documented on Saab's 2.2 TiD diesel with a Bosch distributor pump, as a mechanical misfire fault in two speed and quantity windows with the warning light and limp mode limiting injection quantity; the cylinder can still be read out with a scan tool. Typical causes are a faulty injector, leaking high-pressure lines, air or water in the fuel, or low compression.
possible_causes: Injector of one cylinder clogged or leaking (diesel), or coil/plug (petrol) [HIGH]
Leaking high-pressure line, fuel bridge or injector washer [MEDIUM]
Air, water or petrol in the diesel, clogged filter, low supply pressure [MEDIUM]
Compression loss (valve, piston) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Single Cylinder Misfire (Cylinder Not Specified)

bilingual_description.en: P0314 means the misfire is attributable to a single cylinder, but the module does not say which one. CARB generally requires cylinder-specific codes and allows a general code only with approval where the cylinder cannot be identified reliably; for diesels identification is required only where possible without extra hardware. GM and Ford do not use P0314. It is documented on Saab's 2.2 TiD diesel with a Bosch distributor pump, as a mechanical misfire fault in two speed and quantity windows with the warning light and limp mode limiting injection quantity; the cylinder can still be read out with a scan tool. Typical causes are a faulty injector, leaking high-pressure lines, air or water in the fuel, or low compression.
bilingual_description.de: P0314 heißt, die Aussetzer lassen sich einem einzelnen Zylinder zuordnen, aber das Steuergerät sagt nicht, welchem. CARB verlangt grundsätzlich zylinderspezifische Codes und erlaubt einen allgemeinen Code nur mit Genehmigung, wenn der Zylinder nicht sicher bestimmbar ist; bei Dieseln ist die Zuordnung nur Pflicht, soweit sie ohne Zusatzhardware möglich ist. GM und Ford nutzen P0314 nicht. Belegt ist er beim 2,2-TiD-Diesel von Saab mit Bosch-Verteilerpumpe, als mechanischer Aussetzerfehler in zwei Drehzahl- und Mengenfenstern mit Warnleuchte und Notlauf mit Mengenbegrenzung; der Zylinder lässt sich trotzdem mit dem Tester auslesen. Typische Ursachen sind ein defekter Injektor, undichte Hochdruckleitungen, Luft oder Wasser im Kraftstoff oder geringe Kompression.

symptoms: Loss of power, limp mode with quantity limit (Saab diesel)

description: Manufacturing tolerances of the crankshaft tone wheel distort the speed fluctuations misfire detection relies on, so the engine module learns a correction for each tooth or segment. P0315 means these values have not been learned or are invalid. GM checks that the learned tooth angles add up to 360° (deviation above 0.001° sets the code in the first trip) and learns them with a scan tool: brakes held, full throttle in park until fuel cut-off. bilingual_description.en: Manufacturing tolerances of the crankshaft tone wheel distort the speed fluctuations misfire detection relies on, so the engine module learns a correction for each tooth or segment. P0315 means these values have not been learned or are invalid. GM checks that the learned tooth angles add up to 360° (deviation above 0.001° sets the code in the first trip) and learns them with a scan tool: brakes held, full throttle in park until fuel cut-off. Ford learns the profile during up to three overrun phases from 60 to 40 mph and sets P0315 when that fails. Until relearned, misfire detection is suspended – at GM above 1,000 rpm – and misfire readiness stays incomplete. The relearn is needed after replacing the engine, engine module, crankshaft, damper or crankshaft sensor.
bilingual_description.de: Fertigungstoleranzen des Kurbelwellen-Geberrads verfälschen die Drehzahlschwankungen, auf die sich die Aussetzererkennung stützt, deshalb lernt das Motorsteuergerät eine Korrektur je Zahn oder Segment. P0315 heißt, diese Werte sind nicht gelernt oder ungültig. GM prüft, ob die gelernten Zahnwinkel zusammen 360° ergeben (eine Abweichung über 0,001° setzt den Code im ersten Fahrzyklus), und lernt sie mit dem Tester: Bremse halten, in P Vollgas bis zur Schubabschaltung. Neu gelernt werden muss nach Tausch von Motor, Motorsteuergerät, Kurbelwelle, Schwingungsdämpfer oder Kurbelwellensensor.

description: P0316 concerns misfire within the first 1,000 revolutions after start. CARB requires a pending code here after the first exceedance of the emissions-relevant rate (later in the drive only after the fourth) and the warning light if it recurs at the next start. Ford sets P0316 in addition to the cylinder code; GM evaluates the start within P0300–P0308 without its own code. Typical causes are water in the plug wells (Mazda Tribute bulletin: blocked drain in the valve cover channel), coils that arc when cold and damp, injectors that drip after switch-off and over-rich starting – Ford traced cases on the 2.7 EcoBoost to engine software or leaking direct injectors.
possible_causes: Moisture or water in the plug wells, coils arcing when cold or damp [HIGH]
Leaking injectors (fuel drips after switch-off, over-rich start) [MEDIUM]
Worn or sooted spark plugs that only fire cleanly when warm [MEDIUM]
Wrong temperature sensor value or engine software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 1200€ (0.3h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

CARB verlangt hier schon nach der ersten Überschreitung der emissionsrelevanten Rate einen vorläufigen Code (später in der Fahrt erst nach der vierten) und die Warnleuchte, wenn es sich beim nächsten Start wiederholt. symptoms: Rough running right after a cold start, then normal

description: Misfire detection works from crankshaft speed fluctuations, which rough roads also cause. CARB therefore allows misfire detection to pause on rough roads; many engines take a rough-road signal from the wheel speeds of the ABS module, a Ford patent describes such a detector. P0317 means the engine module is calibrated for an external rough-road signal but does not find the hardware: the supplying module does not respond on the data bus, or the configuration does not match the equipment – for example after replacing the engine or ABS module. Without the signal misfire detection cannot separate road bumps from misfires. No manufacturer document using P0317 was found; the description follows CARB and GM's rough-road sources in its misfire monitor.
possible_causes: Module configuration does not match the equipment (after engine or ABS module replacement) [HIGH]
ABS/ESP module not responding (supply, CAN line) [MEDIUM]
Separate rough-road sensor missing or unplugged, where fitted [LOW]
Engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Possibly false misfire codes on rough roads

description: Misfire detection works from crankshaft speed fluctuations, which rough roads also cause. CARB therefore allows misfire detection to pause on rough roads; many engines take a rough-road signal from the wheel speeds of the ABS module, a Ford patent describes such a detector. P0318 means rough-road signal A is missing or invalid. On GM engines (documented in Saab service information for the 1.6 turbo) the brake control module sends wheel speed over the data bus; the code sets between 1,520 and 4,000 rpm when that module reports a wheel speed sensor fault or no signal arrives for more than 5 s. GM files it without the warning light. Misfire detection then runs without its rough-road filter. ABS or stability warnings and further codes often appear at the same time.

Communication between engine and brake module lost (CAN, connector, supply) [MEDIUM]
Brake control module faulty [LOW]
Separate rough-road sensor faulty, where fitted [LOW]

description: Ignition C is one of the control signal lines from the engine module to an ignition module, ignition output stage or group of coils; which cylinders it serves is defined by the manufacturer, not by the code standard. The code concerns the logic-level control signal, not the coil's primary current (that has its own codes, P0351 ff and P2300 ff). P031A means the control line is open – the module sees a voltage with its driver off that indicates high resistance. No manufacturer using these codes was found; GM reports coil control faults as P0351 ff (open above 30 kΩ, first trip), so the description follows CARB and that analogy. The affected coils fire wrongly or not at all, causing misfire; many modules then shut off injection to those cylinders to protect the catalyst.
possible_causes: Control line or connector pin open (corrosion, pushed-back pin) [HIGH]
Ignition module or coil with integrated driver of this group faulty [MEDIUM]
Supply or ground of the ignition module faulty [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Der Code betrifft das Steuersignal, nicht den Primärstrom der Spule (dafür gibt es eigene Codes, P0351 ff und P2300 ff). Die betroffenen Spulen zünden falsch oder gar nicht, was Aussetzer verursacht; viele Steuergeräte schalten dann die Einspritzung dieser Zylinder zum Schutz des Katalysators ab.

bilingual_description.en: Ignition D is one of the control signal lines from the engine module to an ignition module, ignition output stage or group of coils; which cylinders it serves is defined by the manufacturer, not by the code standard. The code concerns the logic-level control signal, not the coil's primary current (that has its own codes, P0351 ff and P2300 ff). P031F means the control line reads high – typically shorted to voltage. No manufacturer using these codes was found; GM reports coil control faults as P0351 ff (open above 30 kΩ, first trip), so the description follows CARB and that analogy. The affected coils fire wrongly or not at all, causing misfire; many modules then shut off injection to those cylinders to protect the catalyst.
bilingual_description.de: Zündung D ist eine der Steuersignalleitungen vom Motorsteuergerät zu einem Zündmodul, einer Zündendstufe oder einer Spulengruppe; welche Zylinder sie bedient, legt der Hersteller fest, nicht die Code-Norm. Der Code betrifft das Steuersignal, nicht den Primärstrom der Spule (dafür gibt es eigene Codes, P0351 ff und P2300 ff). P031F heißt, die Steuerleitung ist zu hoch – typisch ein Schluss gegen Spannung. Ein Hersteller, der diese Codes nutzt, wurde nicht gefunden; GM meldet Fehler der Spulenansteuerung als P0351 ff (Unterbrechung über 30 kΩ, erster Fahrzyklus), die Beschreibung folgt deshalb CARB und dieser Analogie. Die betroffenen Spulen zünden falsch oder gar nicht, was Aussetzer verursacht; viele Steuergeräte schalten dann die Einspritzung dieser Zylinder zum Schutz des Katalysators ab.

symptoms: Loss of power, possibly cylinders shut off

description: P0320 originally covered the engine speed signal from the distributor or ignition module to the engine module (early OBD II); today Ford's engine module evaluates the crankshaft sensor directly and uses this code for it. Ford checks continuously from 200–500 rpm and sets it within 5 s when the number of teeth after the gap is wrong, the tooth time is implausible (below 30 or above 9,000 rpm) or the gap appears in the wrong place; fuel and spark are then cut briefly to resynchronise, and on electronic throttle P2106 limits power. Some Ford engines use P0339 instead. Typical causes are a faulty crankshaft sensor, interference in the wiring or a damaged tone wheel.
possible_causes: Crankshaft or distributor speed sensor faulty or wrong air gap [HIGH]
Wiring, connector or shielding disturbed (loose contact, interference from ignition or radios) [HIGH]
Tone wheel damaged or dirty (missing tooth, metal chips) [MEDIUM]
Ignition module faulty on older vehicles [MEDIUM]
Engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition/Distributor Engine Speed Input Circuit

bilingual_description.en: P0320 originally covered the engine speed signal from the distributor or ignition module to the engine module (early OBD II); today Ford's engine module evaluates the crankshaft sensor directly and uses this code for it. Ford checks continuously from 200–500 rpm and sets it within 5 s when the number of teeth after the gap is wrong, the tooth time is implausible (below 30 or above 9,000 rpm) or the gap appears in the wrong place; fuel and spark are then cut briefly to resynchronise, and on electronic throttle P2106 limits power. Some Ford engines use P0339 instead. Typical causes are a faulty crankshaft sensor, interference in the wiring or a damaged tone wheel.
bilingual_description.de: P0320 betraf ursprünglich das Drehzahlsignal vom Zündverteiler oder Zündmodul zum Motorsteuergerät (frühes OBD II); heute wertet Fords Motorsteuergerät den Kurbelwellensensor direkt aus und nutzt den Code dafür. Ford prüft ständig ab 200–500/min und setzt ihn binnen 5 s, wenn die Zähnezahl nach der Lücke nicht stimmt, die Zahnzeit unplausibel ist (unter 30 oder über 9.000/min) oder die Lücke an der falschen Stelle erscheint; Kraftstoff und Zündung werden dann zum Neusynchronisieren kurz abgeschaltet, und bei E-Gas begrenzt P2106 die Leistung. Manche Ford-Motoren nutzen stattdessen P0339. Typische Ursachen sind ein defekter Kurbelwellensensor, Störungen in der Leitung oder ein beschädigtes Geberrad.

symptoms: Reduced power on electronic throttle (Ford P2106)

description: P0321 belongs to the same signal as P0320 and P0322: the speed and reference input of the ignition, formerly the distributor's Hall pickup, today practically always the crankshaft position sensor. Range/Performance means a signal is present but implausible – wrong number of teeth between the reference gaps, erratic tooth times, or a speed that does not fit the camshaft signal. No manufacturer document available to us describes P0321 by code: Ford runs these tooth checks under P0320 or P0339 (wrong tooth count after the gap, tooth time outside 30 to 9,000 rpm, gap at the wrong position) and GM under P0336. The description therefore follows that logic and CARB's rationality requirement for crank angle sensors.
possible_causes: Crankshaft position sensor faulty or aged (weak, noisy signal) [HIGH]
Sensor loose or air gap wrong [MEDIUM]
Tone wheel damaged or clogged with metal chips [MEDIUM]
Interference, poor ground or damaged wiring [MEDIUM]
Engine module or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition/Distributor Engine Speed Input Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: P0321 belongs to the same signal as P0320 and P0322: the speed and reference input of the ignition, formerly the distributor's Hall pickup, today practically always the crankshaft position sensor. Range/Performance means a signal is present but implausible – wrong number of teeth between the reference gaps, erratic tooth times, or a speed that does not fit the camshaft signal. No manufacturer document available to us describes P0321 by code: Ford runs these tooth checks under P0320 or P0339 (wrong tooth count after the gap, tooth time outside 30 to 9,000 rpm, gap at the wrong position) and GM under P0336. The description therefore follows that logic and CARB's rationality requirement for crank angle sensors.
bilingual_description.de: P0321 gehört zum selben Signal wie P0320 und P0322: dem Drehzahl- und Bezugseingang der Zündung, früher der Hallgeber im Verteiler, heute praktisch immer der Kurbelwellengeber. Bereich/Leistung heißt: Ein Signal ist da, aber unplausibel – falsche Zähnezahl zwischen den Bezugslücken, sprunghafte Zahnzeiten oder eine Drehzahl, die nicht zum Nockenwellensignal passt. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage beschreibt P0321 codegenau: Ford führt diese Zahnprüfungen unter P0320 oder P0339 (falsche Zähnezahl nach der Lücke, Zahnzeit außerhalb 30 bis 9.000/min, Lücke an falscher Stelle), GM unter P0336. Die Beschreibung folgt deshalb dieser Logik und der CARB-Pflicht zur Plausibilitätsprüfung von Kurbelwinkelgebern.

description: P0322 means the speed and reference input of the ignition – today the crankshaft position sensor – delivers no signal although the engine is turning. Ford proves the rotation with the camshaft sensor: if it shows more than one engine revolution without a crank signal (from 500 rpm, detected within 5 s), Ford sets P0322 or, depending on the engine, P0335; with electronic throttle the throttle software adds P2106 and goes into limp mode. Without a crank signal there is no ignition or injection, so the engine stalls or does not start. Saab's Motronic 2.8.1 (900 V6) sets P0322 when the engine fails to start; its inductive sensor should measure 500–600 Ω and give 2–5 V AC while cranking. Systems without a camshaft-based check may store no code at all on a total failure.
possible_causes: Crankshaft position sensor failed (often heat-related) [HIGH]
Open or short in signal, ground or 5 V supply, corroded connector [HIGH]
Sensor loose, air gap too large or tone wheel damaged [MEDIUM]
5 V reference pulled down by another sensor on the same supply [LOW]
Engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 400€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.en: P0322 means the speed and reference input of the ignition – today the crankshaft position sensor – delivers no signal although the engine is turning. Ford proves the rotation with the camshaft sensor: if it shows more than one engine revolution without a crank signal (from 500 rpm, detected within 5 s), Ford sets P0322 or, depending on the engine, P0335; with electronic throttle the throttle software adds P2106 and goes into limp mode. Without a crank signal there is no ignition or injection, so the engine stalls or does not start. Saab's Motronic 2.8.1 (900 V6) sets P0322 when the engine fails to start; its inductive sensor should measure 500–600 Ω and give 2–5 V AC while cranking. Systems without a camshaft-based check may store no code at all on a total failure.
bilingual_description.de: P0322 heißt: Der Drehzahl- und Bezugseingang der Zündung – heute der Kurbelwellengeber – liefert kein Signal, obwohl der Motor dreht. Ford weist die Drehung über den Nockenwellengeber nach: Zeigt er mehr als eine Motorumdrehung ohne Kurbelsignal (ab 500/min, erkannt binnen 5 s), setzt Ford P0322 bzw. je nach Motor P0335; mit elektronischer Drosselklappe setzt deren Software zusätzlich P2106 und geht in den Notlauf. Ohne Kurbelsignal gibt es weder Zündung noch Einspritzung, der Motor geht aus oder springt nicht an. Saabs Motronic 2.8.1 (900 V6) setzt P0322, wenn der Motor nicht anspringt; ihr Induktivgeber soll 500–600 Ω haben und beim Anlassen 2–5 V Wechselspannung liefern. Systeme ohne Nockenwellen-Gegenprüfung speichern bei Totalausfall womöglich gar keinen Code.

symptoms: Engine cranks but does not start
Check engine light on, with electronic throttle limp mode (P2106)

description: P0323 stands for a speed and reference signal at the ignition input – today the crankshaft position sensor – that drops out or is disturbed for moments and then recovers. None of the manufacturer documents available to us (GM 2014–2019, Ford 2012 and 2020–2023, Saab workshop information) uses P0323; the sporadic crank sensor check runs under P0339 at Ford and under P0336 at GM. Ford's logic shows what is evaluated: teeth missing or extra for a moment and the reference gap appearing at an unexpected position, after which the module briefly cuts fuel and spark and resynchronises. Typical causes are a loose contact, chafed wiring and electrical interference. The code itself is described only by its J2012 name and CARB's monitoring requirement for crank angle sensors.
possible_causes: Loose contact or corrosion at the sensor connector [HIGH]
Chafed wiring, break under vibration [MEDIUM]
Sensor dropping out when hot [MEDIUM]
Interference from neighbouring wires [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 300€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition/Distributor Engine Speed Input Circuit Intermittent

bilingual_description.en: P0323 stands for a speed and reference signal at the ignition input – today the crankshaft position sensor – that drops out or is disturbed for moments and then recovers. None of the manufacturer documents available to us (GM 2014–2019, Ford 2012 and 2020–2023, Saab workshop information) uses P0323; the sporadic crank sensor check runs under P0339 at Ford and under P0336 at GM. Ford's logic shows what is evaluated: teeth missing or extra for a moment and the reference gap appearing at an unexpected position, after which the module briefly cuts fuel and spark and resynchronises. Typical causes are a loose contact, chafed wiring and electrical interference. The code itself is described only by its J2012 name and CARB's monitoring requirement for crank angle sensors.
bilingual_description.de: P0323 steht für ein Drehzahl- und Bezugssignal am Zündungseingang – heute der Kurbelwellengeber –, das zeitweise ausfällt oder gestört ist und sich wieder erholt. Keine der uns vorliegenden Herstellerunterlagen (GM 2014–2019, Ford 2012 und 2020–2023, Saab-Werkstattinformation) verwendet P0323; die sporadische Kurbelwellengeber-Prüfung läuft bei Ford unter P0339 und bei GM unter P0336. Fords Logik zeigt, was bewertet wird: kurzzeitig fehlende oder zusätzliche Zähne und eine Bezugslücke an unerwarteter Stelle, worauf das Steuergerät kurz Kraftstoff und Zündung abschaltet und neu synchronisiert. Typisch sind Wackelkontakt, durchgescheuerte Leitung und Einstreuung. Belegt ist der Code selbst nur durch seinen J2012-Namen und die CARB-Überwachungspflicht für Kurbelwinkelgeber.

symptoms: Brief stumbling or stalling, then normal again

description: P0324 concerns the knock control as a whole rather than a single sensor circuit. GM and Saab's GM-based engines set it when excessive knock persists on one cylinder – knock despite ignition retard, or mechanical noise taken for knock – for more than 8–10 s; GM's 2018 engines in the first trip, older ones after two. Older GM calibrations also flag an abnormally low or flat signal per cylinder here. Ignition is retarded. Typical causes are low-octane fuel, carbon deposits, high intake or coolant temperature, lean running, or loose parts and valve train noise. Ford does not use this code; GM reports internal processor faults separately (P06B6/P06B7).
possible_causes: Genuine knock: low-octane fuel, carbon deposits, high intake or coolant temperature, lean mixture [HIGH]
Mechanical noise taken for knock (loose parts, brackets, valve train, bearings) [MEDIUM]
Knock sensor damaged, wrongly torqued or mounted with sealant [MEDIUM]
Engine software or calibration [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: P0324 concerns the knock control as a whole rather than a single sensor circuit. GM and Saab's GM-based engines set it when excessive knock persists on one cylinder – knock despite ignition retard, or mechanical noise taken for knock – for more than 8–10 s; GM's 2018 engines in the first trip, older ones after two. Older GM calibrations also flag an abnormally low or flat signal per cylinder here. Ignition is retarded. Typical causes are low-octane fuel, carbon deposits, high intake or coolant temperature, lean running, or loose parts and valve train noise. Ford does not use this code; GM reports internal processor faults separately (P06B6/P06B7).
bilingual_description.de: P0324 betrifft die Klopfregelung als Ganzes statt eines einzelnen Sensorkreises. GM und Saabs GM-basierte Motoren setzen ihn, wenn an einem Zylinder länger als 8–10 s übermäßiges Klopfen anhält – Klopfen trotz Spätverstellung oder mechanische Geräusche, die als Klopfen gewertet werden; GMs Motoren von 2018 im ersten Fahrzyklus, ältere nach zwei. Ältere GM-Kalibrierungen melden hier auch ein auffällig schwaches oder flaches Signal je Zylinder. Die Zündung wird nach spät verstellt. Typische Ursachen sind Kraftstoff mit zu niedriger Oktanzahl, Ölkohle, hohe Ansaugluft- oder Kühlmitteltemperatur, Magerlauf oder lose Anbauteile und Ventiltriebgeräusche. Ford nutzt diesen Code nicht; GM meldet interne Prozessorfehler gesondert (P06B6/P06B7).

symptoms: Loss of power from ignition retard
Audible pinging or knocking under load

description: The knock sensor is a piezoelectric structure-borne sound sensor bolted to the engine block; the module evaluates its signal per cylinder and retards ignition when it detects knock. Sensor A is the first sensor (bank 1 or a single sensor). With a fault the module retards ignition across the board as protection – noticeable loss of power and higher consumption. P0325 means the sensor circuit is open or the signal stays below the noise threshold. GM feeds a 20 kHz test signal into the circuit and detects an open circuit when it does not cancel out, setting the code in the first trip; Ford sees any open or short as a knock signal that is too small compared with the speed- and load-dependent noise level (at least 1,500 rpm, 35 % load, warm engine). Bulletins name moisture in the sensor (VW Touareg 3.6), engine software (GM Malibu 1.5) and chafed wiring (FCA).
possible_causes: Wiring or connector chafed, broken or corroded (sensor often under the intake manifold) [HIGH]
Knock sensor faulty (cracked piezo, moisture, heat damage) [MEDIUM]
Sensor loose or wrongly torqued [MEDIUM]
Engine software or diagnostic calibration [LOW]
Engine module input stage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 600€ (0.5h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Bulletins name moisture in the sensor (VW Touareg 3.6), engine software (GM Malibu 1.5) and chafed wiring (FCA).
bilingual_description.de: Der Klopfsensor ist ein piezoelektrischer Körperschallaufnehmer, der am Motorblock angeschraubt ist; das Steuergerät wertet sein Signal je Zylinder aus und nimmt bei erkanntem Klopfen den Zündwinkel zurück. Sensor A ist der erste Sensor (Bank 1 bzw. Einzelsensor). Bei einem Fehler verstellt das Steuergerät die Zündung zum Schutz pauschal nach spät – spürbar weniger Leistung und mehr Verbrauch. P0325 heißt, der Sensorkreis ist unterbrochen oder das Signal bleibt unter der Rauschschwelle. GM speist ein 20-kHz-Prüfsignal in den Kreis und erkennt eine Unterbrechung, wenn es sich nicht aufhebt, mit Code im ersten Fahrzyklus; Ford wertet jede Unterbrechung oder jeden Kurzschluss als zu kleines Klopfsignal gegenüber dem drehzahl- und lastabhängigen Rauschpegel (mindestens 1.500/min, 35 % Last, warmer Motor). Bulletins nennen Feuchtigkeit im Sensor (VW Touareg 3.6), Motorsoftware (GM Malibu 1.5) und durchgescheuerte Leitungen (FCA).

symptoms: Loss of power, sluggish response from ignition retard

description: The knock sensor is a piezoelectric structure-borne sound sensor bolted to the engine block; the module evaluates its signal per cylinder and retards ignition when it detects knock. Sensor A is the first sensor (bank 1 or a single sensor). With a fault the module retards ignition across the board as protection – noticeable loss of power and higher consumption. P0326 means the circuit is electrically sound but the signal is implausible. GM sets it when the filtered background noise stays below a threshold – typically a loose sensor or one not bolted down properly – in the first trip; Saab's GM-based engines also when excessive knock persists on several cylinders or a whole bank for 8–10 s. Ford does not use this code.

Engine software or calibration (bulletins for some models) [MEDIUM]
Genuine knock on a whole bank or mechanical noise [MEDIUM]
Sensor aged or damaged (low sensitivity) [LOW]

description: The knock sensor is a piezoelectric structure-borne sound sensor bolted to the engine block; the module evaluates its signal per cylinder and retards ignition when it detects knock. Sensor A is the first sensor (bank 1 or a single sensor). With a fault the module retards ignition across the board as protection – noticeable loss of power and higher consumption. P0327 means the diagnostic DC voltage at the sensor input is too low – the signal or return wire is shorted to ground. GM biases each input through a resistor network and sets the code below 8 % of 5 V in 50 of 63 samples, in the first trip; Ford checks actively once every 250 engine cycles on modules with this circuit. Subaru introduced a more durable sensor for this fault.
possible_causes: Signal or return wire chafed to ground [HIGH]
Moisture or corrosion in connector or sensor [MEDIUM]
Sensor faulty internally (series issue on some models) [MEDIUM]
Engine module internal [LOW]

description: P032F is a plausibility code: the engine module compares the torque the combustion engine actually delivers with the expected or requested torque. On hybrids the actual torque can be measured precisely through the generator; if it stays too low for a calibrated time, the code sets. Ford uses it on the 2.5 litre Escape, Corsair and Maverick hybrids: after recall 23V-380 the software detects internal engine damage such as connecting rod bearing failure and can then shut the engine down – P032F appears together with Ford's P1061; another bulletin fixes false setting by software. Stellantis lists it on the Ram 6.7 Cummins for engine stall detection. Thresholds are not published.
