bilingual_description.de: Plug-in- und manche Vollhybride halten den Tank während der Fahrt abgedichtet, durch ein Ventil vom Aktivkohlebehälter getrennt. Drückt der Fahrer die Tanktaste, öffnet das System das Ventil, lässt den Druck in den Behälter ab und entriegelt erst dann die Tankklappe. Ein Schalter meldet, ob die Klappe offen oder zu ist, damit der Tank danach wieder abgedichtet wird. P04DC heißt, das Signal des Klappenschalters ist elektrisch gültig, aber unplausibel. Ein GM-Patent erkennt das Tanken an steigendem Füllstand im Stand bei niedrigem Tankdruck; meldete der Schalter dabei kürzer als etwa 20 s „offen“ oder zu lange „geschlossen“, ist er fehlerhaft. Ein Ford-Patent setzt einen Fehler, wenn der Füllstand gestiegen und das Fahrzeug losgefahren ist, ohne dass der Schalter je „offen“ gemeldet hat – das Ventil bleibt dann offen, und der Fahrer wird gewarnt. Ist der Klappenzustand unbekannt, lässt das System den Tank vorsorglich zum Behälter offen und setzt die Lecktests aus. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt diesen Code; die Beschreibung folgt den CARB-Regeln für Eingangsbauteile und Patenten zum Klappenschalter.

description: Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) routes part of the exhaust back into the intake to lower combustion temperature and NOx. P04DD monitors EGR A while a cold-start emission reduction strategy is active and commands EGR: if the flow does not react as intended, too little exhaust is recirculated in the warm-up phase. CARB requires separate codes for such cold-start faults, which is why P04DD exists alongside P0401. The only manufacturer reference is a FCA bulletin for a six-cylinder diesel with high- and low-pressure EGR, naming it as a consequence of a failed position sensor (P0407/P0408) – repair that first.

EGR path or cooler narrowed [MEDIUM]
Pressure, temperature or air mass sensor misreading [LOW]

description: The crankcase ventilation (PCV) system routes blow-by gas from the crankcase into the intake; CARB requires a disconnection between crankcase and intake to be detected. GM's 2.0-litre LSY has a pressure sensor in the PCV hose: with the hose connected it must see a pressure drop that grows with air flow, plus pressure pulses from the pistons. Ford reports the same sensor type as crankcase pressure sensor A (P051A ff). P04E1 is the sensor's general circuit fault, typical of digital sensors with invalid signal patterns or where low and high are not separated. Its circuit diagnosis is a precondition for the disconnection check P04DB. No manufacturer document available to us uses P04E1 itself; GM uses P04E2/P04E3, Ford P051A ff.
possible_causes: Sensor connector not latched or corroded [HIGH]
Signal, 5 V reference or ground wire open [MEDIUM]
Sensor faulty [MEDIUM]
Engine module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

symptoms: Disconnection check P04DB does not run

description: The crankcase ventilation (PCV) system routes blow-by gas from the crankcase into the intake; CARB requires a disconnection between crankcase and intake to be detected. P04E2 means the sensor signal is too low: GM's LSY sets it at 4.3 % of 5 V or less (about 0.22 V) in 1280 of 1600 samples, MIL after two trips. Connector not latched or corroded [MEDIUM]
Sensor faulty [MEDIUM]

description: Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) routes part of the exhaust back into the intake to lower combustion temperature and NOx. The code standard allows up to four EGR temperature sensors, A to D – for example before and after the cooler, or in the high- and low-pressure circuits; which is which depends on the maker. Sensor D is the fourth of them, usually an NTC whose low voltage means hot. P04E5 is its general circuit fault, conceivable on systems with high- and low-pressure EGR and two sensors per circuit. description: Turbocharged engines also purge the charcoal canister under boost, through a high-load line to the compressor inlet via a venturi; check valves keep boost out of the EVAP system, and CARB requires this path to be monitored. description: An electrically heated catalyst has a heating disc ahead of the catalyst so that it works soon after a cold start; Emitec's EMICAT runs on 12, 24 or 48 V and draws up to about 300 A. It is in series production on 48-volt mild-hybrid diesel vans since 2022. P04F2 concerns the heated catalyst of bank 1. The code monitors the supply voltage of the heater: if it lies outside its window when heating is requested, the heater cannot deliver its power and is limited or switched off, so the catalyst lights off later. A Subaru patent detects faults in the supply path when the heater is commanded. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code – Ford, for example, states that heated catalyst monitoring is not supported – so thresholds and warning-lamp logic are not documented; the description follows CARB and patents for the same part.
possible_causes: 48 V or high-voltage supply weak (battery, charge, cold, DC-DC converter) [HIGH]

description: Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) routes part of the exhaust back into the intake to lower combustion temperature and NOx. P04FA is a protective check of the electrically driven EGR valve A (DC motor on an H-bridge with position sensor): the module detects overtemperature or thermal overload of the actuator, modelled from current, actuating work and position behaviour, and limits or switches off EGR. Ford petrol engines from 2020 run it continuously with 4 s to fault above 8.25 V and 400 rpm. Pierburg documents heat damage to VW's 12 V electric EGR valves. EGR then closes, NOx rises.
possible_causes: EGR valve stiff from coking (motor working against resistance) [HIGH]
High thermal load (full load, poor valve cooling, low coolant) [MEDIUM]
Valve motor or H-bridge driver faulty (overcurrent) [MEDIUM]
Module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 700€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The crankcase ventilation hose connection sensor is a pressure sensor in the PCV line that measures pressure relative to atmosphere; it is the basis for detecting a disconnected hose (P04DB). P04FB is its plausibility check: GM's 2.0-litre LSY checks the zero point with the engine stopped (at least 10 s, coolant 70 °C or more) – a reading outside ±0.63 kPa or a frozen value sets the code in 128 of 160 samples, MIL after two trips. The disconnection check P04DB is then not possible.

Sensor port or line blocked by oil or ice (value frozen) [MEDIUM]
Contact resistance in supply, ground or signal [MEDIUM]
Residual crankcase pressure after switch-off (blocked ventilation) [LOW]

description: Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) routes part of the exhaust back into the intake to lower combustion temperature and NOx. Some EGR actuators have their own electronics (smart actuators), with position control inside the actuator and communication with the engine module by bus or PWM. P04FD means the actuator reports an internal processor or electronics fault, or its self-test failed. CARB does not require such internal faults to be reported, so the code is a voluntary detail. Volvo and Mack trucks with turbocompound document it with false triggers fixed by engine software. The actuator then goes to its default position and EGR is off.
possible_causes: Engine or actuator software (false trigger) [HIGH]
Electronics in the EGR actuator faulty (heat, moisture) [MEDIUM]
Actuator supply or ground unstable [MEDIUM]
Valve stiff, causing a control fault in the actuator [LOW]

Volvo- und Mack-Lkw mit Turbocompound belegen ihn mit Fehlauslösungen, behoben durch Motorsoftware. Der Steller geht dann in seine Ersatzstellung, die AGR ist aus.

description: An electrically heated catalyst has a heating disc ahead of the catalyst so that it works soon after a cold start; Emitec's EMICAT runs on 12, 24 or 48 V and draws up to about 300 A. It is in series production on 48-volt mild-hybrid diesel vans since 2022. P04FE concerns the heated catalyst of bank 1. The code is the function check: the circuit is electrically sound but the effect does not fit – for example the energy delivered in a time window after switch-on stays below target, which a Toyota patent evaluates as a ratio, or the catalyst temperature does not rise as modelled. Ageing of the disc raises its resistance. The pure temperature result code is P0424/P0434. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code – Ford, for example, states that heated catalyst monitoring is not supported – so thresholds and warning-lamp logic are not documented; the description follows CARB and patents for the same part.
possible_causes: Heating disc aged (resistance increased, cracks, electrode damage) [HIGH]
Supply drops under load (cold or weak 48 V battery, contact resistance) [MEDIUM]
Catalyst or exhaust temperature sensor implausible [LOW]
Software or calibration [LOW]

description: The vehicle speed signal A comes, depending on the maker, from a sensor on the gearbox, the transmission output speed, the wheel speeds via ABS/ESP or a CAN message; CARB explicitly names it as an input to be monitored. P0500 is the general code for this signal. Ford checks plausibility: the car must be moving (high load, positive torque), yet the signal stays below 1–5 mph for 5 s; Ford diesels flag a missing CAN message after 0.5 s. GM's Saturn ION of 2004 used high load with below 3 mph for 6.2 s (MIL after two trips); GM's 2018 tables use P0502/P0503 instead. Cruise control is then disabled and substitute values are used.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Defective Vehicle Speed Sensor, Defective Speedometer, Vehicle Speed Sensor wiring or connector, Communication (CAN) bus problems, Defective transmission or differential Vehicle Speed Sensor drive gear

possible_causes: ABS/ESP module or wheel speed sensor faulty (signal source) [HIGH]
Output speed sensor or vehicle speed sensor faulty or dirty (metal debris on the magnet) [HIGH]
Wire or connector open or shorted, corrosion [MEDIUM]
CAN communication fault (message missing) [MEDIUM]
Wrong tyre or axle data programmed [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The vehicle speed signal A comes, depending on the maker, from a sensor on the gearbox, the transmission output speed, the wheel speeds via ABS/ESP or a CAN message; CARB explicitly names it as an input to be monitored. description: The brake pedal switch has two contacts – A usually for the brake lights, B for cruise control and brake information – working in opposite sense, so the module expects opposite states on every brake application. P0504 means they disagree. The signal is used for cruise control cut-off, brake override with electronic throttle, the shift interlock and start-stop. Ford sets it only after more than 25 (petrol) or 40 (diesel) disagreeing brake applications, with the wrench lamp instead of the warning lamp; a NHTSA investigation covers Hyundai brake light switches.
possible_causes: Brake light switch faulty (burnt or corroded contact) [HIGH]
Switch misadjusted or retaining clip or stop pad worn [HIGH]

description: CARB requires the idle speed control to be monitored: petrol engines must flag a fault if the target idle speed is not reached within +200/−100 rpm, diesels within ±30 %. Older engines use a separate idle air control valve that bypasses the closed throttle; with electronic throttle the throttle itself controls idle and no separate valve exists. P0505 is the general fault of the idle control, used where the maker does not separate too low from too high or the control is at its limit. With an idle valve it is typically sticking or gummed (Saab T5: idle outside 700–1200 rpm); on electronic throttles a Ford investigation shows P0505 from deposits in the throttle body. Ford's 2020–23 engines disable start-stop with P0505–P0507. Warning lamp behaviour depends on the maker.

bilingual_description.de: CARB verlangt, die Leerlaufregelung zu überwachen: Benziner müssen einen Fehler melden, wenn die Soll-Leerlaufdrehzahl nicht innerhalb +200/−100 1/min erreicht wird, Diesel innerhalb ±30 %. Ältere Motoren nutzen einen eigenen Leerlaufsteller, der die geschlossene Drosselklappe umgeht; bei E-Gas regelt die Drosselklappe selbst den Leerlauf, ein eigener Steller entfällt. P0505 ist der allgemeine Fehler der Leerlaufregelung, genutzt, wenn der Hersteller nicht nach zu niedrig und zu hoch trennt oder die Regelung am Anschlag ist. Mit Leerlaufsteller klemmt oder verharzt dieser typischerweise (Saab T5: Leerlauf außerhalb 700–1200 1/min); bei E-Gas zeigt eine Ford-Untersuchung P0505 durch Ablagerungen in der Drosselklappe. Fords Motoren von 2020–23 sperren bei P0505–P0507 die Start-Stopp-Funktion. Das Verhalten der Kontrollleuchte ist herstellerabhängig.

description: CARB requires the idle speed control to be monitored: petrol engines must flag a fault if the target idle speed is not reached within +200/−100 rpm, diesels within ±30 %. Older engines use a separate idle air control valve that bypasses the closed throttle; with electronic throttle the throttle itself controls idle and no separate valve exists. P0506 means the idle speed of the warm engine at standstill stays too low despite fully used control. GM uses more than 91 rpm filtered for 10 s (MIL after two trips), Ford petrol −100 rpm plus a correction above 1 lb/min, Ford diesel −100 rpm for 5 s, Subaru −100 rpm with the correction at its limit for 10 s three times. Typical are deposits, extra load or a restricted intake or exhaust.

description: CARB requires the idle speed control to be monitored: petrol engines must flag a fault if the target idle speed is not reached within +200/−100 rpm, diesels within ±30 %. Older engines use a separate idle air control valve that bypasses the closed throttle; with electronic throttle the throttle itself controls idle and no separate valve exists. P0508 is an electrical fault in the drive circuit of a separate idle valve. Supply missing (main relay, fuse) [MEDIUM]
Connector contact at valve or module [MEDIUM]
Driver in the engine module [LOW]

description: After a cold start the engine module raises idle speed and air mass and retards the ignition so that much heat goes into the exhaust and the catalyst lights off quickly. CARB requires this cold-start strategy to be monitored with its own codes, separate from ordinary idle and ignition faults. Ford collects data during the first 15 s after a cold start (coolant and catalyst 20–100 °F) and judges after 300 s, once per trip. GM does not use P050A as its own monitor and reports cold-start system faults under its manufacturer code P1400.

False air or vacuum leak [MEDIUM]
Fault in the throttle or idle valve circuit [MEDIUM]
Extra load at cold start (alternator, A/C), stiff engine [LOW]

description: P050C is documented only on Bosch ME9 in the Saab 9-3 V6 2.8 turbo: a cold-start plausibility check of the coolant temperature sensor. After a long stop coolant and intake air must read about the same; the code sets if coolant is more than 10 °C below or 15 °C above intake air, once per trip with the warning lamp. description: GM's direct-injection petrol engines (from about 2016) split the injection into two pulses and retard the ignition after a cold start to heat the catalyst. P050D counts engine cycles with incomplete combustion via the crankshaft misfire detection during this strategy; if the rate reaches the catalyst-damaging misfire threshold, the code sets – once per trip, while the strategy is active (under 45 s running, coolant up to 66 °C). Mostly MIL after two trips, some calibrations without MIL. Ford and FCA do not use P050D.
possible_causes: Injector with poor spray pattern or deposits, or injector circuit fault [HIGH]
Spark plug or ignition coil weak [MEDIUM]
Engine module software or calibration [MEDIUM]
Poor fuel or low fuel pressure [LOW]

description: GM (from about model year 2017/18) monitors the brake booster with a vacuum sensor: with the pedal at rest and high intake vacuum the booster must hold its vacuum; a loss over time is filtered as a drift ratio, and above a threshold P050F sets, MIL after two trips. It runs with the engine on, during start-stop auto-stops and after switch-off. Without enough brake vacuum the module must throttle, restart the engine from auto-stop or request a pump – which affects idle and start-stop – and brake assistance can drop. Ford and FCA do not use P050F.

Subaru (auch im Saab 9-2X) prüft die Plausibilität: Läuft der Motor über 500 1/min und bleibt das Startsignal länger als 3 Minuten aktiv, wird ein Kurzschluss oder klemmender Schalter angenommen, Kontrollleuchte nach zwei Fahrten. Bei einem Jeep-Cherokee-Diesel führte ein durchgescheuerter Kabelbaum zu P0512 mit Nichtstart. Der Anlasser dreht dann nicht – oder läuft bei Plusschluss weiter.

symptoms: Engine does not start, starter does not crank
Starter keeps running after the start (noise)
Check engine light (Subaru after two trips)

description: The engine module receives a secret code from the immobiliser or body module (Chrysler SKIM/SKREEM/RF hub, Saab CIM); if it does not match the stored code, P0513 sets and starting is prevented – Saab cuts fuel and blocks the starter. The most common trigger is a replaced or reflashed engine module that was not taught to the immobiliser (FCA, Saab), less often handshake timing on FCA hybrids or a key not programmed. FCA lists it as invalid SKIM key. It is not emission-related; CARB does not require immobiliser monitoring, and no source documents a warning lamp.
possible_causes: Engine module replaced or reflashed and not taught to the immobiliser [HIGH]
Key or transponder not programmed or faulty [MEDIUM]
Immobiliser, body or RF hub module replaced or faulty [MEDIUM]
Software fault in the handshake [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The battery temperature sensor – usually an NTC in the battery tray or inside an intelligent battery sensor on the negative terminal – lets the module adjust the charging voltage (higher when cold, lower when warm) and supports battery management and start-stop. P0514 is the plausibility check of the temperature signal. On FCA/Alfa Romeo the temperature comes from the intelligent battery sensor on the negative terminal; P0514 means its value is implausible, and several cases on the Alfa Giulia 2.0 were fixed by engine module software. A fixed substitute temperature is then used; CARB requires plausibility faults to have their own code.
possible_causes: Engine module software (false trigger) [HIGH]
Battery sensor or NTC drifting [MEDIUM]
Corrosion at sensor or connector near the battery acid [MEDIUM]
Sensor fitted wrongly after a battery change [LOW]

description: Older engines without electronic throttle have a separate idle air control valve bypassing the closed throttle; CARB requires its output to be checked but not the fault types to be coded separately. P0518 means its circuit fails sporadically – the signal or current briefly leaves its valid range and returns. description: P0519 means the idle control fails functionally with an electrically sound circuit – the actual idle speed deviates strongly despite fully used control. It is documented only on Subaru (also in the Saab 9-2X, electronic throttle, around 2005): idle at least 1000 rpm above target with the control already at zero for 2 or 5 s sets the code with the warning lamp at once, and a fail-safe cuts fuel to cylinders to stop the engine racing. GM and Ford use P0506/P0507 instead; CARB's mandatory limit is +200/−100 rpm.

Throttle or idle valve stuck open (foreign body, coking) [HIGH]
Throttle actuator motor faulty (follow-on P2101) [MEDIUM]
Follow-on fault of other codes (sensors, pedal) [MEDIUM]

description: The crankcase pressure sensor measures pressure in the crankcase ventilation (PCV) against atmosphere; Ford's EcoBoost engines use it for the disconnection check P04DB, which needs a sound sensor. It is checked continuously with 5 s to fault.

description: The crankcase pressure sensor measures pressure in the crankcase ventilation (PCV) against atmosphere; Ford's EcoBoost engines use it for the disconnection check P04DB, which needs a sound sensor. Engine module software (known false trigger) [MEDIUM]

description: The crankcase ventilation has an oil mist separator or filter element that can clog; the crankcase pressure sensor then sees rising pressure at a given flow. P051F reports this restriction. No manufacturer document available to us uses it – Ford reports high pressure under P051B. BMW and GM bulletins describe the consequences of a blocked separator: oil pushed past seals, oil mist in the intake and charge air cooler, higher oil consumption. CARB requires the PCV system to be monitored.

Icing in the separator or hose on short winter trips [MEDIUM]

description: The oil pressure sensor matters for emissions control because modern engines use it as an input – for two-stage or regulated oil pumps, hydraulic cam phasers and GM's cylinder deactivation, whose lifters switch by oil pressure. P0520 is the general circuit fault, used differently: Ford petrol and diesel engines set it for the digital SENT sensor when it reports an internal fault, does not initialise or sends values out of range (lost communication is U0600), after 5 s. GM's 1.4 L turbo with an oil pressure switch sets it when the switch reports pressure although the engine has been off long enough to be pressureless – type C, without warning lamp.
possible_causes: Sensor or switch faulty internally [HIGH]

description: P0525 concerns vehicles with a separate cruise control servo – a vacuum or electric actuator on the throttle cable driven by the engine module: the control circuit is electrically sound, but the response does not match the command. description: Some engines shift the intake (A) camshaft right after a cold start so that more exhaust heat reaches the catalyst; CARB requires each commanded element of this cold-start strategy to be monitored under its own codes. Documented only by Ford (from 2008): during the first 60 s it checks the cam position for 5 s and sets a code above 11° deviation, plus a stuck-pin test (10° commanded, under 2° movement) and an averaged deviation index. Warning lamp after two trips; afterwards the normal cam codes take over. P052A means bank 1 was too far advanced. Outside cold start, P0011 applies.

description: P052E is a function fault of the crankcase ventilation pressure regulating valve. Audi's 3.0 TFSI has a diaphragm valve whose torn diaphragm or elbow causes false air and whistling; Mercedes' M270/M274 have a switched part-load ventilation valve that blocks with oil carbon and lets oil into the intake – blue smoke, rough running, lack of power; Mercedes extended the emission warranty on the intake module. GM Europe's 2.0 diesel in the Saab 9-5 uses P052E differently, for PCV heater performance – which J2012 lists as P053D.
possible_causes: Diaphragm of the regulating valve torn or fatigued [HIGH]
Part-load ventilation valve blocked (oil carbon, sludge) [HIGH]
Elbow or hose at the valve cracked, clamp leaking [MEDIUM]
Engine module software [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1200€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Diesel glow plugs are switched by a separate glow plug control module fed from the battery, with its own ground, a command from the engine module and a diagnostic line back. P052F means its supply voltage is out of range. Ford's 6.7 L and 3.0 L Power Stroke set it below 6.5 V, above 16.5 V or with an open supply, after about 1 s, continuously. An FCA bulletin shows P052F together with all six glow plug open codes P0671–P0676, because without supply no current flows – check main feed, connector and grounds first. GM does not use it.
possible_causes: Main feed to the module open or high-resistance (fuse, connector, corroded ring terminal) [HIGH]
Poor ground of the glow plug module [MEDIUM]
System voltage too low or too high (weak battery, regulator fault) [MEDIUM]
Glow plug module faulty internally [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 20€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The engine module reads the high-side refrigerant pressure sensor (5 V reference, signal rising with pressure) to switch or regulate the compressor, raise the radiator fans at high pressure and pre-control the compressor load at idle. CARB therefore requires A/C components to be monitored where they alter fuel or ignition control or feed other diagnoses (from 2006–2008). P0530 is the general circuit fault; GM and the Saab 9-4X use the more precise P0532/P0533 instead. Saab's 2006 9-5 diesel (Bosch EDC16) assigns P0530 differently, to a short to ground below 0.1 V for 0.6 s, switching off the A/C relay. Warning lamp depends on the maker.
possible_causes: Connector or contacts corroded or loose [HIGH]
Pressure sensor faulty [HIGH]
Wire open or chafed [MEDIUM]
5 V reference shorted by another sensor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: P0534 reports too little refrigerant (a leak), not a sensor circuit: the module compares pressure or temperature in the circuit with a model, and the compressor is locked out for protection. FCA's 2020 Ram EcoDiesel sets it with the warning lamp; a software update fixed false setting. In GM's Volt, Spark EV and Lyriq the circuit also cools the traction battery – GM prescribes recovering and weighing the charge (Volt at least 800 of 950 g) and comparing the battery's refrigerant temperature sensors with ambient.
possible_causes: Refrigerant leak (condenser, joints, compressor shaft seal, service ports) [HIGH]
Pressure or temperature sensor offset (misjudgement) [MEDIUM]
Software or calibration [MEDIUM]
Traction battery chiller faulty (electric and hybrid only) [LOW]

description: P053E is the system code for crankcase pressure above an operating-point limit while the sensor itself is plausible. Normally the crankcase runs at a slight vacuum (GM: −1 to −5 inH2O). No manufacturer document available to us uses P053E – Ford reports the same under P051B (above 5 inHg at idle air flow). description: Petrol direct-injection engines often inject twice after a cold start, once late in the compression stroke, to heat the catalyst; this needs rail pressure within a window. P053F reports that the window was not reached often enough. Documented only by Ford's EcoBoost: over the whole cold-start phase it compares the time in the window with the phase duration against 0.70, once per cold start, with fuel level at least 15 % and the fuel sensors sound. The module then drops this mode, the catalyst lights off later; warning lamp after two trips. GM does not use P053F.
possible_causes: High-pressure pump weak or volume control valve sluggish [HIGH]
Low supply pressure (lift pump, filter) [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure sensor drifting [MEDIUM]
Pump follower or cam lobe worn [LOW]
Software or calibration [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Air Heater A Circuit Open

bilingual_description.en: Some diesels – typically Cummins engines in Ram pick-ups and commercial vehicles, and Iveco – heat the intake air with a grid heater in the intake manifold instead of or alongside glow plugs. It draws very high current through a relay (on recent Ram a solid-state relay) and is switched by the engine module before and after starting; CARB requires cold-start aids to be monitored. P0543 means an open circuit at heater A – in the control line or relay coil, or depending on the maker in the power circuit or heating element itself. It is detected by driver diagnosis with the output off, by a missing voltage dip on switching on or by a missing temperature rise. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; GM's Duramax LML has an intake heater but reports it under its own codes P154A–P154D.
bilingual_description.de: Manche Diesel – typisch Cummins-Motoren in Ram-Pick-ups und Nutzfahrzeugen sowie Iveco – heizen die Ansaugluft mit einem Heizgitter im Ansaugkrümmer statt oder neben Glühkerzen. Es zieht sehr hohen Strom über ein Relais (bei neueren Ram ein Halbleiterrelais) und wird vom Motorsteuergerät vor und nach dem Start geschaltet; CARB verlangt die Überwachung von Kaltstarthilfen. P0543 heißt, der Kreis von Heizer A ist unterbrochen – in Steuerleitung oder Relaisspule, je nach Hersteller auch im Leistungskreis oder Heizelement selbst. Erkannt wird das über die Endstufendiagnose bei ausgeschaltetem Ausgang, über einen fehlenden Spannungseinbruch beim Einschalten oder einen fehlenden Temperaturanstieg. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt diesen Code; GMs Duramax LML hat einen Ansaugluftheizer, meldet ihn aber unter eigenen Codes P154A–P154D.

symptoms: White smoke or knocking while warming up

description: The exhaust gas temperature sensor is a thermistor in a voltage divider with the module's pull-up resistor; the first one (sensor 1) sits before the turbocharger, the oxidation catalyst or after it depending on the maker. Diesels use it for particulate filter regeneration and component protection; CARB names it explicitly as a monitored input. P0544 is the general fault of bank 1 sensor 1. Ford's 6.7 L diesel uses it not as a circuit fault but for plausibility against an exhaust temperature model: after at least 6 h off it compares sensor and model over 200–400 s, a fault exceeding ±80 °C for 20 s, once per trip. GM's Duramax does not use P0544. The module then runs on a model value and may restrict filter regeneration.
possible_causes: Sensor aged or drifting, soot on the tip [HIGH]
Cable or connector damaged by heat or vibration [MEDIUM]
Exhaust leak before the sensor [LOW]
Exhaust temperature really deviating (injection fault) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 300€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The exhaust gas temperature sensor is a thermistor in a voltage divider with the module's pull-up resistor; the first one (sensor 1) sits before the turbocharger, the oxidation catalyst or after it depending on the maker. description: Camshaft B is the exhaust camshaft. During catalyst heating after a cold start some engines set it to a specific position; CARB requires such commanded elements to be monitored with their own codes, separate from the normal cam codes. Ford watches the deviation with an averaged variance index for each direction; GM (Saab 9-4X V6) uses only the retard codes, above 6° for 1 s or 4 s cumulative, type B. The commonest cause is oil pressure building too slowly when cold. P054A means bank 1 was too far advanced. Mercedes (M276) traces it to slow oil pressure – 1 bar should be reached after about 3 s; Audi (Q5 3.2) and VW (Atlas 3.6 and 2.0 T) fixed it by software.
possible_causes: Oil pressure building too slowly when cold (oil level, viscosity, pick-up, pump) [HIGH]
Exhaust oil control valve sticking or screens clogged [MEDIUM]
Module software (threshold too tight) [MEDIUM]
Cam phaser defective, locking pin [LOW]
Timing chain stretched or misassembled [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 900€ (0.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Nockenwelle B ist die Auslassnockenwelle. Beim Katheizen nach einem Kaltstart stellen manche Motoren sie auf eine bestimmte Lage; CARB verlangt, solche befohlenen Elemente mit eigenen Codes getrennt von den normalen Nockenwellencodes zu überwachen. Ford beobachtet die Abweichung mit einem gemittelten Streuungsindex je Richtung; GM (Saab 9-4X V6) nutzt nur die Spät-Codes, über 6° für 1 s oder 4 s kumuliert, Typ B. Häufigste Ursache ist ein kalt zu langsam aufgebauter Öldruck. P054A heißt, Bank 1 lag zu weit früh. Mercedes (M276) führt ihn auf langsamen Öldruck zurück – nach etwa 3 s sollte 1 bar anliegen; Audi (Q5 3.2) und VW (Atlas 3.6 und 2.0 T) behoben ihn per Software.

description: Diesel only. At controlled idle the module compares the fuel quantity the idle governor needs for target speed with a model value; CARB sets the limit from 2013 at ±50 % of what a sound engine needs. Ford's diesel sets the codes beyond ±50 % for 5 s at standstill with warm engine and no filter regeneration; GM compares with 0.5 times a minimum map or 1.5 times a maximum map, 200 of 255 samples, type B. P054E means the engine holds idle with much less fuel than expected – more energy arrives than commanded, for example from injectors delivering too much, oil entering combustion or wrong injector correction codes.
possible_causes: Injectors delivering more than commanded (drift, coking, leaking needle) [HIGH]
Oil entering combustion (turbo seal, crankcase ventilation) [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure actually higher than measured [MEDIUM]

description: Hydraulic power steering has a pressure switch or sensor on the high-pressure line; when the wheel is turned at standstill, pump pressure and engine load rise sharply, so the engine module raises idle air in advance to stop the engine stalling. Damit ist er nach CARB ein Eingang der Leerlaufregelung. Schalter (Saab, Mitsubishi) legen einen Pull-up auf Masse; analoge 5-V-Sensoren (Toyota) liefern bei null Druck etwa 0,45 V. description: The brake booster pressure sensor (5 V reference, signal, ground) measures the vacuum in the brake booster. On direct-injection, turbo, stop-start and hybrid engines intake vacuum is scarce, so the engine module watches it and creates vacuum when needed – closing the throttle, suppressing engine stop or running an electric vacuum pump. That makes it an input to idle and throttle control. P0555 is the general circuit fault without low/high distinction. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM splits circuit faults into P0557 and P0558. The module then assumes a substitute value and keeps vacuum available as a precaution.
possible_causes: Connector or wire to the sensor open or corroded [HIGH]
Sensor faulty [MEDIUM]
5 V reference disturbed (short at another sensor on the same reference) [MEDIUM]
Engine module [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Der Bremskraftverstärker-Drucksensor (5-V-Referenz, Signal, Masse) misst den Unterdruck im Bremskraftverstärker. Bei Direkteinspritzern, Turbos, Start-Stopp und Hybriden ist Saugrohrunterdruck knapp, deshalb überwacht ihn das Motorsteuergerät und erzeugt bei Bedarf Unterdruck – Drosselklappe schließen, Motorstopp unterbinden oder eine elektrische Vakuumpumpe einschalten. Damit ist er Eingang der Leerlauf- und Drosselklappensteuerung. P0555 ist der allgemeine Kreisfehler ohne Unterscheidung zu niedrig/hoch. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt ihn; GM trennt Kreisfehler in P0557 und P0558. Das Steuergerät nimmt dann einen Ersatzwert an und hält vorsorglich Unterdruck bereit.

symptoms: Check engine light or brake booster warning

description: The brake booster pressure sensor (5 V reference, signal, ground) measures the vacuum in the brake booster. On direct-injection, turbo, stop-start and hybrid engines intake vacuum is scarce, so the engine module watches it and creates vacuum when needed – closing the throttle, suppressing engine stop or running an electric vacuum pump. That makes it an input to idle and throttle control. P0556 means the signal is valid but implausible. GM compares it with intake vacuum (MAP) with the throttle nearly closed for over 3 s, filtered, type B with two trips. VW and Porsche also check the electric vacuum pump with it – Porsche compares the pressure at wake-up and 1.5 s later – so P0556 can also mean a weak pump or a leak. P0558 heißt, die Signalspannung ist zu hoch: GM 2018 über 95 % der Referenz in 2000 von 2400 Proben (etwa 30 s), GM 2006 über 4,89 V; Typ B, zwei Fahrten. symptoms: Check engine light or brake booster warning

description: The brake booster pressure sensor (5 V reference, signal, ground) measures the vacuum in the brake booster. On direct-injection, turbo, stop-start and hybrid engines intake vacuum is scarce, so the engine module watches it and creates vacuum when needed – closing the throttle, suppressing engine stop or running an electric vacuum pump. That makes it an input to idle and throttle control. P0559 means the signal jumps briefly – a loose contact or broken wire under movement – without staying out of range long enough for P0557 or P0558. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM catches dropouts through the sample counters of P0557/P0558. CARB requires input components to be checked for circuit faults.
possible_causes: Loose contact at the sensor connector (pin tension, corrosion) [HIGH]
Broken or chafed wire moving with the engine [MEDIUM]
Sensor with internal dropouts [LOW]

description: P055F is a condition code: the measured oil pressure is above the maximum expected for speed and oil temperature – Ford, which documents it, calls it 'too high' and pairs it with P0524 (too low). description: Cruise control buttons are almost always a resistor ladder on one or two signal lines, each button giving its own voltage; the module reading it (GM and Saab from about 2010: the body module; FCA: steering column module or PCM) sends the button state to the engine module over CAN. CARB names cruise control as the example of an emission-neutral diagnosis – it is simply switched off – so GM lists all these codes as type C and Ford as non-MIL: no warning lamp, the engine runs normally. P0564 watches signal line A of the ladder: only voltage windows matching a button or no button are valid. GM sets it when the ratio sits in a gap between windows for over 0.5 s (2014: 2.5 s), the body module in the Saab 9-4X and 9-5 after an invalid voltage for 2 s. Cruise control is locked out for the ignition cycle.
possible_causes: Cruise or steering wheel switch faulty or dirty (moisture, worn contacts) [HIGH]
Clockspring or steering wheel connector with contact resistance [MEDIUM]
Supply or signal line to the body module open or shorted [MEDIUM]
Body module [LOW]

Der Tempomat wird für den Zündzyklus gesperrt.

description: Diesels with SCR may have a separate module for AdBlue/DEF dosing (pump, heaters, dosing valve) talking to the engine module over CAN. It measures its supply; outside its window no safe dosing is possible, so dosing and SCR diagnoses are suspended and NOx rises, and if it persists the SCR warnings and power limits apply. No manufacturer document available to us uses P056D – Ford's diesel reports the dosing module supply as P21CB below 8.5 V and P21CC above 19 V. CARB requires SCR modules to be monitored.
possible_causes: Fuse, relay or supply line of the DEF module [HIGH]
Corrosion at module connector or ground (underbody, road salt) [MEDIUM]
System under- or overvoltage [MEDIUM]
Module faulty [LOW]

symptoms: Check engine light and DEF warning
Possible countdown to start inhibit or power limit

description: CARB requires every element commanded by the cold-start strategy to respond measurably in the commanded direction, with its own codes separate from the general monitoring of the same part. During catalyst heating the boost control is positioned deliberately – diesels close the variable turbine for load and heat, petrol engines open the wastegate so heat reaches the catalyst. P056E means boost control A (the first or only charger) did not follow its cold-start target. Its only documented user is Stellantis: the 2025 Ram 3500 cab chassis with 6.7 L Cummins lists it among codes that can light the warning lamp, fixed by a PCM software update; customers noticed hard cold starts and raised cold idle. Ford and GM do not use it.
possible_causes: Variable turbine or wastegate actuator stiff (coking, cold) [HIGH]
Module software or calibration [MEDIUM]
Vacuum or boost hose leaking [MEDIUM]
Position or boost sensor faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Beim Katheizen wird die Ladedruckregelung gezielt gestellt – Diesel schließen die variable Turbine für Last und Wärme, Benziner öffnen das Wastegate, damit die Wärme den Katalysator erreicht. P056E heißt, Ladedruckregelung A (der erste oder einzige Lader) folgte nicht ihrem Kaltstart-Sollwert. Einziger belegter Nutzer ist Stellantis: Beim Ram 3500 Fahrgestell 2025 mit 6,7-l-Cummins steht er unter den Codes, die die Kontrollleuchte setzen können, behoben per PCM-Software; Kunden bemerkten schlechten Kaltstart und erhöhten Kaltleerlauf. Ford und GM nutzen ihn nicht.

FCA nutzt zwei redundante Leitungen mit gespiegelten Leitern: P0579 wird gesetzt, wenn Signal 1 bei gedrückter Taste außerhalb seines Fensters liegt – für Ein/Aus muss es zwischen 0,235 und 0,353 V liegen – und ist nur aktiv, solange die Taste gedrückt ist. Häufigste Ursache ist Oxidation am Lenkradstecker oder an der Wickelfeder; der Rückruf zum Jeep JK tauscht die Wickelfeder.

symptoms: Cruise control cannot be switched on at times
No check engine light, engine runs normally

description: The brake pedal position sensor is an analogue 5 V sensor, usually Hall-type, giving the pedal position continuously instead of a switch – for brake lights, cruise control, stop-start, brake-throttle override and regenerative braking. GM (from about 2012) and Stellantis read it in the engine module, Saab's 9-4X and 9-5 in the body module; its learned rest position (about 1 V) must be relearned after replacement. P057A is the general circuit or open-circuit fault. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM reports an open circuit as P057C or P057D depending on the line, type A with one trip, and sets the pedal position to 0 %. Brake detection then relies on the brake light switch.
possible_causes: Connector at the sensor loose or corroded, pins pushed back [HIGH]
5 V reference, signal or ground line open [MEDIUM]
Sensor faulty internally [MEDIUM]
Engine or body module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 250€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The brake pedal position sensor A is an analogue 5 V sensor giving pedal travel continuously; its rest position (about 1 V) is learned. GM reads it in the engine module from about 2012 and uses it as an enabling condition of transmission monitors – hence type A, warning lamp after one trip, unlike cruise control codes. On any circuit fault GM sets the pedal to 0 %, so brake detection relies on the brake light switch. P057C means the signal is too low – a short to ground: GM below 5 in 20 of 32 samples. GM bulletins for 2012–14 pick-ups and SUVs name connector X205 under the left defroster duct, with cruise, brake light and stability messages and reduced power.

Sensor faulty internally [MEDIUM]
5 V reference pulled down by another sensor [LOW]

description: P057F means the state of charge of battery A behaves implausibly or leaves its expected range – a performance code, not a circuit fault. Its documented use is on plug-in hybrids of the VW group: the 2025 Porsche Panamera E-Hybrid and Bentley Continental and Flying Spur set it in the high-voltage battery controller, which requests the warning lamp; both causes were software. CARB requires hybrids to monitor battery and charging performance. A use for a 12 V battery sensor was not found; GM and Ford do not list P057F.
possible_causes: Software of the battery controller (state of charge miscalculated) [HIGH]
State of charge not relearned after deep discharge, long standstill or disconnection [MEDIUM]
Battery ageing or cell imbalance [LOW]
Faulty current or voltage measurement in the battery system [LOW]

description: Cruise control buttons form a resistor ladder on one or two signal lines, each button giving its own voltage window. FCA uses two lines with offset windows – signal 1 is input A, signal 2 input B – and both must report the same button; GM evaluates the ratio to the reference. Any fault locks out cruise control; CARB treats this as emission-neutral, and GM and Ford set these codes without warning lamp. P0580 means signal line A is too low: GM at a ratio of 0–0.185 for over 2 s (short to ground or, depending on wiring, open circuit); FCA treats signal 1 below 0.216 V as circuit low. Work at the steering wheel involves the driver airbag.
possible_causes: Signal line shorted to ground (steering wheel wiring, clockspring) [HIGH]
Button block faulty (water, dirt) [MEDIUM]
Steering wheel or clockspring connector corroded or off [MEDIUM]
Evaluating module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 450€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Older engines without electronic throttle use a vacuum cruise servo on the throttle cable: a vacuum valve (closed when unpowered) opens the throttle with intake vacuum, a vent valve (open when unpowered) holds or releases it, and a dump valve fed through the brake switch vents it when braking. Where the engine module drives these valves, it checks each circuit and switches cruise off; CARB treats this as emission-neutral, usually without warning lamp. P0582 concerns the vacuum valve circuit: an open circuit, checked with ignition on and cruise control active. Without current the vacuum valve stays closed – the safe state.
possible_causes: Connector at the servo loose or corroded [HIGH]
Vacuum valve coil in the servo open [HIGH]
Wire between servo and engine module open [MEDIUM]
Engine module driver [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 300€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The battery monitor module (intelligent battery sensor) sits on the negative terminal of the 12 V battery: a shunt measures current, electronics also measure voltage and temperature and calculate state of charge, health and cranking ability, reporting over LIN. Energy management uses the data for alternator control, idle boost and stop-start release, which is why the engine module diagnoses it. GM sets P058A–P058F in its engine modules from 2016 as type B, warning lamp after two trips. P058A means the module reports an internal fault of its own over LIN. GM checks it every 250 ms above 9 V, without LIN faults and at outside temperatures of −20 to 50 °C. Battery data are then unreliable – stop-start is blocked and the alternator usually runs a fixed substitute voltage. Loss of communication is a separate U code.
possible_causes: Battery sensor faulty internally [HIGH]
Poor supply or ground at the sensor (loose terminal, corroded connector) [MEDIUM]
Sensor not relearned after battery replacement or disconnection [MEDIUM]
Module or engine module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Battery Monitor Module Temperature Too Low

bilingual_description.en: The battery monitor module (intelligent battery sensor) sits on the negative terminal of the 12 V battery: a shunt measures current, electronics also measure voltage and temperature and calculate state of charge, health and cranking ability, reporting over LIN. Energy management uses the data for alternator control, idle boost and stop-start release, which is why the engine module diagnoses it. GM sets P058A–P058F in its engine modules from 2016 as type B, warning lamp after two trips. P058F means the module reports a temperature below its plausible range: GM sets it below −43 °C in 4 of 5 samples, but only with an outside temperature above −20 °C – so the value is physically implausible, usually an open sensing circuit or faulty sensor. It suspends P058C; the charge voltage then lacks correct temperature compensation.
bilingual_description.de: Das Batterieüberwachungsmodul (intelligenter Batteriesensor) sitzt am Minuspol der 12-V-Batterie: Ein Shunt misst den Strom, die Elektronik zusätzlich Spannung und Temperatur und berechnet Ladezustand, Alterung und Startfähigkeit, gemeldet per LIN. Das Energiemanagement nutzt die Daten für Generatorregelung, Leerlaufanhebung und Start-Stopp-Freigabe, deshalb diagnostiziert ihn das Motorsteuergerät. GM setzt P058A–P058F in seinen Motorsteuergeräten ab 2016 als Typ B, Kontrollleuchte nach zwei Fahrten. P058F heißt, das Modul meldet eine Temperatur unter dem plausiblen Bereich: GM setzt ihn unter −43 °C in 4 von 5 Proben, aber nur bei einer Außentemperatur über −20 °C – der Wert ist also physikalisch unplausibel, meist ein offener Messkreis oder ein defekter Sensor. Er setzt P058C aus; die Ladespannung ist dann nicht richtig temperaturkompensiert.

description: Cruise control buttons form a resistor ladder on one or two signal lines, each button giving its own voltage window. description: Older engines without electronic throttle use a vacuum cruise servo on the throttle cable: a vacuum valve (closed when unpowered) opens the throttle with intake vacuum, a vent valve (open when unpowered) holds or releases it, and a dump valve fed through the brake switch vents it when braking. Where the engine module drives these valves, it checks each circuit and switches cruise off; CARB treats this as emission-neutral, usually without warning lamp. P0594 concerns the servo control or supply circuit: an open circuit. Where the servo is fed through the cruise contact of the brake light switch, braking interrupts this supply on purpose, so the brake switch and its wiring are typical causes and brake lights may be affected too. No manufacturer document available to us describes P0594 in detail.
possible_causes: Brake light switch (cruise contact) faulty or misadjusted [HIGH]
Supply line open or shorted to ground [MEDIUM]
Servo connector or servo [MEDIUM]
Engine module output [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Ältere Motoren ohne E-Gas nutzen einen Unterdruck-Tempomatsteller am Gaszug: Ein Vakuumventil (stromlos zu) öffnet die Drosselklappe mit Saugrohrunterdruck, ein Belüftungsventil (stromlos offen) hält oder lässt ihn ab, ein über den Bremsschalter versorgtes Schnellentlüftungsventil belüftet beim Bremsen. Wo das Motorsteuergerät diese Ventile ansteuert, prüft es jeden Kreis und schaltet den Tempomat ab; CARB wertet das als emissionsneutral, meist ohne Kontrollleuchte. Wo der Steller über den Tempomatkontakt des Bremslichtschalters versorgt wird, unterbricht Bremsen diese Versorgung absichtlich; typische Ursachen sind dann Bremsschalter und Leitungen, auch die Bremslichter können betroffen sein. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage beschreibt P0594 genauer.

description: A map-controlled thermostat is a wax thermostat with a built-in heating resistor (Valeo: about 10 Ω). Unheated it opens late, for hot running at part load; the engine module heats it by map under full load or towing so it opens earlier. CARB requires the thermostat to be monitored and the heater circuit counts as an output component. GM switches it to ground with a low-side driver and checks it every second, fault after 15 of 30 samples, type B; Hyundai/Kia/Genesis and VW/Audi use the codes as well. P0597 means the heater circuit is open – GM above 200 kΩ with the driver off. The thermostat then only works through its wax and opens late, so coolant runs hotter under load; Audi's 4.2 FSI also limits engine speed. Genesis (G80/G90 3.3 T, 3.8) replaced thermostats from an early production lot.
possible_causes: Heating resistor in the thermostat open [HIGH]
Connector at the thermostat loose or corroded, coolant in the connector [MEDIUM]
Broken wire or missing supply (fuse, relay) [MEDIUM]
Engine module driver [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Der Thermostat arbeitet dann nur über das Wachs und öffnet spät, das Kühlmittel wird unter Last heißer; Audis 4.2 FSI begrenzt zusätzlich die Drehzahl. Genesis (G80/G90 3.3 T, 3.8) tauschte Thermostate einer frühen Fertigungscharge.

Unbeheizt öffnet er spät, für heißen Betrieb in Teillast; das Motorsteuergerät heizt ihn nach Kennfeld unter Volllast oder mit Anhänger, damit er früher öffnet. CARB verlangt die Überwachung des Thermostats, der Heizkreis gilt als Ausgangsbauteil. GM schaltet ihn mit einer Low-Side-Endstufe gegen Masse und prüft jede Sekunde, Fehler nach 15 von 30 Proben, Typ B; auch Hyundai/Kia/Genesis und VW/Audi nutzen die Codes. P0599 heißt, ein Plusschluss oder ein kurzgeschlossener Heizwiderstand – GM erkennt ihn bei eingeschalteter Endstufe, wenn sie die Leitung nicht nach Masse ziehen kann. Die Heizung ist wirkungslos, das Kühlmittel wird unter Last heißer; Audis 4.2 FSI meldet ihn mit P2181, zeigt die Kühlmittelwarnung und begrenzt die Drehzahl.

description: The active grille shutter (A = upper or only shutter, B = second) closes louvres to cut drag and speed warm-up and opens them for cooling; CARB names it as an off-cycle CO2 technology and requires its components to be monitored. description: Shutter B is the second active grille shutter – at GM, Ford and Stellantis the lower one in the bumper. Shutters cut drag and speed warm-up when closed and open for cooling; CARB names them as an off-cycle CO2 technology and treats the actuator as an output component. Smart actuators report over LIN (loss of communication: U0285); a fault usually costs fuel and warm-up time, a closed shutter can make the engine run hot under load. P05AE compares commanded and reached position. GM checks in two stages with five clearing attempts, type B, two trips; Ford's 3.0 L diesel at over 6° deviation in operation or 20° when learning open; Stellantis uses it too. GM, Ford and Stellantis do not distinguish the direction. GM bulletins for 2019–21 Silverado and Sierra name stones or ice at the bottom of the lower shutter, often with U0285.
possible_causes: Debris, stones, ice or snow in the lower shutter [HIGH]
Louvres unhooked or broken, rubbing on bracket or horn, impact damage [HIGH]
Water or corrosion in connector or harness [MEDIUM]
Actuator B faulty [MEDIUM]

bilingual_description.de: Jalousie B ist die zweite aktive Kühlerjalousie – bei GM, Ford und Stellantis die untere im Stoßfänger. description: Shutter B is the second active grille shutter – at GM, Ford and Stellantis the lower one in the bumper. description: Shutter B is the second active grille shutter – at GM, Ford and Stellantis the lower one in the bumper. description: After a crash the restraint control module tells the engine module that airbags or belt tensioners have fired; the engine module then cuts the fuel pump (Ford: until the ignition is cycled) and possibly the engine. Depending on the maker the message travels over CAN and/or a dedicated wire with a defined level or voltage drop. P05B8 means the wired signal line is open – no valid rest level arrives. After a real crash the fuel cut-off may then not be triggered via this line. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; it is a safety function, not an emission-relevant monitor, so usually without warning lamp.
possible_causes: Signal wire or connector between restraint and engine module open (e.g. after accident repair or seat removal) [HIGH]
Corroded or spread pin at either module [MEDIUM]
Replacement module not configured [MEDIUM]
Restraint module output stage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 300€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Shutter B is the second active grille shutter – at GM, Ford and Stellantis the lower one in the bumper. Shutters cut drag and speed warm-up when closed and open for cooling; CARB names them as an off-cycle CO2 technology and treats the actuator as an output component. Smart actuators report over LIN (loss of communication: U0285); a fault usually costs fuel and warm-up time, a closed shutter can make the engine run hot under load. P05C1 means the smart actuator of shutter B measures its control chip above 140 °C for 10 s and switches its driver off for protection. Documented only for Ford's 3.0 L diesel. Usual causes are continuous motor load from a stiff or blocked shutter or a shorted coil, or an internal fault; it may work again after cooling.

Shutter stiff or blocked (ice, dirt, bent louvres) causing continuous current [MEDIUM]
High heat load at the mounting point (radiator, traffic, towing) [LOW]

description: P05CB means a control module has found that installed hardware does not match the vehicle configuration – a wrong variant or part number, an unprogrammed replacement module, or messages from another vehicle type. Typical cause is a replaced module or battery that was not matched or programmed.

description: During catalyst heating after a cold start the engine module commands a specific cam phaser position for more residual gas and exhaust heat; CARB requires this to be monitored under codes separate from the normal cam codes. These 'performance' codes are GM's current form (since about 2015/16; older GM engines and Ford use the direction codes P052A ff and P054A ff): fault when commanded and actual position differ by more than 4° or 6° once the target is stable. P05CC watches intake camshaft A on bank 1 – the cold-start counterpart of P0011. GM's 3.0 L twin turbo sets it above 4°, 60 of 100 samples, type B; the 2.0 L turbo in the Envision above 6° as type A after one trip. A GM bulletin for the 2024–25 Traverse, Enclave and Acadia (2.5 L turbo, electric phaser) names a damaged phaser motor with rattle, together with P0011/P0016.
possible_causes: Insufficient cold oil supply: wrong viscosity, low level, worn oil [HIGH]
Oil control valve sticking or screen clogged [MEDIUM]
Phaser worn or lock pin not releasing; on electric phasers a damaged phaser motor [MEDIUM]
Timing chain stretched or skipped [LOW]
Engine module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: During catalyst heating after a cold start the engine module commands a specific cam phaser position for more residual gas and exhaust heat; CARB requires this to be monitored under codes separate from the normal cam codes. These 'performance' codes are GM's current form (since about 2015/16; older GM engines and Ford use the direction codes P052A ff and P054A ff): fault when commanded and actual position differ by more than 4° or 6° once the target is stable. P05CC watches intake camshaft A on bank 1 – the cold-start counterpart of P0011. GM's 3.0 L twin turbo sets it above 4°, 60 of 100 samples, type B; the 2.0 L turbo in the Envision above 6° as type A after one trip. A GM bulletin for the 2024–25 Traverse, Enclave and Acadia (2.5 L turbo, electric phaser) names a damaged phaser motor with rattle, together with P0011/P0016.
bilingual_description.de: Beim Katheizen nach einem Kaltstart befiehlt das Motorsteuergerät eine bestimmte Lage des Nockenwellenverstellers für mehr Restgas und Abgaswärme; CARB verlangt, das unter eigenen Codes getrennt von den normalen Nockenwellencodes zu überwachen. Diese „Funktions“-Codes sind GMs heutige Form (seit etwa 2015/16; ältere GM-Motoren und Ford nutzen die Richtungscodes P052A ff und P054A ff): Fehler, wenn Soll- und Istlage nach stabilem Sollwert um mehr als 4° oder 6° abweichen. P05CC überwacht die Einlassnockenwelle A auf Bank 1 – das Kaltstart-Gegenstück zu P0011. GMs 3,0-l-Biturbo setzt ihn über 4°, 60 von 100 Proben, Typ B; der 2,0-l-Turbo im Envision über 6° als Typ A nach einer Fahrt. Ein GM-Bulletin zu Traverse, Enclave und Acadia 2024–25 (2,5-l-Turbo, elektrischer Versteller) nennt einen beschädigten Verstellermotor mit Klappern, zusammen mit P0011/P0016.

symptoms: Check engine light on (GM mostly after two trips)
Often no noticeable symptoms, possibly rough cold idle

possible_causes: Insufficient cold oil supply: wrong viscosity, low level, worn oil [HIGH]

Timing chain stretched or skipped [LOW]
Engine module software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The driver mode select switch (tour, sport, eco, snow, off-road, towing) changes engine and transmission maps such as shift points, pedal map and cylinder deactivation, so CARB requires it to be monitored as an input. GM reads switch A as an eight-position resistor ladder in the body module and sets P05D1–P05D3 in its 2025 tables when a condition is present for 4 s within 5 s, type B with warning lamp after two trips. A fault blocks mode selection; the vehicle stays in its basic mode. P05D0 is the general circuit fault of switch A without low/high assignment. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM covers the same switch with the more specific P05D1–P05D3.
possible_causes: Connector at the switch or control panel corroded or loose [HIGH]
Switch faulty, e.g. liquid in the centre console [MEDIUM]
Wire to the reading module open [MEDIUM]
Reading module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 350€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Driver Mode Select Switch A Circuit

bilingual_description.en: The driver mode select switch (tour, sport, eco, snow, off-road, towing) changes engine and transmission maps such as shift points, pedal map and cylinder deactivation, so CARB requires it to be monitored as an input. GM reads switch A as an eight-position resistor ladder in the body module and sets P05D1–P05D3 in its 2025 tables when a condition is present for 4 s within 5 s, type B with warning lamp after two trips. A fault blocks mode selection; the vehicle stays in its basic mode. P05D0 is the general circuit fault of switch A without low/high assignment. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM covers the same switch with the more specific P05D1–P05D3.
bilingual_description.de: Der Fahrmodus-Wahlschalter (Tour, Sport, Eco, Schnee, Gelände, Anhänger) schaltet Motor- und Getriebekennfelder wie Schaltpunkte, Pedalkennlinie und Zylinderabschaltung um, deshalb verlangt CARB seine Überwachung als Eingang. GM liest Schalter A als achtstufige Widerstandsleiter im Karosseriesteuergerät und setzt P05D1–P05D3 in seinen Tabellen von 2025, wenn eine Bedingung 4 s innerhalb von 5 s vorliegt, Typ B mit Kontrollleuchte nach zwei Fahrten. Ein Fehler sperrt die Moduswahl; das Fahrzeug bleibt im Grundmodus. P05D0 ist der allgemeine Kreisfehler von Schalter A ohne Zuordnung zu niedrig/hoch. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt ihn; GM deckt denselben Schalter mit den genaueren P05D1–P05D3 ab.

symptoms: Drive mode cannot be changed, vehicle stays in normal mode
Mode display missing or jumping back
Check engine light (GM after two trips)

description: The driver mode select switch (tour, sport, eco, snow, off-road, towing) changes engine and transmission maps such as shift points, pedal map and cylinder deactivation, so CARB requires it to be monitored as an input. GM reads switch A as an eight-position resistor ladder in the body module and sets P05D1–P05D3 in its 2025 tables when a condition is present for 4 s within 5 s, type B with warning lamp after two trips. A fault blocks mode selection; the vehicle stays in its basic mode. P05D1 means the signal is below the lowest valid window: GM petrol body modules below 1.327 V, diesel below 0.528 V. Typical are a signal shorted to ground or a shorted switch.
possible_causes: Signal line to the body module shorted to ground (chafing in the console) [HIGH]
Switch shorted internally (moisture, spilled drink) [MEDIUM]
Connector at the switch damaged [MEDIUM]
Body module input [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 350€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: Brake-by-wire and hybrid systems use a dual-channel pedal travel sensor; channel B runs opposite to A at Toyota (3.6–4.4 V at rest, falling when pressed), so a common fault of both channels shows up. It feeds brake assist and regenerative blending; CARB requires inputs used by other diagnoses to be monitored. Brake or hybrid module [LOW]

description: Brake-by-wire and hybrid systems measure brake pedal travel with a two-channel sensor; the channels often run in opposite directions (Toyota RAV4 hybrid 2024–25: one rises from about 1 V, the other falls from about 4 V). P05E0 means both channels are electrically fine but no longer match each other. Toyota sets it when the relationship is invalid for 0.2 s and lights the lamp at once; Mitsubishi's Outlander PHEV adds the regenerative brake warning. Braking falls back to plain hydraulics, so the pedal may feel hard and regeneration is off. GM notes for the CT6, Bolt, Malibu and Volt 2016–18 that the code can also appear without a defect if the driver rests a foot lightly on the brake (1.8–5.6 mm travel) for 60 s while accelerating. Single-channel faults are P057A–P057E and P05DB–P05DF.
possible_causes: Pedal travel sensor faulty internally (channels drift apart) [HIGH]
Contact resistance or corrosion in the connector or harness of one channel [MEDIUM]
Sensor not calibrated after replacement or pedal work [MEDIUM]
Foot resting lightly on the brake while accelerating (GM) [MEDIUM]
Brake or hybrid control module faulty [LOW]

description: The refrigerant pressure sensor (three wires, 5 V reference, signal rising with pressure) tells the engine module the A/C pressure; it uses it to switch the radiator fan, to block the compressor at too high or too low pressure and to pre-control idle load. CARB requires such inputs to be checked for circuit faults and plausibility, but they need not light the lamp if they do not affect emissions. 'Intermittent/Erratic' means the signal jumps implausibly fast or briefly leaves its valid range without staying low or high long enough for those codes. Sensor A is usually the high-pressure sensor; GM and Saab report it only as P0532/P0533 (circuit low/high, at GM below 3 % or above 98 % of 5 V) and P0531, so no manufacturer document available to us uses P05E1 itself. Chafed or broken wire (5 V, signal, ground) [MEDIUM]
Sensor faulty internally (signal jumps) [MEDIUM]
Shared 5 V reference disturbed by another sensor [LOW]

description: The engine module reads the park brake status, directly or via another module, because strategies depend on it: a parked diesel filter regeneration only runs with the park brake applied (Navistar), idle shutdown and PTO logic use it, and Ford delays an automatic restart while the electric park brake moves. CARB requires such inputs to be monitored. The only documented user of this code family is Volvo Trucks: since OBD 2021 a second park brake sensor (about 0.5 V applied, 3.5 V released) must agree with the old switch; the engine module reports the fault. No passenger car maker uses it verifiably. P05E3 is the general circuit fault – usually an open circuit or undefined state. Low and high signals are P05E4 and P05E5.
possible_causes: Broken wire or corroded connector at the park brake switch or sensor [HIGH]
Switch or pressure sensor faulty [MEDIUM]
Faulty diode in the switch circuit (Volvo) [LOW]
Vehicle or brake module delivers a wrong status [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 300€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.en: The engine oil bypass valve is an electrically switched solenoid that, according to patents (Hyundai/Kia), routes oil around the oil cooler when cold so the engine warms up faster with less friction, and through the cooler once the oil is hot. It is not the purely mechanical oil filter bypass. CARB requires output components to be checked for circuit faults. No manufacturer document available to us uses P05E8–P05EA, and no vehicle with these codes was found. If the circuit fails, the valve stays in its unpowered position – depending on design oil may run too hot under load or warm up slowly. P05EA means the control circuit voltage is too high – a short to battery or overcurrent at the driver, so the valve cannot be operated.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motoröl-Bypassventil ist ein elektrisch geschaltetes Magnetventil, das laut Patenten (Hyundai/Kia) das Öl im kalten Zustand am Ölkühler vorbeiführt, damit der Motor mit weniger Reibung schneller warm wird, und bei heißem Öl durch den Kühler. Gemeint ist nicht der rein mechanische Ölfilter-Bypass. CARB verlangt, Ausgangsbauteile auf Kreisfehler zu prüfen. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt P05E8–P05EA, ein Fahrzeug mit diesen Codes wurde nicht gefunden. Fällt der Kreis aus, bleibt das Ventil in seiner stromlosen Stellung – je nach Auslegung wird das Öl unter Last zu heiß oder langsam warm. P05EA heißt: Die Spannung im Steuerkreis ist zu hoch – Plusschluss oder Überstrom an der Endstufe, das Ventil lässt sich nicht ansteuern.

symptoms: Check engine light (if rated as emission related)
Oil too hot under load or slow warm-up, depending on rest position

description: After a cold start a diesel heats its exhaust actively – retarded and post injection, intake or exhaust throttling, higher idle, EGR cooler bypass – so the SCR catalyst quickly reaches the temperature at which urea dosing can start (around 180–200 °C). P05EB sets when the measured temperature at the SCR inlet stays below the expected or modelled value within a set time after the start: the heating strategy is not working. CARB requires this 'catalyst warm-up' monitor for light-duty diesels from model year 2026 (20 %) to 2028 (100 %); GM 2025 and Ford 2023 tables do not contain the code yet. Volvo Trucks used it on 2016–17 heavy-duty engines and advised a software check instead of replacing parts. The lamp comes on; no power limitation from this code alone is known.
possible_causes: Engine module software or calibration (false trigger) [HIGH]
Exhaust temperature sensor before the SCR reads low or slow [MEDIUM]
Heating measure not effective: throttle, EGR cooler bypass or turbo vanes sticking [MEDIUM]
Post or retarded injection not effective (injectors) [LOW]
Exhaust leak before the sensor or extremely cold conditions [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 800€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: To heat the exhaust after a cold start, a diesel shifts its start of injection, usually later, plus post injections. CARB requires faults of such elements during the cold start strategy to be reported under codes separate from normal operation – hence P05EC. GM's 2025 diesels compare the start of injection requested by the application software with the timing actually scheduled for the injector drivers, during cold start only; a deviation beyond ±4 or ±5 in 88 of 176 or 8 of 16 samples sets the code and the lamp in the first trip. Ford's 2023 diesel instead checks whether the cold start operating mode is really activated when requested (10 s). Mechanical injector timing faults in normal operation are P01CB ff and P020A ff; the petrol counterpart for ignition timing is P050B.
possible_causes: Engine module software or internal fault (request and execution differ) [HIGH]
Cold start mode blocked by other faults (coolant or fuel temperature, rail pressure) [MEDIUM]
Injector driver or injector circuit [LOW]
Weak battery during cold start [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Some diesels use a separate control module or power stage for the DEF heaters in tank, pump and lines; without heating, frozen fluid cannot thaw in winter and dosing stays blocked. P05ED reports that this module's supply voltage is outside its allowed window – a blown main fuse, an open feed or ground, or system voltage too low or too high. Chrysler (FCA) lists this code among those that trigger the DEF inducement: a 'Service DEF System' warning, a countdown after 50 miles and no restart after 150 miles (P241D). Thresholds are not published; GM's L5P monitors the comparable heater supply under its own codes and flags a drop of more than 3 V below battery voltage while heating is requested. Start with fuse, feed, ground and battery or charging system.
possible_causes: Main fuse or feed wire to the heater module faulty, connector corroded (splash zone) [HIGH]
Poor module ground [MEDIUM]
Weak battery or charging fault (system voltage too low or too high) [MEDIUM]
Heater control module faulty internally [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Schwellen sind nicht veröffentlicht; GMs L5P überwacht die vergleichbare Heizerversorgung unter eigenen Codes und bewertet einen Abfall von mehr als 3 V unter Batteriespannung bei Heizanforderung. Zuerst Sicherung, Zuleitung, Masse sowie Batterie und Ladesystem prüfen.

symptoms: DEF/AdBlue warning, possibly countdown to no-restart

description: The electric supply pump in the diesel exhaust fluid (DEF, AdBlue) tank module builds the dosing pressure for the SCR catalyst. Its supply voltage is monitored separately from the pump control circuit (P208A ff); CARB requires SCR components and their outputs to be checked for circuit faults and function. P05EE means the supply circuit is open: when the supply is switched on, no voltage or current reaches the pump branch. Ford's comparable check flags a pump controller voltage below 6 V. Chrysler (FCA) lists this code among those that trigger the DEF inducement: a 'Service DEF System' warning, a countdown after 50 miles and no restart after 150 miles (P241D). Without supply the pump cannot build pressure, dosing stops and NOx rises; pressure or SCR efficiency codes may follow.
possible_causes: Connector at the pump or tank module corroded or loose [HIGH]
Open wire in the harness to the tank [MEDIUM]
Fuse or relay of the pump supply faulty [MEDIUM]
Pump or tank module open internally [LOW]

description: P05F8 is the function check of the DEF heater control module: its feedback does not match the command – heating current or power, temperature rise, or an internal module fault. The code is documented for Chrysler's 3.0 L EcoDiesel in the 2014 Ram 1500 and Jeep Grand Cherokee: several bulletins list it together with the heater codes P20BA, P20BE and P20C2, and the fix in each case was only reprogramming the engine module – a diagnostic that was too sensitive rather than a hardware defect. description: A discrete stop-start status line tells the engine module (or another module) whether stop-start is active, inhibited or has just stopped the engine. On most current cars this status travels over CAN instead, so a hard-wired line and these codes are rare; no manufacturer document available to us uses P05F9–P05FB. CARB names stop-start as its example of an 'emissions neutral' reaction: a module that simply disables stop-start when a fault appears may report it without the check engine light, which is what Ford does for its stop-start codes. P05F9 is the general circuit fault or open line. The typical reaction is that stop-start is disabled; the driver-operated stop-start switch has its own codes.

description: During a cold start, direct injection petrol engines usually raise rail pressure for finer atomisation with multiple injections while the catalyst heats up. P05FC monitors whether the actual rail pressure of bank 2 stays within the target window during this phase – only engines with separate rails and pressure sensors per bank (V or boxer engines with two high-pressure circuits) can set it. CARB lists fuel pressure as a cold start component that must respond measurably beyond what would happen without the strategy. No manufacturer document available to us uses P05FC; Ford checks the single-rail counterpart P053F and flags a fault when the share of cold start time inside the pressure window is 0.70 or less, and Kia replaced the engine module of the 2018 Stinger 2.0T for P053F with stumbling during warm-up. GM uses P2C1E–P2C20 instead.
possible_causes: High-pressure pump or volume control valve of bank 2 weak or sticking [HIGH]
Low supply pressure (low-pressure pump, filter) [MEDIUM]
Rail pressure sensor of bank 2 inaccurate [MEDIUM]
Engine module software [MEDIUM]
Leaking injector or pressure relief on bank 2 [LOW]

description: Electric variable-geometry turbo actuators use a DC motor with gearing, driven by an H-bridge in the engine module or in the actuator itself. Constant high load – sooted or stiff vanes, running against a stop, an internal motor short – drives up current and temperature. GM's 2025 diesels set P05FD when the H-bridge driver exceeds 170 °C in 240 of 300 samples (about 3 s) and light the lamp in the first trip. The driver then shuts off for protection, the actuator stops or returns to its rest position, and boost control is limited – underboost or overboost and reduced power can follow. GM Europe's earlier 2.0 diesels reported the same protection under P0046. Circuit faults of the actuator are P0045–P0048, the position sensor P2563 ff.
possible_causes: Vane mechanism sooted or stiff, actuator works constantly against resistance [HIGH]
Electric actuator faulty internally (shorted turns, bearing) [MEDIUM]
High ambient heat at the actuator (missing heat shield, exhaust leak) [LOW]
Engine module or driver [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2500€ (1.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Active grille shutters close the air inlet when little cooling is needed, to reduce drag and speed up warm-up. P05FE is the performance check of a third shutter C – target and actual position do not match, as P059F does for shutter A and P05AE for shutter B. Only vehicles with three separately driven shutters could set it, and no manufacturer was found that uses a shutter C: GM and Ford use only A (upper) and B (lower). This description therefore follows A and B: control is suspended and the shutter stays where it is or opens; if it sticks closed, cooling air is missing under load. GM and Ford light the lamp for A and B after two trips. Ice and debris are frequent causes, and GM fixed false A/B codes in snow by software on the 2025 Equinox. Stuck on is P2C73.
possible_causes: Debris or ice blocking the louvres [HIGH]
Louvres unhooked or broken (impact) [MEDIUM]
Shutter C actuator faulty [MEDIUM]
Connector, wiring or supply corroded [LOW]
Software false trigger in frost [LOW]
