bilingual_description.de: Injektoren von Direkteinspritzern (Benzin und Common-Rail-Diesel) brauchen zum schnellen Öffnen eine im Steuergerät erzeugte hohe Boost-Spannung; danach hält das Steuergerät sie mit getakteter Batteriespannung. P062D überwacht diese Boost-Spannung bzw. die gemeinsame Injektorversorgung von Bank 1. GMs Duramax von 2018 setzt ihn, wenn die interne Boost-Spannung über 75 V oder unter etwa 52 V liegt, die Versorgungsleitung zu den Injektoren offen ist oder ein interner Fehler vorliegt, in 14 von 20 Proben zu 6,25 ms, Leuchte in der ersten Fahrt (2025: über 60 V oder unter 40 V). Fords Benzin-Direkteinspritzer melden ihn, wenn der Öffnungsstrom nicht rechtzeitig erreicht wird (10 s, ohne Zylinderangabe), Fords Diesel, wenn der Treiberbaustein einen Ausfall der Hochspannung meldet (0,5 s). Die Injektoren öffnen dann verspätet oder gar nicht: Aussetzer, rauer Lauf, Leistungsverlust oder kein Start. GM nutzt nur P062D, auch bei V8. Einzelne Injektorkreise sind P0201 ff.

symptoms: Check engine light (GM in the first trip)
Loss of power or limp mode

description: Direct-injection injectors (petrol and common-rail diesel) need a high boost voltage generated in the module to open fast; the module then holds them with pulsed battery voltage. P062E is the bank 2 counterpart of P062D for V engines with separate driver circuits per bank. The only user found is Ford's 2023 diesel (6.7 L Power Stroke V8): the driver chip's internal logic reports a loss of the high-voltage supply and the code sets within 0.5 s; group supply faults of the injectors are P2150/P2151 and P2153/P2154. GM monitors the same boost voltage only under P062D. The injectors of bank 2 then open incorrectly – misfires on one side of the engine, rough idle, loss of power and possibly limp mode. Check wiring and connectors under the bank 2 valve cover and each injector for shorts before suspecting the engine module.
possible_causes: Short in an injector wire or injector of bank 2 [HIGH]
Engine module or driver chip faulty internally [MEDIUM]
Connector or harness under the bank 2 valve cover [MEDIUM]
Undervoltage or poor ground [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Einziger gefundener Nutzer ist Fords Diesel 2023 (6,7-l-Power-Stroke-V8): Die interne Logik des Treiberbausteins meldet einen Ausfall der Hochspannungsversorgung, der Code setzt binnen 0,5 s; Gruppenfehler der Injektorversorgung sind P2150/P2151 und P2153/P2154. Vor dem Verdacht aufs Motorsteuergerät Kabelbaum und Stecker unter dem Ventildeckel von Bank 2 sowie jeden Injektor auf Kurzschluss prüfen.

symptoms: Misfires on one side of the engine
Loss of power or limp mode

description: Learned values, adaptations, counters and configuration are saved to non-volatile memory (EEPROM or flash-emulated NVM) when the module shuts down. P062F means this memory failed a check: GM and GM Europe test at start-up whether the last write at shutdown completed, GM's 6.6 L diesel checks a checksum per data block and whether sectors can be erased, Ford's diesel reports read, write or erase errors (5 s). Lamp behaviour varies: GM petrol engine modules after two trips, the Duramax 2014 and Saab 2.0 L turbo in the first trip, GM transmission modules and GM Europe's 1.6 L turbo without it. Most often the shutdown was interrupted – battery disconnected, voltage dip, main relay dropping out too early. Learned values are lost and relearned. The code also appears in transmission and other modules.
possible_causes: Shutdown interrupted (battery disconnected, voltage dip, main relay drops out too early) [HIGH]
Weak battery, poor ground or supply at the module [MEDIUM]
Software fault or incomplete programming [MEDIUM]
Memory defect in the module (write cycles, ageing) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 1200€ (0.3h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Internal Control Module EEPROM Error

The code also appears in transmission and other modules.
bilingual_description.de: Lernwerte, Adaptionen, Zähler und Konfiguration werden beim Abschalten des Steuergeräts in einen nichtflüchtigen Speicher geschrieben (EEPROM oder Flash-emuliertes NVM). P062F heißt: Dieser Speicher hat eine Prüfung nicht bestanden. GM und GM-Europa prüfen beim Start, ob der letzte Schreibvorgang beim Abschalten fertig wurde, GMs 6,6-l-Diesel prüft eine Prüfsumme je Datenblock und ob sich Sektoren löschen lassen, der Ford-Diesel meldet Lese-, Schreib- oder Löschfehler (5 s). Die Leuchte ist uneinheitlich: GM-Benzin-Motorsteuergeräte nach zwei Fahrten, Duramax 2014 und Saab 2,0-l-Turbo in der ersten, GM-Getriebesteuergeräte und GM-Europas 1,6-l-Turbo ohne. Meist wurde das Abschalten unterbrochen – Batterie abgeklemmt, Spannungseinbruch, Hauptrelais fällt zu früh ab. Lernwerte gehen verloren und werden neu gelernt.

symptoms: Check engine or service lamp (depending on the maker, sometimes after two trips)
Learned values lost: rough idle or harsh shifts until relearned

description: Since model year 2005 CARB requires exactly one module to report the VIN to a scan tool, and reprogramming the VIN must erase all emission-related diagnostic data. P0630 means the engine module holds no valid VIN or one that does not fit. GM checks continuously whether every VIN position is a valid ASCII character (older tables: bytes 00 or FF count as empty), 250 ms, with the lamp in the first trip. At Ford the body module sends VIN, tyre circumference and axle ratio at every start, and P0630 sets while only default values are stored – so it covers more than the VIN; the 2023 diesel checks within 0.5 s. Hyundai requires writing the VIN after replacement; once written it cannot be changed. The engine runs normally; inspection stations may reject a missing VIN.
possible_causes: New replacement module without written VIN [HIGH]
Used module from another vehicle (VIN does not match) [MEDIUM]
Interrupted programming or missing configuration data from the body module (Ford) [MEDIUM]
Internal memory fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: VIN Not Programmed or Incompatible ECM/PCM
bilingual_title.de: Fahrgestellnummer nicht programmiert oder unpassend Motorsteuergerät

Hyundai requires writing the VIN after replacement; once written it cannot be changed. The engine runs normally; inspection stations may reject a missing VIN.
bilingual_description.de: Seit Modelljahr 2005 verlangt CARB, dass genau ein Steuergerät die Fahrgestellnummer (VIN) an das Diagnosegerät meldet und dass beim Programmieren der VIN alle abgasrelevanten Diagnosedaten gelöscht werden. P0630 heißt: Das Motorsteuergerät hat keine gültige oder eine unpassende VIN. GM prüft laufend, ob jede VIN-Stelle ein gültiges ASCII-Zeichen ist (ältere Tabellen: Byte 00 oder FF gilt als leer), 250 ms, Leuchte in der ersten Fahrt. Bei Ford sendet das Karosseriesteuergerät bei jedem Start VIN, Reifenumfang und Achsübersetzung, und P0630 steht, solange nur Standardwerte gespeichert sind – er umfasst also mehr als die VIN; der Diesel 2023 prüft binnen 0,5 s. Hyundai verlangt, die VIN nach dem Tausch zu schreiben; danach ist sie nicht mehr änderbar. Der Motor läuft normal; Prüfstellen können eine fehlende VIN bemängeln.

symptoms: Check engine light (some Ford trucks without)
Scan tool shows no or a wrong VIN
Ford: wrong tyre or axle data, speedometer errors

description: P0631 is the transmission module counterpart of P0630: the transmission control module holds no VIN, an invalid one, or one that does not match the vehicle – usually compared with the VIN of the engine or body module. Typical is a replaced transmission module or mechatronic unit (on dual-clutch and automatic gearboxes with integrated control) that was not VIN-programmed, or a used part. Depending on the architecture the transmission module itself or the engine module sets the code. No manufacturer table or bulletin available to us names P0631; the description follows CARB's VIN rules and the documented P0630 procedure (Hyundai, Ford), where the VIN is distributed to all modules that need it and stored once. Shifting is usually normal, but adaptations or configuration may be blocked.
possible_causes: Transmission module or mechatronic unit replaced, VIN not written [HIGH]
Used transmission module from another vehicle [MEDIUM]
Interrupted transmission module programming [MEDIUM]
CAN communication fault during the VIN comparison [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Depending on the architecture the transmission module itself or the engine module sets the code. No manufacturer table or bulletin available to us names P0631; the description follows CARB's VIN rules and the documented P0630 procedure (Hyundai, Ford), where the VIN is distributed to all modules that need it and stored once. bilingual_description.de: P0631 ist das Getriebe-Gegenstück zu P0630: Das Getriebesteuergerät hat keine, eine ungültige oder eine nicht zum Fahrzeug passende Fahrgestellnummer – meist verglichen mit der VIN von Motor- oder Karosseriesteuergerät. Typisch ist ein getauschtes Getriebesteuergerät bzw. eine Mechatronik (bei Doppelkupplungs- und Automatikgetrieben mit integrierter Steuerung) ohne VIN-Programmierung oder ein Gebrauchtteil. Je nach Architektur setzt das Getriebe- oder das Motorsteuergerät den Code. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellertabelle oder Bulletin nennt P0631; die Beschreibung folgt den CARB-Regeln zur VIN und dem belegten Vorgehen bei P0630 (Hyundai, Ford), wo die VIN an alle Module verteilt und einmalig gespeichert wird. Das Schalten ist meist normal, Anlernwerte oder Konfiguration können aber gesperrt sein.

symptoms: Check engine light or transmission warning
Scan tool shows no or a wrong VIN in the transmission module

description: Engine modules increasingly keep their own copy of the odometer reading or take it over from the instrument cluster or body module; for model years 2019–2021 onward CARB requires mileage in the module's operating data records and explicitly mentions the case 'odometer is lost'. P0632 means the engine module holds no valid odometer value. It typically appears after the engine module was replaced and the mileage was neither transferred with the tool nor taken over from the cluster. GM notes for the 2019–20 Cadillac CT6-V that mileage is stored redundantly in engine module, body module and cluster, and that programming several of them at once can corrupt it – program one after the other. No manufacturer table available to us names P0632 itself. Driving is normal; service and operating counters may be implausible.
possible_causes: Engine module replaced, mileage not transferred [HIGH]
Several modules (engine, body, cluster) replaced or programmed at the same time [MEDIUM]
No communication to the cluster or body module during takeover [LOW]
Internal memory fault (EEPROM/NVM) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Motorsteuergeräte führen zunehmend eine eigene Kopie des Kilometerstands oder übernehmen ihn von Kombiinstrument oder Karosseriesteuergerät; ab den Modelljahren 2019–2021 verlangt CARB den Kilometerstand in den Betriebsdatenaufzeichnungen und nennt ausdrücklich den Fall „Kilometerstand verloren“. P0632 heißt: Das Motorsteuergerät hat keinen gültigen Kilometerstand. Typisch ist er nach einem Tausch des Motorsteuergeräts, wenn der Stand weder per Tester übertragen noch vom Kombiinstrument übernommen wurde. GM weist für den Cadillac CT6-V 2019–20 darauf hin, dass der Kilometerstand redundant in Motor-, Karosseriesteuergerät und Kombiinstrument liegt und dass gleichzeitiges Programmieren mehrerer davon ihn verfälschen kann – nacheinander programmieren. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellertabelle nennt P0632 selbst. Das Fahrverhalten ist normal; Service- und Betriebszähler können unplausibel sein.

symptoms: Check engine light (depending on the maker)
Scan tool shows no or a different mileage in the engine module
Implausible service or oil change displays

description: The immobiliser couples the engine module to the immobiliser control module (GM body module, Chrysler SKIM/WCM) through a secret key and a challenge-response exchange – 'key' here means these security data, not the ignition key. P0633 means the engine module has not learned this secret key yet. At GM and Saab the code is set automatically whenever the engine module enters learn mode, for example as a new part, and clears after a successful learn and engine start; it is only a real fault if learn mode does not end, often because the engine fails to start for another reason. Chrysler calls it 'SKIM secret key not stored in PCM' and fixed false settings on the 2012–13 Grand Voyager 2.8 diesel by software. The engine does not start or dies after one or two seconds; the security lamp, not the check engine light, comes on.
possible_causes: Engine module replaced, immobiliser not learned [HIGH]
Learn procedure aborted or learn mode not exited (no start for another reason) [MEDIUM]
Communication fault to the immobiliser module [MEDIUM]
Engine module software fault (false setting) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Die Wegfahrsperre koppelt das Motorsteuergerät über einen Geheimschlüssel und einen Frage-Antwort-Austausch an das Wegfahrsperren-Steuergerät (GM Karosseriesteuergerät, Chrysler SKIM/WCM) – „Schlüssel“ meint hier diese Sicherheitsdaten, nicht den Zündschlüssel. P0633 heißt: Das Motorsteuergerät hat diesen Geheimschlüssel noch nicht gelernt. Bei GM und Saab wird der Code automatisch gesetzt, sobald das Motorsteuergerät in den Lernmodus geht, etwa als Neuteil, und erlischt nach erfolgreichem Anlernen und Motorstart; ein echter Fehler ist er nur, wenn der Lernmodus nicht endet, oft weil der Motor aus anderem Grund nicht anspringt. Chrysler nennt ihn „SKIM-Geheimschlüssel nicht im PCM gespeichert“ und behob fälschliches Setzen beim Grand Voyager 2.8 Diesel 2012–13 per Software. Der Motor springt nicht an oder geht nach ein, zwei Sekunden aus; es leuchtet die Sicherheits-, nicht die Motorkontrollleuchte.

symptoms: Engine does not start or dies immediately
Security or immobiliser lamp on or flashing
Code present after engine module replacement until learned

description: The module measures its own circuit board temperature with an internal sensor and sets P0634 when it overheats. In practice this concerns mainly transmission modules mounted in or on the gearbox, such as GM's 6T70/6T75 and 6L units with the module in the valve body, surrounded by transmission fluid. GM sets it at 142 °C or more for 5 s (Saab 9-4X: 146 °C), or at 50 °C or more with system voltage of 18 V or higher for 2 s, because overvoltage heats the output stages. The Saab 9-4X then goes into limp mode with only reverse and 5th gear, manual shifting disabled and maximum line pressure; GM's table rates it without the check engine light. Check transmission overtemperature (P0218) first, then fluid level and cooler, engine cooling and charging voltage. Faults of the internal temperature sensor circuit are P0666–P0669.
possible_causes: Transmission fluid too hot: cooler clogged, lines kinked, air flow blocked, wrong level [HIGH]
Engine overheating [MEDIUM]
Charging system overvoltage (18 V or more) [MEDIUM]
Faulty internal temperature sensor or valve body module [MEDIUM]
High sustained load (towing, mountain driving, heat) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät misst mit einem internen Sensor die Temperatur seiner eigenen Platine und setzt P0634 bei Überhitzung. Praktisch betrifft das vor allem Getriebesteuergeräte im oder am Getriebe, etwa GMs 6T70/6T75 und 6L mit dem Steuergerät im Schieberkasten, umspült von Getriebeöl. GM setzt ihn bei 142 °C oder mehr für 5 s (Saab 9-4X: 146 °C) oder bei 50 °C oder mehr mit 18 V Bordspannung oder höher für 2 s, weil Überspannung die Endstufen zusätzlich erwärmt. Der Saab 9-4X geht dann in den Notlauf mit nur Rückwärts- und 5. Gang, gesperrter Tippschaltung und maximalem Leitungsdruck; GMs Tabelle führt ihn ohne Motorkontrollleuchte. Zuerst Getriebeöl-Übertemperatur (P0218) prüfen, dann Ölstand und Kühler, Motorkühlung und Ladespannung. Kreisfehler des internen Temperatursensors sind P0666–P0669.

symptoms: Transmission limp mode (fixed gear), harsh shifts
Transmission warning, check engine light depending on the maker

description: P0635–P0637 concern the control or signal circuit between engine module and power steering – depending on the maker the drive of an electro-hydraulic pump or the steering load signal the engine module uses to raise idle. CARB requires power steering components to be monitored only if another diagnostic uses them, so these codes are rare and maker-specific. Mercedes-Benz stores P0635 in the electric steering module itself (no assist after start, software update); no engine module table available to us uses P0635–P0637. P0635 is the general or open-circuit code; output components must be checked for circuit faults, but separate low/high codes (P0636/P0637) are not mandatory. Steering assist may fail or be reduced; without the load signal idle can sag at full lock. The power steering pressure switch family is P0550–P0554.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between engine module and steering module or pump open or corroded [HIGH]
Software or calibration fault in the steering module (Mercedes) [MEDIUM]
Steering module or electro-hydraulic pump faulty [MEDIUM]
Undervoltage from weak battery, alternator or poor ground [MEDIUM]
Engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0635–P0637 betreffen den Steuer- oder Signalkreis zwischen Motorsteuergerät und Servolenkung – je nach Hersteller die Ansteuerung einer elektrohydraulischen Pumpe oder das Lastsignal der Lenkung, mit dem das Motorsteuergerät den Leerlauf anhebt. CARB verlangt die Überwachung von Servolenkungsbauteilen nur, wenn eine andere Diagnose sie nutzt; die Codes sind daher selten und herstellerspezifisch. Mercedes-Benz speichert P0635 im Steuergerät der elektrischen Lenkung selbst (keine Unterstützung nach dem Start, Software-Update); keine uns vorliegende Motorsteuergeräte-Tabelle nutzt P0635–P0637. description: The electronic throttle motor positions the throttle plate; P0638 means the actuator does not follow its command on bank 1 (or the only throttle): target and actual angle from the two position sensors differ, or the motor needs too much duty cycle to hold the position. Subaru (also sold as Saab 9-2X) sets it at more than 3.5° deviation for 250 ms or over 95 % duty cycle for 2 s, lights the lamp at once and lets the spring set the plate to about 6° – raised idle, almost no power. GM's Saab 9-4X V6 uses more than 80 % duty cycle for over 1 s, lamp in the first trip. Mazda's CX-9 set it after frosty nights when condensation froze the throttle and fixed it with software that moves the plate after switch-off. Ford reports the same function as P2111/P2112.
possible_causes: Throttle dirty, sooted or stiff [HIGH]
Icing from condensation in frost [MEDIUM]
Throttle motor or gears worn [MEDIUM]
Resistance in the motor control wires [MEDIUM]
Module or software [LOW]

description: P0639 is the bank 2 counterpart of P0638 and only applies to engines with two separate electronic throttles, one per cylinder bank (some V8, V10 and V12 engines with separate intake paths). The module compares target and actual angle and the duty cycle the motor needs; if the plate does not follow, it is de-energised and springs to its rest position, and power is limited. No manufacturer document available to us uses P0639 – this follows P0638 (Subaru: more than 3.5° deviation for 250 ms) and CARB's function check of output components. Ford calls a second throttle 'throttle actuator B' and reports it as P211A ff, its sensors as sensor C (P0225/P0229). Uneven filling of the two banks can also cause a rough idle.

description: Some charging systems measure the actual battery or alternator voltage through a separate sense line (regulator terminal S or an input of the module) to compensate voltage drops in the charging cable; without it the system reports a charging fault. No manufacturer document available to us uses P063A–P063D, so these descriptions follow the circuit principle and CARB, under which a charging-system input needs the check engine light only if it affects emissions or other diagnostics. P063A is the general or open-circuit code of sense circuit A; range, low and high are P063B–P063D. It differs from the F feedback (P0622/P0625/P0626) and the L line (P0621); the module's own supply voltage is monitored as P0560–P0563.

description: Some modules configure themselves at start-up by detecting which inputs are present. P063E means the module expects a throttle position input for bank 1 but does not detect it. Unlike circuit codes such as P0122/P0123 or P2135, which judge a present but faulty signal, this says the input was not found for the configuration. No manufacturer document or patent available to us describes this check; the explanation is derived from the J2012 wording. CARB requires input components to be checked for circuit continuity and plausibility, and modules with several variants to detect a wrong one. Possible causes are an unplugged throttle body or open wiring, or software meant for a different vehicle. Without a throttle signal an electronic throttle runs in limp mode.

P063E heißt: Das Steuergerät erwartet einen Drosselklappeneingang für Bank 1, erkennt ihn aber nicht. Anders als Kreiscodes wie P0122/P0123 oder P2135, die ein vorhandenes, aber fehlerhaftes Signal bewerten, besagt dieser Code, dass der Eingang für die Konfiguration nicht gefunden wurde. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage und kein Patent beschreibt diese Prüfung; die Erklärung ist aus dem J2012-Wortlaut abgeleitet. Mögliche Ursachen sind eine abgesteckte Drosselklappe oder unterbrochene Leitungen oder Software für ein anderes Fahrzeug. Ohne Drosselklappensignal läuft ein E-Gas-System im Notlauf.

description: Some modules configure themselves at start-up by detecting which inputs are present. P063F means the module expects a coolant temperature input but does not detect it during this self-configuration. CARB requires the coolant temperature sensor to be monitored for circuit, range and warm-up. Possible causes are an unplugged NTC sensor, an open wire or software for a different vehicle. Expect a substitute temperature, a constantly running fan, a dead temperature gauge and poorer cold starts.

description: Some diesels (for example GM's 6.6 L Duramax LML and the Cummins in Ram trucks) warm the intake air with a heater grid switched by a relay or semiconductor switch. P0640 reports a fault in its control circuit. GM's LML glow plug module expects a digital feedback from the heater while it is commanded on; if it is missing for 2 s (75 % of 4 s), the code sets and the lamp follows after two trips. Current, voltage and temperature faults run under GM's own codes P154A–P154D. CARB requires intake air heaters to be checked for response, current and voltage drop. The result is poor cold starts, white smoke and rough running after a cold start; a relay stuck on drains the battery – Ram recalled 2021 trucks because a shorted heater relay could overheat. Ford's 2023 diesel does not use P0640.

Control wire or connector open or corroded [MEDIUM]
Heater grid burnt out or shorted to ground [MEDIUM]

bilingual_title.en: Intake Air Heater Control Circuit

bilingual_description.en: Some diesels (for example GM's 6.6 L Duramax LML and the Cummins in Ram trucks) warm the intake air with a heater grid switched by a relay or semiconductor switch. P0640 reports a fault in its control circuit. GM's LML glow plug module expects a digital feedback from the heater while it is commanded on; if it is missing for 2 s (75 % of 4 s), the code sets and the lamp follows after two trips. Current, voltage and temperature faults run under GM's own codes P154A–P154D. CARB requires intake air heaters to be checked for response, current and voltage drop. The result is poor cold starts, white smoke and rough running after a cold start; a relay stuck on drains the battery – Ram recalled 2021 trucks because a shorted heater relay could overheat. Ford's 2023 diesel does not use P0640.
bilingual_description.de: Manche Diesel (etwa GMs 6,6-l-Duramax LML und der Cummins in Ram-Pick-ups) wärmen die Ansaugluft mit einem Heizgitter, das ein Relais oder Halbleiterschalter schaltet. P0640 meldet einen Fehler in dessen Steuerkreis. GMs Glühsteuergerät beim LML erwartet bei eingeschaltetem Heizer eine digitale Rückmeldung; fehlt sie 2 s lang (75 % von 4 s), setzt der Code, die Leuchte folgt nach zwei Fahrten. Strom-, Spannungs- und Temperaturfehler laufen unter GMs eigenen Codes P154A–P154D. CARB verlangt, Ansaugluftheizer auf Reaktion, Strom und Spannungsabfall zu prüfen. Folgen sind schlechte Kaltstarts, weißer Rauch und unrunder Lauf nach Kaltstart; ein hängendes Relais leert die Batterie – Ram rief 2021er-Modelle zurück, weil ein kurzgeschlossenes Heizerrelais überhitzen konnte. Fords Diesel 2023 nutzt P0640 nicht.

description: The engine module feeds several sensors (pedal, throttle, pressure and position sensors) from shared, regulated 5 V reference circuits; 'A' is circuit 1. A short on one sensor or its wire pulls down every sensor on that circuit and triggers many follow-up codes – so look for the one faulty sensor or chafed wire, for example by unplugging the sensors one at a time. P0641 is the general code for circuit A. GM puts everything into this one code: reference outside 4.875–5.125 V or jumping (filtered against unfiltered value), 19 of 39 counts or 0.19 s in a row, lamp in the first trip; circuits 2–4 are P0651, P0697 and P06A3, and GM does not use P0642/P0643. GM Europe's 2.0 L diesel flags it outside 4.5–5.5 V for 0.5 s with reduced engine power (two trips), the 2.0 L petrol after 1 s or 10 s cumulative (first trip). Because throttle and pedal sensors may be affected, limp mode is common.

A sensor signal wire shorted to voltage [MEDIUM]
Harness damage (chafing, rodent bite, water in connector) [MEDIUM]
Module internal (reference regulator) [LOW]

description: P0644 concerns a dedicated serial line on which the engine module sends values or warnings to a driver display or information display – not the general vehicle CAN bus. The module reports missing or invalid communication on that line (open, short, display not answering); CARB requires digital outputs to be checked for communication faults. GM Europe's 2010 Saab, for example, passes engine data such as fuel level over CAN to the body module and on to the instrument unit and information display – where such data runs on the bus, a failure is reported as a U code (e.g. U0155) instead. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the description follows CARB and the component. Displays then show missing, frozen or jumping information; the engine runs normally.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between module and receiver open, corroded or shorted [HIGH]
Display or instrument cluster faulty or without supply (fuse, ground) [MEDIUM]
Low system voltage during cranking [LOW]
Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Informationsdisplay sendet – nicht den allgemeinen Fahrzeug-CAN. description: The engine module switches the A/C compressor clutch relay through a low-side driver once the climate control requests cooling. P0645 is the general circuit fault of the relay coil control, usually an open circuit. GM Europe's 2011 Saab 9-5 sets P0645/P0646 for an open or short to ground and P0647 for a short to voltage, with the engine running and A/C requested; Ford's commercial trucks report it without the check engine light. Older Saab diesels (Bosch EDC16/PSG16) use a different assignment (P0645 short to voltage, 0.6 s). GM found a no-start with P0645 on the 2002–04 Alero/Grand Am 3.4 L because a shorted compressor clutch coil blew a fuse shared with the engine control; Ford traced warm air with P0645 on the 2020–23 Explorer to spread terminals at the body module. The compressor then does not engage or runs constantly.
possible_causes: A/C clutch relay faulty (coil open) [HIGH]
Control wire or connector open, terminals spread [HIGH]
Relay or clutch supply fuse blown (e.g. shorted clutch coil) [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 15€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The engine module switches the A/C compressor clutch relay through a low-side driver once the climate control requests cooling. P0646 means the voltage at the control output is too low while the driver is off – the control wire is shorted to ground, so the relay can pull in permanently and the compressor keeps running, which can ice up the evaporator. Saab's EDC16 diesels set it after more than 0.6 s with the engine running; GM Europe's 2011 Saab 9-5 also includes an open circuit here. Ford's OBD summaries list P0646/P0647 in a 5 V reference section for Bosch modules – an unusual assignment not covered here. The code is not emission relevant and does not light the check engine lamp at most makers.

Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]

description: The engine module switches this hard-wired output with its own driver and checks the circuit electrically (open, short to ground or voltage) – it cannot see whether the lamp lights; on CAN-based cars such faults appear as U codes. P0648 concerns the immobiliser or security lamp where the engine module drives it directly by wire – on GM and Saab systems this lamp shows the immobiliser learn mode and faults. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the description follows CARB and the component. The lamp then does not show the immobiliser status, or shows it permanently; the immobiliser itself keeps working, because start authorisation is separate (key faults are P0513/P0633). The immobiliser is not an emission component, so no check engine light is expected.

Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]

Cruise control possibly disabled (depending on the maker)

description: Demand-controlled fuel systems drive the pump through a separate pump control module; the engine module sets the target and reads its status back. P064A means this module reports an internal fault. Ford petrol engines encode the status as a duty cycle on a monitor line – 30 % (±4 %) means internal driver fault, 20 % invalid data (P025B), no signal U0109 – and set the code after 2–5 s; Ford's 2023 diesel checks the period of the monitor signal (0–1.2 s, 0.5 s). GM's pump module sets P064A when its output stage exceeds 150 °C (3 of 15 samples), with the lamp after two trips; Ford petrol stores it without the lamp. Pump output may be reduced or switched off, so low fuel pressure, stalling or a no-start can follow. A stiff, worn pump drawing high current can overheat the module.
possible_causes: Pump control module faulty internally (output stage, electronics) [HIGH]
Output stage overheating from a stiff or worn pump or poor module cooling [MEDIUM]
Supply or ground fault or corrosion at the module (often on frame or tank) [MEDIUM]
Disturbed monitor line, so a wrong duty cycle is read [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

P064A heißt: Dieses Modul meldet einen internen Fehler. Ford-Benziner kodieren den Status als Tastgrad auf einer Rückmeldeleitung – 30 % (±4 %) bedeutet interner Treiberfehler, 20 % ungültige Daten (P025B), kein Signal U0109 – und setzen den Code nach 2–5 s; Fords Diesel 2023 prüft die Periodendauer des Rückmeldesignals (0–1,2 s, 0,5 s). symptoms: Check engine light (GM) or stored code only (Ford petrol)
Hard start, stumbling or lack of power from low fuel pressure
Stalling or no start if the pump is switched off
Fuel pressure codes as well (e.g. P0087)

description: A power take-off (PTO) drives equipment on trucks and pick-ups – tipper, crane, hydraulic pump or winch – from the engine or transmission. A PTO control module, or the PTO function in the engine module, manages switching, working speed and release conditions; P064B reports a fault of this module or an implausible PTO request. The only manufacturer document found is a Chrysler case for Ram chassis cabs: with the PTO engaged the engine speed hunts and does not rise above about 1100 rpm, P064B sets together with the torque monitoring code P061B and the PTO switches off; the cause was software, so check upfitter installation and programming before replacing parts. CARB defines PTO units and allows monitors to pause while one is active. Thresholds and lamp status are not published; driving is usually normal.
possible_causes: Engine or PTO module software or calibration (implausible torque or speed request) [HIGH]
PTO equipment installed or programmed incorrectly by the upfitter [MEDIUM]
Harness, connector or supply of the PTO module or switches [MEDIUM]
PTO control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Ein PTO-Steuergerät oder die PTO-Funktion im Motorsteuergerät regelt Ein- und Ausschalten, Arbeitsdrehzahl und Freigaben; P064B meldet einen Fehler dieses Moduls oder eine unplausible PTO-Anforderung. Einzige gefundene Herstellerunterlage ist ein Chrysler-Fall zu Ram-Fahrgestellen: Bei eingelegtem Nebenabtrieb pendelt die Drehzahl und steigt nicht über etwa 1100/min, P064B setzt zusammen mit dem Momentenüberwachungscode P061B, und der Nebenabtrieb schaltet ab; Ursache war Software – vor einem Teiletausch also Aufbauereinbau und Programmierung prüfen. CARB definiert Nebenabtriebe und erlaubt, Überwachungen bei aktivem Nebenabtrieb auszusetzen. Schwellen und Leuchtenstatus sind nicht veröffentlicht; der Fahrbetrieb ist meist normal.

symptoms: PTO switches off or cannot be engaged
Engine speed hunts with PTO active or stays below about 1100 rpm (Chrysler)
Warning lamp or stored code; driving usually normal

description: On diesels a glow plug control module switches the glow plugs (at Ford also the DEF heaters) with semiconductor switches, diagnoses itself and reports to the engine module. P064C means this module reports an internal fault. GM's 2017–18 Duramax checks for a switch that is commanded on but delivers less than 3.2 A and 0 V at the plug (3.5 s), ROM, RAM and EEPROM checksums, the charge pump of the high-side drivers and reverse polarity; the LML (2011–16) used under 6.6 A for 75 % of 4 s; lamp after two trips. Ford's 2023 diesels flag drivers that do not switch or overheat, a RAM checksum error, supply below 6.5 or above 16.5 V and module temperature above 125 °C, within about 1 s. The glow system then fails partly or completely: hard cold starts, white smoke and higher cold-start emissions.
possible_causes: Glow plug module faulty internally (switches, memory) [HIGH]
Insufficient supply or ground (battery, corrosion, main fuse) [MEDIUM]
Short in a glow plug or wire overloading a driver [MEDIUM]
Moisture or corrosion in the connector of the engine-mounted module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Bei Dieseln schaltet ein Glühsteuergerät die Glühkerzen (bei Ford auch die AdBlue-Heizer) über Halbleiterschalter, diagnostiziert sich selbst und meldet an das Motorsteuergerät. P064C heißt: Dieses Modul meldet einen internen Fehler. GMs Duramax 2017–18 prüft auf einen Schalter, der eingeschaltet ist, aber unter 3,2 A und 0 V an der Kerze liefert (3,5 s), auf ROM-, RAM- und EEPROM-Prüfsummen, die Ladungspumpe der High-Side-Treiber und Verpolung; der LML (2011–16) nutzte unter 6,6 A für 75 % von 4 s; Leuchte nach zwei Fahrten. Fords Diesel 2023 melden Treiber, die nicht schalten oder überhitzen, einen RAM-Prüfsummenfehler, Versorgung unter 6,5 oder über 16,5 V und Modultemperatur über 125 °C, binnen etwa 1 s. Die Glühanlage fällt dann teilweise oder ganz aus: schwere Kaltstarts, weißer Rauch und höhere Kaltstartemissionen.

symptoms: Check engine and glow plug lamp
Hard cold start, long cranking in cold weather
White smoke and rough running after a cold start
Glow plug circuit codes as well

description: Wide-band oxygen sensors need a pump current control; inside the engine module a dedicated chip (ASIC, for example Bosch's CJ125 family) regulates it, measures lambda, diagnoses sensor wiring and heater, and talks to the main processor via SPI. P064D means this chip for bank 1 sensor 1 does not work correctly or its messages are invalid. Ford validates the SPI communication continuously and sets P064D/P064E after 10 s at 11–18 V with the sensor heater working; an internal chip fault adds Ford's P1646/P1647. GM (wide-band engines such as the 3.0 L twin turbo, 2018–2025) evaluates two error counters from the chip and sets the code at 128 of 160 samples (about 4 s), more than 20 s after start-up, with the lamp after two trips. Fuel control then runs open loop and oxygen sensor monitors are disabled – fuel consumption and emissions rise. Faults in the sensor or wiring can also push the chip into an invalid state.
possible_causes: Engine module (lambda chip) faulty [HIGH]
Wiring or sensor fault pushing the chip into an invalid state (short to battery voltage, water in connector) [MEDIUM]
Faulty wide-band sensor (e.g. heater-to-signal short) [MEDIUM]
Voltage dips or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1200€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Breitband-Lambdasonden brauchen eine Pumpstromregelung; im Motorsteuergerät übernimmt das ein eigener Baustein (ASIC, etwa Boschs CJ125-Familie), der den Pumpstrom regelt, Lambda misst, Sondenleitungen und Heizung diagnostiziert und per SPI mit dem Hauptprozessor spricht. P064D heißt: Dieser Baustein für Bank 1 Sensor 1 arbeitet nicht korrekt oder seine Meldungen sind ungültig. Ford prüft die SPI-Kommunikation laufend und setzt P064D/P064E nach 10 s bei 11–18 V und funktionierender Sondenheizung; ein interner Bausteinfehler bringt zusätzlich Fords P1646/P1647. GM (Breitbandmotoren wie der 3,0-l-Biturbo, 2018–2025) wertet zwei Fehlerzähler des Bausteins aus und setzt den Code bei 128 von 160 Proben (etwa 4 s), mehr als 20 s nach dem Start, Leuchte nach zwei Fahrten. Die Gemischregelung läuft dann gesteuert, Sondenüberwachungen sind gesperrt – Verbrauch und Abgaswerte steigen. Auch Fehler an Sonde oder Leitung können den Baustein in einen ungültigen Zustand bringen.

symptoms: Higher fuel consumption, rough running (open loop)
Codes for the bank 1 sensor 1 wide-band sensor

description: Wide-band oxygen sensors need a pump current control; inside the engine module a dedicated chip (ASIC, for example Bosch's CJ125 family) regulates it, measures lambda, diagnoses sensor wiring and heater, and talks to the main processor via SPI. P064E is the bank 2 counterpart of P064D and only occurs on V and boxer engines with two sensors before the catalysts. Ford sets it when the SPI communication with the bank 2 chip fails (10 s; an internal chip fault adds Ford's P1647); GM uses the same error counters as for bank 1 (128 of 160 samples, lamp after two trips). Fuel control on bank 2 then runs open loop, with higher consumption and emissions. Check the bank 2 sensor 1 wiring and sensor first; if they are fine, the engine module is the likely cause.
possible_causes: Engine module (lambda chip bank 2) faulty [HIGH]
Wiring or connector fault of the bank 2 sensor 1 [MEDIUM]
Bank 2 wide-band sensor faulty [MEDIUM]
Voltage dips or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1200€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Die Gemischregelung von Bank 2 läuft dann gesteuert, mit höherem Verbrauch und mehr Abgasen. Zuerst Leitung und Sonde von Bank 2 Sensor 1 prüfen; sind sie in Ordnung, ist das Motorsteuergerät die wahrscheinliche Ursache.

symptoms: Codes for the bank 2 sensor 1 wide-band sensor

description: P064F means the module has found that its software or calibration is not the version released by the manufacturer, or fails an authenticity check (signature, checksum, security keys). CARB requires manufacturers to protect calibrations against changes without special tools and to report calibration IDs and checksums. GM's 2025 engine modules set it when the embedded message authentication table for secured bus messages is invalid, with the lamp in the first trip; chassis modules also check missing key storage or wrong key-slot configuration. Chrysler fixed P064F on the 2017 Ram 3500–5500 chassis cab 6.7 L Cummins by reprogramming – so it is not only about tuning. Typical triggers are tuning software, an interrupted or wrong reflash, a module from another vehicle, or a module replaced without learning its security keys. Programming released software usually clears it.
possible_causes: Unapproved or tuned software (chip tuning, programmer) [HIGH]
Faulty or interrupted reflash, outdated software [MEDIUM]
Used or replaced module without learning the security keys, wrong configuration [MEDIUM]
Module faulty internally (key storage) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Unauthorized Software/Calibration Detected

bilingual_description.en: P064F means the module has found that its software or calibration is not the version released by the manufacturer, or fails an authenticity check (signature, checksum, security keys). CARB requires manufacturers to protect calibrations against changes without special tools and to report calibration IDs and checksums. GM's 2025 engine modules set it when the embedded message authentication table for secured bus messages is invalid, with the lamp in the first trip; chassis modules also check missing key storage or wrong key-slot configuration. Typical triggers are tuning software, an interrupted or wrong reflash, a module from another vehicle, or a module replaced without learning its security keys. Programming released software usually clears it.
bilingual_description.de: P064F heißt: Das Steuergerät hat festgestellt, dass seine Software oder Kalibrierung nicht der vom Hersteller freigegebenen Fassung entspricht oder eine Echtheitsprüfung (Signatur, Prüfsumme, Sicherheitsschlüssel) nicht besteht. CARB verlangt von Herstellern, Kalibrierungen gegen Änderungen ohne Spezialwerkzeug zu schützen und Kalibrierkennungen und Prüfsummen auszugeben. GMs Motorsteuergeräte von 2025 setzen ihn, wenn die eingebettete Tabelle zur Authentifizierung gesicherter Busnachrichten ungültig ist, Leuchte in der ersten Fahrt; Fahrwerkssteuergeräte prüfen zusätzlich fehlenden Schlüsselspeicher oder falsche Schlüsselplatz-Konfiguration. Chrysler behob P064F beim Ram 3500–5500 Chassis Cab 6.7 l Cummins von 2017 per Neuprogrammierung – es geht also nicht nur um Tuning. Typische Auslöser sind Tuning-Software, ein abgebrochenes oder falsches Flashen, ein Steuergerät aus einem anderen Fahrzeug oder ein Tausch ohne Anlernen der Sicherheitsschlüssel. Freigegebene Software aufzuspielen behebt es meist.

symptoms: Check engine light (GM in the first trip)
Possibly follow-up codes in other modules or communication problems

description: The engine module switches the check engine light (MIL) through a low-side driver – or sends the command over CAN – and monitors the circuit: with the lamp off the line must carry supply voltage, with it on nearly 0 V. CARB requires the MIL to light for a bulb check at ignition on with the engine off (at least 15 s since model year 2005). GM's 2018–2025 modules use P0650 only for an open circuit (200 kΩ or more, above 11 V, 50 ms) and P263A/P263B for shorts to ground and voltage – stored without lighting the MIL, since a broken MIL cannot report itself; older GM diesels combine all faults in P0650. GM Europe's Saab 9-5 V6 checks only once the MIL has been commanded on and off. The engine runs normally, but emission faults go unseen and inspections fail if the lamp does not light at the bulb check.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between engine module and instrument cluster open or corroded [HIGH]
MIL bulb burnt out or LED/instrument cluster faulty [HIGH]
MIL supply in the cluster missing (fuse, ignition feed) [MEDIUM]
Short in the circuit (at GM reported as P263A/P263B) [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät schaltet die Motorkontrollleuchte (MIL) über einen Low-Side-Treiber – oder sendet den Befehl per CAN – und überwacht den Kreis: Bei aus geschalteter Leuchte muss auf der Leitung Versorgungsspannung liegen, bei eingeschalteter nahezu 0 V. CARB verlangt, dass die MIL bei Zündung an und stehendem Motor zum Lampentest leuchtet (seit Modelljahr 2005 mindestens 15 s). GMs Steuergeräte von 2018–2025 nutzen P0650 nur für eine Unterbrechung (200 kΩ oder mehr, über 11 V, 50 ms) und P263A/P263B für Masse- und Plusschluss – gespeichert ohne MIL, denn eine defekte MIL kann sich nicht selbst anzeigen; ältere GM-Diesel fassen alle Fehler in P0650 zusammen. GM-Europas Saab 9-5 V6 prüft erst, nachdem die MIL einmal an- und ausgeschaltet wurde. Der Motor läuft normal, aber Abgasfehler bleiben unbemerkt, und Prüfstellen lehnen ab, wenn die Leuchte beim Lampentest nicht aufleuchtet.

symptoms: MIL does not light at the bulb check
MIL stays on (with a short or combined code)
Code only visible with a scan tool, engine runs normally

description: The engine module feeds several sensors (camshaft, pedal, pressure sensors) from separate regulated 5 V reference circuits; 'B' is circuit 2. A short at one sensor pulls the whole reference down, so every sensor on it reports at once – unplug them one by one until the reference returns to 4.8–5.2 V. P0651 is the general code for circuit B. GM puts all faults into it: reference outside 4.875–5.125 V or jumping, 19 of 39 counts or 0.19 s in a row, with the lamp in the first trip (2018; GM's 2006 V6 used 10 s and two trips). GM Europe's 2.0 L turbo feeds all four camshaft sensors and pedal sensor 1 from it and also uses P0652/P0653 (1 s or 10 s cumulative). Ford reports reference B only as range/performance P06A7. Expect limp mode if the pedal sensor is affected, and starting problems or stalling if camshaft sensors are.
possible_causes: Short in the wire or sensor of a connected sensor (camshaft, pedal, pressure) [HIGH]
Chafing or water in harness or connector [MEDIUM]
A sensor signal wire shorted to voltage [MEDIUM]
Module internal voltage regulator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0651 ist der allgemeine Code für Kreis B. GM fasst alle Fehler darin zusammen: Referenz außerhalb 4,875–5,125 V oder springend, 19 von 39 Zählungen oder 0,19 s am Stück, Leuchte in der ersten Fahrt (2018; GMs V6 von 2006 nutzte 10 s und zwei Fahrten). GM-Europas 2,0-l-Turbo versorgt daraus alle vier Nockenwellensensoren und Pedalsensor 1 und nutzt zusätzlich P0652/P0653 (1 s oder 10 s kumuliert). Ford meldet Referenz B nur als Bereich/Funktion P06A7. Zu erwarten sind Notlauf, wenn der Pedalsensor betroffen ist, und Startprobleme oder Ausgehen bei den Nockenwellensensoren.

symptoms: Several sensor codes at once (camshaft, pedal, pressure)

description: The engine module feeds several sensors (camshaft, pedal, pressure sensors) from separate regulated 5 V reference circuits; 'B' is circuit 2. A short at one sensor pulls the whole reference down, so every sensor on it reports at once – unplug them one by one until the reference returns to 4.8–5.2 V. P0652 means reference B is too low – usually the 5 V line or a connected sensor is shorted to ground. GM's 6.6 L Duramax LB7/LLY (2004–05) sets it below 4.7 V for 2 s; GM Europe's 2.0 L turbo after 1 s or 10 s cumulative, each with the lamp in the first trip. Newer GM engines report it under the collective code P0651, and Ford does not use P0652. All sensors on the circuit then read low, with matching codes, limp mode and possibly starting problems.
possible_causes: 5 V reference wire shorted to ground (chafing) [HIGH]
Sensor on the reference circuit shorted internally [HIGH]
Moisture or corrosion in a connector [MEDIUM]
Module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The engine module feeds several sensors (camshaft, pedal, pressure sensors) from separate regulated 5 V reference circuits; 'B' is circuit 2. A short at one sensor pulls the whole reference down, so every sensor on it reports at once – unplug them one by one until the reference returns to 4.8–5.2 V. P0653 means reference B is too high – often a signal wire of a connected sensor has chafed onto a 12 V line, less often the reference wire itself. GM's Duramax LB7/LLY (2004–05) sets it above 5.2 V for 2 s; GM Europe's 2.0 L turbo after 1 s or 10 s cumulative, each with the lamp in the first trip. Newer GM engines report it as P0651, Ford does not use it. Sensor readings then become implausibly high and limp mode follows.
possible_causes: Reference or sensor signal wire shorted to a 12 V line [HIGH]
Faulty sensor feeding in external voltage [MEDIUM]
Module voltage regulator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The engine module switches this hard-wired output with its own driver and checks the circuit electrically (open, short to ground or voltage) – it cannot see whether the lamp lights; on CAN-based cars such faults appear as U codes. P0654 concerns the engine speed output: the module turns the crankshaft signal into a cleaned-up square wave for the tachometer and other modules – Saab's 1999 9-3, for example, sends two pulses per revolution, about 30 Hz at idle. P0654 reports an open circuit or other fault on this output. Saab's EDC16 diesels use P0654 differently (a sensor supply group). No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the description follows CARB and the component. The tachometer then reads zero or jumps; devices using the signal may fail, while the engine itself runs normally because the crankshaft input is intact.
possible_causes: Wire between module and tachometer or receiver open, connector corroded [HIGH]
Output wire shorted [MEDIUM]
Instrument cluster or receiving module faulty (input stage) [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The engine module switches this hard-wired output with its own driver and checks the circuit electrically (open, short to ground or voltage) – it cannot see whether the lamp lights; on CAN-based cars such faults appear as U codes. P0655 concerns the engine hot or coolant warning lamp that the engine module switches by wire from the coolant temperature signal. CARB links overtemperature protection strategies to this lamp: a protective reaction that only starts after the hot lamp lights needs no MIL. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the description follows CARB and the component. If the circuit fails, the driver may not be warned of overheating – check it promptly even though the check engine light usually stays off. Actual overheating is P0217; the coolant sensor circuit is P0117/P0118.

Bulb/LED or instrument cluster faulty [MEDIUM]
Lamp supply missing (fuse) [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]

description: The engine module switches this hard-wired output with its own driver and checks the circuit electrically (open, short to ground or voltage) – it cannot see whether the lamp lights; on CAN-based cars such faults appear as U codes. Where the engine module reads the fuel level sender itself – it needs the level for the evaporative leak test – it passes the level on to the fuel gauge. GM Europe's 2010 Saab 9-5 reads two senders (0.5–3.5 V), calculates the level in percent and sends it over CAN via the body module to the instrument cluster; there a failure would be a U code. P0656 reports a fault on a hard-wired level output. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the description follows CARB and the component. The gauge then reads empty, full or jumps and the low fuel warning is wrong; engine and evaporative test are not affected. Sender input faults are P0460–P0464.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between module and instrument cluster open or shorted [HIGH]
Instrument cluster (fuel gauge input) faulty [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the module faulty [LOW]
Fuel level sender fault as root cause [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 450€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Actuator supply A is a high-side switch feeding several actuators together; its use differs by maker (Ford transmission solenoids, GM shared high-side driver, GM Europe 2.0 CDTI internal 5 V supply). P0657 is the open-circuit code; it is documented at Ford: the high-side switch of the 5R110W and 6R80 automatics feeds all shift solenoids, and the 2023 diesels split them into two supplies (P0657 and P2669), checked continuously. On a fault the solenoids are de-energised and the transmission falls back to a mechanical limp gear with maximum line pressure – harsh shifts and a single forward gear. Ford's 6.8 L V10 reports it with or without the lamp depending on the variant. GM does not use P0657 and reports opens together with ground faults under P0658.
possible_causes: Open or connector fault at the transmission pass-through connector or wire to the valve body [HIGH]
Damaged harness [MEDIUM]
Internal high-side switch in the engine or transmission module [MEDIUM]
Internal transmission harness [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Actuator supply A is a high-side switch feeding several actuators together; its use differs by maker (Ford transmission solenoids, GM shared high-side driver, GM Europe 2.0 CDTI internal 5 V supply). P0658 means the supply output is too low with the driver on – a short to ground (0.5 Ω or less). GM's engine module checks its shared high-side driver in 20 of 25 samples; the lamp rating changed from none (2016) via two trips (2017–18) to the first trip (2025). GM's transmission modules include an open circuit here, set it in the first trip and block the solenoid diagnostics, so the gearbox goes into limp mode. On GM Europe's 2.0 CDTI it means the internal 5 V supply is too low – no MIL, and if it recurs, the engine module is replaced.
possible_causes: Actuator supply wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Actuator (solenoid) shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Transmission harness or connector (also open, in transmission modules) [MEDIUM]
Module internal (main cause on the Saab diesel) [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Demand-controlled (smart) charging lets the module vary alternator voltage; the charging system is not an emission component, so these codes usually come without the check engine light. P065A is the function check of the whole charging strategy. Chrysler (Stellantis) explains it as a non-MIL code: the engine module switches off demand-controlled charging and falls back to normal charging because of electrical faults in other modules – returned alternators replaced for P065A were found to be fine. Other Stellantis cases trace it, together with P2503/P2504, to loose B+ or high-current connections, and the Ram 1500 3.0 EcoDiesel Gen 3 received a software update. The result is a constant charging voltage instead of smart charging, possibly with a battery lamp; there is no power limitation. Check codes in other modules and the main battery connections before replacing the alternator.
possible_causes: Electrical fault in another module (lighting, wipers, blower) disabling smart charging [HIGH]
Loose or corroded B+ or high-current connection [MEDIUM]
Engine module software [MEDIUM]
Alternator or regulator faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Bei bedarfsgeregelter Ladung („Smart Charging“) variiert das Steuergerät die Generatorspannung; das Ladesystem ist kein Abgasbauteil, diese Codes kommen daher meist ohne Motorkontrollleuchte. P065A ist die Funktionsprüfung der gesamten Ladestrategie. Chrysler (Stellantis) erklärt ihn als Code ohne MIL: Das Motorsteuergerät schaltet die Bedarfsladung wegen Elektrikfehlern anderer Steuergeräte ab und fällt auf normale Ladung zurück – wegen P065A getauschte Generatoren waren ohne Befund. Andere Stellantis-Fälle führen ihn zusammen mit P2503/P2504 auf lose B+- oder Hochstromverbindungen zurück, und der Ram 1500 3.0 EcoDiesel Gen 3 bekam ein Software-Update. Folge ist eine konstante Ladespannung statt Bedarfsladung, eventuell mit Ladekontrollleuchte; eine Leistungsbegrenzung gibt es nicht. Vor einem Generatortausch Codes anderer Steuergeräte und die Hauptverbindungen der Batterie prüfen.

description: Demand-controlled (smart) charging lets the module vary alternator voltage; the charging system is not an emission component, so these codes usually come without the check engine light. P065B is the plausibility check of the control channel to the alternator regulator (LIN or a dedicated smart-charge line): command and feedback do not match, or the signal is out of range (too low or too high). A manufacturer table published via NHTSA for a gateway with LIN alternator shows the battery lamp and disabled stop-start, notes that jump starting or charging can set it briefly, and says to check P065C (belt) first; Ford's 6.8 L V10 reports it with or without the lamp depending on the variant. The regulator then falls back to a default target voltage. Circuit faults are P0620; L and F lines are P0621/P0622.
possible_causes: LIN or control wire between alternator and module (connector, corrosion, open) [HIGH]
Weak battery, jump start or external charging [MEDIUM]
Alternator regulator faulty [MEDIUM]
Ground or B+ connections [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Der Regler fällt dann auf eine Standard-Sollspannung zurück. Kreisfehler sind P0620, L- und F-Leitung P0621/P0622.

description: Demand-controlled (smart) charging lets the module vary alternator voltage; the charging system is not an emission component, so these codes usually come without the check engine light. P065C points to the alternator's mechanical drive: the alternator does not deliver as commanded or its feedback does not match engine speed, typically because the belt slips. The only manufacturer document found – a table for a gateway with LIN alternator published via NHTSA – shows the battery lamp and disabled stop-start and names checking and adjusting the drive belt tension as the fix, to be checked before P065B. Thresholds are not published. Belt wear or oil contamination, a weak tensioner, a faulty overrunning pulley or a stiff alternator bearing are the obvious mechanical causes. Hybrid starter-generators use other codes.
possible_causes: Drive belt slipping (tension, wear, oil) [HIGH]
Weak belt tensioner [MEDIUM]
Alternator overrunning pulley faulty [MEDIUM]
Alternator bearing or rotor stiff [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Thresholds are not published. Belt wear or oil contamination, a weak tensioner, a faulty overrunning pulley or a stiff alternator bearing are the obvious mechanical causes. Hybrid starter-generators use other codes.

P065C deutet auf den mechanischen Antrieb des Generators: Der Generator liefert nicht wie angefordert, oder seine Rückmeldung passt nicht zur Motordrehzahl, typisch weil der Riemen rutscht. Die einzige gefundene Herstellerunterlage – eine über NHTSA veröffentlichte Tabelle für ein Gateway mit LIN-Generator – nennt Ladekontrollleuchte und abgeschaltetes Start-Stopp und als Abhilfe, die Riemenspannung zu prüfen und einzustellen, noch vor P065B. Schwellen sind nicht veröffentlicht. Riemenverschleiß oder Öl am Riemen, ein schwacher Spanner, eine defekte Freilaufriemenscheibe oder ein schwergängiges Generatorlager sind die naheliegenden mechanischen Ursachen. Hybrid-Startergeneratoren nutzen andere Codes.

description: The engine module switches this hard-wired output with its own driver and checks the circuit electrically (open, short to ground or voltage) – it cannot see whether the lamp lights; on CAN-based cars such faults appear as U codes. On SCR diesels a separate lamp or symbol warns of low DEF/AdBlue level, poor quality or system faults and announces speed or start restrictions (inducement). P065D reports a fault in the control circuit of this lamp. CARB requires inputs and outputs of the inducement strategy to be monitored on diesels from model years 2019–2021, and US federal rules define the inducement stages; Detroit Diesel, for example, shows the symbol below 1/8 tank and flashes it with a speed limit when empty. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the description follows CARB and the component. Without the lamp the driver may run into an inducement stage without warning; the code itself is not known to trigger one.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between module and receiver open, corroded or shorted [HIGH]
Bulb/LED or instrument cluster faulty [MEDIUM]
Lamp supply missing (fuse) [MEDIUM]
Driver in the engine or SCR module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The intake manifold tuning valve switches the manifold length or plenum connection with engine speed (more torque low, more power high); it is not the runner or swirl flap (IMRC, P2004 ff). P065E is the function check for bank 1 (or the only valve): the valve does not follow its command. It can be detected with a position sensor or, as a GM patent describes, without one from the intake pressure pulsation in steady running – a closed, tuned manifold pulses more. No manufacturer table available to us uses P065E itself: GM reports the same fault on this valve as P2070/P2071 (end position not reached within 5 s, 320 of 400 samples, two trips), and Ford's valve has no feedback at all. A valve stuck in one position leaves a torque gap in part of the rev range; sooted shafts and broken linkages are typical causes.
possible_causes: Valve shaft or linkage stiff or sooted (oil mist from crankcase ventilation or EGR) [HIGH]
Plastic lever or ball joint between actuator and shaft broken or detached [MEDIUM]
Actuator motor or solenoid faulty (weak, gears) [MEDIUM]
Manifold leak or, on vacuum-operated actuators, a leak in the vacuum line [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The intake manifold tuning valve switches the manifold length or plenum connection with engine speed (more torque low, more power high); it is not the runner or swirl flap (IMRC, P2004 ff). P065F is the function check of the bank 2 valve: it does not follow its command, detected via a position sensor or the intake pressure pulsation (GM patent). description: The intake manifold tuning valve switches the manifold length or plenum connection with engine speed (more torque low, more power high); it is not the runner or swirl flap (IMRC, P2004 ff). P0660 means the control circuit of the bank 1 (or only) valve is open. GM evaluates the line voltage with the driver off: too low means the supply through the coil is missing (200 kΩ or more). GM's engines with this valve (low-side driver) check with ignition voltage of at least 11 V and the engine above 400 rpm and set the code after 40 of 50 samples (about 0.6 s), with the check engine light after two trips. Ford uses P0660 (older: P1549) as the electrical check of its actuator, which has no position feedback and stays closed and unpowered below about 2600 rpm – without the check engine light (5 s). The valve then stays in its rest position and power at high revs suffers.
possible_causes: Actuator connector loose, corroded or spread [HIGH]
Actuator coil or motor open internally [HIGH]
Broken or chafed wire (control or supply) [MEDIUM]
Supply (fuse, main relay) to the actuator missing [LOW]
Output driver in the engine module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 20€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: Modern diesel glow systems switch each glow plug through its own power semiconductor (in a glow plug module or the engine module), so current and faults can be measured per plug; a faulty channel is switched off. CARB requires glow plugs to be checked for correct current and voltage drop and, since model year 2010, a single plug outside specification to be detected and named. P066A means the circuit to the cylinder 1 glow plug is shorted to ground or draws overcurrent. GM's engine-module drivers flag a circuit impedance to ground below 0.11 Ω (10 of 20 samples at 100 ms) with the check engine and glow plug lamps after two trips; Ford's 2023 Power Stroke checks during heating for more than 22 A for 0.3 s or 20–22 A for 2 s. The channel is switched off, so plug 1 no longer heats – harder cold starts and white smoke follow. A plug shorted internally is the usual cause; a wrong plug type is another.
possible_causes: Glow plug cylinder 1 shorted internally (element against body) [HIGH]
Plug wire insulation damaged and shorted to ground (block, bracket) [MEDIUM]
Wrong plug type (resistance or voltage rating) [LOW]
Driver in the glow or engine module faulty, or software (GM 3.0 L 2020) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Moderne Diesel-Glühanlagen schalten jede Glühkerze über einen eigenen Leistungshalbleiter (im Glüh- oder Motorsteuergerät), sodass Strom und Fehler je Kerze messbar sind; ein fehlerhafter Kanal wird abgeschaltet. CARB verlangt, Glühkerzen auf korrekten Strom und Spannungsabfall zu prüfen und seit Modelljahr 2010 schon eine einzelne Kerze außerhalb der Spezifikation zu erkennen und zu benennen. P066A heißt: Der Kreis zur Glühkerze von Zylinder 1 hat Masseschluss oder zieht Überstrom. GMs Endstufen im Motorsteuergerät melden eine Kreisimpedanz gegen Masse unter 0,11 Ω (10 von 20 Proben zu 100 ms) mit Motorkontroll- und Vorglühleuchte nach zwei Fahrten; Fords Power Stroke 2023 prüft beim Glühen auf mehr als 22 A für 0,3 s oder 20–22 A für 2 s. Der Kanal wird abgeschaltet, Kerze 1 glüht nicht mehr – schwerere Kaltstarts und weißer Rauch folgen. Meist ist die Kerze innen kurzgeschlossen; ein falscher Kerzentyp ist eine weitere Ursache.

bilingual_title.en: Cylinder 3 Glow Plug Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Modern diesel glow systems switch each glow plug through its own power semiconductor (in a glow plug module or the engine module), so current and faults can be measured per plug; a faulty channel is switched off. CARB requires glow plugs to be checked for correct current and voltage drop and, since model year 2010, a single plug outside specification to be detected and named. P066F means the circuit to the cylinder 3 glow plug is shorted to battery voltage, so the driver cannot switch it off. GM's engine-module drivers detect an impedance to the supply below 0.5 Ω (0.14 Ω for low-resistance plugs) in 10 of 20 samples, with the lamps after two trips; Ford's 2023 Power Stroke sees 0 A through its measuring path while the plug is commanded on (about 1 s). A permanently powered low-voltage plug can overheat and burn through, after which an open-circuit code follows, and the battery may drain.
bilingual_description.de: Moderne Diesel-Glühanlagen schalten jede Glühkerze über einen eigenen Leistungshalbleiter (im Glüh- oder Motorsteuergerät), sodass Strom und Fehler je Kerze messbar sind; ein fehlerhafter Kanal wird abgeschaltet. CARB verlangt, Glühkerzen auf korrekten Strom und Spannungsabfall zu prüfen und seit Modelljahr 2010 schon eine einzelne Kerze außerhalb der Spezifikation zu erkennen und zu benennen. P066F heißt: Der Kreis zur Glühkerze von Zylinder 3 hat Plusschluss, die Endstufe kann ihn nicht abschalten. GMs Endstufen im Motorsteuergerät erkennen eine Impedanz zur Versorgung unter 0,5 Ω (0,14 Ω bei niederohmigen Kerzen) in 10 von 20 Proben, Leuchten nach zwei Fahrten; Fords Power Stroke 2023 misst bei eingeschalteter Kerze 0 A in seinem Messpfad (etwa 1 s). Eine dauernd bestromte Niedervoltkerze kann überhitzen und durchbrennen, danach folgt ein Unterbrechungscode, und die Batterie kann sich entladen.

description: In today's J2012 meaning P0670 is the electrical check of the activation line from the engine module to glow plug control module 1 for an open circuit; a short to ground is P0383, a short to voltage P0384, and serial communication between the modules P0683/P0684. On Bosch systems (Saab 2.2 TiD and EDC16) the engine module switches this line, detects an open load with the output off and a short to voltage with it on, and also compares the glow module's diagnostic feedback, which must switch inversely – Saab reports all line faults under P0670. GM's LB7/LLY Duramax (2004–05) used P0670 in an older meaning for glow module performance (50 of 100 samples, two trips). No current GM or Ford table uses it. If the line fails, no plug heats: hard or no cold start in frost, smoke and rough running.

Glow module faulty (input open) or without supply or ground (fuse, terminal 30) [MEDIUM]
Control line shorted (makers reporting all line faults under P0670, e.g. Saab) [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine module faulty [LOW]

description: The engine module switches its main relay coil to ground (control circuit), reads the switched voltage back on a sense line and keeps the relay on briefly after ignition off to save learned values. P0685 means the relay control circuit is open: GM measures with the driver off and flags 200 kΩ or more to ground. GM checks with run/crank voltage above 11 V and sets the code after 8 of 10 samples at 250 ms, with the lamp after two trips. GM Europe's 2.0 L turbo compares commanded and actual state for 2 s, Ford's 2023 diesel checks continuously within 0.5 s. A real open keeps the relay from pulling in – no start; on Saab's V6 there is then no communication with the engine module and the MIL flashes. GM notes P0686 may set alongside.

Weak battery or voltage dip [LOW]
Module driver faulty [LOW]

bilingual_description.en: The engine module switches its main relay coil to ground (control circuit), reads the switched voltage back on a sense line and keeps the relay on briefly after ignition off to save learned values. P068B is the counterpart of P068A: after ignition off and the module's switch-off command the relay voltage remains – the relay drops out late or not at all. GM Europe's 2.0 diesel runs this check from ignition off until the module shuts down and names a control line shorted to ground (coil stays energised), an output line shorted to voltage or a sticking contact as causes, without lighting the MIL. Modules and loads then stay powered and the battery drains. GM reports the same electrical faults as P0686/P0690 instead. A Ford diesel table lists 'P068B' for a memory error, which is evidently a typo for P06B8.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motorsteuergerät schaltet die Spule seines Hauptrelais nach Masse (Steuerkreis), liest die geschaltete Spannung über eine Rückmeldeleitung zurück und hält das Relais nach Zündung aus kurz, um Lernwerte zu sichern. P068B ist das Gegenstück zu P068A: Nach Zündung aus und dem Abschaltbefehl des Steuergeräts liegt die Relaisspannung weiter an – das Relais fällt zu spät oder gar nicht ab. GM-Europas 2,0-l-Diesel prüft das von Zündung aus bis zum Abschalten des Steuergeräts und nennt eine Steuerleitung mit Masseschluss (Spule bleibt bestromt), eine Ausgangsleitung mit Plusschluss oder einen klebenden Kontakt als Ursachen, ohne die MIL einzuschalten. Steuergeräte und Verbraucher bleiben dann versorgt, die Batterie entlädt sich. GM meldet dieselben elektrischen Fehler stattdessen als P0686/P0690. Eine Ford-Dieseltabelle nennt „P068B“ für einen Speicherfehler – offensichtlich ein Schreibfehler für P06B8.

symptoms: Relay or module stays active after ignition off (fan or pump keeps running)
Possibly check engine light (depending on the maker)

description: Modern diesel glow systems switch each glow plug through its own power semiconductor (in a glow plug module or the engine module), so current and faults can be measured per plug; a faulty channel is switched off. CARB requires glow plugs to be checked for correct current and voltage drop and, since model year 2010, a single plug outside specification to be detected and named. P068C means the circuit to the cylinder 7 glow plug is shorted to ground or draws overcurrent. GM's engine-module drivers flag an impedance to ground below 0.11 Ω (10 of 20 samples) with the check engine and glow plug lamps after two trips; Ford's 2023 Power Stroke checks during heating for more than 22 A for 0.3 s or 20–22 A for 2 s. The channel is switched off and plug 7 no longer heats – harder cold starts and white smoke follow.
possible_causes: Glow plug cylinder 7 shorted internally (element against body) [HIGH]
Plug wire insulation damaged and shorted to ground [MEDIUM]
Wrong plug type (resistance or voltage rating) [LOW]
Driver in the glow or engine module faulty, or software (GM bulletins) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The engine module switches its main relay coil to ground (control circuit), reads the switched voltage back on a sense line and keeps the relay on briefly after ignition off to save learned values. P0690 means the sense voltage is too high: voltage is present although the relay has been off for 2 s – a welded or sticking contact, or external voltage fed in through a short – or, on some systems, overvoltage above 18 V with the relay on. GM sets it at 4 V or more with the relay off, in 50 of 63 samples at 100 ms, lamp after two trips; GM Europe's 2.0 L turbo above 2 V with the relay off or above 18 V with it on, for 2 s, and advises fixing other short-to-voltage codes first. Modules, fans or pumps may keep running after switch-off and the battery drains overnight.
possible_causes: Relay contact sticking or welded [HIGH]
Short to voltage on the sense or load line (external feed from another component) [MEDIUM]
Control wire shorted to ground (relay permanently on) [MEDIUM]
Overvoltage from the alternator regulator (where the 18 V limit applies) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 10€ - 250€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The engine module switches the radiator fan relays (or the input of a PWM fan module) through output drivers and checks each control circuit electrically. GM sets a short to ground or voltage at 0.5 Ω or less after 50 of 63 samples, with the lamp after two trips; GM Europe's 2011 Saab 9-5 covers P0691–P0696 with relay assignments, the Saab 9-4X's PWM fan module reacts within 1 s. P0691 means the fan 1 control circuit is shorted to ground. GM fixed a related problem with bulletin 16-NA-123, Ford with SSM 47999 for the 6.7 L diesel. The former title 'Cooling Fan 1' was shortened to the J2012 wording, as for P0480.
possible_causes: Control wire to fan relay or module shorted to ground (chafing) [HIGH]
Water or corrosion in fan or relay connector [HIGH]
Fan relay faulty (coil shorted or low-resistance) [MEDIUM]
Engine module driver faulty [LOW]

description: The engine module switches the radiator fan relays (or the input of a PWM fan module) through output drivers and checks each control circuit electrically. Engine module driver faulty [LOW]

description: The engine module feeds sensors from several regulated 5 V reference circuits; a short at one sensor pulls the whole circuit down, so all its sensors report at once – unplug them one by one to find the culprit. Which sensors hang on circuit C depends on the maker – pedal sensor 2 is common to all: GM 2016–2025 feeds only pedal sensor 2 from it, the Saab 9-4X also the MAP sensor, the Saab 9-5 2.0 L turbo also throttle, crankshaft and A/C pressure sensors, and Bentley's 2026 Bentayga V8 lists its own set. P0697 is the general code for circuit C. GM puts all faults into it: reference outside 4.875–5.125 V or jumping, 19 of 39 counts or 0.19 s, lamp in the first trip; GM Europe's 2.0 L turbo also uses P0698/P0699.
possible_causes: Short in the wire or sensor of a connected sensor [HIGH]
Chafing or water in harness or connector [MEDIUM]
A connected sensor faulty internally [MEDIUM]
Module internal voltage regulator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Modern diesel glow systems switch each glow plug through its own power semiconductor (in a glow plug module or the engine module), so current and faults can be measured per plug; a faulty channel is switched off. CARB requires glow plugs to be checked for correct current and voltage drop and, since model year 2010, a single plug outside specification to be detected and named. P069A means the circuit to the cylinder 9 glow plug is shorted to ground or draws overcurrent. GM's engine-module drivers flag an impedance to ground below 0.11 Ω (10 of 20 samples) with the check engine and glow plug lamps after two trips; Ford's 2023 Power Stroke checks during heating for more than 22 A for 0.3 s or 20–22 A for 2 s. The channel is switched off and plug 9 no longer heats – harder cold starts and white smoke follow. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code for cylinders 9 and above; the description follows cylinders 1–8.
possible_causes: Glow plug cylinder 9 shorted internally (element against body) [HIGH]
Plug wire insulation damaged and shorted to ground [MEDIUM]
Wrong plug type (resistance or voltage rating) [LOW]
Driver in the glow or engine module faulty, or software (GM bulletins) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.
