description: A shift solenoid is an electrically switched valve in the valve body. Manufacturers use these codes differently: Ford reports an open circuit with the base code and shorts separately, newer GM units have separate low/high codes, and the letter is not tied to a valve number (Saab's 9-5: A = valve S2). P0750 is the general code for solenoid A and is used in practice for an open circuit: Ford's step automatics (2012–2023) set it when the smart driver feedback disagrees with the command for 0.5–5 s, with shorts to ground and power as P0973/P0974; Ram's 6.7 L with Aisin transmission calls it 'control circuit open', and a 2023 bulletin traces it to a leaking capacitor in the engine module. GM does not use P0750. With the solenoid unpowered the transmission falls back to a hydraulic default gear with maximum pressure.
possible_causes: Open or corroded wire or transmission pass-through connector [HIGH]
Solenoid coil open or shorted [MEDIUM]
Internal harness or electronic module in the transmission [MEDIUM]
Module driver faulty or valve supply missing [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid A

bilingual_description.en: A shift solenoid is an electrically switched valve in the valve body. Manufacturers use these codes differently: Ford reports an open circuit with the base code and shorts separately, newer GM units have separate low/high codes, and the letter is not tied to a valve number (Saab's 9-5: A = valve S2). P0750 is the general code for solenoid A and is used in practice for an open circuit: Ford's step automatics (2012–2023) set it when the smart driver feedback disagrees with the command for 0.5–5 s, with shorts to ground and power as P0973/P0974; Ram's 6.7 L with Aisin transmission calls it 'control circuit open', and a 2023 bulletin traces it to a leaking capacitor in the engine module. GM does not use P0750. With the solenoid unpowered the transmission falls back to a hydraulic default gear with maximum pressure.
bilingual_description.de: Ein Schaltmagnetventil ist ein elektrisch geschaltetes Ventil im Ventilkörper. Die Hersteller belegen diese Codes unterschiedlich: Ford meldet mit dem Grundcode eine Unterbrechung und Kurzschlüsse getrennt, neuere GM-Getriebe haben eigene Low/High-Codes, und der Buchstabe hängt nicht an einer Ventilnummer (Saabs 9-5: A = Ventil S2). P0750 ist der allgemeine Code für Ventil A und wird in der Praxis für eine Unterbrechung genutzt: Fords Stufenautomaten (2012–2023) setzen ihn, wenn die Rückmeldung des Smart-Drivers 0,5–5 s nicht zum Befehl passt, Masse- und Plusschluss als P0973/P0974; Rams 6,7 l mit Aisin-Getriebe nennt ihn „Steuerkreis offen“, und ein Bulletin von 2023 führt ihn auf einen undichten Kondensator im Motorsteuergerät zurück. GM nutzt P0750 nicht. Mit stromlosem Ventil fällt das Getriebe in einen hydraulischen Ersatzgang mit Maximaldruck.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning lamp
Limp mode in a fixed gear, no upshifts
Harsh shifts from maximum line pressure

description: A shift solenoid is an electrically switched valve in the valve body; together the solenoid states select the gear, and the module checks the result by gear ratio, slip or a pressure switch – the pattern of wrong gears shows which solenoid hangs off or on. P0751 means solenoid A is commanded on but valve, clutch or gear do not follow. GM's 6T70 flags a ratio of 1.34–1.48 with slip of 400 rpm for 0.3 s eight times and locks out first gear; GM 4-speeds recognise the pattern 2-2-3-3; both after two trips. Allison checks its pressure switch for 5 s after one trip. Ford's 'functionally failed off' covers the whole clutch circuit, and its 10R80 and 8F35 bulletins show purely mechanical causes such as a leaking clutch cylinder.
possible_causes: Shift spool in the valve body sticking (dirt, debris) [HIGH]
Internal leak or clutch fault in the circuit [MEDIUM]
Solenoid mechanically sluggish or screen clogged [MEDIUM]
Fluid level or quality wrong [MEDIUM]

bilingual_description.en: A shift solenoid is an electrically switched valve in the valve body; together the solenoid states select the gear, and the module checks the result by gear ratio, slip or a pressure switch – the pattern of wrong gears shows which solenoid hangs off or on. bilingual_description.de: Ein Schaltmagnetventil ist ein elektrisch geschaltetes Ventil im Ventilkörper; zusammen wählen die Ventilzustände den Gang, und das Steuergerät prüft das Ergebnis über Übersetzung, Schlupf oder Druckschalter – das Muster der falschen Gänge zeigt, welches Ventil aus oder an hängt. P0751 heißt: Ventil A ist eingeschaltet, Schieber, Kupplung oder Gang folgen aber nicht. GMs 6T70 meldet eine Übersetzung von 1,34–1,48 bei 400/min Schlupf für 0,3 s achtmal und sperrt den 1. Gang; GMs Viergang-Automaten erkennen das Muster 2-2-3-3; beide nach zwei Fahrten. Allison prüft seinen Druckschalter 5 s lang, nach einer Fahrt. Fords „functionally failed off“ umfasst den ganzen Kupplungskreis, und seine Bulletins zu 10R80 und 8F35 zeigen rein mechanische Ursachen wie einen undichten Kupplungszylinder.

symptoms: Pulling away in the wrong gear, weak acceleration

description: A shift solenoid is an electrically switched valve in the valve body; together the solenoid states select the gear, and the module checks the result by gear ratio, slip or a pressure switch – the pattern of wrong gears shows which solenoid hangs off or on. P0752 means solenoid A is commanded off but its clutch stays applied. GM's 6T70 flags slip of 400 rpm for 2 s five times after one trip and then runs only reverse, first and third with maximum pressure; GM's T43 a ratio of 3.83–4.23 (first instead of fourth); GM 4-speeds the pattern 1-1-4-4 after two trips; Allison its pressure switch after 2 s. Ford calls it 'functionally failed on'. A clutch that does not release can tie up the transmission.
possible_causes: Shift spool sticking in the applied position [HIGH]
Solenoid stuck open or leaking [MEDIUM]
Clutch not releasing (burnt or stuck) [MEDIUM]
Contaminated or wrong fluid [MEDIUM]

description: P075F is not a circuit fault but a condition: a working fluid level sensor reports a level above the target band – the counterpart of P070F. In the Allison patent the transmission module reports 'too high, drain a quart or more', measuring only with the vehicle at rest, warm fluid and low input speed. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code. Overfilling makes rotating parts churn the fluid, which foams, pressure control becomes unsteady, fluid escapes at the vent and temperature rises; an FCA bulletin traces poor shifting after repairs to overfilling. Automatic transmission fluid level depends strongly on temperature – topping up cold often overfills.

description: What shift solenoid E does depends on the transmission. On Ford's 6R80 and 6F35/6F55 it is an on/off valve that moves a multiplex valve, so solenoid D feeds either the low/reverse brake or the 4-5-6 clutch; on the 6R140 and 5R110W it is a proportional clutch valve with separate short codes (P0985/P0986). On Saab's Aisin 5-speed E is valve S1. P0770 is the general code for solenoid E; Ford uses it for an open circuit, detected when the smart driver feedback disagrees with the command for 0.5–5 s, and on the 6R80/6F it covers all circuit faults of the solenoid. On Ram's 6.7 L with Aisin AS69RC a 2023 bulletin traces P0770 to a leaking capacitor in the engine module, together with other circuit codes. Limp mode follows; on the 6R80/6F engine braking in first or the 4th–6th gears may be missing.
possible_causes: Open or corroded wire or transmission connector [HIGH]
Solenoid coil faulty [MEDIUM]
Transmission module or electronic module faulty [MEDIUM]
Solenoid supply missing [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt ihn; die Fachzeitschrift MOTOR nennt ihn als Leistungscode des Leitungsdruckventils B beim Ford 5R55, gesetzt zusammen mit Übersetzungscodes nach einem gebrochenen Overdrive-Servo. Die Untercodes für Funktion, hängt ein, elektrisch und sporadisch folgen (P0776–P0779).

description: Pressure control solenoids are current-controlled proportional valves, and what B and C mean depends on the design: on GM's clutch-to-clutch automatics they are the pressure valves of clutches 2 and 3, on GM's CVT B is primary pulley pressure and C line pressure, on Jatco CVTs B is the secondary pressure valve, on Saab's AF40 B and C are clutch valves SLC1/SLC2. P0776 means the valve is electrically fine but pressure stays too low. GM's 8-speed flags gear slip of 400 rpm for 1.5 s three times, the 9-speed clutch 2 slip over 200 rpm for 3 s, the CVT primary pressure below 200 kPa for 3 s – all after one trip. Mitsubishi's Jatco CVT flags secondary pressure 1.2 MPa off target; Nissan's bulletin calls for a mechanical CVT repair, a GM 6T70 bulletin a broken wave spring. Slipping, missing gears or lack of drive and limp mode follow.
possible_causes: Clutch, return spring or piston seal of the assigned clutch faulty [HIGH]
Valve body or pressure valve dirty or worn [HIGH]
CVT belt or pulley damaged (CVT) [MEDIUM]
Fluid level low, fluid worn, filter clogged [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 5000€ (2h - 14h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Some transmissions use an output shaft speed sensor that also reports direction of rotation: in a GM patent two offset Hall elements send one pulse per tooth whose width encodes forward or reverse. The direction is needed to detect rolling back on a hill (a Hyundai patent raises idle speed then), for hill hold, stop-start and the forward/reverse change. P077A means the sensor still delivers speed pulses but no usable direction information – the pulse width stays outside the direction windows or one Hall element has failed. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; GM checks direction coherence under P0721. Hill hold, auto hold or stop-start may then be disabled and the forward/reverse change runs in a substitute mode.
possible_causes: Output speed sensor faulty (one Hall element or direction channel failed) [HIGH]
Contact resistance in connector or wiring distorts the pulse [MEDIUM]
Wrong replacement sensor without direction function [MEDIUM]
Reluctor wheel damaged or air gap too large [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 500€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Manche Getriebe nutzen einen Abtriebsdrehzahlgeber, der auch die Drehrichtung meldet: In einem GM-Patent senden zwei versetzte Hall-Elemente je Zahn einen Impuls, dessen Breite vorwärts oder rückwärts kodiert. Die Richtung braucht es, um Zurückrollen am Berg zu erkennen (ein Hyundai-Patent hebt dann die Leerlaufdrehzahl an), für Berganfahrhilfe, Start-Stopp und den Wechsel zwischen Vorwärts und Rückwärts. P077A heißt: Der Geber liefert noch Drehzahlimpulse, aber keine verwertbare Richtungsinformation mehr – die Impulsbreite bleibt außerhalb der Richtungsfenster oder ein Hall-Element ist ausgefallen. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt diesen Code; GM prüft die Richtungsplausibilität unter P0721. Berganfahrhilfe, Auto-Hold oder Start-Stopp können dann abgeschaltet sein, der Wechsel Vorwärts/Rückwärts läuft in einem Ersatzmodus.

symptoms: Transmission warning or check engine light depending on manufacturer
Hill hold, auto hold or stop-start unavailable
Rolling back on a hill not caught

description: Some transmissions use an output shaft speed sensor that also reports direction of rotation: in a GM patent two offset Hall elements send one pulse per tooth whose width encodes forward or reverse. The direction is needed to detect rolling back on a hill (a Hyundai patent raises idle speed then), for hill hold, stop-start and the forward/reverse change. P077B means the sensor reports a direction that does not fit – for example reverse while a forward gear is engaged and the input and intermediate shaft sensors confirm forward motion. GM's transmission modules list P077B as a blocking condition for other checks, but run the actual check under their own codes: direction contradicts the gear for 2.5 s above 500 rpm, after one trip. Speed and direction are then unreliable: hill hold and the park and reverse logic fall back to substitute modes.
possible_causes: Output speed sensor faulty (direction evaluation disturbed) [HIGH]
Wrong or incorrectly fitted sensor (orientation to the wheel) [MEDIUM]
Reluctor wheel damaged, metal debris on the sensor [MEDIUM]
Faulty reference (input or intermediate shaft sensor) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 500€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Check engine light or transmission warning

description: GM's transmission modules from 2019 to 2025 (9- and 10-speeds) also read the active output speed sensor's line voltage as an analog value. P077C means this voltage is below 0.25 V – a short to ground of under about 0.5 Ω between signal and module ground – for more than 0.05 s with the system above 10 V; GM rates it after one trip. GM then blocks the no-signal and ratio checks so that P0722 is not set instead of the actual short. Without output speed the transmission enters limp mode and road speed may be missing. On GM's 10-speed input and output sensors share a supply.
possible_causes: Signal or supply wire shorted to ground (chafing at the case) [HIGH]
Sensor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Oil or moisture in the connector, corrosion [MEDIUM]
Module input faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 450€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: GMs Getriebesteuergeräte von 2019 bis 2025 (Neun- und Zehngang) lesen zusätzlich die Leitungsspannung des aktiven Abtriebsgebers als Analogwert. P077C heißt: Diese Spannung liegt unter 0,25 V – ein Masseschluss von unter etwa 0,5 Ω zwischen Signal und Steuergerätemasse – länger als 0,05 s bei über 10 V Bordspannung; GM stuft ihn nach einer Fahrt ein. GM sperrt dann die Prüfungen auf fehlendes Signal und Übersetzung, damit nicht P0722 statt des eigentlichen Kurzschlusses gesetzt wird. Ohne Abtriebsdrehzahl geht das Getriebe in den Notlauf, ggf. fehlt die Geschwindigkeit. Beim GM-Zehngang teilen sich Eingangs- und Abtriebsgeber eine Versorgung.

description: GM's transmission modules from 2019 to 2025 (9- and 10-speeds) also read the active output speed sensor's line voltage as an analog value. P077D is the mirror of P077C: the voltage is above 4.75 V – a short to the module supply of under about 0.5 Ω – for more than 0.05 s, after one trip. GM then blocks the no-signal and ratio checks; a GM hybrid also blocks its idle diagnosis. Without usable output speed the transmission enters limp mode, and speedometer or cruise control may fail.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to sensor supply or battery voltage [HIGH]
Sensor faulty internally [MEDIUM]
Ground fault at the sensor, corroded connector [MEDIUM]
Module input [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 450€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P077E is a plausibility check between several fluid temperature readings – for example sensors A and B, sump and valve body, or the module's internal temperature. If they differ by more than allowed after a settling time, such as a long stop, the code sets, without being able to blame a single sensor. No manufacturer document available to us uses it: GM checks each sensor alone (P0711, with the module temperature on the 6T70), and Ford has no multi-sensor check. A substitute value then limits converter clutch and shift adaption.
possible_causes: One temperature sensor drifting (aged NTC) [HIGH]
Contact resistance at a sensor connector or wire [MEDIUM]
Fluid level too low (sensor not wetted) [LOW]
Module or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 600€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Temperature Measurement System Multiple Sensor Correlation

bilingual_description.en: P077E is a plausibility check between several fluid temperature readings – for example sensors A and B, sump and valve body, or the module's internal temperature. If they differ by more than allowed after a settling time, such as a long stop, the code sets, without being able to blame a single sensor. bilingual_description.de: P077E ist eine Plausibilitätsprüfung zwischen mehreren Öltemperaturwerten – etwa Sensor A und B, Ölwanne und Ventilkörper oder Steuergeräte-Innentemperatur. Weichen sie nach einer Ausgleichszeit, etwa langer Standzeit, stärker als zulässig voneinander ab, setzt der Code, ohne einen einzelnen Sensor benennen zu können. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt ihn: GM prüft jeden Sensor einzeln (P0711, beim 6T70 mit der Steuergerätetemperatur), Ford kennt keine Mehrsensorprüfung. Ein Ersatzwert schränkt dann Wandlerkupplung und Schaltadaption ein.

symptoms: Transmission warning, possibly check engine light
Converter clutch applies late or not at all

description: P077F checks the ratio in a second reverse gear: input speed divided by output speed lies outside the tolerance band around the target ratio – a slipping clutch, a wrong gear or a sensor fault. Only transmissions with two reverse ratios need it, such as Mercedes' 7G-Tronic (−3.42 and −2.23, with the second reverse kept in limp mode) and its 5G-Tronic predecessor; GM's 9- and 10-speeds, Ford's 10R and ZF's 8HP have one. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the check works like the other ratio codes such as P0736.
possible_causes: Slipping clutch or brake in the second reverse power path [HIGH]
Fluid level low or fluid worn [MEDIUM]
Solenoid or pressure regulator sticking [MEDIUM]
Faulty input or output speed sensor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 3500€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Reverse 2 Incorrect Ratio

bilingual_description.en: P077F checks the ratio in a second reverse gear: input speed divided by output speed lies outside the tolerance band around the target ratio – a slipping clutch, a wrong gear or a sensor fault. Only transmissions with two reverse ratios need it, such as Mercedes' 7G-Tronic (−3.42 and −2.23, with the second reverse kept in limp mode) and its 5G-Tronic predecessor; GM's 9- and 10-speeds, Ford's 10R and ZF's 8HP have one. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; the check works like the other ratio codes such as P0736.
bilingual_description.de: P077F prüft die Übersetzung in einem zweiten Rückwärtsgang: Eingangs- geteilt durch Abtriebsdrehzahl liegt außerhalb des Toleranzbands um die Sollübersetzung – eine rutschende Kupplung, ein falscher Gang oder ein Geberfehler. Nur Getriebe mit zwei Rückwärtsstufen brauchen ihn, etwa die 7G-Tronic von Mercedes (−3,42 und −2,23, im Notlauf bleibt der zweite Rückwärtsgang) und ihr Vorgänger 5G-Tronic; GMs Neun- und Zehngang, Fords 10R und ZFs 8HP haben einen. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt diesen Code; die Prüfung arbeitet wie die übrigen Übersetzungscodes, etwa P0736.

symptoms: Transmission warning or check engine light

description: Shift codes are a functional check of the gear change itself: the module compares the commanded shift with the speed trace and flags a shift that takes too long, is too short or abrupt, does not happen, flares or ties up. Ford does not use P0780–P0784 (its shift completion check feeds the solenoid codes), nor do GM's 2018–2025 tables. P0780 is the collective code when the faulty shift is not assigned to a gear. GM's 2006 Aisin-type five-speed counts five shifts that are too long, too short or tied up with fluid above 60 °C and lights the MIL at once; GM's Honda-built unit flags a 3–4 shift that stays in the lower ratio after two trips; Saab's 2010 Aisin six-speed counts ten faulty shifts without MIL, limits torque and keeps second and reverse. Nissan fixed P0780 on the 2021 Rogue CVT with new software.
possible_causes: Fluid level wrong, fluid worn or contaminated [HIGH]
Valve body, shift or pressure valve sticking [HIGH]
Worn clutches or bands (mechanical damage) [MEDIUM]
Module software or shift adaption [MEDIUM]
Faulty speed sensor signal [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 3500€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Error

bilingual_description.en: Shift codes are a functional check of the gear change itself: the module compares the commanded shift with the speed trace and flags a shift that takes too long, is too short or abrupt, does not happen, flares or ties up. Ford does not use P0780–P0784 (its shift completion check feeds the solenoid codes), nor do GM's 2018–2025 tables. P0780 is the collective code when the faulty shift is not assigned to a gear. GM's 2006 Aisin-type five-speed counts five shifts that are too long, too short or tied up with fluid above 60 °C and lights the MIL at once; GM's Honda-built unit flags a 3–4 shift that stays in the lower ratio after two trips; Saab's 2010 Aisin six-speed counts ten faulty shifts without MIL, limits torque and keeps second and reverse. Nissan fixed P0780 on the 2021 Rogue CVT with new software.
bilingual_description.de: Schaltcodes sind eine Funktionsprüfung des Gangwechsels selbst: Das Steuergerät vergleicht den befohlenen Wechsel mit dem Drehzahlverlauf und meldet eine Schaltung, die zu lange dauert, zu kurz oder ruckartig ist, ausbleibt, hochdreht oder verspannt. Ford nutzt P0780–P0784 nicht (seine Schaltabschlussprüfung speist die Ventilcodes), GMs Tabellen von 2018–2025 ebenfalls nicht. P0780 ist der Sammelcode, wenn die fehlerhafte Schaltung keinem Gang zugeordnet wird. GMs Aisin-artiger Fünfgang von 2006 zählt fünf zu lange, zu kurze oder verspannte Schaltungen bei Öl über 60 °C und schaltet die MIL sofort ein; GMs von Honda gebautes Getriebe meldet eine 3–4-Schaltung, die in der niedrigeren Übersetzung bleibt, nach zwei Fahrten; Saabs Aisin-Sechsgang von 2010 zählt zehn Fehlschaltungen ohne MIL und behält nur 2. Gang und Rückwärts. Nissan behob P0780 beim Rogue-CVT (2021) per Software.

description: Shift codes are a functional check of the gear change itself: the module compares the commanded shift with the speed trace and flags a shift that takes too long, is too short or abrupt, does not happen, flares or ties up. Ford does not use P0780–P0784 (its shift completion check feeds the solenoid codes), nor do GM's 2018–2025 tables. P0781 names the 1–2 shift as the faulty one, up or down; slip in a steady gear is reported by the ratio codes instead. Lexus' AB60F six-speed (LX 570, 2008–11) lists P0781 among its transmission performance codes; the bulletin first checks fluid level, then installs new software and, if needed, a new transmission. No manufacturer publishes thresholds for P0781.

Valve body, shift or pressure valve sticking [HIGH]
Worn clutches or bands [MEDIUM]
Module software or shift adaption [MEDIUM]
Faulty speed sensor signal [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 3500€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: 'Shift timing solenoid' means different parts: on GM's 4L60-E the 3-2 downshift solenoid that times the band apply on that downshift, on Aisin five-speeds (GM, Saab) the linear valve SLS that sets clutch pressure during the shift, and on the 2017–18 Genesis G80/G90 with shift-by-wire the on/off solenoids that engage drive (A) and reverse (B). P0785 is the general circuit code for solenoid A. GM's 2006 tables use it for the 3-2 downshift solenoid circuit (more than 43 of 50 failed counts, after one trip); Saab's 2002 Aisin box for an open or short in the SLS circuit with warning lamp and limp mode; Hyundai's Genesis bulletins for the drive solenoid, replacing valve and electronic module and then the module if it returns. Limp mode, harsh 3-2 downshifts or – on the Genesis – no drive follow.
possible_causes: Solenoid coil open or shorted [HIGH]
Connector or wire at the transmission (oil, corrosion) [MEDIUM]
Electronic module or transmission module driver [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 900€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: „Shift Timing Solenoid“ meint unterschiedliche Bauteile: beim GM 4L60-E das 3-2-Rückschaltventil, das den Bandeinsatz bei dieser Rückschaltung steuert, bei Aisin-Fünfgängen (GM, Saab) das Linearventil SLS, das den Kupplungsdruck während des Schaltens stellt, und beim Genesis G80/G90 von 2017–18 mit Shift-by-Wire die Ein/Aus-Ventile, die Vorwärts (A) und Rückwärts (B) einlegen. P0785 ist der allgemeine Kreiscode für Ventil A. GMs Tabellen von 2006 nutzen ihn für den Kreis des 3-2-Rückschaltventils (über 43 von 50 Fehlzählungen, nach einer Fahrt); Saabs Aisin-Getriebe von 2002 für Unterbrechung oder Kurzschluss im SLS-Kreis mit Warnleuchte und Notlauf; Hyundais Genesis-Bulletins für das Vorwärts-Ventil und tauschen Ventil und E-Modul, bei Wiederkehr das Steuergerät. description: P078F is the circuit fault of a third transmission mode switch (C), after A (P071A–P071C) and B (P071D–P071F): its state is invalid or implausible. GM's transmission modules of 2023 and 2025 list the number only as a blocking condition for another check, without a description of their own; GM reports its drive mode selector today under P05D0–P05D3 (8-step resistor ladder, two trips). No manufacturer document available to us describes P078F itself. The mode then cannot be selected and the transmission stays on its normal schedule.
possible_causes: Switch or button faulty or sticking [HIGH]
Wire or connector open or shorted [MEDIUM]
Moisture or dirt in the centre console [MEDIUM]
Control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 250€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: P0790 is the circuit fault of the normal/performance (sport or power program) selector of an automatic transmission – the older single code that preceded the mode switch codes P071A ff; the early J2012 list still called it 'circuit malfunction'. The switch is usually a button to ground or a resistor ladder; a fault is an invalid level, a permanently pressed button or an open circuit. No manufacturer document available to us describes it; GM uses P05D0–P05D3 for its drive mode selector today. The sport program is then unavailable or permanently on.

Liquid in the console [MEDIUM]
Control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 250€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The intermediate shaft speed sensor measures a shaft between input and output – a countershaft on Toyota's U760 six-speed, the intermediate shaft behind the overdrive set on Ford's 5R110W. Together with turbine and output speed it lets the module check each gear stage and control clutch slip. Ford uses P0791 as its only intermediate shaft code, for 'no or too little signal': while the vehicle drives under power (turbine at least 1500 rpm, output at least 650 rpm or 15 mph), the sensor reports below 250 rpm for 5 s – in the 2012 and 2020–23 summaries, with MIL. A Toyota bulletin for the U760 (Highlander, Venza, Camry 2009–10) replaces the countershaft sensor for P0791/P0793. GM's 10-speed has two such sensors but uses its own codes. Limp mode and harsh shifts follow.
possible_causes: Intermediate shaft speed sensor faulty [HIGH]
Connector or wire at the transmission (oil, corrosion, chafing) [MEDIUM]
Reluctor wheel damaged or debris on the sensor [MEDIUM]
Control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 600€ (1.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Der Zwischenwellengeber misst eine Welle zwischen Eingang und Abtrieb – beim Toyota-Sechsgang U760 ein Vorgelegerad, beim Ford 5R110W die Zwischenwelle hinter dem Overdrive-Satz. Zusammen mit Turbinen- und Abtriebsdrehzahl kann das Steuergerät so jede Gangstufe prüfen und den Kupplungsschlupf regeln. Ford nutzt P0791 als einzigen Zwischenwellencode, für „kein oder zu wenig Signal“: Während das Fahrzeug unter Last fährt (Turbine mindestens 1500/min, Abtrieb mindestens 650/min oder 15 mph), meldet der Geber 5 s lang unter 250/min – in den Übersichten von 2012 und 2020–23, mit MIL. Ein Toyota-Bulletin zum U760 (Highlander, Venza, Camry 2009–10) tauscht bei P0791/P0793 den Vorgelegegeber. GMs Zehngang hat zwei solche Geber, nutzt aber eigene Codes. Es folgen Notlauf und harte Schaltungen.

description: The intermediate shaft speed sensor measures a shaft between input and output – a countershaft on Toyota's U760 six-speed, the intermediate shaft behind the overdrive set on Ford's 5R110W. Together with turbine and output speed it lets the module check each gear stage and control clutch slip. P0792 means a signal is present but implausible: intermediate shaft speed does not match turbine or output speed for the detected gear stage, exceeds a maximum or jumps unrealistically. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code – Ford uses only P0791, Toyota's bulletin P0791/P0793, GM its own codes; the logic follows GM's range checks for input and output sensors (P0716/P0721). Ratio codes, by contrast, point to clutch slip rather than a sensor fault.
possible_causes: Sensor delivering faulty pulses (air gap, reluctor wheel) [HIGH]
Interference or loose contact [MEDIUM]
Mechanical slip interpreted as a sensor fault [LOW]
Wrong sensor fitted [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 600€ (1.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Pressure control solenoids are current-controlled proportional valves, and what B and C mean depends on the design: on GM's clutch-to-clutch automatics they are the pressure valves of clutches 2 and 3, on GM's CVT B is primary pulley pressure and C line pressure, on Jatco CVTs B is the secondary pressure valve, on Saab's AF40 B and C are clutch valves SLC1/SLC2. P0795 is the general code for valve C. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM's 8-speed uses only P0796/P0797 for its clutch 3 valve, Saab's AF40 only P0798 for valve SLC2. Sub-codes for performance, stuck on, electrical and intermittent follow (P0796–P0799).
possible_causes: Valve body or pressure valve C [HIGH]
Fluid or line pressure [MEDIUM]
Circuit or coil [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 3000€ (1h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0795 is the general code for valve C. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM's 8-speed uses only P0796/P0797 for its clutch 3 valve, Saab's AF40 only P0798 for valve SLC2. bilingual_description.de: Druckregelventile sind stromgeregelte Proportionalventile, und was B und C bedeuten, hängt von der Bauart ab: Bei GMs Kupplung-zu-Kupplung-Automaten sind es die Druckventile der Kupplungen 2 und 3, beim GM-CVT ist B der Primärscheibendruck und C der Leitungsdruck, bei Jatco-CVTs ist B das Sekundärdruckventil, bei Saabs AF40 sind B und C die Kupplungsventile SLC1/SLC2. P0795 ist der allgemeine Code für Ventil C. description: The 'friction element slip' codes monitor a clutch that is commanded locked in a power-split hybrid transmission: the module calculates its slip from electric motor, engine and output speeds (target 0 rpm) and flags slip above a threshold for a minimum time, with sufficient line pressure and clutch torque; from 2016 GM also flags a calculated friction energy threshold at once. The letter matches the manufacturer's clutch number. P079A concerns clutch 1. On GM's Two-Mode SUVs and pickups (2008–13) that is the hybrid low/1-2 clutch, flagged above 200 rpm for 3 s after one trip; GM bulletins link it to a clogged line pressure orifice and the auxiliary oil pump. The Volt flags above 200 rpm in three attempts, Malibu Hybrid and Volt from 2016 190 rpm for 0.6 s or 8003 J. Chrysler's Pacifica PHEV fixes P079A by software, as a permanent code with MIL.
possible_causes: Clutch A plates worn or glazed [HIGH]
Too little line pressure: low or aged fluid, filter, auxiliary oil pump or blocked pressure orifice [MEDIUM]
Pressure or shift valve of clutch A or valve body sticking [MEDIUM]
Module software (false setting) [LOW]
Faulty speed signals (motor resolver, output) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4500€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: With electronic gear selection the park position sensor/switch reports the park request or position. On GM's shift-by-wire selectors (2017 LaCrosse, XT4/XT5, Bolt EV, later SUVs and pickups) it is the P button, read by two redundant analog sensors A and B with separate 'released' and 'pressed' voltage zones. No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; GM covers an open analog circuit under its low and high codes (P07B3/P07B4), which CARB allows when an open cannot be told apart from an out-of-range value. description: These low/high codes are a purely electrical check of the sensor's signal voltage at the module and run even with the vehicle at rest – unlike the circuit, range, no-signal and intermittent codes, which evaluate speed while driving. Low means a short to ground, high a short to supply or, depending on the circuit, an open. GM's transmission modules from 2019 (9-speed, 10-speed) flag below 0.25 V or above 4.75 V – a short of under 0.5 Ω – for more than 0.05 s with the system above 10 V for 5 s, after one trip. P07BF is the low side: a short to ground of the input sensor. A GM bulletin for 2019 nine-speed models (Enclave, Equinox, Malibu, XT4 and others) traces intermittent P07BF/P07C0 together with P0717 to an open inside the input speed sensor.
possible_causes: Signal or supply wire shorted to ground (chafing at the case) [HIGH]
Sensor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Oil or moisture in the connector [MEDIUM]
Module input faulty [LOW]

Sensor B is typically the second input shaft of a dual-clutch transmission (reverse and even gears); Ford's DPS6 reports it under P2765–P2767, and a VW/Getrag patent notes that the speed of a failed input shaft can be calculated from the other one. The expected logic follows GM's sensor A check (below 0.25 V).
bilingual_description.de: Diese Low/High-Codes sind eine rein elektrische Prüfung der Signalspannung des Gebers am Steuergerät und laufen auch im Stand – anders als die Codes für Kreis, Bereich, kein Signal und sporadisch, die die Drehzahl bei Fahrt auswerten. Low heißt Masseschluss, High Schluss zur Versorgung oder je nach Schaltung Unterbrechung. Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt diesen Code. Sensor B ist typisch die zweite Eingangswelle eines Doppelkupplungsgetriebes (Rückwärts und gerade Gänge); Fords DPS6 meldet ihn unter P2765–P2767, und ein VW/Getrag-Patent vermerkt, dass sich die Drehzahl einer ausgefallenen Eingangswelle aus der anderen berechnen lässt. Die erwartbare Logik folgt GMs Prüfung für Sensor A (unter 0,25 V).

description: Many automatics have a thermostat in the fluid cooler circuit or a coolant-to-oil heat exchanger: a BMW patent describes a wax thermostat that bypasses the cooler until about 76 °C, a Ford patent a heat exchanger that warms transmission fluid from the coolant after a cold start. P07CB means this thermostat does not work as expected: fluid warms up too slowly (stuck open) or overheats (stuck closed). No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; GM checks fluid warm-up under the temperature sensor code P0711 (below 15 °C after the warm-up time, two trips). The check works like CARB's engine thermostat monitor (P0128). Slow warm-up raises consumption and delays converter lock-up; overheating ages fluid quickly.
possible_causes: Transmission fluid thermostat stuck open or closed [HIGH]
Fluid temperature sensor drifting [MEDIUM]
Cooler lines or heat exchanger blocked or leaking [MEDIUM]
Very cold weather or short trips [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Thermostat Performance

bilingual_description.en: Many automatics have a thermostat in the fluid cooler circuit or a coolant-to-oil heat exchanger: a BMW patent describes a wax thermostat that bypasses the cooler until about 76 °C, a Ford patent a heat exchanger that warms transmission fluid from the coolant after a cold start. P07CB means this thermostat does not work as expected: fluid warms up too slowly (stuck open) or overheats (stuck closed). No manufacturer document available to us uses this code; GM checks fluid warm-up under the temperature sensor code P0711 (below 15 °C after the warm-up time, two trips). The check works like CARB's engine thermostat monitor (P0128). Slow warm-up raises consumption and delays converter lock-up; overheating ages fluid quickly.
bilingual_description.de: Viele Automatikgetriebe haben einen Thermostat im Ölkühlerkreis oder einen Kühlmittel-Öl-Wärmetauscher: Ein BMW-Patent beschreibt einen Dehnstoffthermostat, der den Kühler bis etwa 76 °C umgeht, ein Ford-Patent einen Wärmetauscher, der das Getriebeöl nach dem Kaltstart über das Kühlmittel aufheizt. P07CB heißt: Dieser Thermostat arbeitet nicht wie erwartet – das Öl wird zu langsam warm (hängt offen) oder überhitzt (hängt zu). Keine uns vorliegende Herstellerunterlage nutzt diesen Code; GM prüft das Aufwärmen unter dem Temperatursensor-Code P0711 (unter 15 °C nach der Aufwärmzeit, zwei Fahrten). Die Prüfung entspricht CARBs Überwachung des Motorthermostats (P0128). Langsames Aufwärmen erhöht den Verbrauch und verzögert die Wandlerüberbrückung; Überhitzung lässt das Öl schnell altern.

description: Transmission mode switches select alternative shift programs such as sport, winter or tow/haul; the J2012 family runs from A (P071A–P071C) and B (P071D–P071F) to C (base code P078F), D and E. No manufacturer document available to us uses switches C to E; GM reads its analog mode switch under its own codes (low below 21–29 % of 5 V, high from 94 %, two trips) and newer drive mode selectors under P05D0–P05D3. P07CC means the signal of mode switch C is below its lower limit – a short to ground or a button stuck against ground. The opposite is P07CD.

description: P07D7 means gear 8 cannot be disengaged: the module commands a shift out of 8th, but the transmission stays in it. It is the counterpart to P07D8, where gear 8 cannot be engaged. The only documented user is Maserati's eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox in the MC20 (from model year 2023), whose bulletin lists it next to the other 'Stuck in Gear' codes: hydraulic actuators move the shift forks, and a fork that does not reach neutral is reported. The repair path there first runs a service fast-learn with valve flushing and new adaptation, then records system pressure – it should hold 20–30 bar; drops below 5 bar point to the mechatronic unit, a stable pressure to the gearbox itself. No thresholds or trip counts are published.
possible_causes: Shift fork actuator or shift valve sticking (contamination) [HIGH]
System pressure low or unstable (mechatronic pressure valve) [MEDIUM]
Shift fork, synchronizer or gear damaged [MEDIUM]
Fluid or filter contaminated [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 9000€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: P07D7 means gear 8 cannot be disengaged: the module commands a shift out of 8th, but the transmission stays in it. It is the counterpart to P07D8, where gear 8 cannot be engaged. The only documented user is Maserati's eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox in the MC20 (from model year 2023), whose bulletin lists it next to the other 'Stuck in Gear' codes: hydraulic actuators move the shift forks, and a fork that does not reach neutral is reported. The repair path there first runs a service fast-learn with valve flushing and new adaptation, then records system pressure – it should hold 20–30 bar; drops below 5 bar point to the mechatronic unit, a stable pressure to the gearbox itself. No thresholds or trip counts are published.
bilingual_description.de: P07D7 heißt: Gang 8 lässt sich nicht auslegen – das Steuergerät befiehlt den Wechsel aus dem 8. Gang, das Getriebe bleibt aber drin. Er ist das Gegenstück zu P07D8, bei dem sich Gang 8 nicht einlegen lässt. Einziger belegter Nutzer ist Maseratis Achtgang-Doppelkupplungsgetriebe im MC20 (ab Modelljahr 2023); dessen Bulletin führt ihn neben den übrigen „Stuck in Gear“-Codes: Hydraulische Steller bewegen die Schaltgabeln, und eine Gabel, die die Neutralstellung nicht erreicht, wird gemeldet. Der Reparaturweg dort beginnt mit einem Schnell-Anlernen samt Ventilspülung und neuer Adaption und zeichnet dann den Systemdruck auf: Er soll 20–30 bar halten; Einbrüche unter 5 bar weisen auf die Mechatronik, stabiler Druck auf das Getriebe selbst. Schwellen und Fahrtenzahl sind nicht veröffentlicht.

symptoms: Transmission stays in gear 8 and will not downshift

description: 'Unable to Engage' means the transmission does not reach the commanded gear – here 8th. Documented users are eight-speed dual-clutch gearboxes with hydraulically moved, position-monitored shift forks. A GM bulletin for the 2020–23 Corvette lists it with the MIL on, caused by a solenoid or internal switch sticking from debris: valve cleaning is only advised when system pressure codes are present as well, otherwise a service fast-learn; if that fails, the mechanics are damaged. Maserati's MC20 lists it with a pressure check of 20–30 bar. On a dual-clutch box the half carrying the even gears may be locked out. No published thresholds or trip counts.
possible_causes: Sticking solenoid or shift valve in the mechatronic unit [HIGH]
System pressure too low or unstable [MEDIUM]

bilingual_title.en: Unable to Engage Gear 8

bilingual_description.en: 'Unable to Engage' means the transmission does not reach the commanded gear – here 8th. Documented users are eight-speed dual-clutch gearboxes with hydraulically moved, position-monitored shift forks. A GM bulletin for the 2020–23 Corvette lists it with the MIL on, caused by a solenoid or internal switch sticking from debris: valve cleaning is only advised when system pressure codes are present as well, otherwise a service fast-learn; if that fails, the mechanics are damaged. Maserati's MC20 lists it with a pressure check of 20–30 bar. On a dual-clutch box the half carrying the even gears may be locked out. No published thresholds or trip counts.
bilingual_description.de: „Unable to Engage“ heißt: Das Getriebe erreicht den befohlenen Gang nicht – hier den 8. Belegte Nutzer sind Achtgang-Doppelkupplungsgetriebe mit hydraulisch bewegten, wegüberwachten Schaltgabeln. Ein GM-Bulletin für die Corvette 2020–23 führt ihn mit eingeschalteter MIL; Ursache ist ein durch Schmutz klemmendes Magnetventil oder ein interner Schalter: Eine Ventilreinigung empfiehlt GM nur, wenn zusätzlich Systemdruck-Codes vorliegen, sonst ein Schnell-Anlernen; scheitert das, ist die Mechanik beschädigt. Maseratis MC20 führt ihn mit einer Druckprüfung auf 20–30 bar. Beim Doppelkupplungsgetriebe kann das Teilgetriebe mit den geraden Gängen gesperrt werden. Schwellen und Fahrtenzahl sind nicht veröffentlicht.

symptoms: Gear 8 skipped or never reached, higher rpm at cruise
Check engine and transmission warning lamp
Jerky shifts, possibly loss of one half of a dual-clutch gearbox

description: A ratio code compares input or turbine speed divided by output speed with the ratio of the commanded gear; a slipping clutch or the wrong gear trips it. Ford's summaries describe the check (over 30 rpm off for more than 1.8 s, three times) for gears 1–6 only; its 10-speed bulletins show gears 7–10 as P076F, P07D9, P07F6 and P07F7. P07D9 covers 8th gear. Ford's 10R80 (F-150, Mustang, Ranger, Expedition and others) and 10R140 (2020 Super Duty) list it in bulletins on harsh or delayed shifts, caused by adaptive learning, sticking valve-body valves or a migrating sleeve in a clutch cylinder. Nissan's nine-speed Frontier and Titan set it with the MIL on; a Stellantis bulletin pairs it with P0731 on low-mileage vehicles with wrong factory adaptives. Hyundai's eight-speeds and GM's 10-speed do not use it.

Shift adaptives wrong or not learned [HIGH]
Sticking valve in the valve body [MEDIUM]
Fluid level low or fluid degraded [MEDIUM]
Turbine or output speed sensor signal wrong [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4500€ (0.5h - 14h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Turbinendrehzahl geteilt durch Abtriebsdrehzahl mit der Übersetzung des befohlenen Gangs; eine rutschende Kupplung oder ein falscher Gang lösen ihn aus. Hyundais Achtgang und GMs Zehngang nutzen ihn nicht.

symptoms: Slipping or flaring engine speed in gear 8
Check engine or transmission warning lamp
Gear 8 locked out, higher rpm at cruise

description: Shift codes check the gear change itself: the module compares the commanded change with the speed trace and flags a shift that takes too long, does not happen, flares or binds up two clutches. They continue the series P0781 '1-2 Shift' to P0784 '4-5 Shift'. No manufacturer document available to us uses P07DA or P07DB: Ford's Diesel summary checks shift completion (speed must drop by more than 30 rpm on an upshift, flare above 300 rpm) without a gear-specific code, Ford's 10R80 feeds the solenoid function codes and GM the clutch valve codes. P07DA names the change between 6th and 7th gear, in either direction, as faulty; it exists only on transmissions with seven or more gears. Flags and thresholds follow the manufacturer's own logic.
possible_causes: Shift or clutch valve sticking [MEDIUM]
Worn clutch or hydraulic leak on the clutches involved [MEDIUM]
Shift adaptives wrong [MEDIUM]
Fluid level or condition [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4000€ (0.5h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Schaltcodes prüfen den Gangwechsel selbst: Das Steuergerät vergleicht den befohlenen Wechsel mit dem Drehzahlverlauf und meldet eine Schaltung, die zu lange dauert, ausbleibt, hochdreht oder zwei Kupplungen verspannt. Sie setzen die Reihe P0781 „1-2 Shift“ bis P0784 „4-5 Shift“ fort. P07DA benennt den Wechsel zwischen 6. und 7. Gang, in beide Richtungen, als fehlerhaft; es gibt ihn nur bei Getrieben mit sieben oder mehr Gängen. MIL und Schwellen folgen der Logik des Herstellers.

symptoms: Engine speed flares during the shift

description: The series 'Incorrect Shift from Gear N' (P07DC–P07E3 for gears 1–8, P07FA and P07FD for 9 and 10) covers a shift that leaves the starting gear but lands in a gear other than the commanded target – a skipped or overshot gear. A module can see this after the shift because the measured ratio matches the wrong gear. No manufacturer document available to us uses the series: Ford assigns such patterns to the shift solenoid that caused them (P0751 ff), newer GM automatics report clutch pressure valve codes. P07DC starts from gear 1. It differs from P0731 (wrong ratio while in gear 1, a slipping clutch), P072C (gear 1 cannot be left) and P0781 (the shift itself takes too long or flares). Detection, MIL and trip count therefore follow only by analogy from CARB's functional check and Ford's ratio and shift completion checks.
possible_causes: Shift or pressure control valve sticking in the valve body [HIGH]
Clutch or brake pack worn or leaking [MEDIUM]
Fluid low or contaminated [MEDIUM]
Wrong adaptives or software [MEDIUM]
Turbine or output speed signal wrong [LOW]

description: With shift-by-wire or park-by-wire, P, R, N and D are requested electrically (buttons, rotary selector, automatic park on shutdown) and an actuator moves the selector shaft or the park pawl; the module compares the requested with the range actually reached. P07E4 means park is not reached or not held within the allowed time. GM gives thresholds: 2 s in 2018 tables and the ICCM of its electronic range selector (2000 ms), 6–10 s in later tables, type B with the MIL after two trips; a 2018 bulletin for LaCrosse and XT5 blames a misaligned coupling of the range control module. Ford sets it with the wrench lamp instead of the MIL – on the 2020 Escape and Corsair a misrouted park release cable, on the Mach-E software – and applies the electric parking brake. Ram 1500 (2019) sets the MIL; Stellantis names a used manual park release as the most common cause.
possible_causes: Manual park release cable misrouted or actuated [HIGH]
Range actuator misaligned or its coupling offset [MEDIUM]
Control module software [MEDIUM]
Park lock actuator or its ground faulty [MEDIUM]
Range or park position signal wrong [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Bei Shift-by-Wire oder Park-by-Wire werden P, R, N und D elektrisch angefordert (Taster, Drehwähler, automatisches Parken beim Abstellen), ein Steller bewegt Wählwelle oder Parksperre; das Steuergerät vergleicht angeforderte und erreichte Fahrstufe. P07E4 heißt: P wird nicht innerhalb der erlaubten Zeit erreicht oder nicht gehalten. GM nennt Schwellen: 2 s in Tabellen von 2018 und im ICCM seines elektronischen Wählers (2000 ms), 6–10 s in späteren Tabellen, Typ B mit MIL nach zwei Fahrten; ein Bulletin von 2018 für LaCrosse und XT5 nennt eine versetzte Kupplung des Fahrstufen-Steuergeräts. Ford setzt ihn mit der Schraubenschlüssel-Leuchte statt der MIL (Escape und Corsair 2020: falsch verlegter Notentriegelungszug; Mach-E: Software) und zieht die elektrische Parkbremse an. Der Ram 1500 (2019) schaltet die MIL ein; laut Stellantis ist meist die Notentriegelung betätigt worden.

description: With shift-by-wire or park-by-wire, P, R, N and D are requested electrically (buttons, rotary selector, automatic park on shutdown) and an actuator moves the selector shaft or the park pawl; the module compares the requested with the range actually reached. P07E5 means drive is requested but not reached in time. Only GM documents it: its electronic range selector (LaCrosse, XT5, XT4, 2025 Equinox and Terrain) allows 10 s in most tables, 3 s in the 2018 Diesel table and 2000 ms in the selector module, type B with the MIL after two trips. A 2018 bulletin blames a misaligned range control module coupling, its 2019 revision adds ratio codes; on the 2025 Equinox and Terrain it can appear after an over-the-air update and clears after a ten-minute rest. The car does not move forward or falls back to neutral.

Software or after-effect of an over-the-air update [MEDIUM]

description: With shift-by-wire or park-by-wire, P, R, N and D are requested electrically (buttons, rotary selector, automatic park on shutdown) and an actuator moves the selector shaft or the park pawl; the module compares the requested with the range actually reached. P07E6 means park cannot be left: the pawl stays engaged or its position feedback keeps reporting P. Ford documents it on the HF45 hybrid transmission (2023–24 Escape, 2022–24 Maverick), where the inverter control module monitors the park actuator – the P on the rotary selector flashes, the wrench lamp comes on and an internally failed actuator is replaced (about 13–14 h) – and on the 2024–25 Mach-E, where a high resistance in the park motor ground is fixed with new software and a ground harness. Maserati lists it for the MC20 dual-clutch gearbox. Ford keeps it off the MIL; GM tables do not list it.
possible_causes: Park lock actuator failed internally [HIGH]
High resistance at the park motor ground [MEDIUM]
Control module software [MEDIUM]
Low system voltage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 3000€ (1.5h - 14h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: With shift-by-wire or park-by-wire, P, R, N and D are requested electrically (buttons, rotary selector, automatic park on shutdown) and an actuator moves the selector shaft or the park pawl; the module compares the requested with the range actually reached. P07E7 means drive cannot be left: after a request for P, N or R the transmission stays in D. It is the counterpart to P07E5, where drive cannot be engaged, and to P07E6 for park. No manufacturer document available to us uses it; GM's range selector module checks requested against reached range in the same way for P07E4 and P07E5 (2000 ms, two trips). With shift-by-wire the fault matters for safety, because the car cannot be put into park or neutral. Typical causes would be a sticking range actuator or selector shaft, a range sensor wrongly reporting D, or the selector or its software.

description: Despite its name, 'Transmission Range Control A' is not the range actuator motor – that has its own codes, P272A and P272B – but the sensor circuits of an electric shift-by-wire selector. The only documented user is Mitsubishi's 2022 service manual for a CVT with electric shift (very likely the 2022–23 Outlander): the lever carries eight position sensors whose on/off pattern encodes R, N, home, D and M. P07E8 is the open-circuit check of these sensor lines: if one sensor input is pulled above 4.5 V for 2.4 s with the ignition on, the code sets. Mitsubishi lists it with the MIL but without a fail-safe reaction, because the remaining sensors still identify the position. Low and high are P07EA/P07EB. GM and Ford use their own codes for their selectors.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between selector and shift module open [HIGH]
Position sensor in the selector faulty [MEDIUM]
Shift module input faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 900€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: A ratio code compares input or turbine speed divided by output speed with the ratio of the commanded gear; a slipping clutch or the wrong gear trips it. Ford's summaries describe the check (over 30 rpm off for more than 1.8 s, three times) for gears 1–6 only; its 10-speed bulletins show gears 7–10 as P076F, P07D9, P07F6 and P07F7. description: P07F8 means gear 9 cannot be disengaged: the transmission stays in 9th despite the command to leave it. No manufacturer document available to us uses it. description: P07FF means the transmission does not work as expected during the cold-start phase, shortly after starting with cold, thick fluid – for example a gear preselection or a clutch or valve response outside the expected window. The only documented user is Mercedes-Benz: its 2024 bulletin for the eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox 8G-DCT in the compact models (A-Class, CLA, GLA, GLB) names P07FF together with P0921, with reverse not available, a possible limp-home mode and the MIL; after switching off and on everything works again, and the fix was new control unit software. No thresholds or trip counts are published. It is not CARB's cold-start emission strategy, which concerns engine and catalyst heating (P050A ff), but a functional check of the transmission.
possible_causes: Transmission control module software misjudging the cold phase [HIGH]
Shift valve or hydraulics too slow with cold fluid [MEDIUM]
Wrong or aged fluid, low level [LOW]
Fluid temperature sensor reading wrong [LOW]

description: P0800 works like P0700 for the transmission: the transfer case control module has detected a fault of its own that it rates as emissions-relevant and asks the engine control module to turn on the MIL. The engine module only stores P0800; the actual fault – often C, U or manufacturer codes – sits in the transfer case module and needs a scan tool that addresses it. CARB requires monitoring of an electronic transfer case only where it feeds other diagnostics, for example the 4WD-low signal that GM uses as an enable condition; this is why most transfer case modules never request the MIL and P0800 hardly appears in manufacturer documents. A GM bulletin for 2020–23 trucks with 'Service 4WD' and the MIL points to wiring and terminal contact at the transfer case.
possible_causes: Fault in the transfer case system stored in its module (shift motor, sensor, clutch) [HIGH]
Wiring or connector at the transfer case (terminal tension, corrosion) [MEDIUM]
Transfer case module software [MEDIUM]
Transfer case module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transfer Case Control System (MIL Request)

bilingual_description.en: P0800 works like P0700 for the transmission: the transfer case control module has detected a fault of its own that it rates as emissions-relevant and asks the engine control module to turn on the MIL. The engine module only stores P0800; the actual fault – often C, U or manufacturer codes – sits in the transfer case module and needs a scan tool that addresses it. CARB requires monitoring of an electronic transfer case only where it feeds other diagnostics, for example the 4WD-low signal that GM uses as an enable condition; this is why most transfer case modules never request the MIL and P0800 hardly appears in manufacturer documents. A GM bulletin for 2020–23 trucks with 'Service 4WD' and the MIL points to wiring and terminal contact at the transfer case.
bilingual_description.de: P0800 funktioniert wie P0700 beim Getriebe: Das Verteilergetriebe-Steuergerät hat einen eigenen Fehler erkannt, den es als emissionsrelevant einstuft, und fordert beim Motorsteuergerät die MIL an. Das Motorsteuergerät speichert nur P0800; der eigentliche Fehler – oft C-, U- oder Herstellercodes – steht im Verteilergetriebe-Steuergerät und braucht ein Diagnosegerät, das es anspricht. CARB verlangt die Überwachung eines elektronischen Verteilergetriebes nur, soweit es andere Diagnosen speist, etwa das 4WD-Low-Signal, das GM als Einschaltbedingung nutzt; deshalb fordern die meisten Verteilergetriebe-Steuergeräte nie die MIL an, und P0800 taucht in Herstellerunterlagen kaum auf. Ein GM-Bulletin für Pick-ups 2020–23 mit „Service 4WD“ und MIL verweist auf Kabelbaum und Kontaktdruck am Verteilergetriebe.

symptoms: All-wheel drive or low range cannot be selected

description: On GM manual gearboxes (Tremec T56/TR6060 in Corvette, Camaro, CTS-V and ATS-V) the engine module drives a solenoid that blocks reverse while the car moves forward. P0801 means its control circuit is open. GM's tables describe the check: the low-side driver's internal diagnosis flags an open line with at least 9 V and the engine above 250 rpm, 20 failures in 25 samples of 250 ms – about 6 s; in 2006 a 5 s comparison of commanded and actual driver state. GM rates it type C, emissions-neutral and without MIL, from 2019 with a 'service vehicle soon' note. Depending on how it fails, reverse cannot be engaged or is no longer blocked. The title was updated to the current J2012 wording with '/Open'.
possible_causes: Connector at the reverse inhibit solenoid loose or corroded [HIGH]
Solenoid coil open [MEDIUM]
Harness between engine module and gearbox damaged [MEDIUM]
Engine module driver faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Bei GM-Handschaltgetrieben (Tremec T56/TR6060 in Corvette, Camaro, CTS-V und ATS-V) steuert das Motorsteuergerät einen Magneten, der den Rückwärtsgang sperrt, solange das Auto vorwärts rollt. P0801 heißt: Dessen Steuerkreis ist unterbrochen. GMs Tabellen beschreiben die Prüfung: Die interne Diagnose des Low-Side-Treibers meldet die offene Leitung bei mindestens 9 V und über 250 1/min, 20 Fehler in 25 Proben zu 250 ms – rund 6 s; 2006 ein 5-s-Vergleich von befohlenem und tatsächlichem Treiberzustand. symptoms: Reverse hard or impossible to engage
Service note in the driver display, usually no MIL

description: On older vehicles with a separate transmission module and no MIL message on the CAN bus, the transmission module signals 'MIL on' over its own wire to the engine module. P0802 checks this wire for an open circuit. GM's Duramax tables of 2004 and 2005 (Allison 1000) describe it: at key-on the transmission module briefly pulls the line active like a bulb check; if the engine module sees no off-to-on transition between 0.125 and 7 s after ignition, the line is treated as open – type B, MIL after two trips. Only then is P0700 evaluated. The wire itself must be monitored because an open line would stop transmission emission faults from lighting the MIL. Newer vehicles send the request over CAN, where faults appear as U codes.
possible_causes: MIL request wire or connector between the modules open or corroded [HIGH]
Transmission module without power or ground (fuse, relay) [MEDIUM]
Module output or input faulty [LOW]
Wrong or retrofitted transmission module without this line [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

P0802 checks this wire for an open circuit. GM's Duramax tables of 2004 and 2005 (Allison 1000) describe it: at key-on the transmission module briefly pulls the line active like a bulb check; if the engine module sees no off-to-on transition between 0.125 and 7 s after ignition, the line is treated as open – type B, MIL after two trips. Only then is P0700 evaluated. The wire itself must be monitored because an open line would stop transmission emission faults from lighting the MIL. Newer vehicles send the request over CAN, where faults appear as U codes.
bilingual_description.de: Bei älteren Fahrzeugen mit eigenem Getriebesteuergerät und ohne MIL-Botschaft auf dem CAN-Bus meldet das Getriebesteuergerät „MIL an“ über eine eigene Leitung an das Motorsteuergerät. P0802 prüft diese Leitung auf Unterbrechung. GMs Duramax-Tabellen von 2004 und 2005 (Allison 1000) beschreiben es: Beim Einschalten zieht das Getriebesteuergerät die Leitung kurz aktiv wie bei einem Lampentest; sieht das Motorsteuergerät zwischen 0,125 und 7 s nach Zündung keinen Wechsel von aus nach an, gilt die Leitung als offen – Typ B, MIL nach zwei Fahrten. Erst danach wird P0700 ausgewertet. Die Leitung selbst muss überwacht werden, weil eine offene Leitung Abgasfehler des Getriebes nicht mehr an die MIL brächte. Neuere Fahrzeuge senden die Anforderung per CAN, wo Fehler als U-Codes erscheinen.

symptoms: Transmission faults no longer light the MIL

description: GM's skip-shift (CAGS) on manual gearboxes such as the T56 and TR6060 uses an engine-module solenoid in the shifter housing that, at light load and low speed blocks the way from 1st into 2nd and 3rd so the driver shifts 1 to 4 – a measure for fuel economy ratings; the 1-4 lamp (P0804) shows it. P0803 means the solenoid control circuit is open. GM's tables check the low-side driver while it is off: too low a voltage or over 200 kΩ to ground, with at least 9 V and over 250 rpm, 5 of 6 samples of 250 ms (2019 LT5: 20 of 25), type B with the MIL after two trips; shorts are P080C and P080D. An open circuit leaves the solenoid unpowered, so 1 to 2 always works. 'Skip-shift eliminators' with the wrong resistance are a frequent cause.
possible_causes: Solenoid unplugged or replaced by a skip-shift eliminator with the wrong resistance [HIGH]
Connector at the gearbox loose or corroded [HIGH]
Solenoid coil open [MEDIUM]
Harness damaged [MEDIUM]
Engine module driver faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 250€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

P0803 means the solenoid control circuit is open. GM's tables check the low-side driver while it is off: too low a voltage or over 200 kΩ to ground, with at least 9 V and over 250 rpm, 5 of 6 samples of 250 ms (2019 LT5: 20 of 25), type B with the MIL after two trips; shorts are P080C and P080D. An open circuit leaves the solenoid unpowered, so 1 to 2 always works. 'Skip-shift eliminators' with the wrong resistance are a frequent cause.
bilingual_description.de: GMs Skip-Shift (CAGS) bei Handschaltgetrieben wie T56 und TR6060 nutzt einen vom Motorsteuergerät geschalteten Magneten im Schaltgehäuse, der bei geringer Last und niedrigem Tempo den Weg vom 1. in den 2. und 3. Gang sperrt, sodass der Fahrer von 1 nach 4 schaltet – eine Maßnahme für die Verbrauchswerte; die 1-4-Leuchte (P0804) zeigt es an. P0803 heißt: Der Steuerkreis des Magneten ist offen. GMs Tabellen prüfen den Low-Side-Treiber im ausgeschalteten Zustand: zu niedrige Spannung oder über 200 kΩ gegen Masse, bei mindestens 9 V und über 250 1/min, 5 von 6 Proben zu 250 ms (LT5 2019: 20 von 25), Typ B mit MIL nach zwei Fahrten; Kurzschlüsse sind P080C und P080D. Ein offener Kreis lässt den Magneten stromlos, 1 nach 2 geht also immer. Häufige Ursache sind „Skip-Shift-Eliminatoren“ mit falschem Widerstand.

symptoms: Check engine lamp after two trips
1-4 lockout no longer works (1-2 always possible)

description: With GM's skip-shift (CAGS) on manual gearboxes, a '1-4' lamp in the cluster tells the driver that the lockout is active and to shift from 1st directly into 4th. P0804 means the control circuit of this lamp is faulty – open, shorted, or the lamp does not follow its command. No GM table from 2004 to 2025 available to us contains it, because newer cars switch the indicator by a CAN message from the instrument cluster without a separate engine-module line check; the code therefore mainly concerns older vehicles with a lamp driven directly by the engine module. The lockout itself (P0803) keeps working, only the hint is missing; there is no limp mode, and the MIL behavior is not documented.
possible_causes: Bulb or LED in the cluster faulty [HIGH]
Wire or connector between engine module and cluster open or shorted [MEDIUM]
Instrument cluster board faulty [MEDIUM]
Engine module output faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 10€ - 300€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Bei GMs Skip-Shift (CAGS) an Handschaltgetrieben zeigt eine „1-4“-Leuchte im Kombiinstrument dem Fahrer, dass die Sperre aktiv ist und er vom 1. direkt in den 4. Gang schalten soll. P0804 heißt: Der Steuerkreis dieser Leuchte ist fehlerhaft – offen, kurzgeschlossen, oder die Leuchte folgt ihrer Ansteuerung nicht. In keiner uns vorliegenden GM-Tabelle von 2004 bis 2025 kommt er vor, weil neuere Autos die Anzeige per CAN-Botschaft aus dem Kombiinstrument schalten, ohne eigene Leitungsprüfung im Motorsteuergerät; der Code betrifft daher vor allem ältere Fahrzeuge mit direkt vom Motorsteuergerät angesteuerter Leuchte. Die Sperre selbst (P0803) arbeitet weiter, nur der Hinweis fehlt; einen Notlauf gibt es nicht, das MIL-Verhalten ist nicht belegt.

symptoms: 1-4 lamp never lights or stays on

description: The J2012 family 'Clutch Position Sensor A' (P0805 circuit, P0806 range/performance, P0807 low, P0808 high, P0809 intermittent, P080A not learned) covers the position of a clutch – the pedal of a manual gearbox, the clutch actuator of an automated or dual-clutch gearbox, or a clutch inside an automatic. P0805 is the general circuit fault. Uses differ: Nissan's 2022 Pathfinder with its nine-speed automatic stores it in the transmission module, lights the MIL and disables idle stop ('Idle Stop System Fault'), fixed with new software. Ford's DPS6 dual-clutch gearbox uses it for the module-internal chip that drives the clutch A motor, so a control unit fault rather than an outside sensor. GM reads its clutch pedal sensor under P0806–P0808 only.
possible_causes: Clutch position sensor faulty (pedal or actuator) [HIGH]
Connector or harness open, corroded or shorted [MEDIUM]
Transmission module software (Nissan) [MEDIUM]
Control unit internal fault (Ford DPS6: clutch motor driver) [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Clutch Position Sensor A Circuit

bilingual_description.en: The J2012 family 'Clutch Position Sensor A' (P0805 circuit, P0806 range/performance, P0807 low, P0808 high, P0809 intermittent, P080A not learned) covers the position of a clutch – the pedal of a manual gearbox, the clutch actuator of an automated or dual-clutch gearbox, or a clutch inside an automatic. P0805 is the general circuit fault. Uses differ: Nissan's 2022 Pathfinder with its nine-speed automatic stores it in the transmission module, lights the MIL and disables idle stop ('Idle Stop System Fault'), fixed with new software. Ford's DPS6 dual-clutch gearbox uses it for the module-internal chip that drives the clutch A motor, so a control unit fault rather than an outside sensor. GM reads its clutch pedal sensor under P0806–P0808 only.
bilingual_description.de: Die J2012-Familie „Clutch Position Sensor A“ (P0805 Kreis, P0806 Bereich/Funktion, P0807 zu niedrig, P0808 zu hoch, P0809 sporadisch, P080A nicht angelernt) erfasst die Stellung einer Kupplung – das Pedal eines Handschalters, den Kupplungssteller eines automatisierten oder Doppelkupplungsgetriebes oder eine Kupplung im Automatikgetriebe. P0805 ist der allgemeine Kreisfehler. Die Nutzung unterscheidet sich: Nissans Pathfinder 2022 mit Neungangautomatik speichert ihn im Getriebesteuergerät, schaltet die MIL ein und sperrt die Start-Stopp-Funktion („Idle Stop System Fault“), behoben per Software. Fords Doppelkupplungsgetriebe DPS6 nutzt ihn für den internen Baustein, der den Motor der Kupplung A ansteuert – also einen Steuergerätefehler statt eines äußeren Sensors. GM liest seinen Kupplungspedalsensor nur unter P0806–P0808.

symptoms: Idle stop disabled ('Idle Stop System Fault')
Jerky driving or harsh clutch engagement (dual clutch)

description: The 'Clutch Position Sensor A' family (P0805 circuit to P0809, P080A not learned) means different parts by vehicle generation. GM used P0806–P080A until model year 2018 for the analog clutch pedal sensor of its manual cars, then the newer pedal sensor codes P08A8 ff; Saab's 2012 9-3 does the same. Ford's DPS6 dual clutch uses the family for the electric motor of clutch A. P0806 is the plausibility check. On GM's LT4 manual cars the pedal sensor is compared with gear detection: if it reports the clutch pressed while engine and output speed show a valid gear, a filtered position error above 4 % sets the code (above 5.6 mph, not in 4WD low), type A with the MIL after one trip. On Ford's DPS6 it reports a fault of the Hall sensors on the clutch A motor; Saab sets it for a frozen pedal signal and switches off cruise control.
possible_causes: Pedal sensor or Hall sensors of the clutch motor faulty [HIGH]
Pedal sensor misadjusted or not relearned after clutch work [MEDIUM]
Harness or connector with contact resistance [MEDIUM]
Clutch actuator motor faulty (DPS6) [MEDIUM]
Master cylinder leaking, pedal does not fully return [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 900€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GM nutzte P0806–P080A bis Modelljahr 2018 für den analogen Kupplungspedalsensor seiner Handschalter, danach die neueren Pedalsensor-Codes P08A8 ff; Saabs 9-3 von 2012 ebenso. Bei GMs Handschaltern mit LT4 wird der Pedalsensor mit der Gangerkennung verglichen: Meldet er „getreten“, obwohl Motor- und Abtriebsdrehzahl einen gültigen Gang zeigen, setzt ein gefilterter Lagefehler über 4 % den Code (über 5,6 mph, nicht in 4WD-Low), Typ A mit MIL nach einer Fahrt. symptoms: Cruise control and start-stop not working
Engine starts only with the pedal fully pressed, or not at all
Dual clutch: jerky take-off, limp mode

description: The 'Clutch Position Sensor A' family (P0805 circuit to P0809, P080A not learned) means different parts by vehicle generation. GM used P0806–P080A until model year 2018 for the analog clutch pedal sensor of its manual cars, then the newer pedal sensor codes P08A8 ff; Saab's 2012 9-3 does the same. Ford's DPS6 dual clutch uses the family for the electric motor of clutch A. P0807 means the signal is too low. GM's three-wire pedal sensor on a 5 V reference has dead bands at both ends: below 4 % of the reference counts as low or open, 200 of 250 samples of 12.5 ms (about 3 s), engine not cranking, over 9 V, type A with the MIL after one trip. Saab names an open circuit or short to ground. With the clutch position unknown, cruise control, start-stop and starter release by the sensor are blocked.
possible_causes: Signal wire open or shorted to ground [HIGH]
5 V reference of the sensor missing [MEDIUM]
Pedal sensor faulty internally [MEDIUM]
Connector corroded or pins loose [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The 'Clutch Position Sensor A' family (P0805 circuit to P0809, P080A not learned) means different parts by vehicle generation. GM used P0806–P080A until model year 2018 for the analog clutch pedal sensor of its manual cars, then the newer pedal sensor codes P08A8 ff; Saab's 2012 9-3 does the same. P0809 is documented only for Ford's DPS6 (Fiesta from 2011, Focus from 2012): the motor that operates clutch A carries three Hall sensors, one per phase, and while the motor turns they must produce a fixed sequence; a wrong sequence sets the code. The clutch B counterpart is P087E. The module then loses confidence in the clutch position, so clutch A with the odd gears 1, 3 and 5 is restricted. GM and Saab do not use P0809; Ford publishes no thresholds.
possible_causes: Clutch A actuator motor or its Hall sensors faulty [HIGH]
Loose contact at the actuator connector [MEDIUM]
Transmission module Hall evaluation faulty [LOW]
Supply voltage dips [LOW]

description: The 'Clutch Position Sensor A' family (P0805 circuit to P0809, P080A not learned) means different parts by vehicle generation. GM used P0806–P080A until model year 2018 for the analog clutch pedal sensor of its manual cars, then the newer pedal sensor codes P08A8 ff; Saab's 2012 9-3 does the same. On GM manual cars the factory learns the pedal position 'clutch fully pressed', and the engine module then tracks it as the clutch wears; a learned value outside 9.0–36.0 % of travel sets the code (250 ms, type A, one trip), a factory counter keeps the MIL off during assembly. Saab clears it by relearning with the scan tool. A relearn is needed after replacing the pedal sensor, master cylinder, clutch or engine module.

Clutch badly worn or misadjusted [MEDIUM]
Pedal sensor misadjusted or wrongly fitted [MEDIUM]
Engine module reprogrammed or replaced [MEDIUM]

GM nutzte P0806–P080A bis Modelljahr 2018 für den analogen Kupplungspedalsensor seiner Handschalter, danach die neueren Pedalsensor-Codes P08A8 ff; Saabs 9-3 von 2012 ebenso. Fords Doppelkupplung DPS6 nutzt die Familie für den Elektromotor der Kupplung A. P080A heißt: Die angelernte Kupplungsstellung fehlt oder passt nicht. Bei GMs Handschaltern lernt das Werk die Stellung „Kupplung ganz getreten“ an, das Motorsteuergerät führt sie mit dem Verschleiß nach; ein Lernwert außerhalb 9,0–36,0 % des Wegs setzt den Code (250 ms, Typ A, eine Fahrt), ein Werkszähler unterdrückt die MIL bei der Montage. Saab behebt ihn durch Anlernen mit dem Diagnosegerät. Nach dem Tausch von Pedalsensor, Geberzylinder, Kupplung oder Steuergerät muss neu angelernt werden.

description: GM's skip-shift (CAGS) on manual gearboxes such as the T56 and TR6060 uses an engine-module solenoid that, at light load, blocks the way from 1st into 2nd so the driver shifts 1 to 4; the 1-4 lamp shows it (P0804). The engine module drives the solenoid with a low-side driver; P0803 is the open circuit. P080B would be the range or performance fault of this circuit: electrically plausible, but outside the expected range for the command – for example a coil resistance outside its window, a partial short or contact resistance. No manufacturer document available to us uses it: GM's tables from 2006 to 2019 check the solenoid only electrically (P0803 open, P080C short to ground, P080D short to positive). CARB requires a functional check of outputs where feasible. The lockout may then work unreliably.
possible_causes: Solenoid coil with shorted turns or resistance out of range [MEDIUM]
Retrofitted skip-shift eliminator with the wrong value [MEDIUM]
Corroded connector at the gearbox (contact resistance) [MEDIUM]
Control module or software [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 250€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: P0810 reports a control error of an electronically or hydraulically operated clutch: commanded and actual position differ too much or for too long. It is documented on Stellantis plug-in hybrids – Jeep Wrangler 4xe and Grand Cherokee 4xe with the 8P75PH transmission – where it concerns the K0 disconnect clutch between engine and electric motor. According to the 2024 and 2025 bulletins the clutch adaptation ran at standstill or in electric mode, drive was lost until the next key cycle and the MIL came on; the cause was too tight setting parameters, fixed with new transmission software, partly together with P2885. On automated or dual-clutch gearboxes the same idea applies when the clutch actuator misses its target position.
possible_causes: Control unit software with too tight parameters [HIGH]
Clutch actuator or hydraulics (pressure, valve) faulty [MEDIUM]
Clutch position sensor inaccurate [MEDIUM]
Wrong or aged fluid, worn clutch [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.3h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Loss of drive until the next key cycle

description: P0811 means clutch A slips too much while it should be closed – on a dual-clutch gearbox clutch 1 with the odd gears. The module compares engine speed with the input shaft speed of the closed clutch; thresholds are not published. Audi's seven-speed S tronic DL382 (A4 to A7 and Q5, 2020–24) sets it intermittently together with P081E and input speed sensor codes, partly also clutch temperature too high; the cause was the transmission module calculating wrong slip, and the fix was a new module. Genuine slip from wear or overheating shows as flaring take-off and burnt fluid. The module limits torque, may lock out the affected half and go to limp mode.
possible_causes: Transmission module calculating wrong slip (speed capture) [HIGH]
Clutch worn or overheated [MEDIUM]
Fluid burnt or wrong (wet clutch) [MEDIUM]
Clutch pressure or actuator too low [MEDIUM]
Input speed sensor faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Das Steuergerät begrenzt das Moment, sperrt eventuell das Teilgetriebe und geht in den Notlauf.

description: P0812 concerns the input 'reverse engaged' at the engine or transmission module – the reverse or back-up lamp switch on a manual gearbox, or the R contact of a selector. Modules check it for open or stuck states and against a second source such as a gear position sensor or the direction from speed sensors. A Honda patent describes this double detection: reverse counts only when switch and gear position sensor agree; if only one reports R, it is a fault and engine speed is limited. No manufacturer document with thresholds is available to us. Back-up lamps, reversing camera or parking aids may fail; on automated manual gearboxes reverse may be blocked. CARB lets such safety and comfort inputs run without the MIL.
possible_causes: Reverse or back-up lamp switch faulty or misadjusted [HIGH]
Connector loose or wire broken (e.g. after clutch work) [HIGH]
Back-up lamp circuit fuse blown [MEDIUM]
Gear position sensor reporting the wrong position [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 200€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Rückfahrlichtschalter am Schaltgetriebe oder den R-Kontakt eines Wählhebels.
