description: P0813 concerns a signal 'reverse active' that a module puts out – usually the transmission module, on manual cars the engine or body module – for example to the back-up lamp relay, the reversing camera or the body module. Like other driver outputs it is checked by comparing commanded and actual state, which reveals an open circuit or a short. Saab's 2012 transmission module reports a short to positive on its park/neutral output in the same way. No manufacturer document with thresholds for the reverse output is available to us. Back-up lamps, camera or mirror tilt may stop working; driving itself is not affected, and CARB allows such outputs without the MIL.
possible_causes: Wire from module to relay or body module open or shorted [HIGH]
Back-up lamp relay or connected load faulty [MEDIUM]
Connector corroded [MEDIUM]
Module output stage faulty [LOW]

description: P0814 concerns the drive or data circuit of the range display – the PRNDL or PRNDM display or lighting on the selector, sometimes in the instrument cluster. It is documented on the 2017–22 Jeep Compass with the nine-speed automatic: the electronic shift module stores P0814 with the MIL on, the selector lighting flickers or goes dark, and in a 2020 bulletin the lever could be moved out of park during cranking so that the engine stalled. The cause was software in the shift module, fixed by reflashing; a 2022 bulletin adds P081C. A wrong or missing range display matters for safety because the driver cannot reliably see P, R or N. No thresholds are published.
possible_causes: Shift module software (Jeep Compass) [HIGH]
Connector or wire to the selector display or cluster [MEDIUM]
Display LED or selector module faulty [MEDIUM]
Range sensor or transmission module delivering an invalid range [LOW]

description: Tap-up and tap-down switches let the driver choose gears on an automatic (selector gate, buttons or paddles). GM, Ford and Saab all treat a shift request that appears where it is impossible – in park or neutral, at Ford also reverse – or that stays on implausibly long as a stuck switch. P0815 is the upshift switch. GM's 2019 and 2025 tables set it when 'tap up' stays on for more than 1 s in P or N, or permanently in a drive range; the 2018 hybrid table uses 2 s in P/N and 655 s in drive; type C without MIL. Ford's 6R80 and 6F35 SelectShift report a switch closed in P, R or N without MIL. On Saab's 9-4X with the 6T70 a Hall switch feeds a resistor network on one wire: a short to positive sets P0815 or P0816, a short to ground or an open sets P0826. Manual shifting is then disabled.
possible_causes: Tap switch or paddle sticking or faulty [HIGH]
Signal wire shorted to positive [MEDIUM]
Selector assembly (Hall sensor, resistor network) faulty [MEDIUM]
Clockspring or steering wheel wiring (paddles) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GM's 2025 table sets it when 'tap down' stays on for more than 1 s (100 ms raster, over 9 V), the 2018 hybrid table after 2 s in P/N or 655 s in drive, type C without MIL; Saab's 9-4X after 1 s in P/N or 10 minutes in a drive range; Ford's SelectShift when the switch is closed in P, R or N, without MIL. On selectors with a resistor network a short to positive in the downshift branch sets P0816. Manual shifting is disabled, automatic operation stays normal.

description: P0818 concerns a switch input that reports whether the driveline is disconnected – on four-wheel-drive vehicles typically the neutral position of the transfer case or an axle disconnect, on hybrids a disconnect clutch between engine and transmission, as a Ford patent uses the term. It matters for OBD because in transfer case neutral the engine runs without load and wheel speed does not match the ratio, so misfire, ratio and vehicle speed monitors must know about it; CARB requires monitoring only then. The check would be a circuit or plausibility test against the speed ratio. No manufacturer document available to us uses P0818, and which of the two meanings applies cannot be proven. All-wheel drive or neutral may then be unavailable.

Control module or software [LOW]

description: P0819 is the plausibility check between the tap-up and tap-down switches and the range sensor: a shift request may only appear in the manual gate or in drive. description: P081E is the counterpart to P0811 for clutch B – on a dual-clutch gearbox clutch 2 with the even gears and reverse, which Audi calls 'clutch 2'. description: The brake transmission shift interlock (BTSI) is a solenoid or actuator that locks the selector in park until the brake pedal is pressed, as US rule FMVSS 114 requires. 'Signal correlation' is the plausibility check between the interlock command or feedback and its input signals – brake switch and selector position: for example the lock released without a brake signal, or still active although the brake is pressed. The selector then cannot leave park, or it moves without the brake and the safety function is missing. Electrical faults of the lock solenoid have their own codes P0928–P0931. No manufacturer document with P081F is available to us; a GM service update for the 2016 Malibu and 2016–17 Volt explains the part and the 'won't shift out of park' complaint. CARB may exempt such safety parts from monitoring.

Wire or connector to the selector [MEDIUM]
Selector module, control unit or software [LOW]

description: Gear lever X and Y position sensors detect a selector's position in two directions: on an H-gate shift and select direction (a LuK patent uses two sensors about 90° apart), on a shift-by-wire lever its two axes. P0820 covers the whole X-Y circuit, P0821–P0824 and P082A–P082F sensor 1, P089A–P08A3 a redundant sensor 2. P0820 is the umbrella code: the module does not tell X from Y, or sees an invalid combination of both axes that matches no gate position. The only documented user is Mitsubishi's 2022 Outlander PHEV, which names it 'shift lever position (main) circuit malfunction' and sets it for an impossible lever position, without published thresholds. GM reads its X/Y sensors under P082A–P082F instead. Range selection may be blocked and the vehicle stays in P or N.

description: P0825 concerns a switch on the selector that reports pushing or pulling the lever – sequential + and – shifting – or the start of a shift movement, hence 'shift anticipate'. Its purpose: the control unit of an automated manual gearbox can prepare clutch and engine torque before the actual gear change is detected; a LuK patent describes such shift-intent detection, which reports intent when the lever signal exceeds a filtered, load-dependent reference and cancels on a reversal. A fault is typically a switch reporting 'pressed' without lever movement or never, implausible against the X/Y sensors. No manufacturer document with P0825 is available to us. Shift-intent detection is then off, gear changes are slower or sequential shifting is disabled.
possible_causes: Switch in the selector faulty or sticking [HIGH]
Wire or connector to the selector assembly [MEDIUM]
Liquid or dirt in the shift gate [MEDIUM]
Control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0825 betrifft einen Schalter am Wählhebel, der das Drücken oder Ziehen des Hebels meldet – sequentielles Schalten mit + und – – oder den Beginn einer Schaltbewegung, daher „Shift Anticipate“. Der Zweck: Das Steuergerät eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes kann Kupplung und Motormoment vorbereiten, bevor der eigentliche Gangwechsel erkannt wird; ein LuK-Patent beschreibt eine solche Schaltabsichtserkennung, die die Absicht meldet, wenn das Hebelsignal einen gefilterten, lastabhängigen Bezugswert überschreitet, und bei Richtungsumkehr abbricht. Ein Fehler ist typisch ein Schalter, der „gedrückt“ ohne Hebelbewegung oder nie meldet, unplausibel zu den X/Y-Sensoren. Eine Herstellerunterlage mit P0825 liegt uns nicht vor. Die Schaltabsichtserkennung ist dann aus, Gangwechsel dauern länger oder das sequentielle Schalten ist gesperrt.

description: Many selectors read tap-up and tap-down over one shared wire with voltage steps or a resistor network; P0826–P0828 cover this shared circuit, P0815/P0816 the single directions. P0826 is the general fault of the shared circuit. GM (6L80 in 2011, 2019, 2025, hybrids) sets it when the circuit shows an invalid voltage for at least 60 s with 8.6–32 V and 400–7500 rpm, without MIL. On Saab's 9-4X with the 6T70 a short to ground or an open sets P0826. Saab's 2003–04 9-3 Sentronic reports below 0.2 V or above 6.7 V for over 30 s under P0826 with a fault-type byte, lights 'Check gearbox' and locks the lever in P/N. Ram's 2025 heavy-duty trucks set it with P0827 and P085F and the MIL, fixed with transmission software. Manual shifting is then disabled.
possible_causes: Wire or connector between selector and module open or shorted [HIGH]
Selector assembly (Hall switch, resistor network, module) faulty [HIGH]
Transmission module software (Ram) [MEDIUM]
Clockspring or steering wheel wiring (paddles) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Shift codes check the gear change itself: the module compares the commanded change with the speed trace and flags a shift that takes too long, does not happen, flares or binds up two clutches. P0829 covers the change between 5th and 6th gear in either direction; J2012 placed it here because P0785 ff were already taken, between P0781 '1-2 Shift' to P0784 '4-5 Shift' and P07DA/P07DB for 6-7 and 7-8. No manufacturer document available to us uses it: Ford's Diesel summary checks shift completion without a gear-specific code (speed must drop by more than 30 rpm on an upshift, flare above 300 rpm), Ford's automatics feed the solenoid function codes and GM the clutch valve codes. It exists only on transmissions with at least six gears; MIL and trip count follow the manufacturer.

Type B, MIL after two trips; the other sensor takes over.

description: Clutch pedal switches A and B are digital inputs of manual gearboxes: they release the starter only with the pedal pressed, switch off cruise control and tell start-stop whether the clutch is open. Which switch is A or B is up to each manufacturer – FCA calls the pedal-up switch A. Ford's 2020–23 summary checks a dual switch over more than 40 pedal applications and reports a stuck switch without MIL (P0830 stuck high, P0833 stuck low, comparison P0704). P0830 is the general fault of switch A. On Ford it means the switch is stuck high. On a 2012–13 Jeep Wrangler with the six-speed manual, Chrysler reprogrammed the engine module for unwanted cruise control cut-outs with P0830; an FCA tip notes that a driver resting a foot on the pedal keeps the pedal-up switch on and sets the code. The MIL depends on the manufacturer.
possible_causes: Switch faulty or misadjusted [HIGH]
Foot resting on the clutch pedal keeps the switch actuated [MEDIUM]
Software misjudgment (reprogramming) [MEDIUM]
Wiring, connector or remote-start bypass [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 200€ (0.3h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Wer A oder B ist, legt jeder Hersteller selbst fest – FCA nennt den Schalter „Pedal oben“ A. P0830 ist der allgemeine Fehler des Schalters A. Bei Ford heißt er, der Schalter hängt high. Beim Jeep Wrangler 2012–13 mit Sechsgang-Handschalter programmierte Chrysler wegen ungewollter Tempomat-Abschaltungen mit P0830 das Motorsteuergerät neu; ein FCA-Hinweis nennt einen Fahrer, der den Fuß auf dem Pedal ruhen lässt und so den Schalter „Pedal oben“ betätigt hält. Die MIL hängt vom Hersteller ab.

description: The park/neutral input tells the engine control module whether the automatic is in P or N, or a manual gearbox in neutral. It releases the starter, prepares idle control for the load of an engaged gear and enables cruise control and other monitors. All documented makers check it for plausibility against driving state or a second source such as the gearbox module. On GM's 6T70 and Subaru the switch pulls the line to ground in P/N. P0850 is the general fault. Ford's 2023 diesels check the switch for plausibility at start-up and set the code after 1 s. On GM's 6T70, as in the Saab 9-4X, the module sees P/N while the range switch reports a gear for 0.2 s above 10 km/h and 75 Nm, type C without MIL; it then uses the range switch for start release.
possible_causes: Range or inhibitor switch faulty or misadjusted [HIGH]
Selector cable misadjusted or stretched [MEDIUM]
Wiring or connector between switch, gearbox module and engine module [MEDIUM]
Module input or software [LOW]

description: The traction control input carries the request of the ABS/stability module to the engine module to cut torque when wheels spin. description: The TCM communication circuit is a direct link between gearbox and engine module outside the CAN bus. Subaru's 2005 WRX, sold as Saab 9-2X, uses a single 'AT diagnosis' wire: about once a second the gearbox module sends a frame with a start pulse of 40 ms low and 20 ms high, carrying among other things its request for the MIL. description: P0867 to P0869 cover the system or line pressure of the gearbox as a whole: a pressure sensor measures it and the control module compares it with the pressure it commands. Faults of the sensor circuit itself have their own codes (Chrysler 68RFE P0932 ff), the single switches A to H have theirs (P0840 ff). Thresholds are not published; the codes are documented in bulletins for the Ram 68RFE and for the Tremec dual clutch of Corvette C8 and Maserati MC20. P0867 is the general pressure fault. GM's Corvette bulletin reads it as 'no system pressure': the pump delivers nothing or the fluid is almost gone, so valve cleaning is pointless and the gearbox needs a mechanical check. The car may lose drive completely.
possible_causes: Fluid level extremely low or leak [HIGH]
Fluid pump or its drive faulty [MEDIUM]

System pressure sensor faulty [LOW]

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure High

bilingual_description.en: P0867 to P0869 cover the system or line pressure of the gearbox as a whole: a pressure sensor measures it and the control module compares it with the pressure it commands. Faults of the sensor circuit itself have their own codes (Chrysler 68RFE P0932 ff), the single switches A to H have theirs (P0840 ff). Thresholds are not published; the codes are documented in bulletins for the Ram 68RFE and for the Tremec dual clutch of Corvette C8 and Maserati MC20. P0869 means the measured pressure stays above target. Chrysler lists 'Line Pressure High' among the 68RFE codes fixed by control module updates; on the Corvette and Maserati dual clutch a valve stuck in the high-pressure position is the usual cause, cured by cleaning or a new control unit. Harsh engagement is the typical sign.

P0869 heißt: Der gemessene Druck bleibt über dem Soll. Typisches Zeichen sind harte Einlegestöße.

description: Transmission fluid pressure switches C and D report whether a clutch circuit is pressurised. They are more widespread than A and B: GM's 6L80/6L90 and 6T40/6T70 six-speeds put switch C on the 2-6 brake and D on the 1-2-3-4 clutch, Allison uses them for its third shift valve and its reverse switch, Ram's RFE gearboxes for the clutch pressure switches in the solenoid block. Allison's 2006 table uses it for the switch on valve S3: if it reports pressure for more than 20 ms with the valve at rest, the valve is retried twice and the case classed as electrical, mechanical or sporadic, type A. description: Clutch position sensor B reports the position of the second clutch or its actuator, the counterpart of sensor A (P0805 ff). The only documented user is Ford's dry DPS6 dual clutch in Fiesta and Focus: clutch B, for reverse and the even gears, is moved by a three-phase motor whose Hall sensors give its position, and the gearbox module drives it through an internal motor driver. symptoms: Reverse or even gears missing, limp mode

description: Clutch position sensor B reports the position of the second clutch or its actuator, the counterpart of sensor A (P0805 ff). The only documented user is Ford's dry DPS6 dual clutch in Fiesta and Focus: clutch B, for reverse and the even gears, is moved by a three-phase motor whose Hall sensors give its position, and the gearbox module drives it through an internal motor driver. Ford sets P087E for a sequence fault: when the clutch B motor turns, its three Hall sensors produce a fixed pattern; if a step is skipped or the order is wrong, motor and clutch position become unreliable. Typical are sporadic Hall dropouts and loose contacts. The counterpart for clutch A is P0809.
possible_causes: Hall sensor in the clutch B motor dropping out [HIGH]
Loose contact at motor or module connector [MEDIUM]
Motor sluggish or slipping mechanically [LOW]
Evaluation in the gearbox module faulty [LOW]

description: The TCM power input codes watch the supply voltage of the gearbox module or of its solenoid supply. Without a proper supply all solenoids go dead and the gearbox falls back to its hydraulic emergency gear with maximum line pressure: a fixed gear, harsh engagement, no shifting. Ford's external gearbox modules check a window of 9 to 16 V; GM reports the same under P0562/P0563. P0880 is the general fault. Hyundai's 2017–19 six-speed automatics set it when the solenoid supply drops below 7 V or rises above 22 V: MIL on, limp mode in 4th gear. Hyundai's bulletin points to the valve body harness and the TCU fuses and expressly not to the gearbox.
possible_causes: Harness or connector between module and valve body damaged or corroded [HIGH]
TCU fuse or transmission relay faulty [MEDIUM]
Weak battery, charging fault, poor ground [MEDIUM]
Gearbox module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Gearbox jerks or briefly enters limp mode while driving

description: Some gearboxes draw their power through a relay, such as the transmission control relay in Chrysler's fuse box that feeds the solenoids. P0885 to P0887 cover the coil control of that relay, P0888 to P0892 its sense line, which reads back the switched output and compares it with the command. A dead relay leaves all solenoids without power, so the gearbox drops into its hydraulic emergency gear. P0885 means the coil circuit is open; the module checks its relay driver output at key-on. Ford lists it in its powertrain code list with or without MIL depending on vehicle; on FCA's 948TE nine-speed in the 2015 Cherokee and Chrysler 200 it was cured with a gearbox module reflash.
possible_causes: Relay faulty (coil open) or missing [HIGH]
Wire between relay and module open, connector or fuse box contact [HIGH]
Fuse of the relay coil blown [MEDIUM]
Module software (FCA 948TE reflash) [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 20€ - 400€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: Allison's 'Prognostics' in its fourth and fifth generation controls (1000 to 4000 series, buses and trucks, from 2009) has no fluid quality sensor: the gearbox module calculates. description: P088E means the module has found that a planetary gear set no longer keeps the fixed speed relation between its sun, carrier and ring gear, for example through broken planet gears, seized planet pins or stripped teeth. No maker's table or bulletin documents the code. It suits power-split hybrid transmissions, which measure speeds at several members: a Toyota patent compares the road speed calculated from engine, generator speed and planetary ratio with the measured one, flags a deviation of about 10 km/h for about 1 s and then drives electrically only. In stepped automatics such damage usually shows as ratio or slip codes.
possible_causes: Planet gears or pins seized or broken (lubrication, overheating) [HIGH]
Tooth damage on sun or ring gear [MEDIUM]
Speed sensor (engine, motor-generator, output) reading wrong [MEDIUM]
Low or worn fluid [LOW]

description: Some gearboxes draw their power through a relay, such as the transmission control relay in Chrysler's fuse box that feeds the solenoids. P0885 to P0887 cover the coil control of that relay, P0888 to P0892 its sense line, which reads back the switched output and compares it with the command. A dead relay leaves all solenoids without power, so the gearbox drops into its hydraulic emergency gear. P0890 means the relay delivers no voltage despite the command. Subaru documents it in four bulletins from 2022 to 2025 (Ascent, WRX, Impreza, Crosstrek, Forester): after a short trip below 0 °C condensation freezes the ignition relay contacts, the starter does not crank and P0700 often comes along. Engine module software cycles the contacts; the 2025 Forester also gets a vented relay.
possible_causes: Relay contacts frozen or corroded (Subaru ignition relay) [HIGH]
Outdated engine module software (Subaru) [HIGH]
Fuse or wire between relay and gearbox module [MEDIUM]
Weak battery [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Shift time is the duration of the speed transition from the old to the new ratio, measured from input and output speed. Gearbox modules adapt fill time and pressure to keep it in a calibrated window; the code sets when adaptation is at its limit and the time is still outside. No maker could be found using these generic codes; Saab's 1994 900 automatic monitored the same with its own code P1832, a window of 0.3 to 1.3 s and a limp program. P0895 means the shift completes faster than the window: clutch pressure too high or applied too early, giving a harsh shift.

description: The MIL request circuit is a dedicated wire over which the gearbox module asks the engine module to switch on the MIL. Today that request travels over CAN and shows as P0700 in the engine module; older Subarus, also sold as Saab 9-2X, used a single serial wire with its own codes P0864 to P0866. P0898 means the request wire stays at ground: a short to ground or, with active-high logic, a gearbox module without power. The engine module can then not tell a real request from a wiring fault. No maker documents the code; Subaru's P0865 is the closest documented equivalent.

description: Gear lever position sensor 2 is the redundant second sensor of an electronic selector lever, next to sensor 1 (P0821 ff), for the X or Y axis. The only documented user is GM's electronic range selection with PWM Hall sensors, as in the Cadillac XT4, and only for range, low and high. description: Here the module compares the combined gear lever position information with other evidence and finds no consistent picture. Two makers document it. FCA/Stellantis sets P08A6 in the PCM of 6-speed manual Jeeps such as the Wrangler JL as the all-gear-sensor check: the sensed gear is compared with a learned top-gear engine-to-road-speed ratio, so larger tyres trigger it until that ratio is relearned in sixth at 40–80 mph; a 4Low issue and software updates are also known, with MIL. Maserati's electronic shift module stores P08A6-64 for signal plausibility, leaving no gear selectable. Unlike P08A4/P08A5 it concerns the whole sensor system, not one sensor pair.

Control module software needing an update [MEDIUM]

description: Sensor A is the analog or PWM sensor that reports how far the clutch pedal of a manual car is pressed; the engine controller needs it for start-stop, cruise control, gear detection and starter release. P08A7 is the general circuit or open-wire fault of that sensor. No manufacturer documents this code publicly: GM folds an open circuit into its low-signal code P08A9, and Ford lists only P08A9/P08AA for sensor A. Saab's 2012 9-3 used the older P0806 as a comparable circuit fault (Check Engine, cruise control off). Range/performance, low, high and erratic faults have their own codes P08A8–P08AB. Expect a warning lamp and disabled start-stop or cruise control until the wiring or sensor is repaired.
possible_causes: Loose connector or broken wire at the pedal sensor (pedal box wiring flexes with every clutch stroke) [HIGH]
Internal fault in clutch pedal position sensor A [MEDIUM]
Missing 5 V reference or sensor ground [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input in the engine control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Saab nutzte im 9-3 von 2012 für einen vergleichbaren Kreisfehler noch P0806 (Motorkontrollleuchte, Tempomat aus). Plausibilität, zu niedrig, zu hoch und sporadisch haben eigene Codes (P08A8–P08AB). description: P08A8 flags a clutch pedal sensor whose signal is electrically valid but contradicts how the car is actually driving. GM uses it on manual cars since model year 2018 (before: P0806), e.g. the LV7 1.4 L engine and the 2019 Corvette ZR1 (LT5): when engine speed to output shaft speed shows that a gear is engaged and transmitting torque, but the pedal reads as pressed, the filtered position error must stay below 4 %. Enabled above 4.3 mph (LT5: 5.6 mph), not in 4WD low, torque above a table, no circuit, crank or speed sensor faults; Type A, MIL after one trip. Circuit faults are P08A9/P08AA. Typical result: start-stop and cruise control off, and the engine computer may misjudge clutch state.
possible_causes: Sensor loose or misaligned on the pedal bracket, so its reading no longer matches pedal travel [HIGH]
Worn or drifting sensor track giving an offset signal [MEDIUM]
Driver resting a foot on the clutch pedal, or a floor mat holding it down [MEDIUM]
Corroded connector adding resistance to signal or ground [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The sensor is designed with dead bands at both ends, so a signal near 0 V can only come from a fault. GM sets P08A9 when the signal stays below 4 % of the 5 V reference (low voltage or open circuit) for 400 of 500 samples taken every 12.5 ms, with the engine not cranking and system voltage above 9 V (10 V in some 2018 tables); Type A, MIL after one trip. GM used P0807 for this before 2018 and lists P08A9 for the LV7, the 2019 Corvette ZR1 and its 2018 OBDG04 engines. Ford's 2020–23 gasoline summary uses P08A9 for cars with dual PWM pedal sensors or a single analog sensor plus switches, detected in under a second. The high-side counterpart is P08AA; sensor B low is P08B6.
possible_causes: Signal wire chafed through and shorted to ground in the pedal area [HIGH]
Open signal wire or missing 5 V reference (connector off, broken wire) [HIGH]
Failed clutch pedal position sensor A [MEDIUM]
Shared 5 V reference pulled down by another sensor on the same circuit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: P08AA is the mirror image of P08A9: the pedal sensor signal climbs into the upper dead band that a healthy sensor never reaches. Failed clutch pedal position sensor A [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input in the engine control module [LOW]

description: P08AB is meant for a clutch pedal sensor A signal that jumps, drops out briefly or changes faster than a foot could move the pedal, without staying out of range long enough for the low or high codes. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. GM's published tables for the same sensor use only P08A8, P08A9, P08AA and P08AC, and its low/high checks need 400 of 500 bad samples, so short dropouts would go unnoticed there; Ford names only low, high and A/B correlation. Start-stop and cruise control may cut out intermittently.

symptoms: Start-stop or cruise control cutting out intermittently

description: The engine controller has to know at which pedal position the clutch is fully released or disengaged. GM teaches the fully applied position at the factory and then adapts it over time to clutch wear. P08AC is set when this learned value falls outside a window (LV7 1.4 L: 7–33 %, 2019 Corvette ZR1: 9–36 % of travel) or when the manufacturer's enable counter shows the learn was never completed; 250 ms loop, Type A, MIL after one trip. Before 2018 GM used P080A. After replacing the sensor, pedal parts, clutch or ECM, a relearn with a scan tool is needed; FCA, for example, issued a Renegade bulletin calling for a clutch pedal sensor learn. Circuit faults (P08A9/P08AA) must be cleared first.
possible_causes: Relearn not performed after replacing the sensor, clutch parts or engine control module [HIGH]
Learned position drifted out of the allowed window (worn clutch, wrong pedal stop, air in hydraulics) [MEDIUM]
Learn procedure aborted, for example by low battery voltage [MEDIUM]
Faulty or misaligned clutch pedal sensor preventing a valid learn [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Neutral position sensor B, the second neutral sensor or channel on a manual gearbox's shift shaft, delivers a signal that drops out or jumps for short moments. The closest documented case is on the A sensor: Audi's bulletin for the 2019–20 Q3 and 2022–23 A3 traces P086D/P086E to wires to sender G701 that were too short, so every gear change strained them; lengthening by 20 mm cures it. description: On a manual gearbox with two neutral sensors or two channels, the engine module compares A and B. description: Analog neutral sensors report a position value, and the control module must learn which value means neutral to cover part and fitting tolerances. P08B3 says no valid learned value exists for sensor B, typically after replacing the sensor, gearbox or module, after a software update, or after an aborted learn. No manufacturer documents P08B3 publicly; the A counterpart P086F is used by GM on the LT5 Corvette. A Schaeffler patent describes the learn: the driver engages neutral and the gears, and a run is rejected if the reading wanders too much in its roughly one-second window. FCA notes a neutral sensor learn procedure after service that restores cruise control. CARB 1968.2 (e)(15) applies. Fix is usually a relearn by scan tool.
possible_causes: Learn procedure not done after sensor, gearbox or module replacement [HIGH]
Learn run aborted, lever unsteady or linkage misadjusted [MEDIUM]
Learned values erased by software update or module reset [MEDIUM]
Sensor mounted outside the learnable range or faulty [LOW]

description: Some manual cars read the clutch pedal with two independent sensors so a single failure can be detected; Ford's 2020–23 gasoline OBD summary describes such a dual PWM layout. Sensor B is the second channel. P08B4 is the general circuit or open-wire fault of that second sensor. No manufacturer documents this code publicly: Ford uses only P08B6/P08B7 for sensor B plus P08B9 for the A/B comparison, and GM's tables cover sensor A alone. The code therefore rests on CARB's requirement to monitor such inputs for circuit faults. Sensor A's counterpart is P08A7. As long as sensor A is healthy the controller can usually still judge the pedal, but start-stop is often locked out until the fault is fixed.
possible_causes: Loose connector or broken wire on the sensor B channel [HIGH]
Internal fault in clutch pedal position sensor B (often a shared housing with sensor A) [MEDIUM]
Missing supply or ground for sensor B [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor B input in the engine control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

symptoms: Correlation code P08B9 may be stored as well

description: P08B5 covers a second clutch pedal sensor whose signal lies within its electrical limits but is implausible on its own, for example stuck at one value while the pedal moves or not matching the driving state. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Ford's dual PWM pedal sensor layout files any disagreement between the two channels under P08B9 rather than a B-only plausibility code, and GM applies the comparable in-gear plausibility check only to sensor A (P08A8: error above 4 % while a gear is engaged). CARB requires plausibility monitoring for inputs used by other diagnostics. If a manufacturer uses it, expect start-stop to be disabled; the clutch itself keeps working because it is hydraulically operated.

Corrosion adding resistance in the sensor B circuit [MEDIUM]

description: P08B6 means the signal of the second clutch pedal sensor has dropped below its valid range. Ford lists it in the 2020–23 gasoline OBD summary under dual PWM clutch sensors, together with P08A9/P08AA for sensor A, P08B7 for sensor B high and P08B9 for the A/B comparison; monitoring runs continuously and needs less than one second to flag a fault. Ford does not mark the code as non-MIL, unlike its clutch switch codes. For a PWM sensor, low usually means the output is stuck at ground (no pulses or 0 % duty cycle), caused by a short to ground, a lost supply or a dead sensor. GM's published tables have no sensor B. The driver mainly notices a warning lamp and missing start-stop.

Failed clutch pedal position sensor B [MEDIUM]

bilingual_title.en: Clutch Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: P08B7 is set when the second clutch pedal sensor reports a value above its valid range. Ford uses it on vehicles with two PWM clutch pedal sensors, as listed in its 2020–23 gasoline OBD summary next to P08B6 (sensor B low), P08A9/P08AA (sensor A) and P08B9 (A/B correlation); the check is continuous and decides within one second. The clutch switch codes on the same page are marked non-MIL, the sensor codes are not. With a PWM output, high typically means the line is held at its pull-up level (100 % duty cycle), which points to an open signal or ground wire or a short to voltage. GM's published tables cover sensor A only. Effect for the driver: warning lamp, start-stop locked out.
bilingual_description.de: P08B7 wird gesetzt, wenn der zweite Kupplungspedalsensor einen Wert oberhalb seines gültigen Bereichs meldet. Ford nutzt den Code bei Fahrzeugen mit zwei PWM-Pedalsensoren, aufgeführt in der Benzin-OBD-Übersicht 2020–23 neben P08B6 (Sensor B zu niedrig), P08A9/P08AA (Sensor A) und P08B9 (A/B-Korrelation); geprüft wird laufend, die Entscheidung fällt binnen einer Sekunde. Die Schaltercodes auf derselben Seite sind als non-MIL gekennzeichnet, die Sensorcodes nicht. Bei PWM-Ausgang bedeutet „hoch“ meist, dass die Leitung auf Pull-up-Pegel steht (100 % Tastgrad) – Hinweis auf unterbrochene Signal- oder Masseleitung oder Schluss nach Plus. GM dokumentiert nur Sensor A. Folge: Warnleuchte, Start-Stopp gesperrt.

symptoms: Sensor B reading pinned at maximum in scan tool data

description: P08B8 is intended for a second clutch pedal sensor whose signal drops out briefly or jumps without staying out of range. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Ford, the only maker found to publish sensor B codes, lists just low (P08B6), high (P08B7) and the A/B comparison (P08B9) for its dual PWM pedal sensors, so short glitches there would most likely surface as a correlation fault; GM covers sensor A only. CARB requires circuit and plausibility monitoring of such inputs. Likely culprits are worn connector terminals or a wire fatiguing where the harness moves with the pedal. Sensor A's counterpart is P08AB. Drivers may see start-stop drop out now and then.
possible_causes: Loose or worn terminals in the sensor B connector [HIGH]
Wire fatiguing where the harness flexes with pedal movement [MEDIUM]
Sensor B producing glitches internally [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 300€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Clutch Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

bilingual_description.en: P08B8 is intended for a second clutch pedal sensor whose signal drops out briefly or jumps without staying out of range. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Ford, the only maker found to publish sensor B codes, lists just low (P08B6), high (P08B7) and the A/B comparison (P08B9) for its dual PWM pedal sensors, so short glitches there would most likely surface as a correlation fault; GM covers sensor A only. CARB requires circuit and plausibility monitoring of such inputs. Likely culprits are worn connector terminals or a wire fatiguing where the harness moves with the pedal. Sensor A's counterpart is P08AB. Drivers may see start-stop drop out now and then.
bilingual_description.de: P08B8 ist für einen zweiten Kupplungspedalsensor gedacht, dessen Signal kurz aussetzt oder springt, ohne dauerhaft den Bereich zu verlassen. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diesen Code. Ford, der einzige gefundene Hersteller mit veröffentlichten Sensor-B-Codes, nennt für seine zwei PWM-Pedalsensoren nur zu niedrig (P08B6), zu hoch (P08B7) und den A/B-Vergleich (P08B9); kurze Störungen dürften dort am ehesten als Korrelationsfehler erscheinen. GM dokumentiert nur Sensor A. CARB fordert Kreis- und Plausibilitätsüberwachung solcher Eingänge. Typische Ursachen sind ausgeleierte Steckkontakte oder ein Kabel, das an der Biegestelle am Pedal ermüdet. Gegenstück bei Sensor A ist P08AB. Start-Stopp kann zeitweise ausfallen.

symptoms: Warning lamp that comes and goes

description: P08B9 is stored when two independent measurements of the clutch pedal disagree. Ford uses it in two ways per its 2020–23 gasoline OBD summary: with dual PWM sensors it compares sensor A with sensor B and decides within a second; with a single analog sensor plus two clutch switches it covers an in-range rationality fault or any switch-related mismatch, the switch part being judged over about 40 clutch cycles at different speeds. FCA patented a similar cross-check of the pedal sensor against the clutch interlock switch, which disables electronic stop-start on a mismatch and cannot always tell which part failed. Circuit faults of each sensor have their own codes (P08A9/P08AA, P08B6/P08B7).
possible_causes: One of the two sensors drifting or worn so the channels no longer agree [HIGH]
Sticking or misadjusted clutch switch on systems with one sensor plus switches [MEDIUM]
Corroded connector or wiring adding resistance to one channel [MEDIUM]
Sensor assembly or pedal stop misaligned after repairs [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Clutch Pedal Position Sensor A/B Correlation

bilingual_description.en: P08B9 is stored when two independent measurements of the clutch pedal disagree. Ford uses it in two ways per its 2020–23 gasoline OBD summary: with dual PWM sensors it compares sensor A with sensor B and decides within a second; with a single analog sensor plus two clutch switches it covers an in-range rationality fault or any switch-related mismatch, the switch part being judged over about 40 clutch cycles at different speeds. FCA patented a similar cross-check of the pedal sensor against the clutch interlock switch, which disables electronic stop-start on a mismatch and cannot always tell which part failed. Circuit faults of each sensor have their own codes (P08A9/P08AA, P08B6/P08B7).
bilingual_description.de: P08B9 wird gespeichert, wenn zwei unabhängige Messungen der Kupplungspedalstellung nicht zueinander passen. Ford nutzt den Code laut Benzin-OBD-Übersicht 2020–23 auf zwei Arten: Bei zwei PWM-Sensoren vergleicht er Sensor A mit Sensor B und entscheidet binnen einer Sekunde; bei einem Analogsensor mit zwei Kupplungsschaltern steht er für einen Plausibilitätsfehler im Messbereich oder jede Unstimmigkeit mit den Schaltern, wobei die Schalter über etwa 40 Betätigungen bei verschiedenen Geschwindigkeiten bewertet werden. FCA hat einen ähnlichen Abgleich von Pedalsensor und Anlasssperrschalter patentiert, der bei Widerspruch Start-Stopp abschaltet und nicht immer erkennt, welches Teil defekt ist. Kreisfehler haben eigene Codes (P08A9/P08AA, P08B6/P08B7).

description: Base code for the twelfth pressure control solenoid of an automatic transmission; which valve carries the letter L is up to the manufacturer. Toyota is the one documented user: bulletin T-SB-0094-24 for the 2024 Tacoma and Tacoma Hybrid lists it as P08BA71, actuator stuck, next to the stuck faults of solenoids A, C, D, G and H and a torque converter clutch stuck off. Because Toyota reports the fault type through the suffix, the stuck valve sits under this base code rather than under P08BB/P08BC. The MIL comes on. For trucks built before the production change Toyota's fix is a new transmission with torque converter, on the hybrid also the hybrid module. GM's Corvette dual clutch tables contain no L code.
possible_causes: Solenoid or its control valve sticking inside the valve body [HIGH]
Internal transmission fault from production, debris spreading through the hydraulics [MEDIUM]
Contaminated or wrong transmission fluid [MEDIUM]
Connector or harness fault at the solenoid [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 9000€ (1h - 7h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L

bilingual_description.en: Base code for the twelfth pressure control solenoid of an automatic transmission; which valve carries the letter L is up to the manufacturer. Toyota is the one documented user: bulletin T-SB-0094-24 for the 2024 Tacoma and Tacoma Hybrid lists it as P08BA71, actuator stuck, next to the stuck faults of solenoids A, C, D, G and H and a torque converter clutch stuck off. Because Toyota reports the fault type through the suffix, the stuck valve sits under this base code rather than under P08BB/P08BC. The MIL comes on. For trucks built before the production change Toyota's fix is a new transmission with torque converter, on the hybrid also the hybrid module. GM's Corvette dual clutch tables contain no L code.
bilingual_description.de: Grundcode für das zwölfte Druckregelventil eines Automatikgetriebes; welches Ventil den Buchstaben L trägt, legt der Hersteller fest. Belegt ist nur Toyota: Das Bulletin T-SB-0094-24 zum Tacoma und Tacoma Hybrid des Modelljahrs 2024 führt ihn als P08BA71, Stellglied hängt, neben den Hängern der Ventile A, C, D, G und H und einer nicht schließenden Wandlerkupplung. Weil Toyota die Fehlerart über die Endung meldet, steht das klemmende Ventil hier und nicht unter P08BB/P08BC. Die MIL leuchtet. Für Fahrzeuge vor der Serienänderung sieht Toyota ein neues Getriebe samt Wandler vor, beim Hybrid zusätzlich das Hybridmodul. GMs Tabellen zur Corvette-Doppelkupplung enthalten keinen L-Code.

symptoms: Transmission may hold a substitute gear

description: Set when pressure control solenoid L is commanded but the pressure or shift element it serves does not respond, i.e. the valve acts as if it were stuck in its off state. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Toyota, the only known user of letter L, reports a stuck valve as P08BA with suffix 71 instead. The closest documented analogue is GM's P08C4 for solenoid M on the Corvette dual clutch, where an intrusive routine moves the shift rods slightly and flags the valve when the expected rod travel stays below 100 µm. CARB requires such functional checks for transmission solenoids. P08BC is the opposite fault, P08BF to P08C2 cover the circuit. The driver notices missing or harsh shifts.
possible_causes: Valve spool held closed by debris or varnish [HIGH]
Low fluid level or weak supply pressure to the valve [MEDIUM]
Leaking seal or circuit downstream of the valve [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 4000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Performance/Stuck Off

bilingual_description.en: Set when pressure control solenoid L is commanded but the pressure or shift element it serves does not respond, i.e. the valve acts as if it were stuck in its off state. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Toyota, the only known user of letter L, reports a stuck valve as P08BA with suffix 71 instead. The closest documented analogue is GM's P08C4 for solenoid M on the Corvette dual clutch, where an intrusive routine moves the shift rods slightly and flags the valve when the expected rod travel stays below 100 µm. CARB requires such functional checks for transmission solenoids. P08BC is the opposite fault, P08BF to P08C2 cover the circuit. The driver notices missing or harsh shifts.
bilingual_description.de: Wird gesetzt, wenn Druckregelventil L angesteuert wird, der zugehörige Druck oder das Schaltelement aber nicht reagiert – das Ventil verhält sich, als hinge es im ausgeschalteten Zustand. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. Toyota, bislang einziger belegter Nutzer des Buchstabens L, meldet ein klemmendes Ventil stattdessen als P08BA mit Endung 71. Nächstes belegtes Gegenstück ist GMs P08C4 für Ventil M der Corvette-Doppelkupplung: Eine eingreifende Prüfroutine bewegt die Schaltstangen ein wenig und beanstandet das Ventil, wenn der erwartete Weg unter 100 µm bleibt. Solche Funktionsprüfungen verlangt CARB für Getriebeventile. P08BC ist der Gegenfehler, P08BF bis P08C2 betreffen den Stromkreis. Spürbar sind fehlende oder harte Gangwechsel.

description: Set when pressure control solenoid L keeps applying pressure although the control module has commanded it off, so the element it feeds stays loaded. No manufacturer publishes this code. Toyota, the only documented user of letter L, files a stuck valve under P08BA71 instead. GM's P08C5 for solenoid M of the Corvette dual clutch shows how such a check can work: after a selector valve change the module watches the shift rods, and unexpected movement of one rod or relaxation of another within 200 ms points to a valve that keeps pressure on. CARB lists transmission solenoids as monitored output components. P08BB is the stuck off counterpart. For the driver this means shift shock, binding or a fallback gear.
possible_causes: Valve spool held open by debris [HIGH]
Worn bore in the valve body letting pressure through [MEDIUM]
Output stage or wiring keeping the solenoid energised [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 4000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Stuck On

bilingual_description.en: Set when pressure control solenoid L keeps applying pressure although the control module has commanded it off, so the element it feeds stays loaded. No manufacturer publishes this code. Toyota, the only documented user of letter L, files a stuck valve under P08BA71 instead. GM's P08C5 for solenoid M of the Corvette dual clutch shows how such a check can work: after a selector valve change the module watches the shift rods, and unexpected movement of one rod or relaxation of another within 200 ms points to a valve that keeps pressure on. CARB lists transmission solenoids as monitored output components. P08BB is the stuck off counterpart. For the driver this means shift shock, binding or a fallback gear.
bilingual_description.de: Wird gesetzt, wenn Druckregelventil L weiter Druck gibt, obwohl das Steuergerät es abgeschaltet hat, sodass das versorgte Element belastet bleibt. Kein Hersteller veröffentlicht diesen Code. Toyota, einziger belegter Nutzer des Buchstabens L, führt ein klemmendes Ventil stattdessen unter P08BA71. Wie eine solche Prüfung aussehen kann, zeigt GMs P08C5 für Ventil M der Corvette-Doppelkupplung: Nach einem Wechsel des Wählventils beobachtet das Steuergerät die Schaltstangen, und eine unerwartete Bewegung der einen oder ein Nachgeben der anderen binnen 200 ms verrät ein Ventil, das Druck hält. CARB zählt Getriebeventile zu den überwachten Ausgangskomponenten. P08BB ist der Gegenfehler. Für den Fahrer bedeutet das Schaltstöße, Verspannen oder einen Notgang.

symptoms: Harsh engagement or binding during shifts
Transmission locked in a fallback gear

description: Collective code for an electrical fault of pressure control solenoid L that the module does not break down further into open, low or high. No manufacturer documents it publicly; Toyota, the one known user of letter L, has only published the stuck fault P08BA71. Manufacturers that diagnose their solenoids in detail use the specific circuit codes instead, as GM does for solenoid M with P08C8, P08CA and P08CB, each fed by the diagnostic status of the output driver chip. CARB requires a circuit continuity check for every monitored transmission solenoid. The usual culprits are coil, connector or the internal harness; the driver sees the warning light and, depending on the valve, a restricted gear range.
possible_causes: Solenoid coil open or shorted [HIGH]
Corroded connector or damaged internal harness [MEDIUM]
Faulty output stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Electrical

bilingual_description.en: Collective code for an electrical fault of pressure control solenoid L that the module does not break down further into open, low or high. No manufacturer documents it publicly; Toyota, the one known user of letter L, has only published the stuck fault P08BA71. Manufacturers that diagnose their solenoids in detail use the specific circuit codes instead, as GM does for solenoid M with P08C8, P08CA and P08CB, each fed by the diagnostic status of the output driver chip. CARB requires a circuit continuity check for every monitored transmission solenoid. The usual culprits are coil, connector or the internal harness; the driver sees the warning light and, depending on the valve, a restricted gear range.
bilingual_description.de: Sammelcode für einen elektrischen Fehler von Druckregelventil L, den das Steuergerät nicht weiter in Unterbrechung, zu niedrig oder zu hoch aufschlüsselt. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert ihn öffentlich; Toyota, einziger bekannter Nutzer des Buchstabens L, hat nur den Hänger P08BA71 veröffentlicht. Wer seine Ventile genauer diagnostiziert, nutzt die Einzelcodes – so GM bei Ventil M mit P08C8, P08CA und P08CB, die jeweils aus dem Diagnosestatus des Endstufen-Chips gespeist werden. CARB verlangt für jedes überwachte Getriebeventil eine Durchgangsprüfung des Stromkreises. Meist stecken Spule, Stecker oder der innere Kabelbaum dahinter; der Fahrer sieht die Warnleuchte und je nach Ventil einen eingeschränkten Gangbereich.

description: Reports a fault of pressure control solenoid L that comes and goes, typically a circuit that drops out briefly or a valve response that is only occasionally implausible. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, and in earlier packages the intermittent codes of the other pressure control solenoids also proved unused. Toyota, the one documented user of letter L, publishes only P08BA71. GM's circuit tests for the comparable solenoid M confirm a fault only after it persists for 150 ms, which is why brief dropouts tend to surface as a stored circuit code instead. CARB requires transmission solenoids to be monitored. Loose pins and chafed wires are the likely causes; symptoms are occasional shift flare or a short-lived fallback mode.
possible_causes: Loose or spread terminal at the solenoid or transmission connector [HIGH]
Chafed wire touching ground intermittently [MEDIUM]
Debris making the valve hang only now and then [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Intermittent

bilingual_description.en: Reports a fault of pressure control solenoid L that comes and goes, typically a circuit that drops out briefly or a valve response that is only occasionally implausible. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, and in earlier packages the intermittent codes of the other pressure control solenoids also proved unused. Toyota, the one documented user of letter L, publishes only P08BA71. GM's circuit tests for the comparable solenoid M confirm a fault only after it persists for 150 ms, which is why brief dropouts tend to surface as a stored circuit code instead. CARB requires transmission solenoids to be monitored. Loose pins and chafed wires are the likely causes; symptoms are occasional shift flare or a short-lived fallback mode.
bilingual_description.de: Meldet einen Fehler von Druckregelventil L, der kommt und geht – meist ein kurz aussetzender Stromkreis oder eine nur gelegentlich unplausible Ventilreaktion. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich, und schon in früheren Paketen blieben die Sporadisch-Codes der übrigen Druckregelventile ungenutzt. Toyota, einziger belegter Nutzer von L, veröffentlicht nur P08BA71. GMs Kreisprüfungen für das vergleichbare Ventil M bestätigen einen Fehler erst nach 150 ms Dauer, weshalb kurze Aussetzer eher als gespeicherter Kreiscode auftauchen. CARB verlangt die Überwachung der Getriebeventile. Wahrscheinlich sind lockere Pins oder durchgescheuerte Leitungen; spürbar sind gelegentliches Hochdrehen beim Schalten oder ein kurzer Notbetrieb.

symptoms: Warning light that comes and goes

description: Points to an open control circuit of pressure control solenoid L: the module sees no load where the coil should be. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the only known user of letter L, has published just P08BA71. GM's open-load test for the analogous solenoid M (P08C8) shows the method: with the low-side driver switched off, the coil should pull the sense pin up to battery voltage; if the driver chip can hold it between roughly 1.7 and 3 V with a tiny current, the circuit is open. Confirmation takes 150 ms. P08C1 and P08C2 are the short to ground and short to power. Typical results are a fallback gear and the warning light.
possible_causes: Connector loose, unplugged or corroded [HIGH]
Broken wire in the internal or external harness [MEDIUM]
Solenoid coil burnt open [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Control Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: Points to an open control circuit of pressure control solenoid L: the module sees no load where the coil should be. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the only known user of letter L, has published just P08BA71. GM's open-load test for the analogous solenoid M (P08C8) shows the method: with the low-side driver switched off, the coil should pull the sense pin up to battery voltage; if the driver chip can hold it between roughly 1.7 and 3 V with a tiny current, the circuit is open. Confirmation takes 150 ms. P08C1 and P08C2 are the short to ground and short to power. Typical results are a fallback gear and the warning light.
bilingual_description.de: Weist auf einen unterbrochenen Steuerkreis von Druckregelventil L hin: Das Steuergerät findet keine Last, wo die Spule sein sollte. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; Toyota, einziger bekannter Nutzer des Buchstabens L, hat nur P08BA71 veröffentlicht. Die Methode zeigt GMs Prüfung auf offene Last beim entsprechenden Ventil M (P08C8): Bei abgeschalteter Low-Side-Endstufe müsste die Spule den Messpin auf Batteriespannung ziehen; gelingt es dem Treiberchip, ihn mit winzigem Strom zwischen etwa 1,7 und 3 V zu halten, ist der Kreis offen. Bestätigt wird nach 150 ms. P08C1 und P08C2 sind der Schluss nach Masse bzw. nach Plus. Typische Folgen sind Notgang und Warnleuchte.

description: Set when the control circuit of pressure control solenoid L is electrically intact but its behaviour is implausible, for example the current through the coil does not match the commanded value. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the only documented user of letter L, publishes only P08BA71. As an orientation, GM's tables for the comparable solenoid M list a current check next to the circuit tests: a deviation of more than 70 % for 60 ms or more than 400 mA for 300 ms between target and estimated current, without naming P08C9 for it. Causes are a coil with changed resistance, contact resistance or supply problems. P08BF, P08C1 and P08C2 cover clear open or short faults.
possible_causes: Coil resistance out of specification [HIGH]
High contact resistance at connector pins [MEDIUM]
Unstable supply voltage to the transmission module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Control Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: Set when the control circuit of pressure control solenoid L is electrically intact but its behaviour is implausible, for example the current through the coil does not match the commanded value. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the only documented user of letter L, publishes only P08BA71. As an orientation, GM's tables for the comparable solenoid M list a current check next to the circuit tests: a deviation of more than 70 % for 60 ms or more than 400 mA for 300 ms between target and estimated current, without naming P08C9 for it. Causes are a coil with changed resistance, contact resistance or supply problems. P08BF, P08C1 and P08C2 cover clear open or short faults.
bilingual_description.de: Wird gesetzt, wenn der Steuerkreis von Druckregelventil L elektrisch zwar intakt ist, sich aber unplausibel verhält – etwa wenn der Spulenstrom nicht zum Sollwert passt. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; Toyota, einziger belegter Nutzer von L, veröffentlicht nur P08BA71. Zur Orientierung: GMs Tabellen für das vergleichbare Ventil M führen neben den Kreisprüfungen einen Stromvergleich – mehr als 70 % Abweichung über 60 ms oder mehr als 400 mA über 300 ms zwischen Soll- und geschätztem Strom –, ohne ihm P08C9 zuzuordnen. Ursachen sind eine Spule mit verändertem Widerstand, Übergangswiderstände oder Versorgungsprobleme. Klare Unterbrechungen und Schlüsse decken P08BF, P08C1 und P08C2 ab.

description: Reports a control circuit voltage of pressure control solenoid L that is too low, usually a short to ground. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the one documented user of letter L, has published only P08BA71. GM's equivalent for solenoid M (P08CA) illustrates the check: while the low-side driver is switched on, the sense pin is examined and a value below about 1.7 V is read as a short to ground, confirmed after 150 ms with battery voltage between 8.75 and 18 V. Depending on the wiring, a ground short can energise the valve permanently or make it uncontrollable. P08C2 is the high counterpart, P08BF the open circuit. Expect a fallback gear and the warning light.
possible_causes: Control wire chafed through to ground [HIGH]
Shorted turns in the solenoid coil [MEDIUM]
Fluid or moisture in the connector [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Reports a control circuit voltage of pressure control solenoid L that is too low, usually a short to ground. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the one documented user of letter L, has published only P08BA71. GM's equivalent for solenoid M (P08CA) illustrates the check: while the low-side driver is switched on, the sense pin is examined and a value below about 1.7 V is read as a short to ground, confirmed after 150 ms with battery voltage between 8.75 and 18 V. Depending on the wiring, a ground short can energise the valve permanently or make it uncontrollable. P08C2 is the high counterpart, P08BF the open circuit. Expect a fallback gear and the warning light.
bilingual_description.de: Meldet eine zu niedrige Spannung im Steuerkreis von Druckregelventil L, meist ein Schluss nach Masse. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; Toyota, einziger belegter Nutzer von L, hat nur P08BA71 veröffentlicht. GMs Gegenstück für Ventil M (P08CA) zeigt die Prüfung: Bei eingeschalteter Low-Side-Endstufe wird der Messpin bewertet, ein Wert unter etwa 1,7 V gilt als Masseschluss und wird nach 150 ms bei 8,75 bis 18 V Bordspannung bestätigt. Je nach Verdrahtung kann ein Masseschluss das Ventil dauernd bestromen oder unsteuerbar machen. P08C2 ist das Gegenstück zu hoch, P08BF die Unterbrechung. Zu erwarten sind Notgang und Warnleuchte.

description: Reports a control circuit voltage of pressure control solenoid L that is too high, typically a short to battery voltage or to a neighbouring output. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the one documented user of letter L, has published only P08BA71. GM's equivalent for solenoid M (P08CB) uses two tests: with the low-side driver on, a sense voltage above 0.7 to 1.1 V, depending on supply voltage, means a short to power; at shutdown each output is also switched on in turn to detect a short to a neighbouring output, which is then stored and reported at the next start. A shorted valve usually cannot be switched off. P08C1 is the low counterpart, P08BF the open circuit.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Short between adjacent solenoid wires in the internal harness [MEDIUM]
Defective output stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid L Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Reports a control circuit voltage of pressure control solenoid L that is too high, typically a short to battery voltage or to a neighbouring output. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; Toyota, the one documented user of letter L, has published only P08BA71. GM's equivalent for solenoid M (P08CB) uses two tests: with the low-side driver on, a sense voltage above 0.7 to 1.1 V, depending on supply voltage, means a short to power; at shutdown each output is also switched on in turn to detect a short to a neighbouring output, which is then stored and reported at the next start. A shorted valve usually cannot be switched off. P08C1 is the low counterpart, P08BF the open circuit.
bilingual_description.de: Meldet eine zu hohe Spannung im Steuerkreis von Druckregelventil L, typischerweise ein Schluss nach Plus oder zu einem benachbarten Ausgang. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; Toyota, einziger belegter Nutzer von L, hat nur P08BA71 veröffentlicht. GMs Gegenstück für Ventil M (P08CB) prüft doppelt: Bei eingeschalteter Low-Side-Endstufe bedeutet eine Messspannung über 0,7 bis 1,1 V, je nach Bordspannung, einen Plusschluss; beim Abstellen werden zudem alle Ausgänge nacheinander geschaltet, um einen Schluss zum Nachbarausgang zu finden, der gespeichert und beim nächsten Start gemeldet wird. Ein so kurzgeschlossenes Ventil lässt sich meist nicht abschalten. P08C1 ist das Gegenstück zu niedrig, P08BF die Unterbrechung.

description: Base code for the thirteenth pressure control solenoid; the letter is assigned by the manufacturer. GM uses letter M in the Tremec eight-speed dual clutch of the Corvette (RPO M1L/M1M): its 2023–2025 TCM tables name the part synchronizer actuation valve 1, which serves the odd-gear shaft, while valves 2 to 5 report under P27B9 onwards. GM does not set this base code but the specific ones: P08C4 and P08C5 for hydraulic sticking, P08C8, P08CA and P08CB for the circuit. No other manufacturer documents P08C3 publicly. If it appears, the module has seen a non-specific fault of this valve; the driver typically notices the warning light and rough or missing gear changes on that shaft.
possible_causes: Valve sticking from debris in the valve body [HIGH]
Fault in the solenoid wiring or connector [MEDIUM]
Worn or failed solenoid [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 4000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Grundcode für das dreizehnte Druckregelventil; den Buchstaben vergibt der Hersteller. GM nutzt M im Tremec-Achtgang-Doppelkupplungsgetriebe der Corvette (RPO M1L/M1M): Die TCM-Tabellen 2023–2025 nennen das Bauteil Synchronisier-Betätigungsventil 1, zuständig für die Welle der ungeraden Gänge; die Ventile 2 bis 5 melden ab P27B9. GM setzt nicht diesen Grundcode, sondern die Einzelcodes: P08C4 und P08C5 für hydraulisches Klemmen, P08C8, P08CA und P08CB für den Stromkreis. Kein anderer Hersteller dokumentiert P08C3 öffentlich. Taucht er auf, hat das Steuergerät einen unspezifischen Fehler dieses Ventils erkannt; spürbar sind Warnleuchte und raue oder fehlende Gangwechsel auf dieser Welle.

symptoms: Rough or missing shifts in odd gears

description: GM sets this code on the Corvette's Tremec dual clutch when synchronizer actuation valve 1, the valve for the odd-gear shaft, is hydraulically stuck off. The test runs inside a synchronizer recovery or integrity routine, started after a shift-related fault or when the stored gear does not match the sensed gears at start-up: the shift rods are moved slightly, and if a rod travels 100 µm or less where the valve should move it, a current profile check of the valve has to fail three times before the fault is confirmed. Type A, MIL at once. Bulletin 21-NA-033 blames debris; the fix is GDS valve cleaning three times, service clean and fast learn, and a new control valve body only if it returns.
possible_causes: Valve stuck closed by debris in the control valve body [HIGH]
Debris from a dislodged snap ring in the direct clutch assembly (bulletin 23-NA-197) [MEDIUM]
Low system pressure or fluid level [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Geprüft wird in einer Rettungs- oder Integritätsroutine der Synchronisierung, die nach einem Schaltfehler startet oder wenn der gespeicherte Gang beim Start nicht zu den erkannten Gängen passt: Die Schaltstangen werden ein Stück bewegt, und legt eine Stange dort, wo das Ventil sie bewegen müsste, höchstens 100 µm zurück, muss eine Stromprofilprüfung des Ventils dreimal scheitern, bevor der Fehler bestätigt ist. Typ A, MIL sofort. Laut Bulletin 21-NA-033 ist Abrieb schuld: dreimal mit GDS spülen, Service Clean und Schnell-Anlernen, erst bei Wiederkehr neuer Steuerventilblock.

symptoms: Odd gears not engaged or engaged late

description: GM uses this code on the Corvette's Tremec dual clutch when synchronizer actuation valve 1, serving the odd-gear shaft, keeps pressure on although it is commanded off. The check runs whenever the selector pilot valve changes position: a valve stuck on keeps pushing a shift rod, so after the switch the pressure is routed elsewhere. If within 200 ms one rod moves unintentionally by 1000 µm or more while another relaxes by 125 µm or more, and both position sensors are electrically fine, the fault is set. Type A, monitored continuously. Bulletins 21-NA-033 and 23-NA-197 list it with the other valve codes; debris in the control valve body is the main cause. P08C4 is the stuck off counterpart.
possible_causes: Valve held open by debris in the control valve body [HIGH]
Debris from a dislodged snap ring in the direct clutch assembly (bulletin 23-NA-197) [MEDIUM]
Worn valve bore in the control valve body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: GM nutzt diesen Code am Tremec-Doppelkupplungsgetriebe der Corvette, wenn Synchronisier-Betätigungsventil 1 für die Welle der ungeraden Gänge Druck hält, obwohl es abgeschaltet ist. Geprüft wird bei jedem Stellungswechsel des Wähl-Vorsteuerventils: Ein hängendes Ventil drückt weiter auf eine Schaltstange, nach dem Umschalten wird sein Druck aber anders verteilt. Bewegt sich binnen 200 ms eine Stange ungewollt um 1000 µm oder mehr, während eine andere um 125 µm oder mehr nachgibt, und sind beide Wegsensoren elektrisch in Ordnung, wird der Fehler gesetzt. Typ A, ständig überwacht. Die Bulletins 21-NA-033 und 23-NA-197 führen ihn mit den übrigen Ventilcodes; Hauptursache ist Abrieb im Steuerventilblock. P08C4 ist der Gegenfehler.

symptoms: Clunks or unwanted gear engagement on the odd shaft

description: Collective code for an electrical fault of pressure control solenoid M without a finer split into open, low or high. No manufacturer documents it publicly. GM, the documented user of letter M on the Corvette dual clutch (synchronizer actuation valve 1), reports electrical faults only through the specific codes P08C8, P08CA and P08CB, which are derived from the diagnostic status of the low-side driver chip and confirmed after 150 ms. CARB requires a circuit check for every monitored transmission solenoid. A manufacturer setting P08C6 would point to coil, connector or harness of this valve; for the driver this means the warning light and restricted shifting on the affected shaft.
possible_causes: Solenoid coil open or shorted [HIGH]
Damaged connector or internal harness [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Sammelcode für einen elektrischen Fehler von Druckregelventil M ohne genauere Aufteilung in Unterbrechung, zu niedrig oder zu hoch. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert ihn öffentlich. GM, belegter Nutzer des Buchstabens M an der Corvette-Doppelkupplung (Synchronisier-Betätigungsventil 1), meldet elektrische Fehler nur über die Einzelcodes P08C8, P08CA und P08CB, die aus dem Diagnosestatus des Low-Side-Treiberchips abgeleitet und nach 150 ms bestätigt werden. CARB verlangt für jedes überwachte Getriebeventil eine Kreisprüfung. Ein Hersteller, der P08C6 setzt, verweist damit auf Spule, Stecker oder Kabelbaum dieses Ventils; für den Fahrer heißt das Warnleuchte und eingeschränktes Schalten auf der betroffenen Welle.

description: Reports an on-and-off fault of pressure control solenoid M, such as brief circuit dropouts or occasional implausible responses. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; GM, which uses letter M for synchronizer actuation valve 1 of the Corvette dual clutch, lists no intermittent code for it, and earlier packages found the intermittent codes of the other pressure control solenoids unused as well. GM's circuit tests need a fault to last 150 ms, so short dropouts mostly end up as P08C8, P08CA or P08CB once they persist. CARB requires transmission solenoids to be monitored. Loose terminals and chafed wires are the likely causes; symptoms are sporadic shift faults and a warning light that comes and goes.
possible_causes: Loose terminal at the solenoid or transmission connector [HIGH]
Chafed wire with intermittent contact [MEDIUM]
Debris causing occasional valve hang-ups [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Meldet einen kommenden und gehenden Fehler von Druckregelventil M, etwa kurze Aussetzer im Stromkreis oder gelegentlich unplausible Reaktionen. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; GM, das M für Synchronisier-Betätigungsventil 1 der Corvette-Doppelkupplung verwendet, führt dafür keinen Sporadisch-Code, und schon frühere Pakete fanden die Sporadisch-Codes der übrigen Druckregelventile ungenutzt. GMs Kreisprüfungen verlangen 150 ms Fehlerdauer, kurze Aussetzer landen daher bei Bestand meist als P08C8, P08CA oder P08CB. CARB schreibt die Überwachung der Getriebeventile vor. Wahrscheinlich sind lockere Kontakte und durchgescheuerte Leitungen; spürbar sind sporadische Schaltfehler und eine Warnleuchte, die kommt und geht.

symptoms: Warning light that comes and goes

description: GM sets this code on the Corvette's Tremec dual clutch for an open circuit at synchronizer actuation valve 1, the valve for the odd-gear shaft. The open-load test runs with the low-side driver switched off: an intact coil pulls the sense pin to battery voltage, so if the driver chip can hold it between about 1.7 and 3 V (each ±0.5 V) with a very small current, the circuit is considered open. The fault must persist for 150 ms with battery voltage between 8.75 and 18 V and the engine not cranking; it is suspended while P0882 or P0883 indicates a supply problem. Type A, MIL at once. Without this valve the odd shaft cannot be shifted reliably, so a fallback mode is likely.
possible_causes: Connector at the control valve body loose or corroded [HIGH]
Broken wire in the internal harness [MEDIUM]
Solenoid coil open [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

The open-load test runs with the low-side driver switched off: an intact coil pulls the sense pin to battery voltage, so if the driver chip can hold it between about 1.7 and 3 V (each ±0.5 V) with a very small current, the circuit is considered open. The fault must persist for 150 ms with battery voltage between 8.75 and 18 V and the engine not cranking; it is suspended while P0882 or P0883 indicates a supply problem. Type A, MIL at once. bilingual_description.de: GM setzt diesen Code am Tremec-Doppelkupplungsgetriebe der Corvette bei einem unterbrochenen Kreis von Synchronisier-Betätigungsventil 1, dem Ventil für die Welle der ungeraden Gänge. Die Prüfung auf offene Last läuft bei abgeschalteter Low-Side-Endstufe: Eine intakte Spule zieht den Messpin auf Batteriespannung; kann der Treiberchip ihn mit sehr kleinem Strom zwischen etwa 1,7 und 3 V (je ±0,5 V) halten, gilt der Kreis als offen. Der Fehler muss 150 ms anstehen, bei 8,75 bis 18 V Bordspannung und ohne Startvorgang; zeigt P0882 oder P0883 ein Versorgungsproblem, ruht die Prüfung. Typ A, MIL sofort. Ohne dieses Ventil lässt sich die ungerade Welle nicht sicher schalten, ein Notbetrieb ist wahrscheinlich.

description: Meant for a control circuit of pressure control solenoid M that is not open or shorted but behaves implausibly, for instance a coil current that does not follow the command. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. GM, which uses letter M for synchronizer actuation valve 1 of the Corvette dual clutch, publishes only open, low, high and the two hydraulic codes for it; its tables do describe a current check that compares target and estimated current (more than 70 % for 60 ms or more than 400 mA for 300 ms), but without naming P08C9. CARB requires monitoring of transmission solenoids. Possible causes are a coil with drifting resistance, contact resistance or supply voltage problems; shift quality may suffer.
possible_causes: Coil resistance out of specification [HIGH]
High contact resistance at connector pins [MEDIUM]
Unstable supply voltage to the transmission module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Gedacht für einen Steuerkreis von Druckregelventil M, der weder offen noch kurzgeschlossen ist, sich aber unplausibel verhält – etwa ein Spulenstrom, der dem Sollwert nicht folgt. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. GM, das M für Synchronisier-Betätigungsventil 1 der Corvette-Doppelkupplung verwendet, veröffentlicht dafür nur Unterbrechung, zu niedrig, zu hoch und die beiden Hydraulikcodes; seine Tabellen beschreiben zwar einen Stromvergleich zwischen Soll- und geschätztem Strom (über 70 % für 60 ms oder über 400 mA für 300 ms), ordnen ihm aber nicht P08C9 zu. CARB verlangt die Überwachung der Getriebeventile. Mögliche Ursachen sind driftender Spulenwiderstand, Übergangswiderstände oder Spannungsprobleme; die Schaltqualität kann leiden.

description: GM sets this code on the Corvette's Tremec dual clutch for a short to ground in the circuit of synchronizer actuation valve 1, which serves the odd-gear shaft. The test runs while the low-side driver is switched on: the sense pin should then sit at a defined level, and if the driver chip reports it below about 1.7 V (±0.5 V), a ground short is assumed. Confirmation takes 150 ms at 8.75 to 18 V battery voltage with the engine not cranking, and the check is suspended when P0882 or P0883 is present. Type A, MIL at once, monitored continuously. Valves 2 to 5 have their own low codes (P27BF onwards). The driver should expect a fallback mode until the wiring fault is repaired.
possible_causes: Control wire chafed through to ground [HIGH]
Shorted turns in the solenoid coil [MEDIUM]
Fluid in the transmission connector [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Geprüft wird bei eingeschalteter Low-Side-Endstufe: Der Messpin sollte dann auf einem festen Niveau liegen; meldet der Treiberchip weniger als etwa 1,7 V (±0,5 V), wird ein Masseschluss angenommen. Bestätigt wird nach 150 ms bei 8,75 bis 18 V Bordspannung und ohne Startvorgang; liegen P0882 oder P0883 vor, ruht die Prüfung. Typ A, MIL sofort, ständig überwacht. Die Ventile 2 bis 5 haben eigene Codes (ab P27BF). Bis zur Reparatur der Leitung ist mit Notbetrieb zu rechnen.

description: GM uses this code on the Corvette's Tremec dual clutch for synchronizer actuation valve 1 (odd-gear shaft) in two situations. First, a short to battery voltage: with the low-side driver on, a sense voltage above 0.7, 0.9 or 1.1 V (±0.1 V), depending on supply voltage, counts as a shorted load, confirmed after 150 ms. Second, a short to a neighbouring output: at shutdown every output is switched on in turn, a cross-reaction is stored in memory and the code is set at the next start. Type A, MIL at once. The check pauses while P0882 or P0883 is present. A valve shorted to power cannot be switched off, so the transmission will usually go into a fallback mode.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Short to an adjacent solenoid wire in the internal harness [MEDIUM]
Defective driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.
