bilingual_description.en: Set when the control module of an automated manual gearbox commands the select actuator to a new gate, but the measured select position does not reach the target within the allowed time and tolerance. Sensor and actuator circuits may be electrically fine; the fault lies in the closed loop as a whole. Typical reasons are a jammed or stiff select shaft or shift head, a worn or weak select motor, or a sensor offset. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. An Aisin AI patent describes select control with target and actual gates, and a Hyundai/Kia patent detects jammed or stuck shift actuators from motor current. CARB requires functional checks on such outputs. P0910 to P0913 are the actuator circuit faults, P0919 the same error in the shift direction. The gearbox may refuse gears or stay in neutral.
bilingual_description.de: Wird gesetzt, wenn das Steuergerät eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes den Wählsteller in eine neue Gasse schickt, die gemessene Wählposition das Ziel aber nicht in der erlaubten Zeit und Toleranz erreicht. Sensor- und Stellerkreise können elektrisch intakt sein – der Fehler liegt im Regelkreis als Ganzem. Typisch sind eine klemmende Wählwelle bzw. Schaltkopf, ein verschlissener Wählmotor oder ein Sensorversatz. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Ein Patent von Aisin AI beschreibt die Wählregelung mit Ziel- und Istgasse, ein Patent von Hyundai/Kia erkennt blockierte oder klemmende Schaltsteller am Motorstrom. CARB verlangt Funktionsprüfungen solcher Ausgänge. P0910 bis P0913 sind die Stellerkreis-Fehler, P0919 derselbe Fehler in Schaltrichtung. Das Getriebe verweigert dann Gänge oder bleibt in Neutral.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Certain gears cannot be engaged or gearbox stays in neutral
Clicking or whirring from the actuator without a gear change

description: Watches the drive circuit of the actuator for clutch B, the second clutch of a dual-clutch transmission, and sets when the module finds an open circuit. Ford uses it on the DPS6 PowerShift of the Fiesta and Focus: the clutch B electric motor is tested for driver faults (P087A), hall sensor faults (P087B), sequence errors (P087E), an open circuit (P090A), a short to ground (P090C) and a short to power (P090D). Trade guidance for the DPS6 is to swap the two identical clutch motors; if the code moves to the clutch A equivalent P0900, the motor is defective, otherwise the harness or TCM is. CARB requires circuit monitoring of such outputs. Shifting becomes erratic and the gearbox may refuse to drive.
possible_causes: Failed clutch B actuator motor [HIGH]
Loose connector or broken wire to the clutch B motor [MEDIUM]
Faulty motor driver inside the TCM [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 900€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Clutch B Actuator Control Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: Watches the drive circuit of the actuator for clutch B, the second clutch of a dual-clutch transmission, and sets when the module finds an open circuit. Ford uses it on the DPS6 PowerShift of the Fiesta and Focus: the clutch B electric motor is tested for driver faults (P087A), hall sensor faults (P087B), sequence errors (P087E), an open circuit (P090A), a short to ground (P090C) and a short to power (P090D). Trade guidance for the DPS6 is to swap the two identical clutch motors; if the code moves to the clutch A equivalent P0900, the motor is defective, otherwise the harness or TCM is. CARB requires circuit monitoring of such outputs. Shifting becomes erratic and the gearbox may refuse to drive.
bilingual_description.de: Überwacht den Ansteuerkreis des Stellers für Kupplung B, die zweite Kupplung eines Doppelkupplungsgetriebes, und steht, wenn das Steuergerät eine Unterbrechung findet. Ford nutzt den Code beim DPS6-PowerShift von Fiesta und Focus: Der E-Motor für Kupplung B wird auf Endstufenfehler (P087A), Hallsensorfehler (P087B), Signalfolgefehler (P087E), Unterbrechung (P090A), Masseschluss (P090C) und Schluss nach Plus (P090D) geprüft. Fachlicher Tipp beim DPS6: die beiden baugleichen Kupplungsmotoren tauschen; springt der Code auf das Gegenstück P0900 von Kupplung A, ist der Motor defekt, sonst Kabelbaum oder TCM. CARB fordert die Kreisüberwachung. Das Schalten wird unruhig, unter Umständen fährt das Auto nicht mehr.

symptoms: Even gears or reverse missing, erratic shifts

description: Set when the clutch B actuator circuit is electrically connected but the actuator does not respond as commanded, for example too slowly or with an unexpected current draw. Ford uses P090B on the DPS6 PowerShift transmission. Trade guidance for this gearbox starts with a visual check of the harness from the TCM to the clutch B motor, then swaps the two identical clutch motors: if the code becomes P0901, the motor with its built-in position sensor is faulty; if P090B stays, the circuit or TCM needs pinpoint testing. Ford's TCM program 14M02 for 2011-2015 Fiesta and Focus also lists P090B as a code where the TCM itself can be the cause. P090A, P090C and P090D are the pure circuit faults of clutch B.
possible_causes: Worn or sluggish clutch B actuator motor [HIGH]
TCM fault (Ford program 14M02 lists this code) [MEDIUM]
Damaged harness between TCM and clutch B motor [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Clutch B Actuator Control Circuit Performance

bilingual_description.en: Set when the clutch B actuator circuit is electrically connected but the actuator does not respond as commanded, for example too slowly or with an unexpected current draw. Ford uses P090B on the DPS6 PowerShift transmission. Trade guidance for this gearbox starts with a visual check of the harness from the TCM to the clutch B motor, then swaps the two identical clutch motors: if the code becomes P0901, the motor with its built-in position sensor is faulty; if P090B stays, the circuit or TCM needs pinpoint testing. Ford's TCM program 14M02 for 2011-2015 Fiesta and Focus also lists P090B as a code where the TCM itself can be the cause. P090A, P090C and P090D are the pure circuit faults of clutch B.
bilingual_description.de: Der Kreis des Stellers für Kupplung B ist elektrisch verbunden, der Steller reagiert aber nicht wie befohlen, etwa zu langsam oder mit unerwarteter Stromaufnahme. Ford setzt P090B beim DPS6-PowerShift ein. Der Fachrat für dieses Getriebe: zuerst den Kabelbaum vom TCM zum Motor von Kupplung B ansehen, dann die beiden baugleichen Kupplungsmotoren tauschen. Wird daraus P0901, ist der Motor samt eingebautem Positionssensor defekt; bleibt P090B, müssen Kreis und TCM gezielt geprüft werden. Fords TCM-Programm 14M02 für Fiesta und Focus 2011–2015 nennt P090B außerdem als Code, bei dem das Steuergerät selbst die Ursache sein kann. P090A, P090C und P090D sind die reinen Kreisfehler von Kupplung B.

symptoms: Shudder or slipping in even gears and reverse
Delayed or missed shifts, possible limp mode

description: Set when the control circuit of the clutch B actuator shows a low state, which on the documented application means a short to ground. Ford defines P090C as the short-to-ground check of the clutch B motor in the DPS6 PowerShift gearbox, paired with P090A for an open circuit and P090D for a short to power. Ford's TCM program 14M02 for 2011-2015 Fiesta and Focus also lists P090C among the codes that a defective TCM can cause, so the module belongs on the suspect list along with the motor and its wiring. Swapping the identical clutch motors helps: if the fault moves to P0902, the motor is bad. CARB requires circuit monitoring of such outputs. Expect missing gears, erratic shifts or no drive.
possible_causes: Clutch B actuator motor with internal short to ground [HIGH]
Failed TCM output stage (Ford program 14M02 lists this code) [MEDIUM]
Chafed motor wire touching ground [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1200€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: Set when the control circuit of the clutch B actuator shows a low state, which on the documented application means a short to ground. Ford definiert P090C als Masseschluss-Prüfung des Motors von Kupplung B im DPS6-PowerShift, ergänzt durch P090A für Unterbrechung und P090D für Schluss nach Plus. Fords TCM-Programm 14M02 für Fiesta und Focus 2011–2015 führt P090C auch unter den Codes, die ein defektes Getriebesteuergerät auslösen kann – neben Motor und Leitungen gehört also das Steuergerät auf die Liste. Ein Tausch der baugleichen Kupplungsmotoren hilft: Springt der Fehler auf P0902, ist der Motor schuld. CARB verlangt die Kreisüberwachung. Typisch sind fehlende Gänge, unruhiges Schalten oder kein Vortrieb.

description: Set when the control circuit of the clutch B actuator shows a high state, i.e. a motor or control line is shorted to battery voltage. Ford documents P090D as the short-to-power check of the clutch B motor in the DPS6 PowerShift transmission of the Fiesta and Focus. Ford customer satisfaction program 20B23, covering some 2016-2017 Focus cars, names P090D together with P0900 and several hall and driver codes as signs of failed clutch actuator motors, with erratic shifting, vibration and a lit check engine light; dealers replaced both motors. P090A and P090C are the open and ground faults of the same circuit, P0903 the clutch A equivalent. CARB requires circuit checks on such transmission outputs.
possible_causes: Failed clutch B actuator motor (Ford program 20B23) [HIGH]
Motor or control wire shorted to a supply line [MEDIUM]
Faulty motor driver in the TCM [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 900€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Clutch B Actuator Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Set when the control circuit of the clutch B actuator shows a high state, i.e. a motor or control line is shorted to battery voltage. Ford dokumentiert P090D als Prüfung auf Schluss nach Plus am Motor von Kupplung B im DPS6-PowerShift von Fiesta und Focus. P090A und P090C sind Unterbrechung und Masseschluss desselben Kreises, P0903 das Gegenstück an Kupplung A. CARB verlangt solche Kreisprüfungen an Getriebe-Ausgängen.

symptoms: Erratic or missed shifts and vibration

description: Concerns the drive circuit of the gate select actuator, the motor or valve that moves the shift mechanism of an automated manual gearbox sideways from gate to gate. The code sets when the control module finds this output open or electrically faulty, for example when no current flows although the driver stage is switched on. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Isuzu and Hyundai/Kia patents describe select and shift actuators as electric motors fed by the transmission controller; older and heavy-duty systems use hydraulic or pneumatic select cylinders with solenoid valves. CARB requires circuit checks on such outputs. P0911 to P0913 are the range, low and high variants, P0909 a select movement that misses its target. Without the select actuator the gearbox cannot change gates and stays in its current gear or neutral.
possible_causes: Open winding or worn brushes in the select motor [HIGH]
Broken actuator wire or terminal pushed out of the connector [MEDIUM]
Corroded actuator connector near the gearbox [MEDIUM]
Faulty actuator driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Betrifft den Ansteuerkreis des Gassenwahl-Stellers, also des Motors oder Ventils, der die Schaltmechanik eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes seitlich von Gasse zu Gasse bewegt. Der Code steht, wenn das Steuergerät diesen Ausgang offen oder elektrisch fehlerhaft findet, etwa wenn trotz eingeschalteter Endstufe kein Strom fließt. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Patente von Isuzu und Hyundai/Kia beschreiben Wähl- und Schaltsteller als Elektromotoren am Getriebesteuergerät; ältere und Nutzfahrzeug-Systeme nutzen hydraulische oder pneumatische Wählzylinder mit Magnetventilen. CARB verlangt für solche Ausgänge eine Kreisüberwachung. P0911 bis P0913 sind die Varianten Plausibilität, niedrig und hoch, P0909 eine Wählbewegung, die ihr Ziel verfehlt. Ohne Wählsteller bleibt das Getriebe im aktuellen Gang oder in Neutral.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Gearbox cannot change between gates, only some gears available
Vehicle may stay in neutral and not drive off

description: Plausibility fault in the drive circuit of the gate select actuator of an automated manual gearbox. The circuit is neither open nor shorted, but the current, voltage or response measured on it does not fit the command, for example a current that is too high or too low for the requested movement. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. A Hyundai/Kia patent explains why controllers watch actuator current closely: jamming and sticking raise the motor load, and the motor can be damaged if this is not caught early. An Isuzu patent describes electric select actuators controlled by the transmission module. CARB requires functional checks on such outputs. P0910, P0912 and P0913 are the clear electrical faults, P0909 the failure to reach a gate. Gear changes become slow or are blocked.
possible_causes: Worn select motor drawing abnormal current [HIGH]
Stiff select mechanism overloading the actuator [MEDIUM]
High resistance in actuator wiring or connector [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Plausibilitätsfehler im Ansteuerkreis des Gassenwahl-Stellers eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes. Der Kreis ist weder offen noch kurzgeschlossen, doch Strom, Spannung oder Reaktion passen nicht zur Ansteuerung – etwa ein zu hoher oder zu niedriger Strom für die verlangte Bewegung. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Ein Patent von Hyundai/Kia erläutert, warum Steuergeräte den Stellerstrom genau beobachten: Klemmen und Festsitzen erhöhen die Motorlast, und ohne frühe Erkennung kann der Motor Schaden nehmen. Ein Isuzu-Patent beschreibt elektrische Wählsteller unter Regie des Getriebesteuergeräts. CARB fordert Funktionsprüfungen solcher Ausgänge. P0910, P0912 und P0913 sind die eindeutigen elektrischen Fehler, P0909 das Verfehlen einer Gasse. Gangwechsel werden träge oder gesperrt.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Slow, hesitant or aborted gear changes
Gearbox enters fallback mode with limited gears

description: Set when the drive circuit of the gate select actuator of an automated manual gearbox shows a voltage that is too low for the current switching state, which usually means a short to ground on a motor or control line, or an internal short in the actuator. Many controllers then switch the affected output off to protect the driver stage. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Isuzu and Hyundai/Kia describe in their patents select and shift actuators built as electric motors and driven by the transmission controller, which is the hardware this circuit check covers; CARB requires circuit monitoring of such outputs. P0913 is the matching high fault, P0910 an open circuit and P0911 a plausibility fault. With the select actuator disabled, the gearbox can no longer change gates.
possible_causes: Actuator wire chafed through and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in the select motor, e.g. from brush debris [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Many controllers then switch the affected output off to protect the driver stage. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Isuzu and Hyundai/Kia describe in their patents select and shift actuators built as electric motors and driven by the transmission controller, which is the hardware this circuit check covers; CARB requires circuit monitoring of such outputs. P0913 is the matching high fault, P0910 an open circuit and P0911 a plausibility fault. With the select actuator disabled, the gearbox can no longer change gates.
bilingual_description.de: Wird gesetzt, wenn der Ansteuerkreis des Gassenwahl-Stellers eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes für den aktuellen Schaltzustand eine zu niedrige Spannung zeigt. Meist bedeutet das einen Masseschluss einer Motor- oder Steuerleitung oder einen inneren Kurzschluss im Steller. Viele Steuergeräte schalten den betroffenen Ausgang dann zum Schutz der Endstufe ab. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Isuzu und Hyundai/Kia beschreiben in Patenten Wähl- und Schaltsteller als Elektromotoren, die das Getriebesteuergerät ansteuert – genau diese Hardware erfasst die Kreisprüfung; CARB fordert die Überwachung solcher Ausgänge. P0913 ist der passende Hoch-Fehler, P0910 eine Unterbrechung und P0911 ein Plausibilitätsfehler. Ist der Wählsteller abgeschaltet, kann das Getriebe keine Gasse mehr wechseln.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
No gate change possible, gearbox stays in current gear or neutral

description: Set when the drive circuit of the gate select actuator of an automated manual gearbox shows a voltage that is too high for the current switching state. Usual causes are a short of a motor or control line to battery voltage, or a driver stage in the module that no longer switches off; depending on the circuit design an open load can also read high. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Patents by Isuzu and Hyundai/Kia describe electric select and shift actuators that the transmission controller powers directly, and CARB requires circuit checks on such outputs. P0912 is the opposite low fault, P0910 the open circuit, P0911 the plausibility fault and P0909 a select movement that misses its gate. The driver sees a warning lamp and a gearbox that can no longer change gates.
possible_causes: Actuator wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Open motor winding read as high voltage by the driver stage [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the transmission control module stuck on [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Usual causes are a short of a motor or control line to battery voltage, or a driver stage in the module that no longer switches off; depending on the circuit design an open load can also read high. bilingual_description.de: Steht, wenn der Ansteuerkreis des Gassenwahl-Stellers eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes für den aktuellen Schaltzustand eine zu hohe Spannung führt. Üblich sind ein Schluss einer Motor- oder Steuerleitung nach Batteriespannung oder eine Endstufe im Steuergerät, die nicht mehr abschaltet; je nach Schaltungsaufbau liest auch eine fehlende Last hoch. P0912 ist der Gegenfehler niedrig, P0910 die Unterbrechung, P0911 der Plausibilitätsfehler und P0909 eine Wählbewegung ohne Zielgasse. Der Fahrer sieht eine Warnleuchte, und das Getriebe wechselt keine Gasse mehr.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Gearbox stops changing gates or holds one gear
Actuator may run noisily or get hot

description: Circuit A of the gear shift position sensor reports how far the shift mechanism of an automated manual gearbox has moved in the shift direction, i.e. whether a gear is engaged, in neutral or in between. This generic circuit code sets on an electrical fault on that signal that does not match the more specific variants. No manufacturer documents the code publicly. An Aisin AI patent pairs such a shift stroke sensor with a select stroke sensor, and a Nissan/Aichi patent places the shift position sensor as a magnet and field detector on the piston of a hydraulic shift actuator. CARB requires circuit checks on such inputs. P0915 to P0919 are the siblings, P091A and P095A the same signal on circuits B and C. Without it the module cannot confirm the engaged gear and usually blocks shifting.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded connector at the shift sensor or actuator unit [HIGH]
Damaged sensor wiring near the gearbox [MEDIUM]
Faulty gear shift position sensor [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input or reference supply in the transmission control module [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Stromkreis A des Schaltpositionssensors meldet, wie weit die Schaltmechanik eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes in Schaltrichtung verfahren ist – ob ein Gang eingelegt ist, Neutral anliegt oder die Mechanik dazwischen steht. Der allgemeine Stromkreis-Code steht bei einem elektrischen Fehler, der zu keiner genaueren Variante passt. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Ein Patent von Aisin AI kombiniert einen solchen Schaltwegsensor mit einem Wählwegsensor, ein Patent von Nissan/Aichi setzt den Schaltpositionssensor als Magnet mit Feldaufnehmer an den Kolben eines hydraulischen Schaltstellers. CARB verlangt für solche Eingänge eine Kreisprüfung. P0915 bis P0919 sind die Geschwister, P091A und P095A dasselbe Signal auf Kreis B und C. Ohne Signal kann das Steuergerät den Gang nicht bestätigen und sperrt meist das Schalten.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Gearbox stops shifting or stays in neutral
Engine may not start because neutral cannot be confirmed

description: Plausibility fault of the gear shift position signal on circuit A in an automated manual gearbox. The voltage stays within its electrical limits, but the reading does not fit: the signal does not change while the shift actuator moves, or the engaged position does not match the learned gear positions. No manufacturer documents this code in freely citable material. A Nissan/Aichi patent points out that sensor brackets on shift forks can deform under vibration and spoil the reading, and an Aisin AI patent describes the fallback when a stroke sensor can no longer be trusted. CARB requires rationality checks on such inputs. P0914, P0916 and P0917 are the electrical faults, P0919 a shift movement that misses its target. Shifting becomes limited or stops.
possible_causes: Worn or drifting shift position sensor, redundant tracks disagree [HIGH]
Bent sensor bracket or displaced magnet on the shift rod [MEDIUM]
Gear positions not relearned after actuator or TCM replacement [MEDIUM]
High resistance at connector pins distorting the signal [LOW]

CARB fordert Plausibilitätsprüfungen. P0914, P0916 und P0917 sind die elektrischen Fehler, P0919 eine Schaltbewegung ohne Ziel. Das Schalten wird eingeschränkt oder gesperrt.

description: Set when the gear shift position signal on circuit A of an automated manual gearbox stays below its lowest valid value for longer than a calibrated time. A short to ground on the signal line, a lost sensor supply or an internal sensor defect are the usual causes; depending on the sensor design a broken signal wire reads low as well. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. In the patents of Aisin AI and Nissan/Aichi the shift stroke or shift position sensor is the only feedback telling the controller whether a gear is engaged, so a missing signal stops automatic shifting. CARB requires out-of-range checks on such inputs. P0917 is the matching high fault, P091C and P095C are the low faults of circuits B and C. The gearbox typically locks gear changes or drops to neutral.

Sensor reference supply interrupted or shorted [MEDIUM]
Internal defect of the shift position sensor [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage in the transmission control module [LOW]

description: Set when the control module of an automated manual gearbox drives the shift actuator towards a gear, but the measured shift position does not reach the target within the allowed time and tolerance. bilingual_title.en: Gear Shift Reverse Actuator Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: Concerns the drive circuit that moves the shift mechanism of an automated manual gearbox in the reverse shift direction, i.e. opposite to the forward actuator. It does not mean the reverse gear itself. Depending on design this is the second solenoid valve of a double-acting shift cylinder or the second rotation direction of an electric shift motor. The code sets when the module finds this output open or electrically faulty. No manufacturer documents the code publicly. A ZF patent assigns one 3/2 solenoid valve to each cylinder chamber, an Isuzu patent reverses the shift motor depending on shift direction. CARB requires circuit checks on outputs. P0925 to P0927 are the siblings, P0920 the forward direction. Gears in this direction cannot be engaged.
bilingual_description.de: Betrifft den Ansteuerkreis, der die Schaltmechanik eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes in Schaltrichtung rückwärts bewegt, also entgegen dem Vorwärts-Steller. Gemeint ist nicht der Rückwärtsgang selbst. Je nach Bauart ist das das zweite Magnetventil eines doppeltwirkenden Schaltzylinders oder die zweite Drehrichtung eines elektrischen Schaltmotors. Der Code steht, wenn das Steuergerät diesen Ausgang offen oder elektrisch fehlerhaft findet. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Ein ZF-Patent ordnet jeder Zylinderkammer ein eigenes 3/2-Magnetventil zu, ein Isuzu-Patent kehrt den Schaltmotor je nach Schaltrichtung um. CARB verlangt Kreisprüfungen. P0925 bis P0927 sind die Geschwister, P0920 die Vorwärtsrichtung. Gänge in dieser Richtung lassen sich nicht einlegen.

symptoms: Some gears cannot be selected or the gearbox stays in neutral
Gear changes out of the current gear may fail

description: Plausibility fault in the drive circuit of the reverse shift actuator of an automated manual gearbox, the actuator that moves the shift mechanism opposite to the forward direction. The circuit is neither open nor shorted, but current, voltage or the resulting shift movement do not match the command. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. A Hyundai/Kia patent detects jammed shift actuators from rising motor current, and a ZF patent shows double-acting shift cylinders with one solenoid valve per chamber, so each direction can be judged on its own. CARB requires functional checks on such outputs. P0924, P0926 and P0927 are the clear electrical faults, P0921 the forward direction, P0919 the missed target. Shifts in this direction become slow or fail.
possible_causes: Sticking shift valve, worn shift motor or stiff shift linkage [HIGH]
Solenoid or motor resistance out of specification [MEDIUM]
Increased contact resistance in connector or wiring [MEDIUM]
Insufficient hydraulic pressure on hydraulic units [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2000€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Der Kreis ist weder offen noch kurzgeschlossen, doch Strom, Spannung oder die erzielte Schaltbewegung passen nicht zum Befehl. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Hyundai/Kia erkennt laut Patent klemmende Schaltsteller am ansteigenden Motorstrom; ein ZF-Patent zeigt doppeltwirkende Schaltzylinder mit je einem Magnetventil pro Kammer, sodass sich jede Richtung getrennt beurteilen lässt. CARB fordert Funktionsprüfungen solcher Ausgänge. P0924, P0926 und P0927 sind die eindeutigen elektrischen Fehler, P0921 die Vorwärtsrichtung, P0919 das verfehlte Ziel. symptoms: Slow, harsh or aborted gear changes in one direction
Fallback mode with fewer available gears

description: Set when the drive circuit of the reverse shift actuator of an automated manual gearbox, the one moving the shift mechanism opposite to the forward direction, shows a voltage that is too low for the current switching state. This usually means a valve or motor line shorted to ground or an internal short in the actuator; the module often switches the output off to protect itself. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. A ZF patent drives each chamber of a double-acting shift cylinder through its own solenoid valve, an Isuzu patent runs the shift motor in both directions. CARB requires circuit checks on outputs. P0927 is the opposite high fault, P0924 the open circuit, P0922 the forward direction. Gears in this direction are blocked.
possible_causes: Drive wire chafed through and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in solenoid coil or shift motor [MEDIUM]
Water or corrosion bridging pins in the connector [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2000€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Steht, wenn der Ansteuerkreis des Schaltstellers rückwärts eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes – er bewegt die Schaltmechanik entgegen der Vorwärtsrichtung – für den aktuellen Schaltzustand eine zu niedrige Spannung zeigt. Meist liegt ein Masseschluss einer Ventil- oder Motorleitung oder ein innerer Kurzschluss im Steller vor; das Steuergerät schaltet den Ausgang dann oft zum Selbstschutz ab. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. Ein ZF-Patent steuert jede Kammer eines doppeltwirkenden Schaltzylinders über ein eigenes Magnetventil, ein Isuzu-Patent betreibt den Schaltmotor in beiden Drehrichtungen. CARB verlangt Kreisprüfungen. P0927 ist der gegenteilige High-Fehler, P0924 die Unterbrechung, P0922 die Vorwärtsrichtung. Gänge in dieser Richtung sind gesperrt.

symptoms: Certain gears can no longer be engaged
Gearbox may stay in neutral or hold one gear

description: Set when the drive circuit of the reverse shift actuator of an automated manual gearbox shows a voltage that is too high for the current switching state. Common reasons are a valve or motor line shorted to battery voltage or a driver stage that no longer switches off; on some circuit designs an open load also reads high. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. A ZF patent describes double-acting shift cylinders with a 3/2 solenoid valve on each chamber, and an Isuzu patent reverses an electric shift motor according to shift direction, so the reverse direction has its own output. CARB requires circuit checks on outputs. P0926 is the opposite low fault, P0924 the open circuit, P0923 the forward direction. A permanently energised actuator can force a gear, so shifting is usually locked.
possible_causes: Drive wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Driver stage in the control module stuck on [MEDIUM]
Open coil or winding read as high on some circuit designs [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2000€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Gearbox locks in one gear or refuses to shift
Possible grinding when a gear is pushed unintentionally

description: The module that drives the shift lock (brake transmission shift interlock, BTSI) sees no continuity on control circuit A, so it cannot reliably release the selector from Park. FCA/Chrysler uses the code as P0928-00 BTSI Control: bulletin 08-072-14 (2013-14 Ram 1500, 2014 Durango with 8-speed) and 21-034-15 (2015 Chrysler 300 rotary shifter) name it when the selector will not leave Park or the knob turns without the brake applied; the cure there is a new electronic shifter. P0929 is the plausibility fault, P0930 and P0931 the low and high faults of circuit A, P092A the same open fault on circuit B. The driver usually cannot shift out of Park until the fault clears or the manual release is used.
possible_causes: Internal fault in the electronic shifter module, often logged together with P0607 (documented by FCA) [HIGH]
Shift lock solenoid coil open [MEDIUM]
Broken wire, poorly crimped or pushed-out terminal on the shift lock circuit [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 900€ (0.3h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

FCA/Chrysler führt den Code als P0928-00 BTSI Control: Bulletin 08-072-14 (Ram 1500 2013–14, Durango 2014 mit Achtgang-Automatik) und 21-034-15 (Chrysler 300 2015 mit Drehwahlschalter) nennen ihn, wenn der Hebel P nicht verlässt oder sich der Drehknopf ohne Bremse drehen lässt; abgestellt wird das mit einem neuen elektronischen Wählhebel. Für den Fahrer heißt das meist: Der Hebel bleibt in P, bis der Fehler weg ist oder die Notentriegelung genutzt wird.

symptoms: Selector lever will not move out of Park even with the brake pressed
Problem may disappear after the ignition is switched off and the modules go to sleep
Rotary or electronic shifter can be moved without the brake applied

description: Set when the shift lock actuator on circuit A is electrically present but does not respond as commanded, for example it fails to reach the locked or released position. Ford stores it in the gear shift module (GSM): SSM 51057 and 53039 list P0929:77 (commanded position not reachable) on Mach-E, Escape, Bronco Sport, Maverick and Transit, fixed by GSM software or replacement; TSB 25-2045 adds P0929:00, :07 and :9A on 2021-24 F-150 together with a selector that will not leave or enter Park, and checks pin 3 of connector C211. Ford shows the wrench lamp, not the MIL. P0928, P0930 and P0931 are the pure electrical faults of circuit A, P092B the same fault on circuit B.
possible_causes: Gear shift module software that misjudges the actuator position (Ford reprogramming bulletins) [HIGH]
Worn or binding lock actuator inside the shifter assembly [MEDIUM]
Poor pin fit or damaged pin at the shifter connector [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 900€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Ford speichert den Code im Wählhebelmodul (GSM): SSM 51057 und 53039 nennen P0929:77 (Sollposition nicht erreichbar) bei Mach-E, Escape, Bronco Sport, Maverick und Transit, behoben per GSM-Software oder neuem GSM; TSB 25-2045 ergänzt P0929:00, :07 und :9A beim F-150 2021–24, verbunden mit einem Hebel, der P nicht verlässt oder nicht erreicht, und lässt Pin 3 im Stecker C211 prüfen. symptoms: Wrench or transmission warning lamp on
Selector will not leave Park or will not go back into Park
Clicking from the shifter or a selector that does not stow or unstow

description: Reports an open on control circuit B of the shift lock. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, and none says which lock is B. One possible use is a second lock actuator: GHSP patents describe shifters where a further solenoid holds the lever in Neutral below a set speed unless the brake is pressed, beside the usual Park lock. CARB requires output circuits to be checked for continuity but may exempt safety-only systems. The FCA recall on the BTSI solenoid shows how such a lock fails in practice. P0928 is the same open fault on circuit A, P092B the plausibility fault, P092C and P092D the low and high faults of circuit B. Expect a lever that is locked in a position or no longer locked.
possible_causes: Broken wire or loose terminal on circuit B at the shifter [HIGH]
Open coil in the second lock solenoid [MEDIUM]
Shifter connector not fully seated after console work [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Meldet eine Unterbrechung auf Steuerkreis B der Schaltsperre. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code, und keiner sagt, welche Sperre B ist. Denkbar ist ein zweiter Sperraktuator: Patente von GHSP beschreiben Wählhebel, bei denen neben der üblichen P-Sperre ein weiterer Magnet den Hebel unterhalb einer Geschwindigkeitsschwelle ohne Bremse in N hält. P0928 ist dieselbe Unterbrechung auf Kreis A, P092B der Plausibilitätsfehler, P092C und P092D sind Low und High von Kreis B. Typisch ist ein Hebel, der in einer Stellung festsitzt oder gar nicht mehr sperrt.

symptoms: Selector lever locked in one position although the brake is pressed
Lock no longer engages, lever moves freely without brake
Warning message about the shifter or transmission

description: Set when the actuator on shift lock circuit B is wired correctly but does not reach or report the commanded lock or release state. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The closest documented case is Ford P0929 on circuit A, where the gear shift module logs that the commanded position was not reached and the cure is new GSM software or a new module. CARB asks for a functional check of output components where feasible. GHSP patents show that a shifter can carry a second lock solenoid, for instance a Neutral lock. P092A, P092C and P092D are the open, low and high faults of circuit B, P0929 the matching fault on circuit A. The lever may stay locked, or the lock may engage late.
possible_causes: Lock pin or actuator binding inside the shifter assembly [HIGH]
Shifter module software misjudging the actuator response [MEDIUM]
Weak battery or poor supply leaving the solenoid too little force [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 800€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Lever stays locked in one position
Transmission or wrench warning lamp on

description: The voltage on shift lock control circuit B is lower than expected, usually because the wire or the solenoid has a path to ground. No manufacturer documents this code publicly or names the lock behind circuit B. GHSP patents describe shifters with a second solenoid next to the Park lock, for example one that holds the lever in Neutral unless speed is low and the brake is applied. CARB requires output circuits to be checked for shorts but allows safety-only systems to be left out. P092D is the high fault, P092A the open and P092B the plausibility fault of circuit B; P0930 is the low fault on circuit A. A shorted lock circuit can leave the lever locked or let it move without the brake.
possible_causes: Circuit B wire chafed to ground near the shifter [HIGH]
Shorted turns in the second lock solenoid [MEDIUM]
Liquid spilled into the shifter causing leakage to ground [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

symptoms: Lever locked in a position despite brake applied
Lock does not engage, lever moves without brake

description: The module sees a higher voltage on shift lock circuit B than the commanded state allows, such as a short to supply or, with a low-side driver, an open coil. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The documented counterpart on circuit A is FCA P0931 in recall 16V-249, where a badly crimped BTSI solenoid terminal on 2016 Grand Cherokees set the high fault and kept the lever in Park. GHSP patents show that a shifter may carry a second lock solenoid, so circuit B can be a separate lock. CARB requires circuit fault checks on outputs, with an exemption path for safety-only systems. P092C is the low, P092A the open fault of circuit B; P0931 is the same fault on circuit A.

Open coil in the second lock solenoid [MEDIUM]

description: The voltage on control circuit A of the shift lock solenoid stays below the expected level, typically a short to ground or a driver output pulled low. CARB requires output components to be checked for circuit continuity and shorts, while a safety-only system may be exempt, which is why these faults often do not light the MIL. CARB requires output components to be checked for circuit continuity and shorts, while a safety-only system may be exempt, which is why these faults often do not light the MIL. P0928 is the open, P0931 the high fault, P0929 the plausibility fault of circuit A; P092C is the low fault on circuit B. Depending on the design the selector stays locked in Park or is no longer locked at all.
bilingual_description.de: Die Spannung auf Steuerkreis A des Schaltsperrmagneten bleibt unter dem erwarteten Wert, meist durch einen Masseschluss oder eine nach Masse gezogene Endstufe. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller den Code. FCA nutzt die Geschwistercodes an derselben Bremse-Getriebe-Schaltsperre (P0928 BTSI Control, P0931 beim Grand Cherokee 2016). CARB verlangt für Ausgangskomponenten Prüfungen auf Durchgang und Kurzschluss, nimmt reine Sicherheitssysteme aber aus; daher leuchtet bei solchen Fehlern oft keine MIL. P0928 ist die Unterbrechung, P0931 der High-Fehler, P0929 der Plausibilitätsfehler von Kreis A; P092C ist der Low-Fehler auf Kreis B. Je nach Auslegung bleibt der Hebel in P gesperrt oder er ist gar nicht mehr gesperrt.

symptoms: Selector lever stuck in Park although the brake is pressed
Selector can be moved out of Park without pressing the brake
Shift lock override slot needed to move the lever

description: The control module reads a voltage on shift lock circuit A that is higher than the commanded state allows. FCA documents the code directly: in recall 16V-249 the Jefferson North plant found 2016 Jeep Grand Cherokee (WK) vehicles with active or stored P0931-00 whose selector would not release from Park. The cause was a badly crimped terminal on the BTSI solenoid harness from shifter supplier GHSP; FCA replaced the gear selector and warned that losing the solenoid could leave the lever locked in Park or Neutral. So a poor connection, not only a short to battery, can show up as High. P0930 is the low, P0928 the open fault of circuit A; P092D is the high fault on circuit B.
possible_causes: Poorly crimped or loose terminal on the shift lock solenoid harness (FCA recall 16V-249) [HIGH]
Control wire shorted to a supply voltage [MEDIUM]
Open shift lock solenoid coil seen as high voltage by a low-side driver [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

FCA belegt den Code direkt: Im Rückruf 16V-249 fand das Werk Jefferson North Jeep Grand Cherokee (WK) Modelljahr 2016 mit aktivem oder gespeichertem P0931-00, deren Wählhebel P nicht freigab. Ein schlechter Kontakt kann sich also ebenfalls als High zeigen, nicht nur ein Plusschluss. P0930 ist der Low-, P0928 der Unterbrechungsfehler von Kreis A; P092D ist der High-Fehler auf Kreis B.

symptoms: Selector lever will not release from Park
Lever may lock in Park or Neutral unexpectedly after stopping
Fault comes and goes with vibration or temperature

description: General electrical fault in the circuit of the sensor that reports hydraulic pressure in the gearbox, usually line pressure in an automatic or system pressure in an automated manual or dual-clutch unit. The module sees a signal it cannot use at all, without a clear low or high pattern. Chrysler names it Line Pressure Sensor Circuit Fault; an ALLDATA case on a 2003 Grand Cherokee 4.7 automatic shows it together with P0935, caused by an open line pressure solenoid in the solenoid pack. CARB requires circuit checks on such transmission inputs. P0934 and P0935 are the low and high faults, P0933 the plausibility fault, P0936 the intermittent one. Expect harsh shifts, often with line pressure forced to maximum.
possible_causes: Fault in the solenoid pack or valve body module that carries the pressure sensor (open solenoid, internal lead frame) [HIGH]
Poor crimp or solder joint at the sensor connector terminals [MEDIUM]
5 V reference or sensor ground interrupted [MEDIUM]
Transmission or powertrain control module fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler im Kreis des Sensors, der den Hydraulikdruck im Getriebe meldet – beim Automatikgetriebe meist den Leitungsdruck, beim automatisierten Schalt- oder Doppelkupplungsgetriebe den Systemdruck. Das Steuergerät erhält ein unbrauchbares Signal ohne eindeutiges Low- oder High-Muster. Chrysler führt den Code als Line Pressure Sensor Circuit Fault; ein ALLDATA-Fall am Grand Cherokee 4.7 Automatik (2003) zeigt ihn zusammen mit P0935, Ursache war ein unterbrochenes Leitungsdruck-Magnetventil im Ventilblock. CARB verlangt Kreisprüfungen solcher Getriebeeingänge. P0934/P0935 sind Low und High, P0933 der Plausibilitäts-, P0936 der sporadische Fehler. Spürbar sind harte Schaltungen, oft mit festgesetztem Maximaldruck.

symptoms: Warning light or transmission warning on
Harsh engagements and firm shifts from maximum line pressure
Possible limp mode with limited gears

description: The pressure reading is electrically valid but does not fit the operating state. Chrysler RFE, RLE and TES transmissions set it when measured line pressure is more than 25 psi (172 kPa) above the commanded value while staying below the highest pressure ever used in that gear; Sonnax notes that a maximum-pressure condition from an open pressure control solenoid circuit can trigger it and mislead toward the sensor. Ferrari lists P0933 on its DCT as an invalid hydraulic pressure sensor signal, read in the NCR gearbox ECU. Neighbours: P0932, P0934 and P0935 are circuit faults, P0936 intermittent, P0869 a true high line pressure. The driver notices firm or harsh shifts.
possible_causes: Open circuit or fault in the line pressure control solenoid causing real excess pressure [HIGH]
Pressure sensor drifting or reading offset [MEDIUM]
Worn or sticking valves in the valve body [MEDIUM]
Wrong fluid level or degraded fluid [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Chrysler setzt den Code an RFE-, RLE- und TES-Getrieben, wenn der gemessene Leitungsdruck mehr als 25 psi (172 kPa) über dem Sollwert liegt, aber unter dem höchsten je in diesem Gang genutzten Druck bleibt; laut Sonnax kann ein Maximaldruck durch einen offenen Kreis des Druckregelventils ihn auslösen und fälschlich zum Sensor führen. Ferrari nennt P0933 beim DCT als ungültiges Signal des Hydraulikdrucksensors im Getriebesteuergerät NCR. P0932, P0934 und P0935 sind Kreisfehler, P0936 sporadisch, P0869 echter Überdruck. Am Steuer fallen harte, stramme Schaltungen auf.

symptoms: Harsh or firm engagements and shifts
Shift quality does not adapt and may stay rough

description: The pressure sensor signal sits below its valid window. Chrysler RFE transmissions feed the line pressure sensor with a 5 V reference and expect 0.35 to 4.75 V; P0934 sets when the signal stays at or below 0.35 V for 0.18 s, monitored continuously with the engine running. Typical reasons are a signal wire shorted to ground, a lost 5 V reference or a failed sensor. Ferrari also uses P0934 on its DCT, described as hydraulic pressure sensor signal too low. P0935 is the opposite high fault, P0932 the general circuit fault, P0933 plausibility and P0936 intermittent. Without a usable pressure signal the control usually raises pressure to a safe maximum, so shifts turn harsh.
possible_causes: Sensor signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
5 V reference open or shorted [MEDIUM]
Pressure sensor or the solenoid pack carrying it failed [MEDIUM]
Control module fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 900€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0935 ist der High-Fehler, P0932 der allgemeine Kreisfehler, P0933 Plausibilität, P0936 sporadisch. Ohne verwertbares Drucksignal regelt die Steuerung meist auf sicheren Maximaldruck – die Schaltungen werden hart.

symptoms: Harsh shifts due to default maximum pressure

description: The pressure sensor signal sits above its valid window. On Chrysler RFE transmissions the line pressure sensor normally reads between 0.35 and 4.75 V; P0935 sets when the signal stays at or above 4.75 V for 0.18 s with the engine running. That pattern points to a signal wire shorted to the 5 V reference or to battery voltage, an open sensor ground or a sensor failed internally. An ALLDATA case on a 2003 Grand Cherokee logged it with P0932. Ferrari lists P0935 on its DCT as hydraulic pressure sensor signal too high. P0934 is the low counterpart, P0932 the general circuit fault, P0933 plausibility, P0936 intermittent. Expect harsh shifts and possibly a limp mode.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Hydraulic power unit assembly failure, Transmission Control Module (TCM) failure, Wiring issue

Control module fault [LOW]

description: The hydraulic pressure signal drops out or jumps for short periods, too briefly or irregularly for a lasting low or high fault. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The underlying sensor is the same one Chrysler uses for line pressure on RFE units and Ferrari for system pressure on its DCT, where the steady faults appear as P0934 and P0935. Gears Magazine names poor solder joints and crimps at the sensor terminals as a frequent source of intermittent pressure sensor codes. CARB requires circuit checks on such transmission inputs. P0932 to P0935 cover the general, plausibility, low and high faults. The driver may see a warning that comes and goes and occasional harsh shifts.

Chafed harness making intermittent contact [MEDIUM]
Moisture or corrosion in the connector [MEDIUM]
Sensor with an internal intermittent fault [LOW]

Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diesen Code. Der zugrunde liegende Sensor ist derselbe, mit dem Chrysler an RFE-Getrieben den Leitungsdruck und Ferrari am DCT den Systemdruck misst; dort erscheinen die dauerhaften Fehler als P0934 und P0935. Gears Magazine nennt schlechte Löt- und Crimpstellen an den Sensorkontakten als häufige Quelle sporadischer Drucksensor-Codes. CARB fordert Kreisprüfungen solcher Getriebeeingänge. P0932 bis P0935 decken allgemeinen Fehler, Plausibilität, Low und High ab. Fahrer sehen eine Warnung, die kommt und geht, und gelegentlich harte Schaltungen.

description: General electrical fault in the circuit of the temperature sensor for the hydraulic fluid of an automated gearbox, without a clear low or high pattern. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. Ferrari shows where such a sensor sits: its DCT carries a radiator outlet and gearbox inlet oil temperature sensor reported under P0938 to P0940 in the NCR gearbox ECU. The control needs this value to correct pressure and clutch fill for viscosity. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission sensors. P0938 is the plausibility fault, P0939 and P0940 low and high, P0941 intermittent; P0711 to P0713 cover the main transmission fluid temperature sensor. Shift quality may suffer and a warning appears.
possible_causes: Connector at the temperature sensor loose, corroded or oil-soaked [HIGH]
Damaged sensor wiring near the gearbox or cooler lines [MEDIUM]
Temperature sensor failed [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller genau diesen Code. Wo ein solcher Sensor sitzt, zeigt Ferrari: Das DCT hat einen Öltemperatursensor am Kühlerausgang bzw. Getriebeeingang, den das Getriebesteuergerät NCR unter P0938 bis P0940 meldet. Die Steuerung braucht den Wert, um Druck und Kupplungsbefüllung an die Viskosität anzupassen. CARB fordert Kreisprüfungen an Getriebesensoren. P0938 ist der Plausibilitätsfehler, P0939/P0940 Low und High, P0941 sporadisch; P0711 bis P0713 betreffen den Hauptsensor der Getriebeöltemperatur. Die Schaltqualität kann leiden, eine Warnung erscheint.

symptoms: Rougher shifts or clutch engagement, especially when cold

description: By J2012 wording the hydraulic oil temperature reading is electrically valid but implausible, for example frozen, rising too slowly after a cold start or disagreeing with other temperature values. Ferrari uses P0938 on its DCT for the radiator outlet and gearbox inlet oil temperature sensor, but describes it in its bulletin as no signal, an electrical fault rather than a plausibility check; the code is read in the NCR gearbox ECU. CARB asks for rationality checks on temperature inputs. P0937 is the general circuit fault, P0939 and P0940 the low and high faults, P0941 intermittent. A wrong temperature value leads to poorly matched clutch and shift pressures and may limit the cooling strategy.
possible_causes: Temperature sensor drifting or reacting sluggishly [HIGH]
Signal lost through connector or wiring fault (as in Ferrari's no-signal case) [MEDIUM]
Real temperature anomaly from a cooler or thermostat fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Shift and clutch quality inconsistent with operating temperature

description: The hydraulic oil temperature sensor signal sits below its valid window. With the usual NTC thermistor, a low voltage corresponds to an implausibly hot reading and typically comes from a signal wire shorted to ground or a sensor shorted internally. Ferrari uses P0939 on its DCT for the radiator outlet and gearbox inlet oil temperature sensor, described as signal too low and read in the NCR gearbox ECU. CARB requires out-of-range checks on transmission sensors. P0940 is the high counterpart, P0937 the general circuit fault, P0938 plausibility and P0941 intermittent. Because the module believes the oil is very hot, it may reduce torque, change shift strategy or show an overheat warning.

Temperature sensor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Control module input fault [LOW]

symptoms: Reduced performance or altered shift behaviour

description: The control circuit of the solenoid that opens or locks a hydraulic accumulator in the gearbox is open. Such accumulators store pressurised fluid, for example to keep clutches applied during engine stop-start, as GM's patents on a stop-start accumulator and an accumulator with solenoid valve describe. No manufacturer documents P093A publicly. GM uses its own P171A for the same fault on the surge accumulator solenoid: failed if circuit impedance exceeds 200 kOhm in 32 of 40 samples, Type B with MIL after two trips. P093B and P093C are the low and high faults, P093D the performance fault. Stop-start is usually disabled, and the first restart may engage with a jolt.
possible_causes: Accumulator solenoid coil open [HIGH]
Connector unplugged or wire broken between module and solenoid [MEDIUM]
Fault in the internal transmission harness or lead frame [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the control module failed [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1200€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P093B und P093C sind Low und High, P093D der Funktionsfehler. Start-Stopp wird meist abgeschaltet, der erste Wiederstart kann ruckartig einkuppeln.

symptoms: Jolt or slip when driving off after an engine restart

description: The control circuit of the hydraulic accumulator solenoid reads low, usually a control wire shorted to ground or a coil with very low resistance. No manufacturer documents P093B publicly. GM covers the same fault on its surge accumulator solenoid with P171B: failed short to ground when circuit impedance drops below 0.5 Ohm in 32 of 40 samples, Type B with MIL after two trips. The accumulator holds pressurised fluid so clutches stay applied during an engine auto-stop, as GM's stop-start accumulator patent explains. P093A is the open-circuit fault, P093C the high fault and P093D the performance fault. A grounded control line can leave the valve permanently energised, and stop-start is typically switched off.

Solenoid coil shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the control module failed [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis des Hydraulikspeicher-Magnetventils meldet ein zu niedriges Signal, meist durch eine Steuerleitung mit Masseschluss oder eine Spule mit sehr kleinem Widerstand. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P093B. GM erfasst denselben Fehler am Surge-Accumulator-Ventil mit P171B: Masseschluss, wenn die Kreisimpedanz in 32 von 40 Abtastungen unter 0,5 Ohm fällt, Typ B mit MIL nach zwei Fahrten. Der Speicher hält Drucköl vor, damit beim automatischen Motorstopp die Kupplungen geschlossen bleiben, wie das GM-Patent zum Start-Stopp-Speicher erläutert. P093A ist die Unterbrechung, P093C der High-, P093D der Funktionsfehler. Eine Steuerleitung an Masse kann das Ventil dauerhaft bestromen; Start-Stopp wird meist abgeschaltet.

description: The control circuit of the hydraulic accumulator solenoid reads high, typically a control wire shorted to battery voltage so the driver cannot switch the valve as commanded. No manufacturer documents P093C publicly. GM covers the same fault on its surge accumulator solenoid with P171C: failed short to voltage when the circuit impedance criterion of 0.5 Ohm is met in 6 of 8 samples, Type B with MIL after two trips. GM's patent on an accumulator with solenoid valve shows how the valve holds or releases the stored fluid. P093A is the open circuit, P093B the low fault and P093D the performance fault. Stop-start is usually disabled; a valve that never closes cannot keep the accumulator charged during an auto-stop.
possible_causes: Solenoid control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Damaged internal transmission harness or lead frame [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the control module failed [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1200€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P093C. GM erfasst denselben Fehler am Surge-Accumulator-Ventil mit P171C: Schluss nach Plus, wenn das Impedanzkriterium von 0,5 Ohm in 6 von 8 Abtastungen erfüllt ist, Typ B mit MIL nach zwei Fahrten. Das GM-Patent zum Speicher mit Magnetventil zeigt, wie das Ventil das gespeicherte Öl hält oder freigibt. P093A ist die Unterbrechung, P093B der Low-, P093D der Funktionsfehler. Start-Stopp wird meist abgeschaltet; ein nie schließendes Ventil hält den Speicher beim Motorstopp nicht gefüllt.

symptoms: Jolt when pulling away after a restart

description: The accumulator solenoid circuit is electrically sound, but the accumulator system does not deliver the expected hydraulic result. No manufacturer documents P093D publicly. GM's comparable P171D on the 9-speed transmission watches turbine speed during an engine auto-start: if it exceeds a predicted value because holding clutches slip from too little stored pressure, it counts a failure, enabled between 0 and 110 °C transmission fluid temperature, Type B. Gears Magazine names a solenoid stuck open or closed, a leaking accumulator piston, clutch or valve body leakage and misplaced check balls as causes. P093A to P093C are the electrical faults. Stop-start is disabled and the restart may feel like a bang.
possible_causes: Accumulator solenoid stuck open (drains) or closed (no fill) [HIGH]
Accumulator piston or bore leaking [MEDIUM]
Leakage at clutch seals or a worn valve body [MEDIUM]
Missing or misplaced check ball after a rebuild [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 250€ - 2500€ (2h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GMs vergleichbarer P171D am 9-Gang-Getriebe überwacht die Turbinendrehzahl beim automatischen Motorstart: Übersteigt sie einen vorhergesagten Wert, weil Haltekupplungen mangels Speicherdruck rutschen, zählt ein Fehler; aktiv zwischen 0 und 110 °C Getriebeöltemperatur, Typ B. Gears Magazine nennt als Ursachen ein offen oder geschlossen hängendes Ventil, einen undichten Speicherkolben, Leckagen an Kupplungen oder Ventilkörper und falsch sitzende Rückschlagkugeln. P093A bis P093C sind die elektrischen Fehler. Start-Stopp wird abgeschaltet, der Wiederstart kann schlagen.

symptoms: Lurch or bang when the engine restarts
Firm shifts with adaptive learning frozen

description: The hydraulic oil temperature sensor signal sits above its valid window. With an NTC thermistor this matches an extremely cold reading, typically from an open circuit, an unplugged connector, a broken ground or a short to a voltage source. Ferrari uses P0940 on its DCT for the radiator outlet and gearbox inlet oil temperature sensor, described as an electrical fault with signal too high, read in the NCR gearbox ECU. CARB requires out-of-range checks on transmission sensors. P0939 is the low counterpart, P0937 the general circuit fault, P0938 plausibility and P0941 intermittent. With a substitute value the gearbox works on, but clutch and shift pressures are no longer matched to the real oil temperature.
possible_causes: Open signal or ground wire, or connector unplugged [HIGH]
Temperature sensor open internally [MEDIUM]
Signal wire shorted to a voltage source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Das Signal des Hydrauliköl-Temperatursensors liegt oberhalb seines gültigen Fensters. Bei einem NTC-Thermistor entspricht das einem extrem kalten Wert, meist durch Unterbrechung, abgezogenen Stecker, fehlende Masse oder Schluss zu einer Spannungsquelle. Ferrari nutzt P0940 am DCT für den Öltemperatursensor am Kühlerausgang bzw. Getriebeeingang, beschrieben als elektrischer Fehler mit „Signal zu hoch“, gelesen im Getriebesteuergerät NCR. CARB verlangt Bereichsprüfungen an Getriebesensoren. P0939 ist das Low-Gegenstück, P0937 der allgemeine Kreisfehler, P0938 Plausibilität, P0941 sporadisch. Mit Ersatzwert arbeitet das Getriebe weiter, doch Kupplungs- und Schaltdrücke passen nicht mehr zur echten Öltemperatur.

symptoms: Shifts or clutch engagements feel rough once warm

description: The hydraulic oil temperature signal jumps or drops out briefly, too short or irregular for a lasting low or high fault. Since fluid temperature changes slowly, a sudden step is a clear sign of an electrical problem rather than a real temperature change. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Ferrari's DCT bulletin shows the related sensor at the radiator outlet and gearbox inlet, with its steady faults under P0938 to P0940. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission sensors. P0937 is the general circuit fault, P0938 plausibility, P0939 and P0940 low and high. For the driver this means a warning that may come and go and shift quality that changes from one moment to the next.
possible_causes: Loose contact at the sensor connector under vibration or heat [HIGH]
Chafed wiring near hot gearbox or cooler parts [MEDIUM]
Sensor with an intermittent internal fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Weil sich die Öltemperatur nur langsam ändert, deutet ein plötzlicher Sprung klar auf ein elektrisches Problem und nicht auf eine echte Temperaturänderung. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diesen Code. Das Ferrari-Bulletin zum DCT zeigt den verwandten Sensor am Kühlerausgang bzw. Getriebeeingang, dessen dauerhafte Fehler unter P0938 bis P0940 laufen. CARB fordert Kreisprüfungen an Getriebesensoren. P0937 ist der allgemeine Kreisfehler, P0938 Plausibilität, P0939/P0940 Low und High. Fahrer sehen eine Warnung, die kommt und geht, und eine wechselnde Schaltqualität.

description: General fault of the unit that generates and stores hydraulic pressure for an automated gearbox or its auxiliary oil supply: motor-driven pump, accumulator and pressure control. Toyota sets P0942 on the 2001 to 2005 MR2 Spyder sequential gearbox together with the SMT warning light and a buzzing pump, or with gears that can no longer be changed; fluid seeping from the reservoir cap or the seal of the hydraulic power unit is a known cause, fixed with new seal rings. Ferrari reads P0942 on its DCT differently, as system pressure command signal too low. CARB requires functional checks of transmission outputs. P0943 and P0944 are the cycling and pressure-loss faults, P0945 to P0948 the pump control circuit.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Hydraulic power unit assembly failure, Transmission Control Module (TCM) failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Fluid loss at the reservoir cap or hydraulic power unit seals [HIGH]
Worn pump motor or faulty pump relay [MEDIUM]
Damaged wiring, connectors or power supply of the pump [MEDIUM]
Transmission control module fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hydraulic Pressure Unit

bilingual_description.en: General fault of the unit that generates and stores hydraulic pressure for an automated gearbox or its auxiliary oil supply: motor-driven pump, accumulator and pressure control. Toyota sets P0942 on the 2001 to 2005 MR2 Spyder sequential gearbox together with the SMT warning light and a buzzing pump, or with gears that can no longer be changed; fluid seeping from the reservoir cap or the seal of the hydraulic power unit is a known cause, fixed with new seal rings. Ferrari reads P0942 on its DCT differently, as system pressure command signal too low. CARB requires functional checks of transmission outputs. P0943 and P0944 are the cycling and pressure-loss faults, P0945 to P0948 the pump control circuit.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner Fehler der Einheit, die für ein automatisiertes Getriebe oder dessen Zusatzölversorgung Hydraulikdruck erzeugt und speichert: motorgetriebene Pumpe, Druckspeicher, Druckregelung. Toyota setzt P0942 beim sequenziellen Getriebe des MR2 Spyder (2001–2005) zusammen mit der SMT-Warnleuchte und summender Pumpe oder bei nicht mehr wechselbaren Gängen; bekannte Ursache ist Öl, das am Behälterdeckel oder an der Dichtung der Hydraulikeinheit austritt, behoben mit neuen Dichtringen. Ferrari liest P0942 am DCT abweichend als „Systemdruck-Sollsignal zu niedrig“. CARB verlangt Funktionsprüfungen von Getriebe-Ausgängen. P0943 und P0944 betreffen Taktung und Druckverlust, P0945 bis P0948 den Steuerkreis der Pumpe.

symptoms: Transmission or gearbox warning light on
Pump buzzing or running for long periods
Gears cannot be changed or shifts are delayed
Auto stop-start disabled or engine restarts immediately

description: In a hydraulic pressure unit the pump charges an accumulator up to a cut-out pressure and switches off until pressure falls to the cut-in point. By J2012 wording this code means the pump switches on again too soon, so the interval between charging cycles is shorter than expected. Typical reasons are internal leakage across valves or seals, or an accumulator that has lost its gas precharge and stores too little oil. Audi patents describe such accumulator and leakage checks based on charging switch-over times and pressure decay. No manufacturer documents this exact meaning publicly; Ferrari uses P0943 on its DCT for a system pressure command signal that is too high. CARB requires functional checks of transmission outputs. P0942 is the general fault, P0944 the loss of pressure.
possible_causes: Accumulator has lost its gas precharge [HIGH]
Internal leakage at valves, seals or actuator cylinders [HIGH]
Faulty pressure switch or pressure sensor giving wrong cut-in point [MEDIUM]
Low or aerated hydraulic fluid [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2500€ (1.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

No manufacturer documents this exact meaning publicly; Ferrari uses P0943 on its DCT for a system pressure command signal that is too high. CARB requires functional checks of transmission outputs. bilingual_description.de: In einer Hydraulik-Druckerzeugungseinheit lädt die Pumpe einen Druckspeicher bis zum Abschaltdruck und ruht, bis der Druck auf den Einschaltpunkt fällt. Nach J2012-Wortlaut schaltet die Pumpe hier zu früh wieder ein – die Pause zwischen zwei Ladezyklen ist kürzer als erwartet. Typisch sind innere Leckagen an Ventilen oder Dichtungen oder ein Speicher mit verlorener Gas-Vorfüllung, der zu wenig Öl aufnimmt. Audi-Patente beschreiben solche Speicher- und Leckageprüfungen über Umschaltzeiten und Druckabfall. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller genau diese Bedeutung; Ferrari belegt P0943 am DCT mit „Systemdruck-Sollsignal zu hoch“. CARB verlangt Funktionsprüfungen von Getriebe-Ausgängen. P0942 ist der allgemeine Fehler, P0944 der Druckverlust.

symptoms: Pump can be heard switching on unusually often

description: The pump runs but the expected hydraulic pressure does not build or collapses. Stellantis names it Loss of Hydraulic Pump Prime: a 2023 STAR case lists it with P0868 and a slow engagement after the vehicle has stood, both set as the only transmission codes with the MIL on, and the fix was a new transmission; an FCA defect file from 2015 also shows it beside line pressure low. Mercedes uses P0944 on the 722.9 automatic with electric auxiliary oil pump for stop-start, as internal fault of that pump; stop-start stops working, and a leaking check valve between converter housing and pump is one cause. Ferrari reads it on its DCT as no system pressure signal with pressure loss. P0943 covers short cycles, P0868 low fluid pressure.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Clogged transmission filter, Transmission fluid level is low, Transmission oil pump failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Pump loses prime (air drawn in through filter, seal or strainer pipe) [HIGH]
Blocked oil strainer or suction tube [MEDIUM]
Worn or failed pump (mechanical or electric) [MEDIUM]
Leaking check valve or internal leak in the valve body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 6000€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: The pump runs but the expected hydraulic pressure does not build or collapses. Stellantis names it Loss of Hydraulic Pump Prime: a 2023 STAR case lists it with P0868 and a slow engagement after the vehicle has stood, both set as the only transmission codes with the MIL on, and the fix was a new transmission; an FCA defect file from 2015 also shows it beside line pressure low. Mercedes uses P0944 on the 722.9 automatic with electric auxiliary oil pump for stop-start, as internal fault of that pump; stop-start stops working, and a leaking check valve between converter housing and pump is one cause. Ferrari reads it on its DCT as no system pressure signal with pressure loss. P0943 covers short cycles, P0868 low fluid pressure.
bilingual_description.de: Die Pumpe läuft, aber der erwartete Hydraulikdruck baut sich nicht auf oder bricht ein. Stellantis nennt den Code „Loss of Hydraulic Pump Prime“: Ein STAR-Fall von 2023 zeigt ihn mit P0868 und verzögertem Einlegen nach längerer Standzeit, beide als einzige Getriebecodes bei leuchtender MIL; Abhilfe war ein neues Getriebe. Eine FCA-Defektakte von 2015 führt ihn ebenfalls neben zu niedrigem Leitungsdruck. Mercedes nutzt P0944 am Automatikgetriebe 722.9 mit elektrischer Zusatzölpumpe für Start-Stopp als internen Fehler dieser Pumpe; Start-Stopp fällt aus, eine Ursache ist ein undichtes Rückschlagventil zwischen Wandlergehäuse und Pumpe. Ferrari liest ihn am DCT als fehlendes Systemdrucksignal mit Druckverlust. P0943 betrifft zu kurze Takte, P0868 niedrigen Öldruck.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Slow engagement after the vehicle has been parked
Auto stop-start not available or engine restarts at once
Slipping, no drive or limp mode

description: The control module drives the motor of the hydraulic pump through a relay or a direct output. This code reports a general circuit fault or an open in that control path, so the pump cannot be switched reliably. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. The layout is shown by a ZF patent for an automated gearbox, in which a motor-driven pump draws oil from a reservoir and charges a pressure accumulator behind a one-way valve, with shut-off valves feeding the shift cylinders. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission outputs. P0946 is the plausibility fault, P0947 and P0948 low and high; P094E covers the pump supply instead of the control side. Without the pump the gearbox soon runs out of pressure.
possible_causes: Pump relay coil open or relay not seated [HIGH]
Open control wire or loose terminal between module and relay [MEDIUM]
Failed output stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.en: The control module drives the motor of the hydraulic pump through a relay or a direct output. This code reports a general circuit fault or an open in that control path, so the pump cannot be switched reliably. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. The layout is shown by a ZF patent for an automated gearbox, in which a motor-driven pump draws oil from a reservoir and charges a pressure accumulator behind a one-way valve, with shut-off valves feeding the shift cylinders. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission outputs. P0946 is the plausibility fault, P0947 and P0948 low and high; P094E covers the pump supply instead of the control side. bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät schaltet den Motor der Hydraulikpumpe über ein Relais oder einen direkten Ausgang. Der Code meldet einen allgemeinen Kreisfehler bzw. eine Unterbrechung in diesem Steuerpfad – die Pumpe lässt sich nicht sicher schalten. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller genau diesen Code. Den Aufbau zeigt ein ZF-Patent für ein automatisiertes Schaltgetriebe: Eine motorgetriebene Pumpe saugt Öl aus einem Behälter und lädt hinter einem Rückschlagventil einen Druckspeicher, Absperrventile versorgen die Schaltzylinder. CARB fordert Kreisprüfungen an Getriebe-Ausgängen. P0946 ist der Plausibilitätsfehler, P0947/P0948 Low und High; P094E betrifft die Versorgung statt der Ansteuerung. Ohne Pumpe geht dem Getriebe bald der Druck aus.

symptoms: Pump does not run, pressure is not built
Gears cannot be changed or auto stop-start disabled

description: The pump control circuit is electrically intact, but its behaviour does not match the command, for example a pump that keeps running after being switched off, or one that switches but is not followed by the expected feedback. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. In the hydraulic unit of an automated gearbox, as shown in a ZF patent, the pump only has to run until the accumulator is charged; a relay that sticks or switches late upsets that cycle. CARB requires functional checks on transmission outputs. P0945 is the general circuit or open fault, P0947 and P0948 the low and high faults, P094B a pump stuck on regardless of the relay. A pump that never stops drains the battery and wears quickly.
possible_causes: Relay contacts welded or sticking [HIGH]
Pump supply or control wire shorted to battery voltage [MEDIUM]
Faulty pump state feedback or control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Hydraulic Pump Relay/Control Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The pump control circuit is electrically intact, but its behaviour does not match the command, for example a pump that keeps running after being switched off, or one that switches but is not followed by the expected feedback. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. In the hydraulic unit of an automated gearbox, as shown in a ZF patent, the pump only has to run until the accumulator is charged; a relay that sticks or switches late upsets that cycle. CARB requires functional checks on transmission outputs. P0945 is the general circuit or open fault, P0947 and P0948 the low and high faults, P094B a pump stuck on regardless of the relay. A pump that never stops drains the battery and wears quickly.
bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis der Pumpe ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber ihr Verhalten passt nicht zum Befehl – etwa eine Pumpe, die nach dem Abschalten weiterläuft, oder ein Schaltvorgang ohne die erwartete Rückmeldung. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller genau diesen Code. In der Hydraulikeinheit eines automatisierten Schaltgetriebes, wie sie ein ZF-Patent zeigt, muss die Pumpe nur laufen, bis der Speicher geladen ist; ein klebendes oder verzögert schaltendes Relais stört diesen Zyklus. CARB fordert Funktionsprüfungen an Getriebe-Ausgängen. P0945 ist der allgemeine Kreis- bzw. Unterbrechungsfehler, P0947/P0948 Low und High, P094B eine dauerlaufende Pumpe unabhängig vom Relais. Läuft die Pumpe ständig, leert sie die Batterie und verschleißt.

description: The voltage on the control line of the hydraulic pump relay or driver is lower than the module expects for the commanded state. Usually the line is shorted to ground or the relay coil is shorted, so the output may be overloaded and the pump runs when it should not, or the driver shuts down. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. The hydraulic unit it belongs to, a motor-driven pump that charges an accumulator for the shift and clutch cylinders of an automated gearbox, is described in a ZF patent. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission outputs. P0948 is the high counterpart, P0945 the open fault, P0946 plausibility. Pressure supply for shifting may fail.
possible_causes: Relay control wire chafed and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Shorted relay coil [MEDIUM]
Damaged output stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Meist ist die Leitung nach Masse kurzgeschlossen oder die Relaisspule hat Windungsschluss; der Ausgang wird überlastet, die Pumpe läuft ungewollt oder die Endstufe schaltet ab. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller genau diesen Code. Die zugehörige Hydraulikeinheit – eine motorgetriebene Pumpe, die einen Speicher für Schalt- und Kupplungszylinder eines automatisierten Getriebes lädt – beschreibt ein ZF-Patent. CARB fordert Kreisprüfungen an Getriebe-Ausgängen. P0948 ist das High-Gegenstück, P0945 die Unterbrechung, P0946 die Plausibilität. Die Druckversorgung für Schaltvorgänge kann ausfallen.

symptoms: Pump runs continuously or not at all
Gearbox in limp mode or stop-start disabled

description: The control line of the hydraulic pump relay or driver shows a higher voltage than expected, typically because it is shorted to battery voltage or the relay coil is open on a low-side driver. The pump then cannot be switched on, or the module sees it as active when it is not. J2012 places this code with the pump control circuit; Ferrari however reads P0948 on its DCT as no signal from the system pressure output, an unrelated use. The pump and accumulator unit of an automated gearbox is described in a ZF patent. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission outputs. P0947 is the low counterpart, P0945 the open fault and P0946 the plausibility fault. Expect a warning and possible loss of pump pressure.
possible_causes: Relay control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Open relay coil seen as high level by the driver [MEDIUM]
Control module fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.
