bilingual_description.de: Die Steuerleitung von Relais bzw. Endstufe der Hydraulikpumpe führt mehr Spannung als erwartet, meist durch Kurzschluss nach Plus oder eine offene Relaisspule an einer masseseitig schaltenden Endstufe. Die Pumpe lässt sich dann nicht einschalten, oder das Steuergerät hält sie fälschlich für aktiv. J2012 ordnet den Code dem Steuerkreis der Pumpe zu; Ferrari liest P0948 am DCT dagegen als fehlendes Signal des Systemdruck-Ausgangs, eine abweichende Nutzung. Die Pumpen- und Speichereinheit eines automatisierten Getriebes beschreibt ein ZF-Patent. CARB fordert Kreisprüfungen an Getriebe-Ausgängen. P0947 ist das Low-Gegenstück, P0945 die Unterbrechung, P0946 die Plausibilität. Warnung und möglicher Verlust des Pumpendrucks.

symptoms: Gear changes not possible or stop-start disabled

description: Status code for an automatically shifted manual gearbox: the control unit has not yet finished learning its adaptation values, above all the clutch touch point and the end positions of the shift actuators. Such learning runs after a new control unit, clutch or actuator, after a software update and sometimes after the battery was disconnected; Hyundai and Kia patents show how the touch point is found and corrected from shaft speed changes. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. The code is a reminder rather than a hardware fault; launch and shifts may be jerky until learning is done. P0950 to P0954 cover the manual control circuit, P0806 to P0808 the clutch position sensor. MIL use depends on the maker.
possible_causes: Relearn not run after clutch, actuator or control unit replacement [HIGH]
Adaptation values erased by software update or battery disconnection [MEDIUM]
Learning aborted by low voltage or worn clutch outside the learn window [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 250€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The hydraulic pump keeps running although the module has switched it off, or it never reaches its cut-out point. Causes are a welded relay or shorted driver, or a pump that cannot reach cut-out pressure because of leakage. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. In the pump and accumulator unit of an automated gearbox, described in a ZF patent, the pump should rest once the accumulator is charged. Toyota links a constantly buzzing pump on the MR2 sequential gearbox to fluid loss at the hydraulic power unit, reported under P0942. CARB requires functional checks on outputs. P094C is the opposite fault, P0946 the relay plausibility fault, P0943 the too-short cycle. Battery drain and pump wear follow.
possible_causes: Pump relay contacts welded closed [HIGH]
Leakage or lost accumulator charge keeps pressure below cut-out [MEDIUM]
Shorted driver stage or supply wire shorted to battery voltage [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The pump is commanded on but does not deliver: it does not turn, turns too slowly or produces too little pressure. The module judges this from pressure or speed feedback. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. Mercedes reports a comparable condition of the electric auxiliary oil pump on the 722.9 automatic under P0944; its test plan checks connector and fuse, supply voltage, CAN lines and software, then a check valve in the converter housing, before the pump is replaced. Hyundai lists a stuck high-flow pump on its 8-speed DCT as P193E71. CARB requires functional checks on outputs. P094B is the opposite fault, P094A the driver, P0944 the pressure loss of the whole unit.
possible_causes: Air in the pump after service or a suction leak [HIGH]
Seized or failed pump motor [MEDIUM]
Blocked strainer or leaking check valve [MEDIUM]
Supply or relay fault stopping the pump [LOW]

symptoms: Engine restarts at once or stop-start not available

description: The hydraulic or electric oil pump, or its integrated controller, has become too hot. The temperature is usually measured on the controller board and the pump is derated or switched off to protect it. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. Hyundai lists the same condition for the high-flow pump of its wet 8-speed DCT as P193D4B, over temperature, and P1C2E92 for the high-pressure pump motor control. Kia recalled stop-start oil pump controllers in 2023 because a damaged capacitor could short and overheat the board, harness and connector. CARB requires functional checks on outputs. P094A is the driver fault, P094B a pump that never stops, a common reason for heat build-up.
possible_causes: Pump running too long because of leakage or a stuck relay [HIGH]
Defective pump controller board [MEDIUM]
Very hot transmission fluid or blocked cooling [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Burning smell near the pump in severe cases

description: Fault in the power feed of the hydraulic or electric oil pump: fuse, supply wire, connector or relay output. The module sees missing or implausible supply at the pump or its controller. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. Mercedes shows the checks that belong to it on the electric auxiliary oil pump of the 722.9 automatic, although it reports that pump under P0944: connector and fuse first, then supply voltage and CAN lines. Hyundai lists an open circuit of its DCT high-flow pump as P193D13. CARB requires circuit checks on outputs. P0945 to P0948 concern the control side, P094A the driver, P0562 general low system voltage. Without supply the pump stops and stop-start is usually blocked.

Open or corroded supply wire or connector [MEDIUM]
Weak battery or poor main ground lowering pump supply voltage [LOW]

description: General electrical fault in the circuit that carries the driver's manual up and down requests to the transmission control, as used by tip-shift gates on automatics and by automated manual gearboxes. A Chrysler patent shows the classic design: a transverse gate beside the drive positions with a proximity switch that signals upshift on one side and downshift on the other. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. The module typically checks the switch signals for states that cannot occur. P0951 to P0954 are the range, low, high and intermittent faults, P0955 onward the mode select circuit. Usually manual shifting is disabled while normal automatic driving remains available; MIL use varies.
possible_causes: Failed up/down switch or sensor in the selector lever or paddles [HIGH]
Damaged wiring or corroded connector at the shifter (e.g. after spilled liquid) [MEDIUM]
Clockspring or steering column wiring fault on paddle-shift vehicles [LOW]

Meist wird nur das manuelle Schalten gesperrt, der Automatikbetrieb bleibt; die MIL ist herstellerabhängig.

symptoms: Manual or tip shifting does not respond

description: Plausibility fault in the circuit that reports the driver's manual upshift and downshift requests, typically the tip gate of an automatic selector lever or steering wheel paddles. The signal is electrically valid but makes no sense, for example both requests active together or a request held far longer than any tap. A Volkswagen patent explains that the Hall elements in such tip gates are hard to diagnose and proposes checking all sensors and lines while the lever sits in P or R. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly; CARB requires rationality checks on such inputs. P0950 is the general circuit fault, P0952 to P0954 the low, high and intermittent faults. Usually only manual shifting is disabled.
possible_causes: Sticking or worn up/down tip switch, request signal stays active [HIGH]
Displaced magnet or damaged Hall sensor board in the selector lever [MEDIUM]
Spilled liquid or dirt in the shifter causing cross-talk between contacts [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage in the transmission or shifter control module [LOW]

Unwanted gear changes in manual mode

description: The control unit sees the voltage on the manual up/down request circuit below its expected window, typically a signal wire shorted to ground or a switch stuck in the grounded state. In practice manual shifting is locked out while D keeps shifting automatically.

Low supply voltage to a Hall-type tip sensor [LOW]

description: Open-circuit fault in the driver circuit of pressure control solenoid A: the module measures an impedance far above the coil value, as if a wire, pin or winding were broken. Which solenoid carries the letter A depends on the gearbox. Ford uses it for the line pressure (EPC) solenoid; GM's 8-speed for clutch 1 (CB1278R), the 9- and 10-speeds for clutch CB123456(R), Allison 1000 for main modulation (line) pressure and GM's dual-clutch gearbox for the odd-clutch valve. GM flags more than 200 kOhm for 0.3 s (Type A), Allison 173 kOhm or more after an intrusive test. GM six-speeds report an open under P0963 instead. Low and high are P0962/P0963, performance P0961. Expect maximum line pressure, harsh shifts or a fixed limp gear.

description: Performance fault of pressure control solenoid A: the circuit is electrically intact, but the solenoid does not behave as commanded. Allison 1000 flags a current error of 0.5 A or more in 40 of 80 samples (Type A). Ford's 2023 diesel summary lists it as a PC A current range fault. In GM's CVT, A feeds the secondary pulley: a pressure error above 500 kPa steady or 1,500 kPa transient, confirmed by a ratio error, sets it after 5 s. Electrical faults are P0960, P0962 and P0963. The module usually commands maximum line pressure and freezes adaptations.

Weil das Ventil im Schieberkasten sitzt, wird oft die ganze Ventil-Steuergeräte-Einheit getauscht.

symptoms: Limp mode in reverse and one forward gear

description: Pressure control solenoid C circuit high: a short to voltage, and on GM six-speeds also an open, as there is no separate open code there. The Saab 9-4X 6T70 (clutch pressure solenoid 3, low/reverse and 4-5-6 clutches) and GM's 2018 six-speed table set it after 1 s or 0.3 s as Type A, with limp mode in reverse and 5th gear at maximum line pressure. GM's 8-, 9- and 10-speeds use the code for their clutch solenoid C; GM's dual-clutch gearbox for the redundant odd-clutch shutdown valve, where too high a voltage at the sense pin with the output switched on counts as a short. Ford does not use C codes. Siblings: P0968 open, P0970 low, P0969 performance. A loose connector can make the fault come and go.
possible_causes: Open coil or poor connection (reported as high on GM six-speeds) [HIGH]
Control wire shorted to a supply voltage [MEDIUM]
Damaged or loose transmission connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty output stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Der Saab 9-4X mit 6T70 (Kupplungsdruckventil 3 für Low/Rückwärts und 4-5-6) und GMs Sechsgangtabelle 2018 setzen ihn nach 1 s bzw. 0,3 s als Typ A, mit Notlauf im Rückwärts- und fünften Gang bei Höchstdruck. GMs Acht-, Neun- und Zehngang nutzen den Code für ihr Kupplungsventil C, GMs Doppelkupplungsgetriebe für das redundante Abschaltventil der ungeraden Kupplung – dort gilt zu hohe Spannung am Messpin bei eingeschaltetem Ausgang als Kurzschluss. symptoms: MIL on, limp mode in a fixed gear
Harsh engagements at maximum line pressure
Fault comes and goes with temperature or vibration

description: Range/performance fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid A: the circuit is not plainly shorted, yet its electrical behaviour does not fit what the module commands. Today's large makers rarely use the code. GM's 2007 table for the Allison 1000 six-speed used it for an open SS1 circuit: after three hardware fault samples the module opens the low-side driver as an intrusive test and reports P0972 if four more samples show no short to ground (400 ms, Type A, MIL at once). Newer GM Allison tables move that open to P097A. Ferrari's DCT bulletin reuses P0972 for a missing signal from the actuator 1 engage position sensor, not a solenoid. Ford and GM six-speeds report opens elsewhere. Shorts are P0973/P0974.
possible_causes: Open or high-resistance coil of shift solenoid A (Allison-type usage) [HIGH]
Loose or corroded terminal at the transmission connector or internal harness [MEDIUM]
Chafed or broken wire between module and solenoid [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid A Control Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.de: Plausibilitätsfehler im Ansteuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil A: Der Kreis ist nicht eindeutig kurzgeschlossen, verhält sich elektrisch aber nicht so, wie das Steuergerät es vorgibt. Heute nutzen ihn die großen Hersteller kaum. GMs Tabelle von 2007 für das Allison-1000-Sechsganggetriebe meldete darunter eine Unterbrechung von SS1: Nach drei Fehlermessungen öffnet das Steuergerät testweise den Low-Side-Treiber und setzt P0972, wenn vier weitere Messungen keinen Masseschluss zeigen (400 ms, Typ A, MIL sofort). Neuere GM-Tabellen für das Allison führen diese Unterbrechung als P097A. Ferrari nutzt P0972 im DCT für ein fehlendes Signal des Positionssensors von Aktuator 1 – also gar kein Ventil. Kurzschlüsse sind P0973/P0974.

symptoms: Transmission falls back to a fixed default gear

description: Low-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid A, usually a short to ground. Ford lists it as SSA short to ground beside P0750 (open) for the 5R110W, 6R80, 6F and 6R140, checked by a driver feedback line within 0.5 to 5 s. GM six-speeds (6L/6T) call SS A the mode 2 solenoid and set P0973 after 1.2 of 1.5 s, MIL after one trip. The Saab 9-4X 6T70 needs 2 s, Type A, then only reverse and 5th remain. GM's 2016 Allison 1000 table folds ground short (0.42 ohm or less) and open (200 kOhm or more) into this code over 10 counts. Saab's Aisin gearbox in the 9-5 (2010) maps it to shift solenoid valve 2. High side is P0974.
possible_causes: Control wire to solenoid A chafed through and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in solenoid A or the control solenoid assembly [MEDIUM]
Fluid or metal debris bridging pins at the transmission connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty low-side driver in the transmission or powertrain module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1600€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Spannung im Steuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil A zu niedrig, meist durch einen Masseschluss. Ford führt ihn neben P0750 (Unterbrechung) als Masseschluss von SSA für 5R110W, 6R80, 6F und 6R140; geprüft über eine Rückmeldeleitung der Endstufe binnen 0,5 bis 5 s. Bei GMs Sechsganggetrieben (6L/6T) heißt SS A Mode-2-Ventil; der Code fällt nach 1,2 von 1,5 s, MIL nach einer Fahrt. Der Saab 9-4X mit 6T70 braucht 2 s, Typ A, danach bleiben nur Rückwärts und der 5. Gang. GMs Tabelle 2016 fürs Allison 1000 fasst Masseschluss (höchstens 0,42 Ω) und Unterbrechung (ab 200 kΩ) über 10 Zählungen hierunter zusammen. Im Aisin-Getriebe des Saab 9-5 (2010) steht er für Schaltventil 2. Gegenstück ist P0974.

symptoms: MIL on after the first faulty trip on many vehicles
Limp mode with only a few gears, often reverse plus one forward gear
Harsh engagements due to maximum line pressure
Torque converter lockup and manual shifting disabled

description: High-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid A. What it covers depends on the maker. Ford reserves it for a short to power on SSA, because an open SSA circuit sets P0750. GM six-speeds put both an open and a power short of the mode 2 solenoid here: 1.2 of 1.5 s, MIL only after two trips. The Saab 9-4X 6T70 waits 2 s, Type B, and then blocks 1st gear. GM's Allison 1000 tables of 2016 and 2023 treat it as a pure power short (0.39 ohm or less, 3 samples, 75 or 60 ms) and report opens separately. Saab's Aisin gearbox in the 9-5 (2010) sets it when solenoid valve 2 reads off while commanded on, 100 ms five times, Type A. Ground-side faults are P0973.
possible_causes: Open coil or broken wire where the maker reports opens under the high code (GM six-speed) [HIGH]
Control wire shorted to a supply voltage [MEDIUM]
Spread or corroded pins at the transmission connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1600€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Ford meint nur einen Kurzschluss nach Plus an SSA, denn eine Unterbrechung von SSA setzt P0750. symptoms: MIL on, on GM six-speeds only after a second faulty trip
First gear locked out, start-off in a higher gear
Missing or wrong shifts, possibly limp mode

description: Range/performance fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid B. Three documented uses differ widely. GM's 2007 Allison 1000 table used it for an open SS2 circuit, confirmed by an intrusive low-side test (400 ms, Type A). FCA's 2016 recall for the 9-speed front-drive transaxle (Cherokee, 200, Renegade, 500X, ProMaster City) names P0975 with P0978, P0981 and P0984 as the codes set by intermittent high resistance from poorly crimped terminals in the range sensor harness under old TCM software; updated software reports that case as P0901 instead. Ferrari's DCT uses P0975 for a missing actuator 2 position signal. Low/high are P0976/P0977.
possible_causes: Poorly crimped terminals causing intermittent high resistance (FCA 9-speed recall) [HIGH]
Open or high-resistance coil of shift solenoid B [MEDIUM]
Outdated transmission software that misreads harness resistance [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid B Control Circuit Range/Performance

symptoms: Unexpected shift to neutral or loss of drive (FCA 9-speed)
Fixed default gear or harsh shifts

description: Low-voltage fault, normally a ground short, in the control circuit of shift solenoid B. On GM six-speeds SS B is the mode 3 multiplex valve; the 2016 table sets P0976 after 1.2 of 1.5 s without lighting the MIL, while the Saab 9-4X 6T70 version needs 2 s, is Type B and raises line pressure. Ford uses it for SSB short to ground, with P0755 for an open; on the 2023 Super Duty diesel SSB is fed by solenoid supply TSPC2, so a P2669 supply fault disables this check. GM's Allison 1000 merges ground short and open into it in 2016, but from 2022 reports opens as P097B and keeps P0976 for ground faults found by an intrusive test (120 ms, MIL after one trip). High side is P0977.
possible_causes: Solenoid B control wire shorted to ground or housing [HIGH]
Internal short in solenoid B or its valve body assembly [MEDIUM]
Moisture or debris bridging pins at the connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1600€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Firm shifts due to raised line pressure

description: High-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid B. FCA 9-speed and Aisin uses are not documented for this code. Ground-side faults are P0976.

Control wire shorted to battery or a switched supply [MEDIUM]
Damaged pins or seals at the transmission pass-through connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]

Für FCA-Neungang und Aisin ist dieser Code nicht belegt. Masseseitige Fehler sind P0976.

symptoms: Limp mode with only reverse and one high forward gear
MIL or transmission warning, depending on calibration

description: Range/performance fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid C. GM's 2007 Allison 1000 table used it for an open SS3 circuit, but only while the commanded gear is not reverse trim, 5th or 6th; the table even prints the label Circuit Low beside an open-circuit test, an apparent typo. GMs Allison-1000-Tabelle von 2007 meldete darunter eine Unterbrechung von SS3, allerdings nur, solange weder Rückwärts-Trim noch 5. oder 6. symptoms: Sudden neutral or default gear while driving

description: Low-voltage fault, usually a short to ground, in the control circuit of shift solenoid C. GM uses it mainly on the Allison 1000 six-speed of its heavy pickups and chassis cabs: in 2016 a ground short of 0.22 ohm or less, stricter than the 0.42 ohm for SS1 and SS2, or an open of 200 kOhm or more counts after 10 samples (250 ms, Type A). Faulty low-side driver in the control module [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Unterbrechung im Ansteuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil A – ein Code, den erst spätere J2012-Ausgaben eingeführt haben; ältere Listen führen P097A noch als reserviert. Belegt ist er nur bei GM: Die Tabellen 2022 bis 2025 für das Allison-1000-Sechsganggetriebe der schweren Nutzfahrzeuge nennen ihn „Shift Solenoid 1 Control Circuit Open“. Nach einem ersten Hardwarefehler gilt er als vorläufig, nach drei Messungen öffnet das Steuergerät testweise den Low-Side-Treiber; drei weitere Unterbrechungsbefunde bei 9 bis 18 V setzen den Code (120 ms, MIL nach einer Fahrt). Dasselbe Getriebe nutzte dafür früher P0972 und 2016 P0973. Ford meldet eine Unterbrechung von SSA als P0750, GMs Sechsgang als P0974, Genesis fasst alle elektrischen Fehler von A unter P0753.

symptoms: MIL on after one faulty trip
Transmission in a fixed default gear

description: Open-circuit fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid B. Public use is again limited to GM's Allison 1000 six-speed in heavy-duty trucks, where the 2022 to 2025 tables label it Shift Solenoid 2 Control Circuit Open. SS2 shares high-side driver 2 with SS1 and SS3, so the open test only runs while that supply is on and free of P2669, P2670 or P2671. It confirms an open by switching the low-side driver off and needs three samples, 120 ms, MIL after one trip. Allison's 2007 table filed the same check as P0975, the 2016 table under P0976. Ford reports an open SSB as P0755, GM six-speeds as P0977. Low/high are P0976/P0977.
possible_causes: Open coil of shift solenoid 2/B [HIGH]
Loose or corroded terminal on the solenoid B circuit [HIGH]
Wire broken by vibration or heat near the transmission [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Unterbrechung im Ansteuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil B. Öffentlich belegt ist auch dieser Code nur bei GMs Allison-1000-Sechsgang in schweren Nutzfahrzeugen; die Tabellen 2022 bis 2025 nennen ihn „Shift Solenoid 2 Control Circuit Open“. Die Allison-Tabelle von 2007 führte dieselbe Prüfung als P0975, die von 2016 unter P0976. Ford meldet die Unterbrechung von SSB als P0755, GMs Sechsgang als P0977. Niedrig/hoch sind P0976/P0977.

symptoms: MIL on after one faulty trip
Default gear operation, some ranges unavailable

description: Open-circuit fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid C. GM documents it for the Allison 1000 six-speed in its 2022 to 2025 heavy-duty tables as Shift Solenoid 3 Control Circuit Open, with the same intrusive low-side test as SS1 and SS2: three samples, 120 ms, battery 9 to 18 V, MIL after one trip. It is the youngest of three codes for this one fault on that gearbox: 2007 used P0978, only outside reverse trim, 5th and 6th gear, 2016 merged it into P0979 with a 200 kOhm limit. Ford reports an open SSC under P0760, and no other maker was found using P097C. A related pressure switch code may set too, because SS3 strokes the S3 valve that switch PS3 watches.
possible_causes: Open coil of shift solenoid 3/C [HIGH]
Loose, wet or corroded pin in the transmission connector [HIGH]
Broken wire between module and solenoid C [MEDIUM]
Faulty low-side driver in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GM belegt ihn für das Allison-1000-Sechsganggetriebe in den Nutzfahrzeugtabellen 2022 bis 2025 als „Shift Solenoid 3 Control Circuit Open“, mit demselben aktiven Low-Side-Test wie bei SS1 und SS2: drei Messungen, 120 ms, Bordspannung 9 bis 18 V, MIL nach einer Fahrt. Ford meldet die Unterbrechung von SSC als P0760; weitere Hersteller mit P097C wurden nicht gefunden. Ein Druckschaltercode kann zusätzlich auftreten, weil SS3 das Ventil S3 verschiebt, das der Druckschalter PS3 überwacht.

symptoms: MIL on after one faulty trip
Upper gears unavailable or fixed default gear

description: Open-circuit fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid D. No maker documents this code publicly. GM's Allison tables that use P097A to P097C stop at shift solenoid 3, and Ford, which has a solenoid D in its 5R110W, 6R80, 6F and 6R140 gearboxes, reports an open SSD under the base code P0765, with P0982/P0983 for ground and power shorts. Any use would follow the CARB rule that every transmission output must be checked for lack of circuit continuity, plus the pattern of the A to C codes: a high-impedance reading confirmed by switching the driver. On Ford's 6R80 and 6F, SSD feeds either CBLR or C456 through a multiplex valve, so an open there would disturb first and upper gears alike.
possible_causes: Open coil of shift solenoid D [HIGH]
Disconnected or corroded terminal in the solenoid D circuit [MEDIUM]
Broken wire in the transmission harness [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid D Control Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: Open-circuit fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid D. No maker documents this code publicly. GM's Allison tables that use P097A to P097C stop at shift solenoid 3, and Ford, which has a solenoid D in its 5R110W, 6R80, 6F and 6R140 gearboxes, reports an open SSD under the base code P0765, with P0982/P0983 for ground and power shorts. On Ford's 6R80 and 6F, SSD feeds either CBLR or C456 through a multiplex valve, so an open there would disturb first and upper gears alike.
bilingual_description.de: Unterbrechung im Ansteuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil D. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. GMs Allison-Tabellen, die P097A bis P097C nutzen, enden bei Schaltventil 3, und Ford, das in 5R110W, 6R80, 6F und 6R140 ein Ventil D besitzt, meldet die Unterbrechung von SSD über den Grundcode P0765, Masse- und Plusschluss über P0982/P0983. Eine Verwendung stützt sich auf die CARB-Pflicht, jeden Getriebeausgang auf fehlende Leitungsdurchgängigkeit zu prüfen, und auf das Muster der Codes A bis C: hoher Widerstand, bestätigt durch Umschalten des Treibers. Bei Fords 6R80 und 6F versorgt SSD über ein Multiplexventil wahlweise CBLR oder C456 – eine Unterbrechung träfe dort den ersten wie die oberen Gänge.

symptoms: Missing gears that depend on solenoid D
Limp mode in a fixed gear

description: Open-circuit fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid E. No manufacturer was found that documents this code. Ford, the main user of an SSE, still reports an open SSE under P0770; its 2023 diesel summary pairs that with P0985 for ground and P0986 for power shorts, and powers SSE from supply TSPC1 together with SSA and SSC. In the 6R80 and 6F, SSE is an on/off solenoid that switches the multiplexing of SSD, while the 6R140 uses a variable force SSE for clutch C456. Without a public owner the code rests on the CARB demand for circuit continuity checks on transmission outputs and on GM's A to C pattern. Opens in shared supply wiring usually set P0657 first.
possible_causes: Open coil of shift solenoid E [HIGH]
Poor contact at the solenoid E terminal or lead frame [MEDIUM]
Broken signal wire to solenoid E [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid E Control Circuit/Open

description: Open-circuit fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid F. It is the only code in its family for letter F, since J2012 has no range/performance, low or high codes for F in this block. No maker was found to document it. Hyundai's Genesis bulletin for the eight-speed (2017–2018 G80 and G90) shows how F is handled in practice: an electrical fault of shift control solenoid F (labelled 8LR) is reported under P2709 and fixed by replacing the solenoid. Other makers with six or more clutches use their own codes. A P097F would follow the CARB requirement to test every transmission output for circuit continuity, by analogy with GM's open tests for solenoids 1 to 3.
possible_causes: Open coil of shift solenoid F [HIGH]
Loose or corroded terminal at the valve body connector [MEDIUM]
Broken wire between module and solenoid F [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Er ist der einzige Code dieser Reihe für den Buchstaben F, denn J2012 sieht in diesem Block für F weder Plausibilitäts- noch Niedrig-/Hoch-Codes vor. Ein Hersteller, der ihn dokumentiert, wurde nicht gefunden. Wie F in der Praxis behandelt wird, zeigt Hyundais Genesis-Bulletin zum Achtganggetriebe (G80 und G90, 2017–2018): Ein elektrischer Fehler des Schaltventils F (Kennung 8LR) läuft dort als P2709 und wird durch Ventiltausch behoben. Ein P097F folgt der CARB-Pflicht, jeden Getriebeausgang auf Durchgängigkeit zu prüfen, analog zu GMs Unterbrechungstests für Ventil 1 bis 3.

symptoms: Gears that need solenoid F unavailable

description: High-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid C, meaning a short to supply. GM documents it for the Allison 1000 six-speed: the 2007 table wants four consecutive power-short samples (100 ms, Type A) and skips the check in reverse trim, 5th and 6th gear; later tables (2016, 2018) look for 0.39 ohm or less to a supply over three counts within 75 ms, and from 2022 within 60 ms, MIL after one trip. Ford uses it for SSC short to power in all its listed gearboxes, with P0760 for an open. Neither GM's 6L/6T six-speeds nor Saab's documented gearboxes use P0980. The ground counterpart is P0979, the open code for the Allison is P097C.
possible_causes: Solenoid C control wire shorted to a supply voltage [HIGH]
Shorted turns in solenoid C lowering its resistance [MEDIUM]
Adjacent pins bridged by fluid or debris in the connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid C Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: High-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid C, meaning a short to supply. GM documents it for the Allison 1000 six-speed: the 2007 table wants four consecutive power-short samples (100 ms, Type A) and skips the check in reverse trim, 5th and 6th gear; later tables (2016, 2018) look for 0.39 ohm or less to a supply over three counts within 75 ms, and from 2022 within 60 ms, MIL after one trip. Ford uses it for SSC short to power in all its listed gearboxes, with P0760 for an open. Neither GM's 6L/6T six-speeds nor Saab's documented gearboxes use P0980. The ground counterpart is P0979, the open code for the Allison is P097C.
bilingual_description.de: Spannung im Steuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil C zu hoch, also Kurzschluss nach Plus. GM belegt ihn für das Allison-1000-Sechsganggetriebe: Die Tabelle von 2007 verlangt vier aufeinanderfolgende Plusschluss-Messungen (100 ms, Typ A) und setzt im Rückwärts-Trim, 5. und 6. Gang aus; spätere Tabellen (2016, 2018) suchen höchstens 0,39 Ω gegen eine Versorgung über drei Zählungen binnen 75 ms, ab 2022 binnen 60 ms, MIL nach einer Fahrt. Ford meldet darunter in allen genannten Getrieben den Plusschluss von SSC, die Unterbrechung als P0760. GMs Sechsgang 6L/6T und die dokumentierten Saab-Getriebe nutzen P0980 nicht. Masseseitiges Gegenstück ist P0979, der Unterbrechungscode des Allison P097C.

symptoms: MIL on after the first faulty trip
Solenoid C stuck energized, wrong gear or default gear

description: Range/performance fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid D. GM's Allison tables end at solenoid C, and Ford checks SSD only with P0765, P0982 and P0983, so the large North American users skip it. Two codegenau sources exist. FCA's recall S55 (NHTSA 16V-529) covers about 323,400 vehicles with the 9-speed front-drive transaxle; with old TCM software, intermittent high resistance from weak crimps in the range sensor harness could set P0981 or its siblings, and the remedy is new software plus, if a code is present, a new harness. Ferrari's DCT bulletin uses P0981 for a missing signal from the actuator 3 position sensor. Low/high for D are P0982/P0983.
possible_causes: Weak terminal crimps causing intermittent resistance (FCA recall S55) [HIGH]
Transmission software not yet updated by the recall [MEDIUM]
Solenoid D coil resistance out of range [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid D Control Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: Range/performance fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid D. GM's Allison tables end at solenoid C, and Ford checks SSD only with P0765, P0982 and P0983, so the large North American users skip it. Two codegenau sources exist. FCA's recall S55 (NHTSA 16V-529) covers about 323,400 vehicles with the 9-speed front-drive transaxle; with old TCM software, intermittent high resistance from weak crimps in the range sensor harness could set P0981 or its siblings, and the remedy is new software plus, if a code is present, a new harness. Ferrari's DCT bulletin uses P0981 for a missing signal from the actuator 3 position sensor. Low/high for D are P0982/P0983.
bilingual_description.de: Plausibilitätsfehler im Ansteuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil D. GMs Allison-Tabellen enden bei Ventil C, und Ford prüft SSD nur mit P0765, P0982 und P0983 – die großen nordamerikanischen Nutzer lassen ihn also aus. Codegenau belegt sind zwei Fälle. FCAs Rückruf S55 (NHTSA 16V-529) betrifft rund 323.400 Fahrzeuge mit dem Neungang-Frontquergetriebe; mit alter TCM-Software konnte sporadisch hoher Widerstand durch schwache Crimpungen im Kabelbaum des Wählbereichssensors P0981 oder seine Geschwister auslösen, abgestellt durch neue Software und, wenn ein Code vorliegt, einen neuen Kabelbaum. Ferrari nutzt P0981 im DCT für ein fehlendes Signal des Positionssensors von Aktuator 3. Niedrig/hoch für D sind P0982/P0983.

symptoms: Unexpected shift to neutral while driving (FCA 9-speed)

description: Low-voltage fault, in practice a short to ground, in the control circuit of shift solenoid D. Ford is the documented user: its summaries list SSD with P0765 open, P0982 short to ground and P0983 short to power, checked continuously through the driver feedback within 0.5 to 5 s. Which clutch this hits depends on the gearbox. In the 6R80 and 6F, SSD is a variable force solenoid feeding CBLR or C456 via the SSE multiplex valve; in the 6R140 it drives CBLR alone. In the 2023 diesel summary SSD is fed from supply TSPC2 with SSB, the converter clutch and line pressure solenoid. GM's six-speed and Allison tables do not use P0982. Ferrari reuses it for an actuator 3 sensor reading too low.
possible_causes: Solenoid D control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in solenoid D or the main control assembly [MEDIUM]
Damaged internal lead frame or connector inside the transmission [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver in the powertrain or transmission module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid D Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Low-voltage fault, in practice a short to ground, in the control circuit of shift solenoid D. Ford is the documented user: its summaries list SSD with P0765 open, P0982 short to ground and P0983 short to power, checked continuously through the driver feedback within 0.5 to 5 s. Which clutch this hits depends on the gearbox. In the 6R80 and 6F, SSD is a variable force solenoid feeding CBLR or C456 via the SSE multiplex valve; in the 6R140 it drives CBLR alone. In the 2023 diesel summary SSD is fed from supply TSPC2 with SSB, the converter clutch and line pressure solenoid. GM's six-speed and Allison tables do not use P0982. Ferrari reuses it for an actuator 3 sensor reading too low.
bilingual_description.de: Spannung im Steuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil D zu niedrig, praktisch ein Masseschluss. Belegter Nutzer ist Ford: Die Zusammenfassungen führen für SSD P0765 (Unterbrechung), P0982 (Masseschluss) und P0983 (Plusschluss), laufend geprüft über die Rückmeldung der Endstufe binnen 0,5 bis 5 s. Welche Kupplung betroffen ist, hängt vom Getriebe ab: Im 6R80 und 6F ist SSD ein Proportionalventil, das über das Multiplexventil SSE entweder CBLR oder C456 versorgt; im 6R140 steuert es nur CBLR. In der Diesel-Zusammenfassung 2023 hängt SSD mit SSB, Wandlerkupplung und Hauptdruckventil an der Versorgung TSPC2. GMs Sechsgang- und Allison-Tabellen nutzen P0982 nicht. Ferrari verwendet ihn für einen zu niedrigen Wert des Sensors von Aktuator 3.

symptoms: MIL on and default gear operation
No engine braking in first or no reverse, depending on gearbox

description: High-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid D. Ford defines it narrowly as SSD short to power; the open circuit stays with P0765. On the 6R140 the solenoid outputs are run by a smart driver chip (ADLER) that does the open and short checks itself, while older units use a feedback line from the output stage; both need 0.5 to 5 s. Since SSD on Ford six-speeds controls the low/reverse clutch, either alone or through the multiplex valve, a constant power short can apply that clutch at the wrong time. The 2020–2023 gasoline summary keeps the same assignment. GM documents no P0983 for its geared automatics, and Ferrari uses it for an actuator 3 sensor reading too high. Ground faults are P0982.
possible_causes: Solenoid D control wire shorted to a supply [HIGH]
Solenoid D with shorted windings [MEDIUM]
Conductive contamination between neighbouring pins [MEDIUM]
Faulty smart driver or output stage in the module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Shift Solenoid D Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.de: Spannung im Steuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil D zu hoch. Ford fasst ihn eng als Plusschluss von SSD; die Unterbrechung bleibt bei P0765. Im 6R140 übernimmt ein intelligenter Treiberbaustein (ADLER) die Prüfung auf Unterbrechung und Kurzschluss, ältere Getriebe nutzen eine Rückmeldeleitung der Endstufe; beide brauchen 0,5 bis 5 s. Weil SSD bei Fords Sechsgang die Low/Rückwärts-Kupplung steuert – direkt oder über das Multiplexventil –, kann ein Dauerplus diese Kupplung zur falschen Zeit schließen. Die Benziner-Zusammenfassung 2020–2023 behält dieselbe Zuordnung bei. GM belegt für seine Stufenautomaten keinen P0983, Ferrari nutzt ihn für einen zu hohen Wert des Sensors von Aktuator 3. Masseschlüsse sind P0982.

symptoms: Clunk or tie-up feel if the low/reverse clutch applies unintentionally

description: Range/performance fault in the drive circuit of shift solenoid E. Ford checks SSE with P0770, P0985 and P0986 only, GM's documented tables never reach letter E, and even Ferrari's DCT list, which reuses most of its neighbours, skips P0984. The one codegenau source is FCA: in recall S55 for the 9-speed front-drive transaxle it names P0984 together with P0975, P0978 and P0981. Under old TCM software, a range sensor harness with poor crimps and intermittent high resistance could set them; with new software the same fault shows as P0901, and these four codes then point to a separate transmission problem. Otherwise the code rests only on the CARB rule for transmission output checks. Low/high are P0985/P0986.
possible_causes: Range sensor harness with weak crimps (FCA 9-speed recall) [HIGH]
TCM software below the recall level [MEDIUM]
Internal transmission fault when the code returns after the update [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Sudden neutral or loss of drive (FCA 9-speed)

description: Low-voltage fault, usually a short to ground, in the control circuit of shift solenoid E. Ford lists it for SSE on the 5R110W and 6R140 and in its 2020–2023 gasoline and 2023 diesel summaries, beside P0770 for an open; for the 6R80 and 6F, whose SSE is the on/off multiplex solenoid, the 2012 text names only P0770. Saab's 2010 9-5 with the Aisin six-speed uses P0985 differently, for shift solenoid valve 1: the module sees the circuit reading on while it is commanded off, 100 ms five times in a row, Type A; it then turns all solenoids off and freezes adaptation. Voltage must be 10.2 to 15.5 V and the engine above 400 rpm. High side is P0986.
possible_causes: Solenoid E control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short of solenoid E [MEDIUM]
Water or fluid in the transmission connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the transmission module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Spannung im Steuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil E zu niedrig, meist ein Masseschluss. Ford führt ihn für SSE beim 5R110W und 6R140 sowie in den Zusammenfassungen Benzin 2020–2023 und Diesel 2023, neben P0770 für die Unterbrechung; für 6R80 und 6F, deren SSE das Ein/Aus-Multiplexventil ist, nennt der Text von 2012 nur P0770. Saab nutzt P0985 im 9-5 von 2010 mit Aisin-Sechsgang anders, nämlich für Schaltventil 1: Das Steuergerät liest den Kreis als eingeschaltet, obwohl „aus“ befohlen ist, 100 ms fünfmal hintereinander, Typ A; danach schaltet es alle Ventile ab und friert die Adaption ein. Bedingung sind 10,2 bis 15,5 V und über 400 1/min. Gegenstück ist P0986.

symptoms: MIL on after the fault is confirmed
All solenoids off, fixed fail-safe gear (Saab/Aisin)
Missing upper gears on Ford gearboxes

description: High-voltage fault in the control circuit of shift solenoid E. Ford means a short to power on SSE; an open sets P0770 and a ground short P0985. On the 6R140 SSE is a variable force solenoid for the C456 clutch, so a short to power can hold that clutch on. Saab's 2010 9-5 with the Aisin six-speed instead assigns P0986 to shift solenoid valve 1 and sets it when the circuit reads off although it is commanded on, which also catches an open coil: 100 ms, five times, Type A, all solenoids then switched off. GM's published transmission tables do not use the code. Because makers split opens differently, check the maker's table before replacing parts.
possible_causes: Solenoid E control wire shorted to a supply voltage [HIGH]
Open coil or wire where the maker reads it as high (Saab/Aisin) [MEDIUM]
Bent or corroded terminals at the solenoid E connector [MEDIUM]
Faulty driver stage in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Spannung im Steuerkreis von Schaltmagnetventil E zu hoch. Ford meint damit einen Plusschluss an SSE; eine Unterbrechung setzt P0770, ein Masseschluss P0985. Im 6R140 ist SSE ein Proportionalventil für die Kupplung C456, ein Plusschluss kann diese Kupplung also geschlossen halten. Saab ordnet P0986 im 9-5 von 2010 mit Aisin-Sechsgang dagegen dem Schaltventil 1 zu und setzt ihn, wenn der Kreis trotz Befehl „ein“ als aus gelesen wird – das erfasst auch eine unterbrochene Spule: 100 ms, fünfmal, Typ A, danach werden alle Ventile abgeschaltet. GMs veröffentlichte Getriebetabellen nutzen den Code nicht. Weil die Hersteller Unterbrechungen unterschiedlich einordnen, vor dem Teiletausch die Herstellertabelle prüfen.

symptoms: MIL on, transmission in fail-safe gear
Tie-up or harsh shift if the controlled clutch stays applied

description: General circuit fault of transmission fluid pressure sensor or switch E. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The only public user of switch E found, GM's 6T70/6T75 family (Saab 9-4X: switch 5 on the low/reverse and 4-5-6 clutch regulator valve), reports only P0989 and P0990 for it, both as plausibility counts. P0987 is the slot for a module that sees a generic circuit fault on a fifth pressure sensor or switch, for example an open or out-of-range signal, without separating low from high. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission inputs. Range/performance is P0988, low and high are P0989/P0990; switches A to D use P0840 to P0878. Typical effects are frozen shift adaptations and harsher shifts.
possible_causes: Failed pressure sensor or switch E [HIGH]
Open or shorted signal wire or poor connector contact [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General circuit fault of transmission fluid pressure sensor or switch E. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The only public user of switch E found, GM's 6T70/6T75 family (Saab 9-4X: switch 5 on the low/reverse and 4-5-6 clutch regulator valve), reports only P0989 and P0990 for it, both as plausibility counts. P0987 is the slot for a module that sees a generic circuit fault on a fifth pressure sensor or switch, for example an open or out-of-range signal, without separating low from high. CARB requires circuit checks on transmission inputs. Range/performance is P0988, low and high are P0989/P0990; switches A to D use P0840 to P0878. Typical effects are frozen shift adaptations and harsher shifts.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner Kreisfehler am Getriebeöldrucksensor bzw. -schalter E. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. Der einzige gefundene öffentliche Nutzer von Schalter E, GMs 6T70/6T75-Familie (Saab 9-4X: Schalter 5 am Regelschieber der Low/Rückwärts- und 4-5-6-Kupplung), meldet dafür nur P0989 und P0990, beide als Plausibilitätszähler. P0987 ist für ein Steuergerät gedacht, das an einem fünften Drucksensor oder -schalter einen allgemeinen Kreisfehler erkennt, etwa Unterbrechung oder Signal außerhalb des Bereichs, ohne zwischen niedrig und hoch zu trennen. CARB verlangt Kreisprüfungen an Getriebeeingängen. Plausibilität ist P0988, niedrig/hoch P0989/P0990; Schalter A bis D belegen P0840 bis P0878. Üblich sind eingefrorene Schaltadaptionen und härtere Schaltungen.

description: Range/performance fault of transmission fluid pressure sensor or switch E: the signal is electrically valid but does not fit the commanded clutch state or the pressure expected from other inputs. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. GM's 6T70/6T75 family, the one public user of switch E (switch 5 on the low/reverse and 4-5-6 regulator valve), folds such plausibility checks into P0989 and P0990; its switch logic table shows which gears should pressurise the switch. Sonnax describes how these normally closed film switches in the valve body module fail through debris or delaminated films. CARB requires rationality checks of transmission inputs. Siblings: P0987 circuit, P0989 low, P0990 high.
possible_causes: Damaged or delaminated switch film, switch reacts late or not at all [HIGH]
Debris in the fluid holding the switch or its regulator valve [MEDIUM]
Low fluid level or real pressure deviation in the clutch circuit [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: Range/performance fault of transmission fluid pressure sensor or switch E: the signal is electrically valid but does not fit the commanded clutch state or the pressure expected from other inputs. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. GM's 6T70/6T75 family, the one public user of switch E (switch 5 on the low/reverse and 4-5-6 regulator valve), folds such plausibility checks into P0989 and P0990; its switch logic table shows which gears should pressurise the switch. Sonnax describes how these normally closed film switches in the valve body module fail through debris or delaminated films. CARB requires rationality checks of transmission inputs. Siblings: P0987 circuit, P0989 low, P0990 high.
bilingual_description.de: Plausibilitätsfehler am Getriebeöldrucksensor bzw. -schalter E: Das Signal ist elektrisch gültig, passt aber nicht zum befohlenen Kupplungszustand oder zu dem Druck, den die übrigen Eingänge erwarten lassen. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. GMs 6T70/6T75-Familie, der einzige öffentliche Nutzer von Schalter E (Schalter 5 am Regelschieber der Low/Rückwärts- und 4-5-6-Kupplung), packt solche Prüfungen in P0989 und P0990; ihre Schaltlogik-Tabelle zeigt, in welchen Gängen der Schalter Druck sehen muss. Sonnax beschreibt, wie diese stromlos geschlossenen Membranschalter im Schieberkasten-Modul durch Schmutz oder abgelöste Folien versagen. CARB verlangt Plausibilitätsprüfungen der Getriebeeingänge. Geschwister: P0987 Kreis, P0989 niedrig, P0990 hoch.

symptoms: Often no noticeable symptom at first
Shift quality worsens because adaptation stops

description: Pressure switch E reads low, meaning no pressure, when it should show pressure. GM's 6T70/6T75 family uses E for switch 5 on the R1/4-5-6 clutch regulator valve; the normally closed switch sees pressure while both the low/reverse and the 4-5-6 clutch are released. The module counts clutch releases after which the signal stays low, checked with commanded clutch pressure at 50 kPa or less: 18 counts in GM's 2011 tables and on the Saab 9-4X, 17 in the 2016 table. It is a Type C or Special No Trip code without MIL, and the adaptations of both clutches are frozen. Sonnax lists P0989 among typical switch failures in this valve body module. P0990 is the stuck-high counterpart; switches A to D use P0840 to P0878.
possible_causes: Damaged or delaminated film in switch 5 of the valve body module [HIGH]
Debris keeping pressure away from the switch [MEDIUM]
R1/4-5-6 clutch regulator valve sticking [MEDIUM]
Low fluid level [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 1500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Pressure switch E reads low, meaning no pressure, when it should show pressure. GM's 6T70/6T75 family uses E for switch 5 on the R1/4-5-6 clutch regulator valve; the normally closed switch sees pressure while both the low/reverse and the 4-5-6 clutch are released. The module counts clutch releases after which the signal stays low, checked with commanded clutch pressure at 50 kPa or less: 18 counts in GM's 2011 tables and on the Saab 9-4X, 17 in the 2016 table. It is a Type C or Special No Trip code without MIL, and the adaptations of both clutches are frozen. Sonnax lists P0989 among typical switch failures in this valve body module. P0990 is the stuck-high counterpart; switches A to D use P0840 to P0878.
bilingual_description.de: Druckschalter E meldet niedrig, also keinen Druck, obwohl Druck anliegen müsste. GMs 6T70/6T75-Familie nutzt E für Schalter 5 am R1/4-5-6-Regelschieber; der stromlos geschlossene Schalter sieht Druck, solange Low/Rückwärts- und 4-5-6-Kupplung beide gelöst sind. Das Steuergerät zählt Kupplungsfreigaben, nach denen das Signal niedrig bleibt, geprüft bei befohlenem Kupplungsdruck bis 50 kPa: 18 Zählungen in GMs Tabellen von 2011 und beim Saab 9-4X, 17 in der Tabelle von 2016. Es ist ein Typ-C- bzw. „Special No Trip“-Code ohne MIL; die Adaption beider Kupplungen wird eingefroren. Sonnax nennt P0989 unter den typischen Schalterausfällen dieses Schieberkasten-Moduls. P0990 ist das Gegenstück „hängt hoch“; Schalter A bis D belegen P0840 bis P0878.

symptoms: No warning light, code stored only
Shifts into 4th to 6th or reverse gradually less smooth
Occasional limp mode if the fault persists

description: Pressure switch E reads high, meaning pressure, when it should be vented. GM's 6T70/6T75 family uses E for switch 5 on the R1/4-5-6 clutch regulator valve; applying the low/reverse or 4-5-6 clutch moves that valve and should exhaust the switch. If the signal stays high after such an apply, with commanded clutch pressure at 700 kPa or more, the module counts it: 15 counts on the Saab 9-4X, 30 in GM's 2016 table. It is a Type C or Special No Trip code, so no MIL, and the adaptations of both clutches are frozen. According to Saab, normal debris in the fluid can set it intermittently without noticeable symptoms. A short to voltage on the signal wire has the same effect. P0989 is the stuck-low case.
possible_causes: Switch 5 stuck open by a damaged film or debris [HIGH]
R1/4-5-6 regulator valve not moving, switch stays pressurised [MEDIUM]
Signal circuit shorted to voltage or open inside the module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 1500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GMs 6T70/6T75-Familie nutzt E für Schalter 5 am R1/4-5-6-Regelschieber; wird die Low/Rückwärts- oder die 4-5-6-Kupplung zugeschaltet, verschiebt sich dieser Schieber und der Schalter müsste drucklos werden. Laut Saab kann gewöhnlicher Abrieb im Öl ihn sporadisch auslösen, ohne dass der Fahrer etwas merkt. Ein Plusschluss der Signalleitung wirkt genauso. P0989 ist der Fall „hängt niedrig“.

symptoms: No warning light, code stored only

description: The module has seen the signal of the fifth transmission pressure sensor or switch drop out or jump briefly, without a steady low or high reading. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The only switch E found in public sources is GM's TFP switch 5 in the 6T70/6T75 valve body module (Saab 9-4X 2011), a normally closed switch that GM monitors only through P0989 and P0990: signal stuck low at commanded pressure of 50 kPa or less, or stuck high, counted over clutch releases and logged as Special No Trip without MIL. An intermittent check would follow the CARB rule that transmission inputs be monitored for circuit faults. Steady faults are P0987 to P0990. Expect frozen shift adaptation and the odd harsh shift.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded contact at the valve body module connector [HIGH]
Debris or damaged diaphragm film making the switch contact flicker [MEDIUM]
Chafed internal harness that shorts or opens under vibration [MEDIUM]
Fault in the transmission control module input stage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch E Circuit Intermittent

bilingual_description.en: The module has seen the signal of the fifth transmission pressure sensor or switch drop out or jump briefly, without a steady low or high reading. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The only switch E found in public sources is GM's TFP switch 5 in the 6T70/6T75 valve body module (Saab 9-4X 2011), a normally closed switch that GM monitors only through P0989 and P0990: signal stuck low at commanded pressure of 50 kPa or less, or stuck high, counted over clutch releases and logged as Special No Trip without MIL. An intermittent check would follow the CARB rule that transmission inputs be monitored for circuit faults. Steady faults are P0987 to P0990. Expect frozen shift adaptation and the odd harsh shift.
bilingual_description.de: Das Signal des fünften Getriebedrucksensors oder -schalters ist kurzzeitig weggebrochen oder gesprungen, ohne dauerhaft zu niedrig oder zu hoch zu sein. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diesen Code. Der einzige öffentlich belegte Schalter E ist GMs TFP-Schalter 5 im Ventilblockmodul des 6T70/6T75 (Saab 9-4X 2011), ein Öffner, den GM nur über P0989 und P0990 überwacht – Signal hängt bei befohlenem Druck bis 50 kPa auf Low oder hängt auf High, gezählt über Kupplungsfreigaben, als Special No Trip ohne MIL. Eine Sporadisch-Prüfung entspräche der CARB-Pflicht, Getriebe-Eingänge auf Kreisfehler zu überwachen. Dauerhafte Fehler laufen unter P0987 bis P0990. Für den Fahrer bedeutet das eingefrorene Schaltadaption und gelegentlich harte Schaltungen.

symptoms: Stored fault, often without warning light

description: General circuit fault of a sixth transmission pressure sensor or switch, labelled F. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, and no gearbox with a switch F was found. GM's six-speeds stop at TFP switch 5 (letter E, P0989/P0990), and Mitsubishi's 2019 six-speed monitors its 2-6 brake, high clutch and low-reverse brake switches under P0846, P0876 and P0988, which are letters B, D and E. Pressure switches like these sit in the valve body module and tell the module which clutch is applied; Sonnax describes them as normally closed film-and-piston switches. P0992 would be the code for an open or implausible circuit without a low/high split, as CARB requires circuit checks on transmission inputs. Range/performance, low, high and intermittent are P0993 to P0996.
possible_causes: Open or damaged signal wire or connector to the switch [HIGH]
Pressure switch or sensor failed inside the valve body module [MEDIUM]
Transmission control module input fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch F Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General circuit fault of a sixth transmission pressure sensor or switch, labelled F. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, and no gearbox with a switch F was found. Pressure switches like these sit in the valve body module and tell the module which clutch is applied; Sonnax describes them as normally closed film-and-piston switches. P0992 would be the code for an open or implausible circuit without a low/high split, as CARB requires circuit checks on transmission inputs. Range/performance, low, high and intermittent are P0993 to P0996.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner Kreisfehler eines sechsten Getriebedrucksensors oder -schalters mit dem Buchstaben F. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diesen Code, und ein Getriebe mit Schalter F war nicht zu finden. GMs Sechsgang-Getriebe enden bei TFP-Schalter 5 (Buchstabe E, P0989/P0990); Mitsubishis Sechsgang von 2019 überwacht seine Druckschalter an 2-6-Bremse, High-Kupplung und Low-Reverse-Bremse unter P0846, P0876 und P0988, also den Buchstaben B, D und E. Solche Schalter sitzen im Ventilblockmodul und melden, welche Kupplung geschlossen ist; Sonnax beschreibt sie als Öffner mit Folie und Kolben. P0992 stünde für einen offenen oder unplausiblen Kreis ohne Low/High-Trennung, wie ihn CARB bei Getriebe-Eingängen prüfen lässt. Plausibilität, Low, High und sporadisch sind P0993 bis P0996.

symptoms: Warning light depending on manufacturer calibration
Possible limp mode with a fixed gear

description: Pressure sensor or switch F is electrically intact, but its reading does not match what the module expects from the commanded clutch state. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The closest documented logic is GM's for switch E (TFP switch 5, 6T70/6T75): the module checks after each clutch release whether the switch returns to its exhausted state and counts failures, at 50 kPa or less commanded pressure for the low case. A sixth switch would be checked the same way, plausibility against commanded pressure and gear, which CARB requires for transmission inputs. Typical causes are sticking regulator valves, debris and worn switch films rather than wiring. P0992 is the plain circuit fault, P0994/P0995 are low and high.
possible_causes: Sticking clutch regulator valve feeding the switch [HIGH]
Worn or delaminated switch film, debris in the switch [MEDIUM]
Low or contaminated transmission fluid [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1800€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Transmission Fluid Pressure Sensor/Switch F Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: Pressure sensor or switch F is electrically intact, but its reading does not match what the module expects from the commanded clutch state. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. The closest documented logic is GM's for switch E (TFP switch 5, 6T70/6T75): the module checks after each clutch release whether the switch returns to its exhausted state and counts failures, at 50 kPa or less commanded pressure for the low case. A sixth switch would be checked the same way, plausibility against commanded pressure and gear, which CARB requires for transmission inputs. Typical causes are sticking regulator valves, debris and worn switch films rather than wiring. P0992 is the plain circuit fault, P0994/P0995 are low and high.
bilingual_description.de: Drucksensor oder -schalter F ist elektrisch in Ordnung, sein Wert passt aber nicht zu dem, was das Steuergerät aus dem befohlenen Kupplungszustand erwartet. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diesen Code. Am nächsten kommt GMs Logik für Schalter E (TFP-Schalter 5, 6T70/6T75): Nach jeder Kupplungsfreigabe prüft das Modul, ob der Schalter in die entlüftete Stellung zurückkehrt, und zählt Fehlversuche, im Low-Fall bei befohlenem Druck bis 50 kPa. Ein sechster Schalter würde ebenso geprüft – Plausibilität gegen befohlenen Druck und Gang, wie CARB es für Getriebe-Eingänge fordert. Ursache sind dann eher klemmende Regelventile, Schmutz oder verschlissene Schalterfolien als die Leitung. P0992 ist der reine Kreisfehler, P0994/P0995 sind Low und High.

description: The signal of pressure sensor or switch F stays low. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. With a normally closed switch as described by Sonnax for GM's valve body modules, low means the contacts stay closed, so the module sees no pressure where pressure should be, or the signal wire is shorted to ground. GM's equivalent for switch E, P0989, flags a low signal when commanded pressure is 50 kPa or less and handles it as Special No Trip without MIL; Saab's 9-4X text gives 0 V as the low state and 12 V as high. For an analogue sensor, low would mean a voltage below its valid range. CARB requires such out-of-range checks on transmission inputs. P0995 is the high counterpart.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Switch stuck closed by debris or damaged film [MEDIUM]
Clutch circuit not reaching pressure (valve or seal leak) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Bei einem Öffner, wie ihn Sonnax für GMs Ventilblockmodule beschreibt, heißt Low: Die Kontakte bleiben geschlossen, das Steuergerät sieht keinen Druck, wo Druck sein müsste, oder die Signalleitung hat Masseschluss. GMs Gegenstück für Schalter E, P0989, meldet ein Low-Signal bei befohlenem Druck bis 50 kPa und führt es als Special No Trip ohne MIL; der Saab-9-4X-Text nennt 0 V als Low und 12 V als High. description: The signal of pressure sensor or switch F stays high: with a normally closed switch the contacts stay open, which looks like permanent pressure, or the wire is open or shorted to voltage. No manufacturer documents this use publicly. Hyundai/Genesis bulletins 17-AT-001-G and 21-AT-016HG list P0995 in their subject lines, but their tables pair it with Auto Shift Manual Mode Circuit (SBC), and 21-AT-016HG prints the DTC as P095500; this is a misprint for P0955 and does not count as a use of P0995. GM's matching switch E code P0990 is a Special No Trip without MIL; Saab's 9-4X text treats an open and a short to voltage alike as high. CARB requires such checks on transmission inputs. P0994 is the low side.
possible_causes: Open signal wire or unplugged connector [HIGH]
Signal wire shorted to voltage [MEDIUM]
Switch stuck open inside the valve body module [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: The signal of pressure sensor or switch F stays high: with a normally closed switch the contacts stay open, which looks like permanent pressure, or the wire is open or shorted to voltage. No manufacturer documents this use publicly. Hyundai/Genesis bulletins 17-AT-001-G and 21-AT-016HG list P0995 in their subject lines, but their tables pair it with Auto Shift Manual Mode Circuit (SBC), and 21-AT-016HG prints the DTC as P095500; this is a misprint for P0955 and does not count as a use of P0995. GM's matching switch E code P0990 is a Special No Trip without MIL; Saab's 9-4X text treats an open and a short to voltage alike as high. CARB requires such checks on transmission inputs. P0994 is the low side.
bilingual_description.de: Das Signal von Drucksensor oder -schalter F bleibt auf High: Beim Öffner bleiben die Kontakte offen, was wie dauernder Druck aussieht, oder die Leitung ist unterbrochen bzw. hat Plusschluss. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller diese Verwendung. Die Hyundai/Genesis-Bulletins 17-AT-001-G und 21-AT-016HG nennen P0995 zwar in der Betreffzeile, ihre Tabellen ordnen ihn aber der Schaltung Auto Shift Manual Mode Circuit (SBC) zu, und 21-AT-016HG druckt den DTC als P095500 – ein Druckfehler für P0955, der nicht als Nutzung von P0995 zählt. GMs passender Schalter-E-Code P0990 ist Special No Trip ohne MIL; der Saab-9-4X-Text wertet Unterbrechung und Plusschluss gleichermaßen als High. CARB fordert solche Prüfungen für Getriebe-Eingänge. P0994 ist die Low-Seite.

description: The signal of pressure sensor or switch F drops out or flickers for short moments without staying low or high. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, and no transmission with a sixth pressure switch was found: GM's six-speeds end at switch 5 (E), Mitsubishi's 2019 six-speed uses letters B, D and E. Because such switches are thin film-and-piston units inside the valve body module, as Sonnax shows, debris or a delaminated film can make the contact chatter, and connector or harness faults do the same electrically. CARB requires transmission inputs to be checked for circuit faults; an intermittent code is the slot for faults too short to set P0994 or P0995. Expect occasional rough shifts, often without a warning light.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded connector contact [HIGH]
Debris or delaminated film making the switch chatter [MEDIUM]
Chafed harness shorting or opening under vibration [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The drive circuit of shift solenoid F works electrically but its measured current or voltage does not fit the command. No manufacturer was found to document this code. description: Low-voltage fault, typically a short to ground, in the control circuit of shift solenoid F. Two makers document it. Control wire shorted to ground in harness or connector [MEDIUM]
Transmission control module driver fault [LOW]

description: Open circuit or general circuit fault in the drive of shift solenoid G. It is a late addition to J2012: older code lists still show P09A0 to P09FF as reserved. description: General electrical fault on the second gate select position signal (circuit B) of an automated manual gearbox. The published designs from Isuzu (one select potentiometer) and Aisin AI (one select stroke sensor) show only a single sensor, so it is not documented whether B is a redundant second track of that sensor or a separate sensor. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. CARB requires circuit checks on such inputs. P09A4 and P09A5 are the more specific low and high faults of circuit B, P09A3 its plausibility fault; unlike circuit A (P0908) there is no intermittent variant. P0904 and P09A6 cover circuits A and C. Expect shifting to be restricted.
possible_causes: Loose, corroded or wet connector at the select sensor or actuator unit [HIGH]
Chafed or broken signal wire of circuit B near the gearbox [MEDIUM]
Faulty select sensor, often integrated in the shift and select actuator [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage for circuit B in the transmission control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Gearbox shifts slowly or locks out certain gears
Gearbox stays in one gear or neutral

description: Plausibility fault of gate select circuit B: the signal is electrically valid but does not match what the module expects. That could be the reading of circuit A, the learned gate positions, or the target gate the module has commanded, as in the Aisin AI select control that compares actual and target gate. Which comparison applies depends on whether B is a redundant track or a separate sensor, and no manufacturer publishes that or uses this code in citable material. CARB requires rationality checks on such inputs. P09A2, P09A4 and P09A5 are electrical faults of B, P0905 and P09A7 the same check on circuits A and C. A fallback mode with limited shifting is likely.
possible_causes: Worn or drifting select sensor, signal B no longer agrees with the reference [HIGH]
Gate positions not relearned after actuator, clutch or module replacement [MEDIUM]
Contact resistance at connector pins distorting signal B [MEDIUM]
Sluggish or worn select mechanism so the measured gate lags the commanded one [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Set when the gate select signal on circuit B stays below its lowest valid value for longer than a calibrated time. Likely causes are a signal line shorted to ground, a lost sensor supply or an internal sensor short; with potentiometer sensors like the select position sensor in an Isuzu patent, an open signal wire often reads low too. No manufacturer documents this code publicly, nor whether B is a second track or another sensor. CARB requires out-of-range checks on such inputs. P09A5 is the opposite fault, P09A2 the general circuit fault, P0906 and P09A8 the low faults of circuits A and C. If A and B are both low, look for a shared supply or ground.

Sensor reference supply interrupted or shorted [MEDIUM]
Internal short or broken wiper in the select sensor [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage in the transmission control module [LOW]

description: Indicates that the gate select signal on circuit B has stayed above its highest valid value for longer than allowed. description: General circuit fault on temperature sensor A in the separate coolant loop that cools the inverter and other drive electronics of a hybrid or electric vehicle. The module flags it when the sensor signal cannot be used at all, without a more specific low, high or plausibility verdict; those cases have their own codes P0A01 to P0A04. GM's Two-Mode hybrid trucks monitor the same sensor only through P0A01 to P0A03, and CARB requires every input of the inverter thermal management to be checked for circuit faults. Without a valid reading the control unit usually limits electric drive power to protect the electronics.

CARB verlangt, alle Eingänge der Wechselrichter-Temperierung auf Kreisfehler zu prüfen. Ohne gültigen Messwert drosselt das Steuergerät meist die elektrische Antriebsleistung, um die Elektronik zu schützen.

description: The sensor delivers a value inside its electrical range, but it does not fit the other temperatures in the vehicle. A failure is a Type B code with MIL after two trips. Nissan describes a similar comparison between inverter coolant and power element temperatures. Hard electrical faults are P0A02 and P0A03.

Fault actually in the engine coolant or intake air sensor used for comparison [LOW]

Electronics temperature shown far below ambient

description: The temperature signal from the drive electronics coolant loop jumps or drops out for short moments, then returns to normal. Coolant temperature changes slowly, so a sudden step that the physics cannot explain points to a loose contact rather than a real temperature change. No manufacturer documents P0A04 publicly. GM's Two-Mode hybrids check the same sensor only for steady faults (P0A01 to P0A03), and a Nissan patent shows how an inverter coolant sensor is compared with the power element temperature to catch implausible readings. CARB requires such inverter cooling inputs to be monitored. The driver may see a warning light that comes and goes, with occasional power reduction.
possible_causes: Loose or fretting terminal at the sensor or module connector [HIGH]
Partly broken wire that opens under vibration or heat [MEDIUM]
Sensor with an internal intermittent contact [LOW]

symptoms: Warning light that appears and disappears

description: The electric pump that circulates coolant through the inverter, converter and drive motor loop is driven by a control line from the hybrid module. P0A05 means that line shows an open circuit or a fault the driver cannot classify further. No manufacturer documents P0A05 publicly. GM's Chevrolet Volt tables cover the same pump under P0CE9, set when the control line is open or shorted in 16 of 20 samples at 250 ms, Type B with MIL after two trips. CARB requires inverter cooling outputs to be checked, and Toyota patents describe how pump faults are told apart from other cooling faults. Low and high faults are P0A06 and P0A07; pump B is P0B38. Without circulation the electronics heat up quickly and power is cut.
possible_causes: Pump connector loose or corroded, often from road splash at the low-mounted pump [HIGH]
Broken control wire between module and pump [MEDIUM]
Failed electronics or open winding inside the pump [MEDIUM]
Blown pump fuse or missing supply, so the control input sees no load [LOW]

description: The control line of pump A in the drive electronics coolant loop sits at a voltage below what the module expects for the commanded state, usually because the line or the pump input is shorted to ground. Depending on the driver design, the pump then runs uncontrolled or not at all. No manufacturer documents P0A06 publicly; GM's Volt reports a short of the comparable pump control line under P0CE9 (16 of 20 samples at 250 ms, Type B). A failing pump soon leads to power reduction.

Internal short at the pump's control input [MEDIUM]
Water or coolant in the pump connector [MEDIUM]

description: The module measures a voltage on the pump A control line that is higher than the commanded state allows, typically because the line touches a supply wire or the pump input has failed internally. symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine light
Pump running all the time, even with the vehicle off
Possible power limitation if cooling cannot be confirmed

description: General fault on the status line through which the DC/DC converter reports its condition to the hybrid control module. The converter replaces the alternator: it steps the traction battery voltage down to charge the 12 V battery. When its self-diagnosis detects an internal problem it signals this back, and the controller reacts. P0A08 is the broad verdict for an unusable or implausible status signal; a signal stuck low or high has its own codes P0A09 and P0A10. No manufacturer documents P0A08 publicly in an official source. Toyota's Prius c recall shows the consequence of a dead converter: warning lights, then a draining 12 V battery that can shut the hybrid system down. Drivers should not keep driving for long.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Inverter/converter assembly failure, Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Internal fault in the DC/DC converter reported by its self-diagnosis [HIGH]
Damaged or corroded status line or connector between converter and hybrid control module [MEDIUM]
Converter overheating due to a fault in the inverter/converter coolant loop [LOW]
Faulty input stage in the hybrid control module [LOW]

Der Wandler übernimmt die Rolle der Lichtmaschine und setzt die Spannung der Fahrbatterie auf das 12-V-Bordnetz herunter. Erkennt seine Eigendiagnose ein internes Problem, meldet er das zurück. symptoms: Hybrid system, battery or master warning light on
12 V battery is no longer charged and voltage drops while driving
Electrical consumers fail and the hybrid system may finally shut down

description: The status signal that the DC/DC converter sends to the hybrid control module stays below its expected range, typically from a short to ground, an open line read as low, or a converter that pulls its status output down because of an internal fault. Mitsubishi uses P0A09 on the 2012-2013 i-MiEV for a DC-DC converter fault; its bulletins tie it to a failed on-board charger that blows the high-voltage fuse feeding the converter, after which the 12 V battery and drive battery stop charging. That usage predates the current split into P0A08, P0A09 and P0A10. Siblings: P0A08 covers the general circuit fault, P0A10 a signal stuck high. Expect warning lights and a 12 V battery that slowly runs flat.
possible_causes: Blown high-voltage fuse feeding the converter, e.g. after an on-board charger failure (Mitsubishi i-MiEV) [HIGH]
DC/DC converter internal fault pulling the status output low [MEDIUM]
Status line shorted to ground or chafed harness [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage in the hybrid/EV control module [LOW]

description: The high-voltage interlock loop (HVIL) is a low-voltage signal loop routed through every HV connector, the service disconnect and component covers. If it opens, the control module opens the main contactors so no one can touch live parts. P0A0A is the general circuit fault on loop A. Stellantis sets P0A0A-00 on the Jeep Wrangler and Grand Cherokee 4xe when an HV connector is torqued but not fully seated after repair, and on the 2024-2025 Pacifica Hybrid it was traced to battery pack control module software; there the car will not start on either power source. Mercedes logs P0A0A00 in the DC converter of model line 243. CARB counts the HVIL as a safety-only system, so MIL behaviour varies. Low, high, performance and intermittent faults use P0A0B to P0A0E.
possible_causes: HV connector or service disconnect not fully seated after repair [HIGH]
Spread, bent or corroded interlock pins or damaged connector seals [MEDIUM]
Interlock wiring chafed or cut [MEDIUM]
Battery pack control module software fault (Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid 2024-2025) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.4h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Öffnet sie sich, trennt das Steuergerät die Hauptschütze, damit niemand spannungsführende Teile berührt. P0A0A ist der allgemeine Kreisfehler der Schleife A. Für niedrig, hoch, Funktion und sporadisch gibt es P0A0B bis P0A0E.

symptoms: Vehicle will not start or go into ready mode
Check engine and hybrid system warning on
High-voltage system switched off while the 12 V system still works

description: The interlock loop A responds electrically, but its behaviour does not match what the module expects – for example a loop resistance outside the window, a signal that does not follow the commanded test pattern, or two modules on the same loop disagreeing. Improperly connected HV connector or bent interlock pins on an HV component [MEDIUM]
Twisted or chafed interlock harness rubbing on the body [MEDIUM]
Faulty interlock driver or receiver in a control module [LOW]
