symptoms: High-voltage system warning in the instrument cluster
Several modules store interlock codes at the same time

description: The voltage sensed on interlock loop A is too low while the module drives the loop – typically an opened loop or a short to ground. GM documents it codegenau: in its 2016 HPC2 table P0A0C sets when the sensed interlock voltage stays below 30 % of the 5 V test signal in 2 of 2 samples (12.5 ms each) with the 12 V supply above 10.2 V; it is Type A, so the MIL lights after one trip. The 2011 Volt tables used a 10 % threshold. Mercedes-Benz model line 243 stores P0A0C00 in the DC converter and on-board charger as a short to ground in the interlock circuit. The opposite fault is P0A0D. Since the loop guards against live HV parts, the system drops the contactors and the car will not drive on electric power.
possible_causes: HV connector, cover or service disconnect open, interrupting the loop [HIGH]
Interlock wire shorted to ground, e.g. chafed at a module or the body [MEDIUM]
Corroded or pushed-back interlock pins [MEDIUM]
Faulty interlock source or sense stage in the battery or hybrid module [LOW]

GM dokumentiert den Code genau: Laut HPC2-Tabelle 2016 setzt P0A0C, wenn die Rückspannung in 2 von 2 Messungen (je 12,5 ms) unter 30 % des 5-V-Prüfsignals bleibt und das 12-V-Netz über 10,2 V liegt; Typ A, also MIL nach einer Fahrt. symptoms: Check engine light (GM Type A) and hybrid/EV warning
No ready mode, electric drive unavailable

description: The voltage sensed on interlock loop A is higher than expected – most often a short to a voltage source, or the loop not being pulled down when the module expects it. GM checks both states: in the 2016 HPC2 table P0A0D sets when the sensed voltage exceeds 24 % of 5 V with the source switched off (5 of 8 samples) or 44 % with it switched on (4 of 6 samples), Type A with MIL after one trip. Mercedes model line 243 stores P0A0D00 in the battery management as a short to positive. P0A0C is the low-side counterpart; both leave the HV system switched off.

specific_definitions.AUDI: High voltage safety device failure, Inverter/converter assembly failure, Power management control module failure, Service disconnect plug is not properly connected, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Service/safety plug not fully inserted or with poor contact (Hyundai Sonata Hybrid) [HIGH]
Interlock wire shorted to a 12 V or reference voltage [MEDIUM]
Damaged interlock harness or connector after body or battery work [MEDIUM]
Faulty interlock stage in the battery or hybrid control module [LOW]

symptoms: No ready mode or ready light blinking
Check engine and charging warning lights on

description: The interlock loop A signal drops out or jumps for short moments and then recovers, so the module sees an unstable loop rather than a lasting open or short. Typical are connectors with loose or spread contacts, harness sections that move with the body or drivetrain, and moisture in seals. No manufacturer documents P0A0E publicly; the GM tables only list P0A0C and P0A0D for the same loop. Reference designs and patents on interlock monitoring describe the loop as a current or voltage path through each HV connector and point out that contact resistance and interference can cause brief false trips. CARB treats the HVIL as a safety-only system. For the driver this means sudden HV shutdowns or no-starts that come and go; static faults use P0A0A to P0A0D.
possible_causes: Loose or spread interlock contacts in an HV or low-voltage connector [HIGH]
Harness section with a broken strand that opens under vibration [MEDIUM]
Moisture entering through a damaged connector seal [MEDIUM]
Electrical interference on the interlock line or a weak module input [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Das Signal der Interlock-Schleife A bricht kurzzeitig ein oder springt und erholt sich wieder; das Steuergerät sieht also eine unruhige Schleife statt einer dauerhaften Unterbrechung oder eines Kurzschlusses. Typisch sind lockere oder aufgeweitete Steckkontakte, Kabelabschnitte, die sich mit Karosserie oder Antrieb bewegen, und Feuchtigkeit in Dichtungen. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A0E; GM führt für dieselbe Schleife nur P0A0C und P0A0D. Referenzdesigns und Patente beschreiben die Schleife als Strom- oder Spannungspfad durch jeden HV-Stecker und nennen Übergangswiderstände und Störungen als Grund kurzer Fehlauslösungen. CARB zählt die HVIL zu den reinen Sicherheitssystemen. Für den Fahrer: wiederkehrende HV-Abschaltungen oder Startverweigerungen; dauerhafte Fehler laufen unter P0A0A bis P0A0D.

symptoms: Hybrid/EV warning that appears and disappears
Occasional loss of ready mode or sudden shutdown of electric drive
Intermittent no-start, often after rough roads or rain

description: The control module commanded an engine start – by the hybrid system or an automatic start/stop restart – but the combustion engine did not reach a self-sustaining run within the allowed attempts. The code describes the result, not the cause. Toyota sets P0A0F with MIL on the 2010-2013 Prius and Prius v when a separated purge VSV/PCV hose leans out the mixture, often with P3190, P3191 and P0171. Kia traced P0A0F on the 2017-2018 Niro hybrid to an A/C pressure sensor harness chafed by an idler pulley, which disturbs the engine ECU 5 V reference. Audi sets P0A0F00 on 2019 A6/A7 3.0 mild hybrids after the second failed automatic restart, with a drive system warning. Look at fuel, air, ignition and engine sensor faults first.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Hybrid transaxle assembly failure, Internal engine failure, Power management control module failure

possible_causes: Vacuum leak, e.g. separated purge VSV/PCV hose at the throttle body (Toyota Prius) [HIGH]
Shorted sensor harness pulling down the engine ECU 5 V reference (Kia Niro) [MEDIUM]
Fuel delivery or ignition fault preventing combustion [MEDIUM]
Failed automatic restart of a mild hybrid with a cold engine (Audi A6/A7 2019) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Check engine light and hybrid or drive system warning
Engine does not start, or runs briefly and stops
Reduced power because the vehicle runs on the battery only

description: The status signal from the DC/DC converter to the hybrid control module sits above its valid range, typically because the line is shorted to a voltage source, its ground or pull-down path is open, or the converter drives the output high after an internal failure. The converter supplies the 12 V system from the traction battery, and its self-diagnosis reports problems over this status path. No manufacturer documents P0A10 publicly in an official source; older lists that call it a hybrid battery voltage sense circuit are wrong for today's J2012. Siblings: P0A08 is the general status fault, P0A09 the low signal. A converter that stops working shows up as warning lights and a falling 12 V voltage until the hybrid system shuts down.
possible_causes: Status line shorted to 12 V or another supply [MEDIUM]
Open ground or signal return at the converter connector [MEDIUM]
DC/DC converter internal fault driving the status output high [MEDIUM]
Faulty input stage in the hybrid control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1800€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: DC/DC Converter Status Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The status signal from the DC/DC converter to the hybrid control module sits above its valid range, typically because the line is shorted to a voltage source, its ground or pull-down path is open, or the converter drives the output high after an internal failure. The converter supplies the 12 V system from the traction battery, and its self-diagnosis reports problems over this status path. No manufacturer documents P0A10 publicly in an official source; older lists that call it a hybrid battery voltage sense circuit are wrong for today's J2012. Siblings: P0A08 is the general status fault, P0A09 the low signal. A converter that stops working shows up as warning lights and a falling 12 V voltage until the hybrid system shuts down.
bilingual_description.de: Das Statussignal vom DC/DC-Wandler zum Hybridsteuergerät liegt oberhalb des gültigen Bereichs – typisch durch Schluss nach Spannung, eine unterbrochene Masse bzw. Pull-down-Verbindung oder einen Wandler, der den Ausgang nach einem internen Defekt hochzieht. Der Wandler versorgt das 12-V-Bordnetz aus der Fahrbatterie, seine Eigendiagnose meldet Probleme über diese Statusleitung. In offiziellen Quellen dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A10 öffentlich; ältere Listen, die den Code als Spannungserfassung der Hybridbatterie führen, passen nicht zur heutigen J2012. P0A08 ist der allgemeine Statusfehler, P0A09 das zu niedrige Signal. Fällt der Wandler aus, folgen Warnleuchten und eine sinkende 12-V-Spannung, bis das Hybridsystem abschaltet.

symptoms: Hybrid system or battery warning light on
12 V battery voltage falls while driving
Possible shutdown of the hybrid system if the 12 V battery runs flat

description: General or open-circuit fault on the enable line with which the hybrid or battery control module tells the DC/DC converter that it may deliver power to the 12 V system. In typical designs a high enable level permits converter output, and a CAN message carries the same permission in parallel, so the two can be cross-checked. If the line is open, the converter cannot be switched on reliably and the 12 V battery is no longer charged. No manufacturer documents P0A11 publicly in an official source; Honda's hybrid recall shows what follows when the converter shuts down: charging warning, discharged 12 V battery, possible loss of drive. Low and high faults on the same line are P0A12 and P0A13; status line faults are P0A08 to P0A10.
possible_causes: Broken enable wire or unplugged connector between control module and converter [HIGH]
Corroded or pushed-out terminal at the converter enable pin [MEDIUM]
Faulty enable output driver in the control module [LOW]
Faulty enable input inside the DC/DC converter [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: DC/DC Converter Enable Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: General or open-circuit fault on the enable line with which the hybrid or battery control module tells the DC/DC converter that it may deliver power to the 12 V system. In typical designs a high enable level permits converter output, and a CAN message carries the same permission in parallel, so the two can be cross-checked. If the line is open, the converter cannot be switched on reliably and the 12 V battery is no longer charged. No manufacturer documents P0A11 publicly in an official source; Honda's hybrid recall shows what follows when the converter shuts down: charging warning, discharged 12 V battery, possible loss of drive. Low and high faults on the same line are P0A12 and P0A13; status line faults are P0A08 to P0A10.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner bzw. Unterbrechungsfehler an der Freigabeleitung, mit der das Hybrid- oder Batteriesteuergerät dem DC/DC-Wandler erlaubt, das 12-V-Netz zu versorgen. In üblichen Auslegungen gibt ein hoher Pegel die Wandlerleistung frei, parallel überträgt eine CAN-Botschaft dieselbe Erlaubnis – beides lässt sich gegeneinander prüfen. Ist die Leitung offen, lässt sich der Wandler nicht sicher einschalten, und die 12-V-Batterie wird nicht mehr geladen. In offiziellen Quellen dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A11 öffentlich; Hondas Hybrid-Rückruf zeigt, was folgt, wenn der Wandler abschaltet: Ladewarnung, leere 12-V-Batterie, möglicher Antriebsverlust. Niedrig und hoch auf derselben Leitung sind P0A12 und P0A13, Fehler der Statusleitung P0A08 bis P0A10.

symptoms: Battery or charging warning light on
12 V battery is not charged and runs down
Vehicle may lose motive power after a while

description: The enable line to the DC/DC converter reads low when the control module is commanding it on. Because a low enable level usually means converter output is not permitted, the converter stays off and the 12 V system loses its charging source. Typical causes are a short to ground on the enable wire, a weak output driver in the module, or an input stage in the converter that loads the line. Older lists name this code DC/DC converter communication; today's J2012 wording is enable circuit low. No manufacturer documents P0A12 publicly in an official source, so the description rests on CARB and on patent descriptions of hard-wired enable lines. P0A11 covers an open line, P0A13 a line stuck high. Drivers see a charging warning and a draining 12 V battery.
possible_causes: Enable wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Weak or failed enable output driver in the control module [MEDIUM]
Converter enable input internally shorted [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

No manufacturer documents P0A12 publicly in an official source, so the description rests on CARB and on patent descriptions of hard-wired enable lines. P0A11 covers an open line, P0A13 a line stuck high. Drivers see a charging warning and a draining 12 V battery.
bilingual_description.de: Die Freigabeleitung zum DC/DC-Wandler zeigt einen niedrigen Pegel, obwohl das Steuergerät den Wandler einschalten will. Da ein niedriger Freigabepegel in der Regel „keine Leistung erlaubt“ bedeutet, bleibt der Wandler aus, und dem 12-V-Netz fehlt die Ladequelle. Typisch sind Masseschluss der Freigabeleitung, eine schwache Endstufe im Steuergerät oder ein Wandlereingang, der die Leitung belastet. Ältere Listen nennen den Code „DC/DC-Wandler Kommunikation“; der heutige J2012-Wortlaut lautet Freigabeleitung niedrig. In offiziellen Quellen dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A12 öffentlich; die Beschreibung stützt sich auf CARB und Patentbeschreibungen fest verdrahteter Freigabeleitungen. P0A11 ist die Unterbrechung, P0A13 die zu hohe Leitung. Für den Fahrer: Ladewarnung und eine sich leerende 12-V-Batterie.

symptoms: Charging or battery warning light on
12 V voltage drops, electrical consumers misbehave
Hybrid system may shut down when the 12 V battery is flat

description: The enable line to the DC/DC converter reads high when the control module expects it low, for example while the converter should be switched off. The usual reasons are a short to battery voltage on the enable wire, a stuck output driver, or a missing pull-down. Since a high enable level normally permits converter output, the converter may keep running when it should not – during shutdown, a fault or high-voltage disconnection – which the module treats as a safety and battery-drain risk. No manufacturer documents P0A13 publicly in an official source; the explanation relies on CARB and on patents describing hard-wired DC/DC enable lines cross-checked against a CAN request. P0A11 is the open line, P0A12 the low fault; status-side faults are P0A08 to P0A10.
possible_causes: Enable wire shorted to 12 V or another supply [HIGH]
Enable output driver in the control module stuck on [MEDIUM]
Open pull-down or ground reference at the converter input [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: DC/DC Converter Enable Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The enable line to the DC/DC converter reads high when the control module expects it low, for example while the converter should be switched off. The usual reasons are a short to battery voltage on the enable wire, a stuck output driver, or a missing pull-down. P0A11 is the open line, P0A12 the low fault; status-side faults are P0A08 to P0A10.
bilingual_description.de: Die Freigabeleitung zum DC/DC-Wandler zeigt einen hohen Pegel, obwohl das Steuergerät einen niedrigen erwartet, etwa wenn der Wandler aus sein soll. Üblich sind Schluss nach Batteriespannung, eine hängende Endstufe oder ein fehlender Pull-down. Da ein hoher Freigabepegel normalerweise Wandlerleistung erlaubt, kann der Wandler weiterlaufen, wenn er es nicht soll – beim Abschalten, bei einem Fehler oder bei getrenntem Hochvoltnetz. Das Steuergerät wertet das als Sicherheits- und Entladerisiko. In offiziellen Quellen dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A13 öffentlich; die Erklärung stützt sich auf CARB und auf Patente zu fest verdrahteten Freigabeleitungen, die mit einer CAN-Anforderung abgeglichen werden. P0A11 ist die Unterbrechung, P0A12 der zu niedrige Pegel; Fehler der Statusseite sind P0A08 bis P0A10.

symptoms: Hybrid system or battery warning light on
12 V battery drains while the vehicle is parked
Converter-related functions disabled as a precaution

description: Some vehicles use switchable or active engine mounts that the powertrain or a mount control unit changes between soft and firm, or drives with an actuator against vibration. P0A14 reports an open or undefined fault in the control circuit of mount A. Ford lists it in its 2020 to 2023 gasoline OBD summary as the active mount circuit check: the low-side driver reports the fault and it matures after about 5 seconds; mount B uses P0AB6 to P0AB8. Honda's active control engine mounts, for example on the 2008 Pilot V6, use P0A14 for the front mount actuator and P0AB6 for the rear. P0A15 and P0A16 cover low and high faults. The car stays drivable, but vibration may increase.
possible_causes: Mount actuator connector loose, corroded or unplugged after engine work [HIGH]
Open coil in the mount actuator or switching solenoid [MEDIUM]
Wire broken where the harness flexes with engine movement [MEDIUM]
Fault in the engine or mount control unit output [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Manche Fahrzeuge haben schaltbare oder aktive Motorlager, die das Motor- oder ein eigenes Lagersteuergerät zwischen weich und hart umschaltet oder per Aktuator gegen Schwingungen ansteuert. P0A14 meldet eine Unterbrechung oder einen unbestimmten Fehler im Steuerkreis von Lager A. Ford führt den Code in der OBD-Übersicht Benzin 2020–2023 als Kreisprüfung der aktiven Lager: Die Low-Side-Endstufe meldet den Fehler, er reift nach etwa 5 Sekunden; Lager B nutzt P0AB6 bis P0AB8. Hondas aktive Motorlager, etwa im Pilot V6 von 2008, verwenden P0A14 für den Aktuator des vorderen und P0AB6 für den des hinteren Lagers. P0A15 und P0A16 decken zu niedrig und zu hoch ab. Das Auto bleibt fahrbar, vibriert aber unter Umständen stärker.

symptoms: More vibration at idle or during cylinder deactivation
Shudder that feels like a torque converter problem

description: The control circuit of switchable or active engine mount A shows a voltage or current below the expected level, which usually points to a short to ground on the line or inside the actuator. Ford uses P0A15 in its 2020 to 2023 gasoline OBD summary for the active mounts: the low-level driver reports the fault and the PCM matures it after about 5 seconds; the partner mount B has P0AB7. Honda's active control engine mount system on the 2008 Pilot V6 assigns P0A15 to the front mount actuator and P0AB7 to the rear. Ford engineers describe these mounts as switched between a damping and a stiffening mode, so a stuck mount is felt as vibration. The open circuit is P0A14, the high fault P0A16.
possible_causes: Control wire chafed on the engine or subframe and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Shorted coil in the mount actuator or solenoid, often after fluid leakage [MEDIUM]
Moisture in the mount connector [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.en: The control circuit of switchable or active engine mount A shows a voltage or current below the expected level, which usually points to a short to ground on the line or inside the actuator. bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis des schaltbaren oder aktiven Motorlagers A zeigt Spannung oder Strom unterhalb der Erwartung, meist wegen eines Masseschlusses in der Leitung oder im Aktuator. Ford verwendet P0A15 in der OBD-Übersicht Benzin 2020–2023 für die aktiven Lager: Die Endstufe meldet den Fehler, das Motorsteuergerät bestätigt ihn nach etwa 5 Sekunden; das Partnerlager B hat P0AB7. Hondas System aktiver Motorlager im Pilot V6 von 2008 ordnet P0A15 dem Aktuator des vorderen und P0AB7 dem des hinteren Lagers zu. Ford-Entwickler beschreiben solche Lager als umschaltbar zwischen dämpfend und versteifend – ein hängendes Lager spürt man daher als Vibration. Die Unterbrechung ist P0A14, der Fehler zu hoch P0A16.

symptoms: Noticeable vibration at idle or low speed

description: The module sees a higher voltage on the control circuit of engine mount A than it should for the commanded state, usually a short to a supply line or a failed actuator input. The mount can then no longer be switched or driven as intended. Ford lists P0A16 in its 2020 to 2023 gasoline OBD summary under the active mount circuit check, matured after about 5 seconds once the driver reports the fault; mount B uses P0AB8. On Honda's active control engine mounts, such as the 2008 Pilot V6, P0A16 belongs to the front mount actuator and P0AB8 to the rear one. A Ford patent shows the mounts are toggled between soft and firm, so a fault means either harsh idle or more movement. See P0A14 and P0A15.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to a battery or ignition supply [HIGH]
Mount actuator or solenoid failed with an open low side [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the engine or mount control unit damaged [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Mount A Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The module sees a higher voltage on the control circuit of engine mount A than it should for the commanded state, usually a short to a supply line or a failed actuator input. The mount can then no longer be switched or driven as intended. Ford lists P0A16 in its 2020 to 2023 gasoline OBD summary under the active mount circuit check, matured after about 5 seconds once the driver reports the fault; mount B uses P0AB8. On Honda's active control engine mounts, such as the 2008 Pilot V6, P0A16 belongs to the front mount actuator and P0AB8 to the rear one. A Ford patent shows the mounts are toggled between soft and firm, so a fault means either harsh idle or more movement. See P0A14 and P0A15.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät sieht im Steuerkreis des Motorlagers A eine höhere Spannung, als der befohlene Zustand erlaubt – meist ein Schluss nach Plus oder ein defekter Aktuatoreingang. Das Lager lässt sich dann nicht mehr wie vorgesehen schalten oder ansteuern. Ford führt P0A16 in der OBD-Übersicht Benzin 2020–2023 bei der Kreisprüfung der aktiven Lager, bestätigt nach etwa 5 Sekunden, sobald die Endstufe den Fehler meldet; Lager B nutzt P0AB8. Bei Hondas aktiven Motorlagern, etwa im Pilot V6 von 2008, gehört P0A16 zum Aktuator des vorderen und P0AB8 zu dem des hinteren Lagers. Ein Ford-Patent zeigt das Umschalten zwischen weich und hart; ein Fehler bedeutet also rauen Leerlauf oder mehr Motorbewegung. Siehe auch P0A14 und P0A15.

symptoms: Harsh idle or more engine movement on take-off

description: Some electric drive units measure the torque on the motor or generator shaft directly, for example with a magnetostrictive sensor inside a hollow motor shaft as described in Honda patents for hybrid drive systems. The control unit uses that value to check the torque it commands. P0A17 is the general circuit fault of this sensor, set when the signal is missing or cannot be evaluated at all. No manufacturer documents P0A17 publicly. CARB requires a monitoring plan for drive motor faults that affect propulsion or emission strategies, which covers such feedback sensors. Plausibility is P0A18, low and high P0A19 and P0A20, intermittent P0A21. Expect reduced electric power and a hybrid warning.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded sensor connector at the drive unit [HIGH]
Damaged sensor wiring between drive unit and control module [MEDIUM]
Torque sensor or its excitation electronics failed, often only replaceable with the drive unit [MEDIUM]
Input stage of the hybrid or motor control module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Motor Torque Sensor Circuit

bilingual_description.en: Some electric drive units measure the torque on the motor or generator shaft directly, for example with a magnetostrictive sensor inside a hollow motor shaft as described in Honda patents for hybrid drive systems. The control unit uses that value to check the torque it commands. P0A17 is the general circuit fault of this sensor, set when the signal is missing or cannot be evaluated at all. No manufacturer documents P0A17 publicly. CARB requires a monitoring plan for drive motor faults that affect propulsion or emission strategies, which covers such feedback sensors. Plausibility is P0A18, low and high P0A19 and P0A20, intermittent P0A21. Expect reduced electric power and a hybrid warning.
bilingual_description.de: Manche elektrischen Antriebe messen das Drehmoment an der Motor- oder Generatorwelle direkt, etwa mit einem magnetostriktiven Sensor in einer hohlen Motorwelle, wie ihn Honda-Patente für Hybridantriebe beschreiben. Das Steuergerät prüft damit das befohlene Moment. P0A17 ist der allgemeine Kreisfehler dieses Sensors: Das Signal fehlt oder lässt sich gar nicht auswerten. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A17. CARB verlangt einen Überwachungsplan für Antriebsmotorfehler, die den Vortrieb oder Emissionsstrategien beeinträchtigen, und damit auch für solche Rückmeldesensoren. Plausibilität ist P0A18, zu niedrig und zu hoch sind P0A19 und P0A20, sporadisch P0A21. Für den Fahrer: weniger elektrische Leistung und eine Hybridwarnung.

symptoms: Electric drive power limited or electric drive disabled
Higher fuel consumption because the engine runs more often

description: The motor torque sensor delivers an electrically valid signal, but the torque it reports does not match what the control unit expects from the commanded motor current, speed and operating state. Typical checks compare measured and estimated torque or look for an offset when no torque is applied. Honda patents show such a sensor mounted inside the hollow output shaft of a traction motor, where electromagnetic noise is a known accuracy issue. No manufacturer documents P0A18 publicly. CARB requires approved monitoring of drive motor faults that impair propulsion. P0A17 is the plain circuit fault; P0A19 and P0A20 are out of range low and high. The drive system usually limits electric torque.
possible_causes: Sensor offset or gain drifted, reading off against the torque model [HIGH]
Electrical interference on the signal from damaged shielding or ground [MEDIUM]
Missing or outdated calibration after module or drive unit replacement [MEDIUM]
Mechanical fault in the drive unit that changes the real torque [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Typical checks compare measured and estimated torque or look for an offset when no torque is applied. Honda patents show such a sensor mounted inside the hollow output shaft of a traction motor, where electromagnetic noise is a known accuracy issue. No manufacturer documents P0A18 publicly. CARB requires approved monitoring of drive motor faults that impair propulsion. P0A17 is the plain circuit fault; P0A19 and P0A20 are out of range low and high. The drive system usually limits electric torque.
bilingual_description.de: Der Drehmomentsensor des Antriebsmotors liefert ein elektrisch gültiges Signal, doch das gemeldete Moment passt nicht zu dem, was das Steuergerät aus befohlenem Motorstrom, Drehzahl und Betriebszustand erwartet. Übliche Prüfungen vergleichen gemessenes und geschätztes Moment oder suchen einen Versatz, wenn kein Moment anliegt. Honda-Patente zeigen einen solchen Sensor in der hohlen Abtriebswelle eines Fahrmotors, wo elektromagnetische Störungen die Genauigkeit bekanntermaßen beeinträchtigen. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0A18. CARB verlangt eine genehmigte Überwachung von Antriebsmotorfehlern, die den Vortrieb beeinträchtigen. P0A17 ist der reine Kreisfehler, P0A19 und P0A20 sind zu niedrig und zu hoch. Meist begrenzt das System das elektrische Moment.

symptoms: Engine runs more often, fuel use rises

description: The control unit watches the voltage of a torque sensor that measures load directly on the traction motor shaft, such as the magnetostrictive sensor in a hollow motor shaft shown in a Honda patent. P0A19 sets when the signal stays below its valid window for a calibrated time, typical of a short to ground, a broken supply or an open signal line pulled low. No manufacturer documents P0A19 publicly; CARB only requires an approved drive motor monitoring plan. P0A20 is the opposite fault, P0A18 a plausible voltage with wrong torque, P0A21 dropouts. The driver usually sees a hybrid warning and reduced electric drive power.
possible_causes: Sensor signal or supply line shorted to ground [HIGH]
Sensor reference or excitation supply missing [MEDIUM]
Corroded or loose connector at the drive unit [MEDIUM]
Torque sensor electronics failed, often replaced with the drive unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Überwacht wird die Signalspannung eines Sensors, der das Moment direkt an der Welle des Fahrmotors erfasst – etwa ein magnetostriktiver Sensor in einer hohlen Motorwelle, wie ihn ein Honda-Patent beschreibt. P0A19 entsteht, wenn das Signal für eine kalibrierte Zeit unter dem gültigen Fenster bleibt; typisch sind Masseschluss, fehlende Versorgung oder eine unterbrochene, nach unten gezogene Signalleitung. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A19 öffentlich, CARB fordert lediglich einen genehmigten Überwachungsplan für den Antriebsmotor. Gegenstück ist P0A20, P0A18 meldet ein unplausibles Moment, P0A21 Aussetzer. Im Alltag: Hybridwarnung und gedrosselter E-Antrieb.

symptoms: Reduced electric drive power or electric drive disabled
Engine runs more often, higher fuel consumption

description: P0A1A reports a fault of the electronics that control the generator, either inside a hybrid inverter or in a belt starter-generator. Toyota lists P0A1A for the 2010-2015 Prius and 2012-2017 Prius V together with P0A94, P324E and P3004 as a malfunction inside the inverter assembly with converter; the repair can mean replacing the MG ECU, IPM transistors or the whole inverter. Audi stores P0A1A00 in the engine control unit of 2025 models with a Valeo 48 V starter-generator, paired with a 48 V system fault, and blames starter-generator software. CARB requires monitoring of the generator system. Effects range from a MIL to lost charging or no hybrid drive.
possible_causes: Internal failure of the inverter or generator control electronics [HIGH]
Control software fault, fixed by an update where the maker provides one [MEDIUM]
Supply, ground or bus connection to the module faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A1A meldet einen Fehler der Elektronik, die den Generator steuert – entweder im Hybrid-Inverter oder im riemengetriebenen Starter-Generator. Toyota nennt P0A1A beim Prius 2010–2015 und Prius V 2012–2017 zusammen mit P0A94, P324E und P3004 als Defekt in der Inverterbaugruppe mit Wandler; repariert wird je nach Befund durch Tausch von MG-Steuergerät, IPM-Transistoren oder Inverter. Audi legt P0A1A00 bei Modellen 2025 mit Valeo-48-V-Starter-Generator im Motorsteuergerät ab, gepaart mit einem 48-V-Bordnetzfehler, Ursache dort ist Software. CARB verlangt eine Überwachung des Generatorsystems. Folgen reichen von der MIL bis zu fehlender Ladung oder Hybridausfall.

symptoms: MIL and hybrid or charging warning on
Battery no longer charged, start-stop or hybrid drive unavailable
Vehicle may not reach ready state

description: P0A1B flags a self-test failure of the processor that controls drive motor A, usually inside the inverter. In GM hybrid tables (2016) it sets when the processor fails an inhibit path test at power-down, three or more times, proving it could not take the system to a safe state; in 2011 tables internal SPI, RAM or cache faults in 28 of 32 samples count. Both are Type A, MIL on the first trip. Land Rover sets P0A1B in the inverter of 2024-25 PHEVs at start-up, VW lists P0A1B00 for the ID.4 front drive. Toyota uses subtype P0A1B-1F on the 2023-24 Corolla Hybrid. Drive motor B is P0A1C. Expect a red loss-of-drive warning.
possible_causes: Control software fault, several makers resolve it by reprogramming [HIGH]
Internal processor or memory fault in the inverter control board [MEDIUM]
Weak 12 V supply during start-up or shutdown [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 5000€ (0.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Drive Motor A Control Module Performance

bilingual_description.en: P0A1B flags a self-test failure of the processor that controls drive motor A, usually inside the inverter. In GM hybrid tables (2016) it sets when the processor fails an inhibit path test at power-down, three or more times, proving it could not take the system to a safe state; in 2011 tables internal SPI, RAM or cache faults in 28 of 32 samples count. Toyota uses subtype P0A1B-1F on the 2023-24 Corolla Hybrid. Drive motor B is P0A1C. Expect a red loss-of-drive warning.
bilingual_description.de: P0A1B meldet, dass der Prozessor, der Antriebsmotor A steuert – meist im Inverter –, seinen Selbsttest nicht besteht. In GM-Hybridtabellen von 2016 genügt dafür ein beim Abschalten mindestens dreimal gescheiterter Inhibit-Pfad-Test: Der Rechner konnte das System nicht in den sicheren Zustand bringen. In den Tabellen von 2011 zählen SPI-, RAM- oder Cache-Fehler in 28 von 32 Abtastungen. Beides ist Typ A, MIL in der ersten Fahrt. Land Rover setzt P0A1B im Inverter der PHEV 2024–25 beim Start, VW führt P0A1B00 beim ID.4-Frontantrieb, Toyota nutzt P0A1B-1F beim Corolla Hybrid 2023–24. Motor B ist P0A1C. Oft erscheint eine rote Antriebswarnung.

symptoms: Loss of drive warning and MIL
Vehicle cannot be driven electrically or not at all
Fault may vanish after a full sleep cycle while the code stays stored

description: P0A1C is the counterpart of P0A1B for the second electric machine, drive motor B, and reports that its control processor is no longer trustworthy. GM hybrid tables use it for the motor control processor B: in 2016 calibrations the code sets when an inhibit path test at power-down fails three or more times, in 2011 calibrations internal processor integrity faults such as SPI, RAM or cache errors are counted. Both are Type A with MIL on the first trip. The code concerns the control electronics, not a phase current sensor; those faults use their own codes. Expect a hybrid warning and loss of the affected motor function.
possible_causes: Internal processor or memory fault on the motor B control board [HIGH]
Calibration or software fault in the inverter [MEDIUM]
Unstable 12 V supply or ground to the inverter electronics [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 5000€ (0.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: P0A1C is the counterpart of P0A1B for the second electric machine, drive motor B, and reports that its control processor is no longer trustworthy. Both are Type A with MIL on the first trip. The code concerns the control electronics, not a phase current sensor; those faults use their own codes. Expect a hybrid warning and loss of the affected motor function.
bilingual_description.de: P0A1C ist das Gegenstück zu P0A1B für die zweite E-Maschine, Antriebsmotor B, und meldet, dass deren Steuerprozessor nicht mehr vertrauenswürdig arbeitet. GM verwendet den Code in seinen Hybridtabellen für den Motorsteuerprozessor B: In Kalibrierungen von 2016 entsteht er, wenn ein Inhibit-Pfad-Test beim Abschalten mindestens dreimal scheitert, in Kalibrierungen von 2011 werden interne Integritätsfehler wie SPI-, RAM- oder Cache-Fehler gezählt. Beides ist Typ A mit MIL in der ersten Fahrt. Betroffen ist die Steuerelektronik, nicht ein Phasenstromsensor – dafür gibt es eigene Codes. Folge: Hybridwarnung und Ausfall der betroffenen Motorfunktion.

symptoms: Reduced drive power or no electric drive

description: The hybrid powertrain control module coordinates engine, motors and battery. P0A1D says this module has reported an internal failure or is no longer working reliably. In GM hybrid tables (2013) the engine control module stores P0A1D when a message from motor control processor A signals a hybrid controller status failure in 3 of 4 counts, as a Type B code with MIL after two trips. GM 2016 tables list P0A1D among codes that limit engine power. Subaru warns for the 2014-16 Crosstrek Hybrid that generic OBD readouts may store P0A1D from a scan tool communication error; replace the module only if the code returns. P0E43 covers module B.
possible_causes: Internal fault of the hybrid control module [HIGH]
Code stored by a scan tool communication error, not by a real defect [MEDIUM]
Supply, ground or network fault at the module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (0.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Powertrain Control Module A

bilingual_description.en: The hybrid powertrain control module coordinates engine, motors and battery. P0A1D says this module has reported an internal failure or is no longer working reliably. In GM hybrid tables (2013) the engine control module stores P0A1D when a message from motor control processor A signals a hybrid controller status failure in 3 of 4 counts, as a Type B code with MIL after two trips. bilingual_description.de: Das Hybrid-Antriebsstrang-Steuergerät koordiniert Verbrennungsmotor, E-Maschinen und Batterie. P0A1D besagt, dass dieses Steuergerät einen internen Fehler gemeldet hat oder nicht mehr verlässlich arbeitet. In GM-Hybridtabellen von 2013 speichert das Motorsteuergerät P0A1D, wenn eine Botschaft des Motorsteuerprozessors A in 3 von 4 Zählungen einen Statusfehler des Hybridrechners meldet – Typ B, MIL nach zwei Fahrten. Die GM-Tabellen von 2016 führen P0A1D unter den Codes, die die Motorleistung begrenzen. Subaru warnt beim Crosstrek Hybrid 2014–16, dass ein generischer OBD-Abruf P0A1D durch einen Kommunikationsfehler des Testers erzeugen kann. Modul B: P0E43.

description: Mild and full hybrids often start the engine and recharge the battery with a belt-driven starter-generator that has its own control electronics. P0A1E means that controller has reported a fault or works incorrectly. Audi stores P0A1E00 in the starter-generator control module of the 2020-2022 Q3 mild hybrid and cures it with a software update. Ford logs P0A1E in the engine control module of 2021-2023 F-150 PowerBoost and 2020-2026 Explorer and 2020-2023 Aviator hybrids; its bulletins name a loose connection at the belt integrated starter-generator or its software. Drivers notice a wrench or MIL lamp, no start-stop and no electric-only driving.
possible_causes: Loose wiring connection at the starter-generator [HIGH]
Starter-generator software fault, fixed by update [HIGH]
Starter-generator with integrated electronics failed [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Starter/Generator Control Module

P0A1E bedeutet, dass diese Elektronik einen Fehler gemeldet hat oder nicht korrekt arbeitet. Audi speichert P0A1E00 im Starter-Generator-Steuergerät des Q3 Mild-Hybrid 2020–2022 und behebt ihn per Software-Update. Ford legt P0A1E im Motorsteuergerät von F-150 PowerBoost 2021–2023 sowie Explorer- und Aviator-Hybriden ab 2020 ab und nennt einen lockeren Anschluss am riemengetriebenen Starter-Generator oder dessen Software. Für den Fahrer: Schraubenschlüssel- oder Motorwarnleuchte, kein Start-Stopp, kein reiner E-Betrieb.

symptoms: Wrench lamp or MIL on, electrical system warning

description: The battery energy control module supervises cell voltages, current and temperatures of the high-voltage pack. P0A1F reports that this module failed its own integrity checks. In GM hybrid tables (2011) a single reset of the module by its software watchdog is enough, and the code sets in one trip. GM told dealers for the 2011-2012 Chevrolet Volt not to replace the module for P0A1F but to install a new calibration. FCA lists subtype P0A1F-09, internal component failure, on the 2018 Jeep Wrangler with eTorque and also fixes it by reflashing the battery pack control module. Lost communication with the module is U0111. Expect a MIL and limited hybrid function.
possible_causes: Module software fault, fixed by a new calibration [HIGH]
Internal hardware fault of the battery control module [MEDIUM]
Unstable 12 V supply causing module resets [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 3000€ (0.3h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0A1F meldet, dass dieses Steuergerät seine eigenen Integritätsprüfungen nicht besteht. In GM-Hybridtabellen von 2011 genügt ein einziger Neustart durch den Software-Watchdog, gesetzt wird in einer Fahrt. GM wies die Händler beim Chevrolet Volt 2011–2012 an, das Steuergerät bei P0A1F nicht zu tauschen, sondern neu zu kalibrieren. FCA führt den Untertyp P0A1F-09 (interner Bauteilfehler) beim Jeep Wrangler 2018 mit eTorque und hilft ebenfalls per Neuprogrammierung. Kommunikationsverlust zum Modul ist U0111. Folge: MIL und eingeschränkte Hybridfunktion.

symptoms: MIL or service engine soon light on
Battery or hybrid warning, limited electric operation

description: This code covers the upper electrical limit of a torque sensor fitted to the traction motor shaft, for example the magnetostrictive design inside a hollow output shaft described in a Honda patent. The control unit sets P0A20 when the sensor voltage remains above the valid range for a calibrated time, which points to a short to the supply voltage, an open ground return or a sensor output stuck high. Hyundai nennt den Code für den Sonata Hybrid samt Widerstandswerten des NTC, Audi beim A7 e quattro zusammen mit P0A2E und verschlissenem Stecker. McLaren legt Übertemperatur unter P0A2B98 ab. P0A2C/P0A2D sind harte Kreisfehler, P0A2F echte Hitze. Folge: weniger E-Leistung.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning or check engine light
Motor temperature far off from other temperatures after a cold soak

description: The motor A sensor is an NTC thermistor, so its signal voltage falls as the winding heats; Hyundai's Sonata Hybrid bulletin gives about 11 to 13 kOhm at 20 °C for 2014-15 units. P0A2C means the voltage is too low, which the module reads as an impossibly hot motor: GM sets it on 2013 two-mode trucks above 230 °C (near 0 V), Type B, two trips; the 2011 table uses 184 °C, the 2013 MGU mild hybrid 236 °C. The usual cause is a signal wire shorted to ground or a shorted sensor. P0A2D is the opposite fault, P0A2F a real over-temperature that only counts while the sensor is in range. Hyundai reports a stuck 417 °F reading as a circuit fault. The driver sees a warning and derated electric drive.
possible_causes: Sensor signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Thermistor internally shorted (often only with transaxle or motor) [MEDIUM]
Chafed extension harness between drive unit and inverter [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input in the inverter/motor control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 4000€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0A2C heißt: Spannung zu niedrig, vom Steuergerät als unmöglich heißer Motor gelesen. symptoms: Hybrid system warning or check engine light
Motor temperature shows a very high fixed value in live data
Electric drive power reduced or disabled

description: With an NTC thermistor, a high signal voltage stands for a cold motor, and a voltage close to the 5 V pull-up means the circuit is open. GM sets P0A2D on its 2013 two-mode trucks when the reading falls below -40 °C, Type B over two trips; if the fault is already present at start-up it waits until the motor has warmed up under load for at least 1.5 minutes. The 2011 table uses -41 °C, the 2013 MGU mild hybrid -48 °C with torque above 10 Nm. Typical causes are a broken signal or ground wire, an unplugged connector or an open sensor. Hyundai checks the sensor resistance at the transaxle connector. P0A2C is the low-voltage counterpart. Motor protection is lost, so electric power is limited.
possible_causes: Open signal or ground wire of the motor temperature sensor [HIGH]
Connector unplugged or terminal pushed out, often after drive unit work [MEDIUM]
Thermistor open inside the motor or transaxle [MEDIUM]
Signal wire shorted to a supply voltage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 4000€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Die Tabelle 2011 nennt -41 °C, der MGU-Mildhybrid 2013 -48 °C bei mehr als 10 Nm Moment. Typisch sind gebrochene Signal- oder Masseleitung, abgezogener Stecker oder ein unterbrochener Fühler. Hyundai misst den Widerstand am Getriebestecker. Gegenstück ist P0A2C. Ohne Temperaturschutz wird die E-Leistung begrenzt.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning or check engine light
Motor temperature shows about -40 degrees in live data

description: P0A2E flags short jumps or dropouts in the motor A temperature signal that are too brief or too erratic for the low/high checks. Bentley documents it for the Bentayga PHEV and Flying Spur Hybrid 2020-23: the resistance in the sensor crimp changes suddenly at high temperature, and only the sensor has to be replaced, although the engine and gearbox come out to reach it. Audi lists it on the 2021-22 A7 e quattro together with P0A4000 and/or P0A2B00, caused by contact wear in a coupling connector, fixed with new gold-plated pins. Siblings: P0A2C/P0A2D for a steady out-of-range signal, P2DB0 for sensor B. The car shows a MIL or HV warning and may limit electric drive.
possible_causes: Worn contacts in a coupling connector of the sensor line (Audi A7 e quattro) [HIGH]
Resistance jumps in the sensor crimp at high temperature (Bentley hybrids) [MEDIUM]
Chafed or loosely routed sensor wire with intermittent contact [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 5000€ (1.5h - 20h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Bentley beschreibt den Code für Bentayga PHEV und Flying Spur Hybrid 2020–23: Der Widerstand in der Crimpung des Fühlers springt bei hoher Temperatur, getauscht wird nur der Fühler – dafür müssen allerdings Motor und Getriebe heraus. Geschwister: P0A2C/P0A2D für ein dauerhaft falsches Signal, P2DB0 für Sensor B. Sichtbar wird es als MIL bzw. HV-Warnung, teils mit begrenztem E-Antrieb.

symptoms: Check engine light or high-voltage warning in the cluster
Fault comes and goes, often after hard driving
Gearbox or electric drive warning on some models

description: Unlike its siblings, P0A2F reports a real thermal problem: the sensor works, but motor A stays too hot. GM sets it on 2013 two-mode trucks when the temperature exceeds 200 °C and does not fall below the 135 °C reset level, Type B, provided no circuit or plausibility fault is active. The 2011 table uses 159 °C; on the 2013 MGU mild hybrid the limit is 165 °C, and torque is already cut linearly from 100 % to zero between 155 and 165 °C. Hyundai lists the code in its Sonata Hybrid sensor bulletin, so a skewed sensor can mimic it. McLaren handles over-temperature under P0A2B98 and points to the dielectric cooling circuit. Expect a warning and sharply reduced electric power.
possible_causes: Motor cooling failure such as a weak pump, low fluid or blocked cooler [HIGH]
Sustained high load such as towing or long climbs in electric mode [MEDIUM]
Temperature sensor reading too high while still within range [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GM setzt den Code bei den Two-Mode-Trucks 2013, wenn die Temperatur über 200 °C steigt und nicht unter die Rücksetzschwelle von 135 °C fällt, Typ B, sofern kein Kreis- oder Plausibilitätsfehler aktiv ist. Folge: Warnung, stark gedrosselte E-Leistung.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning
Electric drive power drops sharply or is cut
Engine runs more often to support the drive

description: P0A30 is the general circuit code for the temperature sensor in the second traction motor (motor B). It is meant for faults the control unit can see on the sensor line but cannot classify as too low, too high or implausible. No manufacturer documents P0A30 publicly; GM two-mode hybrids and Mitsubishi (rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV) use the specific codes P0A31 to P0A33 for the same sensor instead. CARB 1968.2 requires hybrid components whose failure can affect emissions to be monitored for circuit faults. Without a valid winding temperature the motor cannot be protected against overheating, so the system usually cuts electric drive power and lights a hybrid warning.
possible_causes: Loose, corroded or damaged connector between motor B and its control module [HIGH]
Chafed or broken sensor wiring at the drive unit [MEDIUM]
Thermistor in the motor winding failed (often only replaceable with the motor) [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input in the motor control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A30 ist der allgemeine Kreiscode für den Temperaturfühler im zweiten Fahrmotor (Motor B). Er ist für Fehler gedacht, die das Steuergerät an der Fühlerleitung erkennt, aber weder als zu niedrig, zu hoch noch als unplausibel einordnen kann. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A30 öffentlich; GM (Two-Mode-Hybride) und Mitsubishi (Heckmotor des Outlander PHEV 2023) melden denselben Fühler stattdessen mit den genaueren Codes P0A31 bis P0A33. CARB 1968.2 verlangt, dass Hybridbauteile mit Einfluss auf die Emissionen auf Kreisfehler überwacht werden. Ohne gültige Wicklungstemperatur lässt sich der Motor nicht vor Überhitzung schützen – das System nimmt deshalb meist E-Leistung zurück und meldet eine Hybridstörung.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning or check engine light
Motor B temperature missing or implausible in live data

description: P0A31 checks whether the motor B temperature reading makes sense, typically after a long rest when all parts should be close to the same temperature. GM compares it with other temperatures: the 2011 tables flag a gap above 20 °C to the average of power-electronics coolant and transmission fluid after 6 h without propulsion (Type A); the 2013 two-mode trucks allow 28 °C against the inverter module after 360 min key-off (Type B, two trips). Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV rear motor) compares two coil sensors after 5,400 s soak and sets it at 13 °C difference. P0A32 and P0A33 cover hard circuit faults; P0A35 is only judged while this test passes. Expect a hybrid warning and limited electric drive.
possible_causes: Motor B thermistor reading drifted out of tolerance [HIGH]
Corroded terminals adding resistance in the sensor circuit [MEDIUM]
Comparison sensor (inverter, coolant or fluid temperature) is wrong [LOW]
Uneven cooling of the drive unit, e.g. low fluid level [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV rear motor) compares two coil sensors after 5,400 s soak and sets it at 13 °C difference. P0A32 and P0A33 cover hard circuit faults; P0A35 is only judged while this test passes. Expect a hybrid warning and limited electric drive.

GM vergleicht mit anderen Temperaturen: In den Tabellen 2011 reicht eine Abweichung über 20 °C zum Mittel aus Leistungselektronik-Kühlmittel und Getriebeöl nach 6 h ohne Antrieb (Typ A); bei den Two-Mode-Trucks 2013 sind es 28 °C gegenüber dem Wechselrichtermodul nach mindestens 360 min Zündung aus (Typ B, zwei Fahrten). symptoms: Hybrid warning light after a cold start
Motor B temperature differs clearly from other temperatures after a long rest
Electric drive limited as a precaution

description: P0A32 means the motor B temperature signal sits below its valid voltage range. GM uses an NTC thermistor, so a voltage near 0 V reads as an impossibly hot winding: the 2011 hybrid tables set it above 184 °C (Type A, one trip), the 2013 two-mode trucks above 230 °C (Type B, two trips). Mitsubishi sets it on the rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the sensor voltage is 0.065 V or less for 0.5 s. A signal wire shorted to ground or a shorted thermistor is the typical cause. P0A33 is the opposite fault, P0A31 the plausibility check, and P0A35 a real over-temperature that GM only evaluates while no out-of-range fault is active. The system derates electric drive and warns the driver.
possible_causes: Sensor signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Thermistor shorted inside the motor [MEDIUM]
Chafed harness between drive unit and motor control module [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input in the motor control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GM uses an NTC thermistor, so a voltage near 0 V reads as an impossibly hot winding: the 2011 hybrid tables set it above 184 °C (Type A, one trip), the 2013 two-mode trucks above 230 °C (Type B, two trips). Mitsubishi sets it on the rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the sensor voltage is 0.065 V or less for 0.5 s. A signal wire shorted to ground or a shorted thermistor is the typical cause. P0A33 is the opposite fault, P0A31 the plausibility check, and P0A35 a real over-temperature that GM only evaluates while no out-of-range fault is active. The system derates electric drive and warns the driver.
bilingual_description.de: P0A32 bedeutet: Das Temperatursignal von Motor B liegt unter seinem gültigen Spannungsbereich. GM verwendet einen NTC-Thermistor, eine Spannung nahe 0 V entspricht also einer unmöglich heißen Wicklung – die Hybridtabellen 2011 setzen den Code ab 184 °C (Typ A, eine Fahrt), die Two-Mode-Trucks 2013 ab 230 °C (Typ B, zwei Fahrten). Mitsubishi löst ihn am Heckmotor des Outlander PHEV 2023 aus, wenn die Fühlerspannung 0,5 s lang höchstens 0,065 V beträgt. Meist ist die Signalleitung gegen Masse geschlossen oder der Thermistor kurzgeschlossen. Gegenstück ist P0A33, P0A31 die Plausibilitätsprüfung, P0A35 echte Übertemperatur, die GM nur ohne aktiven Bereichsfehler bewertet. Der E-Antrieb wird gedrosselt, eine Warnung erscheint.

symptoms: Hybrid warning or check engine light
Motor B temperature shows an extremely high fixed value
Electric drive reduced or switched off

description: P0A33 is stored when the motor B temperature signal stays above its valid voltage range. With GM's NTC thermistor a voltage near 5 V reads as an impossibly cold motor: GM sets it below -41 °C in the 2011 tables (Type A) and below -40 °C on the 2013 two-mode trucks (Type B, two trips). Mitsubishi flags the rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the voltage reaches 4.761 V or more for 0.5 s. That pattern points to an open sensor circuit, an unplugged connector or a short to a voltage source. P0A32 is the low-side fault, P0A31 the rationality check, P0A35 the over-temperature code. Because winding temperature is unknown, the system limits electric drive power and shows a warning.
possible_causes: Open sensor circuit or unplugged connector [HIGH]
Spread or corroded terminals at the motor or module connector [MEDIUM]
Thermistor open inside the motor [MEDIUM]
Signal wire shorted to a voltage source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

With GM's NTC thermistor a voltage near 5 V reads as an impossibly cold motor: GM sets it below -41 °C in the 2011 tables (Type A) and below -40 °C on the 2013 two-mode trucks (Type B, two trips). Because winding temperature is unknown, the system limits electric drive power and shows a warning.
bilingual_description.de: P0A33 wird gespeichert, wenn das Temperatursignal von Motor B oberhalb seines gültigen Spannungsbereichs bleibt. Beim NTC-Thermistor von GM bedeutet eine Spannung nahe 5 V einen unmöglich kalten Motor: GM setzt den Code in den Tabellen 2011 unter −41 °C (Typ A), bei den Two-Mode-Trucks 2013 unter −40 °C (Typ B, zwei Fahrten). symptoms: Hybrid warning or check engine light
Motor B temperature shows about -40 °C regardless of conditions

description: P0A34 covers a motor B temperature signal that drops out or jumps for short moments instead of failing permanently. A winding temperature cannot change by tens of degrees within milliseconds, so such steps point to a loose contact, a chafed wire or a cracked solder joint. No manufacturer documents P0A34 publicly; GM and Mitsubishi only list the permanent faults P0A32 and P0A33 for this sensor, with debounce times of a few hundred milliseconds to seconds that a brief dropout may not meet. CARB 1968.2 requires circuit monitoring of emission-relevant hybrid components. The fault often comes and goes with vibration or heat, and the hybrid system may limit electric drive while it is active.
possible_causes: Loose or fretting terminal in the sensor connector [HIGH]
Wire insulation chafed through at a moving harness section [MEDIUM]
Cracked joint at the thermistor leads inside the motor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Drive Motor B Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent

bilingual_description.de: P0A34 beschreibt ein Temperatursignal von Motor B, das kurzzeitig aussetzt oder springt, statt dauerhaft auszufallen. Eine Wicklungstemperatur kann sich nicht binnen Millisekunden um Dutzende Grad ändern – solche Sprünge deuten auf Wackelkontakt, angescheuerte Leitung oder eine gerissene Lötstelle. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A34 öffentlich; GM und Mitsubishi führen für diesen Fühler nur die Dauerfehler P0A32 und P0A33, mit Entprellzeiten von einigen hundert Millisekunden bis Sekunden, die ein kurzer Aussetzer nicht erreicht. CARB 1968.2 fordert die Kreisüberwachung emissionsrelevanter Hybridbauteile. Der Fehler kommt und geht oft mit Vibration oder Wärme; solange er ansteht, kann der E-Antrieb begrenzt sein.

symptoms: Hybrid warning that appears and clears on its own
Motor B temperature jumps in live data
Occasional loss of electric drive power

description: Unlike the sensor codes, P0A35 reports that motor B is actually too hot according to a working sensor. GM's 2011 hybrid tables set it above 149 °C (Type A, one trip); the 2013 two-mode trucks use 200 °C, clear it only below 135 °C and run it only while P0A31 is not active (Type B). Mitsubishi sets it on the rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the coil reaches 177 °C for one second and names the motor assembly, electric water pump, EV cooling circuit and radiator fan as suspects. Sustained heavy load, towing or a cooling fault are the usual triggers. P0A2F is the same check for motor A, P0A3D for the motor B inverter. The system cuts motor B torque until it has cooled down.
possible_causes: Electric coolant pump of the drive cooling circuit failed or weak [HIGH]
Low coolant or transmission fluid in the motor cooling path [MEDIUM]
Radiator fan not running or radiator blocked [MEDIUM]
Extended high load such as towing or long climbs [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Anders als die Fühlercodes meldet P0A35, dass Motor B laut intaktem Fühler tatsächlich zu heiß ist. Die GM-Hybridtabellen 2011 setzen ihn über 149 °C (Typ A, eine Fahrt); die Two-Mode-Trucks 2013 nutzen 200 °C, löschen erst unter 135 °C und prüfen nur, solange P0A31 nicht aktiv ist (Typ B). Mitsubishi löst ihn am Heckmotor des Outlander PHEV 2023 aus, wenn die Wicklung eine Sekunde lang 177 °C erreicht, und nennt Motoreinheit, elektrische Wasserpumpe, EV-Kühlkreis und Kühlerlüfter als Verdächtige. Auslöser sind meist anhaltend hohe Last, Anhängerbetrieb oder ein Kühlfehler. P0A2F ist dieselbe Prüfung für Motor A, P0A3D für den Wechselrichter von Motor B. Das System nimmt Drehmoment zurück, bis der Motor abgekühlt ist.

symptoms: Noticeable loss of electric drive power
Hybrid system overheat or warning message
Engine runs more often to compensate

description: P0A36 is the general circuit code for the temperature sensor in the hybrid generator, the machine that is mainly driven by the engine to produce electricity. It covers faults the module detects on the sensor line without classing them as low, high or implausible. No manufacturer documents P0A36 publicly; Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV) monitors its generator coil sensor with the specific codes P0A37 to P0A39 instead. CARB 1968.2 requires circuit monitoring for hybrid components that can affect emissions. With the generator temperature unknown, the system cannot protect the windings, so it usually restricts generator output and series operation and shows a hybrid warning.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded connector between generator and its control unit [HIGH]
Damaged sensor wiring near the transaxle [MEDIUM]
Generator coil thermistor failed (usually replaced with the generator) [MEDIUM]
Faulty input in the generator control unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A36 ist der allgemeine Kreiscode für den Temperaturfühler im Hybrid-Generator, also der Maschine, die vor allem vom Verbrennungsmotor angetrieben Strom erzeugt. Er erfasst Fehler an der Fühlerleitung, die das Steuergerät weder als zu niedrig, zu hoch noch unplausibel einstuft. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A36 öffentlich; Mitsubishi (Outlander PHEV 2023) überwacht seinen Generator-Wicklungsfühler stattdessen mit den genaueren Codes P0A37 bis P0A39. CARB 1968.2 schreibt die Kreisüberwachung emissionsrelevanter Hybridbauteile vor. Ist die Generatortemperatur unbekannt, kann das System die Wicklung nicht schützen – es begrenzt daher meist Generatorleistung und seriellen Betrieb und meldet eine Hybridstörung.

symptoms: Hybrid warning or check engine light
Generator output or battery charging restricted
Generator temperature missing or implausible in live data

description: P0A37 tests whether the generator temperature reading is believable. Mitsubishi documents it for the 2023 Outlander PHEV: once per drive cycle, after at least 5,400 s of soak and with the inverter switched off, the generator W-phase coil temperature is compared with the front motor coil and with the oil temperature. A gap of 26 °C to the motor or 22 °C to the oil, held for 0.8 s, sets the code. Suspects are the power drive unit, the coil sensor inside the generator and the wiring. P0A38 and P0A39 are hard voltage faults of the same sensor, P0A3B the real over-temperature. Mitsubishi is the only manufacturer found that documents P0A37 publicly. The driver sees a warning and generator use may be limited.
possible_causes: Generator coil sensor reading out of tolerance [HIGH]
Corroded connector or damaged harness in the sensor circuit [MEDIUM]
Fault in the power drive unit that evaluates the sensor [MEDIUM]
Comparison sensor (motor coil or oil temperature) reads wrong [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance

The driver sees a warning and generator use may be limited.
bilingual_description.de: P0A37 prüft, ob die Generatortemperatur glaubhaft ist. Mitsubishi dokumentiert das für den Outlander PHEV 2023: Einmal pro Fahrzyklus, nach mindestens 5.400 s Standzeit und bei abgeschaltetem Wechselrichter, wird die Wicklungstemperatur der W-Phase des Generators mit der des Frontmotors und mit der Öltemperatur verglichen. Weichen sie 0,8 s lang um 26 °C (Motor) bzw. 22 °C (Öl) ab, wird der Code gesetzt. Verdächtig sind die Leistungselektronik, der Wicklungsfühler im Generator und die Leitungen. P0A38 und P0A39 sind harte Spannungsfehler desselben Fühlers, P0A3B echte Übertemperatur. Außer Mitsubishi beschreibt kein Hersteller P0A37 öffentlich. Für den Fahrer: Warnung, eventuell eingeschränkter Generatorbetrieb.

symptoms: Hybrid warning after the first start of the day
Generator temperature differs from oil temperature after a long rest

description: P0A38 means the generator temperature signal has fallen below the range a healthy sensor can produce. Mitsubishi sets it on the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the voltage of the generator W-phase coil sensor is 0.1 V or less for at least 0.5 s while the generator control unit has at least 8 V supply. Such a low voltage usually comes from a signal wire shorted to ground or a shorted sensor; Mitsubishi lists the power drive unit, the generator coil sensor and damaged wiring or connectors as suspects. P0A39 is the matching high fault, P0A37 the plausibility check and P0A3B a genuine over-temperature. Mitsubishi is the only manufacturer found that documents P0A38. Expect a hybrid warning and restricted generator use.
possible_causes: Sensor signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Generator coil sensor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Damaged connector or harness between generator and power drive unit [MEDIUM]
Faulty sensor input in the power drive unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0A39 is the matching high fault, P0A37 the plausibility check and P0A3B a genuine over-temperature. Mitsubishi is the only manufacturer found that documents P0A38. bilingual_description.de: P0A38 heißt: Das Temperatursignal des Generators liegt unter dem Bereich, den ein intakter Fühler liefern kann. Mitsubishi setzt den Code beim Outlander PHEV 2023, wenn die Spannung des Wicklungsfühlers der W-Phase mindestens 0,5 s lang 0,1 V oder weniger beträgt, sofern das Generator-Steuergerät mindestens 8 V Versorgung hat. Ursache einer so niedrigen Spannung ist meist eine Signalleitung mit Masseschluss oder ein kurzgeschlossener Fühler; Mitsubishi nennt Leistungselektronik, Wicklungsfühler und beschädigte Leitungen oder Stecker. P0A39 ist der passende Fehler nach oben, P0A37 die Plausibilitätsprüfung, P0A3B echte Übertemperatur. Nur Mitsubishi dokumentiert P0A38 öffentlich. Folge: Hybridwarnung und eingeschränkter Generatorbetrieb.

symptoms: Hybrid warning or check engine light
Generator temperature shows an implausibly high fixed value
Battery charging by the engine restricted

description: P0A39 is the high-side counterpart of P0A38: the generator temperature signal stays above the range a working sensor can deliver. Mitsubishi sets it on the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the generator W-phase coil sensor voltage reaches 4.93 V or more for at least 0.5 s. A voltage that close to the reference typically means the sensor circuit is open, a connector is unplugged or a terminal has lost contact, less often a short to a supply. Mitsubishi points to the power drive unit, the coil sensor in the generator and the harness. P0A37 handles implausible but in-range readings, P0A3B a real overheat. No other manufacturer documents P0A39 publicly. The system cannot protect the generator and limits its use.
possible_causes: Open sensor circuit or unplugged generator connector [HIGH]
Spread or corroded terminals at the generator or power drive unit [MEDIUM]
Generator coil sensor open internally [MEDIUM]
Signal wire shorted to a supply voltage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Temperature Sensor Circuit High

bilingual_description.de: P0A39 ist das Gegenstück zu P0A38: Das Temperatursignal des Generators bleibt oberhalb dessen, was ein funktionierender Fühler liefern kann. Mitsubishi setzt den Code beim Outlander PHEV 2023, wenn die Spannung des Wicklungsfühlers der W-Phase mindestens 0,5 s lang 4,93 V oder mehr erreicht. Eine Spannung so nahe an der Referenz bedeutet meist einen unterbrochenen Fühlerkreis, einen abgezogenen Stecker oder einen Kontakt ohne Verbindung, seltener einen Schluss gegen Versorgung. Mitsubishi verweist auf Leistungselektronik, Wicklungsfühler im Generator und Kabelstrang. P0A37 betrifft unplausible Werte im gültigen Bereich, P0A3B echte Überhitzung. Kein anderer Hersteller beschreibt P0A39 öffentlich. Ohne Temperaturwert schränkt das System den Generator ein.

symptoms: Hybrid warning or check engine light
Generator temperature shows a very low fixed value
Generator output or series mode restricted

description: P0A3A flags a generator temperature signal that is interrupted or jumps only briefly. Since the thermal mass of a generator winding rules out sudden steps, such behaviour indicates a contact or wiring problem rather than a real temperature change. No manufacturer documents P0A3A publicly; Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV) only lists the permanent faults P0A38 and P0A39 for its generator coil sensor, each needing at least 0.5 s outside the valid voltage before it sets, so short dropouts would not trigger them. CARB 1968.2 calls for circuit monitoring of emission-relevant hybrid parts. Symptoms come and go, often with heat, vibration or moisture, and generator use may be restricted while the fault is present.
possible_causes: Loose or fretting terminal in the generator sensor connector [HIGH]
Moisture or corrosion in the connector [MEDIUM]
Harness chafed against the transaxle housing [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 3500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent

bilingual_description.en: P0A3A flags a generator temperature signal that is interrupted or jumps only briefly. Since the thermal mass of a generator winding rules out sudden steps, such behaviour indicates a contact or wiring problem rather than a real temperature change. No manufacturer documents P0A3A publicly; Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV) only lists the permanent faults P0A38 and P0A39 for its generator coil sensor, each needing at least 0.5 s outside the valid voltage before it sets, so short dropouts would not trigger them. CARB 1968.2 calls for circuit monitoring of emission-relevant hybrid parts. Symptoms come and go, often with heat, vibration or moisture, and generator use may be restricted while the fault is present.
bilingual_description.de: P0A3A meldet ein Temperatursignal des Generators, das nur kurz aussetzt oder springt. Weil die Wärmeträgheit einer Generatorwicklung plötzliche Sprünge ausschließt, spricht ein solches Verhalten für ein Kontakt- oder Leitungsproblem statt für eine echte Temperaturänderung. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A3A öffentlich; Mitsubishi (Outlander PHEV 2023) führt für seinen Wicklungsfühler nur die Dauerfehler P0A38 und P0A39, die jeweils mindestens 0,5 s außerhalb der gültigen Spannung voraussetzen – kurze Aussetzer lösen sie also nicht aus. CARB 1968.2 verlangt die Kreisüberwachung emissionsrelevanter Hybridteile. Die Beschwerden kommen und gehen, oft mit Wärme, Vibration oder Feuchtigkeit; solange der Fehler ansteht, kann der Generatorbetrieb begrenzt sein.

symptoms: Hybrid warning that appears now and then
Generator temperature jumps in live data
Occasionally restricted battery charging by the engine

description: P0A3B reports that the hybrid generator itself has become too hot, with the temperature sensor working correctly. Mitsubishi documents it as generator coil temperature high on the 2023 Outlander PHEV: the monitor runs continuously and sets the code when the W-phase coil temperature criterion of 199 °C is met for one second. Mitsubishi's checks cover higher-priority codes, the radiator fan, and the EV oil cooling circuit that cools the generator; if those are fine, the generator is replaced. P0A37 to P0A39 are the sensor faults that must be ruled out first, P0A3E the over-temperature of the generator inverter. No other manufacturer documents P0A3B publicly. The system restricts generator output, which can cut charging and series-mode power.
possible_causes: Fault in the oil cooling circuit of the generator (low oil, leak, pump) [HIGH]
Radiator fan not working [MEDIUM]
Internal generator fault such as damaged winding insulation [MEDIUM]
Power drive unit commanding excessive generator current [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 5000€ (1h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Generator A Over Temperature

bilingual_description.en: P0A3B reports that the hybrid generator itself has become too hot, with the temperature sensor working correctly. Mitsubishi documents it as generator coil temperature high on the 2023 Outlander PHEV: the monitor runs continuously and sets the code when the W-phase coil temperature criterion of 199 °C is met for one second. Mitsubishi's checks cover higher-priority codes, the radiator fan, and the EV oil cooling circuit that cools the generator; if those are fine, the generator is replaced. P0A37 to P0A39 are the sensor faults that must be ruled out first, P0A3E the over-temperature of the generator inverter. No other manufacturer documents P0A3B publicly. The system restricts generator output, which can cut charging and series-mode power.
bilingual_description.de: P0A3B meldet, dass der Hybrid-Generator selbst zu heiß geworden ist – bei korrekt arbeitendem Temperaturfühler. Mitsubishi dokumentiert den Code als „Generatorwicklung Temperatur hoch“ für den Outlander PHEV 2023: Die Überwachung läuft ständig und setzt ihn, wenn das Kriterium von 199 °C an der Wicklung der W-Phase eine Sekunde lang erfüllt ist. Geprüft werden höher priorisierte Codes, der Kühlerlüfter und der EV-Ölkühlkreis, der den Generator kühlt; ist dort alles in Ordnung, wird der Generator getauscht. P0A37 bis P0A39 sind Fühlerfehler, die zuerst auszuschließen sind, P0A3E die Übertemperatur des Generator-Wechselrichters. Kein anderer Hersteller beschreibt P0A3B öffentlich. Folge: begrenzte Generatorleistung, damit weniger Laden und serielle Leistung.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning or overheat message
Reduced charging and power when the engine drives the generator
Battery state of charge drops during driving

description: P0A3C reports overheating of the inverter that powers drive motor A, usually measured at its IGBT power switches. Mitsubishi sets it on the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the front motor control unit reads 166 °C or more at the U-phase upper IGBT for 0.12 s; other switch positions have their own P30xx codes. Honda calls it motor control module overheating and lists it among the codes caused by a cracked solder joint in the 2012-15 Civic Hybrid motor power inverter, covered by a warranty extension. On the 2023-25 Accord Hybrid and 2025-26 Civic Hybrid, Honda links it to a PCU radiator damaged by road debris. P0A78 is the general inverter performance code, P0C11 to P0C13 are phase-specific. Power is cut to protect the inverter.
possible_causes: PCU or inverter radiator damaged or leaking (Honda Accord/Civic Hybrid) [HIGH]
Internal inverter defect such as a cracked solder joint (Honda Civic Hybrid 2012-15) [MEDIUM]
Low coolant or failed electric pump in the inverter cooling circuit [MEDIUM]
Radiator fan not running [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 5000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Drive Motor A Inverter Over Temperature

bilingual_description.en: P0A3C reports overheating of the inverter that powers drive motor A, usually measured at its IGBT power switches. Power is cut to protect the inverter.
bilingual_description.de: P0A3C meldet Überhitzung des Wechselrichters, der Fahrmotor A speist, meist gemessen an seinen IGBT-Leistungsschaltern. Mitsubishi setzt den Code beim Outlander PHEV 2023, wenn die Frontmotor-Steuereinheit am oberen IGBT der U-Phase 0,12 s lang 166 °C oder mehr misst; die übrigen Schalter haben eigene P30xx-Codes. Honda nennt ihn Überhitzung des Motorsteuermoduls und zählt ihn beim Civic Hybrid 2012–15 zu den Folgen einer gerissenen Lötstelle im Motor-Wechselrichter, für den die Garantie verlängert wurde. Beim Accord Hybrid 2023–25 und Civic Hybrid 2025–26 führt Honda ihn auf einen durch Steinschlag beschädigten PCU-Kühler zurück. P0A78 ist der allgemeine Funktionscode des Wechselrichters, P0C11 bis P0C13 sind phasenbezogen. Zum Schutz wird Leistung zurückgenommen.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning and check engine light
Coolant loss from the inverter circuit

description: P0A3D is the over-temperature code for the inverter feeding drive motor B. On the 2023 Outlander PHEV this is the rear motor control unit, and Mitsubishi sets the code when its IGBT temperature is 156 °C or higher for one second. Mitsubishi's hints list the rear motor assembly, the electric water pump driven by the PHEV-ECU, the EV coolant circuit and the radiator fan, so cooling problems come before electronics. No other manufacturer documents P0A3D publicly; CARB 1968.2 requires monitoring of hybrid components that affect emissions. P0A35 is the over-temperature of motor B itself, P0C14 to P0C16 phase-specific inverter codes and P0A79 the general inverter performance code. Rear drive power is reduced until the inverter cools down.
possible_causes: Electric water pump of the EV cooling circuit failed [HIGH]
Low coolant or air in the EV cooling circuit [MEDIUM]
Radiator fan not running or radiator blocked [MEDIUM]
Internal fault in the rear motor and inverter assembly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 5000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Rear drive power is reduced until the inverter cools down.
bilingual_description.de: P0A3D ist der Übertemperaturcode für den Wechselrichter, der Fahrmotor B speist. Beim Outlander PHEV 2023 ist das die Steuereinheit des Heckmotors; Mitsubishi setzt den Code, wenn deren IGBT-Temperatur eine Sekunde lang 156 °C oder mehr erreicht. Als Ursachen nennt Mitsubishi die Heckmotoreinheit, die vom PHEV-Steuergerät angesteuerte elektrische Wasserpumpe, den EV-Kühlkreis und den Kühlerlüfter – Kühlprobleme kommen also vor Elektronikfehlern. Kein anderer Hersteller dokumentiert P0A3D öffentlich; CARB 1968.2 verlangt die Überwachung emissionsrelevanter Hybridbauteile.
