Die Heckantriebsleistung sinkt, bis der Wechselrichter abgekühlt ist.

symptoms: Fault appears after long climbs or high load

description: P0A3E reports that the inverter controlling the hybrid generator is too hot. Mitsubishi sets it on the 2023 Outlander PHEV when the generator control unit reads 156 °C or more at the U-phase IGBT for 0.12 s; the other switches report via P30AD to P30B1. Its hints are the power drive unit, the EV water cooling circuit and the radiator fan. Honda lists P0A3E among the PCU overheating codes on the 2023-25 Accord Hybrid and 2025-26 Civic Hybrid, where road debris can puncture the PCU radiator because the original guard is too weak. P0A3B is the generator's own over-temperature, P0A3C and P0A3D cover the motor inverters. Output is restricted, so charging and power drop and further warnings may follow.
possible_causes: PCU radiator punctured or leaking after road debris (Honda Accord/Civic Hybrid) [HIGH]
Low coolant or failed electric pump in the inverter cooling circuit [MEDIUM]
Radiator fan not running [MEDIUM]
Internal fault in the power drive unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 5000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Inverter Over Temperature

bilingual_description.en: P0A3E reports that the inverter controlling the hybrid generator is too hot. P0A3B is the generator's own over-temperature, P0A3C and P0A3D cover the motor inverters. Output is restricted, so charging and power drop and further warnings may follow.
bilingual_description.de: P0A3E meldet, dass der Wechselrichter des Hybrid-Generators zu heiß ist. Mitsubishi setzt den Code beim Outlander PHEV 2023, wenn die Generator-Steuereinheit am IGBT der U-Phase 0,12 s lang 156 °C oder mehr misst; die übrigen Schalter melden sich über P30AD bis P30B1. Als Ursachen nennt Mitsubishi Leistungselektronik, EV-Wasserkühlkreis und Kühlerlüfter. P0A3B ist die Übertemperatur des Generators selbst, P0A3C und P0A3D betreffen die Motor-Wechselrichter. Die Leistung wird begrenzt, Laden und Kraft sinken, weitere Warnungen können folgen.

symptoms: Several hybrid warning lights at once
Coolant loss or visible damage at the front radiator area

description: The rotor position of a traction motor is read by a resolver: one excitation coil and two pickup coils that return sine and cosine signals. P0A3F is the basic circuit code for motor A and mostly means the signal is gone. GM sets it when the sine or cosine amplitude drops below 2.3 V (Type A, one trip in the 2011 and 2016 tables); Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV front motor) watches the excitation voltage and fails it outside 1.0 to 2.86 V for 0.14 s. Field causes: a spread terminal at the X2 connector of the Chevrolet Bolt, low 12 V supply on the 2014 Subaru XV Crosstrek Hybrid (software fix), Stellantis Pacifica Hybrid. P0A40 covers a degraded signal. Expect lost propulsion or no electric drive.
possible_causes: Spread or poorly seated terminal at the resolver connector (documented on the Chevrolet Bolt) [HIGH]
Open or shorted excitation, sine or cosine wire between motor and inverter [MEDIUM]
Low 12 V auxiliary battery voltage disturbing the motor control module (Subaru, fixed by reprogramming) [MEDIUM]
Resolver coil failed inside the motor [LOW]
Faulty resolver excitation or input stage in the inverter/motor control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 6000€ (1h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0A40 covers a degraded signal. Expect lost propulsion or no electric drive.
bilingual_description.de: Die Rotorlage eines Fahrmotors liefert ein Resolver: eine Erregerspule und zwei Abnehmerspulen, die ein Sinus- und ein Kosinussignal zurückgeben. P0A3F ist der Grundcode für den Kreis von Motor A und heißt meist: Signal weg. GM setzt ihn, wenn die Sinus- oder Kosinus-Amplitude unter 2,3 V fällt (Typ A, eine Fahrt, Tabellen 2011 und 2016). Mitsubishi (Frontmotor Outlander PHEV 2023) prüft die Erregerspannung und meldet außerhalb von 1,0 bis 2,86 V für 0,14 s. Aus der Praxis: aufgeweitete Kontakte am Stecker X2 beim Chevrolet Bolt, zu niedrige 12-V-Spannung beim Subaru XV Crosstrek Hybrid 2014 (Softwarelösung), Stellantis Pacifica Hybrid. P0A40 meldet ein verschlechtertes Signal. Folge: Vortriebsverlust oder kein E-Antrieb.

symptoms: Sudden loss of propulsion, sometimes normal again after a restart
MIL and hybrid/EV system warning on
Vehicle will not enter ready mode or electric drive is disabled

description: P0A40 means the resolver of motor A still delivers a signal, but its quality is poor or implausible. GM calls this a degraded signal: the sine or cosine value exceeds 4.0 V, judged within 0.2 to 0.4 s of a 2 s window (Type A, one trip in 2016; Type B, two trips on the 2013 mild hybrid). Mitsubishi (2023 Outlander PHEV front motor) sets it when sine or cosine leaves the 2.1 to 2.9 V band for 0.17 s. Audi lists P0A4000 with an implausible signal on the A7 and Q5 e quattro and replaces rotor position sensor G713 after checking gold-plated connector pins; Bentley pairs it with P0C5100/P0C5B00 and inspects connectors for pin drag. P0A3F is the hard signal loss. Expect a drive system warning or no start.
possible_causes: Rotor position sensor (resolver) delivering a degraded signal, e.g. Audi G713 [HIGH]
Worn, loose or contaminated contacts in the resolver connectors (Audi, Bentley) [HIGH]
Sensor wires pinched or misrouted on the gearbox housing after a repair [MEDIUM]
Faulty resolver evaluation in the inverter/motor control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 5000€ (1.5h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Drive system fault message in the instrument cluster
Vehicle cannot be started or will not enter ready mode
Electric drive disabled or torque jerks while driving

description: P0A41 reports that a resolver signal of motor A sits below its permitted range, as happens with a sine, cosine or excitation wire shorted to ground, a shorted coil or a broken line pulled down by the input circuit. Kia documents it on the 2011-13 Optima Hybrid: an intermittent MIL or hybrid service lamp with P0A41 in the motor control unit, traced to internal shorts or poor pin fit in the sub-harness between the hybrid power control unit and the motor, checked against resistance specs. Bosch patents describe telling a short to ground from a short to supply by the offset of the coil lines. P0A42 is the high side, P0A3F the general loss of signal, P0A40 a degraded signal. Expect a warning lamp and possibly no electric drive.
possible_causes: Internal short in the resolver sub-harness between power control unit and motor (Kia Optima Hybrid) [HIGH]
Poor pin fit at the resolver connectors [HIGH]
Shorted resolver coil inside the motor [LOW]
Faulty resolver input stage in the motor control unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A41 meldet, dass ein Resolversignal von Motor A unter seinem zulässigen Bereich liegt – typisch bei einer Sinus-, Kosinus- oder Erregerleitung mit Masseschluss, einer kurzgeschlossenen Spule oder einer unterbrochenen Leitung, die die Eingangsschaltung nach unten zieht. Kia beschreibt den Code beim Optima Hybrid 2011–13: sporadische MIL oder Hybrid-Serviceleuchte mit P0A41 im Motorsteuergerät; Ursache waren innere Kurzschlüsse oder schlechter Kontaktsitz im Teilkabelbaum zwischen Hybrid-Leistungseinheit und Motor, geprüft nach Widerstandswerten. Bosch-Patente zeigen, wie sich Masse- und Plusschluss am Offset der Spulenleitungen unterscheiden lassen. P0A42 ist die High-Seite, P0A3F der Signalverlust, P0A40 ein schlechtes Signal. Folge: Warnleuchte, teils kein E-Antrieb.

symptoms: Intermittent MIL or hybrid service lamp
Code returns after clearing, often with vibration or heat

description: P0A42 is the counterpart to P0A41: a resolver line of motor A reads above its allowed range. Typical triggers are a sine, cosine or excitation wire shorted to a supply voltage, or an open coil whose line is pulled up by the bias resistors of the input circuit, which drives the converter into clipping. Kia covers it in the same Optima Hybrid 2011-13 bulletin as P0A41: intermittent MIL or hybrid service lamp, fixed by inspecting the HPCU-to-motor sub-harness for internal shorts and pin fit. Bosch patents explain why clipping alone is not enough and how the line offset reveals a short to supply or an open line. P0A3F is the general circuit fault. Expect a warning lamp and reduced or no electric drive.
possible_causes: Resolver wire shorted to a supply voltage inside the sub-harness (Kia Optima Hybrid) [HIGH]
Open sine or cosine line pulled high by the input circuit [MEDIUM]
Poor pin fit or corrosion at the resolver connectors [MEDIUM]
Faulty resolver input stage in the motor control unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A42 ist das Gegenstück zu P0A41: Eine Resolverleitung von Motor A liegt über ihrem zulässigen Bereich. Typische Auslöser sind eine Sinus-, Kosinus- oder Erregerleitung mit Schluss nach Plus oder eine unterbrochene Spule, deren Leitung von den Vorspannungswiderständen der Eingangsschaltung hochgezogen wird – der Wandler läuft dann in die Begrenzung. Kia behandelt ihn im selben Bulletin zum Optima Hybrid 2011–13 wie P0A41: sporadische MIL oder Hybrid-Serviceleuchte, Abhilfe durch Prüfen des Teilkabelbaums zwischen HPCU und Motor auf Kurzschlüsse und Kontaktsitz. Bosch-Patente erklären, warum Begrenzung allein kein Beweis ist und wie der Leitungs-Offset einen Plusschluss oder eine Unterbrechung verrät. Folge: Warnleuchte, weniger oder kein E-Antrieb.

symptoms: Intermittent MIL or hybrid service lamp
Electric drive disabled or vehicle not ready
Reduced power until the fault clears

description: P0A43 is set when the motor A resolver signal drops out or jumps only briefly, so that neither a steady low, high nor a lasting loss is confirmed. Stellantis uses it on the Pacifica Hybrid: NHTSA files show P0A43-00 stored in the hybrid control processor next to P0A3F and P0A45, and a 2026 parts review tells dealers to check active bulletins and flash the hybrid control processor before ordering a new power inverter module. No public set threshold exists. GM's Bolt bulletin shows how a slightly spread connector terminal causes such short dropouts. P0A3F, P0A41 and P0A42 cover permanent faults. Expect a warning that may vanish after a restart, sometimes with a short loss of drive.
possible_causes: Loose or spread terminal in the resolver connector, losing contact under vibration [HIGH]
Hybrid control or inverter software needing an update (Stellantis) [MEDIUM]
Chafed resolver wiring making intermittent contact [MEDIUM]
Intermittent fault in the power inverter module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 4000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent

bilingual_description.de: P0A43 wird gesetzt, wenn das Resolversignal von Motor A nur kurz aussetzt oder springt – zu kurz für einen bestätigten Low-, High- oder Dauerverlust. Stellantis nutzt den Code beim Pacifica Hybrid: In NHTSA-Akten steht P0A43-00 im Hybridsteuergerät neben P0A3F und P0A45, und eine Teileprüfung von 2026 verlangt, vor dem Bestellen eines neuen Leistungswechselrichters aktive Bulletins zu prüfen und das Hybridsteuergerät neu zu flashen. Eine öffentliche Setzschwelle gibt es nicht. GMs Bolt-Bulletin zeigt, wie ein leicht aufgeweiteter Steckerkontakt solche kurzen Aussetzer erzeugt. P0A3F, P0A41 und P0A42 melden Dauerfehler. Folge: Warnung, die nach Neustart verschwinden kann, teils kurzer Antriebsausfall.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning or MIL that comes and goes
Brief loss of propulsion, normal again after restart
Code stored as history without current symptoms

description: P0A44 reports that the speed derived from the motor A resolver is above the highest speed the motor may run. Mitsubishi uses it on the 2023 Outlander PHEV front motor: set at 15,500 rpm or more for 0.5 s with module supply above 8 V, judged only when the position sensor itself is fault-free; the guided fix after other codes are ruled out is a new front motor. GM covers the same check under its own code P1B0D (above 11,500 rpm, Type A) instead of P0A44. A true overspeed can come from a slipping drivetrain or a mechanical fault; a false one from a corrupted speed signal. P0A3F to P0A43 cover the sensor circuit. The system cuts motor torque to protect the rotor.
possible_causes: Mechanical fault in the front motor or its drivetrain (Mitsubishi replaces the motor) [MEDIUM]
Real overspeed from wheel spin or a slipping coupling [MEDIUM]
Disturbed resolver signal producing a false speed value [MEDIUM]
Motor control module calculating speed incorrectly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 7000€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

The system cuts motor torque to protect the rotor.
bilingual_description.de: P0A44 meldet, dass die aus dem Resolver von Motor A errechnete Drehzahl über der höchsten zulässigen Motordrehzahl liegt. Mitsubishi nutzt ihn beim Frontmotor des Outlander PHEV 2023: gesetzt ab 15.500 1/min für 0,5 s bei mehr als 8 V Versorgung, bewertet nur bei fehlerfreiem Lagesensor; nach Ausschluss anderer Codes sieht die Anleitung einen neuen Frontmotor vor. GM führt dieselbe Prüfung unter dem eigenen Code P1B0D (über 11.500 1/min, Typ A) statt P0A44. Echte Überdrehzahl entsteht etwa durch Durchrutschen im Antriebsstrang oder einen mechanischen Schaden, eine scheinbare durch ein gestörtes Drehzahlsignal. P0A3F bis P0A43 betreffen den Sensorkreis. Zum Schutz des Rotors wird das Motormoment abgeschaltet.

symptoms: Electric drive torque cut during acceleration or high speed
Reduced top speed in limp mode

description: P0A45 is the general circuit code for the resolver of the second traction motor (B), usually meaning its signal is missing. GM sets it like P0A3F when sine or cosine amplitude falls below 2.3 V (Type A, one trip). Mitsubishi uses it for the rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV: both sine and cosine below 0.12 V for at least 0.18 s; the resolver is part of the rear motor assembly, which is replaced. Toyota fixes P0A45 on 2016-18 RAV4 Hybrid models built before a production change with a new frame wire harness, and Stellantis lists it for the Pacifica Hybrid. P0A46 to P0A49 split out degraded, low, high and intermittent signals. Expect a hybrid warning, MIL and loss of the motor B drive.
possible_causes: Damaged or faulty frame/body wire harness to the rear motor (Toyota RAV4 Hybrid) [HIGH]
Poor contact at the motor B resolver connector [MEDIUM]
Resolver or control unit inside the rear motor assembly failed (Mitsubishi) [MEDIUM]
Hybrid control software needing an update (Stellantis) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 6000€ (1h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GM setzt ihn wie P0A3F, wenn die Sinus- oder Kosinus-Amplitude unter 2,3 V fällt (Typ A, eine Fahrt). symptoms: MIL and hybrid system warning message
Loss of rear-axle electric drive or all-wheel drive
Reduced power or vehicle not ready

description: P0A46 reports that the motor B resolver still delivers a signal, but one that is degraded or not plausible. GM uses the same check as P0A40 for its second motor: sine or cosine above 4.0 V, with a failure counted when it persists for 0.2 to 0.4 s of a 2 s window (Type A, one trip in the 2011 and 2016 tables). A GM-related patent explains the idea: a degraded signal shows as a large mismatch between sine and cosine amplitudes. P0A45 is a full signal loss. Expect a hybrid warning and loss of motor B drive.
possible_causes: Resolver of motor B delivering unequal or distorted sine/cosine signals [HIGH]
High contact resistance or moisture in the resolver connector [MEDIUM]
Fault inside the rear motor assembly incl. bearing damage (Mitsubishi) [MEDIUM]
Damaged shielding letting inverter noise into the resolver lines [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 6000€ (1.5h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Rear or second motor disabled, reduced traction or power

description: P0A47 means a resolver signal of motor B is below its allowed range, typically from a sine, cosine or excitation line shorted to ground or a shorted coil. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Mitsubishi files low resolver signals of the 2023 Outlander PHEV rear motor under its own codes instead: P0C57 for sine and P0C61 for cosine at 0.3 V or less for 0.18 s. Kia uses the motor A twin P0A41 on the Optima Hybrid and blames shorts or pin fit in the sub-harness. CARB 1968.2 requires circuit monitoring of electric drive components, and Bosch patents show how a ground short is told apart by line offset. P0A48 is the high side, P0A45 the general circuit fault. Expect a warning lamp and reduced motor B drive.

Poor pin fit or water ingress at the motor B resolver connector [MEDIUM]
Shorted resolver coil inside motor B [LOW]
Faulty resolver input stage in the motor control module [LOW]

GM shows on the Bolt that a slightly spread resolver terminal can cause brief signal loss and a sudden loss of drive, and forbids splicing resolver connectors because the circuits are sensitive. CARB 1968.2 requires detection of intermittent circuit faults of drive components. P0A45 is the permanent fault. Expect a warning that may clear after a restart.
bilingual_description.de: P0A49 erfasst kurze Aussetzer oder Sprünge im Resolversignal von Motor B, die zu kurz für einen dauerhaften Verlust, Low- oder High-Fehler sind. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. CARB 1968.2 verlangt das Erkennen sporadischer Kreisfehler. P0A45 ist der Dauerfehler. Folge: Warnung, die nach Neustart verschwinden kann.

symptoms: Hybrid warning or MIL that comes and goes
Brief loss of second-motor drive, often over bumps
Code stored as history without current symptoms

description: P0A4A reports that the speed calculated from the motor B resolver exceeds the motor's permitted maximum. Mitsubishi uses it for the rear motor of the 2023 Outlander PHEV: set at 12,500 rpm or more for at least 1 s with supply above 8 V, and only judged once the rear position sensor codes P0A45, P0A46, P0C57, P0C58, P0C61 and P0C62 are ruled out; otherwise the rear motor assembly is replaced, bearing damage being one listed cause. GM uses its own code P1B0E (above 11,500 rpm, Type A) for this check on the second motor of its two-mode trucks. CARB 1968.2 requires monitoring of electric drive components. possible_causes: Fault in the rear motor assembly, e.g. damaged bearing or control unit (Mitsubishi) [MEDIUM]
Real overspeed from rear wheel spin on low grip [MEDIUM]
Disturbed resolver signal producing a false speed value [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 7000€ (1h - 12h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A4A meldet, dass die aus dem Resolver von Motor B berechnete Drehzahl das zulässige Maximum übersteigt. Mitsubishi nutzt ihn für den Heckmotor des Outlander PHEV 2023: gesetzt ab 12.500 1/min für mindestens 1 s bei mehr als 8 V Versorgung und erst bewertet, wenn die Lagesensor-Codes P0A45, P0A46, P0C57, P0C58, P0C61 und P0C62 ausgeschlossen sind; sonst wird die Heckmotor-Baugruppe getauscht, als mögliche Ursache steht auch ein Lagerschaden. GM prüft dasselbe am zweiten Motor seiner Two-Mode-Trucks unter dem eigenen Code P1B0E (über 11.500 1/min, Typ A). CARB 1968.2 verlangt die Überwachung elektrischer Antriebsbauteile. symptoms: Rear electric drive shut off, front-wheel drive only

description: P0A4B covers the resolver that tells the inverter where the generator rotor stands; without a valid angle the generator cannot be commutated. Mitsubishi (Outlander PHEV 2023) runs the check continuously once the generator control unit has at least 8.0 V and sets P0A4B when its internal status flags stay failed for 0.23 s or 0.28 s; low and high signal levels go to separate codes there. Volvo lists P0A4B in the inverter generator module of its 2022-23 plug-in hybrids, as permanent or intermittent fault, with no-start complaints, and fixed false detections by software only. P0A4C is the plausibility check, P0A4D/P0A4E the low and high signal, P0A4F a sporadic signal, P0A50 overspeed. The driver sees a hybrid warning and may lose electric drive or engine start.
possible_causes: False detection in the inverter monitor software (Volvo, fixed by update) [MEDIUM]
Damaged resolver wiring or connector between generator and inverter [HIGH]
Generator resolver defective [MEDIUM]
Resolver evaluation in the power drive unit faulty [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: P0A4B betrifft den Resolver, der dem Wechselrichter die Stellung des Generator-Rotors meldet; ohne gültigen Winkel lässt sich der Generator nicht kommutieren. Mitsubishi (Outlander PHEV 2023) prüft dauernd, sobald das Generator-Steuerteil mindestens 8,0 V hat, und setzt P0A4B, wenn interne Statusmerker 0,23 s bzw. 0,28 s lang gestört bleiben; zu niedrige und zu hohe Pegel laufen dort unter eigenen Codes. Volvo führt P0A4B im Generator-Wechselrichtermodul seiner Plug-in-Hybride 2022–23, dauerhaft oder sporadisch, mit Startproblemen, und beseitigte Fehlerkennungen allein per Software. P0A4C ist die Plausibilität, P0A4D/P0A4E niedriges/hohes Signal, P0A4F ein sporadisches Signal, P0A50 Überdrehzahl. Für den Fahrer: Hybrid-Warnung, eventuell kein E-Antrieb oder Motorstart.

symptoms: Engine does not start or crank in hybrid mode
Electric drive or charging by the generator disabled

description: P0A4C means the generator resolver delivers signals that are electrically present but implausible, so the computed rotor angle cannot be trusted. Mitsubishi documents the exact limits for the 2023 Outlander PHEV: the sine or cosine winding voltage must stay between 2.1 and 2.9 V; if either leaves that window for 0.28 s, or an internal status fault persists for 0.31 s, the generator control unit stores P0A4C. Typical triggers are a corroded or loose resolver plug, a chafed shield picking up noise, a winding that has drifted, or a faulty input stage in the power drive unit. P0A4B is the general circuit fault, P0A4D and P0A4E the hard low and high signal, P0A4F a sporadic dropout. Expect a hybrid warning, reduced power and possibly no engine start via the generator.
possible_causes: Corroded or loose resolver connector [HIGH]
Damaged shielding letting interference onto the sine/cosine lines [MEDIUM]
Resolver winding drifted out of tolerance [MEDIUM]
Faulty resolver input stage in the power drive unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Mitsubishi nennt für den Outlander PHEV 2023 die genauen Grenzen: Die Spannung der Sinus- bzw. Kosinuswicklung muss zwischen 2,1 und 2,9 V liegen; verlässt eine davon dieses Fenster 0,28 s lang oder bleibt ein interner Statusfehler 0,31 s bestehen, speichert das Generator-Steuerteil P0A4C. Häufige Auslöser sind ein korrodierter oder lockerer Resolverstecker, eine durchgescheuerte Schirmung mit Störeinkopplung, eine gealterte Wicklung oder eine defekte Eingangsstufe der Leistungselektronik. symptoms: Reduced drive power or engine-only operation
Engine start via the generator not possible

description: P0A4D reports a generator resolver signal stuck below its permitted range, as caused by a sine, cosine or excitation line shorted to ground or a winding short. No manufacturer documents this code publicly. Mitsubishi shows how the fault is judged but files it under its own codes: on the 2023 Outlander PHEV a sine or cosine voltage at or below 2.0 V for 0.21 s sets P0C66 or P0C6B instead of P0A4D. A Bosch patent describes distinguishing a short to ground from a short to supply by the offset of the receiver coil lines, which is the basis for low/high splitting. CARB requires such circuit checks for hybrid input components. P0A4E is the high side, P0A4B the general circuit fault, P0A4C plausibility. The hybrid system typically shuts the generator down and warns the driver.
possible_causes: Sine, cosine or excitation line shorted to ground [HIGH]
Moisture or corrosion in the resolver connector [MEDIUM]
Shorted resolver winding inside the generator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich. symptoms: Generator disabled, engine-only or no-start condition

description: P0A4E is set when a generator resolver signal sits above its permitted range, which usually points to an open signal line pulled up by the input circuit or a short to a supply voltage. No manufacturer documents P0A4E publicly. Mitsubishi evaluates the same condition on the 2023 Outlander PHEV but reports it under its own codes: a sine or cosine voltage of 4.9 V or more for 0.21 s stores P0C67 or P0C6C. A Bosch patent explains how the averaged offset of the receiver coil lines reveals whether a line is shorted to supply rather than to ground. CARB requires out-of-range checks for hybrid input components. P0A4D is the low counterpart, P0A4B the general circuit code, P0A4C the plausibility check. The generator is usually shut off and the hybrid warning comes on.
possible_causes: Open resolver signal line or pushed-out terminal [HIGH]
Signal line shorted to a supply voltage [MEDIUM]
Faulty resolver input stage in the power drive unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P0A4F flags a generator resolver signal that drops out or jumps briefly and then recovers, as opposed to a steady fault. No manufacturer documents P0A4F publicly. Mitsubishi and Volvo handle short interruptions inside the general circuit code instead: Volvo lists P0A4B in its inverter generator module with the fault type intermittent, and Mitsubishi tells technicians to treat a resolver fault that cannot be reproduced as an intermittent malfunction of harness and connectors. CARB requires circuit continuity checks on hybrid input components. Loose terminals, fretting contacts, a chafed cable near moving parts or heat-related cracks are the usual suspects. P0A4B is the steady circuit fault, P0A4C plausibility, P0A4D/P0A4E low and high. Symptoms come and go, often with a brief loss of hybrid function.
possible_causes: Loose or fretting terminals in the resolver connectors [HIGH]
Chafed resolver cable that breaks contact under vibration [MEDIUM]
Heat-related cracks in wiring or solder joints [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A4F kennzeichnet ein Resolversignal des Generators, das kurz aussetzt oder springt und sich dann wieder fängt – im Gegensatz zum dauerhaften Fehler. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A4F öffentlich. Mitsubishi und Volvo behandeln kurze Unterbrechungen im allgemeinen Kreiscode: Volvo führt P0A4B im Generator-Wechselrichtermodul mit dem Fehlertyp „sporadisch“, und Mitsubishi verweist bei nicht reproduzierbarem Resolverfehler auf die Suche nach sporadischen Kabelbaum- und Steckerfehlern. P0A4B ist der Dauerfehler, P0A4C die Plausibilität, P0A4D/P0A4E Low/High. Die Symptome kommen und gehen, oft mit kurzem Ausfall der Hybridfunktion.

symptoms: Hybrid warning that appears and clears again
Short loss of electric drive or jerky power delivery
Fault often linked to bumps or heat

description: P0A50 says the generator speed derived from its resolver has exceeded the permitted maximum. Mitsubishi documents it for the 2023 Outlander PHEV: with at least 8.0 V at the generator control unit and the position sensor itself judged healthy, a speed of 15,500 rpm or more lasting 0.5 s stores P0A50, and the repair path ends with replacing the generator. Because a resolver fault would already be caught by P0A4B to P0A4F, an overspeed entry usually reflects a real mechanical overspeed, for example from a transaxle or clutch problem, or an internal generator fault. The drive motor counterparts are P0A44 and P0A4A. CARB requires hybrid components to be monitored. Expect a hybrid warning and the generator being shut off to protect it.
possible_causes: Internal generator fault (Mitsubishi repair path ends with generator replacement) [HIGH]
Mechanical fault in the transaxle or clutch letting the generator overrun [MEDIUM]
Incorrect speed calculation in the power drive unit [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 5000€ (1h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A50 besagt, dass die aus dem Resolver errechnete Generatordrehzahl das zulässige Maximum überschritten hat. Mitsubishi dokumentiert den Code für den Outlander PHEV 2023: Bei mindestens 8,0 V am Generator-Steuerteil und als intakt bewertetem Lagesensor speichert eine Drehzahl ab 15.500 1/min über 0,5 s P0A50; der Prüfablauf endet mit dem Tausch des Generators. Da ein Resolverfehler schon von P0A4B bis P0A4F erfasst würde, steht ein Überdrehzahl-Eintrag meist für eine echte mechanische Überdrehzahl, etwa durch ein Getriebe- oder Kupplungsproblem, oder einen inneren Generatorschaden. Die Gegenstücke der Fahrmotoren sind P0A44 und P0A4A. CARB verlangt die Überwachung von Hybridbauteilen. Folge: Hybrid-Warnung, der Generator wird zum Schutz abgeschaltet.

symptoms: Generator shut off, reduced power or engine-only drive

description: P0A51 reports a fault in the circuit of the current sensor that measures the phase current of drive motor A. The inverter needs this value for torque control and overcurrent protection. No manufacturer documents P0A51 publicly with its criteria. A Toyota patent shows the principle: a control sensor and a monitoring sensor measure the same motor current, and if the control sensor sits in its ground-short range or the two differ beyond a threshold over several cycles, the system flags the sensor and opens the main relays, because a wrong reading could drive the inverter into overcurrent. CARB requires circuit checks of hybrid input components. P0A52 covers plausibility, P0A53/P0A54 low and high; P0A55 is motor B. The hybrid system usually shuts down drive motor A.
possible_causes: Current sensor in the inverter assembly failed [HIGH]
Sensor supply or signal line interrupted inside the inverter [MEDIUM]
Evaluation circuit on the motor control board faulty [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 4500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Drive Motor A Current Sensor Circuit

bilingual_description.en: P0A51 reports a fault in the circuit of the current sensor that measures the phase current of drive motor A. The inverter needs this value for torque control and overcurrent protection. No manufacturer documents P0A51 publicly with its criteria. A Toyota patent shows the principle: a control sensor and a monitoring sensor measure the same motor current, and if the control sensor sits in its ground-short range or the two differ beyond a threshold over several cycles, the system flags the sensor and opens the main relays, because a wrong reading could drive the inverter into overcurrent. CARB requires circuit checks of hybrid input components. P0A52 covers plausibility, P0A53/P0A54 low and high; P0A55 is motor B. The hybrid system usually shuts down drive motor A.
bilingual_description.de: P0A51 meldet einen Fehler im Kreis des Stromsensors, der den Phasenstrom von Antriebsmotor A misst. Der Wechselrichter braucht diesen Wert für die Drehmomentregelung und den Überstromschutz. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A51 öffentlich mit Kriterien. Ein Toyota-Patent zeigt das Prinzip: Ein Regel- und ein Überwachungssensor messen denselben Motorstrom; liegt der Regelsensor im Bereich eines Masseschlusses oder weichen beide über mehrere Zyklen stärker als eine Schwelle ab, gilt der Sensor als defekt und die Hauptrelais öffnen – ein falscher Messwert könnte sonst den Wechselrichter in Überstrom treiben. CARB verlangt Kreisprüfungen für Hybrid-Eingangsbauteile. P0A52 ist die Plausibilität, P0A53/P0A54 Low/High, P0A55 betrifft Motor B. Meist legt das System Motor A still.

symptoms: Drive motor A disabled, vehicle may not move or runs on engine only

description: P0A52 means the current sensor of drive motor A delivers values that are electrically valid but do not fit the operating state. Typical checks compare the reading at zero current with its expected offset, or compare redundant sensors with each other. No manufacturer documents P0A52 publicly. A Hyundai patent describes compensating the sensor offset while no current flows and declaring the compensation abnormal when the offset leaves its allowed band; a Toyota patent compares a control sensor with a monitoring sensor and flags a lasting difference. CARB requires rationality checks of hybrid input components. P0A51 is the general circuit fault, P0A53 and P0A54 the hard low and high signal. A wrong current reading can cause torque errors, so the system limits or disables drive motor A.
possible_causes: Sensor offset drifted beyond the compensation range [HIGH]
Control and monitoring sensor disagree due to one degraded sensor [MEDIUM]
Electrical interference or poor ground on the sensor signal [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 4500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

A Hyundai patent describes compensating the sensor offset while no current flows and declaring the compensation abnormal when the offset leaves its allowed band; a Toyota patent compares a control sensor with a monitoring sensor and flags a lasting difference. CARB requires rationality checks of hybrid input components. P0A51 is the general circuit fault, P0A53 and P0A54 the hard low and high signal. A wrong current reading can cause torque errors, so the system limits or disables drive motor A.
bilingual_description.de: P0A52 bedeutet, dass der Stromsensor von Antriebsmotor A elektrisch gültige Werte liefert, die aber nicht zum Betriebszustand passen. Übliche Prüfungen vergleichen den Messwert bei Nullstrom mit dem erwarteten Offset oder redundante Sensoren miteinander. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A52 öffentlich. Ein falscher Strommesswert verursacht Drehmomentfehler, daher wird Motor A begrenzt oder gesperrt.

symptoms: Drive motor A disabled, engine-only operation

description: P0A53 is stored when the current sensor signal of drive motor A stays below its valid range, typically from a signal line shorted to ground, a lost sensor supply or a failed Hall element. No manufacturer documents P0A53 publicly. A Toyota patent explains why this matters: a sensor stuck in its ground-short range reports far less current than actually flows, so the current controller keeps raising the drive and can push the inverter into overcurrent; the described system therefore turns off the system relay and warns the driver once the condition repeats over consecutive cycles. CARB requires out-of-range checks for hybrid input components. P0A54 is the high counterpart, P0A51 the general circuit code, P0A52 plausibility. Drive motor A is shut down.
possible_causes: Sensor signal line shorted to ground [HIGH]
Sensor supply voltage missing [MEDIUM]
Hall element of the current sensor failed [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 4500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: P0A53 is stored when the current sensor signal of drive motor A stays below its valid range, typically from a signal line shorted to ground, a lost sensor supply or a failed Hall element. No manufacturer documents P0A53 publicly. A Toyota patent explains why this matters: a sensor stuck in its ground-short range reports far less current than actually flows, so the current controller keeps raising the drive and can push the inverter into overcurrent; the described system therefore turns off the system relay and warns the driver once the condition repeats over consecutive cycles. CARB requires out-of-range checks for hybrid input components. P0A54 is the high counterpart, P0A51 the general circuit code, P0A52 plausibility. Drive motor A is shut down.
bilingual_description.de: P0A53 wird gespeichert, wenn das Stromsensorsignal von Antriebsmotor A unter seinem gültigen Bereich bleibt – meist durch eine Signalleitung mit Masseschluss, eine ausgefallene Sensorversorgung oder ein defektes Hall-Element. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A53 öffentlich. Ein Toyota-Patent zeigt, warum das kritisch ist: Ein im Masseschluss-Bereich hängender Sensor meldet viel weniger Strom, als tatsächlich fließt; der Stromregler steuert nach und kann den Wechselrichter in Überstrom treiben. Das beschriebene System schaltet daher das Systemrelais ab und warnt, sobald der Zustand in aufeinanderfolgenden Zyklen auftritt. CARB verlangt Bereichsprüfungen für Hybrid-Eingangsbauteile. P0A54 ist das High-Gegenstück, P0A51 der allgemeine Kreiscode, P0A52 die Plausibilität. Motor A wird abgeschaltet.

Audi documents it on the 2021-23 Q5 e quattro (bulletin 2069917/1): P0A5D00, often with P0A6000 and P0A6300, is stored in the electric drive control module J841, the cluster reads Drive system: fault and the car may not start or drive. No manufacturer documents P0A66 publicly; GM, for instance, only uses the open-phase code P0A67 for this phase. The checks behind such a code are described in patents: a Caterpillar patent declares a phase sensor failed when the three phase currents no longer add up to roughly zero, and a Hyundai patent shows inverters that measure two phases and calculate the third. CARB requires circuit and rationality monitoring of electric drive components. P0A67 and P0A68 are the low and high variants, P0A69 and P0A6C cover phases V and W, P0A5D is the same code on motor A. Motor B is normally shut off.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Phase U Current High

bilingual_description.en: P0A71 is set when the current in phase U of the hybrid generator exceeds its permitted level. No manufacturer documents P0A71 publicly. The Toyota patent on current sensor monitoring applies directly, since its machine also runs as an engine-driven generator and starts the engine: a sensor stuck too low makes the controller push the real current far above command, and an overcurrent through the inverter can damage its switches, so the relays are opened. A real overcurrent can also come from a winding or insulation short in the generator or a shorted switch. CARB requires monitoring of electric drive components. P0A70 is the low side, P0A74 and P0A77 phases V and W, P0A6F the general code. The hybrid system usually shuts down.
bilingual_description.de: P0A71 wird gesetzt, wenn der Strom in Phase U des Hybrid-Generators sein zulässiges Maß überschreitet. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A71 öffentlich. Das Toyota-Patent zur Stromsensor-Überwachung passt unmittelbar, denn seine Maschine arbeitet auch als vom Verbrenner angetriebener Generator und startet den Motor: Hängt ein Sensor zu niedrig, treibt der Regler den tatsächlichen Strom weit über den Sollwert, und Überstrom kann die Schalter des Wechselrichters schädigen – also öffnen die Relais. Echter Überstrom entsteht auch durch einen Wicklungs- oder Isolationsschluss im Generator oder einen durchlegierten Schalter. CARB verlangt die Überwachung elektrischer Antriebsbauteile. P0A70 ist die Low-Seite, P0A74/P0A77 die Phasen V und W, P0A6F der allgemeine Code. Meist schaltet das Hybridsystem ab.

symptoms: Master warning or hybrid warning with MIL
Hybrid system shuts down; vehicle may not move or restart

description: P0A72 reports a fault in the phase V current of the hybrid generator. Toyota uses it: a field report filed with NHTSA covers a 2006 Highlander Hybrid with the MIL on and P0A72 stored together with P0A75 for generator phase W, P0A60 and P0A63 for drive motor A, and inverter performance codes including P0A78; after checking connector fit and the resistance of the three-phase cables, the inverter/converter assembly was replaced. The pairing of V and W codes fits inverters that measure two phases and calculate the third, as a Hyundai patent describes for its starter-generator. P0A73 and P0A74 are the low and high cases, P0A6F and P0A75 phases U and W. Expect a hybrid warning and possibly no drive.
possible_causes: Internal fault in the inverter/converter assembly (Toyota Highlander Hybrid) [HIGH]
Generator phase V current sensor failed [MEDIUM]
Poor pin fit or damaged three-phase cable to the generator [LOW]

Toyota nutzt den Code: Ein bei der NHTSA eingereichter Feldbericht beschreibt einen Highlander Hybrid 2006 mit MIL, in dem P0A72 zusammen mit P0A75 (Generatorphase W), P0A60 und P0A63 (Antriebsmotor A) sowie Wechselrichter-Funktionscodes wie P0A78 gespeichert war. Dass V und W gemeinsam auftreten, passt zu Wechselrichtern, die zwei Phasen messen und die dritte berechnen – so beschreibt es auch ein Hyundai-Patent für den Starter-Generator. symptoms: MIL and master warning, several hybrid codes at once
Vehicle may not move or enter ready mode

description: P0A73 indicates that phase V of the hybrid generator delivers or reports too little current under load. No manufacturer documents P0A73 publicly. On inverters that measure only phases V and W, a low V reading has a knock-on effect: the calculated U current is wrong as well, so the generator torque control loses accuracy. A Caterpillar patent shows the logic for three-sensor systems, where a near-zero reading plus a violated zero-sum identifies the failed sensor; a Toyota patent compares a control sensor with a monitoring sensor and the current command. CARB requires circuit monitoring of electric drive components. P0A74 is the high side, P0A70 and P0A76 phases U and W, P0A72 the general code. Charging and engine start can suffer.
possible_causes: Generator phase V current sensor reading near zero [HIGH]
Generator phase V lead or terminal open [MEDIUM]
Phase V switch in the generator inverter not conducting [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 6000€ (1.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Engine runs more often, battery charge does not recover

description: P0A74 appears when phase V of the hybrid generator shows more current than its limit allows. No manufacturer documents P0A74 publicly. A drifting sensor zero point is one candidate: a Hyundai patent covering both the traction motor and the starter-generator corrects phase sensor offsets and flags a fault when the correction fails. Real overcurrent is the other, for example from a winding or insulation short or a power switch that no longer turns off; a Toyota patent explains why the inverter then shuts down quickly. CARB requires monitoring of electric drive components. P0A73 is the low side, P0A71 and P0A77 phases U and W, P0A72 the general code. The hybrid system typically stops, and in power-split hybrids the car may lose drive entirely.
possible_causes: Phase V sensor offset drifted or offset correction failed [MEDIUM]
Power switch in the generator phase V leg not turning off [MEDIUM]
Winding or insulation short in generator phase V [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 7000€ (1.5h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A74 erscheint, wenn Phase V des Hybrid-Generators mehr Strom zeigt, als ihr Grenzwert zulässt. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A74 öffentlich. Ein möglicher Grund ist ein wandernder Sensor-Nullpunkt: Ein Hyundai-Patent für Fahrmotor und Starter-Generator gleicht die Offsets der Phasensensoren ab und meldet einen Fehler, wenn das nicht gelingt. CARB verlangt die Überwachung elektrischer Antriebsbauteile. P0A73 ist die Low-Seite, P0A71/P0A77 die Phasen U und W, P0A72 der allgemeine Code. symptoms: Master warning or hybrid warning with MIL
Hybrid system shutdown, possibly no propulsion

description: P0A75 stands for a fault in the phase W current of the hybrid generator. Toyota documents it in practice: in a field report from an NHTSA investigation of 2006 Highlander Hybrid inverters, P0A75 appeared next to P0A72, the drive motor phase codes P0A60 and P0A63 and inverter performance codes, and the root cause was inside the inverter/converter, which was replaced. A sudden cluster like this points more to the shared inverter than to the generator winding. A Toyota patent shows how a control and a monitoring current sensor are cross-checked so that a defective sensor is caught before it causes overcurrent. P0A76 and P0A77 are the low and high variants, P0A6F and P0A72 phases U and V. Ready mode or drive may be lost.

Generator phase W current sensor failed [MEDIUM]
Generator phase W cable or connector faulty [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: P0A75 steht für einen Fehler im Strom der Phase W des Hybrid-Generators. Toyota belegt den Code aus der Praxis: In einem Feldbericht aus einer NHTSA-Untersuchung zu Wechselrichtern des Highlander Hybrid 2006 trat P0A75 neben P0A72, den Fahrmotor-Phasencodes P0A60 und P0A63 sowie Wechselrichter-Funktionscodes auf; die Ursache lag im Wechselrichter/Wandler, der getauscht wurde. symptoms: MIL and master warning, usually with other hybrid codes
Vehicle will not become ready or will not move

description: P0A76 signals that phase W of the hybrid generator conducts or reports too little current while the generator should be producing or absorbing torque. No manufacturer documents P0A76 publicly. Physically, the generator phase leads run from the inverter into the transaxle or engine bay, so a loose bolted terminal, a cracked lead or a corroded connector can open the W path; electrically, a sensor fixed near zero gives the same reading. A Caterpillar patent separates both: a sensor fault is assumed when one phase reads about zero while the sum of the three no longer balances. A Hyundai patent shows separate generator phase sensors in the inverter. CARB requires circuit monitoring. P0A77 is the high side, P0A70 and P0A73 phases U and V.
possible_causes: Loose terminal, cracked lead or corroded connector in generator phase W [HIGH]
Generator phase W current sensor stuck near zero [MEDIUM]
Open phase W winding in the generator [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 6000€ (1.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0A76 meldet, dass Phase W des Hybrid-Generators zu wenig Strom führt oder meldet, während der Generator Moment erzeugen oder aufnehmen soll. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0A76 öffentlich. Mechanisch laufen die Generator-Phasenleitungen vom Wechselrichter ins Getriebe bzw. in den Motorraum – eine lose Schraubklemme, eine angebrochene Leitung oder ein korrodierter Stecker können den W-Pfad öffnen; elektrisch liefert ein auf null festsitzender Sensor dasselbe Bild. symptoms: Engine start harsh or delayed, charging reduced

description: P0A77 is the excess-current code for phase W of the hybrid generator. No manufacturer documents P0A77 publicly. When the engine drives the generator hard, for instance while charging or during engine start, a short between turns, a breakdown to the housing or a switch that fails closed can let the W current climb beyond its limit; a sensor with too much gain produces a similar picture without real overcurrent. A Toyota patent, whose machine also works as generator, describes stopping the inverter and opening the relays when current runs away; a Caterpillar patent checks the zero-sum of the phase currents to unmask a bad sensor. CARB requires monitoring of electric drive components. P0A76 is the low side, P0A71 and P0A74 phases U and V.
possible_causes: Turn-to-turn short or insulation breakdown in generator phase W [MEDIUM]
Power switch in the generator phase W leg failed closed [MEDIUM]
Generator phase W current sensor with excessive gain [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 7000€ (1.5h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Master warning or hybrid warning with MIL
Hybrid system shuts down during charging or engine start

description: P0A78 means the inverter stage feeding drive motor A has reported a power-switch fault. GM explains the check in its hybrid OBD tables: the IGBT module watches each phase for desaturation, a sign of a short between the upper and lower switch; if that status persists for about 2 ms the code sets as Type A, MIL on the first trip. Stellantis replaced the power inverter module on 2021 Jeep Wrangler 4xe with P0A78 and P0A79, which ran on engine power only, and refreshed hybrid control software on the 2017 Pacifica Hybrid. Land Rover logs P0A78 in the inverter converter of 2024-25 Range Rover models and asks not to clear it before diagnosis. P0A79 is motor B, P0A7A the generator inverter, P0A3C overheating of inverter A. Expect a warning and loss of electric drive.
possible_causes: IGBT desaturation or short in the inverter power stage [HIGH]
Power inverter module defective (replaced on Jeep Wrangler 4xe) [HIGH]
Hybrid control software requiring update [MEDIUM]
Shorted winding or phase cable of drive motor A [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 6000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P0A7A reports that the inverter stage driving the generator has signalled a fault, for example overcurrent or a failed power switch. Fault in the generator inside the transaxle [MEDIUM]
Insufficient inverter cooling stressing the power stage [LOW]

symptoms: MIL, master warning and Check Hybrid System message
Reduced power or vehicle will not enter ready mode

description: P0A7B is a request code: the battery energy control module, which has found an emissions-relevant fault of its own, asks the engine control module to switch on the MIL, and the engine controller stores P0A7B. The actual cause sits in a separate code in the battery module. GM documents this on the 2024-25 Corvette E-Ray: P0A7B in the K20 engine controller appears together with P0E3C in the battery module, caused by air trapped around the battery coolant pump after a repair; purging the air is the fix. Subaru reports P0A7B in the engine controller of the 2014 XV Crosstrek Hybrid alongside battery and drive motor codes after a frozen power relay. Diagnose the battery module codes first. P0AC4 is the matching request from the hybrid control module.
possible_causes: Emissions-relevant fault stored in the battery energy control module [HIGH]
Air trapped at the battery coolant pump (Corvette E-Ray, with P0E3C) [MEDIUM]
Frozen power supply relay of the drive motor control module (Subaru Crosstrek Hybrid) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: P0A7B is a request code: the battery energy control module, which has found an emissions-relevant fault of its own, asks the engine control module to switch on the MIL, and the engine controller stores P0A7B. The actual cause sits in a separate code in the battery module. GM documents this on the 2024-25 Corvette E-Ray: P0A7B in the K20 engine controller appears together with P0E3C in the battery module, caused by air trapped around the battery coolant pump after a repair; purging the air is the fix. Subaru reports P0A7B in the engine controller of the 2014 XV Crosstrek Hybrid alongside battery and drive motor codes after a frozen power relay. Diagnose the battery module codes first. P0AC4 is the matching request from the hybrid control module.
bilingual_description.de: P0A7B ist ein Anforderungscode: Das Batteriesteuergerät hat einen eigenen abgasrelevanten Fehler erkannt und bittet das Motorsteuergerät, die MIL einzuschalten; dort wird P0A7B abgelegt. Die eigentliche Ursache steht als eigener Code im Batteriesteuergerät. GM beschreibt das bei der Corvette E-Ray 2024–25: P0A7B im Motorsteuergerät K20 erscheint zusammen mit P0E3C im Batteriemodul, verursacht durch Luft, die sich nach einer Reparatur an der Kühlmittelpumpe der Batterie gesammelt hat; Abhilfe ist Entlüften. Subaru nennt P0A7B im Motorsteuergerät des XV Crosstrek Hybrid 2014 neben Batterie- und Fahrmotorcodes nach einem eingefrorenen Versorgungsrelais. Zuerst die Codes im Batteriesteuergerät diagnostizieren. P0AC4 ist die entsprechende Anforderung des Hybrid-Steuergeräts.

symptoms: Additional codes stored in the battery control module

description: P0A7C reports that the electronics controlling the hybrid motors, mainly the inverter, have run hotter than allowed. Ford uses the code on its hybrids and stores it in the PCM. A Ford bulletin for 2010-11 Fusion and Milan Hybrid and 2011 MKZ Hybrid built up to 9 September 2010 describes a wrench light with no drivability concern and P0A7C, cured by a PCM software update. Ford warranty statistics supplied to NHTSA list P0A7C as a recurring code on 2010-12 Escape, Tribute and Mariner Hybrid. Common physical causes are a failed coolant pump of the motor electronics cooling loop, low coolant, air in the loop or a blocked radiator. CARB requires monitoring of inverter thermal management. P0A3C and P0A3D cover the individual inverters. Power is reduced to protect the electronics.
possible_causes: Coolant pump of the motor electronics cooling loop failed [HIGH]
Low coolant or air in the electronics cooling loop [MEDIUM]
PCM calibration triggering the code without real overheating (Ford Fusion Hybrid) [MEDIUM]
Blocked electronics radiator or faulty cooling fan [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1200€ (0.3h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Ford uses the code on its hybrids and stores it in the PCM. P0A3C and P0A3D cover the individual inverters. Power is reduced to protect the electronics.
bilingual_description.de: P0A7C meldet, dass die Elektronik zur Steuerung der Hybridmotoren, vor allem der Wechselrichter, heißer als zulässig geworden ist. Ford nutzt den Code in seinen Hybriden und speichert ihn im PCM. Ein Ford-Bulletin für Fusion und Milan Hybrid 2010–11 sowie MKZ Hybrid 2011, gebaut bis 9. September 2010, beschreibt eine Schraubenschlüssel-Leuchte ohne Fahrprobleme mit P0A7C; abgeholfen wurde per PCM-Softwareupdate. Ford-Garantiestatistiken an die NHTSA führen P0A7C als wiederkehrenden Code bei Escape, Tribute und Mariner Hybrid 2010–12. Typische Ursachen sind eine ausgefallene Kühlmittelpumpe des Elektronik-Kühlkreises, Kühlmittelmangel, Luft im Kreis oder ein verstopfter Kühler. CARB verlangt die Überwachung des Wechselrichter-Thermomanagements. P0A3C/P0A3D betreffen die einzelnen Wechselrichter. Die Leistung wird zum Schutz reduziert.

symptoms: Reduced power, especially under high load or heat

description: The battery controller watches whether the traction or mild-hybrid pack stays inside its usable state-of-charge (SOC) window. GM sets P0A7D (Type B, two trips) when SOC stays below a program threshold (30 % or 10.5 %) for more than half of a drive cycle longer than 50 km, after allowing generator time to recover. Ford reports it on 2020 Escape/Explorer Hybrid after a deep discharge from long standing or crank/no-start, and Audi on 48 V systems whose protection relays open at low SOC. Unlike P0A7F/P0A80 the pack itself is not judged worn; it is simply too empty. Expect no EV mode, weak assist or, in severe cases, a no-start until the pack is recharged.
possible_causes: Pack discharged by long standing time or repeated crank/no-start attempts [HIGH]
Generator, DC/DC or charging path not replenishing the pack [MEDIUM]
48 V battery in low-voltage protection state (relays open) [MEDIUM]
Weak or self-discharging cell modules [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack State of Charge Low

bilingual_description.en: The battery controller watches whether the traction or mild-hybrid pack stays inside its usable state-of-charge (SOC) window. GM sets P0A7D (Type B, two trips) when SOC stays below a program threshold (30 % or 10.5 %) for more than half of a drive cycle longer than 50 km, after allowing generator time to recover. Ford reports it on 2020 Escape/Explorer Hybrid after a deep discharge from long standing or crank/no-start, and Audi on 48 V systems whose protection relays open at low SOC. Unlike P0A7F/P0A80 the pack itself is not judged worn; it is simply too empty. Expect no EV mode, weak assist or, in severe cases, a no-start until the pack is recharged.
bilingual_description.de: Das Batteriesteuergerät prüft, ob der Traktions- oder 48-V-Akku im nutzbaren Ladezustandsfenster bleibt. GM setzt P0A7D (Typ B, zwei Fahrten), wenn der Ladezustand je nach Programm unter 30 % bzw. 10,5 % liegt – und zwar über mehr als die Hälfte eines Fahrzyklus von über 50 km, nachdem der Generator Zeit zum Nachladen hatte. Ford nennt den Code beim Escape/Explorer Hybrid 2020 nach Tiefentladung durch langes Stehen oder Startversuche, Audi bei 48-V-Batterien, deren Schutzrelais bei leerem Akku öffnen. Anders als P0A7F/P0A80 bedeutet er keinen Verschleiß, sondern einen zu leeren Akku. Folgen: kein E-Betrieb, schwache Unterstützung, im Extremfall kein Start, bis nachgeladen wird.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning
No electric driving or reduced motor assist
Engine runs longer to recharge the pack
Vehicle may not start or reach ready mode

description: The pack controller compares the hottest module temperature with a protection limit. GM sets P0A7E, mostly as Type A (MIL after one trip), when the maximum module temperature exceeds a program limit between about 61 and 73.5 °C, unless a temperature sensor fault is active. Subaru documents it on the 2014–16 Crosstrek Hybrid, where too strict logic for heat after shutdown cut assist and auto start-stop; GM links it on eAssist cars to a cooling fan that stops at low system voltage; Porsche saw it with implausible sensor signals on the 911 GTS T-Hybrid. Sensor circuit faults have their own codes (P0A9B–P0A9E). The car limits charge and discharge power to protect the cells.
possible_causes: Battery cooling fan inoperative or intake/filter clogged [HIGH]
Battery controller software logic (update released by Subaru, Porsche) [MEDIUM]
Low 12 V system voltage stopping the cooling fan [MEDIUM]
Aged cells with high internal resistance heating up [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 3000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Over Temperature

bilingual_description.en: The pack controller compares the hottest module temperature with a protection limit. GM sets P0A7E, mostly as Type A (MIL after one trip), when the maximum module temperature exceeds a program limit between about 61 and 73.5 °C, unless a temperature sensor fault is active. Subaru documents it on the 2014–16 Crosstrek Hybrid, where too strict logic for heat after shutdown cut assist and auto start-stop; GM links it on eAssist cars to a cooling fan that stops at low system voltage; Porsche saw it with implausible sensor signals on the 911 GTS T-Hybrid. Sensor circuit faults have their own codes (P0A9B–P0A9E). The car limits charge and discharge power to protect the cells.
bilingual_description.de: Das Batteriesteuergerät vergleicht die heißeste Modultemperatur mit einer Schutzgrenze. GM setzt P0A7E meist als Typ A (MIL nach einer Fahrt), wenn sie eine Programmgrenze zwischen etwa 61 und 73,5 °C überschreitet und kein Temperaturfühlerfehler vorliegt. Subaru beschreibt den Code beim Crosstrek Hybrid 2014–16: Eine zu knapp bemessene Schwelle für die Eigenwärme nach dem Abstellen legte Rekuperation und Start-Stopp still. GM verknüpft ihn bei eAssist-Modellen mit einem Batterielüfter, der bei Unterspannung stehen bleibt, Porsche beim 911 GTS T-Hybrid mit unplausiblen Fühlersignalen. Fühlerkreisfehler haben eigene Codes (P0A9B–P0A9E). Das Fahrzeug drosselt Lade- und Entladeleistung.

symptoms: Hybrid system warning and check engine light
In rare cases warning with no-start

description: This is the state-of-health monitor that CARB requires for hybrid storage systems. GM compares the calculated pack power capability with an end-of-life table at mid state of charge and sets P0A7F as Type B (two trips) when it falls short. Honda reports it as battery module deterioration on the 2009 Civic Hybrid and as serious capacity deterioration on the 2014 Accord Plug-In; Mercedes uses it when the 48 V module reaches its health limit, partly fixed by software. Toyota bulletins for Prius, Prius v and Camry Hybrid name a clogged battery cooling fan as a trigger. P0A80 is the harder replace-pack verdict. Drivers notice weaker assist, more engine running and higher fuel use.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Poor connections at the HV battery, A problem with the HV battery, ECU issues

possible_causes: Pack capacity or power capability lost through ageing [HIGH]
Dust or debris in the battery cooling fan or filter overheating cells [MEDIUM]
Battery controller software misjudging health (Honda, Mercedes) [MEDIUM]
Individual weak modules pulling the pack down [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 8000€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Deterioration

bilingual_description.en: This is the state-of-health monitor that CARB requires for hybrid storage systems. GM compares the calculated pack power capability with an end-of-life table at mid state of charge and sets P0A7F as Type B (two trips) when it falls short. Honda reports it as battery module deterioration on the 2009 Civic Hybrid and as serious capacity deterioration on the 2014 Accord Plug-In; Mercedes uses it when the 48 V module reaches its health limit, partly fixed by software. Toyota bulletins for Prius, Prius v and Camry Hybrid name a clogged battery cooling fan as a trigger. P0A80 is the harder replace-pack verdict. Drivers notice weaker assist, more engine running and higher fuel use.
bilingual_description.de: Hier sitzt die Zustandsüberwachung (State of Health), die CARB für Hybrid-Speicher vorschreibt. GM vergleicht die berechnete Leistungsfähigkeit des Packs bei mittlerem Ladezustand mit einer Lebensende-Tabelle und setzt P0A7F als Typ B (zwei Fahrten), wenn sie darunter fällt. Honda nennt den Code beim Civic Hybrid 2009 Batteriemodul-Verschleiß und beim Accord Plug-In 2014 starken Kapazitätsverlust; Mercedes meldet so das Erreichen der Gesundheitsgrenze des 48-V-Moduls und behebt Fehlmeldungen per Software. Toyota-Bulletins für Prius, Prius v und Camry Hybrid nennen einen verstaubten Batterielüfter als Auslöser. P0A80 ist das schärfere Urteil „Pack tauschen“. Spürbar: schwächere Unterstützung, öfter laufender Motor, Mehrverbrauch.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid/IMA warning light
Weak acceleration assist, especially from a stop
Engine runs more often, higher fuel consumption
Shorter electric range on plug-in models

description: The battery controller has concluded that the pack is at end of life. In GM tables this is a resistance test: the maximum cell or pack resistance, measured from current and voltage swings, exceeds a temperature-dependent end-of-life threshold, and the code sets as Type A after one trip. Toyota bulletins for Prius (2004–09, 2013–15), Prius v and Camry Hybrid report P0A80, often together with P0A7F, caused by dust in the battery cooling fan; cleaning the fan comes first. Honda recalled the 2018 Accord Hybrid because software wrongly set this code as a permanent fault after pack replacement. Compared with P0A7F it is the final verdict; assist and economy drop and the MIL stays on.

specific_definitions.AUDI: High voltage battery assembly failure

possible_causes: Cell or module resistance above end-of-life limit [HIGH]
Clogged battery cooling fan or intake filter (Toyota) [MEDIUM]
Controller software misreading a replaced pack (Honda Accord Hybrid 2018) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 10000€ (1h - 10h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Replace Hybrid/EV Battery Pack

bilingual_description.en: The battery controller has concluded that the pack is at end of life. In GM tables this is a resistance test: the maximum cell or pack resistance, measured from current and voltage swings, exceeds a temperature-dependent end-of-life threshold, and the code sets as Type A after one trip. Toyota bulletins for Prius (2004–09, 2013–15), Prius v and Camry Hybrid report P0A80, often together with P0A7F, caused by dust in the battery cooling fan; cleaning the fan comes first. Honda recalled the 2018 Accord Hybrid because software wrongly set this code as a permanent fault after pack replacement. Compared with P0A7F it is the final verdict; assist and economy drop and the MIL stays on.
bilingual_description.de: Das Batteriesteuergerät hält das Pack für verbraucht. In den GM-Tabellen ist das ein Widerstandstest: Der aus Strom- und Spannungssprüngen berechnete höchste Zell- oder Packwiderstand übersteigt eine temperaturabhängige Lebensende-Schwelle, der Code wird als Typ A nach einer Fahrt gesetzt. Toyota beschreibt P0A80 für Prius (2004–09, 2013–15), Prius v und Camry Hybrid, oft zusammen mit P0A7F, ausgelöst durch Staub im Batterielüfter – erst den Lüfter reinigen. Honda rief den Accord Hybrid 2018 zurück, weil eine Software den Code nach einem Packtausch fälschlich als permanenten Fehler setzte. Gegenüber P0A7F ist das das Endurteil; Unterstützung und Verbrauch verschlechtern sich, die MIL bleibt an.

symptoms: Check engine and hybrid system warning on
Higher fuel consumption, engine runs more

description: The controller watches the output that drives battery cooling fan 1 for an open circuit. In the 2016 GM table the fan is commanded at low duty (under 10 %) and the circuit voltage sits between about 1.6 and 5.85 V instead of being pulled low; 16 failures in 20 samples set it as Type B. An older GM program used it as a general fan unit fault judged by a monitor voltage. Ford found P0A81, often with P0A96 for fan 2, in the battery control module of 2005–12 Escape and Mariner Hybrids and replaced both fans; drivers usually noticed nothing. Low and high faults have their own codes (P0A84, P0A85). Without airflow the pack heats up and power may be limited.
possible_causes: Fan motor or its internal electronics open [HIGH]
Loose or corroded fan connector, broken control wire [MEDIUM]
Blown fan supply fuse [MEDIUM]
Faulty output stage in the battery control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 900€ (0.5h - 3.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The controller watches the output that drives battery cooling fan 1 for an open circuit. In the 2016 GM table the fan is commanded at low duty (under 10 %) and the circuit voltage sits between about 1.6 and 5.85 V instead of being pulled low; 16 failures in 20 samples set it as Type B. An older GM program used it as a general fan unit fault judged by a monitor voltage. Ford found P0A81, often with P0A96 for fan 2, in the battery control module of 2005–12 Escape and Mariner Hybrids and replaced both fans; drivers usually noticed nothing. Low and high faults have their own codes (P0A84, P0A85). Without airflow the pack heats up and power may be limited.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät prüft den Ausgang für Batterielüfter 1 auf Unterbrechung. In der GM-Tabelle von 2016 wird der Lüfter mit kleinem Tastverhältnis (unter 10 %) angesteuert; liegt die Kreisspannung dabei zwischen etwa 1,6 und 5,85 V statt nahe null, zählt ein Fehler – 16 von 20 Proben ergeben Typ B. Ein älteres GM-Programm nutzte den Code als allgemeinen Lüfterfehler über eine Überwachungsspannung. Ford fand P0A81, oft zusammen mit P0A96 für Lüfter 2, im Batteriesteuergerät von Escape und Mariner Hybrid 2005–12 und tauschte beide Lüfter; der Fahrer merkte meist nichts. Kurzschlüsse haben eigene Codes (P0A84, P0A85). Fehlt die Kühlluft, wird der Akku warm und die Leistung ggf. gedrosselt.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid warning, often no other complaint
Battery cooling fan does not run when commanded
Reduced hybrid power in hot conditions

description: This code covers a fan 1 that is electrically intact but does not deliver the requested cooling, up to standing still. No manufacturer publishes code-exact criteria; CARB requires a functional check of battery cooling where feasible. Typical methods: GM compares commanded and fed-back fan speed (filed under its own sense code P0BC8), Toyota flags a fan whose feedback-corrected duty deviates too far from the expected value, and Honda compares expected and measured battery temperature rise. Causes are mostly mechanical: dust on the blades, a clogged intake filter, worn bearings. Circuit faults use P0A81/P0A84/P0A85; the stuck-on case is P0A83. The pack runs hotter and power may be limited.
possible_causes: Dust or debris on fan blades or in the duct [HIGH]
Clogged or covered battery air intake or filter [HIGH]
Worn or seized fan motor bearings [MEDIUM]
Faulty fan speed feedback signal [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Performance/Stuck Off

bilingual_description.en: This code covers a fan 1 that is electrically intact but does not deliver the requested cooling, up to standing still. No manufacturer publishes code-exact criteria; CARB requires a functional check of battery cooling where feasible. Typical methods: GM compares commanded and fed-back fan speed (filed under its own sense code P0BC8), Toyota flags a fan whose feedback-corrected duty deviates too far from the expected value, and Honda compares expected and measured battery temperature rise. Causes are mostly mechanical: dust on the blades, a clogged intake filter, worn bearings. Circuit faults use P0A81/P0A84/P0A85; the stuck-on case is P0A83. The pack runs hotter and power may be limited.
bilingual_description.de: Der Code steht für einen elektrisch intakten Lüfter 1, der die geforderte Kühlung nicht bringt – bis hin zum Stillstand. Kein Hersteller veröffentlicht codegenaue Kriterien; CARB verlangt, soweit machbar, eine Funktionsprüfung der Batteriekühlung. Gängige Verfahren: GM vergleicht Soll- und Ist-Drehzahl (bei GM unter dem eigenen Code P0BC8 abgelegt), Toyota erkennt einen Lüfter, dessen nachgeregeltes Tastverhältnis zu weit vom erwarteten Wert abweicht, Honda vergleicht erwartete und gemessene Erwärmung des Akkus. Ursachen sind meist mechanisch: Staub auf dem Lüfterrad, zugesetzter Filter, verschlissene Lager. Kreisfehler laufen über P0A81/P0A84/P0A85, Dauerlauf über P0A83. Folge: wärmerer Akku, ggf. weniger Leistung.

symptoms: Hybrid warning or check engine light
Fan audibly weak or silent under load
Reduced electric assist in warm weather

description: P0A83 means battery cooling fan 1 keeps turning although the controller has switched it off. No manufacturer publicly documents this exact code. CARB asks for fan outputs to be checked for proper response to commands. GM shows the method under its sense code P0BC8: with the fan off for more than 20 s, a reported speed above about 250 rpm counts as a fault. Likely causes are a control wire shorted to supply, a welded fan relay (GM files that as P0BC1) or a fan controller that ignores the command. The pack stays cool, but the fan drains the 12 V battery when parked and stays loud. Do not confuse it with P0A82 (fan too weak or off) or the circuit codes P0A81/P0A84/P0A85.
possible_causes: Fan control wire shorted to supply voltage [MEDIUM]
Welded fan relay keeps power applied [MEDIUM]
Fan's internal speed controller ignores off command [MEDIUM]
Battery control module output stuck active [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Stuck On

bilingual_description.en: P0A83 means battery cooling fan 1 keeps turning although the controller has switched it off. No manufacturer publicly documents this exact code. CARB asks for fan outputs to be checked for proper response to commands. GM shows the method under its sense code P0BC8: with the fan off for more than 20 s, a reported speed above about 250 rpm counts as a fault. Likely causes are a control wire shorted to supply, a welded fan relay (GM files that as P0BC1) or a fan controller that ignores the command. The pack stays cool, but the fan drains the 12 V battery when parked and stays loud. Do not confuse it with P0A82 (fan too weak or off) or the circuit codes P0A81/P0A84/P0A85.
bilingual_description.de: P0A83 heißt: Batterielüfter 1 dreht weiter, obwohl das Steuergerät ihn abgeschaltet hat. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert genau diesen Code öffentlich. CARB verlangt, dass Lüfterausgänge auf korrekte Reaktion auf Befehle geprüft werden. Wie das geht, zeigt GM unter dem eigenen Sensorcode P0BC8: Ist der Lüfter länger als 20 s aus und meldet trotzdem über etwa 250 U/min, zählt das als Fehler. Wahrscheinliche Ursachen sind eine Steuerleitung mit Schluss nach Plus, ein verschweißtes Lüfterrelais (bei GM als P0BC1 geführt) oder eine Lüfterelektronik, die den Befehl ignoriert. Der Akku bleibt kühl, doch der Lüfter leert im Stand die 12-V-Batterie und bleibt laut. Abgrenzung: P0A82 (zu schwach/aus) und Kreiscodes P0A81/P0A84/P0A85.

symptoms: Battery fan heard running with the vehicle off or idle

description: The controller detects a short to ground on the control output of battery cooling fan 1. GM tests it while the fan is commanded at low duty: a circuit voltage below about 0.26 V counts as a failure, and 16 fails in 20 samples at 250 ms set a Type B code (MIL after two trips). Another GM hybrid program detects it through the output stage status flag (20 of 25 samples). Mitsubishi lists P0A84 in the BMU and PHEV ECU of the 2018–20 Outlander PHEV among codes caused by a frozen battery heater relay, so meaning can differ by maker. Open and high faults are P0A81 and P0A85. With the output pulled low the fan may not respond, the pack warms up and power can be reduced.
possible_causes: Fan control wire chafed and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in the fan's control input [MEDIUM]
Moisture or corrosion in the fan connector [LOW]
Defective output stage in the controller [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The controller detects a short to ground on the control output of battery cooling fan 1. GM tests it while the fan is commanded at low duty: a circuit voltage below about 0.26 V counts as a failure, and 16 fails in 20 samples at 250 ms set a Type B code (MIL after two trips). Another GM hybrid program detects it through the output stage status flag (20 of 25 samples). Mitsubishi lists P0A84 in the BMU and PHEV ECU of the 2018–20 Outlander PHEV among codes caused by a frozen battery heater relay, so meaning can differ by maker. Open and high faults are P0A81 and P0A85. With the output pulled low the fan may not respond, the pack warms up and power can be reduced.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät erkennt einen Masseschluss am Steuerausgang von Batterielüfter 1. GM prüft bei kleiner Ansteuerung: Liegt die Kreisspannung unter etwa 0,26 V, zählt ein Fehler; 16 Fehler in 20 Proben im 250-ms-Takt ergeben Typ B (MIL nach zwei Fahrten). Ein weiteres GM-Hybridprogramm erkennt den Fehler über das Statusflag der Endstufe (20 von 25 Proben). Mitsubishi führt P0A84 im BMU und PHEV-Steuergerät des Outlander PHEV 2018–20 unter den Codes eines eingefrorenen Batterieheizrelais – die Bedeutung kann also je Hersteller abweichen. Unterbrechung und Plusschluss sind P0A81 und P0A85. Liegt der Ausgang auf Masse, reagiert der Lüfter ggf. nicht, der Akku wird warm und die Leistung kann sinken.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid warning after two trips
Battery cooling fan does not follow commands
Reduced hybrid power when the pack gets warm

description: The controller detects a short to voltage on the control output of battery cooling fan 1. GM runs the test while the fan is commanded between 11 % and 100 % duty: a circuit voltage above 9 V counts as a failure, and 16 fails in 20 samples set a Type B code with MIL after two trips. GM tables from 2013, 2016, 2018 and 2019 hybrid programs carry it, partly via the output stage status flag. Depending on the circuit, the fan may run constantly at full speed or not respond. The low and open counterparts are P0A84 and P0A81; a fan that keeps running without a circuit fault is P0A83.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to a supply voltage [HIGH]
Fan control input internally open or shorted to its supply [MEDIUM]
Corroded connector creating leakage to supply [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The controller detects a short to voltage on the control output of battery cooling fan 1. GM runs the test while the fan is commanded between 11 % and 100 % duty: a circuit voltage above 9 V counts as a failure, and 16 fails in 20 samples set a Type B code with MIL after two trips. GM tables from 2013, 2016, 2018 and 2019 hybrid programs carry it, partly via the output stage status flag. Depending on the circuit, the fan may run constantly at full speed or not respond. The low and open counterparts are P0A84 and P0A81; a fan that keeps running without a circuit fault is P0A83.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät erkennt einen Plusschluss am Steuerausgang von Batterielüfter 1. GM prüft, während der Lüfter mit 11 % bis 100 % angesteuert wird: Über 9 V Kreisspannung zählen als Fehler, 16 Fehler in 20 Proben setzen Typ B mit MIL nach zwei Fahrten. Der Code steht in GM-Tabellen der Hybridprogramme 2013, 2016, 2018 und 2019, teils über das Statusflag der Endstufe. Je nach Schaltung läuft der Lüfter dann dauernd mit voller Drehzahl oder reagiert gar nicht. Gegenstücke sind P0A84 (Masseschluss) und P0A81 (Unterbrechung); dreht der Lüfter ohne Kreisfehler weiter, gilt P0A83.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid warning after two trips
Battery fan runs constantly or not at all
Possible 12 V battery drain when parked

description: The 14 volt power module is the DC/DC converter that feeds the 12 V network of a hybrid or electric vehicle from the high-voltage battery; GM calls it the Accessory Power Module (APM). Current sensor A measures the current flowing through this converter. P0A86 is the general circuit code for that sensor, used when the controller recognises a fault in the sensor circuit without classifying it as low, high, implausible or intermittent (P0A87 to P0A8A). No manufacturer documents this code publicly; GM's published tables for the same APM input sensor use only the low/high codes P0A88 and P0A89. With an untrustworthy current reading the hybrid controller may limit or switch off the converter, so the 12 V battery can run down over time.
possible_causes: Current sensor inside the 14 V power module faulty (usually not replaceable separately) [HIGH]
Damaged wiring or corroded connector between module and hybrid controller [MEDIUM]
Software fault in the module or hybrid controller [LOW]

Stromsensor A erfasst den Strom durch diesen Wandler.
