bilingual_description.en: P0AA9 reports that the isolation sensor signal sits below its valid window, typically because the sense line or the measuring input is pulled toward ground or has lost its supply. GM's 2016 and 2019 tables flag it when the sensor reads under 5 V with the bias switch open in 320 of 400 samples (about 5 s), Type B, two trips; the 2013 GM table uses a negative mid-pack reading under 5 V with contactors closed. bilingual_description.de: P0AA9 meldet, dass das Signal des Isolationssensors unter seinem gültigen Fenster liegt – meist, weil Messleitung oder Messeingang nach Masse gezogen werden oder die Versorgung fehlt. In GMs Tabellen 2016 und 2019 setzt der Code, wenn der Sensor bei offenem Vorschalter in 320 von 400 Messungen (etwa 5 s) unter 5 V liegt, Typ B, zwei Fahrten; die GM-Tabelle 2013 prüft einen negativen Mittelabgriff-Wert unter 5 V bei geschlossenen Schützen. Ein zu niedriger Wert ist ein Messfehler, kein Beleg für Isolationsverlust (P0AA6). Folgen: Warnleuchten, eventuell weniger Leistung.

symptoms: Check engine and EV system warning lights
Reduced power or speed limit on some models

description: P0AAA is the high-side counterpart of P0AA9: the isolation sensor reports a rail-to-ground voltage above anything the pack can produce. GM's tables tie the limit to the pack: over 333 V in the 2016 table and over 416 V in the 2019 table, each in 320 of 400 samples with the bias switch open, Type B, two trips. The 2013 GM table instead flags a mid-pack reading that differs from the motor controller's voltage by more than 15 V. Likely sources are an open reference or ground in the measuring circuit or a failed input stage in the battery controller. No public bulletin from another maker names this code. The car usually stays drivable with warnings, but isolation monitoring is lost, and P0AA6 cannot be trusted until it is fixed.
possible_causes: Open ground or reference in the isolation measuring circuit [HIGH]
Failed isolation input stage in the battery controller [MEDIUM]
Sense lead shorted to another HV potential inside the pack [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0AAA ist das Gegenstück zu P0AA9 für zu hohe Werte: Der Isolationssensor meldet eine Schienenspannung gegen Masse, die der Akku gar nicht liefern kann. GM koppelt die Grenze an den Akku: über 333 V in der Tabelle 2016, über 416 V in der Tabelle 2019, jeweils in 320 von 400 Messungen bei offenem Vorschalter, Typ B, zwei Fahrten. Die GM-Tabelle 2013 wertet dagegen eine Abweichung des Mittelabgriff-Werts von über 15 V gegenüber der Spannung des Motorsteuergeräts. Wahrscheinlich sind eine offene Referenz- oder Masseverbindung der Messschaltung oder eine defekte Eingangsstufe im Batteriesteuergerät. Andere Hersteller nennen den Code nicht öffentlich. Meist bleibt das Auto mit Warnleuchte fahrbar, aber die Isolationsüberwachung fehlt, und P0AA6 ist bis zur Reparatur nicht verlässlich.

symptoms: Check engine and hybrid or EV warning lights
Isolation monitoring disabled while the code is active

description: P0AAB covers an isolation sensor signal that jumps or drops out briefly instead of staying wrong. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; GM's hybrid tables use only P0AA7 to P0AAA for the measuring circuit. CARB requires hybrid input components to be monitored for circuit and rationality faults, which is the basis for this code. The best public analogue is Mitsubishi's 2018 Outlander PHEV campaign, where noise from the shift selector, brakes or A/C made the sub-BMU misjudge its leak detection circuit, setting P0AA7 to P0AA9. Check for software updates, then for loose connectors at the battery controller. Erratic readings can mask a true insulation fault (P0AA6). Expect warnings that come and go.
possible_causes: Electrical noise misinterpreted by controller software [HIGH]
Loose or corroded sense connector at the battery controller [MEDIUM]
Failing isolation measuring circuit inside the controller [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: P0AAB covers an isolation sensor signal that jumps or drops out briefly instead of staying wrong. No manufacturer documents this code publicly; GM's hybrid tables use only P0AA7 to P0AAA for the measuring circuit. CARB requires hybrid input components to be monitored for circuit and rationality faults, which is the basis for this code. The best public analogue is Mitsubishi's 2018 Outlander PHEV campaign, where noise from the shift selector, brakes or A/C made the sub-BMU misjudge its leak detection circuit, setting P0AA7 to P0AA9. Check for software updates, then for loose connectors at the battery controller. Erratic readings can mask a true insulation fault (P0AA6). Expect warnings that come and go.
bilingual_description.de: P0AAB steht für ein Signal des Isolationssensors, das springt oder kurz aussetzt, statt dauerhaft falsch zu sein. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; GMs Hybridtabellen nutzen für die Messschaltung nur P0AA7 bis P0AAA. Grundlage ist die CARB-Vorgabe, Eingangsbauteile von Hybridsystemen auf Kreis- und Plausibilitätsfehler zu überwachen. Das nächste öffentliche Beispiel ist Mitsubishis Aktion für den Outlander PHEV 2018: Störsignale von Wählhebel, Bremse oder Klimaanlage ließen die Sub-BMU ihre Leckerkennung falsch bewerten (P0AA7 bis P0AA9). Zuerst nach Software-Updates suchen, dann Stecker am Batteriesteuergerät prüfen. Unstete Werte können einen echten Isolationsfehler (P0AA6) verdecken. Typisch sind Warnleuchten, die kommen und gehen.

symptoms: Hybrid or EV warning lights that come and go
Occasional power limitation that clears after restart

description: Air-cooled hybrid batteries carry a thermistor in the cooling air path; GM calls sensor A the inlet air sensor. The battery controller uses it to run the fan and to judge cooling. P0AAC is the general circuit code, set for an electrical fault that is not classified as low, high or erratic. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly; GM reports the siblings P0AAD to P0AAF instead, with Type B, two-trip logic. CARB requires hybrid component temperature sensors to be monitored like other input components. If the controller has no valid air temperature, it typically falls back to fixed fan control and may restrict battery power. Check connector and wiring at the air inlet duct first, then the sensor.
possible_causes: Loose, corroded or damaged sensor connector or wiring at the air duct [HIGH]
Failed air temperature thermistor [MEDIUM]
Battery controller input or reference voltage fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

The battery controller uses it to run the fan and to judge cooling. P0AAC is the general circuit code, set for an electrical fault that is not classified as low, high or erratic. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly; GM reports the siblings P0AAD to P0AAF instead, with Type B, two-trip logic. CARB requires hybrid component temperature sensors to be monitored like other input components. If the controller has no valid air temperature, it typically falls back to fixed fan control and may restrict battery power. Check connector and wiring at the air inlet duct first, then the sensor.
bilingual_description.de: Luftgekühlte Hybridakkus haben einen NTC-Fühler im Kühlluftstrom; bei GM ist Sensor A der Fühler am Lufteinlass. Das Batteriesteuergerät steuert damit den Lüfter und bewertet die Kühlung. P0AAC ist der allgemeine Stromkreiscode für einen elektrischen Fehler, der nicht als zu niedrig, zu hoch oder unstet eingeordnet wird. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert genau diesen Code öffentlich; GM meldet stattdessen die Geschwister P0AAD bis P0AAF, jeweils Typ B mit zwei Fahrten. CARB verlangt, Temperaturfühler von Hybridkomponenten wie andere Eingangsbauteile zu überwachen. Fehlt ein gültiger Lufttemperaturwert, nutzt das Steuergerät meist eine feste Lüfteransteuerung und begrenzt unter Umständen die Akkuleistung. Zuerst Stecker und Leitung am Lufteinlass prüfen, dann den Fühler.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid system warning light
Battery cooling fan runs constantly or at fixed speed
Reduced electric assist in hot conditions

description: P0AAD is the plausibility check for battery air temperature sensor A: the signal is electrically valid but does not fit other temperatures. GM documents two methods. In the 2011 and 2013 full-size two-mode hybrid tables, at power-up the inlet air reading may not exceed the outlet air reading by more than 20 °C, checked once per start. In GM's 2013 table (13OBDG05C), after more than 8 hours off the inlet sensor may not differ from the average battery core temperature by more than 10 °C, 50 of 62 samples. Both are Type B, two trips. A sensor stuck at a plausible value, a sensor out of the air stream or a faulty core sensor can cause it. The car keeps running, but fan control and power limits may be wrong.
possible_causes: Thermistor drifted or stuck at a plausible value [HIGH]
Sensor displaced from the air stream or duct blocked [MEDIUM]
Fault in the comparison sensor (outlet air or cell temperature) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Air Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: P0AAD is the plausibility check for battery air temperature sensor A: the signal is electrically valid but does not fit other temperatures. GM documents two methods. In the 2011 and 2013 full-size two-mode hybrid tables, at power-up the inlet air reading may not exceed the outlet air reading by more than 20 °C, checked once per start. In GM's 2013 table (13OBDG05C), after more than 8 hours off the inlet sensor may not differ from the average battery core temperature by more than 10 °C, 50 of 62 samples. Both are Type B, two trips. A sensor stuck at a plausible value, a sensor out of the air stream or a faulty core sensor can cause it. The car keeps running, but fan control and power limits may be wrong.
bilingual_description.de: P0AAD ist die Plausibilitätsprüfung für Akku-Lufttemperatursensor A: Das Signal ist elektrisch gültig, passt aber nicht zu anderen Temperaturen. GM beschreibt zwei Verfahren. Bei den großen Two-Mode-Hybriden (Tabellen 2011 und 2013) darf der Einlasswert beim Einschalten den Auslasswert um höchstens 20 °C übersteigen, geprüft einmal pro Start. In der GM-Tabelle 2013 (13OBDG05C) darf der Einlassfühler nach über 8 Stunden Standzeit höchstens 10 °C vom Mittel der Akku-Kerntemperaturen abweichen, 50 von 62 Messungen. Beide Fälle sind Typ B, zwei Fahrten. Ursache kann ein Fühler sein, der auf einem plausiblen Wert hängt, aus dem Luftstrom verrutscht ist, oder ein fehlerhafter Vergleichsfühler. Das Auto fährt weiter, Lüfter und Leistungsgrenzen arbeiten aber womöglich falsch.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid warning light

description: The battery air temperature sensor is an NTC thermistor, so a low signal voltage reads as very hot air. P0AAE sets when the signal stays below the lower limit, usually a short to ground. GM's 2013 table (13OBDG05C) uses under 0.3 V, about 90 °C, in 7 of 10 samples; the two-mode hybrid tables of 2011 and 2013 flag an inlet reading above 95 °C in 30 of 40 samples. Both are Type B, two trips. Since the controller then assumes overheated cooling air, it may run the fan hard and cut battery power although nothing is hot. Look for chafed sensor wires touching ground or a sensor shorted internally. The opposite case, an open circuit reading as very cold, is P0AAF.
possible_causes: Sensor signal wire chafed and shorted to ground [HIGH]
Thermistor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Battery controller input fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: The battery air temperature sensor is an NTC thermistor, so a low signal voltage reads as very hot air. P0AAE sets when the signal stays below the lower limit, usually a short to ground. GM's 2013 table (13OBDG05C) uses under 0.3 V, about 90 °C, in 7 of 10 samples; the two-mode hybrid tables of 2011 and 2013 flag an inlet reading above 95 °C in 30 of 40 samples. Both are Type B, two trips. Since the controller then assumes overheated cooling air, it may run the fan hard and cut battery power although nothing is hot. Look for chafed sensor wires touching ground or a sensor shorted internally. The opposite case, an open circuit reading as very cold, is P0AAF.
bilingual_description.de: Der Akku-Lufttemperaturfühler ist ein NTC-Thermistor; eine niedrige Signalspannung bedeutet für das Steuergerät also sehr heiße Luft. P0AAE setzt, wenn das Signal unter der unteren Grenze bleibt, meist durch Masseschluss. Die GM-Tabelle 2013 (13OBDG05C) nennt unter 0,3 V, rund 90 °C, in 7 von 10 Messungen; die Two-Mode-Tabellen 2011 und 2013 werten einen Einlasswert über 95 °C in 30 von 40 Messungen. Beides ist Typ B, zwei Fahrten. Weil das Steuergerät dann überhitzte Kühlluft annimmt, kann es den Lüfter hochfahren und die Akkuleistung drosseln, obwohl nichts heiß ist. Zu suchen sind durchgescheuerte Fühlerleitungen mit Massekontakt oder ein intern kurzgeschlossener Fühler. Den umgekehrten Fall, eine Unterbrechung mit scheinbar sehr kalter Luft, meldet P0AAF.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid warning light
Battery cooling fan runs at high speed without reason

description: Air temperature sensor A is the thermistor GM places at the cooling air inlet of air-cooled hybrid packs. Being an NTC type, a high signal voltage means the controller sees implausibly cold air, typically from an open wire or a lost ground. GM's 2013 table 13OBDG05C sets P0AAF above 4.63 V, equal to about -45 °C, in 7 of 10 samples; the two-mode hybrid tables of 2011 and 2013 use a reading below -45 °C in 30 of 40 samples. All are Type B, two trips. The controller then ignores the inlet value, so fan control and the inlet-to-outlet comparison lose their reference. Check the connector at the inlet duct for a pushed-out pin first. The shorted counterpart reading as very hot is P0AAE.
possible_causes: Open signal or ground wire between sensor and battery controller [HIGH]
Connector at the air inlet duct loose or with pushed-back pin [MEDIUM]
Thermistor open internally [MEDIUM]
Battery controller input fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Being an NTC type, a high signal voltage means the controller sees implausibly cold air, typically from an open wire or a lost ground. GM's 2013 table 13OBDG05C sets P0AAF above 4.63 V, equal to about -45 °C, in 7 of 10 samples; the two-mode hybrid tables of 2011 and 2013 use a reading below -45 °C in 30 of 40 samples. Check the connector at the inlet duct for a pushed-out pin first. The shorted counterpart reading as very hot is P0AAE.
bilingual_description.de: Lufttemperatursensor A ist bei GM der NTC-Fühler am Kühllufteinlass luftgekühlter Hybridakkus. Eine hohe Signalspannung heißt hier: Das Steuergerät misst unglaubhaft kalte Luft, meist wegen einer unterbrochenen Leitung oder fehlender Masse. description: P0AB2 checks whether air temperature sensor B reads sensibly. GM uses it on the full-size two-mode hybrids, where sensor B measures outlet air: in the 2011 and 2013 tables, with the battery fan commanded on, the outlet air may not be more than 10 °C warmer than the hottest battery module, 90 of 100 samples, Type B, two trips. The logic is simple physics: air leaving the pack cannot be much hotter than the modules that heated it. The test is skipped while module sensor or fan faults are present. A drifting thermistor, a sensor that has slipped out of the air stream or a faulty module sensor can trigger it. Unlike P0AB3 and P0AB4, the circuit itself is electrically in range.
possible_causes: Outlet air thermistor drifted from its characteristic [HIGH]
Sensor displaced from its position in the air duct [MEDIUM]
Battery module temperature sensor used for comparison reads wrong [MEDIUM]
Corroded contact adding resistance [LOW]

description: P0AB3 means the signal of air temperature sensor B sits below its valid range. Because the sensor is an NTC thermistor, a low voltage translates into very hot air, so a short to ground is the usual cause. GM documents the code for the outlet air sensor of its full-size two-mode hybrids: in the 2011 and 2013 tables it fails when the outlet reading exceeds 95 °C in 30 of 40 samples while at least one module sensor still reads below 70 °C, Type B, two trips. That extra condition separates a real overheat from a wiring fault. The controller may then run the fan at full speed and cut battery power without need. The open-circuit counterpart is P0AB4.
possible_causes: Sensor B signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Thermistor shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Moisture or debris bridging the connector pins [LOW]

description: P0AB4 reports a signal from air temperature sensor B above the valid range. description: Some engines sit on switchable or actively driven hydraulic mounts whose solenoid or actuator is energised by the engine controller. P0AB6 reports that the driver output for the second mount (B) sees an open or otherwise faulty circuit. Ford lists the code in its 2020-23 gasoline OBD summary under active mounts, assigns mount B to bank 2, monitors continuously and lets the low-level driver fault mature for about 5 seconds before storing it. On the 2008 Honda Pilot the same code covers the rear mount actuator. Mount A has the matching codes P0A14 to P0A16. Drivers mostly notice more vibration at idle or in cylinder-deactivation mode; the engine itself keeps running normally.
possible_causes: Broken or chafed control wire to the mount actuator [HIGH]
Corroded or loose connector at the mount (splash zone) [MEDIUM]
Mount solenoid or actuator coil open internally [MEDIUM]
Output driver in the engine controller defective [LOW]

description: P0AB7 means the engine controller sees the control line of active engine mount B pulled too low, the usual signature of a short to ground or an actuator coil with too little resistance. Ford's 2020-23 gasoline OBD summary lists it among the active-mount checks for bank 2: the output driver flags the fault continuously and the PCM matures it within roughly 5 seconds. Honda describes the code on the 2008 Pilot as a low-current fault in the rear mount actuator circuit. P0AB6 covers the open circuit, P0AB8 the high side, and P0A15 the same fault on mount A. The driver usually feels more engine shake at idle; drivability is otherwise unaffected.

description: Despite the broad title, GM uses P0AB9 for one concrete check: a failed engine auto-start or auto-stop in its hybrids, including an engine stall during that process. In the 2016 and 2019 hybrid tables the hybrid controller sets the code when the engine still reports no torque about 15 seconds into an auto-start although more than 20 Nm is commanded, provided fuel level is sufficient and no cam or crank fault is present. The 2011 and 2013 tables describe the same idea with a stall during start/stop. GM rates it Type A, so the MIL comes on after one trip. Other faults that prevent starting, such as P0A0F, point at more specific causes; P0AB9 itself is the symptom.

Controller software needing an update [LOW]

description: The battery management system measures the total voltage of the high-voltage pack through a dedicated sense circuit and uses it for state of charge, power limits and contactor checks. P0ABA is the general circuit fault for sense circuit A, set when the reading is unusable without being clearly low, high or erratic. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly; GM, for instance, monitors the same circuit with the more specific P0ABB to P0ABD. CARB requires hybrid battery inputs that feed emission-relevant control to be checked for circuit faults. Expect a warning light and reduced hybrid assistance, because the controller then works with conservative limits.
possible_causes: Damaged or loose voltage sense lead inside the battery pack [HIGH]
Measurement input of the battery controller defective [MEDIUM]
Blown sense fuse or failed divider resistor [LOW]

description: P0ABB is a plausibility check: the measured pack voltage is within electrical limits but does not agree with what the individual cells add up to. GM documents it in several hybrid tables. From 2016 the battery controller flags it when pack voltage and the sum of cell voltages differ by more than 10 V in 32 of 40 samples; the 2013 table compares the pack reading with 32 times the average cell voltage and uses a 5.49 V limit. Both are Type B, so the MIL needs two trips. The check is suppressed while cell voltage circuit faults are active. P0ABC and P0ABD cover hard low or high readings, P0AF8 compares the pack sensor with the inverter bus voltage.
possible_causes: Pack voltage measurement drifted (divider or input aging) [HIGH]
Faulty cell voltage tap distorting the cell sum [MEDIUM]
High-resistance busbar or sense connection [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0ABB ist eine Plausibilitätsprüfung: Die gemessene Akkuspannung liegt zwar im elektrisch zulässigen Bereich, passt aber nicht zur Summe der Einzelzellen. GM dokumentiert den Code in mehreren Hybrid-Tabellen. Ab 2016 setzt ihn das Batteriesteuergerät, wenn Paketspannung und Zellsumme in 32 von 40 Messungen um mehr als 10 V auseinanderliegen; die Tabelle 2013 vergleicht die Paketspannung mit dem 32-Fachen der mittleren Zellspannung und nutzt 5,49 V als Grenze. Beide Fälle sind Typ B, die MIL kommt also nach zwei Fahrten. Bei aktiven Zellspannungs-Kreisfehlern ruht die Prüfung. Harte Grenzwertverletzungen melden P0ABC und P0ABD, den Abgleich mit der Umrichter-Busspannung P0AF8.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid system warning light

description: P0ABC is stored when the pack voltage sensor reports a value below anything the battery could really have, pointing to a short to ground or a lost sense signal rather than a discharged pack. GM's 2016 and 2019 hybrid tables set it below 4.8 V with system voltage above 10.2 V, after 8 failed samples out of 10 taken every 25 ms, and rate it Type A with MIL on the first trip. The 2013 table for an earlier hybrid uses a limit of 30 V, 7 of 10 samples and Type B. A real deep discharge is handled by other codes such as P0AFA. Because the controller no longer trusts pack voltage, hybrid operation is restricted or the vehicle will not go ready.
possible_causes: Sense line shorted to ground or disconnected [HIGH]
Sense fuse or link open so no voltage reaches the input [MEDIUM]
Battery controller measurement input defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2000€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

In GMs Hybrid-Tabellen 2016 und 2019 liegt die Grenze bei 4,8 V (Bordnetz über 10,2 V), nötig sind 8 Fehlmessungen von 10 im 25-ms-Takt; Typ A, die MIL leuchtet sofort. Die Tabelle 2013 eines älteren Hybrids nennt 30 V, 7 von 10 Messungen und Typ B. Echte Tiefentladung erfassen andere Codes wie P0AFA. Weil das Steuergerät der Paketspannung nicht mehr traut, wird der Hybridbetrieb eingeschränkt oder das Fahrzeug geht nicht in Fahrbereitschaft.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning on
Vehicle may refuse to enter ready mode
Engine runs continuously, no electric drive

description: The counterpart to P0ABC: the pack voltage reading is above the highest value the battery could physically reach, which suggests an open reference, a failed divider or a damaged input rather than real overcharging. GM's 2016 and 2019 hybrid tables set P0ABD above 392 V, again with 8 failed samples out of 10 at 25 ms intervals and Type A, so the MIL comes on immediately. For the smaller pack in its 2013 table the limit is 190.1 V, with 7 of 10 samples and Type B. Range and plausibility problems are reported by P0ABB, the low limit by P0ABC. The vehicle typically limits or blocks electric operation until the fault is cleared.
possible_causes: Open ground or reference side of the sense circuit [HIGH]
Voltage divider component failed in the battery controller [MEDIUM]
Battery controller measurement input defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2000€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Meist wird der elektrische Betrieb begrenzt oder gesperrt, bis der Fehler behoben ist.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning on

description: P0ABE flags a pack voltage signal that jumps or drops out briefly instead of changing smoothly, as a battery voltage physically would. A loose sense connection or a cracked solder joint inside the pack are the classic triggers. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly; GM covers the same sensor with P0ABB, P0ABC and P0ABD, and its battery controller cross-checks the pack reading against the cell sum and the inverter bus voltage (P0AF8). CARB demands circuit and rationality monitoring for such battery inputs. Because the faults come and go, the code may be stored without lasting symptoms, but power limits and warning lights can appear during the dropouts.
possible_causes: Loose or fretted voltage sense connection [HIGH]
Cracked solder or crimp joint on the sense board [MEDIUM]
Electrical noise from damaged shielding or ground [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Klassische Auslöser sind ein lockerer Messanschluss oder eine gerissene Lötstelle im Akkupaket. Da der Fehler kommt und geht, bleibt oft nur der gespeicherte Code; während der Aussetzer können aber Leistungsgrenzen und Warnleuchten auftreten.

symptoms: Warning light that comes and goes
Sudden short drops in electric power

description: The pack current sensor, usually a Hall-effect unit around the main cable, tells the battery controller how much current flows in and out. P0ABF is the general fault of sensor A. GM uses it in its 2019 hybrid controller tables as a stuck-in-range check: before the high-voltage bus is precharged the controller stores a zero-current baseline, then expects a measurable change once precharge starts or the main contactor closes and loads such as the inverter and auxiliary power module draw current. If the reading moves by less than 1 A, P0ABF fails. Out-of-range readings are P0AC1 and P0AC2, offset errors P0AC0. Without a valid current value state of charge cannot be tracked, so power is limited.
possible_causes: Hall current sensor output frozen [HIGH]
Sensor supply, ground or signal wire faulty [MEDIUM]
Sensor not seated around the conductor after repair [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Der Paketstromsensor – meist ein Hall-Sensor um das Hauptkabel – meldet dem Batteriesteuergerät, wie viel Strom fließt. P0ABF ist der allgemeine Fehler von Sensor A. GM nutzt ihn in den Hybrid-Tabellen 2019 als Prüfung auf einen festhängenden Messwert: Vor dem Vorladen des Hochvolt-Busses merkt sich das Steuergerät einen Nullstrom-Bezug und erwartet danach eine messbare Änderung, sobald vorgeladen wird oder das Hauptschütz schließt und Verbraucher wie Umrichter und Bordnetzwandler Strom ziehen. Ändert sich der Wert um weniger als 1 A, schlägt P0ABF fehl. Bereichsverletzungen melden P0AC1 und P0AC2, Offsetfehler P0AC0. Ohne gültigen Stromwert lässt sich der Ladezustand nicht verfolgen, die Leistung wird begrenzt.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning on
Reduced electric power and erratic charge display

description: P0AC0 belongs to the battery current sensor family, not to battery cooling. It reports a sensor whose reading is electrically valid but implausible. GM's 2011 to 2013 hybrid tables describe the check: with the contactors open, when no current can flow, the reading in each of the sensor's high, mid and low ranges must stay within 5 A of zero, and the controller also checks that the measured current fits the change in pack voltage. A failure sets the code as one-trip Type A in the 2013 table. The check waits while circuit codes P0AC1 or P0AC2 are active. Effects are a drifting charge estimate, reduced hybrid power and, in severe cases, a vehicle that will not go ready.
possible_causes: Current sensor zero offset drifted [HIGH]
Unstable sensor supply or reference voltage [MEDIUM]
Battery controller input fault [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0AC0 gehört zur Reihe des Batteriestromsensors, nicht zur Akkukühlung. Der Code meldet einen elektrisch gültigen, aber unglaubwürdigen Messwert. GMs Hybrid-Tabellen 2011 bis 2013 beschreiben die Prüfung: Bei offenen Schützen, wenn kein Strom fließen kann, muss der Sensor in seinem hohen, mittleren und niedrigen Messbereich jeweils innerhalb von 5 A um null bleiben; zusätzlich prüft das Steuergerät, ob der gemessene Strom zur Änderung der Paketspannung passt. Ein Fehlschlag gilt in der Tabelle 2013 als Typ A nach einer Fahrt. Bei aktiven Kreisfehlern P0AC1 oder P0AC2 ruht die Prüfung. Folgen sind ein wandernder Ladezustand, weniger Hybridleistung und schlimmstenfalls keine Fahrbereitschaft.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning on
State of charge display drifts or jumps

description: P0AC1 is set when the output of the pack current sensor falls below the valid window, so that the converted current would be an impossible discharge or charge value. GM documents it in several hybrid tables. In the 2016 and 2019 versions the Hall-effect sensor fails when the result is below -365.1 A for 8 of 10 samples at 25 ms with system voltage above 10.2 V; the code is Type A with MIL on the first trip. An earlier GM pack in the 2013 table uses an output below 0.2 V, equal to about -230 A, with 7 of 10 samples and Type B. Typical causes are a lost supply or a signal shorted to ground. P0AC2 is the high side and P0AC0 the plausibility check.
possible_causes: Sensor 5 V supply open or shorted [HIGH]
Signal wire shorted to ground [MEDIUM]
Hall current sensor failed internally [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0AC1 wird gesetzt, wenn das Ausgangssignal des Paketstromsensors unter das gültige Fenster fällt, sodass der umgerechnete Strom einen unmöglichen Wert ergäbe. GM dokumentiert den Code in mehreren Hybrid-Tabellen. In den Fassungen 2016 und 2019 fällt der Hall-Sensor durch, wenn der Wert in 8 von 10 Messungen im 25-ms-Takt unter -365,1 A liegt, Bordnetz über 10,2 V; Typ A, MIL nach der ersten Fahrt. Ein älterer GM-Akku in der Tabelle 2013 nutzt ein Ausgangssignal unter 0,2 V, entsprechend etwa -230 A, mit 7 von 10 Messungen und Typ B. Häufig fehlt die Sensorversorgung oder das Signal hat Masseschluss. Die Obergrenze meldet P0AC2, die Plausibilität P0AC0.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning on
Electric drive limited or vehicle will not go ready

description: With P0AC2 the current sensor output sits above its valid window, which after conversion would mean an implausibly large current in the opposite direction to P0AC1. GM's 2016 and 2019 hybrid tables set it when the Hall-effect sensor reads above 274.6 A in 8 of 10 samples taken every 25 ms, again as Type A with immediate MIL. The 2013 table for an earlier pack uses an output above 4.65 V, roughly 215 A, with 7 of 10 samples and Type B. A signal shorted to the 5 V supply or an open sensor ground are common reasons. Because the controller can no longer count charge, it caps battery power; the low limit is P0AC1 and implausible offsets are P0AC0.
possible_causes: Sensor ground open [HIGH]
Signal wire shorted to the 5 V supply or another voltage [MEDIUM]
Hall current sensor failed internally [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

GMs Hybrid-Tabellen 2016 und 2019 setzen den Code, wenn der Hall-Sensor in 8 von 10 Messungen im 25-ms-Takt über 274,6 A anzeigt, wiederum als Typ A mit sofortiger MIL. Die Tabelle 2013 für einen älteren Akku nennt ein Signal über 4,65 V, etwa 215 A, mit 7 von 10 Messungen und Typ B. Häufig hat das Signal Schluss zur 5-V-Versorgung oder die Sensormasse ist unterbrochen. Weil das Steuergerät die Ladungsbilanz nicht mehr führen kann, begrenzt es die Batterieleistung; die Untergrenze ist P0AC1, Offsetfehler meldet P0AC0.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning on
Battery power limited, engine runs more often

description: P0AC3 describes a battery current signal that jumps, spikes or drops out in a way real current flow could not explain, typically through a loose connector, a chafed signal wire or interference on the sensor ground. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly. GM monitors the same Hall-effect sensor with the stuck check P0ABF, the offset check P0AC0 and the range limits P0AC1 and P0AC2, and CARB requires circuit and rationality monitoring for battery inputs that influence emissions. As the fault is not permanent, the code may be the only trace; during the dropouts the controller may still cut battery power or turn on a warning light.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded current sensor connector [HIGH]
Chafed signal or supply wire with intermittent contact [MEDIUM]
Interference on sensor ground or shield [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Warning light that comes and goes
Short drops in electric power while driving

description: In many hybrids the hybrid powertrain controller has its own emission-related diagnostics but does not drive the malfunction indicator lamp itself. When it detects such a fault it sends a MIL request to the engine controller, which then stores P0AC4 as a pointer. GM documents this in its 2011, 2013, 2016 and 2019 hybrid tables: the engine controller watches the request message continuously once 3 seconds have passed after power-up and logs P0AC4 after one trip, listed as Type A but marked No MIL because the lamp is owed to the original fault. The real cause is therefore stored in the hybrid controller and must be read there. P0A7B is the equivalent request from the battery energy control module.
possible_causes: Emission-related fault stored in the hybrid controller [HIGH]
Request still present because codes were cleared only in the engine controller [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 200€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Bei vielen Hybriden hat das Hybrid-Antriebssteuergerät eigene emissionsrelevante Diagnosen, schaltet die Motorkontrollleuchte aber nicht selbst. Erkennt es einen solchen Fehler, schickt es eine MIL-Anforderung an das Motorsteuergerät, das daraufhin P0AC4 als Verweis speichert. GM beschreibt das in den Hybrid-Tabellen 2011, 2013, 2016 und 2019: Das Motorsteuergerät beobachtet die Anforderung ab 3 Sekunden nach dem Einschalten dauernd und legt P0AC4 nach einer Fahrt ab – als Typ A geführt, aber mit dem Zusatz „No MIL“, weil die Leuchte dem eigentlichen Fehler gehört. Die echte Ursache steht deshalb im Hybridsteuergerät und muss dort ausgelesen werden. P0A7B ist die entsprechende Anforderung des Batteriesteuergeräts.

symptoms: Check engine light on (caused by the underlying hybrid fault)
Further codes present only in the hybrid controller

description: Battery temperature sensor B is one of several thermistors that measure cell or module temperature inside the high-voltage pack; GM's Volt bulletin calls it sensor 2 of nine. P0AC5 is the general circuit code for it, used for an electrical fault the controller does not classify as low, high or erratic. No manufacturer documents this exact code publicly; GM, for instance, reports P0AC6 to P0AC9 instead. CARB requires hybrid battery temperature inputs to be monitored for circuit faults. With one sensor missing the controller has a gap in its temperature picture and tends to limit charge and discharge power. The sensor usually sits on a module or sensing board inside the pack, so checks need high-voltage safety procedures.
possible_causes: Poor contact or damaged wire between sensor B and sensing board [HIGH]
Temperature sensor B failed [MEDIUM]
Fault in the battery controller input stage [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 2500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Batterie-Temperatursensor B ist einer von mehreren NTC-Fühlern, die im Hochvoltakku Zell- oder Modultemperaturen messen; im GM-Volt-Bulletin ist er Fühler 2 von neun. P0AC5 ist sein allgemeiner Stromkreiscode für einen elektrischen Fehler, den das Steuergerät weder als zu niedrig, zu hoch noch unstet einordnet. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert genau diesen Code öffentlich; GM meldet etwa stattdessen P0AC6 bis P0AC9. CARB fordert, Temperatureingänge des Hybridakkus auf Kreisfehler zu überwachen. Fehlt ein Fühler, hat das Steuergerät eine Lücke im Temperaturbild und begrenzt eher die Lade- und Entladeleistung. Der Fühler sitzt meist an einem Modul oder auf der Messplatine im Akku; Prüfungen erfordern daher Hochvolt-Sicherheitsmaßnahmen.

symptoms: Hybrid system or check engine warning
Charging may be slower on plug-in models

description: P0AC6 is the plausibility test for battery temperature sensor B: its reading is compared with the other pack sensors. GM documents several calibrations. The 2016 and 2019 tables fail it when the sensor differs from the average of the other sensors by more than 25 °C, 50 of 67 samples; the two-mode hybrid tables of 2011 and 2013 use more than 15 °C, 90 of 100 samples; GM's 2013 table 13OBDG05C allows 8.55 °C after more than 6 hours off. All are Type B, two trips. Bulletin 18-NA-342 for the Chevrolet Volt lists P0AC6 among false sensor codes in cold weather and fixes them by reprogramming. Otherwise a drifting sensor or a real local hot spot in a module is likely.
possible_causes: Controller software flags the sensor falsely (GM Volt bulletin 18-NA-342) [MEDIUM]
Sensor B drifted from its characteristic [HIGH]
Corroded contact adding resistance in the sensor circuit [MEDIUM]
Real temperature difference from a weak cell or blocked cooling [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 2500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: P0AC9 catches a battery temperature sensor B signal that changes erratically. Pack temperatures move slowly because of the large thermal mass, so rapid swings point to a bad connection. GM documents the method in its 2016 and 2019 hybrid tables: the controller integrates the absolute change of the sensor value over a 10-sample window at 100 ms per sample; a window fails when the sum exceeds 10, and the code sets after 4 of 5 failed windows, Type B, two trips. description: Air-cooled traction batteries can use several blowers; P0ACF belongs to the third one and means the battery controller sees an open or otherwise invalid control line while it drives fan 3. description: P0AD0 is a functional fault: the control line of battery fan 3 may be electrically fine, but the blower does not deliver what was commanded, or stays still. Depending on design, the controller compares fan speed feedback with the request, or, as a Honda patent describes, compares the expected battery temperature change for the known cooling capacity with the measured one. CARB asks for such a functional check of the battery cooling where feasible. No manufacturer publicly documents P0AD0 itself; circuit faults of the same fan are P0ACF, P0AD2 and P0AD3, the opposite case is P0AD1. The driver usually sees a hybrid warning and reduced power on hot days.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Cooling Fan 3 Stuck On

bilingual_description.en: P0AD1 is the counterpart to P0AD0: fan 3 of the traction battery keeps turning although the controller has switched it off or commanded a lower level. A speed feedback or the current in the fan circuit shows that the blower still runs. CARB 1968.2 requires the battery thermal management outputs to be checked for proper response to commands. No manufacturer publicly documents P0AD1; for fan 1 GM treats an unwanted speed above about 250 rpm with the fan off under its own code P0BC8. Typical causes are a driver stage stuck on or a short to supply voltage. Effects are an audible fan after shutdown and possible 12 V battery drain rather than a drivability problem.
bilingual_description.de: P0AD1 ist das Gegenstück zu P0AD0: Lüfter 3 der Fahrbatterie dreht weiter, obwohl das Steuergerät ihn abgeschaltet oder eine niedrigere Stufe verlangt hat. Eine Drehzahlrückmeldung oder der Strom im Lüfterkreis verrät, dass das Gebläse noch läuft. CARB 1968.2 fordert, die Ausgänge des Batterie-Thermomanagements auf korrekte Reaktion zu prüfen. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert P0AD1 öffentlich; GM führt eine unerwünschte Drehzahl über etwa 250 U/min bei abgeschaltetem Lüfter 1 unter dem eigenen Code P0BC8. Ursache ist meist eine durchgeschaltete Endstufe oder ein Schluss nach Plus. Spürbar ist vor allem ein hörbarer Nachlauf nach dem Abstellen und eine mögliche Entladung der 12-V-Batterie, weniger das Fahrverhalten.

symptoms: Battery fan audible after the vehicle is switched off

description: P0AD2 reports that the control signal for battery fan 3 is pulled too low, typically a short to ground on the line between battery controller and blower. Such fans are mostly speed-controlled by a PWM duty cycle, as a Toyota patent on battery fan control explains. No manufacturer publicly documents P0AD2; GM sets the analogous fan 1 code P0A84 when the control voltage stays below 0.257 V with system voltage above 9.1 V, Type B with two trips. The open circuit is P0ACF, a short to voltage P0AD3. CARB requires these electrical checks for battery thermal components. Fan 3 then cannot be driven, and the battery may run warm with limited power.
possible_causes: Control wire chafed through to body ground [HIGH]
Internal short in fan 3 motor or its electronics [MEDIUM]
Moisture or spilled liquid in the fan connector [MEDIUM]
Output stage in the battery controller defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0AD2 meldet, dass das Steuersignal für Batterielüfter 3 zu tief gezogen wird – meist ein Masseschluss auf der Leitung zwischen Batteriesteuergerät und Gebläse. Solche Lüfter werden überwiegend per PWM-Tastverhältnis in der Drehzahl gestellt, wie ein Toyota-Patent zur Batterielüfterregelung zeigt. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0AD2; GM setzt den entsprechenden Lüfter-1-Code P0A84, wenn die Steuerspannung bei Bordspannung über 9,1 V unter 0,257 V bleibt (Typ B, zwei Fahrten). Unterbrechung ist P0ACF, Schluss nach Plus P0AD3. CARB verlangt diese elektrischen Prüfungen für Bauteile der Batteriekühlung. Lüfter 3 lässt sich dann nicht ansteuern, der Akku wird wärmer und die Leistung sinkt.

symptoms: Hybrid or EV system warning light, often with check engine light
Electric drive power reduced when the battery gets warm
No fan noise from the battery area when cooling is expected

description: With P0AD3 the battery controller finds the control line of cooling fan 3 at a voltage that is too high for the commanded state, pointing to a short to a supply voltage or a fan input that no longer pulls the line down. No manufacturer publicly documents this code; GM's analogous fan 1 code P0A85 trips when the control voltage exceeds 9 V while the fan is driven, Type B. Siblings: P0AD2 for the low side, P0ACF for an open line, P0AD1 if the fan keeps running. CARB 1968.2 calls for this circuit monitoring on battery thermal management parts. Depending on the fault the fan runs permanently or not at all, and the pack may be derated.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to 12 V or another supply [HIGH]
Fan electronics no longer loading the control line [MEDIUM]
Bent or bridged pins in the fan connector [MEDIUM]
Battery controller output stage defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Bei P0AD3 liegt die Steuerleitung von Kühllüfter 3 für den angeforderten Zustand auf zu hoher Spannung – Hinweis auf einen Schluss nach Plus oder einen Lüftereingang, der die Leitung nicht mehr herunterzieht. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; der entsprechende GM-Code für Lüfter 1, P0A85, greift bei angesteuertem Lüfter und Steuerspannung über 9 V (Typ B). Je nach Fehlerbild läuft der Lüfter ständig oder gar nicht, und das Paket wird womöglich gedrosselt.

symptoms: Hybrid or EV system warning light
Fan 3 runs constantly or not at all
Reduced electric power when the battery is warm

description: P0AD4 is a system-level check of air-cooled traction batteries: the controller concludes that too little air passes the cells, for example because the cell temperatures rise faster than the commanded fan level allows, as a Honda fan diagnosis patent describes. CARB 1968.2 asks for a functional check of the battery cooling performance where feasible. Stellantis lists P0AD4 for the 48 V eTorque battery of the Ram 1500 (TSBs 08-033/034/035-24, 2022-24) and cures some cases with a battery pack control module software update. Unlike the fan circuit codes, P0AD4 is often caused by a blocked intake or duct. Expect a warning lamp and limited assist or electric power.
possible_causes: Cabin air intake grille or duct of the battery blocked (bags, clothing, dust, pet hair) [HIGH]
Battery air filter clogged, where fitted [MEDIUM]
Battery fan running too slowly [MEDIUM]
Battery controller software sets the code falsely (Ram eTorque, fixed by update) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 400€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Air Flow System Insufficient Air Flow

bilingual_description.en: P0AD4 is a system-level check of air-cooled traction batteries: the controller concludes that too little air passes the cells, for example because the cell temperatures rise faster than the commanded fan level allows, as a Honda fan diagnosis patent describes. CARB 1968.2 asks for a functional check of the battery cooling performance where feasible. bilingual_description.de: P0AD4 ist eine Systemprüfung luftgekühlter Fahrbatterien: Das Steuergerät schließt, dass zu wenig Luft an den Zellen vorbeiströmt – etwa weil die Zelltemperaturen schneller steigen, als es die angeforderte Lüfterstufe zulässt, wie ein Honda-Patent zur Lüfterdiagnose beschreibt. CARB 1968.2 verlangt, die Kühlleistung des Akkus soweit machbar funktional zu prüfen. Stellantis führt P0AD4 bei der 48-V-eTorque-Batterie des Ram 1500 (TSBs 08-033/034/035-24, Baujahre 2022–24) und behebt einen Teil der Fälle mit neuer Software für das Batteriesteuergerät BPCM. Anders als bei den Lüfterkreiscodes steckt oft ein verstopfter Ansaug oder Kanal dahinter. Zu erwarten sind Warnleuchte und begrenzte Unterstützung bzw. E-Leistung.

symptoms: Check engine or hybrid warning light
Reduced electric assist or start-stop not available
Battery fan runs loud for long periods

description: Some air-cooled battery packs route their cooling air through a motorized flap that switches between cabin air, recirculation or an outlet. P0AD5 means the battery controller finds the drive circuit of this valve A open or otherwise faulty. No manufacturer publicly documents P0AD5; the same component appears in Audi's Q5 hybrid (2012-15) bulletin, where the battery management module J841 works with the learned end stops of the air supply valve in the cooling module. CARB 1968.2 requires electrical monitoring of all battery thermal management outputs. Sibling codes are P0AD6 (range/performance), P0AD7 (low) and P0AD8 (high). The flap stays where it is, and the controller may cut electric operation.
possible_causes: Loose or corroded connector at the flap actuator [HIGH]
Broken wire in the actuator harness [MEDIUM]
Actuator motor winding open [MEDIUM]
Output stage in battery controller defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

P0AD5 heißt: Das Batteriesteuergerät erkennt im Ansteuerkreis dieser Klappe A eine Unterbrechung oder einen anderen Kreisfehler. Öffentlich dokumentiert kein Hersteller P0AD5; dasselbe Bauteil taucht im Audi-Bulletin zum Q5 hybrid (2012–15) auf, in dem das Batteriemanagement J841 mit gelernten Endanschlägen der Luftzufuhrklappe im Kühlmodul arbeitet. CARB 1968.2 verlangt die elektrische Überwachung aller Ausgänge des Batterie-Thermomanagements. Geschwister sind P0AD6 (Plausibilität), P0AD7 (zu niedrig) und P0AD8 (zu hoch). Die Klappe bleibt stehen, und das Steuergerät kann den E-Betrieb sperren.

symptoms: Hybrid warning, electric drive may be switched off
Battery temperature not controlled as usual

description: P0AD6 flags that the air flow valve A of the battery cooling does not behave as expected: the circuit is intact, but position, travel or the learned end stops do not fit the command. Audi documents exactly this code as P0AD600 on the 2012-15 Q5 hybrid (TSB 2038152): a software error made the battery management module J841 lose the learned end stops of the air supply valve, electric and hybrid drive were disabled, and a software update to version 0543 fixed it. CARB 1968.2 calls for functional monitoring of battery thermal management. Pure circuit faults are P0AD5, P0AD7 and P0AD8. Besides software, a sticking flap or a slipping actuator can cause it.
possible_causes: Battery controller software loses learned end stops (Audi Q5 hybrid, fixed by update) [HIGH]
Flap binding from dirt or a deformed duct [MEDIUM]
Actuator gears or position feedback worn [MEDIUM]
End stops not relearned after battery or actuator work [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 0€ - 500€ (0.3h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

CARB 1968.2 verlangt eine Funktionsüberwachung des Batterie-Thermomanagements. Reine Kreisfehler laufen unter P0AD5, P0AD7 und P0AD8. symptoms: Hybrid drive system error message in the cluster
Electric and hybrid operation no longer available

description: P0AD7 sets when the control circuit of the battery air flow valve A reads too low a voltage, usually a short to ground in the line or actuator. The valve is a motorized flap in the battery cooling duct, as in the Audi Q5 hybrid cooling module, whose bulletin covers the range/performance sibling P0AD6. No manufacturer publicly documents P0AD7 itself, so thresholds and debounce times are unknown. CARB 1968.2 requires battery thermal management outputs to be checked for circuit faults. Neighbours are P0AD5 (open) and P0AD8 (high). With the flap no longer movable, cooling may be impaired and the hybrid system may restrict electric operation.
possible_causes: Actuator control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in the flap actuator [MEDIUM]
Moisture in the actuator connector [MEDIUM]
Battery controller output stage defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.de: Hybrid-/EV-Batteriepaket Luftklappe A Ansteuerkreis zu niedrig

bilingual_description.en: P0AD7 sets when the control circuit of the battery air flow valve A reads too low a voltage, usually a short to ground in the line or actuator. Gemeint ist eine motorische Klappe im Kühlluftkanal des Akkus, wie im Kühlmodul des Audi Q5 hybrid, dessen Bulletin den Plausibilitäts-Geschwistercode P0AD6 behandelt. symptoms: Hybrid warning, electric drive may be switched off
Battery temperature not controlled as usual

description: With P0AD8 the battery controller sees too high a voltage in the drive circuit of air flow valve A, typically a short to a supply voltage or an actuator that no longer draws current. The component is the motorized flap that directs cooling air through an air-cooled traction battery, documented for example in Audi's Q5 hybrid bulletin on the related code P0AD6. No manufacturer publicly documents P0AD8; exact limits are not published. CARB 1968.2 requires circuit monitoring of battery thermal management outputs. Compare P0AD7 for the low side and P0AD5 for an open circuit. The flap may stay in one position, so cooling and electric drive can be restricted.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to a supply voltage [HIGH]
Actuator no longer loading the circuit [MEDIUM]
Bridged or bent pins in the connector [MEDIUM]
Battery controller output stage defective [LOW]

symptoms: Hybrid warning, electric drive may be switched off
Battery temperature not controlled as usual

description: The positive main contactor connects the traction battery to the high-voltage bus; its coil is driven by the battery or hybrid controller. P0AD9 covers an open in this coil circuit. GM documents it in detail: in hybrid tables from model year 2011 the HPC2 sets it on open load during the commanded state, Type B. 2016-19 tables use a control voltage between 1.15 and 2.81 V with the contactor commanded off, 40 of 50 samples at 12.5 ms; 2019 versions also check coil current below 194 mA when on. CARB requires circuit monitoring of hybrid outputs. Low and high faults are P0ADB and P0ADC; a contactor stuck open is P0AA2. The car usually cannot go ready.
possible_causes: Open in the contactor coil or its pigtail inside the battery disconnect unit [HIGH]
Loose or corroded low-voltage connector at the battery disconnect unit [MEDIUM]
Broken control wire in the battery harness [MEDIUM]
High-side driver in the battery controller defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.en: The positive main contactor connects the traction battery to the high-voltage bus; its coil is driven by the battery or hybrid controller. P0AD9 covers an open in this coil circuit. GM documents it in detail: in hybrid tables from model year 2011 the HPC2 sets it on open load during the commanded state, Type B. 2016-19 tables use a control voltage between 1.15 and 2.81 V with the contactor commanded off, 40 of 50 samples at 12.5 ms; 2019 versions also check coil current below 194 mA when on. CARB requires circuit monitoring of hybrid outputs. Low and high faults are P0ADB and P0ADC; a contactor stuck open is P0AA2. The car usually cannot go ready.
bilingual_description.de: Das Plus-Hauptschütz schaltet die Fahrbatterie auf den Hochvoltbus; seine Spule steuert das Batterie- bzw. Hybridsteuergerät an. P0AD9 steht für eine Unterbrechung in diesem Spulenkreis. GM dokumentiert ihn ausführlich: In Hybridtabellen ab Modelljahr 2011 setzt das HPC2 ihn bei erkannter offener Last, Typ B. CARB fordert die Kreisüberwachung hybrider Ausgänge. Zu niedrig und zu hoch sind P0ADB und P0ADC, ein offen hängendes Schütz P0AA2. Meist geht das Auto nicht in Fahrbereitschaft.

symptoms: Vehicle will not enter ready mode or start
Hybrid or EV warning light and check engine light

description: P0ADA describes a positive contactor coil circuit that is electrically present but does not behave plausibly: coil current, voltage or response time outside the expected window, for instance due to high resistance or an unstable PWM hold signal. No manufacturer publicly documents this code; GM, which details the positive contactor driver codes P0AD9, P0ADB and P0ADC with Type B logic and sample counters, does not list P0ADA. CARB 1968.2 requires functional and rationality checks of hybrid output components. It must be separated from the contact-side codes P0AA1 (stuck closed) and P0AA2 (stuck open). Drivers may see intermittent no-start or loss of ready mode.
possible_causes: High resistance in coil wiring or connector (corrosion, fretting) [HIGH]
Contactor coil degraded or partially shorted [MEDIUM]
Low 12 V supply during contactor closing [MEDIUM]
Battery controller fault or software [LOW]

description: P0ADC indicates that the positive contactor drive circuit carries too much voltage for the commanded state, usually a short to battery voltage. The 2013 eAssist controller sets it for a short to power on the low-side driver in the on state, 3 of 5 samples. CARB requires such circuit monitoring for hybrid components. Siblings are P0AD9 (open) and P0ADB (low). A short to power can energize the coil unintentionally, so the contactor may not open when it should.
possible_causes: Coil control wire shorted to 12 V [HIGH]
Damaged harness or connector at the battery disconnect unit [MEDIUM]
Driver stage in the battery controller shorted [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: P0ADC zeigt, dass der Ansteuerkreis des Plus-Schützes für den angeforderten Zustand zu viel Spannung führt, meist ein Schluss nach Batteriespannung. In den GM-Hybridtabellen 2016–19 liegt der Treiberausgang bei ausgeschaltetem Schütz zwischen 5,27 und 19,7 V, 40 von 50 Proben im 12,5-ms-Takt, Typ B mit zwei Fahrten. Das eAssist-Steuergerät von 2013 setzt den Code bei Schluss nach Plus am Low-Side-Treiber im eingeschalteten Zustand, 3 von 5 Proben. CARB fordert diese Kreisüberwachung für hybride Bauteile. Geschwister sind P0AD9 (Unterbrechung) und P0ADB (zu niedrig). Ein Schluss nach Plus kann die Spule ungewollt bestromen, sodass das Schütz womöglich nicht öffnet, wenn es soll.

description: The negative main contactor closes the return path of the traction battery; P0ADD reports an open in its coil drive circuit. GM documents the code in parallel to the positive side: tables since model year 2011 detect open load in the HPC2 and store it after two trips; 2016-19 tables evaluate a control voltage between 1.15 and 2.81 V while off, 40 of 50 samples, Type B, and 2019 tables add a coil current check below 194 mA when on. CARB 1968.2 covers this circuit monitoring of hybrid components. Related codes are P0ADF and P0AE0 for low and high, P0AA5 for a contactor stuck open, P0AD9 for the positive side. Without this contactor the HV system stays off.
possible_causes: Open in negative contactor coil or its pigtail [HIGH]
Loose or corroded connector at the battery disconnect unit [MEDIUM]
Broken control wire in the battery harness [MEDIUM]
Driver in the battery controller defective [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: Das Minus-Hauptschütz schließt den Rückleiter der Fahrbatterie; P0ADD meldet eine Unterbrechung in seinem Spulen-Ansteuerkreis. GM dokumentiert den Code parallel zur Plusseite: Tabellen ab Modelljahr 2011 erkennen im HPC2 eine offene Last und speichern nach zwei Fahrten; die Tabellen 2016–19 werten eine Steuerspannung zwischen 1,15 und 2,81 V im ausgeschalteten Zustand aus, 40 von 50 Proben, Typ B, und 2019 kommt eine Spulenstromprüfung unter 194 mA im eingeschalteten Zustand hinzu. description: P0ADE is set when the coil circuit of the negative main contactor works electrically but its values are implausible, such as coil current or hold voltage out of range or a slow response after the command. No manufacturer publicly documents this code; GM, whose tables cover the negative contactor driver codes P0ADD, P0ADF and P0AE0 in detail, does not use P0ADE. CARB 1968.2 requires rationality and functional checks on hybrid output components. The contact-side faults P0AA4 (stuck closed) and P0AA5 (stuck open) are separate diagnoses. Possible effects are an intermittent failure to reach ready mode or charge.
possible_causes: High resistance in coil wiring or connector [HIGH]
Negative contactor coil degraded [MEDIUM]
Weak 12 V battery during start-up [MEDIUM]
Battery controller fault or software [LOW]

bilingual_description.de: P0ADE wird gesetzt, wenn der Spulenkreis des Minus-Hauptschützes elektrisch arbeitet, seine Werte aber unplausibel sind – etwa Spulenstrom oder Haltespannung außerhalb des Bereichs oder eine träge Reaktion nach dem Befehl. Kein Hersteller dokumentiert diesen Code öffentlich; GM beschreibt in seinen Tabellen die Treibercodes P0ADD, P0ADF und P0AE0 des Minus-Schützes ausführlich, nutzt P0ADE aber nicht. CARB 1968.2 verlangt Plausibilitäts- und Funktionsprüfungen hybrider Ausgangsbauteile. Die kontaktseitigen Fehler P0AA4 (hängt geschlossen) und P0AA5 (hängt offen) sind eigene Diagnosen. Mögliche Folgen sind sporadisch fehlende Fahrbereitschaft oder abgebrochenes Laden.

symptoms: Vehicle will not enter ready mode or start
Hybrid or EV warning light and check engine light

description: P0ADF reports that the drive circuit of the negative main contactor is pulled too low, typically a short to ground in the coil line. GM documents the code in its 2016-19 hybrid tables: control voltage below 5.35 V while the contactor is commanded on, 13 of 16 samples at 12.5 ms (20 of 25 in one 2016 group), Type B with two trips, enabled above about 9 to 10 V on the 12 V system. CARB 1968.2 requires this kind of circuit monitoring for hybrid outputs. Counterparts are P0ADD (open), P0AE0 (high) and, on the positive side, P0ADB. As the contactor cannot close properly, the high-voltage system does not come up and the vehicle will not drive or charge.
possible_causes: Coil control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Negative contactor coil internally shorted [MEDIUM]
Moisture in the battery disconnect unit connector [MEDIUM]
Driver in the battery controller defective [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 2500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: P0ADF meldet, dass der Ansteuerkreis des Minus-Hauptschützes zu tief gezogen wird, typischerweise durch einen Masseschluss in der Spulenleitung. Weil das Schütz nicht sauber schließt, fährt das Hochvoltsystem nicht hoch – Fahren und Laden sind nicht möglich.

symptoms: Vehicle will not enter ready mode or start

description: P0AE0 is stored when the negative contactor drive circuit shows too high a voltage for its state, which mostly means a short to battery voltage. GM's 2016-19 hybrid tables set it with the contactor commanded off and the driver output between 5.27 and 19.7 V for 40 of 50 samples at 12.5 ms, Type B, two trips. A coil energized by a short could keep the contactor closed, so a stuck-closed code P0AA4 may follow. The controller usually disables the high-voltage system.

bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät erkennt einen Fehler "hoch" am Antriebsmotor B Wechselrichter-Spannungssensor A Stromkreis. Der Messwert kann nicht zuverlässig zur Regelung herangezogen werden.

symptoms: Possible limp mode or vehicle shutdown

description: The ECM detects a intermittent/erratic fault on the drive motor b inverter voltage sensor a circuit. Reading cannot be used reliably for control.
possible_causes: Sensor connector not seated [HIGH]
Noisy ground reference [MEDIUM]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1200€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Drive Motor B Inverter Voltage Sensor A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
bilingual_title.de: Antriebsmotor B Wechselrichter-Spannungssensor A Stromkreis sporadisch/unsauber

bilingual_description.en: The ECM detects a intermittent/erratic fault on the drive motor b inverter voltage sensor a circuit. Reading cannot be used reliably for control.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät erkennt einen Fehler "sporadisch/unsauber" am Antriebsmotor B Wechselrichter-Spannungssensor A Stromkreis. Der Messwert kann nicht zuverlässig zur Regelung herangezogen werden.

symptoms: Possible limp mode or vehicle shutdown

description: The signals of the HV battery voltage and drive motor A inverter voltage do not correlate within the calibrated tolerance.
possible_causes: One sensor characteristic drifted [HIGH]
Ground offset between channels [MEDIUM]
Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Hybrid/EV Battery Voltage/Drive Motor A Inverter Voltage Correlation

bilingual_description.en: The signals of the HV battery voltage and drive motor A inverter voltage do not correlate within the calibrated tolerance.
bilingual_description.de: Die Signale der HV-Batteriespannung und der Wechselrichter-Spannung des Antriebsmotors A korrelieren nicht innerhalb der kalibrierten Toleranz.

Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Das HV-Batteriepaket-Kühlmittel-Steuerventil C meldet einen Zustand "Steuerkreis hoch". Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode

description: The lean NOx trap (LNT) on bank 1 is no longer storing or releasing NOx within the required efficiency window. Detected by the downstream NOx sensor or model-based monitor — typically caused by sulphur poisoning, thermal aging, or a failed regeneration strategy.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) failure, Intake air leak, Mass Airflow (MAF) sensor is dirty/loss of calibration

possible_causes: Sulphur poisoning from high-sulphur fuel — desulphation regeneration not running [HIGH]
Thermal aging of washcoat after high-temperature exposure [MEDIUM]
Downstream NOx sensor reading drifts [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 3500€ (2h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) flap on bank 1 is stuck in the open position. The IMRC swirls or tumbles intake charge at low rpm by closing one runner per cylinder; when stuck open, low-end torque drops and the engine may misfire on cold starts.

specific_definitions.AUDI: A failed IMRC actuator, A problem with the intake manifold or linkage, Wiring issues

possible_causes: Carbon buildup blocks flap travel [HIGH]
IMRC actuator or vacuum motor failed [MEDIUM]
Linkage rod broken or disconnected [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Open (Bank 1)

bilingual_description.en: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) flap on bank 1 is stuck in the open position. The IMRC swirls or tumbles intake charge at low rpm by closing one runner per cylinder; when stuck open, low-end torque drops and the engine may misfire on cold starts.
bilingual_description.de: Die Saugrohrumschaltklappe (IMRC) an Bank 1 hängt offen. Die IMRC erzeugt bei niedriger Drehzahl Drall oder Tumble, indem sie pro Zylinder einen Kanal schliesst; offen festhängend bricht das Drehmoment unten ein und der Motor kann beim Kaltstart Aussetzer zeigen.

description: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) flap on bank 2 is stuck in the open position. The IMRC swirls or tumbles intake charge at low rpm by closing one runner per cylinder; when stuck open, low-end torque drops and the engine may misfire on cold starts.
possible_causes: Carbon buildup blocks flap travel [HIGH]
IMRC actuator failed on bank 2 [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Open (Bank 2)

bilingual_description.en: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) flap on bank 2 is stuck in the open position. The IMRC swirls or tumbles intake charge at low rpm by closing one runner per cylinder; when stuck open, low-end torque drops and the engine may misfire on cold starts.
bilingual_description.de: Die Saugrohrumschaltklappe (IMRC) an Bank 2 hängt offen. Die IMRC erzeugt bei niedriger Drehzahl Drall oder Tumble, indem sie pro Zylinder einen Kanal schliesst; offen festhängend bricht das Drehmoment unten ein und der Motor kann beim Kaltstart Aussetzer zeigen.

description: The IMRC flap on bank 1 is stuck in the closed position and cannot open at higher rpm. Top-end power suffers because the runner is restricted, and the engine may breathe poorly above mid-range.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Intake manifold runner control actuator failure, Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Restricted vacuum lines

possible_causes: Carbon deposits seize flap closed [HIGH]
Actuator stuck or vacuum line collapsed [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Closed (Bank 1)

bilingual_description.en: The IMRC flap on bank 1 is stuck in the closed position and cannot open at higher rpm. Top-end power suffers because the runner is restricted, and the engine may breathe poorly above mid-range.
bilingual_description.de: Die IMRC-Klappe an Bank 1 hängt geschlossen und kann bei höherer Drehzahl nicht öffnen. Die Spitzenleistung leidet, weil der Kanal eingeschnürt bleibt, und der Motor atmet oberhalb des mittleren Drehzahlbereichs schlecht.

description: Bank 2 counterpart to P2006. The IMRC flap on bank 2 cannot return to the open position and chokes intake flow at higher rpm.
possible_causes: Carbon deposits seize flap closed on bank 2 [HIGH]
Bank 2 actuator stuck [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (1h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Closed (Bank 2)

bilingual_description.en: Bank 2 counterpart to P2006. The IMRC flap on bank 2 cannot return to the open position and chokes intake flow at higher rpm.
bilingual_description.de: Bank-2-Pendant zu P2006. Die IMRC-Klappe auf Bank 2 kehrt nicht in die offene Stellung zurück und drosselt den Ansaugfluss bei höherer Drehzahl.

description: The ECU detects an open circuit on the IMRC solenoid for bank 1. No control current flows when the runner is commanded to switch, leaving the flap in its default position.
possible_causes: Solenoid coil open [HIGH]
Connector unplugged or corroded [MEDIUM]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Solenoid Circuit Open (Bank 1)

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects an open circuit on the IMRC solenoid for bank 1. No control current flows when the runner is commanded to switch, leaving the flap in its default position.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt eine Unterbrechung im Stromkreis des IMRC-Magnetventils für Bank 1. Beim Schaltbefehl fliesst kein Steuerstrom, sodass die Klappe in der Grundstellung bleibt.

description: The IMRC solenoid drive line for bank 1 reads below the lower threshold — short to ground or a failed driver stage. The runner cannot be switched on demand.
possible_causes: Drive line shorted to ground [HIGH]
Solenoid internally shorted [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 30€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Solenoid Circuit Low (Bank 1)

bilingual_description.en: The IMRC solenoid drive line for bank 1 reads below the lower threshold — short to ground or a failed driver stage. The runner cannot be switched on demand.
bilingual_description.de: Die Ansteuerleitung des IMRC-Magnetventils an Bank 1 liegt unter dem unteren Schwellwert — Kurzschluss nach Masse oder defekte Endstufe. Die Saugrohrumschaltung lässt sich nicht mehr ansteuern.

description: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) on bank 1 reports that flap movement does not match the commanded position within the allowed time window — either too slow, too short a stroke, or position feedback off-target.
possible_causes: Carbon buildup restricts flap travel [HIGH]
Actuator weak or vacuum supply low [MEDIUM]
Linkage worn — play between actuator and flap [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 600€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Performance (Bank 1)

bilingual_description.en: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) on bank 1 reports that flap movement does not match the commanded position within the allowed time window — either too slow, too short a stroke, or position feedback off-target.
bilingual_description.de: Die Saugrohrumschaltung (IMRC) an Bank 1 meldet, dass die Klappenbewegung nicht im erwarteten Zeitfenster auf die Sollposition kommt — zu langsam, zu kurzer Hub oder Positions-Feedback weicht ab.

description: A temperature sensor at the diesel particulate filter (DPF) on bank 1 has exceeded the safe limit — typically during a runaway regeneration. Continued operation can melt or crack the substrate.
possible_causes: Excessive soot load triggers runaway regeneration [HIGH]
Post-injection over-fueling during regeneration [MEDIUM]
DPF temperature sensor reading drifts high [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 4000€ (1.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Catalyst temperature sensor drifts high [LOW]

description: The IMRC actuator drive line on bank 2 reads below the expected voltage threshold — typically a short to ground or a stuck-low driver inside the control module.

Actuator winding shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]

description: The position feedback signal of the IMRC flap on bank 1 is missing or implausible. Without feedback, the ECU cannot verify that the commanded runner position has been reached.
possible_causes: Position sensor failed [HIGH]
Signal wire broken [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Intake Manifold Runner Position Sensor/Switch Circuit (Bank 1)

bilingual_description.de: Das Rückmeldesignal der IMRC-Klappenstellung an Bank 1 fehlt oder ist unplausibel. Ohne Rückmeldung kann die Motorsteuerung die kommandierte Stellung nicht überprüfen.

description: The IMRC position sensor on bank 1 reports a value, but it does not match the commanded flap state — for example, the flap is commanded closed yet the sensor still reads open. Common on engines where the connector pin clip wears out and the sensor reads erratic positions.
possible_causes: Connector clip worn — intermittent contact [HIGH]
Flap sticking due to carbon [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_description.de: Der IMRC-Positionssensor an Bank 1 liefert ein Signal, das aber nicht zur kommandierten Klappenstellung passt — etwa bei kommandierter Schliessstellung meldet er weiter offen. Häufig bei Motoren, deren Steckerklemme verschleisst und der Sensor wechselnde Stellungen meldet.

bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Reduktionsmittel (AdBlue) Temperatursensor A — kompensiert die Dosierung für Viskosität und steuert die Tankheizung im Winter.

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

description: Reductant temperature sensor A reading is within electrical range but plausibility check fails — slow response or sticks at one value through a tank-warming cycle.
possible_causes: Sensor drifts or sticks [HIGH]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
Sensor mounting loose - signal damping [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.7h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Reductant Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: Reductant temperature sensor A reading is within electrical range but plausibility check fails — slow response or sticks at one value through a tank-warming cycle.
bilingual_description.de: Der Wert des Reduktionsmittel-Temperatursensors A liegt im elektrischen Bereich, scheitert aber an der Plausibilität — träge Reaktion oder bleibt während eines Tankheizzyklus konstant.

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

description: Reductant temperature sensor A reads below its lower plausibility limit — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Short to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.7h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Reductant Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Reductant temperature sensor A reads below its lower plausibility limit — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.
