description: The supply rail to injector group E is open, so none of the injectors in this group can fire. The affected cylinders produce no power and the engine runs rough or on reduced cylinders. Causes: a broken supply wire, an open relay or fuse, or a disconnected group-E supply connector.
possible_causes: Open supply wire or blown fuse [HIGH]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Injector Group E Supply Voltage Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The supply rail to injector group E is open, so none of the injectors in this group can fire. The affected cylinders produce no power and the engine runs rough or on reduced cylinders. Causes: a broken supply wire, an open relay or fuse, or a disconnected group-E supply connector.
bilingual_description.de: Die Versorgungsleitung der Injektorgruppe E ist unterbrochen, sodass keiner der Injektoren dieser Gruppe einspritzen kann. Die betroffenen Zylinder liefern keine Leistung; der Motor läuft unrund oder nur auf den verbleibenden Zylindern. Ursachen: unterbrochene Versorgungsleitung, offenes Relais oder offene Sicherung oder ein abgezogener Versorgungsstecker der Gruppe E.

symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder
Possible fuel smell or smoke from exhaust

description: The supply voltage feeding injector group E has dropped below the lower limit. The injectors in this group lose drive voltage and may stop firing, so the cylinders they serve run lean or cut out. Causes: a blown fuse, a failed injector supply relay, a voltage drop in the supply harness, or a poor ground or connector on the group-E supply.
possible_causes: Fuse, relay, or wiring fault on supply [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Injector Group E Supply Voltage Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The supply voltage feeding injector group E has dropped below the lower limit. The injectors in this group lose drive voltage and may stop firing, so the cylinders they serve run lean or cut out. Causes: a blown fuse, a failed injector supply relay, a voltage drop in the supply harness, or a poor ground or connector on the group-E supply.
bilingual_description.de: Die Versorgungsspannung der Injektorgruppe E ist unter den unteren Grenzwert gefallen. Die Injektoren dieser Gruppe verlieren die Ansteuerspannung und spritzen eventuell nicht mehr ein; die zugehörigen Zylinder laufen mager oder setzen aus. Ursachen: durchgebrannte Sicherung, defektes Injektor-Versorgungsrelais, Spannungsabfall im Versorgungskabelbaum oder schlechte Masse bzw. ein Steckerfehler in der Versorgung der Gruppe E.

symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder
Possible fuel smell or smoke from exhaust

description: The supply voltage on injector group E is above the upper limit. Overvoltage on the group-E supply can mis-time or damage the injectors. Causes: charging-system overvoltage, a stuck supply relay or regulator, or a wiring fault shorting the group-E supply to a higher voltage.
possible_causes: Charging system overvoltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.7h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Injector Group E Supply Voltage Circuit High

bilingual_description.de: Die Versorgungsspannung der Injektorgruppe E liegt über dem oberen Grenzwert. Überspannung auf der Versorgung der Gruppe E kann die Injektoren falsch ansteuern oder beschädigen. Ursachen: Überspannung des Ladesystems, ein hängendes Versorgungsrelais bzw. ein defekter Regler oder ein Verdrahtungsfehler, der die Versorgung der Gruppe E auf eine höhere Spannung kurzschließt.

symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder

bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt einen elektrischen Fehler im Stromkreis des Wasser-im-Kraftstoff-Sensors am Dieselfilter. Bis zur Reparatur kann Wasserkontamination im Filter nicht erkannt werden, mit Risiko fuer Hochdruckpumpe und Injektoren.

description: The ECU detects that the water-in-fuel sensor signal is implausible compared to operating conditions. The reading does not change as expected during fuel filter purge or warm-up.
possible_causes: Sensor drift or contamination [HIGH]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
Sensor mounting loose - signal damping [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 250€ (0.3h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Water in Fuel Sensor Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects that the water-in-fuel sensor signal is implausible compared to operating conditions. The reading does not change as expected during fuel filter purge or warm-up.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt, dass das Signal des Wasser-im-Kraftstoff-Sensors gegenueber den Betriebsbedingungen unplausibel ist. Der Wert aendert sich nicht wie erwartet beim Entwaessern des Filters oder beim Aufwaermen.

description: The water-in-fuel sensor at the diesel fuel filter reads below lower plausibility — short to ground. The sensor warns the driver to drain the filter when condensate accumulates.
possible_causes: Short to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Water in Fuel Sensor A Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The water-in-fuel sensor at the diesel fuel filter reads below lower plausibility — short to ground. The sensor warns the driver to drain the filter when condensate accumulates.
bilingual_description.de: Der Wasser-im-Kraftstoff-Sensor am Dieselkraftstofffilter liegt unter unterer Plausibilität — Kurzschluss nach Masse. Der Sensor warnt den Fahrer, dass der Filter entwässert werden muss, wenn sich Kondensat sammelt.

description: Water-in-fuel sensor reads above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Open signal line [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Water in Fuel Sensor A Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Water-in-fuel sensor reads above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Wasser-im-Kraftstoff-Sensor liest über oberer Plausibilität — offenes Signal oder Kurzschluss nach Plus. Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

description: Water-in-fuel sensor signal jumps or drops out intermittently. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Intermittent connector [HIGH]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
Harness routed against vibrating component [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 300€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The water-in-fuel sensor at fuel filter A has detected water above the warning threshold. The fuel filter must be drained; running the engine on water-contaminated diesel can damage the high-pressure pump and injectors.

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 10€ - 100€ (0.2h - 0.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The downstream oxygen sensor on bank 1 reports a constant lean signal during a forced-rich command from the ECU. Suggests either a sensor that has lost its rich-side response, or a catalyst that is so degraded that no rich exhaust reaches the downstream sensor (cross-check P0420).
possible_causes: Downstream sensor failed stuck lean [HIGH]
Exhaust leak after catalyst [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 800€ (0.3h - 4h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The ECU has detected a discrepancy between commanded throttle/intake conditions and the resulting MAP/MAF that points to unmetered air entering after the throttle body. possible_causes: Boost pipe disconnected or cracked [HIGH]
Intake hose split [HIGH]

bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt nicht vermessene Luft, die nach der Drosselklappe in den Ansaugtrakt eindringt. Typische Quellen sind undichte Saugrohrdichtungen, Unterdruckschlaeuche oder Kurbelgehaeuseentlueftungs-Komponenten.

description: A general electrical fault on the injector control pressure (ICP) sensor — used on HEUI (Hydraulically actuated Electronically controlled Unit Injector) systems on heavy-duty diesel engines such as the Ford Powerstroke 6.0/7.3 and Caterpillar engines. ICP measures the high-pressure oil that actuates the injectors.
possible_causes: Sensor failed [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The injector control pressure (ICP) sensor on HEUI diesel systems reports a value that does not match expected operating range or commanded pressure. Affects fuel injection timing and quantity.

Leak in high-pressure oil system [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: ICP signal is unstable or jumps — connector or sensor issue, or air in the high-pressure oil rail. A flow-deviating injector throws off cylinder balance — adjacent cylinders run leaner/richer to compensate, often masking the root cause until the trim limit is hit.

Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
Harness routed against vibrating component [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2000€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Treiberleitung des Alternativ-Kraftstoffinjektors an Zylinder 1 niedrig — Kurzschluss nach Masse. Ein abweichender Injektor stört die Zylinderbalance — Nachbarzylinder laufen kompensatorisch magerer/fetter, was die Ursache oft maskiert, bis das Trim-Limit erreicht ist.

symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder
Possible fuel smell or smoke from exhaust

description: Cylinder 1 alternative-fuel injector drive line stuck high — short to B+. A flow-deviating injector throws off cylinder balance — adjacent cylinders run leaner/richer to compensate, often masking the root cause until the trim limit is hit.
possible_causes: Short to B+ [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The ECU continuously trims individual cylinders to equalise air-fuel ratio across the bank using ion-current or per-cylinder lambda feedback. garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1200€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Cylinder 1 Air-Fuel Ratio Imbalance Adjustment At Limit During Balance

bilingual_description.en: The ECU continuously trims individual cylinders to equalise air-fuel ratio across the bank using ion-current or per-cylinder lambda feedback. For cylinder 1 the per-cylinder fuel correction has hit its software-side maximum or minimum without restoring balance, indicating the underlying mechanical or fuelling deviation is too large to compensate.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuergerät regelt einzelne Zylinder fortlaufend nach, um das Luft-Kraftstoff-Verhältnis innerhalb einer Bank anzugleichen (per Ionenstrom- oder zylinderindividueller Lambdaregelung). Für Zylinder 1 hat die Kraftstoff-Einzelkorrektur ihre Software-Grenze erreicht, ohne dass die Balance wiederhergestellt wäre - die mechanische oder einspritzbedingte Abweichung ist zu gross, um sie noch ausregeln zu können.

description: The primary control circuit of ignition coil E reads a voltage below the expected level — usually a short to ground on the primary driver wire or a low-resistance fault in the coil primary winding. Coil E cannot build a normal charge, so the cylinder it fires misfires, especially under load. Causes: short to ground in the primary wiring, an internal coil primary fault, or a faulty ECU/igniter driver.
possible_causes: Primary winding shorted to ground or harness chafed [HIGH]
Coil E internal driver fault [MEDIUM]
Connector oxidised or loose at coil E [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 280€ (0.4h - 1.2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Coil E Primary Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The primary control circuit of ignition coil E reads a voltage below the expected level — usually a short to ground on the primary driver wire or a low-resistance fault in the coil primary winding. Coil E cannot build a normal charge, so the cylinder it fires misfires, especially under load. Causes: short to ground in the primary wiring, an internal coil primary fault, or a faulty ECU/igniter driver.
bilingual_description.de: Der Primär-Steuerkreis der Zündspule E liegt unter dem erwarteten Spannungswert — meist Masseschluss an der Primär-Steuerleitung oder ein niederohmiger Fehler in der Primärwicklung. Spule E kann keine normale Ladung aufbauen, der zugehörige Zylinder setzt aus, besonders unter Last. Ursachen: Masseschluss in der Primärverkabelung, interner Fehler der Primärwicklung oder eine defekte Endstufe im Steuergerät/Zündmodul.

description: The primary control circuit of ignition coil E reads a voltage above the expected level — typically an open primary circuit or a short to battery voltage on the primary control wire. The ECU sees no normal current flow, coil E does not fire, and the cylinder misfires. Causes: an open or disconnected primary wire, an internal open in the coil, or a faulty ECU driver.
possible_causes: Open circuit in primary winding or harness for coil E [HIGH]
Control line shorted to battery or supply [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 280€ (0.4h - 1.2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Coil E Primary Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The primary control circuit of ignition coil E reads a voltage above the expected level — typically an open primary circuit or a short to battery voltage on the primary control wire. The ECU sees no normal current flow, coil E does not fire, and the cylinder misfires. Causes: an open or disconnected primary wire, an internal open in the coil, or a faulty ECU driver.
bilingual_description.de: Der Primär-Steuerkreis der Zündspule E liegt über dem erwarteten Spannungswert — typischerweise eine Unterbrechung im Primärkreis oder ein Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung an der Primär-Steuerleitung. Das Steuergerät erkennt keinen normalen Stromfluss, Spule E zündet nicht, der Zylinder setzt aus. Ursachen: unterbrochene oder abgesteckte Primärleitung, interne Unterbrechung in der Spule oder eine defekte Endstufe im Steuergerät.

description: A fault is detected on the secondary (high-voltage) side of ignition coil E. The spark delivered to the plug is missing or too weak, causing a misfire on the cylinder served by coil E. Causes: a worn spark plug or wide gap, a cracked coil or boot, carbon tracking, or an open or leaking secondary winding.
possible_causes: Spark plug worn, fouled or with excessive electrode gap [HIGH]
Secondary breakdown inside coil E [MEDIUM]
Spark lead or boot cracked [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 280€ (0.4h - 1.2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Coil E Secondary Circuit

bilingual_description.en: A fault is detected on the secondary (high-voltage) side of ignition coil E. The spark delivered to the plug is missing or too weak, causing a misfire on the cylinder served by coil E. Causes: a worn spark plug or wide gap, a cracked coil or boot, carbon tracking, or an open or leaking secondary winding.
bilingual_description.de: Auf der Sekundärseite (Hochspannung) der Zündspule E wird ein Fehler erkannt. Der an die Kerze gelieferte Zündfunke fehlt oder ist zu schwach, der von Spule E versorgte Zylinder setzt aus. Ursachen: verschlissene Zündkerze oder zu großer Elektrodenabstand, gerissene Spule oder gerissener Kerzenschacht, Kriechströme oder eine unterbrochene bzw. durchschlagende Sekundärwicklung.

Causes: short to ground in the primary wiring, an internal coil primary fault, or a faulty ECU/igniter driver.
bilingual_description.de: Der Primär-Steuerkreis der Zündspule H liegt unter dem erwarteten Spannungswert — meist Masseschluss an der Primär-Steuerleitung oder ein niederohmiger Fehler in der Primärwicklung. Spule H kann keine normale Ladung aufbauen, der zugehörige Zylinder setzt aus, besonders unter Last. Ursachen: Masseschluss in der Primärverkabelung, interner Fehler der Primärwicklung oder eine defekte Endstufe im Steuergerät/Zündmodul.

description: The primary control circuit of ignition coil H reads a voltage above the expected level — typically an open primary circuit or a short to battery voltage on the primary control wire. The ECU sees no normal current flow, coil H does not fire, and the cylinder misfires. Causes: an open or disconnected primary wire, an internal open in the coil, or a faulty ECU driver.
possible_causes: Open circuit in primary winding or harness for coil H [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 280€ (0.4h - 1.2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

Das Steuergerät erkennt keinen normalen Stromfluss, Spule H zündet nicht, der Zylinder setzt aus. description: A fault is detected on the secondary (high-voltage) side of ignition coil H. The spark delivered to the plug is missing or too weak, causing a misfire on the cylinder served by coil H. possible_causes: Spark plug worn or fouled [HIGH]

bilingual_description.de: Die DPF-Verstopfung hat den Grenzwert für die Notbegrenzung erreicht. Das Fahrverhalten hängt vom Hersteller ab — meist ein hartes Drehmomentlimit mit Wartungshinweis.

symptoms: Check engine light or DPF warning light on

description: The DPF differential pressure sensor reports a backpressure rise consistent with excessive soot accumulation. The filter cannot regenerate fast enough, eventually causing limp mode.
possible_causes: Repeated failed regeneration cycles [HIGH]
Heavily clogged DPF [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 3000€ (1h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Restriction - Soot Accumulation

bilingual_description.en: The DPF differential pressure sensor reports a backpressure rise consistent with excessive soot accumulation. The filter cannot regenerate fast enough, eventually causing limp mode.
bilingual_description.de: Der DPF-Differenzdrucksensor meldet einen Staudruckanstieg, der auf eine zu hohe Russbeladung hinweist. Der Filter kann nicht schnell genug regenerieren, was schliesslich zum Notlauf fuehrt.

symptoms: Check engine light or DPF warning light on

description: The estimated soot mass in the DPF has crossed the upper limit and the ECU could not complete a regeneration to bring it back down. Very common on cars used on short trips. Continued driving in this state risks a runaway regeneration that destroys the filter.
possible_causes: DPF heavily loaded after multiple aborted regenerations [HIGH]
Predominantly short-trip operation [HIGH]
Differential pressure sensor reading drifted high [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 3500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Restriction — Soot Accumulation

bilingual_description.en: The estimated soot mass in the DPF has crossed the upper limit and the ECU could not complete a regeneration to bring it back down. Very common on cars used on short trips. Continued driving in this state risks a runaway regeneration that destroys the filter.
bilingual_description.de: Die geschätzte Rußmasse im DPF hat den oberen Grenzwert überschritten und die Motorsteuerung konnte sie nicht durch eine Regeneration zurückführen. Sehr häufig bei Fahrzeugen mit Kurzstreckenprofil. Weiterfahren in diesem Zustand birgt das Risiko einer unkontrollierten Regeneration, die den Filter zerstört.

symptoms: Check engine light or DPF warning light on

description: The differential pressure across the DPF exceeds the calibrated upper threshold during operation. Indicates severe blockage of the filter element.
possible_causes: DPF heavily clogged [HIGH]
Blocked pressure sensing line [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 3000€ (1.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure Too High

bilingual_description.de: Der Differenzdruck ueber den Dieselpartikelfilter ueberschreitet im Betrieb den kalibrierten oberen Schwellenwert. Hinweis auf eine starke Verstopfung des Filterelements.

symptoms: Check engine light or DPF warning light on

description: The DPF differential pressure sensor signal is implausible compared to engine load and exhaust flow. Either the sensor or the pressure tubes leading to it are at fault.

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

description: The ammonia (NH3) slip sensor downstream of the SCR catalyst delivers an intermittent or erratic signal. The ECM expects a smooth voltage proportional to ammonia concentration in the tailpipe — sudden jumps, dropouts or noise mean the wiring, connector or sensing element is failing. Used to close-loop the AdBlue/DEF dosing strategy.
possible_causes: Corroded or loose sensor connector [HIGH]
Chafed or vibrating harness near the exhaust [MEDIUM]
Aged ceramic sensor element drifting under heat cycles [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 180€ - 900€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

bilingual_description.en: The ammonia (NH3) slip sensor downstream of the SCR catalyst delivers an intermittent or erratic signal. The ECM expects a smooth voltage proportional to ammonia concentration in the tailpipe — sudden jumps, dropouts or noise mean the wiring, connector or sensing element is failing. Used to close-loop the AdBlue/DEF dosing strategy.
bilingual_description.de: Der Ammoniak-Schlupf-Sensor (NH3) hinter dem SCR-Katalysator liefert ein aussetzendes oder sprunghaftes Signal. Die Motorsteuerung erwartet eine ruhige Spannung proportional zur NH3-Konzentration im Endrohr — Sprünge, Ausfälle oder Rauschen deuten auf Verkabelung, Stecker oder die Sensorzelle. Wird genutzt, um die AdBlue/DEF-Dosierung im geschlossenen Regelkreis zu führen.

description: The heater inside the ammonia (NH3) slip sensor warms the sensing cell to operating temperature so it can read tailpipe ammonia. The ECM detects an open in the heater control circuit — no current flows when the heater should be active, so the sensor never reaches its working point and SCR closed-loop control is suspended.
possible_causes: Burnt-out heater winding inside the sensor [HIGH]
Broken wire or unplugged connector [MEDIUM]
Failed heater driver stage in the dosing module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 950€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Heater Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The heater inside the ammonia (NH3) slip sensor warms the sensing cell to operating temperature so it can read tailpipe ammonia. The ECM detects an open in the heater control circuit — no current flows when the heater should be active, so the sensor never reaches its working point and SCR closed-loop control is suspended.
bilingual_description.de: Die Heizung im NH3-Schlupf-Sensor bringt die Messzelle auf Betriebstemperatur, damit sie den Ammoniak-Schlupf erkennen kann. Die Motorsteuerung erkennt eine Unterbrechung im Heizungssteuerkreis — es fließt kein Strom, obwohl die Heizung aktiv sein sollte. Der Sensor erreicht nicht seinen Arbeitspunkt, der geschlossene SCR-Regelkreis wird ausgesetzt.

description: The heater control circuit of the ammonia (NH3) slip sensor reads below the expected voltage range. Either the wiring is shorted to ground or the heater driver in the SCR/dosing module is stuck low. The sensor element never warms up, NH3 readings stay invalid and the SCR strategy falls back to open-loop dosing.
possible_causes: Heater control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short across the heater element [MEDIUM]
Low-side driver pulled down in the control module [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 180€ - 900€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Heater Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The heater control circuit of the ammonia (NH3) slip sensor reads below the expected voltage range. Either the wiring is shorted to ground or the heater driver in the SCR/dosing module is stuck low. The sensor element never warms up, NH3 readings stay invalid and the SCR strategy falls back to open-loop dosing.
bilingual_description.de: Der Heizungssteuerkreis des NH3-Schlupf-Sensors liegt unterhalb des erwarteten Spannungsbereichs. Entweder ist die Leitung gegen Masse kurzgeschlossen oder die Heizungs-Endstufe im SCR-/Dosiermodul hängt niedrig. Die Messzelle erreicht ihre Arbeitstemperatur nicht, NH3-Werte bleiben ungültig, und der SCR fällt auf offene Steuerung zurück.

description: The heater control circuit of the NH3 slip sensor reads above the expected voltage range. Typically a short to battery voltage or a heater driver stuck high — duty-cycle control is lost, the heater either runs continuously or not at all, and the sensor element risks overheating before the ECM disables it.
possible_causes: Heater control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
High-side driver stuck on [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 180€ - 900€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Heater Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The heater control circuit of the NH3 slip sensor reads above the expected voltage range. Typically a short to battery voltage or a heater driver stuck high — duty-cycle control is lost, the heater either runs continuously or not at all, and the sensor element risks overheating before the ECM disables it.
bilingual_description.de: Der Heizungssteuerkreis des NH3-Schlupf-Sensors liegt oberhalb des erwarteten Spannungsbereichs. Meist ein Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung oder eine hängende Heizungs-Endstufe — die Tastverhältnis-Regelung geht verloren, die Heizung läuft entweder dauerhaft oder gar nicht, und die Messzelle droht zu überhitzen, bis das Steuergerät abschaltet.

description: The heater of the NH3 slip sensor is electrically intact, but the warm-up profile or steady-state temperature feedback does not match the ECM model. The sensor takes too long to reach operating temperature or drifts away from setpoint, so SCR closed-loop control is delayed or held off.
possible_causes: Aged heater with increased resistance [HIGH]
Poor thermal contact between heater and sensing cell [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 950€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Heater Circuit Performance

bilingual_description.en: The heater of the NH3 slip sensor is electrically intact, but the warm-up profile or steady-state temperature feedback does not match the ECM model. The sensor takes too long to reach operating temperature or drifts away from setpoint, so SCR closed-loop control is delayed or held off.
bilingual_description.de: Die Heizung des NH3-Schlupf-Sensors ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber das Aufheizprofil oder die Temperaturrückführung im Beharrungspunkt entspricht nicht dem ECM-Modell. Der Sensor erreicht die Betriebstemperatur zu langsam oder driftet vom Sollwert ab, der SCR-Regelkreis wird verzögert oder bleibt offen.

description: The supply rail that powers the NH3 slip sensor electronics (typically 5 V or 12 V from the dosing/SCR module) is out of tolerance. Without a stable supply the sensor cannot deliver a valid ammonia reading, and the ECM disables the closed-loop SCR strategy.
possible_causes: Open or shorted supply wire [HIGH]
Failing supply rail inside the dosing module [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Supply Voltage Circuit

bilingual_description.en: The supply rail that powers the NH3 slip sensor electronics (typically 5 V or 12 V from the dosing/SCR module) is out of tolerance. Without a stable supply the sensor cannot deliver a valid ammonia reading, and the ECM disables the closed-loop SCR strategy.
bilingual_description.de: Die Versorgungsleitung, die die Elektronik des NH3-Schlupf-Sensors speist (typisch 5 V oder 12 V vom Dosier-/SCR-Modul), liegt außerhalb der Toleranz. Ohne stabile Versorgung kann der Sensor keinen gültigen NH3-Wert liefern, und der geschlossene SCR-Regelkreis wird abgeschaltet.

description: The NH3 slip sensor supply voltage drops below the lower limit. Usually a partial short to ground in the supply line, an undersized ground path with high resistance, or an internal supply collapse in the SCR/dosing module. Sensor output is held invalid until the supply recovers.
possible_causes: Supply line shorted to ground [HIGH]
High-resistance ground at the SCR module [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Supply Voltage Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The NH3 slip sensor supply voltage drops below the lower limit. Usually a partial short to ground in the supply line, an undersized ground path with high resistance, or an internal supply collapse in the SCR/dosing module. Sensor output is held invalid until the supply recovers.
bilingual_description.de: Die Versorgungsspannung des NH3-Schlupf-Sensors fällt unter den unteren Grenzwert. Meist ein teilweiser Masseschluss in der Versorgungsleitung, ein hochohmiger Massepfad oder ein Einbruch im internen Versorgungsteil des SCR-/Dosiermoduls. Der Sensorwert bleibt ungültig, bis die Versorgung wieder steht.

description: The NH3 slip sensor supply voltage rises above the upper limit. Either the supply is shorted to battery voltage or an internal regulator in the dosing module has failed open. The sensor electronics may be damaged if the condition persists, so the ECM disables the input.
possible_causes: Supply line shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Failed voltage regulator in the dosing module [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Supply Voltage Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The NH3 slip sensor supply voltage rises above the upper limit. Either the supply is shorted to battery voltage or an internal regulator in the dosing module has failed open. The sensor electronics may be damaged if the condition persists, so the ECM disables the input.
bilingual_description.de: Die Versorgungsspannung des NH3-Schlupf-Sensors steigt über den oberen Grenzwert. Entweder ist die Versorgung gegen Batteriespannung kurzgeschlossen oder ein interner Spannungsregler im Dosiermodul ist offen ausgefallen. Bei dauerhaftem Zustand kann die Sensorelektronik beschädigt werden, deshalb deaktiviert das Steuergerät den Eingang.

description: The NH3 slip sensor stores its individual calibration coefficients in non-volatile memory (EEPROM/flash). The ECM cannot read valid calibration values — either checksum fails, the memory is empty after replacement, or communication with the sensor electronics is broken. Without the trim values the raw ammonia reading is unreliable.
possible_causes: New sensor installed but not coded/learned to the ECM [HIGH]
Corrupted calibration memory after voltage drop [MEDIUM]
Module software outdated, reflash may resolve [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Calibration Memory

bilingual_description.en: The NH3 slip sensor stores its individual calibration coefficients in non-volatile memory (EEPROM/flash). The ECM cannot read valid calibration values — either checksum fails, the memory is empty after replacement, or communication with the sensor electronics is broken. Without the trim values the raw ammonia reading is unreliable.
bilingual_description.de: Der NH3-Schlupf-Sensor speichert seine individuellen Kalibrierwerte in nichtflüchtigem Speicher (EEPROM/Flash). Die Motorsteuerung kann keine gültigen Kalibrierdaten lesen — Checksumme fehlerhaft, Speicher nach Tausch leer, oder Kommunikation mit der Sensorelektronik unterbrochen. Ohne Korrekturwerte ist der Roh-NH3-Wert unzuverlässig.

description: The microcontroller inside the smart NH3 slip sensor reports an internal performance fault — failed self-test, watchdog reset, or out-of-range plausibility checks. The sensor cannot guarantee its output value, the ECM marks the channel invalid and disables SCR closed-loop control on this branch.
possible_causes: Internal processor or firmware fault [HIGH]
Brown-out from supply voltage dips [MEDIUM]
Module software outdated, reflash may resolve [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 900€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NH3 Sensor Processor Performance

bilingual_description.en: The microcontroller inside the smart NH3 slip sensor reports an internal performance fault — failed self-test, watchdog reset, or out-of-range plausibility checks. The sensor cannot guarantee its output value, the ECM marks the channel invalid and disables SCR closed-loop control on this branch.
bilingual_description.de: Der Mikrocontroller im intelligenten NH3-Schlupf-Sensor meldet eine interne Leistungsstörung — fehlgeschlagener Selbsttest, Watchdog-Reset oder Plausibilitätsprüfung außerhalb der Grenzen. Der Sensor kann seinen Ausgabewert nicht garantieren, die Motorsteuerung markiert den Kanal als ungültig und deaktiviert den SCR-Regelkreis auf diesem Pfad.

description: The wake-up line that brings a sleeping ECU back from low-power mode is open. Many networks use a dedicated hardware wake-up wire (door-latch trigger, terminal 15, CAN wake-up) so modules can stay asleep with the ignition off. Without it, the module either fails to wake up at start-up or stays awake and drains the battery.
possible_causes: Broken wake-up wire or unplugged connector [HIGH]
Failed wake-up input stage in the module [MEDIUM]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Control Module Wake-up Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The wake-up line that brings a sleeping ECU back from low-power mode is open. Many networks use a dedicated hardware wake-up wire (door-latch trigger, terminal 15, CAN wake-up) so modules can stay asleep with the ignition off. Without it, the module either fails to wake up at start-up or stays awake and drains the battery.
bilingual_description.de: Die Wake-up-Leitung, die ein schlafendes Steuergerät aus dem Stromsparmodus weckt, ist unterbrochen. Viele Bordnetze nutzen eine eigene Hardware-Weckleitung (Türkontakt, Klemme 15, CAN-Wake-up), damit Module bei abgeschalteter Zündung schlafen können. Ohne sie wacht das Modul beim Start nicht auf oder bleibt wach und zieht die Batterie leer.

description: The wake-up input on the control module reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a permanently asserted wake signal. The module either keeps waking up unnecessarily and drains the battery, or it cannot distinguish a real wake event from the stuck low level.
possible_causes: Wake-up wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Door, hood or terminal switch stuck closed [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Control Module Wake-up Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The wake-up input on the control module reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a permanently asserted wake signal. The module either keeps waking up unnecessarily and drains the battery, or it cannot distinguish a real wake event from the stuck low level.
bilingual_description.de: Der Wake-up-Eingang am Steuergerät liegt dauerhaft niedrig — meist ein Masseschluss oder ein dauerhaft anliegendes Wecksignal. Das Modul wacht entweder unnötig auf und entlädt die Batterie, oder es kann ein echtes Wecksignal nicht mehr vom anhängenden Low-Pegel unterscheiden.

description: The wake-up input reads above the expected range — typically a short to battery voltage. The module sees a permanent wake-up request, never enters sleep mode and drains the battery while parked.
possible_causes: Wake-up wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Control Module Wake-up Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The wake-up input reads above the expected range — typically a short to battery voltage. The module sees a permanent wake-up request, never enters sleep mode and drains the battery while parked.
bilingual_description.de: Der Wake-up-Eingang liegt oberhalb des erwarteten Bereichs — typisch ein Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Das Modul erkennt eine dauerhafte Weckanforderung, geht nie in den Schlafmodus und entlädt im Stand die Batterie.

description: After a long key-off soak both the EGR temperature sensor and the charge-air cooler outlet temperature sensor must read approximately the same ambient temperature. The ECM compares them and detects an implausible delta. One of the sensors drifts, is wired wrong, or is exposed to a heat source the model does not know about.
possible_causes: One sensor drifting outside tolerance [HIGH]
Residual heat in the charge-air cooler after a hot soak [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: EGR Temperature/Charge Air Cooler Temperature Correlation

bilingual_description.en: After a long key-off soak both the EGR temperature sensor and the charge-air cooler outlet temperature sensor must read approximately the same ambient temperature. The ECM compares them and detects an implausible delta. One of the sensors drifts, is wired wrong, or is exposed to a heat source the model does not know about.
bilingual_description.de: Nach längerer Stillstandszeit müssen EGR-Temperatursensor und Ladeluftkühler-Austrittstemperatursensor ungefähr dieselbe Umgebungstemperatur melden. Die Motorsteuerung vergleicht beide und erkennt eine unplausible Differenz. Einer der Sensoren driftet, ist falsch verkabelt oder einer Wärmequelle ausgesetzt, die das Modell nicht kennt.

description: After a long key-off soak the AdBlue/DEF tank temperature and the fuel tank temperature should read close to each other (both at ambient). The ECM detects an implausible spread, which usually means one of the two sensors drifts, is wired wrong, or has a heat source nearby that the plausibility model does not account for.
possible_causes: One temperature sensor drifting outside tolerance [HIGH]
Recently active reductant tank heater warming the tank above ambient [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Reductant Tank Temperature/Fuel Temperature Correlation

bilingual_description.en: After a long key-off soak the AdBlue/DEF tank temperature and the fuel tank temperature should read close to each other (both at ambient). The ECM detects an implausible spread, which usually means one of the two sensors drifts, is wired wrong, or has a heat source nearby that the plausibility model does not account for.
bilingual_description.de: Nach längerer Stillstandszeit sollten die Temperaturen von AdBlue/DEF-Tank und Kraftstofftank nahe beieinander liegen (beide auf Umgebungstemperatur). Die Motorsteuerung erkennt eine unplausible Spreizung, meist, weil einer der beiden Sensoren driftet, falsch verkabelt ist oder eine Wärmequelle in der Nähe das Plausibilitätsmodell stört.

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

description: The pre-catalyst NOx sensor on bank 1 (sensor 1) reacts too slowly when NOx in the exhaust drops from a high to a low level — for example after a fuel cut or transition into low-load. Aged ceramic cells, soot deposits or condensation inside the sensor protective tube slow the diffusion of NOx to the measuring element.
possible_causes: Aged sensor element with reduced response speed [HIGH]
Soot clogging the protective tube [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 1200€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NOx Sensor Delayed Response - High to Low Bank 1 Sensor 1
bilingual_title.de: NOx-Sensor verzögerte Reaktion hoch nach niedrig Bank 1 Sensor 1

bilingual_description.en: The pre-catalyst NOx sensor on bank 1 (sensor 1) reacts too slowly when NOx in the exhaust drops from a high to a low level — for example after a fuel cut or transition into low-load. Aged ceramic cells, soot deposits or condensation inside the sensor protective tube slow the diffusion of NOx to the measuring element.
bilingual_description.de: Der Vorkat-NOx-Sensor an Bank 1 (Sensor 1) reagiert zu langsam, wenn der NOx-Gehalt im Abgas von einem hohen auf einen niedrigen Wert fällt — etwa nach einer Schubabschaltung oder im Übergang in Niedriglast. Gealterte Keramikzellen, Rußablagerungen oder Kondensat im Schutzrohr verlangsamen die Diffusion zum Messelement.

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

description: The post-catalyst NOx sensor on bank 1 (sensor 2) reacts too slowly when NOx in the exhaust drops from a high to a low level. Same failure mechanism as the upstream sensor — aged element, soot or condensate — but post-catalyst the consequence is a degraded SCR conversion-efficiency monitor.
possible_causes: Aged sensor element with reduced response speed [HIGH]
Soot clogging the protective tube [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 1200€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: NOx Sensor Delayed Response - High to Low Bank 1 Sensor 2
bilingual_title.de: NOx-Sensor verzögerte Reaktion hoch nach niedrig Bank 1 Sensor 2

bilingual_description.en: The post-catalyst NOx sensor on bank 1 (sensor 2) reacts too slowly when NOx in the exhaust drops from a high to a low level. Same failure mechanism as the upstream sensor — aged element, soot or condensate — but post-catalyst the consequence is a degraded SCR conversion-efficiency monitor.
bilingual_description.de: Der Nachkat-NOx-Sensor an Bank 1 (Sensor 2) reagiert zu langsam, wenn der NOx-Gehalt im Abgas von hoch auf niedrig fällt. Derselbe Fehlermechanismus wie beim Vorkat-Sensor — gealterte Zelle, Ruß oder Kondensat — nachkat führt das aber zu einer geschwächten SCR-Wirkungsgradüberwachung.

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

description: On systems that inject HC dosing fuel or AIR-assisted reductant into the aftertreatment, a purge valve clears the line after each dosing event. The ECM detects the valve stuck open — pressure or flow does not build up against a closed valve, so the dosing line cannot be charged. Common on diesel HC-doser hardware (DPF regen support).
possible_causes: Mechanically stuck open valve from soot or coking [HIGH]
Broken return spring [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 900€ (0.6h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Stuck Open

bilingual_description.en: On systems that inject HC dosing fuel or AIR-assisted reductant into the aftertreatment, a purge valve clears the line after each dosing event. The ECM detects the valve stuck open — pressure or flow does not build up against a closed valve, so the dosing line cannot be charged. Common on diesel HC-doser hardware (DPF regen support).
bilingual_description.de: Bei Systemen, die HC-Dosierkraftstoff oder luftunterstütztes Reduktionsmittel in die Nachbehandlung einspritzen, spült ein Ventil die Leitung nach jeder Dosierung frei. Die Motorsteuerung erkennt das Ventil als offen festgesteckt — gegen ein geschlossenes Ventil baut sich kein Druck oder Fluss auf, die Dosierleitung lässt sich nicht füllen. Typisch bei Diesel-HC-Dosierern (DPF-Regen-Unterstützung).

description: The aftertreatment HC dosing or reductant purge valve is stuck closed. The ECM commands purge but the line is not cleared, leaving residual fluid that can foul nozzles or freeze in cold weather. Subsequent dosing events also fail because backpressure does not match the model.
possible_causes: Stuck closed by deposits or seized armature [HIGH]
Open coil — valve never opens [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 900€ (0.6h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Stuck Closed

bilingual_description.en: The aftertreatment HC dosing or reductant purge valve is stuck closed. The ECM commands purge but the line is not cleared, leaving residual fluid that can foul nozzles or freeze in cold weather. Subsequent dosing events also fail because backpressure does not match the model.
bilingual_description.de: Das Spülventil der HC-Dosierung oder Reduktionsmittel-Spülung in der Abgasnachbehandlung ist geschlossen festgesteckt. Die Motorsteuerung kommandiert spülen, aber die Leitung wird nicht freigeräumt — Restflüssigkeit kann Düsen verstopfen oder in der Kälte einfrieren. Folgende Dosiervorgänge schlagen ebenfalls fehl, weil der Gegendruck nicht zum Modell passt.

description: General electrical fault in the control circuit of the aftertreatment fuel/air purge valve. The ECM cannot drive the valve coil according to plausibility checks — open, short or unexpected feedback voltage. Until cleared, dosing line purge is suspended.
possible_causes: Open or shorted control wire [HIGH]
Failed driver stage in the dosing module [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault in the control circuit of the aftertreatment fuel/air purge valve. The ECM cannot drive the valve coil according to plausibility checks — open, short or unexpected feedback voltage. Until cleared, dosing line purge is suspended.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler im Steuerkreis des Spülventils der Abgasnachbehandlung. Die Motorsteuerung kann die Ventilspule nicht plausibel ansteuern — Unterbrechung, Kurzschluss oder unerwartete Rückmeldungsspannung. Bis zur Klärung wird die Spülung der Dosierleitung ausgesetzt.

description: The valve coil is electrically intact, but the response (current rise time, return-current decay, position feedback) does not match the ECM model. Typical for solenoids losing magnetic strength after long thermal cycling, or armatures with increased friction from coking.
possible_causes: Aged solenoid with weakened magnetic force [HIGH]
Coked armature with increased friction [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 800€ (0.6h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The valve coil is electrically intact, but the response (current rise time, return-current decay, position feedback) does not match the ECM model. Typical for solenoids losing magnetic strength after long thermal cycling, or armatures with increased friction from coking.
bilingual_description.de: Die Ventilspule ist elektrisch in Ordnung, doch die Reaktion (Stromanstiegszeit, Abklingen, Lagerückmeldung) entspricht nicht dem ECM-Modell. Typisch für Magnetventile, deren Magnetkraft nach langen Temperaturzyklen nachlässt, oder Anker mit erhöhter Reibung durch Verkokung.

description: The control circuit of the aftertreatment purge valve reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a failed low-side driver. The valve is energised continuously when it should be off, or the diagnostic feedback voltage is pulled below threshold.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Failed low-side driver stuck on [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The control circuit of the aftertreatment purge valve reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a failed low-side driver. The valve is energised continuously when it should be off, or the diagnostic feedback voltage is pulled below threshold.
bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis des Spülventils der Abgasnachbehandlung liegt dauerhaft niedrig — meist Masseschluss oder defekter Low-Side-Treiber. Das Ventil wird ständig bestromt, obwohl es ausgeschaltet sein sollte, oder die Diagnose-Rückmeldungsspannung wird unter den Schwellwert gezogen.

description: The control circuit of the aftertreatment purge valve reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage or an open ground/return path. The driver cannot pull the line low to actuate the valve.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Open ground or open coil [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The control circuit of the aftertreatment purge valve reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage or an open ground/return path. The driver cannot pull the line low to actuate the valve.
bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis des Spülventils der Abgasnachbehandlung liegt dauerhaft hoch — typisch Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung oder offene Masse-/Rückleitung. Der Treiber kann die Leitung nicht auf Low ziehen, um das Ventil zu schalten.

description: The PM (soot) sensor heater is driven by a current-limited stage so it can burn off accumulated soot before each measurement. The driver reports current or junction temperature above the safe limit and disables itself. Often a partial short across the heater or sensor element after coolant intrusion.
possible_causes: Partial short across the heater element [HIGH]
Driver overheating due to poor cooling on the module [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 250€ - 1100€ (0.6h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Particulate Matter Sensor Heater Control Circuit Driver Current/Temperature Too High

bilingual_description.en: The PM (soot) sensor heater is driven by a current-limited stage so it can burn off accumulated soot before each measurement. The driver reports current or junction temperature above the safe limit and disables itself. Often a partial short across the heater or sensor element after coolant intrusion.
bilingual_description.de: Der Heizer des Partikel-(Ruß-)Sensors wird über eine strombegrenzte Endstufe angesteuert, damit er vor jeder Messung den angesammelten Ruß abbrennt. Die Endstufe meldet Strom oder Sperrschicht-Temperatur oberhalb der Sicherheitsgrenze und schaltet ab. Häufig ein Teilkurzschluss am Heizelement oder Sensor nach Kühlmittel-Eintritt.

description: The ECM identifies the installed particulate filter A as the wrong part — backpressure signature, regeneration efficiency or coded part-number do not match the application. Common after a non-OEM aftermarket DPF or a wrong-application replacement.
possible_causes: Incorrect or non-OEM DPF installed [HIGH]
Coding mismatch after part replacement [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 3000€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Particulate Filter A Incorrect

bilingual_description.en: The ECM identifies the installed particulate filter A as the wrong part — backpressure signature, regeneration efficiency or coded part-number do not match the application. Common after a non-OEM aftermarket DPF or a wrong-application replacement.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt den verbauten Partikelfilter A als falsches Bauteil — Gegendrucksignatur, Regenerationswirkungsgrad oder codierte Teilnummer passen nicht zur Anwendung. Häufig nach einem aftermarket-DPF oder einem Tausch mit falscher Anwendung.

symptoms: Check engine light or DPF warning light on

description: The ECM identifies the installed SCR catalyst as the wrong part — NOx conversion efficiency, NH3 storage capacity or coded part-number do not match the expected application. Typical after fitting a non-OEM SCR brick or after a coding error following replacement.
possible_causes: Incorrect or non-OEM SCR catalyst installed [HIGH]
Coding mismatch after part replacement [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 500€ - 3500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: SCR Catalyst Incorrect

bilingual_description.en: The ECM identifies the installed SCR catalyst as the wrong part — NOx conversion efficiency, NH3 storage capacity or coded part-number do not match the expected application. Typical after fitting a non-OEM SCR brick or after a coding error following replacement.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt den verbauten SCR-Katalysator als falsches Bauteil — NOx-Umsatz, NH3-Speicherkapazität oder codierte Teilnummer passen nicht zur erwarteten Anwendung. Typisch nach Einbau eines nicht originalen SCR-Bricks oder Codierungsfehler nach Tausch.

symptoms: Sulfur (rotten egg) smell from exhaust under load

description: The temperature of the AdBlue/DEF in the dosing system exceeds the safe limit — risk of thermal decomposition (NH3/biuret formation) and clogged dosing nozzles. Often caused by a stuck-on tank heater, a stalled coolant return or proximity to a hot exhaust component.
possible_causes: Tank heater stuck on [HIGH]
Heat soak from exhaust or engine bay [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1200€ (0.6h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Reductant Temperature Too High

bilingual_description.en: The temperature of the AdBlue/DEF in the dosing system exceeds the safe limit — risk of thermal decomposition (NH3/biuret formation) and clogged dosing nozzles. Often caused by a stuck-on tank heater, a stalled coolant return or proximity to a hot exhaust component.
bilingual_description.de: Die Temperatur des AdBlue/DEF im Dosiersystem überschreitet den Sicherheitsgrenzwert — Risiko der thermischen Zersetzung (NH3/Biuret-Bildung) und verstopfter Dosierdüsen. Oft durch dauernd eingeschaltete Tankheizung, stehende Kühlmittel-Rückführung oder Nähe zu einem heißen Abgasbauteil.

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

description: The L-terminal feedback line from the alternator (charging warning lamp circuit) reads below the lower limit. The lamp may stay on, and battery voltage may drift if regulation feedback is also affected.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Alternator failure, Battery failure, Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: L-terminal shorted to ground [HIGH]
Alternator regulator failed [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Lamp/L-Terminal Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The L-terminal feedback line from the alternator (charging warning lamp circuit) reads below the lower limit. The lamp may stay on, and battery voltage may drift if regulation feedback is also affected.
bilingual_description.de: Die L-Klemmen-Rückmeldeleitung vom Generator (Ladekontroll-Stromkreis) liegt unter dem unteren Grenzwert. Die Kontrollleuchte kann dauerleuchten, und bei zugleich gestörter Regelung driftet die Bordnetzspannung.

description: The L-terminal feedback from the alternator reads above the upper limit — short to supply or open ground side. Charging diagnostics cannot run cleanly.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Alternator failure, Battery failure, Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: L-terminal shorted to supply [HIGH]
Alternator regulator failed [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Generator Lamp/L-Terminal Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The L-terminal feedback from the alternator reads above the upper limit — short to supply or open ground side. Charging diagnostics cannot run cleanly.
bilingual_description.de: Die L-Klemmen-Rückmeldung vom Generator liegt über dem oberen Grenzwert — Kurzschluss nach Plus oder offene Masseseite. Die Ladediagnose läuft nicht sauber.

description: The ECU detects an out-of-range charging system voltage without specifying high or low. Indicates a generic charging fault that requires further sub-code investigation.
possible_causes: Alternator output fault [HIGH]
Voltage regulator fault [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Charging System Voltage

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects an out-of-range charging system voltage without specifying high or low. Indicates a generic charging fault that requires further sub-code investigation.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt eine Bordnetzspannung ausserhalb des Sollbereichs ohne nach hoch oder niedrig zu unterscheiden. Hinweis auf einen allgemeinen Ladefehler, der weiterer Diagnose bedarf.

description: The ECU detects that battery voltage during operation stays below the regulated target. The alternator output is insufficient to maintain charge under load, eventually leading to battery depletion.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Alternator failure, Battery failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Weak alternator output [HIGH]
Faulty voltage regulator [MEDIUM]
Slipping drive belt [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Charging System Voltage Low

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects that battery voltage during operation stays below the regulated target. The alternator output is insufficient to maintain charge under load, eventually leading to battery depletion.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt, dass die Bordnetzspannung im Betrieb unter dem geregelten Sollwert bleibt. Die Generatorleistung reicht unter Last nicht aus, um die Batterie zu laden, was zu Tiefentladung fuehren kann.

description: The ECU detects a battery voltage above the regulated upper limit. The voltage regulator is not limiting alternator output, risking damage to electronic modules and battery overcharge.
possible_causes: Faulty voltage regulator [HIGH]
Poor alternator ground [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Charging System Voltage High

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects a battery voltage above the regulated upper limit. The voltage regulator is not limiting alternator output, risking damage to electronic modules and battery overcharge.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt eine Bordnetzspannung oberhalb des geregelten oberen Grenzwerts. Der Spannungsregler begrenzt die Generatorleistung nicht; es droht Schaden an Steuergeraeten und Ueberladung der Batterie.

description: The ECM/PCM monitors the main switched battery feed (typically terminal 15 / ignition-switched supply via the main relay). A general fault is reported — either the input is missing entirely or it does not match the expected timing relative to ignition state. Engine may not start or stay running.
possible_causes: Failed main relay [HIGH]
Blown fuse on the ECM power feed [MEDIUM]
Corroded connector pin at the ECM [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Input Signal

bilingual_description.en: The ECM/PCM monitors the main switched battery feed (typically terminal 15 / ignition-switched supply via the main relay). A general fault is reported — either the input is missing entirely or it does not match the expected timing relative to ignition state. Engine may not start or stay running.
bilingual_description.de: Das Motor-/Antriebsstrang-Steuergerät überwacht die Hauptschaltbatteriespeisung (typisch Klemme 15 / zündungsgeschaltete Versorgung über das Hauptrelais). Ein allgemeiner Fehler wird gemeldet — der Eingang fehlt entweder ganz oder das Timing passt nicht zum Zündungszustand. Der Motor startet evtl. nicht oder bleibt nicht laufen.

description: The switched-battery input to the ECM/PCM is present, but the level or transient behaviour is out of plausibility — sagging during cranking, slow ramp-up after main-relay close, or noisy. Often caused by aged main relay contacts or a weak battery feed under load.
possible_causes: Aged main relay contacts with rising contact resistance [HIGH]
Weak battery sagging during crank [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Input Signal Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The switched-battery input to the ECM/PCM is present, but the level or transient behaviour is out of plausibility — sagging during cranking, slow ramp-up after main-relay close, or noisy. Often caused by aged main relay contacts or a weak battery feed under load.
bilingual_description.de: Der zündungsgeschaltete Batterie-Eingang am ECM/PCM ist vorhanden, aber Pegel oder transientes Verhalten ist unplausibel — Einbruch beim Anlassen, langsamer Anstieg nach Schließen des Hauptrelais oder verrauscht. Oft durch verschlissene Relaiskontakte oder schwache Versorgung unter Last.

description: The ECM/PCM switched-battery input reads below threshold while the ignition is on. Either the main relay does not close, the supply wire is broken or shorted to ground, or the battery is too low. Engine usually fails to start until the input recovers.
possible_causes: Main relay does not pull in [HIGH]
Open supply wire [MEDIUM]
Severely discharged battery [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Input Signal Low

bilingual_description.en: The ECM/PCM switched-battery input reads below threshold while the ignition is on. Either the main relay does not close, the supply wire is broken or shorted to ground, or the battery is too low. Engine usually fails to start until the input recovers.
bilingual_description.de: Der zündungsgeschaltete Batterie-Eingang am ECM/PCM liegt bei eingeschalteter Zündung unter dem Schwellwert. Entweder schließt das Hauptrelais nicht, die Versorgungsleitung ist unterbrochen oder gegen Masse kurzgeschlossen, oder die Batterie ist zu schwach. Der Motor startet meist nicht, bis der Eingang wieder steht.

description: The ECM/PCM switched-battery input reads above the upper threshold. Most often caused by a charging system overvoltage (failed alternator regulator) or wrong jump-start procedure. Sustained high voltage risks damaging ECU electronics.
possible_causes: Alternator regulator overvoltage [HIGH]
Improper external power source or jump-start [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Input Signal High

bilingual_description.en: The ECM/PCM switched-battery input reads above the upper threshold. Most often caused by a charging system overvoltage (failed alternator regulator) or wrong jump-start procedure. Sustained high voltage risks damaging ECU electronics.
bilingual_description.de: Der zündungsgeschaltete Batterie-Eingang am ECM/PCM liegt über dem oberen Grenzwert. Meist durch Überspannung des Ladesystems (defekter Regler) oder falsche Starthilfe. Anhaltende Überspannung gefährdet die ECU-Elektronik.

description: The ECU detects sporadic interruptions of its supply voltage. The fault is set when supply drops below a threshold for short periods, often during cranking or due to a poor connection.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Powertrain Control Module (PCM) power relay failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Poor battery cable connection [HIGH]
Intermittent main relay [MEDIUM]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 400€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Input Signal Intermittent

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects sporadic interruptions of its supply voltage. The fault is set when supply drops below a threshold for short periods, often during cranking or due to a poor connection.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt sporadische Unterbrechungen ihrer Versorgungsspannung. Der Fehler wird gesetzt, wenn die Versorgung kurz unter einen Schwellenwert faellt, oft beim Starten oder durch einen schlechten Kontakt.

description: General electrical fault on the engine oil level sensor circuit. The ECM cannot read a plausible level signal (analog level, ultrasonic or capacitive sender). Without a valid level reading the ECM disables oil-low warnings and dynamic service-interval calculation.
possible_causes: Open or shorted wiring to the sensor [HIGH]
Corroded connector at the oil pan [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the engine oil level sensor circuit. The ECM cannot read a plausible level signal (analog level, ultrasonic or capacitive sender). Without a valid level reading the ECM disables oil-low warnings and dynamic service-interval calculation.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Stromkreis des Motoröl-Füllstandssensors. Die Motorsteuerung kann keinen plausiblen Pegel auslesen (analoger Geber, Ultraschall oder kapazitiv). Ohne gültigen Pegel werden Niedrigstandswarnung und dynamische Serviceintervall-Berechnung deaktiviert.

description: The oil level sensor is electrically intact, but the level reading is implausible — for example a constant value across drives, jumps that cannot match real oil consumption, or readings outside the design range. Often a contaminated or aged float/ultrasonic sender.
possible_causes: Aged or contaminated sender [HIGH]
Foaming oil under high RPM masking the level [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The oil level sensor is electrically intact, but the level reading is implausible — for example a constant value across drives, jumps that cannot match real oil consumption, or readings outside the design range. Often a contaminated or aged float/ultrasonic sender.
bilingual_description.de: Der Ölstandssensor ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber der Wert ist unplausibel — etwa konstanter Wert über mehrere Fahrten, Sprünge, die kein realer Ölverbrauch sein können, oder Werte außerhalb des Auslegungsbereichs. Häufig ein verschmutzter oder gealterter Schwimmer-/Ultraschall-Geber.

description: The oil level sensor signal voltage reads below the lower limit, typically a short to ground or an open at the reference end of the sender. The ECM treats the input as invalid and ignores oil-low warnings until the circuit is repaired.

specific_definitions.AUDI: Oil level sensor failure, Powertrain Control Module (PCM) failure, Wiring issue

possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Sender shorted internally [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The oil level sensor signal voltage reads below the lower limit, typically a short to ground or an open at the reference end of the sender. The ECM treats the input as invalid and ignores oil-low warnings until the circuit is repaired.
bilingual_description.de: Die Signalspannung des Ölstandssensors liegt unter dem unteren Grenzwert, typisch ein Masseschluss oder eine Unterbrechung am Referenzende des Gebers. Die Motorsteuerung wertet den Eingang als ungültig und ignoriert Niedrigstandswarnungen bis zur Reparatur.

description: The oil level sensor signal voltage reads above the upper limit, typically a short to reference voltage or an open signal return. Pegged at maximum, the ECM cannot distinguish full from invalid and disables the level monitor.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to reference voltage [HIGH]
Open signal return [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The oil level sensor signal voltage reads above the upper limit, typically a short to reference voltage or an open signal return. Pegged at maximum, the ECM cannot distinguish full from invalid and disables the level monitor.
bilingual_description.de: Die Signalspannung des Ölstandssensors liegt über dem oberen Grenzwert, typisch ein Kurzschluss gegen Referenzspannung oder eine offene Signalmasse. Bei Anschlag am Maximum kann die Motorsteuerung Voll nicht von ungültig unterscheiden und schaltet die Pegelüberwachung ab.

description: The oil level signal jumps or drops out intermittently — usually loose contacts, vibration cracks at the sender or oil sloshing on bumpy roads. The ECM filters short transients but flags the input when the noise pattern exceeds the diagnostic limits.
possible_causes: Loose or oil-soaked connector [HIGH]
Cracked sender housing [MEDIUM]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

bilingual_description.en: The oil level signal jumps or drops out intermittently — usually loose contacts, vibration cracks at the sender or oil sloshing on bumpy roads. The ECM filters short transients but flags the input when the noise pattern exceeds the diagnostic limits.
bilingual_description.de: Das Ölstandssignal springt oder fällt aus — meist lockere Kontakte, vibrationsbedingte Risse am Geber oder Ölbewegung auf unebener Strecke. Die Motorsteuerung filtert kurze Aussetzer, meldet den Eingang aber, wenn das Rauschmuster die Diagnosegrenzen überschreitet.

description: The oil level monitor reports the engine oil level below the safe minimum after sensor checks pass. Continued operation risks bearing damage and oil-pump cavitation, so the ECM sets a critical warning, may reduce torque and asks the driver to add oil immediately.
possible_causes: High oil consumption between services [HIGH]
External oil leak [MEDIUM]
Missed top-up since last service [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 10€ - 80€ (0.1h - 0.3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Too Low

bilingual_description.en: The oil level monitor reports the engine oil level below the safe minimum after sensor checks pass. Continued operation risks bearing damage and oil-pump cavitation, so the ECM sets a critical warning, may reduce torque and asks the driver to add oil immediately.
bilingual_description.de: Die Ölstandsüberwachung meldet den Motorölstand unter dem sicheren Minimum, nachdem die Sensorprüfungen bestanden wurden. Weiterer Betrieb gefährdet Lager und führt zu Kavitation der Ölpumpe — die Motorsteuerung setzt eine kritische Warnung, drosselt ggf. das Drehmoment und fordert sofortiges Nachfüllen.

description: The voltage reported on the main power relay sense line for the engine controller does not match expectation. The ECU may shut down too early or stay awake too long, draining the battery.
possible_causes: Main relay contacts pitted [HIGH]
Sense wiring corroded [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 40€ - 400€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Relay Sense Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The voltage reported on the main power relay sense line for the engine controller does not match expectation. The ECU may shut down too early or stay awake too long, draining the battery.
bilingual_description.de: Die am Hauptrelais-Sense-Eingang der Motorsteuerung gemessene Spannung weicht von der Erwartung ab. Das Steuergerät kann zu früh abschalten oder zu lange wach bleiben und die Batterie entladen.

description: The sense (feedback) line that lets the ECM verify the main power relay has actually closed shows intermittent dropouts. The ECM expects to see battery voltage on this line whenever the relay is energised — short losses suggest aged contacts, vibration or chafed wiring.
possible_causes: Aged main relay contacts [HIGH]
Chafed sense wire shorting intermittently [MEDIUM]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: ECM/PCM Power Relay Sense Circuit Intermittent

bilingual_description.en: The sense (feedback) line that lets the ECM verify the main power relay has actually closed shows intermittent dropouts. The ECM expects to see battery voltage on this line whenever the relay is energised — short losses suggest aged contacts, vibration or chafed wiring.
bilingual_description.de: Die Rückmeldeleitung, mit der das ECM prüft, ob das Hauptrelais wirklich geschlossen ist, zeigt sporadische Ausfälle. Bei aktivem Relais wird Batteriespannung erwartet — kurze Aussetzer deuten auf verschlissene Kontakte, Vibrationen oder aufgescheuerte Leitungen.

description: The Event Data Recorder (EDR / black box) request line — used by the ECM or restraint module to trigger the EDR to capture pre-crash data — is open. The ECM cannot trigger an event capture, so any subsequent crash event would not be recorded reliably.
possible_causes: Open request wire or unplugged module [HIGH]
Failed input stage in the EDR [MEDIUM]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Event Data Recorder Request Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The Event Data Recorder (EDR / black box) request line — used by the ECM or restraint module to trigger the EDR to capture pre-crash data — is open. The ECM cannot trigger an event capture, so any subsequent crash event would not be recorded reliably.
bilingual_description.de: Die Anforderungsleitung des Event Data Recorders (EDR / Unfalldatenspeicher) — mit der ECM oder Rückhaltemodul den EDR zur Aufzeichnung der Pre-Crash-Daten anstoßen — ist unterbrochen. Die Motorsteuerung kann kein Aufzeichnungsereignis auslösen, ein späterer Unfall würde nicht zuverlässig protokolliert.

description: The EDR request line reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently asserted request. The ECM either sees a constant request (which it cannot service) or cannot pulse the line high to fire a real event capture.
possible_causes: Request wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Event Data Recorder Request Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The EDR request line reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently asserted request. The ECM either sees a constant request (which it cannot service) or cannot pulse the line high to fire a real event capture.
bilingual_description.de: Die EDR-Anforderungsleitung liegt dauerhaft niedrig — typisch Masseschluss oder dauerhaft anliegende Anforderung. Die Motorsteuerung sieht entweder eine dauernde Anforderung (die sie nicht bedient) oder kann die Leitung nicht hochpulsen, um ein echtes Ereignis auszulösen.

description: The EDR request line reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pulse the line back low to release the request, so the EDR may either ignore further requests or sit in a permanent triggered state.
possible_causes: Request wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Event Data Recorder Request Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The EDR request line reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pulse the line back low to release the request, so the EDR may either ignore further requests or sit in a permanent triggered state.
