bilingual_description.de: Die EDR-Anforderungsleitung liegt dauerhaft hoch — typisch Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Die Motorsteuerung kann die Leitung nicht wieder niedrig pulsen, um die Anforderung zurückzusetzen — der EDR ignoriert weitere Anforderungen oder bleibt im ausgelösten Zustand.

description: General electrical fault in the second A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. Sensor B usually monitors the low-side or compressor-suction pressure (in addition to high-side sensor A). The ECM cannot read a plausible value and disables variable compressor control to avoid evaporator freeze-up or overpressure.
possible_causes: Open or shorted wiring to the sensor [HIGH]
Failed sensor element [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault in the second A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. Sensor B usually monitors the low-side or compressor-suction pressure (in addition to high-side sensor A). The ECM cannot read a plausible value and disables variable compressor control to avoid evaporator freeze-up or overpressure.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Stromkreis des zweiten A/C-Kältemittel-Drucksensors. Sensor B überwacht meist die Niederdruck-/Saugseite (zusätzlich zum Hochdruck-Sensor A). Die Motorsteuerung kann keinen plausiblen Wert lesen und deaktiviert die variable Verdichtersteuerung zum Schutz vor Verdampfer-Vereisung oder Überdruck.

description: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B is electrically intact, but its reading does not match the system model — for example pressures that do not fall when the compressor is off, do not change with ambient temperature, or contradict pressure sensor A. Often a refrigerant charge issue or a contaminated sensor.
possible_causes: Low refrigerant charge [HIGH]
Contaminated or aged sensor diaphragm [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B is electrically intact, but its reading does not match the system model — for example pressures that do not fall when the compressor is off, do not change with ambient temperature, or contradict pressure sensor A. Often a refrigerant charge issue or a contaminated sensor.
bilingual_description.de: Der A/C-Kältemittel-Drucksensor B ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber sein Wert passt nicht zum Systemmodell — Drücke, die bei abgeschaltetem Verdichter nicht fallen, sich nicht mit der Außentemperatur ändern oder Sensor A widersprechen. Oft Kältemittel-Füllmenge oder verschmutzter Sensor.

description: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B signal voltage reads below the lower limit. Either a short to ground in the signal wire, an open reference voltage at the sensor, or an internal short. The ECM ignores the reading and disables A/C closed-loop control until the circuit recovers.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Missing 5 V reference at the sensor [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B signal voltage reads below the lower limit. Either a short to ground in the signal wire, an open reference voltage at the sensor, or an internal short. The ECM ignores the reading and disables A/C closed-loop control until the circuit recovers.
bilingual_description.de: Die Signalspannung des A/C-Kältemittel-Drucksensors B liegt unter dem unteren Grenzwert. Entweder Masseschluss in der Signalleitung, fehlende Referenzspannung am Sensor oder interner Kurzschluss. Die Motorsteuerung verwirft den Wert und deaktiviert die A/C-Regelung bis zur Erholung des Kreises.

description: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B signal voltage reads above the upper limit. Typically a short to reference voltage in the signal line, an open signal return, or an overpressure event briefly pegging the sensor. ECM disables variable compressor control to protect the system.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to reference voltage [HIGH]
Open signal return at the sensor [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B signal voltage reads above the upper limit. Typically a short to reference voltage in the signal line, an open signal return, or an overpressure event briefly pegging the sensor. ECM disables variable compressor control to protect the system.
bilingual_description.de: Die Signalspannung des A/C-Kältemittel-Drucksensors B liegt über dem oberen Grenzwert. Typisch Kurzschluss gegen Referenzspannung in der Signalleitung, offene Signalmasse oder kurzzeitiges Überdruckereignis am Anschlag. Die Motorsteuerung deaktiviert die variable Verdichtersteuerung zum Schutz des Systems.

description: General electrical fault on the A/C compressor request input A. This input tells the ECM that the HVAC controller wants the A/C compressor engaged. With the input invalid, the ECM cannot enable the compressor clutch — A/C does not cool, idle-up compensation is not applied.
possible_causes: Open or shorted A/C request wire [HIGH]
HVAC module not transmitting the request [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Request A Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the A/C compressor request input A. This input tells the ECM that the HVAC controller wants the A/C compressor engaged. With the input invalid, the ECM cannot enable the compressor clutch — A/C does not cool, idle-up compensation is not applied.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am A/C-Verdichter-Anforderungseingang A. Über diesen Eingang meldet das HVAC-Steuergerät, dass der Klima-Verdichter eingeschaltet werden soll. Bei ungültigem Eingang kann die Motorsteuerung die Magnetkupplung nicht aktivieren — keine Kühlung, keine Leerlaufanhebung.

description: The Power Take-Off (PTO) enable switch input to the ECM is open. PTO is used on trucks and work vehicles to drive auxiliary equipment from the engine — without a valid enable signal the ECM refuses to enter PTO operating mode, idle speed control changes do not apply.
possible_causes: Open switch wire or unplugged switch [HIGH]
Failed PTO enable switch [MEDIUM]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Enable Switch Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The Power Take-Off (PTO) enable switch input to the ECM is open. PTO is used on trucks and work vehicles to drive auxiliary equipment from the engine — without a valid enable signal the ECM refuses to enter PTO operating mode, idle speed control changes do not apply.
bilingual_description.de: Der Eingang des Nebenantriebs-Freigabeschalters (PTO) am ECM ist unterbrochen. PTO treibt an Nutzfahrzeugen Anbaugeräte vom Motor an — ohne gültige Freigabe wird der PTO-Modus nicht aktiviert, Leerlaufanpassung greift nicht.

description: The PTO enable switch input reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently closed switch. The ECM either sees PTO enabled when the operator has not requested it, or cannot release the PTO mode after work.
possible_causes: Switch wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Switch stuck closed [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Enable Switch Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The PTO enable switch input reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently closed switch. The ECM either sees PTO enabled when the operator has not requested it, or cannot release the PTO mode after work.
bilingual_description.de: Der PTO-Freigabeschalter-Eingang liegt dauerhaft niedrig — typisch Masseschluss oder dauerhaft geschlossener Schalter. Die Motorsteuerung sieht entweder PTO aktiv ohne Bedieneranforderung oder kann den PTO-Modus nach Arbeitsende nicht verlassen.

description: The PTO enable switch input reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pull the input low, so the switch state is unreadable and PTO mode is locked out for safety.
possible_causes: Switch wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Enable Switch Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The PTO enable switch input reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pull the input low, so the switch state is unreadable and PTO mode is locked out for safety.
bilingual_description.de: Der PTO-Freigabeschalter-Eingang liegt dauerhaft hoch — typisch Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Die Motorsteuerung kann den Eingang nicht auf Low ziehen, der Schalterzustand ist nicht lesbar und der PTO-Modus wird sicherheitshalber gesperrt.

description: The PTO engine-shutdown command line is open. This safety input lets a connected work attachment (or operator switch) request an immediate engine shutdown — for example when an interlock is opened on a stationary aerial work platform. With the line broken, the safety shutdown cannot be commanded.
possible_causes: Broken shutdown wire or unplugged work attachment [HIGH]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Engine Shutdown Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The PTO engine-shutdown command line is open. This safety input lets a connected work attachment (or operator switch) request an immediate engine shutdown — for example when an interlock is opened on a stationary aerial work platform. With the line broken, the safety shutdown cannot be commanded.
bilingual_description.de: Die PTO-Motor-Abschaltleitung ist unterbrochen. Über diesen Sicherheitseingang fordert ein angeschlossenes Arbeitsgerät (oder Bedienerschalter) eine sofortige Motorabschaltung an — etwa wenn an einer stationären Hubarbeitsbühne eine Verriegelung geöffnet wird. Bei unterbrochener Leitung lässt sich die Sicherheitsabschaltung nicht auslösen.

description: The PTO engine-shutdown command line reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a permanently asserted shutdown request. The ECM may treat this as an active shutdown command and refuse to start or keep the engine running while in PTO mode.
possible_causes: Shutdown wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Engine Shutdown Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The PTO engine-shutdown command line reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a permanently asserted shutdown request. The ECM may treat this as an active shutdown command and refuse to start or keep the engine running while in PTO mode.
bilingual_description.de: Die PTO-Motor-Abschaltleitung liegt dauerhaft niedrig — meist Masseschluss oder dauerhaft anliegende Abschaltanforderung. Die Motorsteuerung kann das als aktive Abschaltung werten und im PTO-Modus den Start verweigern oder den Motor abstellen.

description: The PTO engine-shutdown command line reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pulse the line low to acknowledge a shutdown request, so the operator-side safety chain is effectively disabled.
possible_causes: Shutdown wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Engine Shutdown Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The PTO engine-shutdown command line reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pulse the line low to acknowledge a shutdown request, so the operator-side safety chain is effectively disabled.
bilingual_description.de: Die PTO-Motor-Abschaltleitung liegt dauerhaft hoch — typisch Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Die Motorsteuerung kann die Leitung nicht auf Low ziehen, um eine Abschaltung zu quittieren — die bediener-seitige Sicherheitskette ist faktisch außer Funktion.

description: The A/C compressor request input A reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently asserted request. The ECM either sees A/C demanded all the time (cannot release idle-up, raises fuel use) or cannot distinguish a real request from the stuck low level.
possible_causes: Request wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Request A Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The A/C compressor request input A reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently asserted request. The ECM either sees A/C demanded all the time (cannot release idle-up, raises fuel use) or cannot distinguish a real request from the stuck low level.
bilingual_description.de: Der A/C-Anforderungseingang A liegt dauerhaft niedrig — typisch Masseschluss oder dauerhaft anliegende Anforderung. Die Motorsteuerung sieht entweder dauernd A/C aktiv (Leerlaufanhebung lässt sich nicht zurücknehmen, höherer Kraftstoffverbrauch) oder kann eine echte Anforderung nicht vom anhängenden Low-Pegel unterscheiden.

description: The A/C request input A reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pull the line low to read switch state, so the A/C compressor request is treated as invalid and the clutch stays disengaged.
possible_causes: Request wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Request A Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The A/C request input A reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pull the line low to read switch state, so the A/C compressor request is treated as invalid and the clutch stays disengaged.
bilingual_description.de: Der A/C-Anforderungseingang A liegt dauerhaft hoch — typisch Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Die Motorsteuerung kann den Schalterzustand nicht auslesen, die Anforderung gilt als ungültig, die Magnetkupplung bleibt offen.

description: General electrical fault on the second A/C request input B. Many vehicles have two HVAC zones, a rear evaporator request, or a redundant request line — input B carries that signal. With the input invalid, the ECM cannot honour zone B compressor demand or rear-evap operation.
possible_causes: Open or shorted A/C request wire B [HIGH]
HVAC module not transmitting request B [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Request B Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the second A/C request input B. Many vehicles have two HVAC zones, a rear evaporator request, or a redundant request line — input B carries that signal. With the input invalid, the ECM cannot honour zone B compressor demand or rear-evap operation.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am zweiten A/C-Anforderungseingang B. Viele Fahrzeuge haben zwei HVAC-Zonen, einen separaten Heck-Verdampfer oder eine redundante Anforderungsleitung — Eingang B führt dieses Signal. Bei ungültigem Eingang kann die Motorsteuerung Zone B oder den Heck-Verdampfer nicht freigeben.

description: The A/C request input B reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently asserted request. Same effect as input A stuck low, applied to the second HVAC channel.
possible_causes: Request wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Request B Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The A/C request input B reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently asserted request. Same effect as input A stuck low, applied to the second HVAC channel.
bilingual_description.de: Der A/C-Anforderungseingang B liegt dauerhaft niedrig — Masseschluss oder dauerhaft anliegende Anforderung. Wirkt wie Eingang A im Low-Zustand, betrifft den zweiten HVAC-Kanal.

description: The A/C request input B reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot read the switch state, request B is treated as invalid.
possible_causes: Request wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.4h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: A/C Request B Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The A/C request input B reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot read the switch state, request B is treated as invalid.
bilingual_description.de: Der A/C-Anforderungseingang B liegt dauerhaft hoch — typisch Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Die Motorsteuerung kann den Schalterzustand nicht auslesen, Anforderung B gilt als ungültig.

description: General electrical fault on the vacuum reservoir pressure sensor circuit. The reservoir stores manifold or pump-generated vacuum for systems like brake booster, EGR actuators or HVAC dampers. Without a valid reading the ECM disables vacuum-pump duty cycle control.
possible_causes: Open or shorted wiring to the sensor [HIGH]
Failed sensor element [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the vacuum reservoir pressure sensor circuit. The reservoir stores manifold or pump-generated vacuum for systems like brake booster, EGR actuators or HVAC dampers. Without a valid reading the ECM disables vacuum-pump duty cycle control.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Stromkreis des Unterdruckspeicher-Drucksensors. Der Speicher hält Saugrohr- oder pumpenerzeugten Unterdruck für Bremskraftverstärker, EGR-Aktoren oder HVAC-Klappen vor. Ohne gültigen Wert wird die Tastverhältnis-Regelung der Vakuumpumpe deaktiviert.

description: The vacuum reservoir pressure sensor is electrically intact, but the reading does not match the model — vacuum that does not build up after pump activation, does not bleed off when consumers draw, or stays at one value. Often a partly clogged hose, a leaking reservoir or an aged sensor.
possible_causes: Leaking reservoir or vacuum line [HIGH]
Aged sensor with offset drift [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The vacuum reservoir pressure sensor is electrically intact, but the reading does not match the model — vacuum that does not build up after pump activation, does not bleed off when consumers draw, or stays at one value. Often a partly clogged hose, a leaking reservoir or an aged sensor.
bilingual_description.de: Der Unterdruckspeicher-Drucksensor ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber der Wert passt nicht zum Modell — Unterdruck baut sich nach Pumpenstart nicht auf, fällt bei Verbraucherzug nicht ab oder bleibt konstant. Häufig ein teilweise verstopfter Schlauch, ein lecker Speicher oder ein gealterter Sensor.

description: Sensor signal voltage below the lower limit — usually a short to ground or open reference. The ECM disables vacuum pump control until the input recovers.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Missing 5 V reference at the sensor [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Sensor signal voltage below the lower limit — usually a short to ground or open reference. The ECM disables vacuum pump control until the input recovers.
bilingual_description.de: Sensorsignalspannung unter dem unteren Grenzwert — meist Masseschluss oder fehlende Referenz. Die Motorsteuerung deaktiviert die Vakuumpumpensteuerung bis zur Erholung.

description: Sensor signal voltage above the upper limit — usually a short to reference voltage or open signal return. ECM disables vacuum pump control to avoid overshooting.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to reference voltage [HIGH]
Open signal return [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 400€ (0.4h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Sensor signal voltage above the upper limit — usually a short to reference voltage or open signal return. ECM disables vacuum pump control to avoid overshooting.
bilingual_description.de: Sensorsignalspannung über dem oberen Grenzwert — meist Kurzschluss gegen Referenzspannung oder offene Signalmasse. Die Motorsteuerung deaktiviert die Vakuumpumpensteuerung zum Schutz vor Überschwingen.

Chafed harness [MEDIUM]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]

description: General electrical fault on the engine oil quality sensor — typically a capacitive/dielectric sensor that estimates oil aging from permittivity, viscosity proxies and conductivity. With no valid reading the dynamic service-interval algorithm falls back to the fixed-interval default.
possible_causes: Open or shorted wiring to the sensor [HIGH]
Failed sensor electrode after long use [MEDIUM]

bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Motoröl-Qualitätssensor — meist ein kapazitiver/dielektrischer Sensor, der die Ölalterung aus Permittivität, Viskositäts-Surrogaten und Leitfähigkeit schätzt. Ohne gültigen Wert fällt die dynamische Serviceintervall-Berechnung auf den festen Intervall-Default zurück.

description: The oil quality sensor is electrically intact, but the readings do not match the model — for example permittivity that does not change after an oil change, or shifts inconsistent with km/h driven. Often a contaminated electrode or oil that does not fit the sensor calibration.

Oil grade outside the sensor calibration range [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

Häufig eine verschmutzte Elektrode oder Öl, das nicht zur Sensorkalibrierung passt.

description: The oil level monitor reports the engine oil level above the safe maximum after sensor checks pass. Overfilling raises foaming, blow-by and crankcase pressure — and on diesels with regen-by-injection, fuel dilution can drive the level up by itself. The ECM warns the driver and may flag for service.
possible_causes: Overfilled at last service [HIGH]
Fuel dilution from incomplete DPF regeneration [MEDIUM]
Coolant intrusion (head gasket / cooler) [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 10€ - 200€ (0.2h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Level Too High

bilingual_description.en: The oil level monitor reports the engine oil level above the safe maximum after sensor checks pass. Overfilling raises foaming, blow-by and crankcase pressure — and on diesels with regen-by-injection, fuel dilution can drive the level up by itself. The ECM warns the driver and may flag for service.
bilingual_description.de: Die Ölstandsüberwachung meldet den Motorölstand über dem sicheren Maximum, nachdem die Sensorprüfungen bestanden wurden. Überfüllung führt zu Schaumbildung, Blow-by und erhöhtem Kurbelgehäusedruck — bei Dieseln mit Regeneration über Nacheinspritzung kann Kraftstoffeintrag den Pegel selbst anheben. Das Steuergerät warnt den Fahrer und meldet ggf. zum Service.

description: The ECU detects an electrical fault on the ignition switch run position input. The signal indicating that the ignition is in the run position is missing or implausible.
possible_causes: Faulty ignition switch contacts [HIGH]
Wiring or connector fault [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch Run Position Circuit

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects an electrical fault on the ignition switch run position input. The signal indicating that the ignition is in the run position is missing or implausible.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt einen elektrischen Fehler am Eingang fuer die Zuendschloss-Position Run. Das Signal, dass die Zuendung in der Stellung Run steht, fehlt oder ist unplausibel.

description: The ignition switch Run-position input reads stuck low — short to ground or a permanently closed contact. The ECM cannot tell when the operator releases the switch from Run, so accessory and crank logic gets confused.
possible_causes: Run input wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Switch contact stuck closed [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch Run Position Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The ignition switch Run-position input reads stuck low — short to ground or a permanently closed contact. The ECM cannot tell when the operator releases the switch from Run, so accessory and crank logic gets confused.
bilingual_description.de: Der Zündschalter-Eingang für die Run-Position liegt dauerhaft niedrig — Masseschluss oder dauerhaft geschlossener Kontakt. Die Motorsteuerung erkennt das Verlassen der Run-Position nicht, die Logik für Zubehör und Anlasserstart gerät durcheinander.

description: The ignition switch Run-position input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open switch return. The ECM cannot detect when the operator turns the switch back to off/accessory, so module sleep and accessory power timeouts do not work correctly.
possible_causes: Run input wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch Run Position Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The ignition switch Run-position input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open switch return. The ECM cannot detect when the operator turns the switch back to off/accessory, so module sleep and accessory power timeouts do not work correctly.
bilingual_description.de: Der Run-Eingang am Zündschalter liegt dauerhaft hoch — Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung oder offene Schalter-Rückleitung. Die Motorsteuerung erkennt das Zurückdrehen auf Aus/Zubehör nicht — Modulschlaf und Zubehör-Timeouts funktionieren nicht korrekt.

description: General electrical fault on the ignition switch On/Start (terminal 50 / crank) input. The ECM uses this signal to know when the starter is energised — without it the ECM cannot raise fuel and timing for cranking, the engine struggles to start or stalls right after.
possible_causes: Open or shorted On/Start wire [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the ignition switch On/Start (terminal 50 / crank) input. The ECM uses this signal to know when the starter is energised — without it the ECM cannot raise fuel and timing for cranking, the engine struggles to start or stalls right after.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Zündschalter-Eingang On/Start (Klemme 50 / Anlasserkontakt). Die Motorsteuerung nutzt das Signal, um den Anlasserbetrieb zu erkennen — ohne es lassen sich Kraftstoff und Zündzeitpunkt nicht für den Start anheben, der Motor startet schwer oder stirbt direkt nach dem Anspringen ab.

description: The On/Start input reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently closed contact. The ECM may see crank request when the key is at rest, blocking accessory functions or causing unexpected starter cut-off logic.
possible_causes: On/Start wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The On/Start input reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently closed contact. The ECM may see crank request when the key is at rest, blocking accessory functions or causing unexpected starter cut-off logic.
bilingual_description.de: Der On/Start-Eingang liegt dauerhaft niedrig — Masseschluss oder dauerhaft geschlossener Kontakt. Die Motorsteuerung erkennt evtl. eine Startanforderung im Ruhezustand, blockiert Zubehörfunktionen oder löst unerwartete Anlasser-Sperrlogik aus.

description: The On/Start input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot read the crank state, modules dependent on this signal are unable to time their wake-up correctly.
possible_causes: On/Start wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: The On/Start input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot read the crank state, modules dependent on this signal are unable to time their wake-up correctly.
bilingual_description.de: Der On/Start-Eingang liegt dauerhaft hoch — Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Die Motorsteuerung kann den Anlasser-Status nicht auslesen, abhängige Module können ihr Aufwachen nicht korrekt takten.

description: General electrical fault on the ignition switch accessory (terminal 75 / ACC) input. ACC tells the ECM that radio, fans, accessory loads should be powered without the engine running. With the input invalid, the body controller may misjudge accessory power timing.
possible_causes: Open or shorted ACC wire [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Ignition Switch Accessory Position Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the ignition switch accessory (terminal 75 / ACC) input. ACC tells the ECM that radio, fans, accessory loads should be powered without the engine running. With the input invalid, the body controller may misjudge accessory power timing.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Zündschalter-Eingang Zubehör (Klemme 75 / ACC). ACC meldet der Motorsteuerung, dass Radio, Lüfter, Zubehörlasten ohne laufenden Motor versorgt werden sollen. Bei ungültigem Eingang kann das Karosseriemodul das Zubehör-Timing falsch beurteilen.

description: The ACC input reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently closed contact. The ECM may see ACC active continuously and refuse to enter sleep, draining the battery.
possible_causes: ACC wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]

description: The ACC input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot detect when the operator releases the switch from ACC, accessory power timeouts do not work.

description: General electrical fault on the low-pressure fuel system sensor — typically the lift-pump or pre-supply pressure sensor that monitors the rail feeding the high-pressure pump. With no valid reading, the ECM cannot verify that lift pressure is sufficient for HP-pump intake.
possible_causes: Open or shorted wiring to the sensor [HIGH]
Failed sensor element [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 500€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit

bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Sensor des Niederdruck-Kraftstoffsystems — meist der Vorförderdruck-Sensor, der die Versorgung der Hochdruckpumpe überwacht. Ohne gültigen Wert kann die Motorsteuerung nicht prüfen, ob der Vorförderdruck für die HD-Pumpe ausreicht.

description: The PTO sense (engagement feedback) line is open. This input tells the ECM whether the PTO clutch or driveline is actually engaged after a request — it closes the loop on the PTO enable command. With it broken, the ECM cannot confirm engagement and refuses to ramp up to PTO speed setpoints.
possible_causes: Open sense wire [HIGH]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Sense Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The PTO sense (engagement feedback) line is open. This input tells the ECM whether the PTO clutch or driveline is actually engaged after a request — it closes the loop on the PTO enable command. With it broken, the ECM cannot confirm engagement and refuses to ramp up to PTO speed setpoints.
bilingual_description.de: Die PTO-Rückmeldeleitung (Engagement-Feedback) ist unterbrochen. Über diesen Eingang erfährt die Motorsteuerung, ob die PTO-Kupplung oder der Triebstrang nach einer Anforderung tatsächlich eingerückt ist — sie schließt den Regelkreis zur PTO-Freigabe. Bei unterbrochener Leitung kann die Steuerung die Einrückung nicht bestätigen und fährt nicht auf die PTO-Solldrehzahl hoch.

description: The PTO sense circuit is electrically intact, but the engagement feedback does not match the command. The ECM requests engage and sees no engaged feedback (or vice versa) within the expected time window — drive-line slip, sticky clutch, or a mis-adjusted limit switch.
possible_causes: Sticky or worn PTO clutch [HIGH]
Mis-adjusted limit switch [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: PTO Sense Circuit Range/Performance

Die Motorsteuerung kommandiert einrücken und sieht innerhalb des Zeitfensters keine eingerückte Rückmeldung (oder umgekehrt) — Triebstrangschlupf, schwergängige Kupplung oder fehlerhaft justierter Endlagenschalter.

description: The oil quality monitor concludes that the engine oil has reached the end of its useful life — based on permittivity, soot content, fuel dilution and total operating hours. The ECM requests an oil change before the next regen cycle to prevent accelerated bearing wear.

High DPF regeneration load with fuel dilution [MEDIUM]

bilingual_title.en: Engine Oil Deteriorated

bilingual_description.de: Die Ölqualitätsüberwachung kommt zu dem Schluss, dass das Motoröl seine Nutzungsdauer erreicht hat — auf Basis von Permittivität, Rußgehalt, Kraftstoffeintrag und Betriebsstunden. Die Motorsteuerung fordert einen Ölwechsel vor dem nächsten Regenerationszyklus, um beschleunigten Lagerverschleiß zu vermeiden.

description: The ECU detects a general fault in the low-pressure fuel system pressure sensor circuit. Without a valid signal the ECU cannot verify lift-pump pressure or fuel rail pre-pressure.

Wiring or connector fault [MEDIUM]

description: The signal of the low-pressure fuel sensor does not match the expected value during operation. Pressure does not rise as expected when the lift pump is commanded.

Clogged fuel filter [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]

Open signal return [MEDIUM]

Either a short to reference voltage in the signal line, an open signal return, or a sensor reading pegged high after an internal failure. The HP-pump pressure-control strategy falls back to default.

Entweder Kurzschluss gegen Referenzspannung in der Signalleitung, offene Signalmasse oder Sensor am Anschlag nach internem Defekt. Die Druckregelstrategie der HD-Pumpe fällt auf Default zurück.

description: The ECU detects an electrical fault on the power demand input signal used to coordinate accessory loads (e.g. AC compressor, alternator load). The signal is missing or implausible.

Fault in requesting module [MEDIUM]

bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt einen elektrischen Fehler am Leistungsanforderungs-Eingang, der zur Koordination von Nebenverbrauchern dient (z. B. Klimakompressor, Generatorlast). Das Signal fehlt oder ist unplausibel.

description: The ECU detects an invalid torque-management request signal A from another control unit (e.g. transmission, ESP, ABS) on the CAN bus. Cooperative torque control cannot be performed as expected.
possible_causes: CAN communication error [HIGH]
Fault in requesting module [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal A

bilingual_description.en: The ECU detects an invalid torque-management request signal A from another control unit (e.g. transmission, ESP, ABS) on the CAN bus. Cooperative torque control cannot be performed as expected.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt eine unzulaessige Drehmomentanforderung A von einem anderen Steuergeraet (z. B. Getriebe, ESP, ABS) auf dem CAN-Bus. Die kooperative Momentenregelung kann nicht wie erwartet durchgefuehrt werden.

description: The ECM receives torque-management requests from other modules (TCM during shifts, ABS/ESC during traction events, hybrid controller). Input A is electrically intact but its values do not match the system model — out-of-range steps, jumps, or persistent values that other modules cannot confirm.
possible_causes: Requesting module sending invalid values [HIGH]
Communication bus corruption between modules [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 800€ (0.5h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal A Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The ECM receives torque-management requests from other modules (TCM during shifts, ABS/ESC during traction events, hybrid controller). Input A is electrically intact but its values do not match the system model — out-of-range steps, jumps, or persistent values that other modules cannot confirm.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erhält Drehmoment-Anforderungen von anderen Modulen (Getriebesteuerung beim Schalten, ABS/ESC bei Traktionseingriffen, Hybrid-Steuergerät). Eingang A ist elektrisch in Ordnung, aber die Werte passen nicht zum Systemmodell — Sprünge, anhaltende Werte, die andere Module nicht bestätigen.

description: Torque management input A reads stuck low — analog short to ground or message stuck at minimum value. The ECM cannot trust the request and falls back to a safe default.
possible_causes: Signal wire shorted to ground [HIGH]

bilingual_description.en: Same condition as the A-side stuck-low fault, but on the second sensor / second turbo. Position sensor B reads stuck near the low end while the actuator is commanded.
bilingual_description.de: Derselbe Zustand wie der A-seitige Stuck-Low-Fehler, aber am zweiten Sensor / zweiten Turbo. Positionssensor B liegt nahe dem unteren Anschlag, während der Aktor angesteuert wird.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: Same as the A-side stuck-high fault, applied to sensor B / turbo B. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.
possible_causes: Actuator mechanically stuck near high end [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 2500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Performance - Stuck High
bilingual_title.de: Turbolader Ladedruck-Positionssensor B Leistung hoch festgesteckt

bilingual_description.en: Same as the A-side stuck-high fault, applied to sensor B / turbo B. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.
bilingual_description.de: Wie der A-seitige Stuck-High-Fehler, am Sensor B / Turbo B. Die Ladedruck-Regelung vergleicht Soll- und Ist-Saugrohrdruck; anhaltende Abweichung bedeutet, dass Wastegate, VTG-Schaufeln, Schlauch oder Aktuator nicht den geforderten Druck liefern.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: After start-up the boost-control loop on turbo A takes longer than the calibration limit to transition from open-loop to closed-loop control. Typically a slow-warming actuator (VGT vanes carbonised), a sluggish position sensor or a leaky pneumatic actuator that cannot follow setpoints quickly enough.
possible_causes: Carbonised VGT vanes [HIGH]
Leaky pneumatic actuator [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2200€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop Turbocharger A Boost Control
bilingual_title.de: Übermäßige Zeit bis zur geschlossenen Regelung Turbolader A Ladedruck

bilingual_description.en: After start-up the boost-control loop on turbo A takes longer than the calibration limit to transition from open-loop to closed-loop control. Typically a slow-warming actuator (VGT vanes carbonised), a sluggish position sensor or a leaky pneumatic actuator that cannot follow setpoints quickly enough.
bilingual_description.de: Nach dem Start braucht der Ladedruck-Regelkreis am Turbo A länger als kalibriert, um vom offenen in den geschlossenen Regelkreis zu wechseln. Typisch ein langsam reagierender Aktor (VTG-Schaufeln verkokt), ein träger Positionssensor oder ein undichter pneumatischer Aktor, der den Sollwerten nicht schnell genug folgt.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: Same condition as the turbo A excessive-warm-up fault, applied to the second turbo. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.
possible_causes: Carbonised VGT vanes [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2200€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop Turbocharger B Boost Control
bilingual_title.de: Übermäßige Zeit bis zur geschlossenen Regelung Turbolader B Ladedruck

bilingual_description.en: Same condition as the turbo A excessive-warm-up fault, applied to the second turbo. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.
bilingual_description.de: Derselbe Fehlermodus wie beim Turbo A, am zweiten Turbo. Die Ladedruck-Regelung vergleicht Soll- und Ist-Saugrohrdruck; anhaltende Abweichung bedeutet, dass Wastegate, VTG-Schaufeln, Schlauch oder Aktuator nicht den geforderten Druck liefern.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: The boost-control actuator on turbo A has been operating at the low end of its travel for too long — the closed-loop controller is saturated against the lower stop trying to reach the boost setpoint. Indicates either a leak (wastegate held closed but boost still escapes) or commanded boost above what the engine can produce.
possible_causes: Boost leak in the charge-air path [HIGH]
Failing turbocharger that cannot produce target boost [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2500€ (0.8h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Turbocharger A Boost Control Position At Low Limit
bilingual_title.de: Turbolader A Ladedruck-Steuerposition am unteren Limit

bilingual_description.en: The boost-control actuator on turbo A has been operating at the low end of its travel for too long — the closed-loop controller is saturated against the lower stop trying to reach the boost setpoint. Indicates either a leak (wastegate held closed but boost still escapes) or commanded boost above what the engine can produce.
bilingual_description.de: Der Ladedruck-Aktor an Turbo A arbeitet zu lange am unteren Anschlag — der Regler ist gegen die untere Begrenzung gesättigt, um den Sollwert zu erreichen. Hinweis auf eine Leckage (Wastegate geschlossen gehalten, Ladedruck entweicht trotzdem) oder einen Sollwert oberhalb der Motorkapazität.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: The boost-control actuator on turbo A has been operating at the high end of its travel — the controller is saturated against the upper stop trying to bleed off boost. Indicates either a wastegate stuck closed, oversized turbo for the calibration, or commanded boost limits being exceeded by ambient conditions (cold dense air).
possible_causes: Wastegate stuck closed [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2500€ (0.8h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Turbocharger A Boost Control Position At High Limit
bilingual_title.de: Turbolader A Ladedruck-Steuerposition am oberen Limit

bilingual_description.en: The boost-control actuator on turbo A has been operating at the high end of its travel — the controller is saturated against the upper stop trying to bleed off boost. Indicates either a wastegate stuck closed, oversized turbo for the calibration, or commanded boost limits being exceeded by ambient conditions (cold dense air).
bilingual_description.de: Der Ladedruck-Aktor an Turbo A arbeitet zu lange am oberen Anschlag — der Regler ist gegen den oberen Endpunkt gesättigt, um Ladedruck abzubauen. Hinweis auf festgestecktes Wastegate, überdimensionierten Turbo für die Kalibrierung oder Sollwert-Überschreitung durch Umgebungsbedingungen (kalte, dichte Luft).

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At Low Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.
possible_causes: Boost leak in the charge-air path [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2500€ (0.8h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At Low Limit
bilingual_title.de: Turbolader B Ladedruck-Steuerposition am unteren Limit

bilingual_description.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At Low Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.
bilingual_description.de: Turbolader B Ladedruck-Steuerposition am unteren Limit: das Steuergerät hat diesen Fehlerzustand erkannt. Dies betrifft die Ladedruckregelung des Turbo-/Kompressors.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At High Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.
possible_causes: Wastegate stuck closed [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2500€ (0.8h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At High Limit
bilingual_title.de: Turbolader B Ladedruck-Steuerposition am oberen Limit

bilingual_description.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At High Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.
bilingual_description.de: Turbolader B Ladedruck-Steuerposition am oberen Limit: das Steuergerät hat diesen Fehlerzustand erkannt. Dies betrifft die Ladedruckregelung des Turbo-/Kompressors.

symptoms: Charging may not start or interrupts

description: The primary brake system control module (ABS/ESC/iBooster) has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side — for example a regenerative braking fault on a hybrid that affects driveline torque flow. The original fault is in the brake module.
possible_causes: Internal fault in the brake module — read its DTCs [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (0.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Brake System Control Module A Requested MIL Illumination

bilingual_description.en: The primary brake system control module (ABS/ESC/iBooster) has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side — for example a regenerative braking fault on a hybrid that affects driveline torque flow. The original fault is in the brake module.
bilingual_description.de: Das primäre Bremssystem-Steuermodul (ABS/ESC/iBooster) hat die Motorsteuerung aufgefordert, die MIL einzuschalten, weil ein abgasrelevanter Fehler auf seiner Seite vorliegt — z.B. ein Rekuperations-Fehler im Hybrid, der den Drehmomentfluss beeinflusst. Der eigentliche Fehler ist im Bremsmodul.

description: After plausibility checks the body controller has concluded that the engine hood is genuinely open while the vehicle is operating. Used to suspend HV operation on hybrids/EVs (HV interlock), block remote engine start, and trigger the alarm if armed.
possible_causes: Hood not properly latched [HIGH]
Failed hood latch sensor [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 10€ - 250€ (0.1h - 1h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Engine Hood Open

bilingual_description.en: After plausibility checks the body controller has concluded that the engine hood is genuinely open while the vehicle is operating. Used to suspend HV operation on hybrids/EVs (HV interlock), block remote engine start, and trigger the alarm if armed.
bilingual_description.de: Nach Plausibilitätsprüfungen schließt das Karosseriemodul, dass die Motorhaube tatsächlich offen ist, während das Fahrzeug betrieben wird. Wird genutzt, um HV-Betrieb in Hybriden/EVs zu sperren (HV-Verriegelung), Remote-Start zu blockieren und ggf. den Alarm auszulösen.

description: General electrical fault on the fuel mode select switch — used on bi-fuel vehicles (CNG/LPG/H2/gasoline) so the driver can pick the active fuel. With the input invalid, the ECM falls back to the default fuel and disables operator-selectable switching.
possible_causes: Open or shorted switch wire [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit

bilingual_description.en: General electrical fault on the fuel mode select switch — used on bi-fuel vehicles (CNG/LPG/H2/gasoline) so the driver can pick the active fuel. With the input invalid, the ECM falls back to the default fuel and disables operator-selectable switching.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner elektrischer Fehler am Kraftstoff-Modus-Wahlschalter — bei bivalenten Fahrzeugen (CNG/LPG/H2/Benzin) wählt der Fahrer damit den aktiven Kraftstoff. Bei ungültigem Eingang nutzt die Motorsteuerung den Default und deaktiviert die Bediener-Wahl.

description: The fuel mode select switch is electrically intact, but its state does not match operating conditions — switched to gas while gas tank is empty, or fast toggling. The ECM rejects the request to avoid stalling.
possible_causes: Switch contact bounce [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Performance

bilingual_description.en: The fuel mode select switch is electrically intact, but its state does not match operating conditions — switched to gas while gas tank is empty, or fast toggling. The ECM rejects the request to avoid stalling.
bilingual_description.de: Der Wahlschalter ist elektrisch in Ordnung, sein Zustand passt aber nicht zu den Betriebsbedingungen — auf Gas geschaltet bei leerem Gastank oder schnelles Toggeln. Die Motorsteuerung verwirft die Anforderung, um Liegenbleiber zu vermeiden.

description: Fuel mode switch input reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed contact. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Switch wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Fuel mode switch input reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed contact. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Eingang des Kraftstoff-Modus-Schalters liegt dauerhaft niedrig — Masseschluss oder dauerhaft geschlossener Kontakt. Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

description: Fuel mode switch input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Switch wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Fuel mode switch input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Eingang des Kraftstoff-Modus-Schalters liegt dauerhaft hoch — Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung. Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

description: Fuel mode switch signal jumps or drops out — worn contact or vibration. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Worn switch contact [HIGH]
Connector with intermittent contact under vibration [LOW]
Harness routed against vibrating component [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 60€ - 350€ (0.3h - 1.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

bilingual_description.en: Fuel mode switch signal jumps or drops out — worn contact or vibration. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Signal des Kraftstoff-Modus-Schalters springt oder fällt aus — verschlissener Kontakt oder Vibration. Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

description: The piston-cooling oil-jet control circuit is open. Modern engines with under-piston oil jets switch them on under high load to cool the piston crown — controlled by a solenoid valve in the oil gallery. With the circuit broken, jets cannot be commanded on or stay locked off, raising piston temperatures under load.
possible_causes: Open control wire to the solenoid [HIGH]
Open solenoid coil [MEDIUM]
Pin pushed back out of connector body [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1200€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit/Open

bilingual_description.en: The piston-cooling oil-jet control circuit is open. Modern engines with under-piston oil jets switch them on under high load to cool the piston crown — controlled by a solenoid valve in the oil gallery. With the circuit broken, jets cannot be commanded on or stay locked off, raising piston temperatures under load.
bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis der Kolbenkühlölspritzen ist unterbrochen. Moderne Motoren mit Spritzöldüsen schalten diese unter hoher Last zu, um den Kolbenboden zu kühlen — gesteuert über ein Magnetventil in der Ölgalerie. Bei unterbrochenem Kreis lassen sich die Düsen nicht zuschalten oder bleiben gesperrt, die Kolbentemperatur steigt unter Last.

description: The piston-cooling oil-jet control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. The jets may be enabled continuously, raising oil pump load and lowering oil pressure to other consumers.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Harness chafing through insulation [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1200€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: The piston-cooling oil-jet control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. The jets may be enabled continuously, raising oil pump load and lowering oil pressure to other consumers.
bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis liegt dauerhaft niedrig — Masseschluss oder hängender Low-Side-Treiber. Die Spritzdüsen sind ggf. dauernd zugeschaltet, was die Ölpumpenlast erhöht und den Druck für andere Verbraucher senkt.

description: Control circuit stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil/return. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to battery voltage [HIGH]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
Supply wire pinched against B+ source [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1200€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit High

bilingual_description.en: Control circuit stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil/return. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Steuerkreis dauerhaft hoch — Kurzschluss gegen Batteriespannung oder offene Spule/Rückleitung. Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

description: The control circuit is electrically intact, but the solenoid valve does not open when commanded — confirmed by oil-pressure or oil-temperature feedback that does not change after the activation pulse. Piston cooling does not engage under high load — risk of piston-crown overheating and ring-land cracks.
possible_causes: Solenoid stuck closed by oil sludge [HIGH]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
Component wear with age - mechanical play [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 1500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit Performance/Stuck Off

bilingual_description.en: The control circuit is electrically intact, but the solenoid valve does not open when commanded — confirmed by oil-pressure or oil-temperature feedback that does not change after the activation pulse. Piston cooling does not engage under high load — risk of piston-crown overheating and ring-land cracks.
bilingual_description.de: Der Steuerkreis ist elektrisch in Ordnung, das Magnetventil öffnet aber bei Anforderung nicht — bestätigt durch Öldruck- oder Öltemperatur-Rückmeldung, die sich nach dem Aktivierungspuls nicht ändert. Die Kolbenkühlung greift unter Last nicht — Gefahr von Kolbenboden-Überhitzung und Ringland-Rissen.

description: The piston cooling solenoid does not close when commanded off — jets remain active when not needed. Oil pressure to top-end consumers may sag, and warm-up takes longer because the cooling jets remove heat from the pistons during cold start.
possible_causes: Solenoid stuck open [HIGH]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
Component wear with age - mechanical play [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 1500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit Stuck On

bilingual_description.en: The piston cooling solenoid does not close when commanded off — jets remain active when not needed. Oil pressure to top-end consumers may sag, and warm-up takes longer because the cooling jets remove heat from the pistons during cold start.
bilingual_description.de: Das Magnetventil schließt bei Aus-Befehl nicht — die Spritzdüsen bleiben aktiv, auch wenn sie nicht gebraucht werden. Der Öldruck zu Verbrauchern oben kann einbrechen, und der Warmlauf zieht sich, weil die Spritzdüsen die Kolben kühlen.

description: With the piston-cooling jets commanded on, the dedicated oil-pressure sensor in that gallery reads below the safe threshold. Insufficient flow to the jets means real piston cooling is not happening — the ECM warns the driver and may reduce torque to protect the pistons.
possible_causes: Low engine oil level [HIGH]
Sludge-clogged oil gallery [MEDIUM]
Worn oil pump [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 2500€ (1h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Piston Cooling Oil Pressure Too Low

bilingual_description.en: With the piston-cooling jets commanded on, the dedicated oil-pressure sensor in that gallery reads below the safe threshold. Insufficient flow to the jets means real piston cooling is not happening — the ECM warns the driver and may reduce torque to protect the pistons.
bilingual_description.de: Bei zugeschalteten Spritzdüsen liegt der Öldruck im zugehörigen Galerieabschnitt unter dem Sicherheitsschwellwert. Unzureichender Durchfluss zu den Düsen bedeutet, dass keine echte Kolbenkühlung stattfindet — das Steuergerät warnt den Fahrer und reduziert ggf. das Drehmoment zum Schutz der Kolben.

description: A dedicated coolant-temperature control module (used on engines with electric coolant pumps and electronic thermostats to keep the cylinder head and block at independent setpoints) has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side. Original fault is in that module.
possible_causes: Internal fault — read the module DTCs [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1200€ (0.5h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Coolant Temperature Control Module Requested MIL Illumination

bilingual_description.en: A dedicated coolant-temperature control module (used on engines with electric coolant pumps and electronic thermostats to keep the cylinder head and block at independent setpoints) has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side. Original fault is in that module.
bilingual_description.de: Ein eigenes Kühlmitteltemperatur-Steuermodul (bei Motoren mit elektrischer Kühlmittelpumpe und elektronischem Thermostat, das Kopf und Block unabhängig regelt) hat die Motorsteuerung aufgefordert, die MIL einzuschalten, weil ein abgasrelevanter Fehler vorliegt. Der eigentliche Fehler ist in diesem Modul.

description: Fuel level sensor A (typically the float in the main fuel tank section) reports a value that does not change over a long driving distance — the float is mechanically stuck against the tank wall, baffle or pump module. Without level changes the EVAP monitor cannot run and remaining-range estimates are wrong.
possible_causes: Stuck float [HIGH]
Bent float arm catching the tank wall [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 800€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Level Sensor A Stuck

bilingual_description.en: Fuel level sensor A (typically the float in the main fuel tank section) reports a value that does not change over a long driving distance — the float is mechanically stuck against the tank wall, baffle or pump module. Without level changes the EVAP monitor cannot run and remaining-range estimates are wrong.
bilingual_description.de: Kraftstoff-Füllstandssensor A (meist der Schwimmer im Haupttankbereich) meldet einen Wert, der sich über eine lange Fahrstrecke nicht ändert — der Schwimmer hängt mechanisch an der Tankwand, einem Schwall-Schott oder am Pumpenmodul. Ohne Pegeländerung kann der EVAP-Monitor nicht laufen, und die Reichweite stimmt nicht.

description: Same condition as sensor A stuck, applied to the second fuel level sensor B. Saddle tanks (often AWD vehicles) and large trucks use two sensors — one per tank chamber — averaged for total level. A stuck B leaves only A and reduces accuracy.
possible_causes: Stuck float [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 800€ (1h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Level Sensor B Stuck

bilingual_description.en: Same condition as sensor A stuck, applied to the second fuel level sensor B. Saddle tanks (often AWD vehicles) and large trucks use two sensors — one per tank chamber — averaged for total level. A stuck B leaves only A and reduces accuracy.
bilingual_description.de: Derselbe Zustand wie bei Sensor A, am zweiten Füllstandssensor B. Sattel-Tanks (oft AWD) und Lkw nutzen zwei Sensoren — einen pro Kammer — und mitteln den Gesamtpegel. Ein festgesteckter B lässt nur A übrig, die Genauigkeit sinkt.

description: The ECM detects that one of the two level sensors is stuck but cannot identify which from the available signals — for example because the saddle-tank algorithm sees implausible delta only intermittently. Both sensors should be inspected.
possible_causes: One stuck float — inspect both [HIGH]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1000€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Fuel Level Sensor A or B Stuck

bilingual_description.en: The ECM detects that one of the two level sensors is stuck but cannot identify which from the available signals — for example because the saddle-tank algorithm sees implausible delta only intermittently. Both sensors should be inspected.
bilingual_description.de: Die Motorsteuerung erkennt, dass einer der beiden Füllstandssensoren festsitzt, kann aber aus den vorhandenen Signalen nicht eindeutig bestimmen welcher — etwa weil der Sattel-Tank-Algorithmus die unplausible Differenz nur sporadisch sieht. Beide Sensoren prüfen.

description: Wastegate A is mechanically stuck open. Exhaust gas bypasses the turbine even at low load — turbo cannot reach target speed, boost is permanently low and the engine feels asthmatic. Common causes are seized linkage, broken return spring or carbon-locked wastegate flap.
possible_causes: Seized wastegate linkage [HIGH]
Broken return spring [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 2500€ (1.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Wastegate A Stuck Open

bilingual_description.en: Wastegate A is mechanically stuck open. Exhaust gas bypasses the turbine even at low load — turbo cannot reach target speed, boost is permanently low and the engine feels asthmatic. Common causes are seized linkage, broken return spring or carbon-locked wastegate flap.
bilingual_description.de: Wastegate A ist mechanisch offen festgesteckt. Abgas umgeht die Turbine schon bei niedriger Last — der Turbo erreicht die Solldrehzahl nicht, der Ladedruck bleibt dauerhaft niedrig, der Motor fühlt sich asthmatisch an. Häufige Ursachen sind festsitzendes Gestänge, gebrochene Rückholfeder oder rußverklemmte Klappe.

symptoms: Possible blue or black smoke from exhaust
Whistling or hissing sound from intake

description: The engine controller commanded a forced shutdown after detecting unmetered fuel reaching the combustion chambers. Common on diesels with leaking turbo seals or cracked intercoolers that drip oil into the intake — the engine then runs on the oil and can overspeed.

Oil collected in the intercooler is sucked into the engine on load [MEDIUM]

description: The rocker arm actuator B on bank 1 is commanded to engage but does not switch. Engine stays in the wrong lift or cylinder mode under load.

description: The second actuator supply rail is above the expected voltage. Likely a charging system overvoltage or a short to a higher-voltage source.
possible_causes: Alternator regulator failure [MEDIUM]
Wiring shorted to a higher-voltage circuit [LOW]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 150€ - 1000€ (1h - 3.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The high-pressure injection pump timing is offset from the expected reference. On distributor pumps with a timing solenoid, the actuator does not match the commanded position.
possible_causes: Worn timing actuator piston or seal [HIGH]
Stretched pump drive chain or belt [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 3000€ (3h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The injection pump timing learning routine did not complete successfully. Without learned values, injection timing runs from default tables and combustion is suboptimal.

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1.5h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The 7th injector (HC dosing for DPF active regeneration) cannot be driven. Active regeneration cannot raise exhaust temperature, soot accumulates in the DPF.
possible_causes: Open coil in injector solenoid [HIGH]

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Injector A Circuit / Open

bilingual_description.en: The 7th injector (HC dosing for DPF active regeneration) cannot be driven. Active regeneration cannot raise exhaust temperature, soot accumulates in the DPF.
bilingual_description.de: Der 7. Injektor (HC-Dosierung zur aktiven DPF-Regeneration) kann nicht angesteuert werden. Aktive Regeneration kann die Abgastemperatur nicht anheben, Ruß sammelt sich im DPF.

symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder
Possible fuel smell or smoke from exhaust

description: The 7th injector responds to commands but does not deliver expected fuel during regeneration. Coking on the nozzle or worn pressure regulation reduces flow.
possible_causes: Coked nozzle restricts fuel delivery [HIGH]
Fuel pressure to the dosing line out of tolerance [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2000€ (1.5h - 5.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Injector A Performance

bilingual_description.en: The 7th injector responds to commands but does not deliver expected fuel during regeneration. Coking on the nozzle or worn pressure regulation reduces flow.
bilingual_description.de: Der 7. Injektor reagiert auf Befehle, liefert während der Regeneration aber nicht die erwartete Menge. Verkokte Düse oder verschlissene Druckregelung mindert die Förderung.

symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder
Possible fuel smell or smoke from exhaust

description: Voltage on the 7th injector control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in injector coil [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.8h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Glow Plug Control Circuit / Open

bilingual_description.en: The control line for the aftertreatment glow plug (used on some diesels to ignite injected HC during DPF regeneration) is open. Active regeneration cannot start.
bilingual_description.de: Die Steuerleitung der Abgasnachbehandlungs-Glühkerze (bei manchen Dieseln zur Zündung des eingespritzten HC während der DPF-Regeneration) ist offen. Die aktive Regeneration kann nicht starten.

symptoms: Glow plug warning light on (often orange coil symbol)
Hard cold start or no start in cold weather
White smoke from exhaust during warm-up

description: The aftertreatment glow plug control responds to commands but the resulting current draw is out of tolerance. Worn glow plug or high-resistance contact.
possible_causes: Worn glow plug element raises resistance [HIGH]
Corroded connector at glow plug [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 120€ - 700€ (0.8h - 3h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

symptoms: Glow plug warning light on (often orange coil symbol)

description: Voltage on the aftertreatment glow plug control line is below the expected window. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Relay coil short [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 100€ - 600€ (0.8h - 2.5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Das Getriebesteuergerät erkennt eine Unterbrechung in der Steuerleitung des Druckregel-Solenoids J. Beim Ansteuern fließt kein Strom.

description: The current through pressure control solenoid J does not match the commanded value within tolerance. Coil resistance drift or high-resistance contact.
possible_causes: Coil resistance changed by thermal stress [MEDIUM]
High-resistance contact in solenoid connector [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1800€ (1.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid J Control Circuit Range/Performance

bilingual_description.en: The current through pressure control solenoid J does not match the commanded value within tolerance. Coil resistance drift or high-resistance contact.
bilingual_description.de: Der Strom durch das Druckregel-Solenoid J stimmt nicht innerhalb der Toleranz mit dem Sollwert überein. Driftender Spulenwiderstand oder hochohmiger Kontakt.

description: Voltage on the pressure control solenoid J control line is below the expected window. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
possible_causes: Control wire shorted to ground [HIGH]
Internal short in solenoid coil [MEDIUM]
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1800€ (1.5h - 6h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid J Control Circuit Low

bilingual_description.en: Voltage on the pressure control solenoid J control line is below the expected window. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
bilingual_description.de: Die Spannung auf der Steuerleitung des Druckregel-Solenoids J liegt unter dem erwarteten Bereich. Verkabelungsfehler dieser Art kommen typischerweise von Scheuern, Wassereintritt an Steckerdichtungen oder zurückgedrückten Pins — ein Wackeltest am Kabelbaum bei aktivem Code lokalisiert den Fehler oft.

possible_causes: Aged solenoid coil resistance drift [HIGH]

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2500€ (2h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid K
