description: Pressure control solenoid K is commanded on but does not produce the expected pressure. Spool stuck closed or hydraulic feed restricted.
possible_causes: Solenoid spool stuck in closed position [HIGH]
Hydraulic feed restricted by debris [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2500€ (2h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid K Performance/Stuck Off

bilingual_description.en: Pressure control solenoid K is commanded on but does not produce the expected pressure. Spool stuck closed or hydraulic feed restricted.
bilingual_description.de: Das Druckregel-Solenoid K wird angesteuert, liefert aber nicht den erwarteten Druck. Schieber geschlossen festsitzend oder Hydraulik-Zulauf eingeengt.

description: Pressure control solenoid K stays in the activated state when commanded off. Affected hydraulic circuit stays pressurised.
possible_causes: Solenoid spool stuck in open position [HIGH]
TCM output driver stuck on [MEDIUM]
Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2500€ (2h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Pressure Control Solenoid K Stuck On

bilingual_description.en: Pressure control solenoid K stays in the activated state when commanded off. Affected hydraulic circuit stays pressurised.
bilingual_description.de: Das Druckregel-Solenoid K bleibt im aktivierten Zustand, auch wenn die Anforderung zurückgenommen wird. Der zugehörige Hydraulikkreis bleibt unter Druck.

description: The TCM detects an electrical fault on transmission pressure control solenoid K. Hydraulic pressure cannot be modulated as expected, causing harsh or slipping shifts.
possible_causes: Internal solenoid fault [HIGH]
Wiring or connector fault [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 400€ - 2500€ (2h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Pressure control solenoid K shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic faults. Loose connector or marginal coil.

bilingual_description.de: Das Hybrid-Steuergerät erkennt einen allgemeinen Fehler im Stromkreis des Drucksensors der Motor-Trennkupplung. Der Einrückdruck kann nicht zuverlässig überwacht werden.

symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Possible limp mode (locked in one gear)
Slipping or shuddering during gear changes

description: The engine disconnect clutch pressure signal does not match plausibility checks against actuator commands. Sensor drift or installation offset.
possible_causes: Sensor zero point drifted [HIGH]
Sensor mounting loose - bias offset [MEDIUM]
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 500€ - 2800€ (2h - 9h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: The ECM/PCM "A" has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. As this is the engine controller itself, the engine usually will not start or run while the message is missing. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

specific_definitions.AUDI: A faulty PCM, A problem with the control module circuit, A problem with the CAN bus

possible_causes: ECM unpowered (fuse, ground, supply wire) [HIGH]
CAN wiring to ECM broken [MEDIUM]
ECM internally failed [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 2000€ (0.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Lost Communication with ECM/PCM "A"

bilingual_description.en: The ECM/PCM "A" has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. As this is the engine controller itself, the engine usually will not start or run while the message is missing. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.
bilingual_description.de: ECM/PCM "A" — diese Komponente sendet keine Botschaften mehr auf dem Datenbus, sodass andere Steuergeräte die benötigten Informationen nicht mehr erhalten. Da es sich um das Motorsteuergerät selbst handelt, springt der Motor meist nicht an oder läuft nicht, solange die Botschaft fehlt. Typische Ursachen sind fehlende Spannungs- oder Masseversorgung, eine unterbrochene oder kurzgeschlossene CAN-/LIN-Leitung, ein Steckerfehler oder ein interner Defekt der Komponente.

description: The ECU has stopped receiving messages from the transmission control module. The transmission falls into limp-home mode (typically locked in 3rd or 4th gear), the speedometer may stop working, and shift adaptation freezes.
possible_causes: TCM unpowered or grounded poorly [HIGH]
CAN wiring to TCM broken [MEDIUM]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 2000€ (0.5h - 8h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_description.de: Steuergerät hat die Kommunikation zum Sitzsteuermodul A verloren (Fahrersitz mit Memory/Heizung/Ventilation). Ein Kommunikationsausfall mit diesem Modul bricht jede Funktion, die seine Daten benötigt — Diagnosegeräte zeigen 'keine Antwort' und abhängige Steuergeräte können in den Notlauf wechseln.

symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down

garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.5h - 2.5h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Lost Communication With Door Window Motor B

bilingual_description.en: The ECU has lost communication with door window motor B, a smart window motor with its own bus interface. One-touch and anti-pinch operation of that window stops, and it may work only manually, if at all. Causes: loss of power or ground at the motor, a broken bus or supply wire in the door harness, a damaged door connector, or a failed motor module.
bilingual_description.de: Die Verbindung zum Fensterhebermotor B — einem intelligenten Motor mit eigener Busanbindung — ist unterbrochen. Komfort- und Einklemmschutz-Funktionen dieses Fensters fallen aus; es lässt sich allenfalls noch manuell betätigen. Ursachen: fehlende Spannungs- oder Masseversorgung am Motor, eine unterbrochene Bus- oder Versorgungsleitung im Türkabelbaum, ein beschädigter Türstecker oder ein defektes Motormodul.

description: The ECM/PCM is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Implausible engine data can force limp mode or stall the engine. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.
possible_causes: ECM software bug or outdated calibration [MEDIUM]
ECM internal sensor or processing fault [MEDIUM]
CAN corruption causing checksum errors [MEDIUM]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 1500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Invalid Data Received from ECM/PCM

bilingual_description.en: The ECM/PCM is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Implausible engine data can force limp mode or stall the engine. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.
bilingual_description.de: ECM/PCM — diese Komponente ist zwar am Datenbus aktiv, liefert aber unplausible Werte (außerhalb des Bereichs, eingefroren oder mit fehlerhafter Prüfsumme bzw. Zählung). Die empfangenden Steuergeräte verwerfen die Daten. Unplausible Motordaten können den Notlauf erzwingen oder den Motor abstellen. Ursachen sind ein fehlerhafter Sensor am Modul, interne Rechenfehler, eine falsche Software- oder Kalibrierungsversion nach einer Reparatur oder Störungen auf dem Bus.

bilingual_title.en: Invalid Data Received from Driver Assistance System

bilingual_description.en: The Driver Assistance System is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Driver-assist features such as lane keeping or adaptive cruise are disabled. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.
bilingual_description.de: Fahrerassistenzsystem — diese Komponente ist zwar am Datenbus aktiv, liefert aber unplausible Werte (außerhalb des Bereichs, eingefroren oder mit fehlerhafter Prüfsumme bzw. Zählung). Die empfangenden Steuergeräte verwerfen die Daten. Fahrerassistenz-Funktionen wie Spurhalter oder Abstandsregeltempomat werden deaktiviert. Ursachen sind ein fehlerhafter Sensor am Modul, interne Rechenfehler, eine falsche Software- oder Kalibrierungsversion nach einer Reparatur oder Störungen auf dem Bus.

description: Generic fault on the control module itself — internal self-diagnostic flagged a problem with computation, memory, drivers or other internal subsystems.
possible_causes: Module internal fault [HIGH]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
CAN terminating resistor (120 Ω) drifted out of spec [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2500€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Control Module

bilingual_description.en: Generic fault on the control module itself — internal self-diagnostic flagged a problem with computation, memory, drivers or other internal subsystems.
bilingual_description.de: Allgemeiner Fehler im Steuermodul selbst — interne Eigendiagnose hat ein Problem mit Berechnung, Speicher, Endstufen oder anderen internen Subsystemen erkannt.

symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults

description: The control module did not complete its shutdown sequence cleanly — power was lost before housekeeping (saving learned values, freeze frames, adaptations) finished.
possible_causes: Power supply lost before shutdown completed [HIGH]
Bad ground connection [MEDIUM]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 500€ (0.5h - 3h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Control Module Improper Shutdown Performance

bilingual_description.en: The control module did not complete its shutdown sequence cleanly — power was lost before housekeeping (saving learned values, freeze frames, adaptations) finished.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuermodul hat seine Abschaltsequenz nicht sauber beendet — Spannung verloren bevor das Speichern der Lernwerte, Freeze-Frames und Adaptionen abgeschlossen war.

symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults

description: The control module reports a problem with the stored Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) — missing, mismatched between modules, or invalid format.
possible_causes: VIN mismatch after module replacement [HIGH]
VIN not programmed in replacement module [MEDIUM]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 50€ - 400€ (0.5h - 2h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

bilingual_title.en: Vehicle Identification Number

bilingual_description.en: The control module reports a problem with the stored Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) — missing, mismatched between modules, or invalid format.
bilingual_description.de: Das Steuermodul meldet ein Problem mit der gespeicherten Fahrzeug-Identifizierungsnummer (VIN) — fehlt, weicht zwischen Modulen ab oder hat ungültiges Format.

symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module

description: The control module detected battery voltage outside its acceptable operating window. Either too low (drained battery, weak charging) or too high (charging system overvoltage).
possible_causes: Battery aged or sulfated [HIGH]
Alternator regulator fault (over- or undervoltage) [MEDIUM]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 80€ - 600€ (0.3h - 2h labor). DIY feasible with standard tools.

bilingual_title.en: Battery Voltage

Ein Kommunikationsausfall mit diesem Modul bricht jede Funktion, die seine Daten benötigt — Diagnosegeräte zeigen 'keine Antwort' und abhängige Steuergeräte können in den Notlauf wechseln.

symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults

description: Generic fault on the position sensor of the coolant mixing valve. A communication loss with this module breaks any function relying on its data — diagnostic tools may show 'no response' and dependent modules can fall into limp mode.
possible_causes: Position sensor failed [HIGH]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
CAN terminating resistor (120 Ω) drifted out of spec [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 200€ - 1500€ (1h - 4h labor). Professional workshop recommended.

description: Generic fault on the differential pressure sensor across the fuel cell stack — measures the pressure drop between cathode and anode (used to detect membrane damage or flooding).
possible_causes: Sensor failed [HIGH]
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly [LOW]
CAN terminating resistor (120 Ω) drifted out of spec [LOW]
garage_advice: Estimated repair: 300€ - 2000€ (1h - 5h labor). Professional workshop recommended.
